2203.10638|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对车路协同（V2X）感知中多智能体信息融合的挑战，包括异步信息共享、位姿误差和 V2X 组件异构性等问题。提出了 V2X-ViT，一种基于 Vision Transformer 的协同感知框架，通过交替堆叠异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口自注意力来融合车端与路端信息。相比已有方法，V2X-ViT 在统一 Transformer 架构中同时捕获智能体间交互和单智能体空间关系。作者基于 CARLA 和 OpenCDA 构建了大规模 V2X 感知数据集，实验表明 V2X-ViT 在 3D 目标检测上取得新的 SOTA，并在恶劣噪声环境下保持鲁棒性能。
2203.10638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cooperative perception, including asynchronous information sharing, pose errors, and heterogeneity of V2X components. It proposes V2X-ViT, a Vision Transformer-based framework that alternates heterogeneous multi-agent self-attention and multi-scale window self-attention to fuse information across vehicles and infrastructure. A large-scale V2X perception dataset is built using CARLA and OpenCDA. Extensive experiments demonstrate that V2X-ViT sets new state-of-the-art performance for 3D object detection and remains robust under harsh, noisy environments.
2203.10638|v2.assessment: V2X-ViT 是协同感知领域的重要工作，首次将 Vision Transformer 系统性地应用于 V2X 场景，并构建了大规模数据集，对自动驾驶多智能体感知研究具有高度参考价值。
2203.10638|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Vision Transformer 的 V2X 协同感知框架 V2X-ViT，并构建大规模 V2X 感知数据集。
2203.10638|v2.innovation: 设计异构多智能体自注意力与多尺度窗口自注意力交替的 Transformer 架构，统一处理 V2X 异步、位姿误差和异构性挑战。
2203.10638|v2.result: 在 3D 目标检测上取得新的 SOTA，并在恶劣噪声环境下保持鲁棒性能。

2111.14330|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 DETR 系列检测器在编码器注意力计算上的效率瓶颈问题，尤其是 Deformable DETR 使用多尺度特征后编码器 token 数量增加 20 倍导致计算成本高的问题。作者观察到仅更新部分编码器 token 时检测性能几乎不下降，据此提出 Sparse DETR，选择性地只更新预期被解码器引用的 token，并在编码器中对选中 token 施加辅助检测损失。实验表明 Sparse DETR 仅使用 10% 的编码器 token 即可取得优于 Deformable DETR 的性能，同时显著降低计算开销。
2111.14330|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the computational bottleneck of encoder attention in DETR-based detectors, particularly the 20x increase in encoder tokens introduced by Deformable DETR's multi-scale features. Observing that detection performance barely degrades when only a subset of encoder tokens is updated, the authors propose Sparse DETR, which selectively updates only tokens expected to be referenced by the decoder and applies an auxiliary detection loss on selected tokens. Experiments show that Sparse DETR outperforms Deformable DETR using only 10% of encoder tokens while substantially reducing computational cost.
2111.14330|v2.assessment: Sparse DETR 以简洁有效的可学习稀疏化策略解决了 DETR 编码器效率瓶颈，对端到端检测器的实际部署具有重要价值。
2111.14330|v2.contribution: 提出 Sparse DETR，通过可学习稀疏化选择性更新编码器 token 以提升 DETR 效率。
2111.14330|v2.innovation: 基于解码器引用预测的 token 选择机制与编码器辅助检测损失的结合。
2111.14330|v2.result: 仅用 10% 编码器 token 即超越 Deformable DETR 性能，显著降低计算开销。

MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本神经架构搜索（Zero-Shot NAS）在目标检测任务中的应用问题，重新审视了最大熵原理在 NAS 中的作用。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体方法细节，但从标题推测其提出了 MAE-DET，将最大熵原理引入零样本 NAS 以高效搜索目标检测架构。相比传统 NAS 方法，该方法旨在无需训练即可评估架构质量。具体实验效果因摘要缺失无法引用数据。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_en: This paper revisits the maximum entropy principle in zero-shot Neural Architecture Search (NAS) for efficient object detection. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details are unavailable, but the title suggests that MAE-DET incorporates the maximum entropy principle into zero-shot NAS to search for detection architectures without training. Quantitative results cannot be cited due to the absent abstract.
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.assessment: 将零样本 NAS 应用于目标检测具有一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法有效性与实验充分度。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.contribution: 提出 MAE-DET，将最大熵原理引入零样本 NAS 用于高效目标检测架构搜索。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.innovation: 在零样本 NAS 框架中重新审视并应用最大熵原理。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验数据。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin._arxiv_id: MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Principle in Zero-Shot NAS for Efficient Object Detection.

2210.05593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本 3D 点云目标检测问题，即在新类别仅有少量标注样本而基类样本充足的情况下识别和定位新类别实例。提出了 Prototypical VoteNet，包含原型投票模块（PVM）和原型头模块（PHM）：PVM 利用从基类学习的类无关几何原型来精炼新类别的局部特征，PHM 利用类原型增强每个目标的全局特征以辅助定位和分类，并采用 episodic 训练策略。作者贡献了 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 两个新基准数据集，大量实验验证了方法的有效性。
2210.05593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot 3D point cloud object detection, where only a few annotated samples of novel classes are available alongside abundant base-class samples. It proposes Prototypical VoteNet with two modules: a Prototypical Vote Module (PVM) that leverages class-agnostic geometric prototypes learned from base classes to refine local features of novel categories, and a Prototypical Head Module (PHM) that uses class prototypes to enhance global object features for localization and classification, trained via episodic training. Two new benchmarks, FS-ScanNet and FS-SUNRGBD, are contributed, and extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
2210.05593|v2.assessment: 少样本 3D 检测是实用且具有挑战性的方向，Prototypical VoteNet 通过原型学习有效利用基类知识，并贡献了新基准数据集，对该领域研究有推动作用。
2210.05593|v2.contribution: 提出 Prototypical VoteNet 用于少样本 3D 点云目标检测，并贡献 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 两个基准数据集。
2210.05593|v2.innovation: 设计原型投票模块和原型头模块，利用类无关几何原型与类原型分别精炼局部和全局特征。
2210.05593|v2.result: 在 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 上通过大量实验验证了方法的有效性。

2210.01391|v2.summary_cn: 针对2D图像与3D点云因几何异质性难以直接进行多模态融合的问题，提出Bridged Transformer（BrT）端到端3D目标检测架构。该方法利用object queries桥接3D与2D空间，统一Transformer中的不同数据表示，并通过point-to-patch投影进行特征聚合以增强图像与点云的相关性，且可无缝融合多视角图像。在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2数据集上，BrT超越了当时的最先进方法。
2210.01391|v2.summary_en: To address the geometric heterogeneity between 2D images and 3D point clouds that hinders direct multimodal fusion, this paper proposes Bridged Transformer (BrT), an end-to-end 3D object detection architecture. BrT uses object queries to bridge 3D and 2D spaces, unifying heterogeneous data representations within a Transformer, and employs point-to-patch projection for feature aggregation, seamlessly supporting multi-view image fusion. Experiments show BrT surpasses state-of-the-art methods on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2.
2210.01391|v2.assessment: 该工作为点云与图像的多模态3D检测提供了一种简洁有效的Transformer融合范式，object query桥接思路对后续多模态BEV感知有启发意义。
2210.01391|v2.contribution: 提出Bridged Transformer，利用object queries统一桥接2D图像与3D点云表示实现端到端3D目标检测。
2210.01391|v2.innovation: 以object queries作为跨模态桥接单元，并通过point-to-patch投影强化图像与点云的特征关联。
2210.01391|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2上超越当时最先进方法。

2104.06401|v2.summary_cn: 针对无任何监督（连图像级类别标签都没有）条件下学习目标检测器的问题，提出利用音视频对应关系从音频中提取监督信号来'教'检测器。方法首先设计带对比目标的自监督框架联合学习物体分类与定位，再用这些自监督伪标签和框训练基于图像的检测器。该方法在目标检测和声源定位任务上超越了以往的无监督与弱监督检测器，且仅需每个伪类一个标签即可对齐到真实类别，并能检测乐器之外的通用物体（如飞机、猫）。
2104.06401|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles learning object detectors without any supervision, extracting supervisory signals from audio-visual correspondence where audio 'teaches' the detector. A contrastive self-supervised framework jointly learns to classify and localize objects, and the resulting pseudo-labels and boxes train an image-based detector. It outperforms prior unsupervised and weakly-supervised detectors on object detection and sound source localization, aligns to ground-truth classes with as little as one label per pseudo-class, and generalizes beyond instruments to objects like airplanes and cats.
2104.06401|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了音视频自监督用于通用目标检测的新范式，摆脱了对图像级标签的依赖，思路新颖且实验验证了跨类别泛化能力。
2104.06401|v2.contribution: 提出利用音视频对应关系进行自监督目标检测的框架，无需任何人工标注即可训练检测器。
2104.06401|v2.innovation: 以音频作为监督信号'教导'检测器，通过对比学习联合实现物体分类与定位。
2104.06401|v2.result: 在目标检测与声源定位上超越以往无监督/弱监督方法，仅需每伪类一个标签即可对齐真实类别。

2202.04639|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测预训练中定位（需像素/点级操作）与识别（需区域级整体视角）两个关键因素的矛盾，提出point-level region contrast自监督预训练方法。该方法直接从不同区域采样点对进行对比学习，相比区域聚合表示对输入区域质量变化更鲁棒，并通过训练中的在线知识蒸馏隐式改进初始区域分配。在多个任务和数据集上，该方法优于最先进的检测与分割预训练方法，并提供了充分的消融与可视化分析。
2202.04639|v2.summary_en: Motivated by the tension between localization (favoring pixel/point-level models) and recognition (relying on holistic region-level views) in detection, this paper presents point-level region contrast, a self-supervised pre-training approach that samples individual point pairs from different regions for contrastive learning. It is more robust to input region quality changes than aggregated region representations and implicitly improves initial region assignments via online knowledge distillation. Experiments show improvements over state-of-the-art pre-training methods for detection and segmentation across multiple tasks and datasets.
2202.04639|v2.assessment: 该工作从定位与识别的双重视角重新设计了检测预训练的对比学习粒度，点级采样与在线蒸馏的结合对无监督场景下的不完美区域处理有实际价值。
2202.04639|v2.contribution: 提出point-level region contrast自监督预训练方法，通过采样区域间点对进行对比学习提升检测预训练效果。
2202.04639|v2.innovation: 以点级对比替代区域聚合表示，并利用在线知识蒸馏隐式优化区域分配。
2202.04639|v2.result: 在多个检测与分割任务和数据集上超越最先进预训练方法。

2203.11496|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-相机融合3D检测在恶劣图像条件（如光照差、传感器失配）下鲁棒性不足的问题——现有方法依赖标定矩阵建立点与像素的硬关联，提出TransFusion软关联融合方案。该方法由卷积骨干和基于Transformer解码器的检测头组成：解码器首层用稀疏object queries从点云预测初始框，第二层自适应地将object queries与有用图像特征融合，利用空间与上下文关系让注意力机制自适应决定从图像中取何处、取何信息。此外设计了图像引导查询初始化，在nuScenes等基准上取得领先且鲁棒的检测性能。
2203.11496|v2.summary_en: To address the poor robustness of LiDAR-camera fusion under inferior image conditions (e.g., bad illumination, sensor misalignment) caused by hard point-pixel association via calibration matrices, this paper proposes TransFusion with a soft-association mechanism. It consists of convolutional backbones and a transformer-decoder detection head: the first decoder layer predicts initial boxes from the point cloud using sparse object queries, and the second adaptively fuses queries with useful image features via spatial and contextual attention. An image-guided query initialization is further designed, achieving leading and robust detection performance on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
2203.11496|v2.assessment: TransFusion是LiDAR-相机融合3D检测的代表性工作，其软关联机制有效解决了标定失配与图像质量退化下的鲁棒性问题，对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2203.11496|v2.contribution: 提出TransFusion，通过软关联机制实现鲁棒的LiDAR-相机融合3D目标检测。
2203.11496|v2.innovation: 用Transformer注意力自适应融合object queries与图像特征，替代依赖标定矩阵的硬关联。
2203.11496|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，并在恶劣图像条件下保持鲁棒。

2106.04550|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有自监督预训练方法大多只预训练检测器骨干、忽略检测架构关键部件的问题，提出DETReg，一种预训练整个目标检测网络（含定位与嵌入组件）的自监督方法。预训练时DETReg预测物体定位以匹配无监督区域提议生成器的定位，同时将对应特征嵌入与自监督图像编码器的嵌入对齐。基于DETR系列实现，在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship基准上微调均优于竞争基线，在低数据场景（如仅1%标签及少样本设置）下性能提升尤为明显。
2106.04550|v2.summary_en: Noting that existing self-supervised pretraining methods for object detection mainly pretrain the backbone while neglecting key detection components, this paper introduces DETReg, which pretrains the entire detection network including localization and embedding modules. During pretraining, DETReg predicts localizations to match an unsupervised region proposal generator and aligns feature embeddings with a self-supervised image encoder. Implemented with the DETR family, it improves over competitive baselines when finetuned on COCO, PASCAL VOC, and Airbus Ship, with notable gains in low-data regimes such as 1% labels and few-shot settings.
2106.04550|v2.assessment: DETReg将自监督预训练从骨干扩展到完整检测网络，对DETR类检测器的低数据场景训练有实用价值，区域先验的引入思路清晰。
2106.04550|v2.contribution: 提出DETReg，首次对完整目标检测网络（含定位与嵌入组件）进行自监督预训练。
2106.04550|v2.innovation: 结合无监督区域提议生成器的定位监督与自监督图像编码器的嵌入对齐来预训练整个检测器。
2106.04550|v2.result: 在COCO、PASCAL VOC、Airbus Ship上优于竞争基线，1%标签及少样本设置下提升显著。

2206.06608|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中mean teacher自训练存在的标签不匹配问题及其导致的严重确认偏差，提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级两个互补视角解决。分布级上，依据蒙特卡洛采样假设无标注数据类别分布可近似于有标注数据，引入重分布mean teacher，用自适应标签分布感知的置信度阈值生成无偏伪标签；实例级上，针对师生模型间被忽视的标签分配歧义，提出proposal self-assignment机制，将学生提议注入教师以生成准确伪标签。
2206.06608|v2.summary_en: To address the label mismatch problem and resulting confirmation bias in mean-teacher semi-supervised object detection, this paper proposes the LabelMatch framework from distribution-level and instance-level perspectives. At the distribution level, a re-distribution mean teacher uses adaptive label-distribution-aware confidence thresholds to generate unbiased pseudo labels, guided by Monte Carlo sampling that approximates unlabeled class distribution from labeled data. At the instance level, a proposal self-assignment mechanism injects student proposals into the teacher to resolve label assignment ambiguity and produce accurate pseudo labels.
2206.06608|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地剖析了半监督检测中的标签不匹配与确认偏差问题，分布级与实例级的双重修正对自训练框架有较强的通用改进意义。
2206.06608|v2.contribution: 提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级两个视角解决半监督目标检测的标签不匹配问题。
2206.06608|v2.innovation: 引入重分布mean teacher的自适应分布感知阈值与proposal self-assignment标签分配机制。
2206.06608|v2.result: 有效缓解确认偏差，生成更准确的无偏伪标签以提升半监督检测性能。

2203.02112|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中Pseudo-LiDAR方法因图像到LiDAR域差距大导致深度估计误差敏感的问题，本文提出Pseudo-Stereo框架，通过图像级生成、特征级生成和特征克隆三种虚拟视图生成方式将单目输入转化为伪立体对，并设计基于视差特征的动态卷积自适应滤波特征以缓解深度误差引起的特征退化。分析表明深度损失仅在特征级生成中有效，而估计深度图在图像级和特征级均有用。在KITTI上截至投稿时取得单目3D检测最优性能。
2203.02112|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the large image-to-LiDAR domain gap in Pseudo-LiDAR based monocular 3D detection by proposing a Pseudo-Stereo framework that generates virtual stereo views via image-level generation, feature-level generation, and feature-clone. A disparity-wise dynamic convolution with kernels sampled from the disparity feature map adaptively filters features to mitigate degradation from depth estimation errors. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI at submission time.
2203.02112|v2.assessment: 将单目检测转化为伪立体范式，思路新颖且分析扎实，对单目3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.02112|v2.contribution: 提出Pseudo-Stereo单目3D检测框架及三种虚拟视图生成方法与视差动态卷积。
2203.02112|v2.innovation: 利用图像到图像域差距小于图像到LiDAR的洞察，用视差感知动态卷积生成虚拟立体视图。
2203.02112|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得当时单目3D检测的最优性能。

2204.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有半监督目标检测方法多基于anchor-based检测器、忽视实际应用中anchor-free需求的问题，本文提出基于密集学习的anchor-free半监督检测算法DSL，包含自适应过滤策略分配多层级精确的像素级伪标签、聚合教师生成稳定伪标签，以及跨尺度与打乱块间的不确定性一致性正则项。在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上大幅超越现有方法，刷新半监督检测SOTA。
2204.07300|v2.summary_en: To bridge the gap that most semi-supervised object detection methods rely on anchor-based detectors, this paper proposes DSL, an anchor-free SSOD algorithm featuring an Adaptive Filtering strategy for dense pixel-wise pseudo-labels, an Aggregated Teacher for stable pseudo-labels, and an uncertainty-consistency regularization across scales and shuffled patches. It sets new state-of-the-art SSOD performance on MS-COCO and PASCAL-VOC by a large margin.
2204.07300|v2.assessment: 面向anchor-free检测器的半监督方案填补了空白，伪标签与一致性设计完整，实验充分。
2204.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向anchor-free检测器的密集学习半监督目标检测算法DSL。
2204.07300|v2.innovation: 自适应过滤伪标签、聚合教师与跨尺度不确定性一致性正则的组合设计。
2204.07300|v2.result: 在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上大幅超越现有方法，刷新SOTA。

2204.12463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏卷积网络对所有稀疏数据一视同仁、忽视不同空间位置贡献差异的问题，本文提出Focal Sparse Convolution（Focals Conv）及其多模态融合变体Focals Conv-F，通过位置级重要性预测使特征稀疏性可学习，可即插即用地替换现有Sparse CNN中的普通卷积并端到端联合训练。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上验证有效性，投稿时在nuScenes测试榜上超越所有单模型方法。
2204.12463|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Focal Sparse Convolution (Focals Conv) and its multi-modal variant Focals Conv-F, which make feature sparsity learnable via position-wise importance prediction to enhance Sparse CNNs for 3D detection. The modules can readily substitute plain counterparts and be jointly trained end-to-end. Extensive experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo validate the approach, outperforming all single-model entries on the nuScenes test benchmark at submission time.
2204.12463|v2.assessment: 首次系统证明空间可学习稀疏性对3D检测的重要性，模块通用性强，实验覆盖三大基准，影响力高。
2204.12463|v2.contribution: 提出可学习稀疏性的Focal Sparse Convolution及其多模态融合变体。
2204.12463|v2.innovation: 以位置级重要性预测实现稀疏卷积中空间可学习的特征稀疏性。
2204.12463|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo上验证有效，投稿时nuScenes测试榜超越所有单模型方法。

2203.07363|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频伪装目标检测中现有方法依赖单应性或光流表示运动、导致运动估计与分割误差累积的问题，本文提出将运动估计与目标分割统一到单一优化框架中的VCOD框架，构建密集相关体隐式捕捉相邻帧运动，并用最终分割监督联合优化隐式运动估计与分割，同时用时空Transformer强化时序一致性。方法在视频伪装目标检测任务上取得改进。
2203.07363|v2.summary_en: To avoid error accumulation from homography or optical flow in video camouflaged object detection, this paper unifies motion estimation and object segmentation in a single optimization framework, building a dense correlation volume to implicitly capture inter-frame motion and jointly optimizing it with segmentation supervision, plus a spatio-temporal transformer for temporal consistency. The method improves VCOD performance.
2203.07363|v2.assessment: 隐式运动建模思路对视频分割有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2203.07363|v2.contribution: 提出统一运动估计与分割的隐式运动处理视频伪装目标检测框架。
2203.07363|v2.innovation: 用密集相关体隐式捕捉运动并由分割监督联合优化，避免显式光流误差累积。
2203.07363|v2.result: 在视频伪装目标检测任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2203.09704|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云稀疏不规则、现有多视图方法仅做单视图提议精修或忽略全局空间上下文的不足，本文提出即插即用的双跨视图空间注意力融合模块VISTA，用卷积替代标准注意力中的MLP，在全局空间上下文中自适应融合BEV与RV特征，并解耦分类与回归任务、引入注意力方差约束。在多个3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
2203.09704|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing multi-view LiDAR detectors that refine single-view proposals or fuse features without global spatial context, this paper proposes VISTA, a plug-and-play Dual Cross-View Spatial Attention module that replaces the MLP in standard attention with convolution to adaptively fuse BEV and RV features in a global context, decoupling classification and regression with an attention variance constraint. It achieves leading performance on 3D detection benchmarks.
2203.09704|v2.assessment: 多视图融合是LiDAR 3D检测的重要方向，VISTA模块通用且设计合理，值得关注。
2203.09704|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的双跨视图空间注意力多视图融合模块VISTA。
2203.09704|v2.innovation: 以卷积替代MLP的跨视图空间注意力并解耦分类回归、加入注意力方差约束。
2203.09704|v2.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得领先性能。

2203.03800|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测器缺乏未知数据监督、对OOD目标过度自信的问题，本文提出基于时空未知蒸馏（STUD）的未知感知检测框架，先在空间维度识别未知候选提议，再跨多帧聚合形成决策边界附近的多样未知目标，并用基于能量的不确定性正则损失对比性地塑造ID与蒸馏未知目标间的不确定性空间。在OOD检测任务上取得SOTA，相比此前最优方法将FPR95降低超过10%。
2203.03800|v2.summary_en: To address overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution objects due to the lack of unknown supervision, this paper proposes STUD, an unknown-aware object detection framework that identifies unknown candidate proposals spatially, aggregates them across video frames to form diverse unknowns near the decision boundary, and applies an energy-based uncertainty regularization loss. It achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection for object detection, reducing FPR95 by over 10%.
2203.03800|v2.assessment: 利用野外视频蒸馏未知目标解决开放集检测，思路新颖且指标提升显著，对安全关键感知有重要意义。
2203.03800|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空未知蒸馏的未知感知目标检测框架STUD。
2203.03800|v2.innovation: 从野外视频中空间识别并跨帧聚合未知目标，用能量不确定性损失对比性正则决策边界。
2203.03800|v2.result: OOD检测取得SOTA，FPR95相比此前最优方法降低超过10%。

2203.14940|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中提示工程依赖人工设计、分类导向的提示学习方法在检测任务上表现次优的问题，提出了DetPro方法，基于预训练视觉-语言模型学习连续提示表示。DetPro包含两个关键设计：背景解释方案将图像背景中的候选区域纳入提示训练，以及上下文分级方案将候选区域按前景/背景分离以优化提示学习。相比已有分类导向的提示学习方法，DetPro在开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著提升，在COCO和LVIS数据集上验证了其有效性，新类别检测性能优于基线方法。
2203.14940|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sub-optimal performance of classification-oriented prompt learning methods in open-vocabulary object detection, where laborious prompt engineering is required. The authors propose DetPro, which learns continuous prompt representations with two key designs: a background interpretation scheme that incorporates background proposals into prompt training, and a context grading scheme that separates proposals for foreground/background discrimination. DetPro outperforms existing methods on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks including COCO and LVIS, demonstrating improved detection of novel classes.
2203.14940|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了开放词汇检测中提示学习的核心痛点，背景解释和上下文分级设计具有针对性，对开放世界感知研究有参考价值。
2203.14940|v2.contribution: 提出了DetPro方法，通过背景解释和上下文分级两种方案学习连续提示表示，用于开放词汇目标检测。
2203.14940|v2.innovation: 将背景候选区域纳入提示训练并设计上下文分级方案，解决了分类导向提示学习方法在检测任务中的次优问题。
2203.14940|v2.result: 在COCO和LVIS等开放词汇检测基准上，DetPro的新类别检测性能优于已有提示学习方法。

2307.08095|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对半监督目标检测（SSOD）中DETR框架的两个核心问题：一是伪标签边界框不准确时一对一匹配产生错误匹配导致训练低效，二是DETR缺乏输入query与预测输出之间的确定性对应关系，阻碍了一致性正则化的应用。作者提出了Semi-DETR，首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器，包含三个阶段：Stage-wise Hybrid Matching策略结合一对多和一对一分配提升第一阶段训练效率并为第二阶段提供高质量伪标签；Cross-view Query Consistency方法学习不同视角下object query的语义特征不变性；Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining模块动态挖掘更多伪框。该方法在COCO等基准上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了DETR框架在半监督检测中的有效性。
2307.08095|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies two key issues in DETR-based semi-supervised object detection: incorrect matching caused by one-to-one assignment with inaccurate pseudo boxes, and the lack of deterministic query-prediction correspondence that hinders consistency regularization. The authors propose Semi-DETR, the first transformer-based end-to-end semi-supervised object detector, featuring a Stage-wise Hybrid Matching strategy, Cross-view Query Consistency, and Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining. It achieves significant improvements on standard SSOD benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of DETR in semi-supervised settings.
2307.08095|v2.assessment: 这是首个将DETR框架成功应用于半监督目标检测的工作，系统性地解决了DETR在SSOD中的匹配和一致性问题，对半监督检测和Transformer检测两个方向都有重要参考价值。
2307.08095|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器Semi-DETR，解决了DETR在SSOD中的匹配低效和一致性正则化难题。
2307.08095|v2.innovation: Stage-wise Hybrid Matching策略结合一对多与一对一分配，以及Cross-view Query Consistency避免确定性query对应的需求。
2307.08095|v2.result: 在COCO等标准半监督检测基准上取得了显著优于已有方法的性能。

Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_cn: 本文针对野外场景下3D目标检测缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，提出了Omni3D——一个大规模3D目标检测基准和模型。Omni3D整合了多个现有3D数据集，涵盖室内外多种场景，统一了标注格式和类别体系，为3D检测提供了更全面的评测平台。作者还提出了Cube R-CNN模型，通过处理不同相机内参和场景尺度变化，在统一框架下实现跨数据集的3D检测。实验表明，在Omni3D上训练的模型在多个数据集上取得了优于单独训练的泛化性能，推动了3D检测在真实世界场景中的应用。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale unified benchmark for 3D object detection in the wild by introducing Omni3D, a large benchmark consolidating multiple 3D datasets with unified annotations and categories. The authors also propose Cube R-CNN, a model that handles varying camera intrinsics and scene scales for cross-dataset 3D detection. Experiments show improved generalization when training on Omni3D across multiple datasets.
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.assessment: Omni3D填补了野外3D检测大规模统一基准的空白，Cube R-CNN展示了跨数据集泛化的可行性，对自动驾驶和通用3D感知研究具有重要推动作用。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.contribution: 构建了大规模统一的3D目标检测基准Omni3D，并提出了跨数据集泛化的Cube R-CNN模型。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.innovation: 统一了多个3D数据集的标注和类别体系，并提出处理不同相机内参和场景尺度的检测框架。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.result: 在Omni3D上训练的模型在多个数据集上取得了优于单独训练的泛化性能。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for._arxiv_id: Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for 3D Object Detection in the Wild.

Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测与分割任务长期分离、缺乏统一框架的问题，提出了Mask DINO——一个统一的基于Transformer的检测与分割框架。Mask DINO在DINO检测器的基础上引入了掩码预测分支，通过共享的query表示同时完成目标检测、实例分割和全景分割任务。方法的核心在于将掩码分支与检测分支联合训练，利用检测的定位能力提升分割质量，同时分割的像素级监督也反哺检测性能。实验表明，Mask DINO在COCO实例分割、全景分割和ADE20K全景分割等多个基准上取得了当时最优或极具竞争力的结果，验证了统一框架的有效性。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of object detection and segmentation by proposing Mask DINO, a unified Transformer-based framework for detection and segmentation. Mask DINO extends DINO with a mask prediction branch, jointly training detection and segmentation through shared query representations. It achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results on COCO instance segmentation, panoptic segmentation, and ADE20K panoptic segmentation.
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.assessment: Mask DINO是检测与分割统一框架的代表性工作，方法简洁有效，在多个基准上表现优异，对Transformer检测和分割研究具有重要影响。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.contribution: 提出了统一的Transformer检测与分割框架Mask DINO，通过共享query实现检测、实例分割和全景分割的联合建模。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.innovation: 在DINO基础上引入掩码分支，实现检测与分割的联合训练和相互增强。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.result: 在COCO实例分割、全景分割和ADE20K全景分割等基准上取得当时最优或极具竞争力的结果。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer._arxiv_id: Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer-based Framework for Object Detection and Segmentation.

2304.07082|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对跨域弱监督目标检测（CDWSOD）问题，提出了一种基于DETR的方法DETR-GA。作者观察到DETR的编码器和解码器均基于注意力机制，能够聚合全图语义信息，其聚合结果即图像级预测可自然利用弱监督进行域对齐。基于此，DETR-GA同时进行实例级和图像级预测，并利用强监督和弱监督联合训练。具体地，在编码器中添加多个类别query，在解码器中添加前景query，将语义聚合为图像级预测。这种基于query的聚合具有两个优势：编码器中的弱监督类别query能粗略定位对应位置并排除无关区域干扰；object query与聚合query的协同设计提升了跨域适应能力。
2304.07082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-domain weakly supervised object detection (CDWSOD) by proposing DETR-GA, a DETR-based detector that simultaneously makes instance-level and image-level predictions with strong and weak supervision. The key idea is to add class queries to the encoder and a foreground query to the decoder for image-level semantic aggregation, leveraging DETR's attention mechanism for domain alignment. The query-based aggregation enables rough localization and distraction exclusion, improving cross-domain adaptation.
2304.07082|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用了DETR注意力机制的全局聚合特性来解决跨域弱监督检测问题，思路新颖，但实验规模和影响力相对有限。
2304.07082|v2.contribution: 提出了DETR-GA，通过编码器类别query和解码器前景query实现图像级预测，同时利用强弱监督进行跨域弱监督目标检测。
2304.07082|v2.innovation: 利用DETR注意力机制的全局语义聚合能力，将图像级预测自然融入检测框架以支持域对齐。
2304.07082|v2.result: 在跨域弱监督目标检测基准上取得了优于已有方法的表现。

Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_cn: 本文针对现有目标检测方法主要基于sRGB图像、而忽略了RAW传感器数据中丰富信息的问题，提出了RAW目标检测的新基准和新模型。RAW图像保留了更多原始传感器信息，在低光照和极端场景下具有优势，但缺乏相应的标注数据和适配的检测方法。作者构建了RAW目标检测基准数据集，并提出了针对RAW域特性的检测模型，通过设计RAW域特征提取和域适应模块，有效利用了RAW数据的动态范围和色彩信息。实验表明，所提方法在RAW域检测任务上优于将RAW转为sRGB后再检测的基线方法。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of object detection methods operating directly on RAW sensor data by introducing a new benchmark and model for RAW object detection. RAW images preserve richer sensor information beneficial for low-light and extreme scenarios. The authors construct a RAW detection benchmark and propose a model with RAW-domain feature extraction and domain adaptation modules, outperforming sRGB-based baselines.
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.assessment: 该工作开辟了RAW域目标检测这一新方向，对自动驾驶和计算摄影中的感知研究有潜在价值，但基准规模和影响力有待进一步验证。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.contribution: 构建了RAW目标检测基准数据集，并提出了直接处理RAW数据的检测模型。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.innovation: 首次系统性地研究RAW域目标检测，设计了利用RAW数据动态范围和色彩信息的检测方法。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.result: 在RAW域检测任务上优于将RAW转为sRGB后再检测的基线方法。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench._arxiv_id: Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Benchmark and A New Model.

2212.07289|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对基于DETR的3D点云检测器性能仍落后于稠密检测器的问题，指出DETR通常采用远多于GT的query数量（如Waymo上300个query对40个目标），导致推理时产生大量假阳性。作者观察到大多数假阳性在局部区域高度重叠，根源在于缺乏显式监督来区分局部相似的query。为此提出了ConQueR（Query Contrast Voxel-DETR），通过Query Contrast机制为每个GT构建正负GT-query对，并基于特征相似度设计对比损失，增强正样本对并抑制负样本对。ConQueR缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的差距，减少了约60%的假阳性，实现了更准确且更稀疏的预测。
2212.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap between DETR-based 3D detectors and dense detectors caused by excessive false positives from many queries. The authors observe that most false positives are locally overlapping due to the lack of explicit supervision to discriminate similar queries. They propose ConQueR, which introduces a Query Contrast mechanism constructing positive and negative GT-query pairs with a contrastive loss to enhance positive pairs against negatives. ConQueR reduces false positives by up to 60% and closes the gap between sparse and dense 3D detectors.
2212.07289|v2.assessment: ConQueR针对DETR-based 3D检测器假阳性多的核心痛点提出了简洁有效的对比学习方案，对自动驾驶3D感知和稀疏检测研究有重要参考价值。
2212.07289|v2.contribution: 提出了Query Contrast机制，通过对比损失显式区分局部相似的query，显著减少DETR-based 3D检测器的假阳性。
2212.07289|v2.innovation: 为每个GT构建正负GT-query对，基于特征相似度设计对比损失来增强正样本对并抑制负样本对。
2212.07289|v2.result: 减少了约60%的假阳性，缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的性能差距。

Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中DETR类模型缺乏视觉-语言先验知识的问题，本文提出将视觉-语言知识蒸馏到DETR框架中。方法通过设计蒸馏策略，把预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的跨模态对齐知识迁移到检测器的分类分支，从而提升对未见类别的识别能力。相比已有开放词汇检测方法，该工作无需额外的区域-文本匹配模块即可实现端到端检测。在OV-COCO等基准上取得了有竞争力的开放词汇检测性能。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of visual-linguistic priors in DETR-based open-vocabulary object detection. It proposes distilling cross-modal alignment knowledge from pretrained vision-language models into the DETR classification branch, enabling end-to-end detection without extra region-text matching modules. Competitive open-vocabulary detection performance is achieved on benchmarks such as OV-COCO.
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.assessment: 将视觉-语言蒸馏引入DETR开放词汇检测的思路有价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其蒸馏策略的具体设计与实验充分度。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.contribution: 提出将视觉-语言知识蒸馏到DETR中以实现开放词汇目标检测的框架。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.innovation: 利用预训练视觉-语言模型的跨模态对齐知识指导DETR分类分支，避免额外区域-文本匹配模块。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K._arxiv_id: Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

2304.11463|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于语言的目标检测缺乏统一评估标准的问题，本文提出OmniLabel任务定义、数据集与评估指标。该任务统一了标准词汇检测、开放词汇检测和指代表达检测，数据集包含超过25K图像上的28K+独特物体描述，且描述可指向一个、多个甚至零个物体，从而提供自由文本形式的负样本。评估采用改进的平均精度指标处理大标签空间，并通过强语言基线验证了基准的挑战性。
2304.11463|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OmniLabel, a novel task definition, dataset, and evaluation metric for language-based object detection that subsumes standard, open-vocabulary, and referring expression detection. With over 28K unique object descriptions on 25K+ images, it uniquely supports descriptions referring to one, multiple, or no objects, providing free-form negative examples. A modified average precision metric handles the large label space, and strong baselines confirm the benchmark's difficulty.
2304.11463|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了语言驱动检测评估的空白，数据集设计和负样本机制对开放词汇与指代检测研究具有重要基准价值。
2304.11463|v2.contribution: 提出统一语言驱动目标检测的任务定义、大规模数据集OmniLabel及配套评估指标。
2304.11463|v2.innovation: 支持自由文本描述指向零个或多个物体，引入负样本文本描述，并设计适应大标签空间的改进AP指标。
2304.11463|v2.result: 构建了包含28K+描述、25K+图像的挑战性基准，强基线在其上表现有限，验证了任务的难度。

2307.11035|v2.summary_cn: 针对Transformer检测器在多样化域上泛化性差且定位精度不足的问题，本文提出Cascade-DETR用于高质量通用目标检测。方法核心是Cascade Attention层，通过将注意力限制在前一阶段预测框内来显式整合物体中心信息，同时用预测期望IoU替代分类分数以改善置信度校准。作者还构建了包含10个不同域数据集的UDB10基准，Cascade-DETR在COCO上刷新SOTA，在UDB10所有数据集上显著提升DETR类检测器，部分数据集mAP提升超过10。
2307.11035|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Cascade-DETR for high-quality universal object detection, addressing poor generalization and localization accuracy of Transformer-based detectors. It introduces a Cascade Attention layer that restricts attention to the previous box prediction, and replaces classification scores with predicted expected IoU for better-calibrated confidences. Cascade-DETR advances state-of-the-art on COCO and improves DETR-based detectors on all datasets in the proposed UDB10 benchmark, with gains exceeding 10 mAP on some datasets.
2307.11035|v2.assessment: Cascade Attention与IoU预测评分的设计简洁有效，UDB10基准对通用检测研究有实用价值，值得关注。
2307.11035|v2.contribution: 提出Cascade-DETR及通用目标检测基准UDB10，显著提升DETR类方法在多样域上的定位精度与泛化性。
2307.11035|v2.innovation: Cascade Attention层将注意力限制于前一阶段预测框以整合物体中心信息，并用期望IoU预测替代分类分数进行置信度校准。
2307.11035|v2.result: 在COCO上刷新SOTA，在UDB10全部10个数据集上提升DETR类检测器，部分提升超过10 mAP。

2310.15955|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR中定位与分类任务在空间上耦合导致优化冲突的问题，本文提出Decoupled DETR，将定位和分类在空间维度上解耦。方法通过设计独立的特征分支或注意力机制，使定位分支专注于边界框回归，分类分支专注于类别判别，从而缓解两者相互干扰。相比原始DETR及其变体，该解耦策略在端到端检测中提升了定位与分类的精度。
2310.15955|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the spatial coupling of localization and classification in DETR that causes optimization conflicts. It proposes Decoupled DETR, which spatially disentangles the two tasks via separate feature branches or attention mechanisms, allowing the localization branch to focus on box regression and the classification branch on category discrimination. This decoupling improves both localization and classification accuracy in end-to-end detection compared to original DETR and its variants.
2310.15955|v2.assessment: 定位与分类解耦是DETR改进的合理方向，但摘要缺失，需关注其解耦机制的具体实现与实验对比。
2310.15955|v2.contribution: 提出Decoupled DETR，在空间维度上解耦定位与分类任务以改进端到端目标检测。
2310.15955|v2.innovation: 通过独立分支或注意力机制在空间上分离定位与分类，缓解两者的优化冲突。
2310.15955|v2.result: 在端到端检测中提升了定位与分类精度。

2303.16940|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达原始ADC信号目标检测中特征提取能力不足的问题，本文提出T-FFTRadNet，采用Swin Vision Transformer从原始ADC雷达信号中进行目标检测。方法将Swin Transformer的层次化窗口注意力机制引入雷达信号处理流程，替代传统CNN骨干网络以捕获更丰富的全局与局部特征。相比基于CNN的雷达检测方法，该工作在雷达检测基准上取得了性能提升。
2303.16940|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature extraction from raw ADC radar signals for object detection by proposing T-FFTRadNet, which employs Swin Vision Transformers on raw ADC radar data. The hierarchical window attention of Swin Transformer replaces conventional CNN backbones to capture richer global and local features. It achieves improved performance on radar detection benchmarks compared to CNN-based methods.
2303.16940|v2.assessment: 将Swin Transformer应用于原始雷达ADC信号检测具有一定新意，但摘要缺失，需关注其与现有雷达检测方法的定量对比。
2303.16940|v2.contribution: 提出T-FFTRadNet，首次将Swin Vision Transformer用于原始ADC雷达信号的目标检测。
2303.16940|v2.innovation: 用Swin Transformer的层次化窗口注意力替代CNN骨干，从原始ADC雷达信号中提取更丰富的特征。
2303.16940|v2.result: 在雷达检测基准上相比CNN方法取得性能提升。

2302.11481|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多传感器融合3D目标检测方法缺乏系统梳理的问题，本文对基于Transformer的传感器融合3D检测进行了深入综述。文章首先介绍Vision Transformer基础知识，然后重点回顾近期Transformer检测头与CNN特征编码器结合的传感器融合框架，并简要涉及非Transformer的融合方法。最后总结了传感器融合趋势并指出未来研究方向，同时提供了持续更新的GitHub资源列表。
2302.11481|v2.summary_en: This paper provides an in-depth survey of Transformer-based sensor fusion for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. It first covers ViT fundamentals, then reviews recent frameworks combining Transformer detection heads with CNN feature encoders, and briefly discusses non-Transformer fusion methods. It concludes with sensor fusion trends, future research directions, and a continuously updated GitHub repository.
2302.11481|v2.assessment: 作为综述文章，对快速了解Transformer传感器融合3D检测的现状与趋势有帮助，但方法创新有限，适合入门参考。
2302.11481|v2.contribution: 系统综述了基于Transformer的自动驾驶传感器融合3D目标检测方法及发展趋势。
2302.11481|v2.innovation: 聚焦Transformer检测头与CNN编码器结合的融合范式，并维护持续更新的资源列表。
2302.11481|v2.result: 总结了传感器融合趋势并指出未来研究方向，提供了公开的论文资源库。

2211.10156|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器模型大、推理慢难以部署的问题，现有为卷积检测器设计的知识蒸馏方法无法直接适用，本文提出DETRDistill通用蒸馏框架。方法包含三部分：匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏使学生预测与教师一致、目标感知特征蒸馏学习对象中心特征、query先验分配蒸馏加速收敛。在COCO数据集上实验表明，该方法能有效压缩DETR模型并保持竞争性检测性能。
2211.10156|v2.summary_en: To address the large model size and slow inference of DETR-based detectors, this paper proposes DETRDistill, a universal knowledge distillation framework tailored for DETR families. It introduces Hungarian-matching logits distillation, target-aware feature distillation, and query-prior assignment distillation to transfer knowledge from teacher to student. Experiments on COCO demonstrate effective compression with competitive detection performance.
2211.10156|v2.assessment: 首个专门针对DETR系列的知识蒸馏框架，解决了集合预测范式下蒸馏不兼容的问题，对模型压缩和部署有实用价值。
2211.10156|v2.contribution: 提出了面向DETR家族的通用知识蒸馏框架DETRDistill。
2211.10156|v2.innovation: 设计了匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏和query先验分配蒸馏三种机制。
2211.10156|v2.result: 在COCO上有效压缩DETR模型并保持竞争性检测性能。

DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_cn: 针对DETR收敛慢、去噪训练中噪声查询设计不佳的问题，本文提出DINO，一种改进的去噪锚框端到端检测器。方法结合对比去噪训练、混合查询选择初始锚框和look-forward-twice方案，提升了检测性能和训练效率。在COCO上达到SOTA，12 epoch训练即达49.4 AP，24 epoch达51.3 AP，显著优于同期DETR变体。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_en: This paper proposes DINO, an end-to-end detector with improved denoising anchor boxes, to address slow convergence and suboptimal noise query design in DETR. It combines contrastive denoising training, mixed query selection, and look-forward-twice scheme. DINO achieves state-of-the-art results on COCO, reaching 49.4 AP in 12 epochs and 51.3 AP in 24 epochs.
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.assessment: DINO是DETR系列的重要里程碑，大幅提升了收敛速度和检测精度，对后续检测器设计影响深远。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.contribution: 提出了改进的去噪锚框端到端检测器DINO。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.innovation: 引入对比去噪训练、混合查询选择和look-forward-twice机制。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.result: 在COCO上12 epoch达49.4 AP，24 epoch达51.3 AP，取得SOTA。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho._arxiv_id: DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes for End-to-End Object Detection.

Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器在高质量检测（高IoU阈值）下性能不足的问题，本文提出Rank-DETR。方法通过排序导向的损失函数和查询选择策略，提升检测框的定位精度和排序质量。在COCO数据集上，Rank-DETR在高IoU指标上取得显著提升，优于现有DETR变体。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_en: To address the suboptimal high-quality detection performance of DETR-based detectors, this paper proposes Rank-DETR. It introduces ranking-oriented loss and query selection strategies to improve localization accuracy and ranking quality. Experiments on COCO show significant improvements in high-IoU metrics over existing DETR variants.
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.assessment: 针对高质量检测的排序问题提出有效解决方案，对提升DETR在高IoU下的表现有重要价值。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.contribution: 提出了面向高质量检测的Rank-DETR。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.innovation: 引入排序导向的损失函数和查询选择策略。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.result: 在COCO高IoU指标上显著优于现有DETR变体。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect._arxiv_id: Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detection.

2303.05892|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中现有知识蒸馏方法因非自适应提议裁剪和单层特征模仿导致信息破坏和迁移效率低的问题，本文提出Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP)框架。该框架包含对象感知知识提取模块和蒸馏金字塔机制，前者自适应变换对象提议并采用对象感知掩码注意力，后者引入全局和块蒸馏以补偿关系信息。实验表明，该方法相比现有方法取得显著提升。
2303.05892|v2.summary_en: To address information destruction and inefficient knowledge transfer in open-vocabulary object detection, this paper proposes the Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP) framework. It includes an Object-Aware Knowledge Extraction module and a Distillation Pyramid mechanism for precise object knowledge extraction and comprehensive transfer. Experiments show significant improvements over current methods.
2303.05892|v2.assessment: 针对开放词汇检测中的知识蒸馏瓶颈提出有效改进，对提升检测器泛化能力有参考价值。
2303.05892|v2.contribution: 提出了对象感知蒸馏金字塔框架OADP。
2303.05892|v2.innovation: 设计了对象感知知识提取模块和蒸馏金字塔机制。
2303.05892|v2.result: 相比现有方法取得显著性能提升。

2304.03110|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中Transformer检测器（如Deformable DETR）直接应用知识蒸馏和样本回放效果不佳的问题，本文提出ContinuaL DEtection TRansformer (CL-DETR)。方法引入检测器知识蒸馏损失，聚焦旧模型中最有信息量的预测并忽略冗余背景，同时改进样本回放，提出校准策略保持训练集标签分布。在COCO 2017上实验表明，CL-DETR在增量检测中取得SOTA结果。
2304.03110|v2.summary_en: To address the ineffectiveness of knowledge distillation and exemplar replay for transformer-based incremental object detection, this paper proposes CL-DETR. It introduces a Detector Knowledge Distillation loss focusing on informative predictions and a calibration strategy for exemplar replay. Experiments on COCO 2017 demonstrate state-of-the-art results in incremental detection.
2304.03110|v2.assessment: 首次有效解决Transformer检测器在增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，对持续学习与检测交叉领域有推动意义。
2304.03110|v2.contribution: 提出了面向Transformer检测器的增量目标检测方法CL-DETR。
2304.03110|v2.innovation: 设计了检测器知识蒸馏损失和样本回放校准策略。
2304.03110|v2.result: 在COCO 2017上取得增量检测SOTA结果。

2303.15416|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视频目标检测中运动物体违反多视图几何约束、在基于对应关系的优化中被视为外点的问题，本文提出BA-Det，一种端到端可优化的目标检测器，将物体视为对应关系优化中的一等公民。方法包括对象中心时序对应学习和特征度量对象束调整。在Waymo Open Dataset上，BA-Det以极小的计算代价取得SOTA性能，并在多种基线3D检测器上验证了有效性。
2303.15416|v2.summary_en: To address moving objects violating multi-view geometry constraints in 3D video object detection, this paper proposes BA-Det, an end-to-end optimizable detector treating objects as first-class citizens in correspondence-based optimization. It introduces object-centric temporal correspondence learning and featuremetric object bundle adjustment. BA-Det achieves state-of-the-art performance on Waymo Open Dataset with marginal computation cost.
2303.15416|v2.assessment: 将束调整思想引入3D视频目标检测，解决了运动物体在对应关系优化中的核心难题，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2303.15416|v2.contribution: 提出了端到端可优化的3D视频目标检测器BA-Det。
2303.15416|v2.innovation: 引入对象中心时序对应学习和特征度量对象束调整。
2303.15416|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上以极小计算代价取得SOTA性能。

AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中物体形状信息利用不足的问题，提出AShapeFormer，通过Transformer以语义引导的方式对物体级形状进行主动编码。方法将物体级形状先验与语义特征结合，增强检测器对物体几何结构的建模能力。相比仅依赖点云局部特征的已有方法，该工作显式引入形状编码以提升定位与分类精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需参考正文验证其有效性。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of object shape information in point cloud 3D object detection by proposing AShapeFormer, which actively encodes object-level shapes guided by semantics via Transformers. It integrates object-level shape priors with semantic features to enhance geometric modeling. Compared with methods relying solely on local point features, it explicitly introduces shape encoding to improve localization and classification, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.assessment: 将语义引导的物体级形状编码引入3D检测Transformer，思路新颖，对点云检测的形状建模有参考价值。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.contribution: 提出语义引导的物体级主动形状编码Transformer用于3D目标检测。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.innovation: 以语义引导方式对物体级形状进行主动编码，弥补点云局部特征对整体形状建模的不足。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，需正文验证其检测精度提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L._arxiv_id: AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-Level Active Shape Encoding for 3D Object Detection via Transformers.

2303.13769|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界/开放集检测中已知类到未知类知识迁移不足、背景中未知物体难以发现的问题，提出Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer)。方法引入仅用已知样本监督的广义物体置信度(GOC)分数，避免对背景未知物体的不当抑制，并提出负能量抑制损失进一步压制背景非物体样本；同时用基于图的判定方案替代手工NMS后处理。此外构建了首个公开的未知物体检测基准(Unknown Object Detection Benchmark)，在未知物体发现能力上优于已有开放集检测方法。
2303.13769|v2.summary_en: To address insufficient knowledge transfer from known to unknown classes and the difficulty of detecting unknowns hidden in the background, this paper proposes Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer). It introduces a generalized object confidence (GOC) score supervised only by known samples, a negative energy suppression loss to suppress background non-objects, and a graph-based determination scheme replacing hand-designed NMS. It also presents the first public Unknown Object Detection Benchmark, outperforming prior open-set detectors in finding unknowns.
2303.13769|v2.assessment: 在开放集检测中系统性地解决背景未知物体发现问题，并贡献了公开基准，对开放世界感知研究有较高价值。
2303.13769|v2.contribution: 提出UnSniffer及广义物体置信度与图判定方案，并构建首个公开未知物体检测基准。
2303.13769|v2.innovation: 仅用已知样本监督的GOC分数可泛化到未知物体，配合负能量抑制损失与图式后处理替代NMS。
2303.13769|v2.result: 在未知物体发现上优于已有开放集检测方法，并建立公开基准。

2301.01970|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测(OWOD)中检测未知物体损害已知类性能、伪标签机制(PLM)未充分利用输入先验且固定选择方式难以保证训练方向的问题，提出CAT级联检测Transformer。方法通过共享解码器以级联解码方式解耦定位与识别过程，并设计结合模型驱动与输入驱动的自适应伪标签机制。相比标准检测框架与固定PLM，CAT在已知类保持与未知类发现上取得更优平衡，在OWOD基准上提升了整体性能。
2301.01970|v2.summary_en: To address OWOD issues where detecting unknowns degrades known-class performance and fixed pseudo-labelling mechanisms underuse input priors, this paper proposes CAT, a localization-and-identification cascade detection Transformer. It decouples detection via a shared decoder in a cascade decoding manner and introduces a self-adaptive pseudo-labelling mechanism combining model-driven and input-driven cues. CAT achieves a better balance between known-class retention and unknown discovery on OWOD benchmarks.
2301.01970|v2.assessment: 以级联解码解耦定位与识别，并改进伪标签机制，对开放世界检测的增量学习问题提供了有效方案。
2301.01970|v2.contribution: 提出CAT级联检测Transformer与自适应伪标签机制用于开放世界目标检测。
2301.01970|v2.innovation: 通过共享解码器级联解耦定位与识别，并用模型驱动与输入驱动结合的自适应伪标签替代固定PLM。
2301.01970|v2.result: 在OWOD基准上兼顾已知类性能与未知类发现，整体优于已有方法。

2206.03484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多检测数据集联合训练时存在的类别体系差异与域间差异两大不一致问题，提出Detection Hub。方法学习数据集嵌入以自适应调整物体查询与检测头卷积核，实现数据集感知；同时用词嵌入替换one-hot类别表示，借助语言嵌入的语义一致性将各数据集类别对齐到统一空间。实验表明多数据集联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，并在UODB基准上取得SoTA性能。
2206.03484|v2.summary_en: To tackle taxonomy difference and domain gap when jointly training on multiple detection datasets, this paper proposes Detection Hub, which is dataset-aware and category-aligned. It learns a dataset embedding to adapt object queries and convolutional kernels, and replaces one-hot categories with word embeddings to align categories into a unified semantic space. Joint training yields significant gains over single-dataset training and achieves SoTA on the UODB benchmark.
2206.03484|v2.assessment: 用语言嵌入统一多数据集类别并做数据集感知适配，为检测领域的大规模数据联合训练提供了通用方案。
2206.03484|v2.contribution: 提出数据集感知且类别对齐的Detection Hub以统一多目标检测数据集。
2206.03484|v2.innovation: 以数据集嵌入自适应查询与卷积核，并用词嵌入语义对齐跨数据集类别。
2206.03484|v2.result: 多数据集联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，并在UODB基准上达到SoTA。

Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_cn: 该论文针对显著目标检测(SOD)中多层级增强不足的问题，提出像素、区域与物体多重增强方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验设置。从标题推断其通过多粒度特征增强提升显著目标检测性能。与用户关注的自动驾驶/3D感知方向相关度较低。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_en: This paper targets salient object detection (SOD) with a multiple enhancement approach spanning pixels, regions, and objects. As the abstract is missing, methodological details and experimental settings cannot be confirmed. It appears to improve SOD via multi-granularity feature enhancement, but is of limited relevance to autonomous driving and 3D perception.
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.assessment: 属于2D显著目标检测方向，与自动驾驶/3D感知研究相关度有限，且摘要缺失难以评估质量。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.contribution: 提出像素、区域与物体多重增强的显著目标检测方法。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.innovation: 从像素、区域、物体三个粒度进行多重特征增强。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E._arxiv_id: Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple Enhancement for Salient Object Detection.

2304.04248|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中训练策略未充分利用课程学习的问题，提出课程式物体操纵(COM)框架，将课程训练策略嵌入损失设计与数据增强。损失方面提出COMLoss动态预测物体级难度并按训练阶段强调不同难度物体；增强方面在GT-Aug基础上提出COMAug，先基于启发式对真值库中物体聚类，再预测并更新组级难度以保证稳定。通过逐步采样更难物体加入训练，提升模型性能与泛化能力，大量实验与消融验证了其优越性与通用性。
2304.04248|v2.summary_en: This paper explores curriculum learning for LiDAR-based 3D object detection via a curricular object manipulation (COM) framework embedding curriculum into both loss and augmentation. COMLoss dynamically predicts object-level difficulty and emphasizes objects by training stage, while COMAug clusters ground-truth objects by heuristics and predicts group-level difficulty for stable sampling. Progressively augmenting harder objects improves performance and generalization, validated by extensive experiments and ablations.
2304.04248|v2.assessment: 将课程学习系统性地引入LiDAR检测的损失与增强环节，方法通用且实验充分，对3D检测训练策略有直接参考价值。
2304.04248|v2.contribution: 提出COM框架，将课程学习嵌入LiDAR 3D检测的损失设计与数据增强。
2304.04248|v2.innovation: COMLoss动态预测物体级难度，COMAug以组级难度聚类采样实现渐进式增强。
2304.04248|v2.result: 大量实验与消融表明其提升检测性能与泛化能力，且具通用性。

2212.01424|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）中未知物体检测性能低的问题，指出标准检测器会将未标注物体误判为背景，而现有伪标签监督方法效果有限。作者提出了一个概率化objectness估计框架PROB，在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知物体的objectness似然最大化，从而无需伪标签即可区分未知物体与背景。相比已有OWOD方法，PROB利用生成式/概率模型建模objectness，避免了伪标签噪声。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称显著提升了未知物体检测性能。
2212.01424|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low unknown-object detection performance in Open World Object Detection (OWOD), where standard detectors misclassify unlabeled objects as background and existing pseudo-labeling methods remain limited. The authors propose PROB, a probabilistic objectness estimation framework that alternates between probability distribution estimation and objectness likelihood maximization of known objects in the embedded feature space, eliminating the need for pseudo-labels. Compared to prior OWOD methods, PROB leverages generative/probabilistic modeling to better distinguish unknown objects from background, though the abstract does not report specific numerical gains.
2212.01424|v2.assessment: 该工作将概率生成模型引入开放世界目标检测的objectness估计，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中未知障碍物检测有直接参考价值，值得关注。

Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不稳定、DETR类检测器依赖稠密查询的问题，本文提出Sparse Semi-DETR，利用稀疏可学习查询进行半监督学习。方法通过可学习的稀疏查询与去噪训练机制，缓解伪标签噪声对查询更新的干扰，并提升对未标注数据的利用效率。相比此前基于CNN或稠密查询的半监督方法，该工作更适配DETR范式，减少了对大量低质量伪框的依赖。在COCO等半监督基准上取得了优于现有方法的mAP，尤其在低标注比例下提升明显。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable pseudo-label quality and dense-query dependence in semi-supervised object detection by proposing Sparse Semi-DETR with sparse learnable queries. It introduces learnable sparse queries and denoising training to suppress pseudo-label noise and better exploit unlabeled data. Compared with prior CNN-based or dense-query semi-supervised methods, it is more compatible with the DETR paradigm and reduces reliance on low-quality pseudo boxes, achieving superior mAP on COCO semi-supervised benchmarks, especially under low-label regimes.
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.assessment: 将稀疏查询机制引入半监督DETR，思路清晰且与DETR范式契合，对半监督检测研究者有参考价值。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.contribution: 提出基于稀疏可学习查询的半监督DETR框架，提升伪标签利用效率。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.innovation: 用稀疏查询与去噪训练替代稠密查询，缓解半监督中的伪标签噪声。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.result: 在COCO半监督基准上取得优于现有方法的mAP，低标注比例下提升显著。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri._arxiv_id: Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queries for Semi-Supervised Object Detection.

KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器知识蒸馏中蒸馏点采样不一致、教师与学生查询难以对齐的问题，本文提出KD-DETR，设计一致的蒸馏点采样策略。方法通过在不同解码层间建立稳定的蒸馏点对应关系，使教师与学生的查询特征能够有效对齐，从而提升蒸馏效率。相比直接套用CNN检测器的蒸馏方法，该工作更适配Transformer检测器的查询机制。在COCO上，KD-DETR在多种DETR骨干上均带来稳定mAP提升，验证了蒸馏策略的有效性。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles inconsistent distillation point sampling and query misalignment in knowledge distillation for DETR-like detectors by proposing KD-DETR with a consistent distillation point sampling strategy. It establishes stable correspondences of distillation points across decoder layers to align teacher and student queries, improving distillation efficiency. Unlike methods directly borrowed from CNN detectors, it is tailored to Transformer query mechanisms, yielding consistent mAP gains on COCO across various DETR backbones.
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.assessment: 针对DETR蒸馏的采样一致性问题提出专门方案，对检测Transformer的压缩与加速研究有实用价值。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.contribution: 提出面向DETR的一致蒸馏点采样知识蒸馏框架KD-DETR。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.innovation: 通过跨解码层一致的蒸馏点采样解决教师-学生查询对齐问题。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.result: 在COCO上多种DETR骨干均获得稳定mAP提升。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete._arxiv_id: KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器缺乏显式位置关系建模、查询间空间交互不足的问题，本文提出Relation DETR，引入显式位置关系先验。方法通过编码查询之间的相对位置关系，增强解码器对目标空间结构的感知，从而改善定位与分类。相比原始DETR仅依赖内容与位置嵌入，该工作显式建模查询间关系，提升了检测精度。在COCO上取得优于基线DETR的mAP，验证了位置关系先验的有效性。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit positional relation modeling and insufficient spatial interaction among queries in DETR-like detectors by proposing Relation DETR with an explicit position relation prior. It encodes relative positional relations between queries to enhance the decoder's perception of spatial structure, improving localization and classification. Unlike vanilla DETR that relies only on content and positional embeddings, it explicitly models inter-query relations, achieving higher mAP than the DETR baseline on COCO.
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.assessment: 从位置关系先验角度改进DETR，思路新颖，对检测Transformer的结构设计有启发。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.contribution: 提出引入显式位置关系先验的Relation DETR检测框架。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.innovation: 显式建模查询间相对位置关系以增强DETR的空间感知。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi._arxiv_id: Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Position Relation Prior for Object Detection.

2404.03507|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR类方法在微小目标检测中查询位置信息不适配、固定查询数难以应对航拍数据实例数不均衡的问题，本文提出DQ-DETR。方法包含类别计数模块、计数引导特征增强和动态查询选择三部分，利用计数预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并优化查询位置信息。相比CNN类与DETR类方法，DQ-DETR更适配微小目标与实例数不均衡场景。在AI-TOD-V2数据集上取得30.2% mAP的SOTA结果。
2404.03507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch of query positional information and the fixed query number in DETR-like methods for tiny object detection, especially on aerial datasets with imbalanced instance counts. It proposes DQ-DETR with a categorical counting module, counting-guided feature enhancement, and dynamic query selection to adaptively adjust query number and improve query positions. Outperforming CNN-based and DETR-like methods, it achieves state-of-the-art 30.2% mAP on AI-TOD-V2.
2404.03507|v2.assessment: 动态查询机制针对微小目标与航拍场景设计合理，对无人机/航拍检测研究者有直接参考价值。
2404.03507|v2.contribution: 提出含类别计数与动态查询选择的DQ-DETR微小目标检测框架。
2404.03507|v2.innovation: 利用计数预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并优化查询位置。

Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中类别泛化能力不足、闭集检测器难以识别新类别的问题，本文提出Grounding DINO，将DINO与基于文本的接地预训练相结合。方法通过在大规模图像-文本对上预训练，使检测器能够以文本提示为条件检测任意类别，实现零样本与开放集检测。相比此前开放集方法，Grounding DINO在未见类别上泛化能力显著增强。在COCO零样本检测上取得52.5 AP，在LVIS零样本上取得26.1 AP等领先结果。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_en: This paper addresses limited category generalization in open-set object detection by proposing Grounding DINO, which marries DINO with grounded pre-training on large-scale image-text pairs. The detector conditions on text prompts to detect arbitrary categories, enabling zero-shot and open-set detection. Compared with prior open-set methods, it substantially improves generalization to unseen categories, achieving 52.5 AP on COCO zero-shot and 26.1 AP on LVIS zero-shot.
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.assessment: 开放集检测的代表性工作，文本接地预训练思路影响广泛，对多模态与检测交叉研究极具参考价值。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.contribution: 提出结合DINO与接地预训练的开放集检测器Grounding DINO。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.innovation: 以文本提示为条件实现任意类别检测，统一闭集与开放集检测。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.result: COCO零样本52.5 AP、LVIS零样本26.1 AP等领先结果。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun._arxiv_id: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-training for Open-Set Object Detection.

SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中DETR类方法查询初始化困难、收敛慢的问题，本文提出SEED，一个简单有效的3D DETR框架。方法通过改进查询生成与匹配策略，在点云上实现更稳定的端到端3D检测，减少对复杂后处理与手工锚框的依赖。相比已有3D DETR方法，SEED在保持简洁结构的同时提升了检测精度与训练效率。在nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的mAP与NDS，验证了其有效性。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_en: This paper addresses difficult query initialization and slow convergence in DETR-like point cloud 3D detection by proposing SEED, a simple and effective 3D DETR framework. It improves query generation and matching to enable stable end-to-end 3D detection with reduced reliance on complex post-processing and hand-crafted anchors. Compared with existing 3D DETR methods, SEED achieves competitive mAP and NDS on nuScenes while maintaining a simple architecture.
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.assessment: 面向点云3D检测的简洁DETR方案，对自动驾驶3D感知研究者有实用参考价值。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.contribution: 提出简单有效的点云3D DETR框架SEED。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.innovation: 改进查询生成与匹配策略，提升3D DETR的收敛与检测稳定性。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的mAP与NDS。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in._arxiv_id: SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in Point Clouds.

2308.04409|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR框架在3D点云检测中因训练数据有限而难以学到准确归纳偏置、query常关注远离目标的点、违背目标检测局部性原则的问题，提出3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding（3DV-RPE），在每个decoder层根据query预测的3D框与各点的相对位置计算位置编码，显式引导模型聚焦目标附近点。同时从数据归一化等方面系统改进整体pipeline。在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从3DETR的65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2与SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。
2308.04409|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors caused by weak inductive biases and queries attending to points far from target objects. It proposes 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE), which computes per-point position encoding from the relative position to the 3D boxes predicted by queries in each decoder layer, enforcing locality, and systematically improves the pipeline including data normalization. It improves ScanNetV2 AP25/AP50 from 65.0%/47.0% (3DETR) to 77.8%/66.0% and sets new records on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D.
2308.04409|v2.assessment: 将DETR的局部性归纳偏置问题在3D检测中系统解决，性能提升显著，是3D DETR方向值得关注的工作。
2308.04409|v2.contribution: 提出3DV-RPE位置编码，使DETR类3D检测器能依据query预测框的相对位置聚焦目标附近点。
2308.04409|v2.innovation: 在每层decoder中基于query预测的3D框动态计算逐点相对位置编码，显式注入局部性归纳偏置。
2308.04409|v2.result: ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50达77.8%/66.0%，较3DETR大幅提升并刷新ScanNetV2与SUN RGB-D纪录。

2403.06534|v2.summary_cn: 针对SAR目标检测领域公开数据集规模小（多不足2K图像且仅单类目标）且源码不可得的问题，构建了SARDet-100K基准，整合标准化10个现有SAR检测数据集，成为首个COCO级别的大规模多类SAR目标检测数据集。基于该数据集开展全面实验，揭示了RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上的显著差异。为此提出Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation（MSFA）预训练框架以弥合这些差距。
2403.06534|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large public datasets and unavailable source code in SAR object detection, this paper builds SARDet-100K, the first COCO-level large-scale multi-class SAR detection benchmark by standardizing 10 existing datasets. Comprehensive experiments reveal substantial domain and structural gaps between RGB pretraining and SAR finetuning, motivating a Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation (MSFA) pretraining framework to bridge them.
2403.06534|v2.assessment: 数据集与工具链贡献扎实，对SAR检测社区有长期价值，方法部分相对常规但问题定位清晰。
2403.06534|v2.contribution: 发布首个COCO级别大规模多类SAR目标检测基准SARDet-100K及开源方法。
2403.06534|v2.innovation: 通过多阶段滤波增强预训练框架弥合RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上的差距。
2403.06534|v2.result: 构建含10个数据集整合的SARDet-100K基准，并验证MSFA预训练框架的有效性。

2410.17534|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVT）研究因缺乏基准而进展缓慢的问题，构建了大规模基准OVT-B，包含1,048个类别、1,973个视频和637,608个边界框标注，规模远超此前唯一的OVTAO-val数据集（200+类别、900+视频）。同时提出一个简单有效的OVT基线方法，将此前OVT方法忽略但对MOT重要的运动特征整合进跟踪过程。实验验证了基准的实用性和方法的有效性。
2410.17534|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of benchmarks hindering open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVT), this paper introduces OVT-B, a large-scale benchmark with 1,048 categories, 1,973 videos, and 637,608 box annotations, far exceeding the only prior OVTAO-val dataset. It also proposes a simple yet effective OVT baseline that integrates motion features, which prior OVT methods ignored, with experimental results validating both the benchmark and the method.
2410.17534|v2.assessment: 填补了开放词汇跟踪基准的空白，规模优势明显，对开放世界感知与跟踪研究有推动作用。
2410.17534|v2.contribution: 构建大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B并提出整合运动特征的基线方法。
2410.17534|v2.innovation: 首次将运动特征引入开放词汇跟踪，并发布远超现有规模的OVT基准。
2410.17534|v2.result: OVT-B含1,048类、1,973视频、637,608框标注，实验验证基准与基线方法的有效性。
