2403.10191|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇/开放端目标检测中类别定义受限、依赖人工标注类别的问题，本文提出生成式区域-语言预训练方法，利用图像-文本对中的区域-语言对齐信号进行预训练。方法通过生成式建模将区域特征与语言描述联合学习，从而在推理时支持任意文本查询的开放端检测。相比固定类别集的传统检测器，该方法无需闭集类别监督即可泛化到新类别。在开放端检测基准上取得了优于现有开放词汇检测方法的性能，验证了生成式预训练的有效性。
2403.10191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-ended object detection where categories are not predefined, proposing a generative region-language pretraining paradigm that learns region-text alignment from image-caption pairs. By jointly modeling region features and language descriptions generatively, the model supports arbitrary text queries at inference without closed-set supervision. It outperforms existing open-vocabulary detection methods on open-ended benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of generative pretraining.
2403.10191|v2.assessment: 将生成式预训练引入开放端检测，思路新颖，对开放词汇与开放集检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2403.10191|v2.contribution: 提出生成式区域-语言预训练框架，实现无需闭集类别监督的开放端目标检测。
2403.10191|v2.innovation: 用生成式建模替代传统判别式对齐，统一区域与语言表示以支持任意文本查询。
2403.10191|v2.result: 在开放端检测基准上超越现有开放词汇检测方法。

2403.05061|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致基于雷达的目标检测性能远逊于LiDAR的问题，本文提出RadarDistill，通过从LiDAR特征进行知识蒸馏来提升雷达检测性能。方法设计特征级蒸馏策略，将LiDAR教师网络的丰富几何与语义特征迁移到雷达学生网络，缓解模态差异。相比直接训练雷达检测器，该方法显著缩小了雷达与LiDAR检测的性能差距。实验表明在多个雷达检测基准上取得一致提升，验证了跨模态蒸馏的有效性。
2403.05061|v2.summary_en: To address the performance gap between radar and LiDAR object detection caused by sparse and noisy radar point clouds, this paper proposes RadarDistill, which distills knowledge from LiDAR features to boost radar-based detection. A feature-level distillation strategy transfers rich geometric and semantic features from a LiDAR teacher to a radar student, mitigating modality gaps. Experiments show consistent improvements on radar detection benchmarks, substantially narrowing the radar-LiDAR performance gap.
2403.05061|v2.assessment: 跨模态知识蒸馏思路实用，对雷达感知与蒸馏方向研究者有直接借鉴意义。
2403.05061|v2.contribution: 提出从LiDAR特征蒸馏到雷达检测器的RadarDistill框架。
2403.05061|v2.innovation: 设计跨模态特征级蒸馏策略以弥合雷达与LiDAR的模态差异。
2403.05061|v2.result: 在雷达检测基准上取得一致提升，显著缩小与LiDAR检测的差距。

GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出GLOW——一种全局布局感知的攻击方法。不同于以往仅扰动局部目标的攻击，GLOW利用图像全局布局信息生成扰动，使攻击更具迁移性与隐蔽性。方法通过建模目标间空间关系来优化攻击策略，从而在多种检测器上实现更有效的攻击。实验表明GLOW在攻击成功率和迁移性上优于现有攻击方法，揭示了检测器的全局脆弱性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of object detectors to adversarial attacks by proposing GLOW, a global layout-aware attack. Unlike prior local-perturbation attacks, GLOW exploits global layout information and inter-object spatial relations to generate more transferable and imperceptible perturbations. Experiments show GLOW achieves higher attack success rates and transferability than existing methods, revealing global vulnerabilities of detectors.
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.assessment: 从全局布局角度切入对抗攻击，对检测鲁棒性研究有启发，但偏安全方向。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.contribution: 提出全局布局感知的对抗攻击方法GLOW。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.innovation: 利用目标间全局空间布局信息生成更具迁移性的扰动。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.result: 在攻击成功率与迁移性上优于现有攻击方法。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj._arxiv_id: GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Object Detection.

2404.18150|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达目标检测中真实标注数据稀缺、合成数据与真实数据存在域差距的问题，本文提出RadSimReal仿真框架，用于生成高质量雷达数据以弥合合成与真实的鸿沟。方法通过物理建模雷达信号传播与噪声特性，生成贴近真实分布的雷达点云，并支持在仿真数据上预训练后迁移到真实数据。相比已有仿真方法，RadSimReal生成的雷达数据更接近真实分布，显著提升了真实场景下的检测性能。实验验证了仿真预训练对雷达检测的有效性。
2404.18150|v2.summary_en: To tackle the scarcity of real radar annotations and the synthetic-to-real domain gap in radar object detection, this paper proposes RadSimReal, a simulation framework that generates high-fidelity radar data. By physically modeling radar signal propagation and noise, it produces point clouds close to real distributions, enabling pretraining that transfers to real data. Experiments show RadSimReal narrows the sim-to-real gap and improves real-world radar detection performance.
2404.18150|v2.assessment: 为雷达检测提供仿真数据方案，对数据稀缺的雷达感知研究有实用价值。
2404.18150|v2.contribution: 提出RadSimReal雷达仿真框架以弥合合成与真实数据差距。
2404.18150|v2.innovation: 通过物理建模雷达信号传播与噪声生成贴近真实分布的雷达数据。
2404.18150|v2.result: 仿真预训练显著提升真实场景雷达检测性能。

Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_cn: 针对恶劣天气条件下单一传感器（LiDAR或雷达）3D检测性能下降的问题，本文提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的鲁棒3D目标检测方法。方法设计多模态融合架构，充分利用LiDAR的高精度几何信息与4D雷达在恶劣天气下的穿透与测速优势，实现互补。相比单模态或传统融合方法，该方案在雨雾等条件下保持更稳定的检测性能。实验表明在多种天气条件下融合方法显著优于单模态基线，验证了LiDAR-4D雷达融合的鲁棒性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_en: To address degraded 3D detection under adverse weather with single sensors, this paper proposes a robust LiDAR and 4D radar fusion method for 3D object detection. The multi-modal architecture leverages LiDAR's precise geometry and 4D radar's weather-penetrating and velocity-sensing strengths complementarily. Experiments show the fusion method consistently outperforms single-modality baselines across various weather conditions, demonstrating robustness.
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.assessment: LiDAR与4D雷达融合是自动驾驶感知热点，对多模态鲁棒检测研究者高度相关。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.contribution: 提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的鲁棒3D检测方法。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.innovation: 利用4D雷达在恶劣天气下的优势与LiDAR几何信息互补融合。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.result: 在多种天气条件下显著优于单模态基线。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with._arxiv_id: Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with LiDAR and 4D Radar Fusion in Various Weather Conditions.

2304.05370|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上目标检测模型的延迟攻击安全问题，本文提出Overload——一种针对检测延迟的对抗攻击方法。不同于传统影响精度的攻击，Overload通过注入特定扰动诱导检测器产生大量冗余计算，从而显著增加推理延迟。方法针对边缘设备的计算特性设计攻击策略，揭示了检测模型在实时性上的安全漏洞。实验表明Overload能大幅提升检测延迟，对自动驾驶等实时系统构成威胁。
2304.05370|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses latency attacks on object detection for edge devices, proposing Overload, an adversarial attack that induces excessive computation to inflate inference latency. Unlike accuracy-targeting attacks, Overload injects perturbations that trigger redundant computation, exploiting edge-device characteristics. Experiments show Overload substantially increases detection latency, exposing real-time security vulnerabilities in systems like autonomous driving.
2304.05370|v2.assessment: 关注检测延迟安全这一被忽视的维度，对边缘部署与实时感知安全有参考价值。
2304.05370|v2.contribution: 提出针对边缘设备检测延迟的对抗攻击方法Overload。
2304.05370|v2.innovation: 通过扰动诱导冗余计算以放大推理延迟，而非降低精度。
2304.05370|v2.result: 显著提升检测延迟，揭示实时检测系统的安全漏洞。

Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_cn: 针对无人机多模态（RGB-红外等）目标检测中模态间弱对齐导致特征融合失效的问题，本文提出自适应特征对齐方法。方法通过可变形对齐模块在特征层面动态校正跨模态空间偏移，而非依赖严格的像素级配准。相比已有假设严格对齐的多模态检测器，该方法在弱配准条件下更鲁棒。在无人机多模态检测基准上取得优于现有方法的精度，验证了对弱对齐场景的有效性。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly misaligned multimodal object detection for UAVs, where cross-modal spatial offsets degrade feature fusion. It proposes an adaptive feature alignment module that dynamically corrects misalignment at the feature level instead of assuming strict pixel-level registration. Experiments on UAV multimodal benchmarks show improved accuracy over prior strictly-aligned detectors under weak alignment conditions.
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.assessment: 面向无人机多模态检测的实际痛点（配准误差），思路务实，对多传感器融合研究者有参考价值。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.contribution: 提出面向弱对齐场景的自适应跨模态特征对齐框架用于无人机多模态目标检测。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.innovation: 以特征级可变形对齐替代严格像素配准假设，提升弱对齐鲁棒性。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.result: 在无人机多模态检测基准上精度优于现有对齐依赖型方法。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur._arxiv_id: Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-Based Multimodal Object Detection.

2401.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中词汇受限与推理速度慢的问题，本文提出YOLO-World，将预训练CLIP文本编码器与YOLO检测器结合，通过重参数化视觉-语言路径实现实时开放词汇检测。方法采用prompt-then-detect范式与在线词汇训练策略，无需为每个类别重训。相比GLIP等重型开放词汇检测器，在保持零样本能力的同时大幅提升速度，在LVIS上达到35.4 AP并在V100上约52 FPS，实现实时开放词汇检测。
2401.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited vocabulary and slow inference of open-vocabulary object detection by proposing YOLO-World, which couples a pretrained CLIP text encoder with a YOLO detector via re-parameterizable vision-language paths for real-time detection. It introduces a prompt-then-detect paradigm and online vocabulary training, avoiding per-category retraining. It achieves 35.4 AP on LVIS at ~52 FPS on V100, delivering real-time open-vocabulary detection.
2401.17270|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇能力高效注入实时检测器，工程与学术价值兼具，对自动驾驶开放场景感知很有启发。
2401.17270|v2.contribution: 提出实时开放词汇检测器YOLO-World，融合CLIP语义与YOLO效率。
2401.17270|v2.innovation: 重参数化视觉-语言路径与prompt-then-detect范式实现高效开放词汇检测。
2401.17270|v2.result: LVIS上35.4 AP，V100约52 FPS，达到实时开放词汇检测。

Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测中模型对未见域泛化能力不足的问题，本文聚焦数据多样化与特征对齐两个方向进行改进。方法通过增强训练域的风格与内容多样性，并引入对齐机制缩小域间特征分布差异。相比已有单域泛化检测方法，在多个跨域检测基准上提升了泛化性能。实验表明多样化与对齐策略结合能有效缓解域偏移带来的精度下降。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_en: This paper targets single domain-generalized object detection, where models fail to generalize to unseen domains. It improves diversification of training-domain styles/content and introduces alignment to reduce inter-domain feature discrepancy. Compared with prior single-DG detectors, it improves cross-domain generalization across multiple benchmarks, showing that combining diversification and alignment mitigates domain-shift degradation.
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.assessment: 单域泛化检测的系统性改进，对域偏移鲁棒性研究有借鉴意义，但创新幅度相对有限。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.contribution: 提出结合多样化与对齐的单域泛化目标检测改进方案。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.innovation: 将风格/内容多样化与特征对齐协同用于单域泛化检测。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.result: 在多个跨域检测基准上提升泛化精度，缓解域偏移下降。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje._arxiv_id: Improving Single Domain-Generalized Object Detection: A Focus on Diversification and Alignment.

D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_cn: 针对RGB-热红外跨模态域自适应目标检测中模态鸿沟导致的知识迁移困难问题，本文提出D3T双域教师框架。方法采用双域教师在不同模态间以之字形（zigzag）方式交替蒸馏，缓解RGB与热红外之间的域差异。相比单教师或单向蒸馏方法，能更有效地跨模态传递判别性知识。在RGB-T域自适应检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_en: This paper addresses the RGB-thermal modality gap in domain-adaptive object detection by proposing D3T, a distinctive dual-domain teacher framework. It performs zigzagging cross-modal distillation between RGB and thermal domains to bridge the gap. Compared with single-teacher or one-way distillation, it transfers discriminative knowledge more effectively, achieving superior performance on RGB-T domain-adaptive detection benchmarks.
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.assessment: 双域教师之字形蒸馏思路新颖，对多模态域自适应检测研究者有参考价值。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.contribution: 提出D3T双域教师之字形蒸馏框架用于RGB-T域自适应目标检测。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.innovation: 以双域教师交替之字形蒸馏跨越RGB-热红外模态鸿沟。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.result: 在RGB-T域自适应检测基准上性能优于现有方法。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig._arxiv_id: D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zigzagging Across RGB-Thermal Gap for Domain-Adaptive Object Detection.

Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在昼夜域差异下性能下降的问题，本文提出零样本昼夜域自适应方法。方法无需目标域标注，通过图像翻译与特征层面的域对齐，将白天训练的检测器迁移到夜间场景。相比需要目标域标注或成对数据的域自适应方法，实现了零样本迁移。实验表明该方法在昼夜跨域检测上显著提升夜间检测精度。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_en: This paper tackles the day-night domain gap that degrades object detection by proposing a zero-shot day-night domain adaptation method. Without target-domain labels, it transfers a daytime-trained detector to nighttime via image translation and feature-level alignment. Unlike methods requiring target labels or paired data, it achieves zero-shot transfer, substantially improving nighttime detection accuracy in day-night cross-domain experiments.
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.assessment: 零样本昼夜自适应对自动驾驶夜间感知有直接价值，方法实用。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.contribution: 提出零样本昼夜域自适应目标检测方法，无需目标域标注。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.innovation: 结合图像翻译与特征对齐实现昼夜零样本域迁移。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.result: 在昼夜跨域检测上显著提升夜间检测精度。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot._arxiv_id: Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation.

InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_cn: 针对真实检测数据标注成本高、长尾类别样本稀缺的问题，本文提出InstaGen，利用扩散模型生成的合成数据增强目标检测训练。方法通过实例级生成与检测器协同训练，将合成实例以伪标签方式融入检测流程，缓解合成-真实域差异。相比仅用真实数据或简单合成数据的方法，在稀有类别与整体检测精度上均有提升，验证了合成数据对检测训练的有效补充。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and long-tail scarcity in object detection by proposing InstaGen, which augments detector training with diffusion-generated synthetic data. It performs instance-level generation and co-training with the detector, integrating synthetic instances via pseudo-labels to mitigate the synthetic-to-real gap. Compared with real-only or naive synthetic augmentation, it improves both rare-category and overall detection accuracy.
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.assessment: 将生成式合成数据与检测器协同训练结合，对数据稀缺场景的检测研究有较强参考价值。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.contribution: 提出InstaGen，用扩散生成合成实例增强目标检测训练。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.innovation: 实例级生成与检测器协同训练，缓解合成-真实域差异。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.result: 在稀有类别与整体检测精度上均优于仅用真实数据的方法。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by._arxiv_id: InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by Training on Synthetic Dataset.

Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本目标检测（FSOD）中标注数据稀缺、模型泛化能力不足的问题，探索如何利用基础模型（Foundation Models）提升少样本场景下的检测性能。方法上，作者提出将大规模预训练基础模型（如视觉-语言模型）的丰富语义先验迁移到少样本检测框架中，通过特征对齐或提示学习等方式增强新类别目标的表征能力。相比传统FSOD方法仅依赖少量基类样本微调，该工作借助基础模型的开放词汇能力缓解了基类-新类分布偏移问题。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但预期在PASCAL VOC和COCO等标准FSOD基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of few-shot object detection (FSOD) where labeled data is scarce and model generalization is limited, by leveraging foundation models. The authors propose to transfer rich semantic priors from large-scale pre-trained foundation models (e.g., vision-language models) into the FSOD framework through feature alignment or prompt learning to enhance novel-class representations. Unlike conventional FSOD methods that rely solely on fine-tuning with few base-class samples, this work mitigates the base-novel distribution shift via the open-vocabulary capability of foundation models. While no specific experimental numbers are provided in the abstract, the approach is expected to outperform existing methods on standard FSOD benchmarks such as PASCAL VOC and COCO.
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.assessment: 该工作将基础模型引入少样本目标检测，思路契合当前视觉-语言预训练趋势，有望为数据稀缺场景下的检测提供新范式，值得关注。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.contribution: 提出利用基础模型的语义先验来增强少样本目标检测的新框架。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.innovation: 将开放词汇基础模型与少样本检测相结合，缓解基类-新类分布偏移。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.result: 预期在标准FSOD基准上取得优于现有方法的性能（摘要未提供具体数据）。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundation Models.

2503.01463|v2.summary_cn: 现有 DETR 类模型普遍采用级联解码器结构，将 object query 的更新限制在级联方向上，导致 query 只能从图像特征中学到相对有限的信息，难以应对极小目标、严重遮挡和背景混淆等自然场景检测难题。本文提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries (MI) 解码器机制，使 object query 能够更全面地学习图像特征。基于 MI 的 MI-DETR 在 COCO 上于不同 backbone 和训练 epoch 设置下均超越现有 DETR 类模型，在 ResNet-50 下相比代表性模型 DINO 和 SOTA 模型 Relation-DETR 分别提升 +2.3 AP 和 +0.6 AP。诊断与可视化实验进一步验证了 MI 的有效性、合理性与可解释性。
2503.01463|v2.summary_en: Existing DETR-like detectors rely on cascaded decoders that constrain object queries to update along a single cascaded direction, limiting the information they can extract from image features. This paper proposes a parallel Multi-time Inquiries (MI) decoder mechanism that lets object queries learn more comprehensive information. MI-DETR outperforms all existing DETR-like models on COCO across backbones and training schedules, achieving +2.3 AP over DINO and +0.6 AP over Relation-DETR with ResNet-50, with diagnostic and visualization experiments supporting its effectiveness and interpretability.
2503.01463|v2.assessment: 针对 DETR 解码器信息瓶颈的结构性改进，思路清晰且提升幅度可观，对检测方向研究者有直接参考价值。
2503.01463|v2.contribution: 提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries 解码器机制，突破级联解码器对 object query 信息获取的限制。
2503.01463|v2.innovation: 以并行多轮查询替代级联单向更新，使 object query 能更充分利用图像特征。
2503.01463|v2.result: 在 COCO 上 ResNet-50 下较 DINO 提升 +2.3 AP、较 Relation-DETR 提升 +0.6 AP。

2412.06647|v2.summary_cn: 事件流目标检测在低光照、运动模糊和高速运动场景下具有优势，但现有基于 SNN、Transformer 或 CNN 的检测器分别存在性能受限、计算开销大或局部感受野有限的问题。本文提出基于 MoE 热传导的检测算法，先用 stem 网络嵌入事件数据，再通过 MoE-HCO 块（集成多种专家模块模拟事件流中的热传导），随后用基于 IoU 的 query 选择模块提取 token 并送入检测头。同时发布基于 Prophesee EVK4-HD 采集的 EvDET200K 基准数据集，在精度与计算效率之间取得良好平衡。
2412.06647|v2.summary_en: Event-stream object detection suffers from limited performance, high computation, or restricted receptive fields in existing SNN-, Transformer-, and CNN-based detectors. This paper proposes a Mixture-of-Experts heat-conduction detector that embeds events with a stem network, processes them through MoE-HCO blocks mimicking heat conduction, and selects tokens via an IoU-based query module before the detection head. It also releases EvDET200K, a benchmark captured with a Prophesee EVK4-HD camera, striking a balance between accuracy and efficiency.
2412.06647|v2.assessment: 将 MoE 与热传导建模引入事件相机检测，并配套大规模数据集，对事件感知与检测交叉方向有较高价值。
2412.06647|v2.contribution: 提出 MoE 热传导检测器并发布 EvDET200K 事件相机检测基准数据集。
2412.06647|v2.innovation: 用多专家模块模拟事件流热传导过程，并结合 IoU-based query 选择实现精度与效率平衡。
2412.06647|v2.result: 在精度与计算效率之间取得显著平衡，并提供大规模高清事件检测数据支撑。

2510.13620|v2.summary_cn: 无人机 RGB-IR 多模态目标检测可实现全天候感知，但现有数据集成像条件单一，难以覆盖真实世界复杂度。本文构建高多样性数据集 ATR-UMOD，覆盖 80m–300m 高度、0°–75° 角度及全天候全年的天气与光照变化，并为每对 RGB-IR 图像标注 6 种条件属性。针对多样条件挑战，提出 prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF)，将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过任务特定软门控变换自适应重分配多模态贡献，并用 prompt 引导的条件解耦模块保证可用性。
2510.13620|v2.summary_en: UAV-based RGB-IR detection enables around-the-clock perception, but existing datasets cover limited imaging conditions. This paper introduces ATR-UMOD, a high-diversity dataset spanning 80–300 m altitudes, 0°–75° angles, and all-day/all-year weather and illumination variations, with 6 condition attributes annotated per RGB-IR pair. It proposes prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF), which encodes imaging conditions as text prompts and adaptively reweights multimodal contributions via task-specific soft gating, complemented by a prompt-guided condition-decoupling module.
2510.13620|v2.assessment: 数据集多样性与条件感知融合设计结合紧密，对多模态感知与无人机检测研究者有较强实用价值。
2510.13620|v2.contribution: 构建高多样性 UAV RGB-IR 多模态检测数据集 ATR-UMOD 并提出条件感知动态融合方法 PCDF。
2510.13620|v2.innovation: 将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过软门控自适应调节多模态融合权重。
2510.13620|v2.result: 在覆盖高度、角度、天气与光照的大范围条件下实现鲁棒的多模态检测。

2506.23575|v2.summary_cn: 反无人机任务中的小目标检测受限于目标尺寸小与背景复杂，传统帧相机因低帧率、有限动态范围和冗余数据难以胜任，而现有事件检测数据集规模小、目标大、背景单一，不适合小目标基准。本文提出首个大规模高多样性事件小目标检测数据集 EV-UAV，含 147 个序列、超 230 万事件级标注，目标平均仅 6.8×5.4 像素，覆盖城市杂乱与极端光照场景。基于小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的观察，提出 EV-SpSegNet 作为事件分割基线。
2506.23575|v2.summary_en: Anti-UAV small object detection is hindered by tiny targets and cluttered backgrounds, and existing event-based datasets are too small-scale and lack target diversity. This paper introduces EV-UAV, the first large-scale, highly diverse event-based small object detection benchmark, with 147 sequences, over 2.3 million event-level annotations, and targets averaging 6.8×5.4 pixels under urban clutter and extreme lighting. Observing that small moving targets form continuous curves in spatiotemporal event point clouds, it proposes EV-SpSegNet as a novel event segmentation baseline.
2506.23575|v2.assessment: 填补事件相机小目标检测基准空白，数据规模与标注粒度突出，对事件感知与反无人机方向有重要参考意义。
2506.23575|v2.contribution: 发布首个大规模事件小目标检测数据集 EV-UAV 并提出 EV-SpSegNet 基线。
2506.23575|v2.innovation: 利用小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的特性进行事件分割检测。
2506.23575|v2.result: 提供 147 序列、230 万+ 事件级标注、平均 6.8×5.4 像素目标的基准与基线。

Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅能从标题推断：本文针对实时开放词汇目标检测，提出 Dynamic-DINO，通过细粒度 Mixture of Experts 微调策略提升模型能力。核心思路应是在开放词汇检测框架中引入细粒度 MoE 调优，以在保持实时性的同时增强对多样类别与动态场景的适应能力。具体方法细节、对比实验与量化结果因摘要为空无法确认。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.summary_en: With the abstract unavailable, the title indicates that this work targets real-time open-vocabulary object detection by proposing Dynamic-DINO, which applies fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts tuning. The approach presumably enhances adaptability to diverse categories and dynamic scenes while preserving real-time inference. Method details, comparisons, and quantitative results cannot be verified without the abstract.
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.assessment: 开放词汇检测与 MoE 微调结合的方向有潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法与实验质量，需查阅全文确认。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.contribution: 提出面向实时开放词汇检测的细粒度 MoE 微调方法 Dynamic-DINO。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.innovation: 将细粒度 Mixture of Experts 调优引入实时开放词汇目标检测。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex._arxiv_id: Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Experts Tuning for Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅能从标题推断：本文针对基于 DETR 的半监督目标检测，提出 STEP-DETR，引入 Super Teacher 与伪标签引导的文本查询机制。核心思路应是通过更强的教师模型生成高质量伪标签，并利用文本查询引导检测器在半监督设定下更有效地学习。具体方法设计、对比实验与量化提升因摘要为空无法确认。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.summary_en: With the abstract unavailable, the title suggests that this work addresses DETR-based semi-supervised object detection via STEP-DETR, introducing a Super Teacher and pseudo-label-guided text queries. The approach presumably leverages a stronger teacher to produce high-quality pseudo-labels and uses text queries to guide learning under semi-supervision. Method details, comparisons, and quantitative gains cannot be verified without the abstract.
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.assessment: 半监督 DETR 检测与文本查询结合的方向较新颖，但摘要缺失使方法质量与实验充分度无法评估。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.contribution: 提出结合 Super Teacher 与伪标签引导文本查询的 DETR 半监督检测框架 STEP-DETR。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.innovation: 用伪标签引导的文本查询增强 DETR 在半监督设定下的学习能力。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup._arxiv_id: STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Supervised Object Detection with Super Teacher and Pseudo-Label Guided Text Queries.

When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_cn: 针对小样本目标检测（FSOD）中 ViT 类检测器难以充分利用像素级局部差异信息的问题，论文提出 PiDiViT，将像素差异模式（Pixel Difference Patterns）与 ViT 结合用于小样本检测。方法通过显式建模支持集与查询集之间的像素级差异特征，增强 ViT 对类间细微差异的判别能力。相比已有基于 ViT 的 FSOD 方法，改进点在于引入像素差异先验而非仅依赖全局注意力。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of ViT-based few-shot object detectors in exploiting pixel-level local difference cues. It proposes PiDiViT, which integrates pixel difference patterns with ViT to enhance discrimination between support and query images. The main improvement over prior ViT-based FSOD methods is the explicit modeling of pixel-level discrepancy priors, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.assessment: 将像素差异先验引入 ViT 小样本检测的思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验规模与增益。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.contribution: 提出将像素差异模式与 ViT 结合的小样本目标检测框架 PiDiViT。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.innovation: 用像素级差异模式增强 ViT 对类间细微差异的判别能力。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:._arxiv_id: When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT: PiDiViT for Few-Shot Object Detection.

DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_cn: 针对跨域小样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中模型在新域上需要重训练的问题，论文提出一种无需重训练的混合框架，将 DETR 与视觉基础模型（Vision Foundation Models）结合。方法利用基础模型的开放词汇/零样本能力弥补 DETR 在跨域小样本场景下的不足，从而避免在新域上微调。相比已有 CD-FSOD 方法，改进点在于免重训练即可适配新域。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain few-shot object detection where retraining on new domains is costly. It proposes a retraining-free mixture framework combining DETR with vision foundation models to leverage open-vocabulary capabilities for domain adaptation. The key improvement is avoiding domain-specific retraining, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.assessment: 免重训练的 DETR+基础模型混合思路对实际部署有吸引力，但需验证其在标准 CD-FSOD 基准上的实际表现。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练的 DETR 与视觉基础模型混合的跨域小样本检测方法。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.innovation: 利用视觉基础模型的开放词汇能力实现免重训练的跨域适配。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR._arxiv_id: DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR and Vision Foundation Models for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection.

2505.20612|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 在预训练分布之外的类别、任务和成像模态上泛化能力差的问题，论文提出 Roboflow100-VL 基准，包含 100 个多模态目标检测数据集，覆盖 VLM 预训练中罕见的多样概念。作者主张通过包含少量视觉示例和丰富文本描述的标注指令将 VLM 对齐到新概念，并在零样本、少样本、半监督和全监督四种设定下评测 SOTA 模型。结果显示 GroundingDINO 和 Qwen2.5-VL 在挑战性医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足 2%，凸显少样本概念对齐的必要性，并分享了 CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD 竞赛的社区洞察。
2505.20612|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Roboflow100-VL, a large-scale benchmark of 100 multi-modal detection datasets covering concepts underrepresented in VLM pre-training. It evaluates state-of-the-art VLMs under zero-shot, few-shot, semi-supervised, and fully-supervised regimes, and argues for aligning VLMs to new concepts via annotation instructions with few visual examples and rich text. Notably, GroundingDINO and Qwen2.5-VL achieve under 2% zero-shot accuracy on challenging medical datasets, motivating few-shot concept alignment.
2505.20612|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了 VLM 在 OOD 概念与多模态检测评测上的空白，对开放集检测与 VLM 泛化研究具有较高参考价值。
2505.20612|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖 100 个多域数据集、支持多数据设定对比的 VLM 目标检测基准 Roboflow100-VL。
2505.20612|v2.innovation: 以少样本概念对齐为核心，系统评测 VLM 在 OOD 类别与模态上的泛化能力。
2505.20612|v2.result: GroundingDINO 与 Qwen2.5-VL 在挑战性医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足 2%。

2503.18430|v2.summary_cn: 针对大词表目标检测中分类式检测器的两大缺陷——稀有正类梯度稀释与大量易负样本导致的难负梯度稀释，论文提出 CQ-DINO，将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询之间的对比任务。方法引入图像引导的查询选择，通过交叉注意力为每张图像自适应检索 top-K 相关类别，从而压缩负空间、重平衡梯度分布并隐式挖掘难例。CQ-DINO 还能在结构化数据集（如 V3Det）中利用显式层级类别关系，或在通用数据集（如 COCO）中通过自注意力学习隐式类别相关性，在挑战性大词表设定下取得更优性能。
2503.18430|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies positive and hard-negative gradient dilution as key limitations of classification-based detectors for vast-vocabulary detection. It proposes CQ-DINO, which reformulates classification as contrastive matching between object queries and learnable category queries, with image-guided top-K category retrieval to rebalance gradients and mine hard examples. It supports both explicit hierarchical category relations (V3Det) and implicit correlations (COCO), achieving superior performance on challenging vast-vocabulary benchmarks.
2503.18430|v2.assessment: 从梯度稀释角度切入大词表检测问题，方法设计清晰且兼容层级与通用数据集，对开放词表检测研究有借鉴意义。
2503.18430|v2.contribution: 提出基于类别查询对比的 CQ-DINO 框架以缓解大词表检测中的梯度稀释问题。
2503.18430|v2.innovation: 将分类重构为物体查询与类别查询的对比任务，并用图像引导 top-K 检索压缩负空间。
2503.18430|v2.result: 在挑战性大词表检测基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2411.17761|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界 3D 感知缺乏全面基准与鲁棒通用方法的问题，论文提出 OpenAD，首个面向 3D 目标检测的真实开放世界自动驾驶基准。OpenAD 基于结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 corner case 发现与标注流水线，在五个自动驾驶感知数据集的 2000 个场景中以统一格式标注 corner case 物体，并设计评测方法对多种开放世界与专用 2D/3D 模型进行评估。作者进一步提出以视觉为中心的 3D 开放世界检测基线，并引入融合通用与专用模型的集成方法以缓解现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题，同时上线 EvalAI 挑战赛。
2411.17761|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenAD, the first real-world open-world benchmark for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. Built on an MLLM-assisted corner-case discovery and annotation pipeline, it annotates 2000 scenarios across five driving perception datasets in a unified format and evaluates diverse open-world and specialized 2D/3D models. The authors propose a vision-centric 3D open-world detection baseline and an ensemble method fusing general and specialized models to address low precision of existing open-world approaches.
2411.17761|v2.assessment: OpenAD 填补了开放世界 3D 检测基准的空白，其 MLLM 标注流水线与集成基线对自动驾驶开放集感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2411.17761|v2.contribution: 构建首个真实开放世界自动驾驶 3D 目标检测基准 OpenAD 及配套评测与基线方法。
2411.17761|v2.innovation: 用 MLLM 驱动的 corner case 发现与标注流水线统一五个数据集的开放世界评测。
2411.17761|v2.result: 在 2000 个场景上完成统一标注与评测，并提出融合通用与专用模型的集成方法提升精度。

2501.16665|v2.summary_cn: 针对 X 射线安检图像中物体重叠导致的前景-背景特征耦合问题，论文提出类别语义先验对比学习（CSPCL）机制，用于基于 Deformable DETR 的违禁品检测器。方法将分类器感知的类别原型与内容查询对齐，以修正和补充分类所需的缺失语义信息，从而提升模型对前景特征的敏感度。为此设计了 CSP 损失，包含类内截断吸引（ITA）损失与类间自适应排斥（IAR）损失：ITA 用类别原型吸引类内内容查询并通过梯度截断保留类内多样性，IAR 依据原型间相似度自适应排斥类间查询。
2501.16665|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses foreground-background feature coupling caused by object overlap in X-ray security images, which degrades general detectors. It proposes Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning (CSPCL) for Deformable DETR-based prohibited item detectors, aligning classifier-perceived class prototypes with content queries to recover missing semantic information. A dedicated CSP loss with Intra-Class Truncated Attraction and Inter-Class Adaptive Repulsion outperforms classic contrastive losses.
2501.16665|v2.assessment: 面向 X 射线安检这一特定场景，对比学习设计有针对性，但与通用检测/自动驾驶主线相关度有限。
2501.16665|v2.contribution: 提出类别语义先验对比学习机制 CSPCL 及其 CSP 损失用于 X 射线违禁品检测。
2501.16665|v2.innovation: 用类别原型对齐内容查询，并通过梯度截断与自适应排斥改进对比损失。
2501.16665|v2.result: CSP 损失优于经典对比损失，提升了检测器对前景特征的敏感度。

Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测中新类别物体难以识别的问题，提出以"objectness"建模为核心统一框架。方法上通过开放世界的objectness估计来区分已知与未知物体，并将其与新颖类别检测流程统一。相比已有开放集检测方法，该框架更强调objectness作为通用先验的作用，减少了对类别特定信息的依赖。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路对开放世界检测具有潜在价值。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_en: This paper addresses novel object detection in open-world settings by proposing a unified framework centered on open-world objectness modeling. The method estimates objectness to distinguish known from unknown objects and integrates it into the novel object detection pipeline. Compared to prior open-set detection approaches, it emphasizes objectness as a general prior, reducing reliance on class-specific information. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the idea holds promise for open-world detection.
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.assessment: 开放世界检测是当前热点，以objectness统一建模的思路新颖，值得关注其后续实验验证。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.contribution: 提出以开放世界objectness建模统一新颖目标检测的框架。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.innovation: 将objectness作为开放世界检测的通用先验进行统一建模。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N._arxiv_id: Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies Novel Object Detection.

2503.15293|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型的后门攻击问题，提出在测试时检测被投毒样本的方法TRACE。基于两个观察：投毒样本在不同背景下检测结果更一致，而干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测一致性更高，TRACE对测试样本施加前景和背景变换并计算变换一致性来判别。相比现有防御方法，TRACE专门应对目标检测中"幽灵"物体出现或"消失"等复杂攻击效果。摘要未给出具体检测指标，但方法针对性强。
2503.15293|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses backdoor attacks on object detection models by proposing TRACE, a test-time poisoned sample detection method. Based on two observations—poisoned samples yield more consistent detections across backgrounds while clean samples show higher consistency under different focal information—TRACE applies foreground and background transformations and measures transformation consistency. Unlike existing defenses, TRACE specifically handles complex attack effects such as ghost object emergence or vanishing. Quantitative metrics are not reported in the abstract.

2503.15293|v2.contribution: 提出基于变换一致性评估的测试时后门样本检测方法TRACE。
2503.15293|v2.innovation: 利用前景/背景变换下检测一致性的差异来区分投毒与干净样本。

Compared to existing oriented detectors, ReDiffDet improves robustness to rotation via diffusion modeling and equivariant design. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the rotation-equivariant diffusion idea is novel for oriented detection.

Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by learning endogenous attention. The method enables the model to learn intrinsic attention mechanisms to retain detection capability for old classes while incrementally learning new ones. Compared to existing incremental detection methods, the endogenous attention design aims to more naturally balance old and new knowledge. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.

2502.04268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点监督有向目标检测问题，提出利用实例间空间布局的Point2RBox-v2。核心包含三项原则：高斯重叠损失学习实例上界、Voronoi分水岭损失学习实例下界、一致性损失学习输入与增强视图间的尺寸/旋转变化，并辅以边缘损失和复制粘贴等技术。相比已有方法，Point2RBox-v2首次探索实例间空间布局用于点监督有向检测。在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，在密集场景中表现优异。
2502.04268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point-supervised oriented object detection by exploiting spatial layout among instances, proposing Point2RBox-v2. It introduces three principles: Gaussian overlap loss for learning an upper bound, Voronoi watershed loss for a lower bound, and consistency loss for size/rotation variation, supplemented by edge loss and copy-paste. It is the first to explore inter-instance spatial layout for point-supervised OOD, achieving 62.61%/86.15%/34.71% on DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M, with strong performance in densely packed scenes.
2502.04268|v2.assessment: 点监督有向检测的实用性强，利用实例间布局的几何先验设计优雅，密集场景性能突出，值得关注。
2502.04268|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用实例间空间布局的点监督有向目标检测方法Point2RBox-v2。
2502.04268|v2.innovation: 通过高斯重叠、Voronoi分水岭与一致性损失联合建模实例间空间布局。
2502.04268|v2.result: 在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，密集场景表现优异。

2503.12009|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中Transformer将3D体素序列化为1D序列破坏空间结构、且因体素数量大而分组导致感受野受限的问题，本文提出Unified Mamba（UniMamba），将3D卷积与状态空间模型（SSM）以多头方式融合，实现局部与全局空间上下文的高效同步聚合。其核心UniMamba块包含空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化和局部-全局序列聚合器，利用3D子流形卷积捕获动态空间结构。相比Transformer方法，该方法在保持全局依赖建模的同时避免了序列化带来的结构破坏和二次复杂度问题。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在LiDAR 3D检测上实现了高效且有效的性能。
2503.12009|v2.summary_en: To address the destruction of 3D voxel spatial structure during serialization and the limited receptive field caused by grouping in Transformer-based LiDAR 3D detection, this paper proposes Unified Mamba (UniMamba), which seamlessly integrates 3D convolution and State Space Models in a multi-head manner for efficient local-global spatial context aggregation. The UniMamba block consists of spatial locality modeling, complementary Z-order serialization, and a local-global sequential aggregator, using 3D submanifold convolution to capture dynamic spatial structure. It avoids the quadratic complexity and structural destruction of Transformers, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2503.12009|v2.assessment: 将Mamba/SSM引入LiDAR 3D检测是一个有前景的方向，方法设计合理，值得关注其在自动驾驶感知中的效率与精度权衡。
2503.12009|v2.contribution: 提出UniMamba，将3D卷积与SSM融合用于LiDAR 3D检测的局部-全局空间上下文聚合。
2503.12009|v2.innovation: 设计互补Z-order序列化与局部-全局序列聚合器，在多头框架下统一3D卷积和状态空间模型。
2503.12009|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在LiDAR 3D检测上实现高效且有效的性能。

2410.11774|v2.summary_cn: 针对真实数据集长尾分布导致稀有类别检测困难的问题，现有重加权和重采样方法仅利用类别频率统计而忽略类别在图像空间中的分布信息。本文提出FRActal CALibration（FRACAL），一种无需训练的后校准方法，利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间中分布的均匀性，并在推理时据此反向降低均匀分布类别预测的概率，从而在频繁/稀有类别和均匀/稀疏分布类别两个维度上实现平衡。FRACAL可即插即用地结合一阶段sigmoid检测器和两阶段实例分割模型，显著提升稀有类别性能。
2410.11774|v2.summary_en: To address long-tailed object detection where existing re-weighting and re-sampling methods only use class frequency statistics and ignore spatial distribution, this paper proposes FRActal CALibration (FRACAL), a training-free post-calibration method. FRACAL uses fractal dimension to estimate how uniformly classes are distributed in image space and inversely downweights probabilities of uniformly spaced class predictions during inference, balancing frequent vs. rare and uniformly vs. sparsely spaced classes. It can be combined with off-the-shelf one-stage sigmoid detectors and two-stage instance segmentation models, boosting rare class performance.
2410.11774|v2.assessment: 从图像空间分布角度切入长尾检测是一个新颖视角，方法无需训练且通用性强，对实际自动驾驶场景中的稀有目标检测有参考价值。
2410.11774|v2.contribution: 提出基于分形维数的后校准方法FRACAL，利用类别空间分布信息解决长尾目标检测。
2410.11774|v2.innovation: 首次利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间的分布均匀性，并据此进行logit调整。
2410.11774|v2.result: FRACAL显著提升稀有类别性能，可即插即用于多种检测和分割模型。

2502.19630|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 目标检测依赖 LiDAR 与相机的固定帧率同步数据，受限于传感器延迟与带宽，无法满足自动驾驶对高速、低延迟感知的需求。本文首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，利用其高时间分辨率与低带宽特性，在同步数据缺失的帧间间隔内通过事件相机检索历史 3D 信息实现检测。作者还构建了首个基于事件的 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD，提供 100 FPS 的 3D 真值框，建立了事件 3D 检测器的首个基准。该工作为突破传统帧率限制的时序 3D 感知提供了新范式与评测平台。
2502.19630|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D object detection relies on synchronized fixed-frame-rate LiDAR and camera data, which is constrained by sensor latency and bandwidth and cannot meet the high-speed, low-latency requirements of autonomous driving. This paper introduces asynchronous event cameras into 3D object detection for the first time, exploiting their high temporal resolution and low bandwidth to perform detection during inter-frame intervals by retrieving previous 3D information via events. The authors also present DSEC-3DOD, the first event-based 3D detection dataset with 100 FPS 3D ground-truth boxes, establishing the first benchmark for event-based 3D detectors.
2502.19630|v2.assessment: 首次将事件相机用于 3D 目标检测并开源数据集与基准，突破了固定帧率传感器的时序边界，对高速自动驾驶感知具有重要参考价值。
2502.19630|v2.contribution: 首次提出基于事件相机的 3D 目标检测方法，并发布首个 100 FPS 3D 真值的事件检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD。
2502.19630|v2.innovation: 利用事件相机的高时间分辨率与低带宽，在帧间间隔内通过事件检索历史 3D 信息实现高速检测。
2502.19630|v2.result: 建立了事件 3D 检测的首个基准，支持 100 FPS 的 3D 框标注，代码与数据集已开源。

The method jointly optimizes instance-level depth estimation and 3D box regression to improve localization accuracy. Compared to prior stereo 3D detectors, it emphasizes the role of instance depth for precise 3D localization. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.

2001.10692|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中稀疏、缺乏颜色和噪声的问题，提出ImVoteNet，通过融合图像2D投票和点云3D投票来增强检测。方法从图像中提取几何与语义特征，利用相机参数提升到3D空间，并采用多塔训练方案改善2D-3D特征融合。在SUN RGB-D数据集上，ImVoteNet将mAP提升了5.7，显著优于现有方法。
2001.10692|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of point clouds (sparsity, lack of color, noise) for 3D detection by proposing ImVoteNet, which fuses 2D image votes and 3D point cloud votes. It extracts geometric and semantic features from images, lifts them to 3D using camera parameters, and employs a multi-tower training scheme for better fusion. On SUN RGB-D, it improves mAP by 5.7 over state-of-the-art.
2001.10692|v2.assessment: ImVoteNet有效融合图像与点云信息，在RGB-D场景下取得显著提升，对多模态3D检测有重要参考价值。

2001.10692|v2.innovation: 显式提取图像几何与语义特征并提升至3D，结合多塔训练增强融合。
2001.10692|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D上mAP提升5.7，达到当时最优。

2004.03080|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对伪LiDAR（PL）流程中深度估计与3D检测网络需分开训练的问题，提出基于可微Change of Representation（CoR）模块的端到端框架。该框架使整个PL流程可端到端训练，兼容多种先进网络，结合PointRCNN在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩。方法持续优于PL基线，并提供了代码。
2004.03080|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate training of depth estimation and 3D detection networks in the pseudo-LiDAR (PL) pipeline by introducing a differentiable Change of Representation (CoR) module for end-to-end training. The framework is compatible with state-of-the-art networks and, combined with PointRCNN, achieves the highest entry on the KITTI image-based 3D detection leaderboard at submission time. It consistently outperforms PL baselines.
2004.03080|v2.assessment: 端到端伪LiDAR框架解决了分步训练的次优问题，在KITTI上取得领先结果，对低成本3D检测有重要意义。
2004.03080|v2.contribution: 提出可微CoR模块实现伪LiDAR流程的端到端训练。
2004.03080|v2.innovation: 通过可微表示转换模块连接深度估计与3D检测，实现联合优化。
2004.03080|v2.result: 在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩，持续优于PL基线。

1912.13192|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中体素CNN与PointNet各自局限，提出PV-RCNN框架，深度融合3D体素CNN和基于PointNet的集合抽象。方法通过体素集合抽象模块将场景总结为关键点，并设计RoI-grid池化从关键点提取提案特征，编码丰富上下文。在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上取得领先性能，成为3D检测的经典工作。
1912.13192|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of voxel CNNs and PointNet-based methods for 3D detection by proposing PV-RCNN, which deeply integrates 3D voxel CNN and PointNet-based set abstraction. It summarizes the scene into keypoints via voxel set abstraction and uses RoI-grid pooling to extract proposal features with rich context. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI and Waymo Open datasets.
1912.13192|v2.assessment: PV-RCNN是3D检测领域的里程碑工作，方法优雅且性能卓越，对后续研究影响深远。
1912.13192|v2.contribution: 提出点-体素特征集合抽象框架PV-RCNN，统一体素与点云特征学习。
1912.13192|v2.innovation: 体素集合抽象生成关键点，RoI-grid池化提取多感受野提案特征。
1912.13192|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open上取得领先精度，成为广泛使用的基线。

2003.01251|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR点云3D检测，提出图神经网络Point-GNN，将点云编码为固定半径近邻图，预测每个顶点的类别和形状。方法引入自动配准机制减少平移方差，并设计框合并与评分操作准确融合多顶点检测。在KITTI基准上，仅用点云即达到领先精度，甚至超越融合方法，展示了图神经网络在3D检测的潜力。
2003.01251|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Point-GNN, a graph neural network for LiDAR point cloud 3D detection. It encodes the point cloud as a fixed-radius near-neighbor graph and predicts category and shape for each vertex. An auto-registration mechanism reduces translation variance, and a box merging and scoring operation combines detections. On KITTI, it achieves leading accuracy using point cloud alone, even surpassing fusion-based methods.
2003.01251|v2.assessment: Point-GNN将图神经网络引入3D检测，方法新颖且性能强劲，为点云处理提供了新视角。
2003.01251|v2.contribution: 提出基于图神经网络的Point-GNN用于LiDAR点云3D检测。
2003.01251|v2.innovation: 自动配准机制减少平移方差，框合并与评分操作融合多顶点检测。
2003.01251|v2.result: 在KITTI上仅用点云达到领先精度，超越部分融合方法。

2004.03572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体图像3D检测中全图视差估计代价高且未利用类别先验的问题，提出Disp R-CNN，设计实例视差估计网络iDispNet，仅预测感兴趣物体像素的视差并学习类别特定形状先验。为缓解视差标注稀缺，使用统计形状模型生成密集视差伪真值，无需LiDAR点云。在KITTI上，即使训练时无LiDAR真值，平均精度仍超越先前最优方法20%。
2004.03572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and lack of category prior in full-image disparity estimation for stereo 3D detection by proposing Disp R-CNN. It designs an instance disparity estimation network (iDispNet) that predicts disparity only for object pixels and learns category-specific shape priors. A statistical shape model generates dense disparity pseudo-ground-truth without LiDAR. On KITTI, it outperforms previous state-of-the-art by 20% in average precision even without LiDAR ground-truth during training.
2004.03572|v2.assessment: Disp R-CNN通过实例视差估计和形状先验，显著提升立体3D检测精度，且降低对LiDAR的依赖，实用性强。
2004.03572|v2.contribution: 提出实例视差估计网络iDispNet和形状先验引导的立体3D检测系统Disp R-CNN。
2004.03572|v2.innovation: 仅预测物体像素视差并学习类别形状先验，利用统计形状模型生成伪真值。
2004.03572|v2.result: 在KITTI上平均精度超越先前最优方法20%，无需LiDAR真值训练。

1911.10150|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达与相机融合方法在主流基准上反而落后于纯激光雷达方法的问题，本文提出PointPainting顺序融合方法，将激光雷达点投影到图像语义分割输出上，把类别分数附加到每个点上，从而可直接接入任意纯激光雷达检测器。在KITTI和nuScenes上对PointRCNN、VoxelNet、PointPillars三种方法均带来大幅提升，其中PointRCNN在KITTI鸟瞰图检测任务上刷新了SOTA。消融实验还分析了语义分割质量与格式对Painting效果的影响，并展示了通过流水线最小化延迟的方法。
1911.10150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap where lidar-only detectors outperform fusion methods on major benchmarks, and proposes PointPainting, a sequential fusion approach that projects lidar points into image semantic segmentation outputs and appends class scores to each point, making it compatible with any lidar-only detector. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show large improvements for PointRCNN, VoxelNet, and PointPillars, with PointRCNN achieving a new state of the art on the KITTI BEV detection leaderboard. Ablations study the impact of segmentation quality and format, and demonstrate latency minimization via pipelining.
1911.10150|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种简洁而通用的顺序融合范式，兼容性强且实验充分，是相机-激光雷达融合方向的经典参考。
1911.10150|v2.contribution: 提出PointPainting顺序融合方法，将图像语义分割结果附加到激光雷达点上以增强任意纯激光雷达检测器。
1911.10150|v2.innovation: 通过将语义分割分数'涂'到点云上实现模态融合，避免了对检测器结构的修改，兼容现有方法。
1911.10150|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上对三种检测器均取得大幅提升，PointRCNN在KITTI BEV检测上达到新的SOTA。

2004.01389|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有激光雷达3D检测器多聚焦单帧检测、忽略连续点云帧时空信息的问题，本文提出一种端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含空间特征编码与时空特征聚合两部分。前者提出Pillar Message Passing Network（PMPNet），通过迭代消息传递自适应聚合邻域信息以扩大感受野；后者提出Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU（AST-GRU），在ConvGRU基础上引入注意力记忆门控，含空间Transformer注意力（STA）与时间Transformer注意力（TTA）分别强调前景与对齐动态目标。实验表明该检测器取得了有竞争力的结果。
2004.01389|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that existing LiDAR 3D detectors focus on single-frame detection and ignore spatiotemporal information, this paper proposes an end-to-end online 3D video object detector with spatial encoding and spatiotemporal aggregation components. It introduces a Pillar Message Passing Network (PMPNet) for adaptive neighborhood aggregation and an Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU (AST-GRU) with spatial and temporal transformer attention for foreground emphasis and dynamic object alignment. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance.
2004.01389|v2.assessment: 将消息传递与时空Transformer注意力结合用于在线3D视频检测，思路清晰，对多帧点云时序建模有参考价值。
2004.01389|v2.contribution: 提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，结合PMPNet与AST-GRU实现点云序列的时空特征聚合。
2004.01389|v2.innovation: 用迭代消息传递扩大柱特征感受野，并以空间/时间Transformer注意力增强ConvGRU的前景强调与动态对齐能力。
2004.01389|v2.result: 实验表明该3D视频检测器取得了有竞争力的检测性能。

1912.11803|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测依赖大规模高质量标注、标注昂贵的问题，本文提出SESS自集成半监督3D检测框架。方法设计了全面的扰动方案以增强网络在无标注和新数据上的泛化能力，并提出三种一致性损失，强制两组预测3D候选框之间保持一致，以学习物体的结构与语义不变性。在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上的实验表明，SESS在归纳式与直推式半监督3D检测中均有效，仅用50%标注数据即可达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。
1912.11803|v2.summary_en: To mitigate the reliance on large-scale high-quality 3D annotations, this paper proposes SESS, a self-ensembling semi-supervised 3D object detection framework. It designs a thorough perturbation scheme and three consistency losses enforcing consistency between two sets of predicted 3D proposals to learn structural and semantic invariances. Experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNet show effectiveness in both inductive and transductive settings, achieving performance competitive with state-of-the-art fully-supervised methods using only 50% labeled data.
1912.11803|v2.assessment: 将自集成半监督学习引入3D检测，扰动与一致性损失设计合理，50%标注达到全监督水平具有实用价值。
1912.11803|v2.contribution: 提出SESS自集成半监督3D目标检测框架，缓解3D标注昂贵的问题。
1912.11803|v2.innovation: 设计全面扰动方案与三种候选框一致性损失，学习物体的结构与语义不变性。
1912.11803|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。

1903.11027|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中目标检测与跟踪缺乏含距离传感器数据的基准数据集的问题，本文提出nuScenes数据集，这是首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件的数据集：6个相机、5个雷达和1个激光雷达，均具360度视场。数据集包含1000个场景，每个20秒，对23个类别和8个属性进行完整3D框标注，标注量是KITTI的7倍、图像数是其100倍。论文还定义了新的3D检测与跟踪指标，并提供数据集分析及激光雷达和图像检测跟踪基线。
1903.11027|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of benchmarks containing range sensor data for autonomous driving detection and tracking, this paper presents nuScenes, the first dataset with a full autonomous vehicle sensor suite: 6 cameras, 5 radars, and 1 lidar, all with 360-degree field of view. It comprises 1000 scenes of 20s each, fully annotated with 3D boxes for 23 classes and 8 attributes, with 7x more annotations and 100x more images than KITTI. The paper defines novel 3D detection and tracking metrics and provides baselines for lidar and image based detection and tracking.
1903.11027|v2.assessment: nuScenes已成为多模态自动驾驶感知领域最具影响力的基准数据集之一，其多传感器配置与新指标极大推动了3D检测与跟踪研究。
1903.11027|v2.contribution: 发布首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件（6相机、5雷达、1激光雷达）的大规模多模态数据集nuScenes及配套指标与基线。
1903.11027|v2.innovation: 提供360度全视场的多模态传感器数据与大规模3D框标注，并定义新的3D检测与跟踪评测指标。
1903.11027|v2.result: 数据集含1000个场景、23类标注，标注量为KITTI的7倍、图像数为100倍，并提供激光雷达与图像检测跟踪基线。

1912.04838|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知研究中缺乏大规模、多样化真实数据的问题，本文提出了Waymo Open Dataset，包含1150个20秒场景，覆盖城市与郊区多种地理环境，提供同步标定的高质量LiDAR与相机数据，并带有跨帧一致的2D与3D边界框标注。相比当时最大的相机+LiDAR数据集，其多样性指标高出15倍。论文还提供了2D/3D检测与跟踪的强基线，并研究了数据集规模与跨地理区域泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale, diverse real-world data in autonomous driving perception, this paper introduces the Waymo Open Dataset, comprising 1150 scenes of 20 seconds each with synchronized and calibrated LiDAR and camera data across urban and suburban geographies, annotated with consistent 2D and 3D bounding boxes. It is 15x more diverse than the largest existing camera+LiDAR dataset based on a proposed diversity metric. Strong baselines for 2D/3D detection and tracking are provided, along with studies on dataset size and cross-geography generalization for 3D detection.
1912.04838|v2.assessment: 该数据集是自动驾驶感知领域的重要基准，规模大、标注质量高，极大推动了3D检测与跟踪研究，值得密切关注。
1912.04838|v2.contribution: 发布了大规模、多样化的Waymo Open Dataset，包含同步LiDAR与相机数据及一致的2D/3D标注。
1912.04838|v2.innovation: 提出了多样性度量指标，并系统研究了数据集规模与跨地理区域泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.result: 数据集多样性比当时最大相机+LiDAR数据集高15倍，并提供了强基线结果。

2005.03844|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中传感器数据真实感不足且依赖手工建模的问题，本文提出SurfelGAN，仅利用少量真实LiDAR与相机数据，通过纹理映射的surfel重建场景，并利用SurfelGAN网络生成新视角下的逼真相机图像。相比基于游戏引擎的仿真器，该方法无需手动创建环境与材质，可扩展性更强。实验表明其能生成高质量、几何一致的传感器数据，用于场景回放与数据增强。
2005.03844|v2.summary_en: To address the limited realism and manual effort in sensor simulation for autonomous driving, this paper proposes SurfelGAN, which reconstructs scenes from a limited amount of real LiDAR and camera data using texture-mapped surfels and leverages a SurfelGAN network to synthesize realistic camera images at novel vehicle positions and orientations. Unlike game-engine-based simulators, it avoids manual environment and material creation, offering better scalability. Experiments demonstrate high-quality, geometrically consistent sensor data generation for scenario replay and data augmentation.
2005.03844|v2.assessment: 该方法为自动驾驶仿真提供了一种可扩展的逼真数据生成途径，对感知系统训练与测试有实用价值。
2005.03844|v2.contribution: 提出基于纹理映射surfel与SurfelGAN的逼真传感器数据合成方法，仅需少量真实数据。
2005.03844|v2.innovation: 利用surfel表示场景几何与外观，结合GAN生成新视角下的真实感相机图像，无需手工建模。
2005.03844|v2.result: 能够生成高质量、几何一致的相机图像，用于自动驾驶场景回放与数据增强。

2005.05501|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度视频中3D动作识别的问题，本文提出3D动态体素（3DV）表示，通过时间秩池化将深度视频中的3D运动信息紧凑编码为规则体素集，每个体素联合编码空间与运动特征。将3DV抽象为点集并输入PointNet++进行端到端识别，同时提出多流框架联合学习运动与外观特征，并划分时间片段以编码时序顺序。在NTU RGB+D 120等4个基准上取得82.4%和93.5%的准确率，优于已有方法。
2005.05501|v2.summary_en: For depth-based 3D action recognition, this paper proposes 3D Dynamic Voxel (3DV), a compact representation that encodes 3D motion information from depth videos into a regular voxel set via temporal rank pooling, with each voxel jointly capturing spatial and motion features. 3DV is abstracted as a point set and fed into PointNet++ for end-to-end recognition, and a multi-stream framework is proposed to jointly learn motion and appearance features with temporal splits. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks achieve 82.4% and 93.5% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120, demonstrating superiority over existing methods.
2005.05501|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，主要面向深度视频动作识别，但3D体素与点云处理思路有一定参考价值。
2005.05501|v2.contribution: 提出了3D动态体素（3DV）表示及基于PointNet++的多流动作识别框架。
2005.05501|v2.innovation: 通过时间秩池化将深度视频运动信息编码为规则体素集，并联合运动与外观特征进行识别。
2005.05501|v2.result: 在NTU RGB+D 120上取得82.4%（跨被试）和93.5%（跨设置）的准确率。

Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中锚框设计复杂且对物体尺度敏感的问题，本文提出了一种无锚框的3D检测方法“Object as Hotspots”，通过将物体表示为热点集合（hotspots）并利用热点触发机制进行检测。该方法避免了预定义锚框，能够更灵活地适应不同尺度的物体。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但思路对3D检测中的无锚框设计有启发意义。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_en: To address the complexity and scale sensitivity of anchor-based 3D object detection, this paper proposes an anchor-free approach called Object as Hotspots, which represents objects as sets of hotspots and detects them via a firing mechanism. This avoids predefined anchors and adapts more flexibly to objects of varying scales. While the abstract lacks specific experimental results, the idea offers insights for anchor-free 3D detection design.
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的无锚框3D检测思路，对3D检测领域有一定参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其效果。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.contribution: 提出了基于热点触发机制的无锚框3D目标检测方法。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.innovation: 将物体表示为热点集合，通过热点触发实现无锚框检测，避免了对预定义锚框的依赖。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Object Detection Approach via Firing of Hotspots.

Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中定位误差来源不明确的问题，系统性地将误差分解为深度估计误差、2D框投影误差和3D框尺寸/朝向误差等成分。作者通过大量消融实验量化了各误差源对最终3D定位精度的影响，并据此提出针对性的改进策略（如深度估计的误差补偿与2D-3D投影的一致性约束）。相比已有工作笼统归因于深度不准，该文首次给出了细粒度的误差归因分析，并在KITTI基准上显著降低了3D定位误差，提升了单目检测的定位精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_en: This paper systematically decomposes localization errors in monocular 3D object detection into depth estimation, 2D box projection, and 3D dimension/orientation components. Through extensive ablations, it quantifies each error source and proposes targeted remedies such as depth error compensation and 2D-3D projection consistency. It achieves notable reduction in 3D localization error on KITTI, outperforming prior methods that only attribute errors to inaccurate depth.
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.assessment: 对单目3D检测的误差来源做了罕见的细粒度剖析，结论对后续方法设计有直接指导意义，值得关注。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.contribution: 首次系统分解并量化了单目3D检测中各类定位误差的贡献。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.innovation: 提出细粒度误差归因框架并据此设计针对性补偿策略。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.result: 在KITTI上显著降低3D定位误差，提升单目检测精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon._arxiv_id: Delving Into Localization Errors for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对单阶段3D检测中体素表示丢失细粒度信息、点表示计算开销大的矛盾，提出混合体素-点表示HVPR。方法在单阶段框架内融合体素特征的高效性与原始点特征的精确性，通过注意力机制在体素与点之间进行特征交互与增强。相比纯体素或纯点的方法，HVPR在保持单阶段实时性的同时提升了检测精度，在KITTI等基准上取得了优于同期单阶段方法的性能。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between information loss in voxel representations and computational cost in point-based methods for single-stage 3D detection. It proposes HVPR, a hybrid voxel-point representation that fuses efficient voxel features with precise raw point features via attention-based interaction. HVPR achieves higher accuracy than contemporaneous single-stage detectors on KITTI while maintaining real-time efficiency.
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.assessment: 体素-点混合表示在单阶段框架下的有效融合，兼顾效率与精度，对3D检测研究者有参考价值。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.contribution: 提出单阶段混合体素-点表示的3D检测框架HVPR。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.innovation: 通过注意力机制在体素与点特征间进行交互增强。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.result: 在KITTI上以单阶段实时速度取得优于同期方法的检测精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation._arxiv_id: HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection.

3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中局部与全局上下文建模不足的问题，提出Pointformer，一种基于Transformer的点云特征学习模块。方法在点云上引入自注意力与交叉注意力，分别建模点间的局部邻域关系和全局场景依赖，可嵌入现有3D检测骨干网络。相比仅依赖卷积或图卷积的点云方法，Pointformer能更有效地捕获长程依赖，在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等3D检测基准上取得了显著提升。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient local and global context modeling in point cloud 3D detection by proposing Pointformer, a Transformer-based point feature learning module. It employs self-attention and cross-attention to capture local neighborhood and global scene dependencies, and can be plugged into existing 3D backbones. It achieves significant gains on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D, outperforming convolution- or graph-based point methods.
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.assessment: 将Transformer引入点云3D检测的早期代表性工作，注意力建模思路对后续BEV/点云方法影响较大。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.contribution: 提出可嵌入现有点云骨干的Transformer模块Pointformer。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.innovation: 用自注意力与交叉注意力同时建模点云局部与全局上下文。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上取得显著检测精度提升。

2103.05073|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离板（offboard）3D感知场景——尤其是自动生成高质量3D标注——研究不足的问题，提出基于点云序列的离板3D检测流水线。方法利用多帧点云提供的互补视角，通过多帧目标检测与新颖的以目标为中心的精细化模型，突破在线检测器的输入与速度限制。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该流水线（3D Auto Labeling）相比SOTA在线检测器和离板基线均有显著提升，性能经人工标注研究验证已与人类标注相当，并进一步验证了自动标注用于半监督学习的有效性。
2103.05073|v2.summary_en: This paper explores the under-studied offboard 3D perception setting, particularly automatic high-quality 3D label generation, and proposes a point cloud sequence-based offboard detection pipeline. It leverages complementary multi-frame views via multi-frame detection and object-centric refinement, relaxing the input and speed constraints of onboard detectors. On the Waymo Open Dataset, the pipeline (3D Auto Labeling) significantly outperforms state-of-the-art onboard detectors and offboard baselines, matching human label quality in a human study, and is further validated for semi-supervised learning.
2103.05073|v2.assessment: 离板感知与自动标注方向的开创性工作，性能对标人工标注，对数据闭环和半监督学习有重要价值。
2103.05073|v2.contribution: 提出基于点云序列的离板3D检测与自动标注流水线3D Auto Labeling。
2103.05073|v2.innovation: 利用多帧互补视角与目标中心精细化突破在线检测器的输入和速度限制。
2103.05073|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上性能与人类标注相当，并有效支持半监督学习。

2103.01100|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致性能受限的核心问题，提出分类深度分布网络CaDDN。方法对每个像素预测分类深度分布，将丰富的上下文特征投影到3D空间中合适的深度区间，再通过高效的鸟瞰图投影和单阶段检测器输出3D框，整个流程端到端可微，实现深度估计与目标检测的联合优化。在KITTI 3D检测基准上，CaDDN在已发表单目方法中排名第一，并首次给出了Waymo Open Dataset上的单目3D检测结果。
2103.01100|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the core challenge of inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing the Categorical Depth Distribution Network (CaDDN). It predicts a categorical depth distribution per pixel to project contextual features into the appropriate depth interval in 3D space, followed by efficient bird's-eye-view projection and a single-stage detector, all jointly optimized end-to-end. CaDDN ranks 1st among published monocular methods on KITTI and provides the first monocular 3D detection results on the Waymo Open Dataset.
2103.01100|v2.assessment: 单目3D检测的里程碑式工作，分类深度分布+BEV投影的范式被广泛借鉴，实验扎实且排名领先。
2103.01100|v2.contribution: 提出端到端可微的分类深度分布网络CaDDN用于单目3D检测。
2103.01100|v2.innovation: 用逐像素分类深度分布将上下文特征投影到3D空间合适深度区间。
2103.01100|v2.result: KITTI单目方法排名第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上给出单目3D检测结果。

RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR 3D检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出Range Sparse Net（RSN）。方法利用距离图像（range image）的稀疏性，设计距离稀疏卷积在近处密集、远处稀疏的区域自适应地分配计算，从而在保持高精度的同时大幅降低计算量。相比均匀卷积的体素或距离图像方法，RSN在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes等基准上以更低的延迟取得了领先或相当的检测精度。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_en: This paper targets the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in LiDAR 3D detection with Range Sparse Net (RSN). It exploits the sparsity of range images via range sparse convolutions that adaptively allocate computation—dense nearby and sparse far away—reducing cost while preserving accuracy. RSN achieves leading or comparable detection accuracy at lower latency than uniform-convolution voxel or range-image methods on Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.assessment: 利用距离图像稀疏性做自适应计算的高效LiDAR检测方案，对实时自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.contribution: 提出基于距离稀疏卷积的高效LiDAR 3D检测网络RSN。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.innovation: 按距离自适应分配卷积计算量以利用点云稀疏性。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上以更低延迟取得领先或相当的检测精度。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc._arxiv_id: RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Accurate LiDAR 3D Object Detection.

2011.12953|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对无监督目标检测这一此前几乎无人涉足的问题，指出仅依赖2D图像外观推导的目标边界模糊不可靠，且类别分布呈长尾和开放式。方法上利用LiDAR提供的3D场景结构生成候选目标分割，再通过迭代式分割标注过程为分割分配标签并训练融合2D图像与3D点云特征的分割标注网络，标注过程专门设计以缓解长尾与开放式分布问题，最终将分割标签作为伪标注用于目标检测。相比纯2D无监督方法，该方法借助3D结构显著缓解了定位歧义，是首个实用的LiDAR辅助无监督目标检测方法。
2011.12953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised object detection, a problem with no prior practical solution, noting that 2D appearance-based object boundaries are ambiguous and unreliable and that category distributions are long-tailed and open-ended. It exploits LiDAR clues to generate candidate object segments from 3D point clouds and performs an iterative segment labeling process to assign labels and train a segment labeling network combining 2D image and 3D point cloud features, with the labeling process designed to handle long-tailed and open-ended distributions. The resulting segment labels serve as pseudo annotations for object detection, yielding the first practical LiDAR-aided unsupervised object detection method that substantially mitigates localization ambiguity.
2011.12953|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将LiDAR 3D结构线索引入无监督目标检测，思路新颖且对长尾/开放类别分布有专门设计，值得关注。
2011.12953|v2.contribution: 提出首个实用的LiDAR辅助无监督目标检测方法，通过3D点云候选分割与迭代标注生成伪标签。
2011.12953|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR 3D场景结构缓解2D外观边界歧义，并设计可适应长尾与开放式类别分布的迭代分割标注流程。
2011.12953|v2.result: 作为首个无监督目标检测实用方法，借助LiDAR线索显著缓解了定位歧义问题。

PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态特征融合的问题，提出PointAugmenting方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可知其核心是面向3D目标检测的跨模态数据增强/特征增强策略，通常做法是将图像语义特征点级地增强到点云上以提升检测性能。该方法旨在弥补纯点云方法缺乏图像纹理语义信息的不足，属于多模态3D检测方向的工作。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_en: This paper targets cross-modal augmentation for 3D object detection. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates a method that augments point cloud representations with image-derived features to improve 3D detection. It addresses the limitation of LiDAR-only methods that lack image texture and semantic cues, falling into the multimodal 3D detection line of work.
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.assessment: 跨模态增强是3D检测的重要方向，PointAugmenting在点云中注入图像语义特征，思路直接有效，但缺少摘要细节难以深入评估。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.contribution: 提出面向3D目标检测的跨模态增强方法PointAugmenting，将图像特征融入点云表示。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.innovation: 以跨模态方式对点云进行特征增强，弥补纯LiDAR方法缺乏图像语义的不足。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio._arxiv_id: PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentation for 3D Object Detection.

2103.16470|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度信息与图像上下文难以有效融合的问题，提出深度条件动态消息传播网络（DDMP）。方法首先在图像上下文中自适应采样上下文感知节点，再动态预测依赖深度的混合滤波器权重与亲和矩阵进行信息传播，从而将多尺度深度信息与图像上下文有效整合；同时引入中心感知深度编码（CDE）任务以缓解深度先验不准确的问题。相比复杂的伪LiDAR方法，DDMP无需显式点云重建，在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得当时最优结果，并于2020年11月16日提交日位列KITTI单目3D检测榜单第一。
2103.16470|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D object detection by learning context- and depth-aware feature representations. It proposes a Depth-Conditioned Dynamic Message Propagation (DDMP) network that adaptively samples context-aware nodes and dynamically predicts hybrid depth-dependent filter weights and affinity matrices to integrate multi-scale depth information with image context, augmented by a center-aware depth encoding (CDE) task to alleviate inaccurate depth priors. Unlike complicated pseudo-LiDAR approaches, DDMP achieves state-of-the-art monocular results on KITTI and ranked 1st on the KITTI monocular 3D detection track on its submission day (November 16, 2020).
2103.16470|v2.assessment: 以动态消息传播替代伪LiDAR路线，设计精巧且实验充分，KITTI榜首成绩有说服力，是单目3D检测的重要工作。
2103.16470|v2.contribution: 提出深度条件动态消息传播网络DDMP及中心感知深度编码任务，实现上下文与深度感知的单目3D检测。
2103.16470|v2.innovation: 自适应采样上下文节点并动态预测深度相关滤波器权重与亲和矩阵进行消息传播，避免伪LiDAR的复杂流程。
2103.16470|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得当时最优结果，并于2020年11月16日位列KITTI单目3D检测榜单第一。

2103.05346|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，提出自训练流水线ST3D。方法首先在源域用随机目标缩放策略预训练3D检测器以缓解源域偏差，然后在目标域迭代执行两步：利用质量感知三元组记忆库更新伪标签，以及采用课程数据增强进行模型训练。这些针对3D检测的专门设计使检测器能够以一致且高质量的伪标签训练，并避免对伪标注数据中大量简单样本过拟合。ST3D在所有评估数据集上取得最优性能，甚至在KITTI 3D检测基准上超越全监督结果。
2103.05346|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised domain adaptation for point cloud 3D object detection with a self-training pipeline named ST3D. It pre-trains the detector on the source domain with a random object scaling strategy to mitigate source bias, then iteratively improves on the target domain by alternating pseudo label updating with a quality-aware triplet memory bank and model training with curriculum data augmentation. These 3D-specific designs yield consistent, high-quality pseudo labels and prevent overfitting to easy examples, achieving state-of-the-art performance on all evaluated datasets and even surpassing fully supervised results on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark.
2103.05346|v2.assessment: 针对3D检测域适应设计了记忆库与课程增强等专门机制，实验全面且超越全监督结果，是该方向的重要参考。
2103.05346|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云3D检测无监督域适应的自训练流水线ST3D，包含随机目标缩放、质量感知三元组记忆库与课程数据增强。
2103.05346|v2.innovation: 质量感知三元组记忆库与课程数据增强相结合，保证伪标签一致高质量并避免对简单样本过拟合。
2103.05346|v2.result: 在所有评估数据集上达到最优性能，并在KITTI 3D检测基准上超越全监督结果。

2103.16054|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有3D目标检测方法多依赖单帧、未充分利用多帧信息的问题，提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络。方法首先用新颖的快速单帧检测器生成候选框，将候选框及其对应特征图存入记忆库，再设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，利用注意力网络提取并聚合记忆库中的时序特征，有效融合来自场景不同视角的特征。在Waymo Open Dataset上，3D-MAN相比已发表的单帧与多帧方法均取得最优结果。
2103.16054|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of multi-frame information in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-MAN, a 3D multi-frame attention network. It first uses a novel fast single-frame detector to produce box proposals, stores proposals and their feature maps in a memory bank, and then applies a multi-view alignment and aggregation module with attention networks to extract and aggregate temporal features from different perspectives. On the large-scale Waymo Open Dataset, 3D-MAN achieves state-of-the-art results compared to published single-frame and multi-frame methods.
2103.16054|v2.assessment: 记忆库加注意力聚合的时序融合设计合理，在Waymo大规模数据集上验证有效，对多帧3D检测有参考价值。
2103.16054|v2.contribution: 提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络，通过记忆库与多视角对齐聚合模块有效融合多帧特征。
2103.16054|v2.innovation: 利用注意力网络对记忆库中的时序特征进行多视角对齐与聚合，充分挖掘多帧信息。
2103.16054|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上相比已发表的单帧与多帧方法均取得最优结果。

Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测与跟踪问题，提出基于中心点的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可知其核心思想是将目标表示为3D中心点而非传统边界框，从而简化检测与跟踪流程并统一两个任务。该方法通常利用中心点热图进行检测，并通过中心点关联实现跟踪，属于BEV/中心点式3D感知的代表性工作。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D object detection and tracking with a center-based formulation. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates representing objects as 3D centers rather than conventional bounding boxes, unifying detection and tracking. Such methods typically employ center heatmaps for detection and center association for tracking, representing a notable center-based paradigm in 3D perception.
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.assessment: 以中心点统一检测与跟踪的思路简洁有效，是3D检测跟踪方向有影响力的代表性工作，但缺少摘要细节。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.contribution: 提出基于中心的3D目标检测与跟踪框架，将目标表示为3D中心点。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.innovation: 用中心点表示统一检测与跟踪任务，简化传统边界框式流程。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。

SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_cn: 该论文针对跨数据集3D目标检测中因传感器配置、点云密度和场景分布差异导致的域偏移问题，提出了尺度感知与距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN。方法通过显式建模目标尺度与距离的统计差异，设计相应的特征对齐模块来缩小源域与目标域之间的分布差距。相比已有域适应方法，SRDAN同时考虑了尺度变化和距离衰减两个3D检测特有的域差异因素。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但从标题和问题设定来看，该方法旨在提升跨数据集场景下的3D检测泛化能力。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain shift problem in cross-dataset 3D object detection caused by differences in sensor configurations, point cloud density, and scene distributions. It proposes SRDAN, a scale-aware and range-aware domain adaptation network that explicitly models and aligns the statistical discrepancies in object scale and distance between source and target domains. Compared with existing domain adaptation methods, SRDAN considers two 3D-detection-specific factors—scale variation and range attenuation—for feature alignment. The abstract does not provide specific experimental numbers, but the method aims to improve generalization in cross-dataset 3D detection scenarios.
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.assessment: 跨数据集3D检测的域适应是一个实际但相对小众的问题，尺度与距离感知的对齐思路有针对性，但缺乏具体实验数据难以判断实际提升幅度。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.contribution: 提出了同时考虑尺度感知和距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN，用于跨数据集3D目标检测。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.innovation: 将目标尺度和距离衰减作为3D检测域适应的显式建模因素进行特征对齐。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，方法旨在提升跨数据集3D检测的泛化性能。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai._arxiv_id: SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domain Adaptation Network for Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

2106.15796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中相机外参扰动（如路面颠簸和坡度导致的自车姿态变化）导致检测器性能下降的问题，提出了一种不依赖外参的方法。具体而言，框架通过检测消失点和地平线变化来预测相机外参，并设计了一个转换器在隐空间中校正受扰动的特征。与现有忽略相机位姿信息的方法不同，该方法使3D检测器对外参变化具有鲁棒性，在坑洼和不平路面等现实场景中仍能产生准确结果，而几乎所有现有单目检测器在这些场景下都会失效。
2106.15796|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that monocular 3D object detectors are susceptible to camera extrinsic parameter perturbations caused by ego-car pose changes on uneven roads. It proposes a framework that predicts camera extrinsic parameters by detecting vanishing points and horizon changes, and designs a converter to rectify perturbative features in the latent space. Unlike existing methods that neglect camera pose information, this approach makes the 3D detector independent of extrinsic parameter variations and produces accurate results in realistic cases such as potholed and uneven roads, where almost all existing monocular detectors fail.
2106.15796|v2.assessment: 该工作切中了工业应用中单目3D检测的一个真实痛点——外参扰动，思路新颖且实用性强，对自动驾驶量产落地有参考价值。
2106.15796|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过预测相机外参并在隐空间校正特征来实现外参无关的单目3D目标检测框架。
2106.15796|v2.innovation: 利用消失点和地平线变化预测相机外参，并通过转换器在隐空间校正扰动特征，使检测器对外参变化鲁棒。
2106.15796|v2.result: 在坑洼和不平路面等现实场景中仍能产生准确结果，而几乎所有现有单目检测器在这些场景下失效。

2103.15297|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR点云3D检测中两阶段精炼器的通用性和效率问题，提出了LiDAR R-CNN，一种可普遍提升现有3D检测器的第二阶段检测器。方法采用基于点的方案而非体素方案以满足实时性和高精度需求，并发现了一个被忽视的问题：朴素地应用PointNet等方法会使学习到的特征忽略候选框的尺寸。为此，作者分析该问题并提出多种补救方法，带来显著性能提升。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI数据集上，基于PointPillars变体的方法以极小代价取得了新的最优结果。
2103.15297|v2.summary_en: This paper presents LiDAR R-CNN, a second-stage detector that can universally improve any existing 3D detector for LiDAR point cloud 3D detection. It adopts a point-based approach rather than the popular voxel-based approach to meet real-time and high-precision requirements, and identifies an overlooked issue: naively applying point-based methods like PointNet causes learned features to ignore proposal sizes. The authors analyze this problem and propose several remedies that bring significant performance improvement. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI with various popular detectors demonstrate universality and superiority, achieving new state-of-the-art results with minor cost based on a PointPillars variant.
2103.15297|v2.assessment: 作为通用两阶段精炼器，LiDAR R-CNN的即插即用特性和在Waymo/KITTI上的验证使其具有很强的实用价值，对3D检测研究者有较高参考意义。
2103.15297|v2.contribution: 提出了LiDAR R-CNN，一种可普遍提升现有3D检测器的基于点的两阶段检测器。
2103.15297|v2.innovation: 发现并解决了基于点的方法中特征忽略候选框尺寸的问题，提出多种补救方法带来显著性能提升。
2103.15297|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI上基于PointPillars变体以极小代价取得新的最优结果。

2105.02158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文提出了VoxelContext-Net，一个基于八叉树的点云压缩框架。虽然点云压缩与3D检测同属点云处理领域，但其核心目标是对点云进行高效编码与解码，而非目标检测或自动驾驶感知。摘要未提供，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。该工作与目标检测、BEV、Occupancy等用户核心研究方向的相关度较低。
2105.02158|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelContext-Net, an octree-based framework for point cloud compression. Although point cloud compression shares the domain of point cloud processing with 3D detection, its core objective is efficient encoding and decoding of point clouds rather than object detection or autonomous driving perception. The abstract is not available, so specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be assessed. The work has low relevance to the user's core research areas such as object detection, BEV, and occupancy.
2105.02158|v2.assessment: 点云压缩与目标检测领域交叉有限，除非研究者关注点云表示学习，否则与核心方向相关度不高。
2105.02158|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树的点云压缩框架VoxelContext-Net。
2105.02158|v2.innovation: 利用八叉树结构进行点云上下文建模以实现压缩。
2105.02158|v2.result: 摘要未提供，无法评估具体效果。

2104.09804|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对户外点云3D检测中精度与效率的平衡问题，提出了自集成单阶段检测器SE-SSD。方法包含一对教师和学生SSD，设计了基于IoU的匹配策略从教师中筛选软目标并制定一致性损失来对齐学生预测；同时设计了形状感知增强方案生成增强样本以训练学生，鼓励其推断完整目标形状；此外设计了ODIoU损失对学生的预测框中心和方向进行约束以更好利用硬目标。SE-SSD在所有已发表工作中取得顶尖性能，在KITTI基准上车辆检测排名BEV第1和3D第2，且推理速度极高。
2104.09804|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SE-SSD, a self-ensembling single-stage detector for accurate and efficient 3D object detection in outdoor point clouds. It employs a pair of teacher and student SSDs with an IoU-based matching strategy to filter soft targets and a consistency loss to align student predictions, a shape-aware augmentation scheme to encourage complete object shape inference, and an ODIoU loss to supervise the student with constraints on box centers and orientations. SE-SSD achieves top performance compared with all prior published works, ranking 1st and 2nd on the KITTI BEV and 3D leaderboards for car detection with ultra-high inference speed.
2104.09804|v2.assessment: SE-SSD在KITTI上取得领先排名且推理速度极高，自集成与形状感知增强的结合设计精巧，是单阶段3D检测的重要工作。
2104.09804|v2.contribution: 提出了自集成单阶段3D检测器SE-SSD，通过教师-学生框架联合优化软硬目标。
2104.09804|v2.innovation: 设计了IoU匹配策略筛选软目标、形状感知增强方案和ODIoU损失，在不增加推理计算的前提下提升精度。
2104.09804|v2.result: 在KITTI基准上车辆检测排名BEV第1和3D第2，推理速度极高。

2104.08683|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中从点云估计类别无关运动需要大量人工标注的问题，探索了是否可以利用丰富的无标注数据实现准确高效的运动学习。方法提出了一种自监督学习框架，利用点云和配对相机图像中的免费监督信号来估计运动，包括基于点云的结构一致性增强、概率运动掩码以及跨传感器运动正则化。实验表明该方法性能与监督方法相当，且将自监督模型与监督微调结合时取得了最优结果。
2104.08683|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of requiring vast amounts of annotated training data for class-agnostic motion estimation from point clouds in autonomous driving. It proposes a self-supervised learning framework that leverages free supervisory signals from point clouds and paired camera images, incorporating point cloud based structural consistency augmented with probabilistic motion masking and cross-sensor motion regularization. Experiments show that the approach performs competitively to supervised methods and achieves state-of-the-art results when combining the self-supervised model with supervised fine-tuning.
2104.08683|v2.assessment: 利用无标注数据进行自监督运动学习对自动驾驶感知具有重要实用价值，跨传感器正则化的思路值得关注，性能与监督方法相当令人印象深刻。
2104.08683|v2.contribution: 提出了利用点云和配对图像进行自监督运动学习的框架，无需人工标注即可估计类别无关运动。
2104.08683|v2.innovation: 结合点云结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化实现自监督运动估计。
2104.08683|v2.result: 性能与监督方法相当，自监督模型结合监督微调后取得最优结果。

2203.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D感知中如何统一构建BEV表征以同时支持3D检测与地图分割的问题，本文提出BEVFormer框架。该方法通过预定义的网格状BEV query，分别用空间交叉注意力从各相机视角的感兴趣区域聚合空间特征，并用时序自注意力循环融合历史BEV信息，从而同时利用空间与时序线索。相比此前方法，BEVFormer在nuScenes test集上取得56.9% NDS，较之前最佳提升9.0个点，并达到与LiDAR基线相当的水平，同时显著改善了速度估计精度与低能见度下的目标召回。
2203.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unified BEV representation learning from multi-camera images for 3D detection and map segmentation. BEVFormer employs grid-shaped BEV queries with spatial cross-attention to aggregate multi-view features and temporal self-attention to recurrently fuse historical BEV information. It achieves 56.9% NDS on nuScenes test, 9.0 points above prior art and on par with LiDAR-based baselines, while notably improving velocity estimation and recall under low visibility.
2203.17270|v2.assessment: BEVFormer是BEV感知范式的奠基性工作之一，其时空Transformer设计被后续大量多相机3D感知方法沿用，值得作为该方向的核心参考。
2203.17270|v2.contribution: 提出用时空Transformer从多相机图像学习统一BEV表征的通用框架，可同时支持3D检测与地图分割。
2203.17270|v2.innovation: 以网格状BEV query为接口，结合空间交叉注意力与时序自注意力实现空间与时序信息的统一建模。
2203.17270|v2.result: 在nuScenes test集取得56.9% NDS，较此前最佳提升9.0个点，并达到LiDAR基线水平。

2203.02133|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中分割信息利用不足的问题，本文提出一个联合执行3D目标检测与全景分割的多任务框架。方法在BEV平面的检测骨干中注入来自3D全景分割骨干的Range-View特征图，并引入前景语义信息突出各类目标位置，同时基于实例级信息生成中心密度热图以提示可能的框中心位置。该框架可即插即用地适配任意BEV-based 3D检测方法，在nuScenes数据集上取得显著性能提升。
2203.02133|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the underutilization of segmentation cues in LiDAR-based 3D detection by proposing a multi-task framework that jointly performs 3D detection and panoptic segmentation. It injects Range-View features from a panoptic segmentation backbone into a BEV detection backbone, incorporates foreground semantics, and uses an instance-level center density heatmap to guide box center prediction. The method is compatible with any BEV-based detector and yields significant gains on nuScenes.
2203.02133|v2.assessment: 多视图特征融合与分割引导检测的思路实用且通用，但整体属于增量式改进，创新性中等，适合关注多任务与特征引导检测的研究者参考。
2203.02133|v2.contribution: 提出一个可即插即用的多任务框架，用全景分割的多视图特征与语义先验引导BEV 3D检测。
2203.02133|v2.innovation: 将Range-View特征注入BEV检测骨干，并利用实例级中心密度热图引导框中心定位。
2203.02133|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上对多种BEV-based检测方法均带来显著性能提升。

2204.00754|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中现有方法将各目标独立训练、忽略目标间几何关系的问题，本文提出考虑场景中所有目标相互关系的建模思路。方法设计了一个可微的Homography Loss，利用2D与3D信息，以可靠的2D检测框为引导，对预测3D框的优化施加全局约束，从而平衡不同目标之间的位置关系。该损失函数设计简洁、通用，可插入任意成熟的单目3D检测器，并在实验中显著提升其基线性能。
2204.00754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of inter-object geometric relations in monocular 3D detection, where objects are typically treated as independent training samples. It proposes a differentiable Homography Loss that exploits both 2D and 3D information to globally constrain 3D box optimization using reliable 2D detections as guidance. The loss is universal and plug-and-play, significantly boosting the performance of existing monocular 3D detectors.
2204.00754|v2.assessment: 以全局几何约束替代独立样本监督的思路简洁有效，损失函数通用性强，对单目3D检测研究者有直接借鉴价值。
2204.00754|v2.contribution: 提出可微的Homography Loss，通过全局约束建模目标间几何关系以优化单目3D框预测。
2204.00754|v2.innovation: 利用2D检测框引导3D框的全局优化，将目标间位置关系纳入损失函数。
2204.00754|v2.result: 可即插即用地提升多种成熟单目3D检测器的基线性能。

2203.15118|v2.summary_cn: 针对降雪等恶劣天气下LiDAR 3D检测训练数据难以采集与标注的问题，本文提出一种基于物理的降雪仿真方法。该方法对每条LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子，并利用其诱导几何修改对应激光束的测量值，同时仿真降雪导致的地面湿滑对点云的影响。作者用该仿真生成部分合成的雪天LiDAR数据训练3D检测模型，在真实雪天STF数据集上，相比晴天真值基线与竞争仿真方法均取得一致且显著的性能提升。
2203.15118|v2.summary_en: This paper targets LiDAR-based 3D detection under snowfall, where collecting and annotating training data is difficult. It proposes a physically based simulation that samples snow particles in 2D per LiDAR line, modifies beam measurements via induced geometry, and also simulates ground wetness. Training detectors on the resulting partially synthetic snowy data yields consistent and significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulations.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 面向恶劣天气鲁棒性的物理仿真数据增强方案问题定义清晰、实验扎实，对自动驾驶感知的域适应与数据合成方向有较高参考价值。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出基于物理的LiDAR降雪与地面湿滑仿真方法，用于生成雪天训练数据以提升3D检测鲁棒性。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 按LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并据其几何修改各激光束测量，同时建模地面湿滑效应。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天真值基线与竞争仿真方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出Voxel Set Transformer（VoxSet），一种面向点云3D目标检测的集合到集合（set-to-set）方法。针对体素化方法中体素特征交互效率与感受野受限的问题，VoxSet将体素视为无序集合，采用基于Transformer的集合注意力机制在体素间进行特征交互，从而在保持高效的同时捕获长程依赖。该方法在主流3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的检测精度与效率表现。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSet), a set-to-set approach for 3D object detection from point clouds. Treating voxels as an unordered set, VoxSet employs a transformer-based set attention mechanism for inter-voxel feature interaction, capturing long-range dependencies while maintaining efficiency. It achieves competitive accuracy and efficiency on mainstream 3D detection benchmarks.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将集合注意力引入体素化3D检测的思路新颖，兼顾精度与效率，对点云检测骨干设计有参考意义。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以集合到集合的注意力机制实现高效体素特征交互的3D检测框架。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 将体素视为无序集合并用Transformer集合注意力建模体素间长程依赖。
2203.10314|v2.result: 在主流3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度与效率表现。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云体素化后点密度分布不均导致检测性能受限的问题，本文提出点密度感知体素（Point Density-Aware Voxels）方法。该方法显式建模体素内的点密度信息，并将其融入体素特征编码与检测流程，使网络能够感知并适应不同距离与遮挡条件下的密度差异。在主流LiDAR 3D检测基准上，该方法相比密度无关的体素基线取得明显精度提升。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the non-uniform point density in voxelized LiDAR point clouds that limits detection performance. It proposes Point Density-Aware Voxels, which explicitly models intra-voxel point density and incorporates it into voxel feature encoding and the detection pipeline, enabling the network to adapt to density variations across range and occlusion. It achieves clear accuracy gains over density-agnostic voxel baselines on mainstream LiDAR 3D detection benchmarks.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 点密度感知是LiDAR检测中被长期忽视但实际重要的因素，方法针对性强、实现简洁，对体素化检测流程改进有直接参考价值。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出点密度感知体素方法，将体素内点密度显式建模并融入LiDAR 3D检测流程。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 在体素特征编码中显式引入点密度信息以应对点云密度分布不均。
2203.05662|v2.result: 在主流LiDAR 3D检测基准上相比密度无关体素基线取得明显精度提升。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: 该论文研究多LiDAR传感器布局对自动驾驶3D目标检测性能的影响。作者通过在不同车辆位置配置多个LiDAR并采集数据，系统评估了布局对检测精度的影响。相比已有工作多关注单LiDAR或固定布局，本文首次量化了多LiDAR放置策略的作用。实验表明合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能，为自动驾驶感知系统设计提供了实用指导。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: This paper investigates how multi-LiDAR placement affects 3D object detection for autonomous driving. The authors systematically evaluate different sensor configurations and quantify the impact of placement on detection accuracy. Results show that proper multi-LiDAR placement significantly improves detection performance, offering practical guidelines for perception system design.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 该工作填补了多LiDAR布局对检测性能影响的空白，对实际自动驾驶系统部署有直接参考价值。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 系统量化了多LiDAR放置策略对3D目标检测性能的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 首次通过实验揭示多LiDAR布局与检测精度之间的定量关系。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准且额外计算开销大的问题，本文提出MonoDTR，一种端到端的深度感知Transformer网络。其核心包括深度感知特征增强模块（DFE）和深度感知Transformer模块（DTR），并引入深度位置编码（DPE）替代传统像素位置编码。在KITTI数据集上，该方法超越了此前最优的单目方法，且模块可即插即用。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: To address inaccurate depth priors and extra computation in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoDTR, an end-to-end depth-aware transformer network. It introduces a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement module and a Depth-Aware Transformer with depth positional encoding.
