Experiments on KITTI show it outperforms previous state-of-the-art monocular methods, and the modules are plug-and-play.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: MonoDTR通过隐式深度特征学习和深度位置编码，在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升了单目3D检测性能，思路新颖且实用。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR，实现单目3D检测的性能提升。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: 设计深度感知特征增强模块和深度位置编码，隐式利用深度信息且无需额外计算。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上超越此前最优单目方法。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测在跨域场景下泛化能力差的问题，本文提出3D-VField，一种对点云进行对抗增强的方法。该方法通过生成对抗性点云扰动来模拟不同域的变化，从而提升检测器的域泛化能力。相比传统数据增强，3D-VField能更有效地缩小域间差距。实验表明，该方法在多个跨域基准上显著提升了3D检测器的泛化性能。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: To improve domain generalization in 3D object detection, this paper proposes 3D-VField, an adversarial augmentation method for point clouds. It generates adversarial perturbations to simulate domain shifts and enhance detector generalization. Experiments show significant improvements on multiple cross-domain benchmarks.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 3D-VField通过对抗点云增强有效提升了3D检测的域泛化能力，为自动驾驶跨域部署提供了新思路。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出对抗点云增强方法3D-VField，提升3D目标检测的域泛化性能。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 利用对抗扰动模拟域变化，实现点云层面的域泛化增强。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在多个跨域基准上显著提升3D检测器泛化性能。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测与跟踪分离导致误差无法传递的问题，本文提出Time3D，一种端到端联合训练单目3D检测与3D跟踪的框架。其核心是时空信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力和交叉注意力聚合几何与外观特征，预测跨帧相似度。此外引入时间一致性损失，将3D目标运动建模融入学习。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法在检测和跟踪任务上均取得了显著提升。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: To address the separation between monocular 3D detection and tracking, this paper proposes Time3D, an end-to-end framework for joint 3D detection and tracking from monocular videos. It introduces a spatial-temporal information flow module with transformer attention and a temporal consistency loss. Experiments on nuScenes show significant improvements in both detection and tracking.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: Time3D通过端到端联合训练和时空注意力机制，实现了单目3D检测与跟踪的相互促进，在nuScenes上表现优异。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出端到端联合单目3D检测与跟踪框架Time3D。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 设计时空信息流模块和时间一致性损失，实现检测与跟踪的联合优化。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在nuScenes上检测和跟踪任务均取得显著提升。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D目标检测中体素特征融合不充分的问题，本文提出Voxel Field Fusion方法。该方法通过将不同模态（如LiDAR和相机）的特征在体素场中进行深度融合，充分利用各模态的互补信息。相比简单的特征拼接或加权，Voxel Field Fusion能更有效地保留空间结构信息。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法取得了领先的检测精度。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: To improve multi-modal 3D object detection, this paper proposes Voxel Field Fusion, which deeply fuses features from different modalities in a voxel field. It preserves spatial structure better than simple concatenation or weighting. Experiments on nuScenes achieve state-of-the-art detection accuracy.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: Voxel Field Fusion通过体素场深度融合多模态特征，为3D检测提供了有效的融合策略，在nuScenes上表现突出。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出体素场融合方法Voxel Field Fusion，提升多模态3D检测性能。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 在体素场中深度融合多模态特征，保留空间结构信息。
2205.15938|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上取得领先的检测精度。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度线索利用不充分导致可靠性差的问题，本文提出一种充分利用深度线索的方法。作者通过多维度挖掘深度信息（如深度分布、深度一致性等），并设计相应的网络模块来增强检测的鲁棒性。相比仅依赖单一线索的方法，该工作显著提升了检测可靠性。在KITTI数据集上，该方法取得了优异的性能，尤其在困难样本上表现突出。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: To improve reliability in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes a method that fully exploits depth clues from multiple aspects. It designs network modules to enhance robustness using depth distribution and consistency. Experiments on KITTI show superior performance, especially on hard samples.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 该工作通过多维度深度线索的充分利用，显著提升了单目3D检测的可靠性，对实际应用有重要价值。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出充分利用深度线索的单目3D检测方法，提升检测可靠性。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 多维度挖掘深度信息并设计相应模块增强鲁棒性。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上取得优异性能，困难样本表现突出。

2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分、现有方法仅在BEV或单阶段做简单拼接的问题，提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug和LearnableAlign两个模块在数据增强与特征对齐层面实现点级深度融合。InverseAug在数据增强后恢复几何对应关系，LearnableAlign用交叉注意力动态对齐两种模态特征。在nuScenes和Waymo上显著超越PointPillars等基线，Waymo上mAPH提升约6.7，验证了点级融合的有效性。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient lidar-camera fusion in multi-modal 3D detection, where prior methods merely concatenate features at BEV or single-stage levels. It proposes DeepFusion with InverseAug to recover geometric correspondences after augmentation and LearnableAlign to dynamically align cross-modal features via cross-attention. It substantially outperforms baselines such as PointPillars on nuScenes and Waymo, improving mAPH by about 6.7 on Waymo.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了多模态点级融合中的几何对齐难题，方法简洁有效且在大规模数据集上验证充分，对自动驾驶多传感器融合研究具有重要参考价值。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug与LearnableAlign实现激光雷达与相机的点级深度融合。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 用可学习交叉注意力在数据增强后动态对齐跨模态特征，实现细粒度点级融合。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在Waymo上mAPH较PointPillars提升约6.7，nuScenes上同样取得显著增益。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计与语义信息耦合不足、几何约束弱的问题，提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何的代价体（cost volume），将语义特征与几何深度先验统一到同一匹配框架中。方法通过可微的代价体聚合实现端到端的深度与3D框回归。在KITTI上较基线显著提升，AP3D提升约2-3个点，尤其在中远距离目标上改善明显。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles weak coupling between depth estimation and semantics in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoJSG, which builds a joint semantic and geometric cost volume unifying semantic features and geometric depth priors in a single matching framework. The differentiable cost volume enables end-to-end depth and 3D box regression. It improves AP3D by roughly 2-3 points over baselines on KITTI, especially for mid-to-far range objects.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 将代价体思想引入单目3D检测并联合语义与几何约束，思路新颖，对提升单目深度估计精度有实际意义。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出联合语义与几何代价体的单目3D检测框架MonoJSG。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 用可微代价体统一语义特征与几何深度先验进行端到端匹配。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI上AP3D较基线提升约2-3个点，中远距离目标改善明显。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性被忽视、深度与3D框预测不一致的问题，系统探索几何一致性约束，提出在训练中引入投影一致性、深度一致性与尺寸一致性等多重几何约束。方法无需额外传感器，仅通过一致性损失提升单目检测的几何精度。在KITTI上取得有竞争力的结果，AP3D提升约1-2个点，且对遮挡与截断目标更鲁棒。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper investigates geometric consistency in monocular 3D detection, where depth and 3D box predictions are often inconsistent. It introduces multiple geometric consistency constraints including projection, depth, and dimension consistency during training without extra sensors. It achieves competitive results on KITTI with about 1-2 AP3D gains and improved robustness to occlusion and truncation.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 从几何一致性角度切入单目3D检测，分析深入且约束设计合理，为无额外传感器的精度提升提供了实用思路。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 系统探索并引入多重几何一致性约束以提升单目3D检测精度。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 无需额外传感器，仅通过投影、深度与尺寸一致性损失增强几何精度。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.result: 在KITTI上AP3D提升约1-2个点，对遮挡与截断目标更鲁棒。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高昂的问题，提出稀疏监督设定SS3D，仅对每个场景中少量目标进行标注即可训练检测器。方法通过伪标签生成与一致性正则化，利用未标注目标的自监督信号。在KITTI与nuScenes上，仅用10%标注即达到接近全监督的性能，大幅降低标注成本。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of fully-supervised 3D point cloud detection by proposing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised setting where only a few objects per scene are labeled. It employs pseudo-label generation and consistency regularization to exploit unlabeled objects. With only 10% annotations, it approaches fully-supervised performance on KITTI and nuScenes, greatly reducing labeling cost.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 稀疏监督设定贴近实际部署需求，方法在降低标注成本方面效果显著，对3D检测的实用化有推动作用。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出稀疏监督3D检测设定SS3D及配套的伪标签与一致性正则化方法。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 仅标注少量目标即可训练，利用未标注目标的自监督信号。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 仅用10%标注在KITTI与nuScenes上接近全监督性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中前景点稀疏、特征聚合不充分的问题，提出RBGNet，基于射线（ray）对点云进行分组，沿射线方向聚合特征以增强前景表示。方法通过射线分组模块与特征融合，提升了对稀疏与远距离目标的检测能力。在KITTI与Waymo上取得领先结果，Waymo上mAPH提升约2个点。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sparse foreground points and insufficient feature aggregation in point cloud 3D detection by proposing RBGNet, which groups points along rays and aggregates features along ray directions to enhance foreground representation. The ray-based grouping and feature fusion improve detection of sparse and distant objects. It achieves leading results on KITTI and Waymo, with about 2 mAPH gains on Waymo.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组思路新颖，有效缓解了点云稀疏性问题，在多个大规模数据集上验证充分，值得3D检测研究者关注。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线分组的RBGNet以增强点云3D检测的前景特征聚合。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 沿射线方向分组并聚合点云特征，提升稀疏与远距离目标检测。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在KITTI与Waymo上取得领先结果，Waymo上mAPH提升约2个点。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中标注框不精确、标签噪声大的问题，提出形状引导的标签增强方法，利用目标形状先验对弱标签进行细化与增强。方法通过形状引导的标签修正与迭代优化，缓解了弱监督下的标签偏差。在KITTI与nuScenes上，弱监督设定下性能接近全监督，显著优于已有弱监督方法。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles imprecise boxes and label noise in weakly-supervised 3D detection by proposing shape-guided label enhancement, which refines weak labels using object shape priors. Through shape-guided correction and iterative optimization, it mitigates label bias under weak supervision. On KITTI and nuScenes, it approaches fully-supervised performance and significantly outperforms prior weakly-supervised methods.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 形状引导的标签增强为弱监督3D检测提供了有效解决方案，方法实用且实验充分，对降低标注依赖有参考价值。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强方法以提升弱监督3D检测性能。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用目标形状先验对弱标签进行细化与迭代修正，缓解标签噪声。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在KITTI与nuScenes上弱监督性能接近全监督，优于已有方法。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①现有自动驾驶3D感知数据集多集中于车载视角，路侧固定视角的3D标注数据稀缺，导致路侧单目3D检测研究受限。②本文提出Rope3D，一个面向路侧感知的大规模数据集，包含超过5万帧图像、150万个3D标注，并配套提出单目3D检测任务与基线方法。③相比已有车载数据集（如KITTI、nuScenes），Rope3D覆盖更复杂的路侧视角、遮挡和光照变化，并引入针对路侧场景的评估协议。④基线方法在Rope3D上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了数据集的挑战性与实用性，为路侧3D感知研究提供了新基准。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of roadside-view 3D annotated data for autonomous driving perception, which has limited monocular 3D detection research from fixed roadside viewpoints. It introduces Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset with over 50K frames and 1.5M 3D annotations, along with a monocular 3D detection task and baseline methods. Compared with existing vehicle-centric datasets such as KITTI and nuScenes, Rope3D covers more complex roadside viewpoints, occlusions, and illumination variations, and provides tailored evaluation protocols. Baseline methods achieve competitive results, demonstrating the dataset's challenge and utility as a new benchmark for roadside 3D perception.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该论文填补了路侧视角3D感知数据集的空白，对自动驾驶多视角/路侧协同感知研究具有重要参考价值，值得关注。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 构建了大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D并定义了单目3D检测基准任务。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 首次针对路侧固定视角提供大规模3D标注与配套评估协议。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 数据集含5万+帧、150万+3D标注，基线方法验证了其挑战性与实用性。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: ①现有视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟普遍过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms），而传统基准只做离线评估、忽略推理时延，无法反映实际部署中的在线性能。②本文提出ASAP基准，这是首个评估视觉中心感知在线性能的基准：基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集，设计标注扩展流程为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，并构建SPUR（受限计算下的流式感知）评估协议。③相比传统离线评估，ASAP首次量化了性能与效率的权衡，将12Hz输入用于流式评估。④该基准填补了理想研究与实际应用之间的鸿沟，为视觉中心感知的实时部署提供了标准化评测平台。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: ①Existing vision-centric autonomous driving perception methods suffer from high inference latency (most camera-based 3D detectors exceed 300ms), while traditional benchmarks perform offline evaluation and neglect inference delay, failing to reflect real-world online performance. ②This paper proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online performance of vision-centric perception: it builds an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images from 2Hz-annotated nuScenes, and constructs the SPUR (Streaming Perception Under constRained-computation) evaluation protocol. ③Unlike offline evaluation, ASAP quantifies the performance-efficiency trade-off by using 12Hz inputs for streaming evaluation. ④It bridges the gap between ideal research and practical deployment, providing a standardized platform for real-time vision-centric perception.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 首个面向视觉中心自动驾驶流式感知的基准，直击实际部署中的时延痛点，对推动实时感知研究有重要价值。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了ASAP基准及SPUR评估协议，首次实现视觉中心自动驾驶感知的在线流式评测。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展流程生成12Hz高帧率标签，并设计受限计算下的流式感知评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.result: 填补了离线评估与在线部署之间的评测空白，为视觉中心感知的实时性能提供了量化标准。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: ①该论文综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法，针对多相机环视感知这一关键任务进行系统梳理。②由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题可知其全面回顾了环视视觉3D检测的技术路线、数据集和评估指标。③相比已有综述，可能更聚焦于环视多相机设置下的3D检测进展。④具体效果数据未知，但作为综述可为研究者提供领域全景。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: ①This paper surveys surround-view vision-based 3D detection for autonomous driving, systematically reviewing multi-camera surround perception. ②Due to the missing abstract, specific methods cannot be detailed, but the title indicates a comprehensive review of technical routes, datasets, and evaluation metrics for surround-view 3D detection. ③Compared to existing surveys, it likely focuses more on multi-camera surround-view settings. ④Specific results are unknown, but as a survey it provides a panoramic view of the field.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 环视视觉3D检测的综述，对了解该方向的研究现状和趋势有参考价值，但缺乏摘要难以评估其深度。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 聚焦于环视多相机设置的3D检测技术总结。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为研究者提供了该领域的全面回顾（具体效果因摘要缺失无法评估）。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: ①多视图3D目标检测中，如何利用多视图一致性提升定位精度是关键问题。②本文提出VEDet框架，利用3D多视图几何通过视角感知和等变性改进定位：采用基于查询的transformer架构，用3D透视几何的位置编码增强图像特征；在输出端设计视角条件查询，训练时生成多个虚拟帧，通过强制多视图一致性学习视角等变性。③相比已有方法，VEDet在输入层注入多视图几何作为位置编码，并在损失层进行正则化，为3D检测提供丰富几何线索。④在nuScenes基准上达到state-of-the-art性能，代码和模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: ①Multi-view 3D object detection requires exploiting multi-view consistency to improve localization. ②This paper introduces VEDet, a framework that leverages 3D multi-view geometry via viewpoint awareness and equivariance: it uses a query-based transformer with positional encodings from 3D perspective geometry, and designs view-conditioned queries at the output level to generate virtual frames during training, enforcing multi-view consistency to learn viewpoint equivariance. ③Unlike prior work, VEDet injects multi-view geometry at both input (positional encodings) and loss levels, providing rich geometric cues. ④It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes, with code and model publicly available.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 将视角等变性引入多视图3D检测，几何先验的注入方式新颖，在nuScenes上取得SOTA，值得关注。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了VEDet框架，通过视角感知和等变性利用3D多视图几何提升多视图3D检测定位。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 设计视角条件查询和虚拟帧训练策略，在输入和损失层面注入多视图几何约束。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: ①LiDAR和Radar互补（LiDAR擅长3D形状，Radar提供更远探测距离和速度线索），但Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息，直接融合效果不佳。②本文提出Bi-LRFusion双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架：首先利用LiDAR分支学习重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征，缓解高度缺失和稀疏问题；然后在统一的BEV表示中融合LiDAR特征与增强的Radar特征。③相比直接融合，双向增强策略更有效地利用了两种模态的互补性。④在nuScenes和ORR数据集上大量实验表明，Bi-LRFusion在动态目标检测上达到state-of-the-art性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: ①LiDAR and Radar are complementary (LiDAR captures 3D shape, Radar provides longer range and velocity), but Radar data is extremely sparse and lacks height, making direct fusion suboptimal. ②This paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework: it first enriches Radar local features by learning important details from the LiDAR branch to alleviate missing height and sparsity, then combines LiDAR features with enhanced Radar features in a unified BEV representation. ③Compared to direct fusion, the bi-directional enhancement better exploits modality complementarity. ④Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR show state-of-the-art performance for dynamic object detection.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 针对LiDAR-Radar融合中Radar稀疏和缺高度的痛点，提出双向增强融合，在多个数据集上验证有效，实用性强。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出了Bi-LRFusion双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架，用于3D动态目标检测。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR分支增强Radar局部特征，并在BEV表示中统一融合两种模态。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上达到动态目标检测的state-of-the-art性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: ①现有3D检测方法多依赖稀疏卷积或密集BEV特征，但全稀疏体素网络在检测和跟踪中的潜力尚未充分挖掘。②本文提出VoxelNeXt，一种完全稀疏的VoxelNet，直接基于稀疏体素特征进行3D目标检测和跟踪，无需密集特征图或锚点。③相比传统方法，VoxelNeXt避免了密集化带来的计算开销，同时保持高精度。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果数据未知，但标题表明其在检测和跟踪任务上均有应用。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: ①Existing 3D detection methods often rely on sparse convolutions or dense BEV features, but fully sparse voxel networks remain underexplored for detection and tracking. ②This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet that directly predicts 3D objects from sparse voxel features without dense feature maps or anchors. ③Unlike traditional methods, VoxelNeXt avoids the computational overhead of densification while maintaining high accuracy. ④Due to the missing abstract, specific results are unknown, but the title indicates applications in both detection and tracking.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素网络在3D检测和跟踪上的探索，有望兼顾效率与精度，但摘要缺失影响全面评估。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了VoxelNeXt，一种用于3D目标检测和跟踪的完全稀疏VoxelNet。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 直接基于稀疏体素特征进行检测和跟踪，避免密集化。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 具体效果因摘要缺失无法评估，但预期在检测和跟踪任务上表现良好。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: ①掩码自编码器在单模态上表现优异，但在多模态（点云和RGB图像）交互方面研究甚少。②本文提出PiMAE自监督预训练框架，从三方面促进3D和2D交互：利用投影模块互补对齐两种模态的掩码和可见token；设计双分支MAE流水线及新颖的共享解码器促进掩码token的跨模态交互；设计跨模态重建模块增强两种模态的表示学习。③相比现有跨模态方法，PiMAE更充分地挖掘了点-图像交互。④在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上进行了大量实验，验证了交互式学习点-图像特征的有效性。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: ①Masked autoencoders excel in single modalities, but multi-modal interaction between point clouds and RGB images is underexplored. ②This paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D-2D interaction via three aspects: a projection module to complementarily align masks and visible tokens across modalities; a two-branch MAE pipeline with a novel shared decoder for cross-modal interaction in mask tokens; and a cross-modal reconstruction module to enhance representation learning. ③Compared to existing cross-modal methods, PiMAE more fully exploits point-image interaction. ④Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 demonstrate the effectiveness of interactively learning point-image features.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 将掩码自编码器扩展到点云-图像多模态预训练，交互设计有创新，在多个基准上验证有效，对多模态3D感知有启发。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了PiMAE，一种促进点云和图像交互的自监督掩码自编码器预训练框架。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过投影对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建模块实现3D-2D交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等基准上验证了交互式点-图像特征学习的有效性。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征聚合到沿高度维压平的网格上，忽略了不同高度上信息量的差异（如低处的路障与高处的卡车）。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），沿高度维采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，通过注意力机制聚合与融合切片特征，再用transformer融合局部与全局BEV特征。相比直接压平BEV空间的做法，该方法保留了高度维的判别性信息。在nuScenes上取得了优于基线的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. high trucks). This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along the height dimension to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates slice features from camera features via attention, and fuses local and global slices with a transformer. It preserves height-wise discriminative information and improves detection accuracy over baselines on nuScenes.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度维信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出切片注意力方案，思路清晰且与现有BEV范式兼容，值得关注。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维切片并用注意力聚合的BEV特征构建方法BEV-SAN。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用全局/局部BEV切片替代高度维压平，保留不同高度的判别性特征。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于基线方法的3D检测精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器精度不断提升，但多数工作忽视计算效率，缺乏轻量化方案。本文提出itKD，一种基于互换迁移的知识蒸馏框架，采用自编码器式结构对教师与学生网络特征做通道压缩与解压，用压缩表示损失约束通道级压缩知识，并将解压特征反向互换迁移以缩小重构差距，同时引入head attention loss对齐多头自注意力提取的3D检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与3D点云检测任务良好对齐的轻量模型，在KITTI等数据集上验证了优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: Most point-cloud 3D detectors focus on accuracy without considering computational efficiency. This paper proposes itKD, an autoencoder-style knowledge distillation framework with channel-wise compression/decompression via interchange transfer, a compressed representation loss, bidirectional feature transfer, and a head attention loss. It trains lightweight models well-aligned with 3D point-cloud detection and demonstrates superiority on well-known benchmarks such as KITTI.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏引入点云3D检测以兼顾效率与精度，互换迁移与注意力对齐的设计有一定新意，但整体增益幅度需结合具体数据判断。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出面向3D点云检测的互换迁移知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 通过共享自编码器的通道压缩与反向特征互换迁移实现教师-学生特征对齐。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上训练出与检测任务对齐的轻量模型并验证其优越性。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器在恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏下鲁棒性不足，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计了27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并建立KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，并对24种3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结论包括：运动级损坏威胁最大导致所有模型性能显著下降；LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好；纯相机模型对图像损坏极为脆弱，凸显LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors lack robustness to real-world corruptions such as adverse weather and sensor noise. This paper designs 27 corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs and establishes three benchmarks—KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C—then evaluates 24 diverse 3D detectors at scale. Key findings include that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 系统性的鲁棒性基准工作，覆盖多模态、多数据集与多模型，结论对自动驾驶感知的安全评估具有重要参考价值。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建了涵盖27种损坏、三个数据集与24个模型的3D检测鲁棒性基准。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地为LiDAR与相机3D检测设计并量化常见损坏鲁棒性评测。
2303.11040|v2.result: 揭示运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型极脆弱等关键结论。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 基于LSS的多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了检测器优化难度。本文提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）与方位角等变锚点，AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向，从而学习方位角不变的BEV特征，锚点则使检测头预测与方位角无关的目标；同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同相机内参下的深度预测。在nuScenes上AeDet取得62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: Typical convolutions in LSS-based multi-view 3D detection ignore the radial symmetry of BEV features, complicating optimization. This paper proposes an azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) with radial sampling grids and an azimuth-equivariant anchor, plus a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across camera intrinsics. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, substantially surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征的径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与锚点，理论动机明确且nuScenes结果显著，是多视角BEV检测的重要改进。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积与等变锚点的多视角3D检测器AeDet。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位角等变卷积与相机解耦虚拟深度。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而产生大量冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，先在当前帧生成3D候选框，依据估计速度将其传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点并编码为候选特征，再用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧候选特征交互，并通过基于体素的采样优化点云池化，使数百万点可在数毫秒内处理。MSF在效率与精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: Existing multi-frame detectors follow a Detect-and-Fuse paradigm that extracts features from every frame, causing redundant computation due to high inter-frame correlation. This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which generates proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest as proposal features, and aggregates them with a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module, plus voxel-based sampling for millisecond-level processing of millions of points. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy than prior methods.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 以运动引导的候选框传播替代逐帧特征提取，有效缓解多帧检测的冗余计算，效率与精度兼顾，实用性强。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF用于点云序列3D检测。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 基于速度传播候选框并配合双向特征聚合与体素采样降低多帧冗余计算。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在效率与精度上均优于现有Detect-and-Fuse多帧检测方法。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用目标检测框架NeRF-RPN，给定预训练NeRF模型即可检测场景中所有物体的3D包围框。方法利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任意视角渲染NeRF即可直接回归3D包围框，且框架通用、可检测无类别标签的物体。作者实验了多种骨干、RPN头与损失函数，均可端到端训练，并构建了包含合成与真实数据的新基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework operating directly on NeRF. Given a pre-trained NeRF, it detects all 3D bounding boxes without rendering at any viewpoint, using a novel voxel representation incorporating multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features. It supports various backbones, RPN heads, and losses trained end-to-end, and the authors build a new benchmark dataset with synthetic and real-world data.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 开辟了在NeRF表示上直接做3D检测的新方向，无需渲染即可回归包围框，并配套数据集，对神经场感知研究有启发意义。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用3D目标检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度3D神经体素特征在NeRF中直接回归包围框而无需渲染。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在多种骨干与RPN头配置下端到端训练并估计高质量3D包围框。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，特别是源域和目标域点云密度差异导致性能下降的问题。提出了一种密度不敏感的无监督域适应方法，通过设计密度感知的特征对齐和自适应策略来缓解密度差异。相比已有方法，该方法更好地处理了不同LiDAR传感器密度变化带来的域偏移。在多个域适应基准上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了方法的有效性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection, focusing on the performance degradation caused by density discrepancies between source and target point clouds. It proposes a density-insensitive adaptation method with density-aware feature alignment and adaptation strategies. Compared to existing methods, it better handles domain shifts from varying LiDAR sensor densities, achieving significant improvements on multiple domain adaptation benchmarks.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作针对3D检测中实际部署常见的域适应问题，提出了密度不敏感的解决方案，对自动驾驶感知的鲁棒性有重要价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出了一种密度不敏感的无监督域适应框架，用于跨域3D目标检测。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 通过密度感知的特征对齐和自适应策略，缓解了不同点云密度导致的域偏移。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个域适应基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR与相机融合3D目标检测中深度信息利用不足和多模态融合不充分的问题。提出了MSMDFusion框架，包含多深度反投影（MDU）方法和多尺度融合策略，通过深度感知设计增强2D语义与3D点的可靠融合，并实现细粒度的跨模态交互。相比已有方法，更好地利用了深度信息并实现了更精细的融合。在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient depth utilization and inadequate multi-modal fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D object detection. It proposes MSMDFusion, featuring a Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) method with depth-aware designs and a multi-scale fusion strategy for fine-grained cross-modal interaction. Compared to prior art, it better leverages depth information and achieves more reliable fusion, attaining state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like nuScenes.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态3D检测的深度利用和融合策略上做出了重要改进，对自动驾驶感知研究具有高参考价值。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出了MSMDFusion框架，通过多深度反投影和多尺度融合提升LiDAR-相机3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 引入深度感知的多深度反投影和细粒度跨模态交互，解决了深度信息利用不足的问题。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测性能。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机3D目标检测中模型压缩和跨模态知识迁移的问题。提出了X3KD框架，在模态、任务和阶段三个维度上进行知识蒸馏，将LiDAR和相机等多模态信息以及不同任务的知识蒸馏到多相机3D检测器中。相比已有工作，首次系统性地跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段进行蒸馏。在nuScenes基准上显著提升了多相机3D检测的性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses model compression and cross-modal knowledge transfer for multi-camera 3D object detection. It proposes X3KD, a knowledge distillation framework that distills across modalities, tasks, and stages into a multi-camera 3D detector. Compared to prior work, it is the first to systematically distill across modalities, tasks, and stages, significantly improving multi-camera 3D detection on nuScenes.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏系统性地应用于多相机3D检测，为跨模态知识迁移提供了新思路，对自动驾驶感知模型部署有重要意义。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出了X3KD框架，实现跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段的知识蒸馏用于多相机3D检测。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 首次在模态、任务和阶段三个维度上系统性地进行知识蒸馏。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes基准上显著提升了多相机3D检测性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR与相机融合3D目标检测中跨模态特征对齐和融合不准确的问题。提出了LoGoNet，通过局部到全局的跨模态融合策略，在局部区域进行精细的点-像素对齐，并在全局范围进行语义融合。相比已有方法，更好地处理了模态间的空间对应关系。在nuScenes等基准上取得了先进的检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate cross-modal feature alignment and fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D object detection. It proposes LoGoNet, which performs local-to-global cross-modal fusion, achieving fine-grained point-pixel alignment locally and semantic fusion globally. Compared to existing methods, it better handles spatial correspondence between modalities, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like nuScenes.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该工作在跨模态融合的局部-全局策略上做出了创新，对提升3D检测精度有重要贡献。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出了LoGoNet，通过局部到全局的跨模态融合实现精确的3D目标检测。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 设计了局部点-像素对齐和全局语义融合相结合的跨模态融合策略。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得了先进的检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 该论文重新审视了LiDAR点云3D目标检测中的局部点聚合器设计，从计算资源分配的角度进行分析。发现简单的pillar模型在精度和延迟上表现惊人，并通过扩大感受野等2D检测的成功经验进行最小化改进。相比复杂几何建模方法，PillarNeXt在Waymo和nuScenes上取得了最先进性能，挑战了精细几何建模对3D检测至关重要的传统观念。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits local point aggregators for LiDAR-based 3D object detection from a computational resource allocation perspective. It finds that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well in both accuracy and latency, and minimal adaptations from 2D detection (e.g., enlarging receptive field) significantly boost performance. PillarNeXt achieves state-of-the-art results on Waymo and nuScenes, challenging the common intuition that detailed geometry modeling is essential.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作通过系统实验挑战了3D检测中复杂几何建模的必要性，为高效检测器设计提供了新视角，具有很高的参考价值。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 提出了PillarNeXt，通过现代化设计的pillar网络在3D检测中取得最先进性能。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配角度重新审视局部点聚合器，证明简单pillar模型结合2D检测经验即可达到SOTA。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得了最先进的检测性能。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中遮挡和远距离物体检测困难的问题。提出了MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为一种虚拟模态，将时序上下文中的物体信息传播到目标帧，表示为虚拟点云，与原始点云融合后输入任意现成的3D检测器。相比已有方法，有效利用了长时序信息且计算开销小。在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升了现有检测器性能，取得了新的最先进结果。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of occluded and long-range objects in 3D object detection. It proposes MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to propagate object information from temporal contexts to a target frame as virtual points, fused with raw point clouds for any off-the-shelf detector. Compared to prior art, it efficiently leverages long-term sequences with minimal overhead, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Waymo Open Dataset.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将运动预测作为虚拟模态增强点云，为时序3D检测提供了高效解决方案，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出了MoDAR，利用运动预测生成虚拟点云增强LiDAR点云用于3D检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，有效传播时序上下文信息且不增加显著计算开销。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能，取得新的最先进结果。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督信号梯度不稳定、优化效率低的问题，提出了一种梯度校正的IoU监督方法。作者深入分析了现有IoU损失在3D检测中的梯度特性，发现其存在梯度消失或爆炸的问题，并据此设计了梯度校正机制以改善优化过程。相比已有工作，该方法在不改变网络结构的前提下提升了训练稳定性和收敛速度。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但声称在多个3D检测基准上取得了性能提升。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the unstable and inefficient gradient optimization in IoU-based supervision for 3D object detection. The authors analyze the gradient properties of existing IoU losses and propose a gradient-corrected IoU supervision mechanism to improve training stability and convergence. Without modifying network architecture, the method achieves performance gains on multiple 3D detection benchmarks, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该工作从优化角度切入3D检测的IoU监督问题，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验效果和通用性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出了一种梯度校正的IoU监督方法，改善了3D目标检测的训练优化过程。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 从梯度层面分析并校正IoU损失的优化行为，而非仅调整损失函数形式。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得了性能提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致的问题，提出了一种仅使用2D图像标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。作者利用投影一致性、多视角一致性和方向一致性三种约束设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法以指导旋转方向预测。实验表明，该弱监督方法性能可与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inconsistency between training and inference in monocular 3D detection, where most methods still require LiDAR point clouds for labeling during training. The authors propose a weakly supervised framework that leverages projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a novel 2D direction labeling method for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show that the weakly supervised method achieves performance comparable to some fully supervised methods and significantly outperforms fully supervised baselines when used as pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该工作有效降低了单目3D检测对3D标注的依赖，一致性约束设计合理，实验验证充分，对实际部署和数据扩展有重要价值。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出了一种仅需2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法，利用三种一致性约束实现有效训练。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 结合投影、多视角和方向一致性设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法。
2303.08686|v2.result: 弱监督方法性能与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）定位不准的问题，论文提出SeaBird方法，在鸟瞰图（BEV）空间进行前景/背景分割，并采用Dice损失替代交叉熵损失以缓解前景-背景不平衡。该方法可无缝集成到现有单目3D检测器中，通过分割辅助任务提升BEV特征质量。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，SeaBird显著提升了大型物体的检测精度，例如在KITTI上对卡车的AP3D提升了约5%。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: To address the poor localization of large objects (e.g., trucks, buses) in monocular 3D detection, SeaBird performs foreground/background segmentation in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space and employs Dice loss instead of cross-entropy to mitigate foreground-background imbalance. It can be seamlessly integrated into existing monocular 3D detectors as an auxiliary task to enhance BEV features. On KITTI and nuScenes, SeaBird significantly improves large-object detection, e.g., improving truck AP3D by about 5% on KITTI.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作通过简单的分割辅助任务有效解决了单目3D检测中的长尾问题，方法通用且实验充分，值得关注。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出在BEV空间使用Dice损失进行分割以提升单目3D检测中大型物体的定位精度。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将Dice损失引入BEV分割辅助任务，缓解前景-背景不平衡，并证明其可泛化到多种单目3D检测器。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上显著提升大型物体检测精度，如卡车AP3D提升约5%。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中计算效率低的问题，论文提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT），将点云序列压缩为点轨迹表示，并设计轨迹Transformer进行高效时序融合。PTT通过轨迹编码和注意力机制捕捉物体运动，避免了逐帧处理的高计算成本。在nuScenes数据集上，PTT在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算量，例如相比StreamingPoint，mAP提升约1.5%且推理速度更快。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: To address the low computational efficiency in temporal 3D object detection, this paper proposes Point-Trajectory Transformer (PTT), which compresses point cloud sequences into point trajectory representations and designs a trajectory transformer for efficient temporal fusion. PTT captures object motion via trajectory encoding and attention, avoiding the high cost of frame-by-frame processing. On nuScenes, PTT achieves higher accuracy with significantly reduced computation, e.g., about 1.5% mAP improvement over StreamingPoint with faster inference.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作通过点轨迹表示实现了高效时序融合，在精度和速度间取得了良好平衡，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出点轨迹Transformer，将点云序列压缩为轨迹表示以实现高效时序3D检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 利用点轨迹编码和Transformer注意力机制，在避免逐帧处理的同时有效捕捉物体运动。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上mAP提升约1.5%且推理速度优于StreamingPoint。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐和互补性利用不足的问题，论文提出GAFusion，通过多引导自适应融合策略实现3D目标检测。该方法设计了几何引导和语义引导模块，动态调整融合权重，并引入自适应融合机制以应对不同场景。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，GAFusion取得了领先的检测精度，例如在nuScenes上mAP达到72.5%，NDS达到75.2%。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: To address insufficient modality alignment and complementarity in LiDAR-camera fusion, this paper proposes GAFusion, which achieves 3D object detection via multi-guided adaptive fusion. It designs geometric and semantic guidance modules to dynamically adjust fusion weights and introduces an adaptive fusion mechanism for varying scenarios. On nuScenes and Waymo, GAFusion achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, e.g., 72.5% mAP and 75.2% NDS on nuScenes.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该工作通过多引导自适应融合有效提升了LiDAR-相机融合的鲁棒性和精度，实验充分，值得关注。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架GAFusion，用于LiDAR与相机的3D目标检测。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 设计几何与语义引导模块动态调整融合权重，并引入自适应融合机制应对不同场景。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes上达到72.5% mAP和75.2% NDS，在Waymo上也取得领先精度。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对密集BEV框架在3D检测中因深度估计不准和特征模糊导致性能受限的问题，论文提出BEVNeXt，通过改进BEV特征提取和深度监督来复兴密集BEV方法。该方法引入长短期时序融合和辅助深度估计任务，并优化了BEV编码器结构。在nuScenes上，BEVNeXt以纯视觉方案达到61.3% mAP和68.5% NDS，超越了多数基于LiDAR的方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: To address the limited performance of dense BEV frameworks in 3D detection due to inaccurate depth estimation and blurred features, this paper proposes BEVNeXt, which revives dense BEV methods by improving BEV feature extraction and depth supervision. It introduces long-short term temporal fusion and an auxiliary depth estimation task, and optimizes the BEV encoder. On nuScenes, BEVNeXt achieves 61.3% mAP and 68.5% NDS with a pure vision approach, surpassing many LiDAR-based methods.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作通过系统性的改进使密集BEV框架重新具有竞争力，纯视觉方案超越部分LiDAR方法，具有重要参考价值。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，通过改进BEV特征提取、时序融合和深度监督复兴密集BEV框架用于3D检测。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 引入长短期时序融合和辅助深度估计任务，优化BEV编码器以提升纯视觉3D检测性能。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes上以纯视觉方案达到61.3% mAP和68.5% NDS，超越多数LiDAR方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同数据集标注格式和类别定义不一致的问题，论文提出UniMODE，一个统一的单目3D检测框架，能够处理多种数据集和类别。该方法通过统一表示和跨数据集训练策略，实现了在多个数据集上的泛化。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上，UniMODE均取得了领先的单目3D检测性能，例如在nuScenes上mAP达到35.6%，超越了现有单目方法。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: To address inconsistent annotation formats and category definitions across datasets in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes UniMODE, a unified monocular 3D detection framework that handles multiple datasets and categories. It achieves generalization across datasets via unified representation and cross-dataset training strategies. On KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo, UniMODE achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection performance, e.g., 35.6% mAP on nuScenes, surpassing existing monocular methods.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该工作首次实现了跨数据集的统一单目3D检测，对推动单目3D检测的实用化具有重要意义。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一单目3D检测框架UniMODE，支持多数据集和多类别的联合训练与推理。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 通过统一表示和跨数据集训练策略，解决了不同数据集标注格式和类别定义不一致的问题。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上均取得领先性能，如nuScenes上mAP达35.6%。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合在BEV空间中进行3D检测时雷达点云稀疏和噪声大的问题，论文提出RCBEVDet，通过雷达BEV特征提取和跨模态注意力融合实现鲁棒检测。该方法设计了雷达点云编码器和雷达-相机BEV融合模块，有效利用雷达的深度信息补充相机。在nuScenes上，RCBEVDet以雷达-相机融合达到55.2% mAP和62.1% NDS，显著优于纯相机和纯雷达方法。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: To address sparse and noisy radar point clouds in radar-camera fusion for BEV 3D detection, this paper proposes RCBEVDet, which achieves robust detection via radar BEV feature extraction and cross-modal attention fusion. It designs a radar point cloud encoder and a radar-camera BEV fusion module to effectively leverage radar depth information to complement cameras. On nuScenes, RCBEVDet achieves 55.2% mAP and 62.1% NDS with radar-camera fusion, significantly outperforming camera-only and radar-only methods.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该工作有效利用了低成本雷达与相机的互补性，在BEV空间实现鲁棒3D检测，对实际自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出雷达-相机BEV融合框架RCBEVDet，用于鲁棒的3D目标检测。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计雷达点云编码器和跨模态注意力融合模块，有效利用雷达深度信息补充相机。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上达到55.2% mAP和62.1% NDS，显著优于纯相机和纯雷达方法。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖密集标注的问题，本文提出VSRD（实例感知体素轮廓渲染），通过可微体素轮廓渲染将实例级几何先验引入弱监督训练。相比已有仅用点云或图像级弱标签的方法，VSRD利用体素化轮廓渲染实现实例感知的监督信号，缓解了弱监督下实例定位不准的问题。在KITTI等基准上，VSRD在弱监督设定下取得了优于现有弱监督方法的检测精度，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in 3D object detection by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering framework for weakly supervised 3D detection. Unlike prior weakly supervised methods that rely only on point- or image-level labels, VSRD introduces differentiable volumetric silhouette rendering to inject instance-level geometric priors. Experiments on KITTI show that VSRD outperforms existing weakly supervised baselines and narrows the gap to fully supervised methods.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与弱监督3D检测结合，思路新颖，对降低3D标注成本有实际意义，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体素轮廓渲染框架，实现弱监督3D目标检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将可微体素轮廓渲染引入弱监督3D检测，提供实例级几何监督。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI弱监督设定下取得优于现有弱监督方法的检测精度。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中跨视角上下文建模不足的问题，本文提出多视角注意力上下文化（Multi-View Attentive Contextualization, MVAC）方法。该方法通过注意力机制在多个相机视角之间聚合上下文信息，增强BEV或3D空间中的特征表达。相比已有仅依赖单视角或简单拼接的方法，MVAC更有效地利用跨视角一致性，在nuScenes等基准上提升了多视角3D检测精度。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient cross-view context modeling in multi-view 3D object detection by proposing Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MVAC). The method aggregates contextual information across camera views via attention to enhance BEV/3D feature representations. Compared with single-view or naive concatenation baselines, MVAC better exploits cross-view consistency and improves multi-view 3D detection accuracy on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 跨视角注意力建模是多相机3D检测的关键方向，该方法设计合理且实验充分，对BEV感知研究者有参考价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文化模块，增强多相机3D检测的跨视角特征。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 通过注意力机制在多个相机视角间聚合上下文信息。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.result: 在nuScenes等基准上提升了多视角3D检测精度。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准、缺乏场景几何约束的问题，本文提出学习占用（Occupancy）来辅助单目3D检测。方法通过预测场景的占用表示，为单目检测提供显式的3D几何先验，从而缓解单目深度歧义。相比已有仅依赖2D特征或隐式深度的方法，该工作显式建模占用并融合到检测框架中，在KITTI等基准上取得了显著提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation and lack of geometric constraints in monocular 3D object detection by learning occupancy as an auxiliary representation. The method predicts scene occupancy to provide explicit 3D geometric priors, alleviating monocular depth ambiguity. Compared with methods relying only on 2D features or implicit depth, it explicitly models occupancy and integrates it into detection, achieving notable gains on KITTI.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用预测引入单目3D检测是当前热点方向，方法有效且实验扎实，对单目与占用感知研究者均有较高参考价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出利用占用学习辅助单目3D目标检测的框架。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 显式建模场景占用为单目检测提供3D几何先验。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升单目3D检测精度。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测与位姿估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行单目3D检测与位姿估计。方法将检测与位姿回归建模为扩散去噪过程，从而更好地捕捉多模态分布与不确定性。相比传统回归方法，MonoDiff在KITTI等基准上提升了检测与位姿估计精度，尤其在困难样本上表现更优。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, which leverages diffusion models. It formulates detection and pose regression as a diffusion denoising process to capture multimodal distributions and uncertainty. Compared with conventional regression methods, MonoDiff improves accuracy on KITTI, especially on hard samples.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 扩散模型用于单目3D检测是较新的尝试，方法有创新性，对不确定性建模研究者有启发。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与位姿估计方法MonoDiff。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将检测与位姿回归建模为扩散去噪过程以捕捉不确定性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI上提升检测与位姿估计精度，困难样本表现更优。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角下基于视觉的BEV 3D目标检测中体素池化效率低、特征聚合不准的问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种用于BEV表示的扩散体素池化方法。该方法通过扩散式池化将体素特征更合理地投影到BEV空间，提升路侧场景下的检测性能。相比已有体素池化方法，BEVSpread在路侧3D检测基准上取得了更好的精度与效率平衡。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper targets inefficient voxel pooling and inaccurate feature aggregation in vision-based roadside BEV 3D detection, proposing BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method for BEV representation. It projects voxel features into BEV space via a spread pooling scheme to improve roadside detection. Compared with existing voxel pooling methods, BEVSpread achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 路侧BEV感知是自动驾驶重要场景，该工作针对体素池化提出改进，实用性强，值得关注。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出BEVSpread扩散体素池化方法用于路侧视觉BEV 3D检测。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 通过扩散式体素池化改进BEV特征聚合。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧3D检测基准上取得更优的精度与效率平衡。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注、伪标签质量差的问题，本文提出常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）方法用于户外无监督3D检测。方法利用常识先验构建类别原型，指导无监督聚类与伪标签生成，提升检测质量。相比已有无监督方法，该方法在户外3D检测基准上取得了更好的无监督检测性能。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and poor pseudo-labels in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing a Commonsense Prototype method. It leverages commonsense priors to build class prototypes that guide unsupervised clustering and pseudo-label generation. Compared with existing unsupervised methods, it achieves improved unsupervised detection performance on outdoor 3D benchmarks.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 无监督3D检测是降低标注依赖的重要方向，常识原型思路新颖，对无监督与开放集检测研究者有参考价值。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型方法用于户外无监督3D目标检测。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用常识先验构建类别原型指导无监督聚类与伪标签生成。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在户外3D检测基准上取得更优的无监督检测性能。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督（sparsely-supervised）3D 目标检测中标注极少导致训练信号不足的问题，本文提出 HINTED 检测器。方法上通过挖掘难例（hard instance）增强训练，并设计混合密度特征融合模块以缓解稀疏标注下前景特征稀疏、密度不均的问题。相比已有稀疏监督方法，HINTED 在极少标注条件下提升了召回与定位精度。摘要中未给出具体数值，但实验表明在稀疏标注设定下优于基线。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection, where extremely limited annotations yield insufficient training signals. HINTED enhances training via hard instance mining and introduces a mixed-density feature fusion module to handle sparse and unevenly distributed foreground features. It improves recall and localization over prior sparsely-supervised baselines under very few annotations.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 稀疏监督 3D 检测是降低标注成本的重要方向，难例挖掘与密度感知融合的结合具有实用价值，值得关注。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督 3D 检测的难例增强检测器 HINTED 及混合密度特征融合模块。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将难例挖掘与混合密度特征融合结合，缓解稀疏标注下的前景稀疏问题。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏标注设定下优于已有基线，提升召回与定位精度。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对 3D 目标检测中几何信息利用不足、单目/多视角特征缺乏 3D 感知的问题，本文提出 3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散模型特征进行 3D 检测。方法将预训练扩散模型提取的几何感知特征迁移到 3D 检测任务，增强对物体三维结构与位姿的感知。相比传统监督特征，扩散特征提供了更强的几何先验，在 3D 检测基准上取得提升。摘要未列出具体数值。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient geometric reasoning in 3D object detection by leveraging geometry-aware diffusion features. 3DiffTection transfers features from a pretrained geometry-aware diffusion model to the 3D detection task, providing stronger 3D structural and pose priors. It improves over conventional supervised features on 3D detection benchmarks.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型特征引入 3D 检测是新颖且有前景的方向，几何感知先验对自动驾驶感知有潜在价值。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行 3D 目标检测的 3DiffTection 框架。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 把预训练几何感知扩散模型特征迁移到 3D 检测，增强几何先验。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在 3D 检测基准上相比传统监督特征取得提升。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中深度估计不准确、深度信息互补性不足的问题，本文提出 MonoCD。方法通过引入互补深度（complementary depths）来增强深度预测，缓解单一深度估计的偏差，从而提升 3D 框定位精度。相比已有单目方法，MonoCD 在 KITTI 等基准上取得更优的 3D 检测性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate and non-complementary depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection. MonoCD introduces complementary depths to enhance depth prediction and reduce bias from single depth estimation, improving 3D box localization. It achieves better performance than prior monocular methods on benchmarks such as KITTI.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 单目 3D 检测中深度估计是核心瓶颈，互补深度思路简洁有效，对低成本自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出利用互补深度提升单目 3D 检测精度的 MonoCD 方法。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 通过互补深度建模缓解单目深度估计偏差。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在 KITTI 等单目 3D 检测基准上优于已有方法。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离 3D 目标检测中 LiDAR 点稀疏、标注困难的问题，本文提出利用 2D 框监督来改进远距离 3D 检测。方法借助 2D 框提供的监督信号辅助远距离目标的 3D 定位，缓解远距离点云稀疏导致的检测退化。相比仅依赖 3D 标注的方法，该方案在远距离目标上取得更好效果。摘要未给出具体数值。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper targets distant 3D object detection, where LiDAR points are sparse and 3D annotation is difficult. It leverages 2D box supervision to assist 3D localization of distant objects, mitigating degradation caused by sparse point clouds. It outperforms methods relying solely on 3D annotations for distant objects.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 远距离检测是自动驾驶安全的关键短板，利用 2D 框监督降低标注依赖具有实际意义。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用 2D 框监督改进远距离 3D 目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 将 2D 框监督引入远距离 3D 检测以缓解点云稀疏问题。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在远距离目标检测上优于仅用 3D 标注的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态 3D 检测中实例与场景信息融合不充分的问题，本文提出 IS-Fusion，实现实例-场景协同融合。方法同时建模实例级与场景级特征并进行协同交互，增强多模态（如 LiDAR 与相机）特征的互补性。相比已有融合策略，IS-Fusion 在 nuScenes 等基准上取得领先的 3D 检测性能。摘要未列出具体数值。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion of instance and scene information in multimodal 3D detection. IS-Fusion performs instance-scene collaborative fusion, jointly modeling instance-level and scene-level features to enhance cross-modal complementarity. It achieves leading 3D detection performance on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知主流方向，实例-场景协同融合思路清晰且性能领先，值得重点关注。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态 3D 检测框架 IS-Fusion。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 联合建模实例级与场景级特征实现多模态协同融合。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在 nuScenes 等基准上取得领先的 3D 检测性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集 3D 目标检测的无监督域适应中伪标签噪声大的问题，本文提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法。方法对生成的伪标签进行筛选与精炼，提升伪标签质量以稳定域适应训练。相比直接使用原始伪标签的方法，该方案在跨数据集 3D 检测上取得更好适应效果。摘要未给出具体数值。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy pseudo labels in unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection. It proposes a pseudo label refinery that filters and refines generated pseudo labels to stabilize domain adaptation. It achieves better adaptation than methods using raw pseudo labels.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 跨数据集域适应对 3D 检测落地很重要，伪标签精炼是提升域适应稳定性的有效手段，具参考价值。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出用于跨数据集 3D 检测域适应的伪标签精炼方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过筛选与精炼伪标签提升无监督域适应质量。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集 3D 检测域适应上优于直接使用原始伪标签的方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D目标检测中稀疏卷积在远距离或稀疏区域特征提取不足的问题，提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏网络。方法上通过设计稀疏自适应特征扩散模块，在保持全稀疏计算效率的同时增强稀疏区域的特征表达。相比已有全稀疏检测器，SAFDNet在不引入密集计算的前提下提升了检测精度。在nuScenes数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果，验证了全稀疏架构的潜力。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited feature extraction in sparse regions of fully sparse 3D object detection. It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective fully sparse network with a sparse adaptive feature diffusion module that enhances feature representation while maintaining computational efficiency. Compared to existing fully sparse detectors, SAFDNet improves detection accuracy without dense computation, achieving competitive results on nuScenes.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 全稀疏3D检测是当前自动驾驶感知的重要方向，该工作以简洁设计提升稀疏区域特征，具有实用价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出SAFDNet全稀疏3D检测网络，通过稀疏自适应特征扩散增强稀疏区域特征表达。

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of model compression and accuracy preservation in lightweight 3D object detection. It proposes CaKDP, a category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning framework that leverages category information to guide both distillation and pruning. Compared to uniform distillation or pruning, CaKDP better handles inter-class differences, improving compressed model accuracy over baselines.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 将类别感知引入3D检测的蒸馏与剪枝，思路新颖，对轻量化部署有参考意义。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，用于轻量化3D目标检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 利用类别信息指导蒸馏和剪枝，解决传统方法忽略类别差异的问题。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在轻量化3D检测任务上取得优于基线方法的性能。

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the low quality of pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection. It proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling method that separates classification and regression in pseudo-label generation to reduce coupled error propagation. Compared to existing semi-supervised methods, the decoupled strategy improves pseudo-label accuracy and robustness, achieving significant gains on KITTI.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 半监督单目3D检测是降低标注成本的关键方向，解耦伪标签思路清晰且有效。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出解耦伪标签方法，用于半监督单目3D目标检测。

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI等数据集上取得显著性能提升。

Compared to existing weakly-supervised methods, Prompt3D improves detection performance without extra annotation cost, achieving competitive results.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换因深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题，提出基于query的RaCFormer框架，从BEV和原始图像两个视角自适应采样实例相关特征。方法上引入极坐标下的自适应圆形分布优化query初始化（按距离调整query密度），并用雷达引导的深度头改进图像到BEV的变换，同时利用雷达多普勒效应设计隐式动态捕捉器建模BEV时序信息。在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views. It introduces an adaptive circular distribution in polar coordinates for query initialization, a radar-guided depth head to refine image-to-BEV transformation, and an implicit dynamic catcher exploiting radar Doppler for temporal BEV modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该工作直面雷达-相机融合中BEV特征错位的核心痛点，query自适应采样与雷达引导深度头的设计思路清晰且实用，对多相机BEV感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出基于query的雷达-相机融合框架RaCFormer，通过双视角自适应采样与雷达引导深度建模提升3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 在极坐标下用自适应圆形分布初始化query，并利用雷达多普勒效应设计隐式动态捕捉器建模BEV时序。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上取得领先的3D目标检测性能。

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内单帧RGB(-D)3D目标检测中现有数据集在规模、精度和多样性上的不足，构建了CA-1M数据集，在1K+激光扫描场景上标注超40万个3D物体，并与3.5K+手持自中心采集对齐。提出全Transformer基线CuTR，直接从2D特征预测3D框而非在点/体素表示上操作。实验表明CuTR在3D中召回超62%的物体，优于基于点的方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度图的噪声和不确定性更具鲁棒性，并支持纯RGB输入。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing indoor 3D detection datasets in scale, accuracy, and diversity, this work introduces CA-1M, labeling over 400K 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes registered to 3.5K+ handheld egocentric captures. It proposes CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline that predicts 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features without 3D inductive biases. CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforms point-based methods, and is more robust to commodity LiDAR depth noise while supporting RGB-only inference.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集规模与标注质量突出，CuTR以纯2D特征预测3D框的思路对室内检测范式有启发，虽与自动驾驶室外场景相关度稍低，但方法论值得借鉴。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模高精度室内3D检测数据集CA-1M，并提出直接从2D特征预测3D框的Transformer基线CuTR。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 摒弃3D归纳偏置，用全Transformer从2D RGB(-D)特征直接回归3D框，并验证其对深度噪声的鲁棒性。
2412.04458|v2.result: CuTR在3D中召回超62%物体，优于基于点的方法，且支持纯RGB输入。

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（依赖物体类别、尺寸和朝向）且现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒网络隐式处理的问题，提出RICCARDO显式利用雷达点分布模型辅助融合。首先基于单目检测器获取的物体属性预测雷达点分布，再以预测分布为核在单目检测邻域内匹配实际雷达点生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精炼匹配分数。在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: RICCARDO addresses the complex radar hit distribution that depends on object category, size, and orientation, which existing radar-camera fusion methods handle implicitly via black-box networks. It explicitly predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on monocular detector outputs, uses the predicted distribution as a kernel to match measured radar points and generate matching scores, and refines scores via a fusion stage. It achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection performance on nuScenes with open-source code.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式建模雷达点分布替代黑盒融合的思路清晰且可解释，对雷达-相机融合研究者有较高参考价值，nuScenes上的SOTA结果与开源代码增强了其实用性。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式利用雷达点分布模型的雷达-相机融合方法RICCARDO，提升3D检测性能。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 以预测的雷达点分布为核匹配实际雷达点，替代传统黑盒融合方式。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖点云笛卡尔坐标等全局几何特征，导致模型过度关注绝对位置而忽略局部结构。本文提出GBlobs，用高斯球显式编码点云邻域的局部结构，无需额外参数且计算高效，可直接嵌入现有检测器。在单源DG基准上，Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP、KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP、nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源DG也分别超越SOTA 17、12、5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: Existing LiDAR 3D detectors generalize poorly across domains, and current domain generalization methods rely solely on global geometric features such as Cartesian coordinates, causing over-reliance on absolute position. This paper proposes GBlobs, which explicitly encodes local point cloud neighborhoods with Gaussian blobs in a parameter-free and highly efficient manner, and can be integrated into existing detectors. It surpasses state-of-the-art single-source DG benchmarks by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also improves multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的局部结构编码显著提升跨域3D检测性能，方法通用且即插即用，对LiDAR域泛化研究具有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出无需额外参数的高斯球局部结构编码GBlobs，用于提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 用高斯球显式编码点云邻域局部结构，替代对全局笛卡尔坐标的过度依赖。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在单源和多源DG基准上分别超越SOTA达21/13/12 mAP和17/12/5 mAP，且不损失域内性能。

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影几何深度因物体视觉表面导致深度误差、边界框高度无法代表真实投影中心高度的问题，本文提出MonoDGP。该方法采用透视不变的几何误差修正投影公式，系统讨论了几何误差的机制与有效性，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代；同时解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，提供2D先验并无干扰地初始化目标查询。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection suffers from geometric depth errors caused by the object's visual surface, where bounding box height fails to represent the actual projected central height. This paper proposes MonoDGP, a Transformer-based method that adopts perspective-invariant geometry errors to modify the projection formula, serving as a simple yet effective alternative to multi-depth prediction. It also decouples the depth-guided decoder and constructs a 2D decoder relying only on visual features to provide 2D priors and initialize object queries without 3D disturbance.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测中几何深度误差进行了系统分析并提出简洁有效的修正方案，解耦解码器设计合理，值得关注。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出基于透视不变几何误差修正投影公式的Transformer单目3D检测方法MonoDGP。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 用几何误差替代多深度预测，并解耦深度引导解码器与纯视觉2D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但方法在机制上提升了几何深度的利用效率。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测标注成本高、且主动学习在室内场景尚未被探索的问题，本文首次研究室内3D检测的主动学习。提出结合不确定性与多样性的框架：不确定性准则同时考虑误检和漏检目标，多样性准则通过新的类感知自适应原型（CAP）库联合优化目标类别分布与场景类型的多样性。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: Active learning for indoor 3D object detection remains unexplored despite high annotation costs. This paper presents the first study on this task, proposing a framework that incorporates uncertainty and diversity criteria. The uncertainty criterion accounts for both inaccurate detections and undetected objects, while the diversity criterion is formulated as a joint optimization problem maximizing diversity of object class distributions and scene types via a new Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 首次将主动学习引入室内3D检测，针对室内数据类别不平衡和场景多样等挑战设计双重准则，具有实际应用价值。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向室内3D目标检测的主动学习框架，融合不确定性与多样性选择策略。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 设计类感知自适应原型库CAP，联合优化类别分布与场景类型多样性。

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注下3D目标检测性能受限的问题，本文提出SP3D，利用大型多模态模型（LMM）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强3D检测器的特征判别能力。具体设计了Confident Points Semantic Transfer（CPST）模块通过边界约束的中心聚类选择生成准确的跨模态语义提示，并基于这些种子点引入Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation（DCPG）模块从多尺度邻域点的几何形状生成伪监督信号，同时提出Distribution Shape score（DS score）筛选高质量监督信号用于初始训练。在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上的实验验证了该方法在稀疏标注设置下能有效提升检测性能，相比已有稀疏监督方法具有更强的鲁棒性。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where accurate labels are extremely scarce. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models to boost feature discrimination. The method includes a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module for generating accurate prompts via boundary-constrained center cluster selection, a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module for producing pseudo-supervision from multi-scale neighbor geometry, and a Distribution Shape score for selecting high-quality signals. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset validate its effectiveness under sparse annotation settings.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将LMM的跨模态语义先验引入稀疏监督3D检测，为缓解标注稀缺问题提供了新思路，实验覆盖主流数据集，值得关注。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM生成跨模态语义提示来增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D策略。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过CPST模块和DCPG模块将LMM语义提示转化为高质量伪监督信号，并设计DS score筛选。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上验证了稀疏标注下检测性能的有效提升。
