DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.summary_cn: 该论文提出 DONNAv2，一个面向视觉任务的轻量级神经架构搜索框架，旨在降低 NAS 的搜索与训练开销。方法上通过轻量化搜索空间与代理评估策略，在分类/检测等视觉任务上快速生成高效子网络。相比早期 DONNA 版本，主要在搜索效率与部署友好性上做了改进。摘要未给出具体数据集与精度/FLOPs 数据，效果难以量化评估。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.summary_en: DONNAv2 presents a lightweight neural architecture search framework for vision tasks, targeting reduced search and training cost. It employs a compact search space with proxy evaluation to rapidly produce efficient subnetworks for classification and detection. Improvements over the earlier DONNA focus on search efficiency and deployment friendliness, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限，仅在需要为车载视觉模型做轻量化搜索时有间接参考价值。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出面向视觉任务的轻量级 NAS 框架 DONNAv2。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.innovation: 通过精简搜索空间与代理评估降低 NAS 计算开销。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.result: 摘要未提供具体精度或效率数据，效果无法量化。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architecture Search for Vision tasks.

2308.15609|v2.summary_cn: 针对 One-Shot NAS 需从零训练超网、耗时耗算力的问题，论文提出 InstaTune，在微调阶段利用现成大模型预训练权重直接生成超网。其子网络针对目标任务而非预训练目标优化，并可即插即用地嵌入现有框架，配合多目标进化搜索完成架构选择。相比从零训练超网的方案，显著降低了 NAS 的总时间与算力需求，但摘要未给出具体加速比或精度数字。
2308.15609|v2.summary_en: To avoid the prohibitive cost of training super-networks from scratch, InstaTune generates a super-network during the fine-tuning stage by reusing off-the-shelf pre-trained weights of large models. Extracted sub-networks are optimized for the target task rather than the pre-training objective, and the method is plug-and-play with existing frameworks, using multi-objective evolutionary search. It substantially reduces NAS time and compute relative to from-scratch super-network training, though no quantitative numbers are given in the abstract.
2308.15609|v2.assessment: 把 NAS 与预训练-微调范式结合，对需要在多硬件平台部署大视觉模型的研究者有实用价值。
2308.15609|v2.contribution: 提出在微调阶段生成超网的 InstaTune，复用预训练权重完成 NAS。
2308.15609|v2.innovation: 将超网构建嵌入微调过程，使子网络面向目标任务优化。
2308.15609|v2.result: 声称显著降低 NAS 时间与算力开销，但摘要未给出具体数据。

Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_cn: 论文针对可微 NAS（DARTS 类）搜索到的架构迁移性差、跨任务泛化弱的问题，提出在搜索目标中显式鼓励可迁移性。方法上通过在搜索过程中引入迁移性正则/评价信号，引导超网偏向更通用的结构。相比原始可微 NAS，改进点在于把迁移性纳入优化目标而非仅优化验证精度。摘要未提供具体数据集与精度提升数值。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_en: This work addresses the poor transferability of architectures found by differentiable NAS such as DARTS. It explicitly encourages transferability within the search objective, biasing the super-network toward more generalizable structures rather than optimizing validation accuracy alone. The abstract provides no concrete datasets or accuracy gains.
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.assessment: 对关注 NAS 泛化性与跨任务迁移的研究者有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知任务本身关联较弱。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.contribution: 在可微 NAS 中引入迁移性约束以提升架构泛化能力。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.innovation: 将可迁移性作为搜索目标的一部分而非事后评估。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.result: 摘要未给出量化结果，改进幅度不明确。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec._arxiv_id: Improving Differentiable Neural Architecture Search by Encouraging Transferability.

AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_cn: 论文提出 AutoGT，将神经架构搜索扩展到图 Transformer，自动搜索图 Transformer 的架构配置。方法上构建了面向图 Transformer 的搜索空间并采用自动搜索策略寻找最优结构。相比手工设计的图 Transformer，减少了人工调参成本。摘要未给出具体图数据集上的精度或效率数据。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_en: AutoGT extends neural architecture search to graph Transformers, automatically searching their architectural configurations. It defines a graph-Transformer-specific search space and applies an automated search strategy to replace manual design. No quantitative results on graph benchmarks are reported in the abstract.
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.assessment: 属于图学习与 NAS 交叉方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知主线相关度低。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.contribution: 提出面向图 Transformer 的自动化架构搜索方法 AutoGT。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.innovation: 将 NAS 搜索空间与策略适配到图 Transformer 结构。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch._arxiv_id: AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Architecture Search.

Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_cn: 论文针对蒸馏感知 NAS（Distillation-Aware NAS）在未见数据集上难以评估子网络蒸馏效果的问题，提出一个元预测模型。方法上通过学习蒸馏性能与架构/数据特征之间的映射，在未见过数据集上预测蒸馏后精度，从而免去昂贵的实际蒸馏训练。相比需要逐数据集实际蒸馏评估的做法，显著降低搜索成本。摘要未给出具体预测误差或搜索加速数据。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_en: This paper targets distillation-aware NAS on unseen datasets, where evaluating the distillation performance of candidate sub-networks is expensive. It proposes a meta-prediction model that learns a mapping from architecture and data characteristics to post-distillation accuracy, avoiding costly actual distillation runs. This reduces search cost compared with per-dataset distillation evaluation, though no quantitative prediction-error or speedup numbers appear in the abstract.
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.assessment: 把元学习引入蒸馏感知 NAS，对模型压缩与高效部署方向有方法学参考价值。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.contribution: 提出在未见数据集上预测蒸馏性能的元预测模型，用于蒸馏感知 NAS。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.innovation: 用元预测替代逐数据集的实际蒸馏评估以降低搜索成本。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.result: 声称可降低搜索成本，但摘要未给出量化结果。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A._arxiv_id: Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-Aware NAS on Unseen Datasets.

Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_cn: 论文针对进化式 NAS 中网络编码的排列（permutation）问题——相同拓扑的不同编码导致交叉操作失效——提出最短编辑路径交叉（Shortest Edit Path Crossover）。方法上从理论上分析排列问题，并设计基于最短编辑路径的交叉算子，使子代更可能继承父代的有效结构。相比传统交叉算子，改进点在于理论驱动的编码对齐。摘要未给出具体搜索基准上的精度或收敛速度数据。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_en: This paper tackles the permutation problem in evolutionary NAS, where equivalent topologies encoded differently break crossover. It proposes Shortest Edit Path Crossover, a theory-driven operator that aligns parent encodings via minimum edit paths so offspring inherit meaningful structure. The improvement lies in principled encoding alignment over conventional crossover, but no quantitative benchmark results are given in the abstract.
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.assessment: 对进化式 NAS 的理论与算子设计有贡献，但与自动驾驶视觉感知任务关联较弱。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.contribution: 提出理论驱动的最短编辑路径交叉算子解决 NAS 排列问题。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.innovation: 用最短编辑路径对齐父代编码以提升交叉有效性。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.result: 摘要未提供具体搜索性能数据。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d._arxiv_id: Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-driven Solution to the Permutation Problem in Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.

PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_cn: 针对一次性（one-shot）NAS 中权重共享超网训练与最终子网性能不一致、搜索效率低的问题，提出 PreNAS，通过“偏好”机制引导超网训练，使超网参数更偏向于高性能子网。方法在超网训练阶段引入偏好采样与优化策略，缓解了权重共享带来的排序偏差。相比常规 one-shot NAS，PreNAS 在保持较低搜索成本的同时提升了搜索到架构的精度。实验在标准 NAS 基准上取得更优的精度-效率权衡，验证了偏好学习对超网训练的有效性。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_en: PreNAS addresses the inconsistency between supernet training and final architecture performance in one-shot NAS by introducing a preference mechanism that biases supernet optimization toward high-performing subnetworks. It mitigates ranking bias caused by weight sharing while maintaining low search cost. Experiments on standard NAS benchmarks show improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over conventional one-shot NAS.
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.assessment: 面向 one-shot NAS 的训练偏差问题提出偏好机制，思路清晰，对 NAS 效率与精度平衡有参考价值，但与视觉感知任务关联较弱。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.contribution: 提出偏好驱动的一次性 NAS 训练框架 PreNAS，缓解超网与子网性能不一致问题。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.innovation: 在超网训练中引入偏好采样与优化，使权重共享更偏向高性能子网。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.result: 在标准 NAS 基准上取得更优的精度-效率权衡，搜索成本保持较低。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa._arxiv_id: PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towards Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_cn: 针对变分量子算法（VQA）中量子电路结构设计依赖人工、搜索空间离散且不可微的问题，提出 QuantumDARTS，将可微架构搜索（DARTS）思想扩展到量子电路设计。方法构建可微量子架构搜索空间，通过连续松弛与梯度优化联合学习量子门参数与电路结构。相比人工设计或离散搜索方法，QuantumDARTS 能自动发现更优的量子电路。实验在典型 VQA 任务上取得更好的收敛与精度表现，展示了可微搜索在量子领域的可行性。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: QuantumDARTS tackles the manual and discrete design of quantum circuits in variational quantum algorithms by extending differentiable architecture search to the quantum domain. It builds a differentiable quantum architecture search space and jointly optimizes gate parameters and circuit structure via continuous relaxation and gradient descent. Experiments on typical VQA tasks show improved convergence and accuracy, demonstrating the feasibility of differentiable search for quantum circuits.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 将 DARTS 迁移到量子电路设计，跨领域有新意，但与经典视觉/自动驾驶感知研究几乎无关。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.contribution: 提出可微量子架构搜索方法 QuantumDARTS，实现量子电路结构自动设计。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.innovation: 把 DARTS 的连续松弛与梯度优化引入变分量子算法电路搜索。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.result: 在典型 VQA 任务上获得更好的收敛性与精度。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc._arxiv_id: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_cn: 针对图神经网络（GNN）架构搜索训练成本高、需要反复训练候选模型的问题，提出一种无需训练的线性 NAS 方法。方法利用 GNN 的线性化近似或线性代理指标来评估架构优劣，从而避免昂贵的端到端训练。相比传统 GNN NAS，该方法显著降低搜索开销。实验表明其在多个图学习任务上以极低搜索成本达到与训练型 NAS 相当的性能，验证了免训练代理评估的可行性。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This work targets the high training cost of graph neural network architecture search by proposing a training-free linear NAS approach. It leverages linearized approximations or linear proxy metrics to evaluate GNN architectures without expensive end-to-end training. Experiments on multiple graph tasks show comparable performance to training-based NAS at substantially lower search cost.
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.assessment: 免训练 GNN 架构搜索思路简洁，对降低 NAS 成本有启发，但与视觉感知主线关联有限。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.contribution: 提出免训练的线性 GNN 架构搜索方法，避免候选模型反复训练。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.innovation: 利用线性代理指标评估 GNN 架构，实现零训练搜索。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 在多个图任务上以极低搜索成本达到与训练型 NAS 相当的性能。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite._arxiv_id: Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Architecture Search of Graph Neural Networks.

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间与算子设计依赖专家经验、代码级搜索难以自动化的问题，提出 EvoPrompting，利用大语言模型（LLM）进行代码级神经架构搜索。方法通过进化式提示（prompt）迭代，让 LLM 生成并变异网络代码，再评估性能并反馈优化。相比传统 NAS 或人工设计，EvoPrompting 能在代码层面自动发现更优架构。实验在多个任务上展示了 LLM 驱动代码级搜索的有效性，为 NAS 提供了新范式。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: EvoPrompting addresses the expert-dependent design of NAS search spaces and operators by using large language models for code-level neural architecture search. It iteratively evolves prompts so that an LLM generates and mutates network code, which is then evaluated and fed back for optimization. Experiments across tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM-driven code-level search, offering a new NAS paradigm.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: 将 LLM 与进化提示结合做代码级 NAS，方向新颖，对自动化架构设计有启发，但与视觉感知任务直接关联较弱。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.contribution: 提出 EvoPrompting，用 LLM 与进化提示实现代码级神经架构搜索。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.innovation: 通过进化式提示让 LLM 生成并变异网络代码，替代传统搜索空间设计。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.result: 在多个任务上验证了 LLM 驱动代码级搜索的有效性。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L._arxiv_id: EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-Level Neural Architecture Search.

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对多任务学习中各任务架构需求不同、单一共享架构难以兼顾的问题，提出多任务图神经架构搜索方法，引入任务感知的协作与课程学习。方法在搜索过程中让不同任务的架构相互协作，并按课程顺序逐步引入任务，缓解任务间冲突。相比统一架构或独立搜索，该方法能更好平衡多任务性能。实验在多任务图学习基准上取得优于基线的表现，验证了任务感知协作与课程策略的有效性。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper targets multi-task learning where a single shared architecture struggles to satisfy diverse task requirements, proposing a multi-task graph neural architecture search with task-aware collaboration and curriculum. Architectures for different tasks collaborate during search, and tasks are introduced in a curriculum order to alleviate conflicts. Experiments on multi-task graph benchmarks show improvements over baselines, validating the task-aware collaboration and curriculum strategy.
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 面向多任务 GNN 架构搜索，任务感知协作与课程学习思路合理，但与视觉感知主线关联有限。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务图神经架构搜索方法。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 在搜索中让多任务架构协作并按课程顺序引入任务，缓解任务冲突。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多任务图学习基准上优于基线方法。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Search with Task-aware Collaboration and Curriculum.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间设计缺乏统一形式化、难以系统扩展的问题，提出基于上下文无关文法（CFG）构建分层神经架构搜索空间。方法用 CFG 形式化描述网络的分层结构，使搜索空间可组合、可扩展且表达力强。相比手工定义的搜索空间，该方法能更系统地覆盖多样架构。实验表明基于 CFG 的分层搜索空间在多个任务上能搜索到有竞争力的架构，为 NAS 搜索空间设计提供了通用框架。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: This work addresses the lack of a unified formalization for NAS search space design by constructing hierarchical neural architecture search spaces based on context-free grammars (CFG). The CFG formalizes hierarchical network structures, making the search space composable, extensible, and expressive. Experiments show that CFG-based hierarchical search spaces yield competitive architectures across tasks, providing a general framework for NAS search space design.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 用 CFG 形式化分层搜索空间，为 NAS 空间设计提供通用框架，方法学价值较高，但与视觉感知任务直接关联较弱。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于上下文无关文法的分层神经架构搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 用 CFG 形式化描述网络分层结构，使搜索空间可组合、可扩展。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 在多个任务上搜索到有竞争力的架构，验证了通用搜索空间框架的有效性。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Construction of Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search Spaces based on Context-free Grammars.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: 该论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中 Transformer 架构设计依赖人工经验的问题，提出了一种面向知识追踪的进化神经架构搜索方法。方法通过进化算法在 Transformer 的架构空间（如注意力头数、层数、维度等）中搜索最优配置，以提升对学生知识状态建模的准确性。相比手工设计的 Transformer 基线，该方法能够自动发现更适配知识追踪数据特性的架构。摘要未提供具体实验数据，因此无法引用定量结果。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual design of Transformer architectures for knowledge tracing by proposing an evolutionary neural architecture search method. The approach searches over Transformer architectural configurations to better model students' knowledge states, aiming to outperform hand-crafted baselines. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该论文属于教育数据挖掘领域的 NAS 应用，与自动驾驶感知/视觉方向几乎无交集，仅 NAS 方法本身对架构搜索研究者有间接参考价值。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 提出了一种面向知识追踪任务的进化 Transformer 架构搜索方法。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 将进化神经架构搜索引入知识追踪领域，自动优化 Transformer 结构。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search._arxiv_id: Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search for Transformer in Knowledge Tracing.

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在分布外（OoD）泛化能力缺乏系统研究的问题，构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准OoD-ViT-NAS，包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构并在8个常见OoD数据集上评估。作者系统分析了影响OoD泛化的架构因素，并首次研究了9种免训练NAS方法在ViT OoD鲁棒性上的表现。关键发现包括：ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化；ID准确率往往是OoD准确率的糟糕指标，仅优化ID性能存在风险；现有免训练NAS方法虽擅长预测ID准确率，却基本无法预测OoD准确率，而Param或Flop等简单代理指标反而出人意料地优于复杂免训练NAS方法。该工作为面向鲁棒性的ViT架构设计提供了重要基准与洞见。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OoD-ViT-NAS, the first systematic benchmark for ViT neural architecture search targeting out-of-distribution generalization, comprising 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets. It analyzes architectural factors affecting OoD generalization and conducts the first study of 9 training-free NAS methods for ViT OoD robustness. Key findings show that ID accuracy is often a poor indicator of OoD accuracy, and existing training-free NAS methods largely fail to predict OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like Param or Flop surprisingly outperforming complex methods.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了ViT架构搜索在OoD泛化评估上的空白，其反直觉发现（如简单代理优于复杂NAS方法）对鲁棒感知模型设计有直接启发，值得关注。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向ViT OoD泛化的NAS基准，并系统揭示了ID与OoD准确率之间的弱相关性及免训练NAS方法的局限。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次将NAS基准与OoD泛化结合，并发现简单代理指标在预测OoD准确率上优于复杂免训练NAS方法。
2501.03782|v2.result: 在8个OoD数据集上评估3000个ViT架构，证明ID准确率无法可靠指示OoD准确率，且现有免训练NAS方法预测OoD准确率基本无效。

SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习场景下设备端推理的神经架构搜索（NAS）计算与通信开销过大的问题，提出了SuperFedNAS方法。其核心思路是通过超网（supernet）级别的联邦训练与架构搜索联合优化，在客户端之间共享超网参数而非独立搜索，从而降低整体搜索成本。相比传统联邦NAS需要为每个客户端单独搜索架构，该方法在保持精度的同时显著减少了训练与通信开销。实验表明其在多个基准上实现了更优的精度-成本权衡，适合资源受限的边缘设备部署。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive computation and communication costs of federated neural architecture search (NAS) for on-device inference. It proposes SuperFedNAS, which jointly optimizes a shared supernet across clients and performs architecture search within it, avoiding per-client independent searches. Compared with conventional federated NAS, it achieves a better accuracy-cost trade-off while maintaining competitive accuracy, making it suitable for resource-constrained edge deployment.
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.assessment: 面向联邦学习与边缘部署的NAS工作，对AutoML与高效推理方向有参考价值，但与视觉感知核心任务关联较弱。

Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: 该论文针对无训练（training-free）生成式架构搜索中代理指标依赖人工设计、泛化性差的问题，提出Auto-GAS自动发现代理指标。方法通过自动化搜索流程从候选操作与指标空间中挖掘适用于生成任务的代理信号，避免人工先验。相比手工设计的training-free指标，Auto-GAS在生成架构搜索上取得更稳定且更优的搜索结果。该工作将代理发现自动化，提升了training-free NAS在生成任务上的实用性。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on hand-crafted proxies and poor generalization in training-free generative architecture search. It proposes Auto-GAS, which automatically discovers proxy metrics from candidate operation and metric spaces for generative tasks. Compared with manually designed training-free metrics, Auto-GAS yields more stable and superior search results, improving the practicality of training-free NAS for generative models.
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.assessment: 将代理指标发现自动化，对training-free NAS与生成模型方向有方法学价值，但与视觉感知任务直接相关性低。

Compared with manually designed training-free metrics, Auto-DAS achieves more stable and superior performance in distillation-aware search, improving the practicality of distillation-aware NAS.

Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_cn: 该论文针对可微分神经架构搜索（DARTS）中忽略架构单元之间依赖关系、导致搜索次优的问题，提出依赖感知的可微分NAS方法。方法在搜索过程中显式建模并利用操作/单元间的依赖关系，以更准确地评估架构性能并指导搜索。相比原始DARTS及其变体，该方法在多个基准上取得更优的架构性能。该工作为可微分NAS引入了依赖建模视角，提升了搜索质量。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of dependencies among architectural components in differentiable architecture search (DARTS), which leads to suboptimal architectures. It proposes a dependency-aware differentiable NAS method that explicitly models and exploits inter-operation/inter-cell dependencies to better estimate architecture performance. Compared with DARTS and its variants, it achieves superior architecture performance on multiple benchmarks, introducing a dependency-modeling perspective to differentiable NAS.

Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督Transformer架构搜索中搜索信号不足、训练成本高的问题，提出掩码蒸馏（Masked Distillation）方法。其核心思路是利用掩码图像建模中的蒸馏信号作为架构搜索的监督，从而在无标签条件下高效评估Transformer架构。相比已有自监督NAS方法，该方法在降低搜索成本的同时提升了搜索到的架构在下游任务上的性能。该工作将掩码蒸馏与自监督Transformer NAS结合，为视觉Transformer的自动化设计提供了新思路。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient search signals and high training cost in self-supervised Transformer architecture search. It proposes masked distillation, which leverages distillation signals from masked image modeling to supervise architecture search under label-free conditions. Compared with existing self-supervised NAS methods, it reduces search cost while improving the searched architectures' downstream performance, offering a new direction for automated Vision Transformer design.
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.assessment: 将掩码蒸馏用于自监督ViT架构搜索，对Vision Transformer与自监督学习方向有参考价值。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.contribution: 提出掩码蒸馏方法，为自监督Transformer架构搜索提供高效监督信号。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.innovation: 将掩码图像建模的蒸馏信号引入自监督NAS，降低搜索成本并提升下游性能。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.result: 在降低搜索成本的同时提升了搜索架构在下游任务上的性能。

2403.07591|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无训练NAS中单一代理指标在不同任务上估计能力不稳定、且与真实性能存在差距的问题，提出RoBoT算法。方法包含两部分：(a) 通过贝叶斯优化从现有training-free指标中探索最优组合，构建跨任务鲁棒且一致的代理指标；(b) 在新指标上应用贪心搜索（利用）以弥合估计差距并提升搜索性能。相比仅用单一training-free指标的方法，RoBoT在多样任务上实现了更鲁棒且更优的搜索表现。该工作为training-free NAS的鲁棒性与性能提升提供了系统方案。
2403.07591|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unstable estimation ability of single training-free metrics across tasks and the gap between such metrics and true architecture performance in training-free NAS. It proposes RoBoT, which (a) employs Bayesian optimization to find an optimized combination of existing training-free metrics for robust and consistently good performance across diverse tasks, and (b) applies greedy search on the new metric to bridge the estimation gap and boost search performance. Compared with single-metric approaches, RoBoT achieves more robust and superior search results on diverse tasks.
2403.07591|v2.assessment: 系统解决training-free NAS的鲁棒性与性能瓶颈，方法设计完整，对AutoML与高效NAS方向有较高参考价值。
2403.07591|v2.contribution: 提出RoBoT算法，通过贝叶斯优化组合training-free指标并配合贪心搜索提升NAS鲁棒性与性能。
2403.07591|v2.innovation: 用贝叶斯优化自动组合多个training-free指标，并以贪心搜索弥合估计差距。
2403.07591|v2.result: 在多样任务上实现比单一training-free指标更鲁棒且更优的搜索性能。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）时代变分量子算法（VQA）中电路架构选择困难的问题，指出噪声对量子架构搜索（QAS）的影响尚不明确。作者提出了基于课程学习的强化学习量子架构搜索算法 CRLQAS，引入三维架构编码和环境动态限制来探索电路搜索空间。相比已有 QAS 工作，该方法首次系统考虑硬件噪声对架构搜索的影响。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the underexplored impact of hardware noise on quantum architecture search (QAS) for variational quantum algorithms in the NISQ era. It introduces CRLQAS, a curriculum-based reinforcement learning QAS algorithm featuring 3D architecture encoding and environment-dynamics restrictions. Unlike prior QAS methods, it explicitly targets realistic noisy VQA deployment, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该论文属于量子计算与强化学习交叉方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知研究领域完全无关，不建议关注。
2402.03500|v2.contribution: 提出面向噪声硬件的课程强化学习量子架构搜索算法 CRLQAS。
2402.03500|v2.innovation: 将课程学习与三维架构编码引入量子电路架构搜索以应对硬件噪声。
2402.03500|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化实验结果。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 中预测器性能高度依赖网络架构编码方式的问题，将神经编码系统归纳为结构型、学习型和分数型三类，并提出统一编码（unified encodings）以支持跨搜索空间预测。作者在 NASBench-101、NB201、NB301、NDS 和 TransNASBench-101 上分析了超过 150 万个架构，并据此设计了 FLAN（Flow Attention for NAS）预测器。FLAN 整合了预测器设计、迁移学习与统一编码的关键经验，将训练成本降低一个数量级以上。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper systematically categorizes neural architecture encodings into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings that extend NAS predictors across multiple search spaces. Based on an analysis of over 1.5 million architectures across NASBench-101, NB201, NB301, NDS, and TransNASBench-101, the authors propose FLAN (Flow Attention for NAS), which integrates insights on predictor design, transfer learning, and unified encodings. FLAN achieves more than an order-of-magnitude cost reduction for training.

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 过程碳排放高的问题，提出碳高效 NAS 框架 CE-NAS。该方法利用强化学习智能体根据时间序列 Transformer 预测的碳强度动态调整 GPU 资源，以平衡节能采样与耗能评估任务，并结合多目标优化器缩减搜索空间。在 HW-NasBench 上碳排放降低最多 7.22 倍且搜索效率与原始 NAS 相当；在 CIFAR-10 上以 1.68M 参数达到 97.35% top-1 准确率，碳排放仅 38.53 磅 CO2。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes CE-NAS, a carbon-efficient NAS framework that uses a reinforcement-learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, balancing energy-efficient sampling and energy-intensive evaluation. It further employs a multi-objective optimizer to reduce the search space. CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22x on HW-NasBench while achieving 97.35% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 with only 1.68M parameters and 38.53 lbs of CO2.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该工作从碳排放角度切入 NAS，问题新颖且实验数据具体，但主题与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联较弱，对绿色 AI 方向研究者有一定参考价值。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出碳高效的端到端 NAS 框架 CE-NAS。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 利用时间序列 Transformer 预测碳强度并驱动强化学习智能体动态调度 GPU 资源。
2406.01414|v2.result: HW-NasBench 上碳排放降低最多 7.22 倍，CIFAR-10 上以 1.68M 参数达 97.35% top-1 准确率。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对零成本NAS代理大多局限于卷积搜索空间、难以适用于Vision Transformer的问题，本文构建了基于Autoformer搜索空间、覆盖6个任务的基准，并提出L-SWAG——一种结合层-样本激活与梯度信息的可泛化零成本指标，在14个任务上同时刻画卷积与Transformer架构。作者进一步提出LIBRA-NAS，用ML模型对互补代理进行低信息增益与偏置重对齐的组合。相比已有ZC代理，L-SWAG首次将零成本代理系统扩展到ViT搜索空间，并在多任务上取得更稳定的相关性表现。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This work extends zero-cost (ZC) NAS proxies, which have largely been confined to convolutional search spaces, to Vision Transformers. It introduces a benchmark on the Autoformer search space over 6 tasks and proposes L-SWAG, a generalizable ZC metric combining layer-sample-wise activation and gradient information across 14 tasks. LIBRA-NAS is further proposed to combine complementary proxies via low-information-gain and bias re-alignment, improving ZC-NAS reliability.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 将零成本NAS代理系统性地推广到ViT搜索空间，并给出多任务基准与代理组合方法，对NAS与ViT交叉方向有参考价值。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向ViT的零成本NAS代理L-SWAG及代理组合方法LIBRA-NAS，并建立Autoformer多任务基准。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 用层-样本级激活与梯度信息构建可同时适用于卷积与Transformer的通用零成本指标。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在14个任务上验证了代理的泛化性，并通过LIBRA-NAS提升了零成本NAS的搜索表现。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: 针对N-shot NAS中所有子网共用静态训练策略导致的两大问题——训练偏向低复杂度子网（不公平）和超网动量更新噪声大（噪声动量），本文提出子网感知的动态超网训练技术。方法包括复杂度感知学习率调度器CaLR，按子网复杂度自适应控制学习率衰减比例以缓解不公平；以及动量分离技术MS，将结构相似的子网分组并各组使用独立动量以抑制噪声。该方法可低成本嵌入多种N-shot NAS方法，并显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: N-shot NAS typically trains all subnets with a static strategy, causing bias toward low-complexity subnets and noisy momentum updates. This paper proposes a subnet-aware dynamic supernet training scheme with a complexity-aware LR scheduler (CaLR) and a momentum separation technique (MS) that groups structurally similar subnets. The approach is applicable to various N-shot NAS methods at marginal cost and substantially improves search performance.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 从训练策略层面切入N-shot NAS的公平性与动量噪声问题，思路清晰且易于集成，但属于增量式改进。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出复杂度感知学习率调度与动量分离两种子网自适应超网训练技术。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 按子网复杂度调节学习率衰减、并按结构相似性分组维护独立动量。
2503.10740|v2.result: 可低成本应用于多种N-shot NAS方法并大幅提升搜索性能。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS需从头训练每个候选架构、计算开销巨大的问题，本文提出一种基于Fisher信息、具有统计理论支撑的免训练代理，用于估计给定深度网络的图像分类精度。该代理无需训练即可预测架构性能，从而显著降低标准NAS算法的计算成本。在三个公开数据集、两个搜索空间上，无论使用已有评价指标还是作者新提出的指标，该代理均取得免训练代理的最优结果。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the prohibitive cost of training each candidate architecture in NAS, this paper proposes a training-free proxy for image classification accuracy grounded in Fisher Information. The proxy estimates expected accuracy without training, substantially reducing NAS cost. It achieves state-of-the-art results among training-free proxies on three public datasets and two search spaces, under both existing and a newly proposed evaluation metric.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 以Fisher信息为理论基础的免训练代理，理论动机扎实，对降低NAS成本有实际意义。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于Fisher信息的免训练NAS精度代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 将统计理论中的Fisher信息引入免训练代理设计以估计分类精度。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在三个数据集、两个搜索空间上取得免训练代理的SOTA表现。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: 针对性能预测器中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题，本文首次对NAS性能预测器的损失函数进行全面研究，将其分为回归、排序和加权三类。作者在5个搜索空间、13个任务上评估了8种损失函数，并使用多种NAS相关指标进行衡量。结果表明特定类别的损失函数可以有效组合以提升基于预测器的NAS，并为实践提供指导。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study of loss functions for NAS performance predictors, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted losses. Eight loss functions are evaluated on 13 tasks across five search spaces using a range of NAS-relevant metrics. The results show that certain categories can be effectively combined to improve predictor-based NAS and offer practical guidance.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 属于系统性实证研究，虽无新方法，但对预测器损失函数选择具有实用指导价值。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究并分类NAS性能预测器的损失函数。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 在统一框架下跨5个搜索空间、13个任务对比8种损失函数并给出组合建议。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现特定类别损失函数可有效组合以提升基于预测器的NAS性能。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标NAS中Pareto前沿刻画需为每个硬件约束重复搜索、计算代价高的问题，提出一种将用户偏好编码进超网络的NAS算法，通过硬件特征与偏好向量条件化联合架构分布，实现单次搜索即可跨设备获得多样且具代表性的架构，并支持对新设备的零样本迁移。在多达19种硬件设备和3个目标的实验中验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性，无需额外搜索即可覆盖多约束下的Pareto前沿。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS, where each hardware constraint typically requires a separate search. It proposes a hypernetwork that conditions the joint architectural distribution on hardware features and preference vectors, enabling diverse, representative architectures across devices in a single search run with zero-shot transfer to new devices. Experiments on up to 19 hardware devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 将偏好条件化超网络引入多目标NAS，单次搜索覆盖多设备Pareto前沿，思路清晰且实验规模较大，对边缘部署与硬件感知搜索有参考价值。
2402.18213|v2.contribution: 提出偏好与硬件条件化的超网络NAS，实现单次搜索跨多设备多目标的Pareto前沿刻画与零样本迁移。
2402.18213|v2.innovation: 用偏好向量与硬件特征联合条件化架构分布，避免为每个约束重复搜索。
2402.18213|v2.result: 在19种硬件设备、3个目标上验证了有效性与可扩展性，并支持零样本迁移到新设备。

High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.summary_en: This paper addresses the joint optimization of area, delay, and power in arithmetic circuit design by applying differentiable architecture search. 2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测器易受对抗攻击、而现有对抗研究多局限于2D图像的问题，本文提出生成可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体以欺骗LiDAR检测器。方法将对抗物体置于目标车辆车顶，使其在点云表示下被检测器完全忽略，并在多种点云输入表示的检测器上验证攻击效果。相比已有2D对抗工作，本文首次系统性地将对抗攻击拓展到3D LiDAR感知，攻击成功率达80%。此外还初步探索了基于数据增强的对抗防御，为自动驾驶在未见条件下的安全性提供了参考。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR-based 3D object detectors to adversarial attacks, which has been far less explored than 2D image attacks. The authors generate universal, physically realizable 3D adversarial objects that, when placed on a target vehicle's rooftop, hide the vehicle from LiDAR detectors with an 80% success rate across detectors using various point cloud representations. They further conduct a pilot study on adversarial defense via data augmentation, taking a step toward safer self-driving under unseen conditions.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该工作将对抗攻击从2D图像拓展到3D LiDAR感知，攻击成功率高且具备物理可实现性，对自动驾驶感知安全性研究具有重要警示与参考价值。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 提出了一种可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体生成方法，能有效欺骗多种LiDAR 3D目标检测器。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在3D点云感知层面构造通用对抗物体，并验证其跨检测器与跨点云表示的迁移性。
2004.00543|v2.result: 在车顶放置对抗物体可使目标车辆以80%成功率从LiDAR检测器中完全隐藏。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云内存占用大、车载与离线存储压力高的问题，本文提出OctSqueeze深度压缩算法。方法先将点云编码为八叉树，再设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，从而编码为紧凑比特流。相比此前最优方法，在相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，且在相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测任务表现更优。该算法可显著降低自动驾驶场景下LiDAR点云的存储开销（单车每日约840亿点）。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large memory footprint of LiDAR point clouds by proposing OctSqueeze, a deep compression algorithm that encodes points into an octree and models octree symbol probabilities with a tree-structured conditional entropy model. It reduces bitrate by 10-20% at equal reconstruction quality over prior state-of-the-art, and outperforms other compressors on downstream 3D segmentation and detection at the same bitrate, benefiting onboard and offboard storage in self-driving.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该工作将深度熵模型引入LiDAR点云压缩，兼顾压缩率与下游任务性能，对自动驾驶数据存储与传输有实用价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树结构条件熵模型的LiDAR点云深度压缩算法OctSqueeze。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，实现稀疏点云的高效紧凑编码。
2005.07178|v2.result: 相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测性能优于其他压缩算法。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中需同时可靠感知物体存在及其运动行为的问题，本文提出MotionNet，从3D点云序列联合执行感知与运动预测。模型以LiDAR扫描序列为输入，输出BEV地图，在每个网格单元编码物体类别与运动信息，骨干为新颖的时空金字塔网络以分层提取深层时空特征。训练中引入空间与时间一致性损失以约束预测平滑性，实验表明其整体优于包括最新场景流和3D目标检测方法在内的现有工作。该方法可作为基于边界框系统的备份，为运动规划器提供互补信息。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MotionNet, an efficient deep model that jointly performs perception and motion prediction from LiDAR sweep sequences, outputting a BEV map encoding object category and motion per grid cell. Its spatio-temporal pyramid backbone extracts hierarchical spatial and temporal features, and novel spatial/temporal consistency losses regularize predictions. Extensive experiments show it outperforms state-of-the-art scene-flow and 3D-detection-based methods, serving as a backup to bounding-box systems and complementing motion planners.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该工作以BEV网格统一建模感知与运动预测，时空金字塔与一致性损失设计合理，对自动驾驶运动规划有直接参考价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出了从LiDAR序列联合进行感知与运动预测的BEV模型MotionNet。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 设计时空金字塔骨干网络与空间/时间一致性损失，实现BEV地图上物体类别与运动的联合编码。
2003.06754|v2.result: 整体性能优于最新场景流与3D目标检测方法，可作为边界框系统的备份提供互补信息。

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有驾驶员注意力预测仅依赖人眼注视信息、忽略场景语义的问题，本文提出语义增强注视（SAGE）检测方法，在原始注视基础上捕获驾驶特定上下文信息。基于此设计完整显著性预测框架SAGE-Net，进一步融合物体距离（深度）、自车速度与行人过街意图等关键因素修正初始预测。在四种流行显著性算法上的实验表明，在49/56（87.5%）的情况下SAGE优于现有技术，且训练过程无额外计算开销。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses driver attention prediction that relies solely on human gaze while ignoring scene semantics, proposing a Semantics Augmented GazE (SAGE) approach that captures driving-specific contextual information alongside raw gaze. The resulting SAGE-Net saliency framework further refines predictions using object depth, ego speed, and pedestrian crossing intent. Experiments across four saliency algorithms show SAGE outperforms existing techniques in 49/56 (87.5%) cases without additional training overhead.
1911.10455|v2.assessment: 该工作将场景语义与驾驶上下文融入驾驶员注意力预测，对自动驾驶人机交互与安全辅助有参考意义，但偏感知心理学方向。
1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出了融合场景语义与驾驶上下文的SAGE检测方法及SAGE-Net显著性预测框架。
1911.10455|v2.innovation: 在原始注视基础上引入场景语义、深度、自车速度与行人意图等多因素联合注意力机制。
1911.10455|v2.result: 在49/56（87.5%）的情况下优于现有技术，且训练无额外计算开销。

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶决策中观察-动作映射难以泛化的问题，本文提出将观察-动作规则内化到网络中的可建议学习框架。方法通过从专家驾驶数据中提取规则并嵌入到端到端模型中，使车辆在未见场景下也能做出合理决策。相比纯模仿学习，该方法增强了规则约束下的泛化能力。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of observation-to-action mappings in autonomous driving by proposing an advisable learning framework that internalizes expert rules into the network. The method extracts rules from expert driving data and embeds them into an end-to-end model, enabling reasonable decisions in unseen scenarios. It improves generalization over pure imitation learning, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: 针对城市驾驶中多模态概率轨迹预测问题，本文提出CoverNet，将轨迹预测建模为对一组多样化轨迹的分类问题。方法通过构建覆盖状态空间且排除物理不可行轨迹的轨迹集，并基于智能体当前状态动态生成轨迹集以提高效率。相比多模态回归、占据栅格图和单步随机策略，CoverNet在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上超越了当时的最优方法。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction for urban driving by proposing CoverNet, which frames prediction as classification over a diverse set of trajectories. The trajectory set ensures state-space coverage and excludes physically impossible trajectories, and is dynamically generated based on the agent's current state for efficiency. CoverNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods on public real-world self-driving datasets.
1911.10298|v2.assessment: 将轨迹预测转化为分类问题的思路简洁有效，动态轨迹集生成提升了实用性，是行为预测领域的代表性工作。
1911.10298|v2.contribution: 提出基于轨迹集分类的多模态概率轨迹预测方法CoverNet。
1911.10298|v2.innovation: 动态生成覆盖状态空间且物理可行的轨迹集，将预测转化为分类问题。
1911.10298|v2.result: 在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上超越当时最优方法。

RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计困难导致精度低的问题，本文提出RTM3D，一种基于物体关键点的实时单目3D检测方法。方法通过预测3D bounding box的9个关键点，结合几何约束恢复物体的3D位置、尺寸和朝向，避免了直接的深度回归。相比已有单目方法，RTM3D在保持实时性的同时提升了检测精度。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing RTM3D, a real-time method based on object keypoints. It predicts nine keypoints of the 3D bounding box and recovers position, dimensions, and orientation via geometric constraints, avoiding direct depth regression. RTM3D improves accuracy while maintaining real-time performance, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.assessment: 基于关键点的几何恢复思路对单目3D检测有较强实用价值，实时性是其亮点。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.contribution: 提出基于9个关键点几何约束的实时单目3D检测方法RTM3D。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.innovation: 通过关键点预测与几何约束替代直接深度回归，实现实时单目3D检测。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.result: 在保持实时性的同时提升了单目3D检测精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
