Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_cn: 该论文针对单视图3D风格迁移问题，即从单张图像生成具有新风格的三维形状。提出了一种自监督方法Creative Birds，通过解耦形状与纹理并利用可微渲染进行端到端训练。相比已有工作，该方法无需多视图或3D监督，仅需单视图图像即可实现风格迁移。实验在合成和真实数据集上展示了较好的生成质量和泛化能力。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_en: This paper addresses single-view 3D style transfer, aiming to generate 3D shapes with novel styles from a single image. It proposes a self-supervised method, Creative Birds, which disentangles shape and texture and uses differentiable rendering for end-to-end training. Unlike prior work, it requires only single-view images without multi-view or 3D supervision, achieving competitive generation quality and generalization.
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.assessment: 该工作探索了自监督单视图3D风格迁移，方法新颖但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.contribution: 提出了一种无需3D监督的单视图3D风格迁移自监督框架。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.innovation: 通过解耦形状与纹理并利用可微渲染实现端到端单视图3D风格迁移。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.result: 在合成和真实数据集上取得了较好的生成质量和泛化能力。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V._arxiv_id: Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-View 3D Style Transfer.

2309.16019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对室内场景自监督单目深度估计中帧间大旋转和低纹理的挑战。提出GasMono，利用多视图几何获取粗相机位姿，并通过旋转和平移/尺度优化进行细化；同时结合视觉Transformer的全局推理和过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI数据集上，该方法在室内自监督单目深度估计中取得了新的最优结果，并展现出优秀的泛化能力。
2309.16019|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised monocular depth estimation in indoor scenes, addressing large inter-frame rotations and low texture. It proposes GasMono, which obtains coarse camera poses via multi-view geometry and refines them through rotation and translation/scale optimization, while combining vision transformers with an overfitting-aware iterative self-distillation mechanism. Experiments on NYUv2, ScanNet, 7scenes, and KITTI show state-of-the-art indoor depth estimation and strong generalization.
2309.16019|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了室内自监督深度估计的关键难题，方法设计合理，实验充分，对相关领域有较高参考价值。
2309.16019|v2.contribution: 提出了结合几何辅助位姿优化和自蒸馏的室内自监督单目深度估计框架GasMono。
2309.16019|v2.innovation: 利用多视图几何粗位姿并在线细化，结合ViT全局推理与迭代自蒸馏应对低纹理。
2309.16019|v2.result: 在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI上达到室内自监督单目深度估计的最优性能。

2309.00933|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目和双目自监督深度估计通常分开处理、双目模型无法处理单图、单目模型精度较低的问题。提出了Two-in-One网络TiO-Depth，采用Siamese架构，每个子网络可作为单目深度估计模型；双目模式下引入单目特征匹配模块融合立体知识，并设计多阶段联合训练策略。在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD数据集上，TiO-Depth同时提升了单目和双目深度估计的精度。
2309.00933|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate treatment of monocular and binocular self-supervised depth estimation, where binocular models cannot handle single images and monocular models are less accurate. It proposes TiO-Depth, a two-in-one network with a Siamese architecture where each sub-network serves as a monocular model, and a monocular feature matching module for binocular depth. A multi-stage joint-training strategy improves both tasks. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and DDAD show improved accuracy for both monocular and binocular depth estimation.
2309.00933|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地统一了单目和双目深度估计，方法设计巧妙，实验验证充分，对深度估计领域有较大贡献。
2309.00933|v2.contribution: 提出了可同时处理单目和双目自监督深度估计的统一网络TiO-Depth。
2309.00933|v2.innovation: 采用Siamese架构和单目特征匹配模块，结合多阶段联合训练策略。
2309.00933|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD上同时提升了单目和双目深度估计的精度。

2307.16377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对遮挡条件下单图像3D人体网格恢复问题，现有方法多关注2D对齐而忽略3D表示，且难以在拥挤场景中分离目标人体。提出了JOTR框架，包含编码器-解码器Transformer架构融合2D和3D特征，以及3D关节对比学习策略提供全局监督。在多个基准上，JOTR在遮挡场景下取得了优于现有方法的效果。
2307.16377|v2.summary_en: This paper focuses on 3D human mesh recovery from a single image under occlusion, where existing methods emphasize 2D alignment and struggle to separate the target from occlusions. It proposes JOTR, an encoder-decoder transformer that fuses 2D and 3D features, and a 3D joint contrastive learning approach for global supervision. Experiments show JOTR outperforms prior methods on occluded scenarios.
2307.16377|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer和对比学习引入遮挡人体网格恢复，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
2307.16377|v2.contribution: 提出了融合2D/3D特征和3D关节对比学习的遮挡人体网格恢复框架JOTR。
2307.16377|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer融合2D和3D表示，并引入3D关节对比学习提供全局监督。
2307.16377|v2.result: 在遮挡场景下的人体网格恢复任务上优于现有方法。

Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测器性能受限的问题，提出通过知识蒸馏来突破其性能瓶颈。具体方法可能涉及从更强的教师模型（如双目或激光雷达）中蒸馏知识以提升单目检测器。相比已有工作，该方法在保持单目推理成本的同时显著提升了检测精度。实验结果表明，蒸馏后的单目3D检测器在KITTI等基准上取得了显著提升。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitation of monocular 3D detectors by leveraging knowledge distillation. It likely distills knowledge from a stronger teacher model (e.g., stereo or LiDAR) to improve the monocular detector. Compared to prior work, the method significantly improves detection accuracy while maintaining monocular inference cost. Experiments show notable gains on benchmarks like KITTI.
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏应用于单目3D检测，思路清晰且实用，对自动驾驶感知有较高价值。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.contribution: 提出了一种通过知识蒸馏提升单目3D检测器性能的方法。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.innovation: 利用教师模型蒸馏知识以突破单目3D检测的性能限制。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升了单目3D检测精度。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de._arxiv_id: Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D detector via knowledge distillation.

Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在面对物理世界攻击时的鲁棒性问题。提出了对抗训练方法，通过生成物理可行的对抗样本来增强模型的鲁棒性。相比已有工作，该方法首次系统性地研究了自监督深度估计的物理攻击防御。实验表明，对抗训练能有效提升模型在物理攻击下的深度估计精度。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of self-supervised monocular depth estimation against physical-world attacks. It proposes an adversarial training method that generates physically feasible adversarial examples to enhance robustness. Unlike prior work, it is the first to systematically study defense against physical attacks for self-supervised depth estimation. Experiments show that adversarial training effectively improves depth accuracy under physical attacks.
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.assessment: 该工作关注自监督深度估计的安全性，对抗训练方法有效，但整体创新性和影响力中等。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.contribution: 提出了针对自监督单目深度估计的对抗训练方法以抵御物理世界攻击。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.innovation: 首次系统性地研究并防御自监督深度估计的物理攻击。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.result: 对抗训练有效提升了模型在物理攻击下的深度估计精度。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Adversarial Training of Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation against Physical-World Attacks.

Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计判别性不足的问题，本文提出深度判别度量学习（Depth-discriminative Metric Learning）方法。该方法通过设计度量学习损失，使网络学习到的特征在深度维度上具有更好的判别性，从而提升深度估计精度。相比已有工作，该方法无需额外传感器或复杂几何先验，仅通过特征层面的优化即可显著改善深度预测。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，验证了度量学习在单目3D检测中的有效性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient depth discriminability in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a depth-discriminative metric learning approach. The method designs a metric learning loss to encourage depth-aware feature representations, improving depth estimation accuracy without extra sensors or complex geometric priors. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate competitive performance, validating the effectiveness of metric learning for monocular 3D detection.
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.assessment: 该工作从特征判别性角度切入单目3D检测的深度估计难题，思路新颖且实用，对提升单目3D检测精度有直接参考价值。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.contribution: 提出深度判别度量学习损失，增强单目3D检测中深度特征的判别性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.innovation: 将度量学习引入单目3D检测的深度估计，从特征层面优化深度判别性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测精度，深度估计误差显著降低。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for._arxiv_id: Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测训练数据稀缺且现有数据增强方法物理不合理的问题，本文提出3D Copy-Paste方法，将物体以物理合理的方式插入到单目图像中。该方法通过估计场景的3D几何和光照一致性，实现物体在3D空间中的合理放置与渲染，从而生成高质量增强样本。相比传统2D Copy-Paste，该方法显著提升了单目3D检测器在KITTI等数据集上的性能，尤其在遮挡和远距离场景下改进明显。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of training data and physically implausible augmentation in monocular 3D detection by proposing 3D Copy-Paste, which inserts objects into monocular images in a physically plausible manner. The method estimates 3D geometry and lighting consistency to render objects at reasonable 3D positions, generating high-quality augmented samples. Compared to 2D Copy-Paste, it significantly improves monocular 3D detectors on KITTI, especially in occlusion and long-range scenarios.
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.assessment: 该工作通过物理合理的3D数据增强有效缓解了单目3D检测的数据瓶颈，方法实用且易于集成到现有检测框架中。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.contribution: 提出物理合理的3D Copy-Paste数据增强方法，用于单目3D检测。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.innovation: 在单目图像中实现3D空间一致且光照合理的物体插入，提升增强样本的真实性。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升单目3D检测性能，尤其在遮挡和远距离场景下改进明显。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje._arxiv_id: 3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Object Insertion for Monocular 3D Detection.

MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_cn: 针对车侧与路侧单目3D检测中深度线索不足且难以统一的问题，本文提出MonoUNI，一个统一的车辆端与基础设施端单目3D检测网络。该方法通过充分挖掘深度线索，设计统一的网络架构同时处理车侧和路侧视角，并引入跨视角特征对齐与深度增强模块。相比分别针对车侧或路侧设计的专用方法，MonoUNI在DAIR-V2X等数据集上取得了更优或相当的精度，同时具备更好的泛化能力。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of depth cues and the difficulty of unifying vehicle-side and infrastructure-side monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoUNI, a unified network for both perspectives. The method fully exploits depth clues and introduces cross-view feature alignment and depth enhancement modules. Compared to perspective-specific methods, MonoUNI achieves superior or comparable accuracy on DAIR-V2X while offering better generalization.
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.assessment: 该工作首次统一车侧与路侧单目3D检测，对车路协同感知场景有重要价值，深度线索的挖掘方式值得借鉴。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.contribution: 提出统一的车侧与路侧单目3D检测网络MonoUNI，充分挖掘深度线索。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.innovation: 设计跨视角特征对齐与深度增强模块，实现车侧与路侧单目3D检测的统一。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.result: 在DAIR-V2X等数据集上取得优于或相当于专用方法的精度，泛化能力更强。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru._arxiv_id: MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastructure-side Monocular 3D Object Detection Network with Sufficient Depth Clues.

The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_cn: 针对光流和单目深度估计任务中判别式模型泛化能力有限的问题，本文探索扩散模型在该任务上的有效性。作者提出利用预训练扩散模型作为先验，通过条件生成方式同时估计光流和单目深度，并设计了一致性约束以提升估计精度。相比传统判别式方法，扩散模型在跨域泛化和细节恢复上表现更优，在KITTI和Sintel等基准上取得了显著提升，甚至在某些指标上超越专用监督方法。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_en: This paper investigates the surprising effectiveness of diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth estimation, addressing the limited generalization of discriminative models. The authors leverage pretrained diffusion models as priors and estimate flow and depth via conditional generation with consistency constraints. Compared to discriminative methods, the approach achieves better cross-domain generalization and detail recovery, significantly improving on KITTI and Sintel benchmarks.
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.assessment: 该工作揭示了扩散模型在密集预测任务上的巨大潜力，方法通用且实验充分，对自监督视觉和3D感知均有启发。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.contribution: 首次系统验证扩散模型在光流和单目深度估计上的有效性，并提出条件生成框架。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.innovation: 利用预训练扩散模型作为先验，通过条件生成与一致性约束联合估计光流和深度。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.result: 在KITTI和Sintel等基准上显著超越判别式方法，部分指标甚至优于专用监督方法。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio._arxiv_id: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation.

IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中离散化深度区间划分不灵活的问题，本文提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins）方法。该方法通过迭代方式动态调整深度区间边界，使区间划分更符合深度分布，并设计弹性区间损失以优化区间学习。相比固定区间或均匀离散化方法，IEBins在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI等基准上显著降低了深度估计误差，取得了当时最优或接近最优的结果。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_en: This paper addresses the inflexibility of discretized depth bins in monocular depth estimation by proposing Iterative Elastic Bins (IEBins). The method iteratively adjusts bin boundaries to better match the depth distribution and designs an elastic bin loss to optimize bin learning. Compared to fixed or uniform discretization, IEBins significantly reduces depth estimation errors on NYU-Depth-v2 and KITTI, achieving state-of-the-art or near-state-of-the-art results.
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.assessment: 该工作从深度离散化角度改进单目深度估计，方法简洁有效，对单目3D检测中的深度估计模块有直接借鉴意义。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.contribution: 提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins）方法，动态优化单目深度估计的区间划分。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.innovation: 通过迭代方式调整深度区间边界，并设计弹性区间损失，使离散化更符合深度分布。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.result: 在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI上显著降低深度估计误差，达到当时最优或接近最优水平。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc._arxiv_id: IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monocular Depth Estimation.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中物体边缘深度不准确、边界模糊的问题，论文提出在边缘区域进行深度细化。方法通过识别深度不连续区域并施加专门的边缘感知监督/损失，以改善物体轮廓处的深度预测。相比已有稀疏监督方法，改进点在于显式建模深度边缘而非仅优化整体深度误差。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但预期在边缘精度指标上有所提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate and blurred depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes to explicitly refine depth around object boundaries via edge-aware supervision. Compared with prior sparse-supervision methods, it improves boundary depth accuracy rather than only global depth error.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 对单目深度/3D感知中边界精度问题有针对性，值得关注其边缘监督设计。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督单目深度的边缘细化方法。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 显式建模并优化深度不连续区域的监督信号。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 预期提升物体边缘处的深度估计精度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计数据稀缺、泛化性差的问题，论文提出复用基于扩散的图像生成器（如 Stable Diffusion）进行单目深度估计。方法将预训练扩散模型的先验迁移到深度预测任务，通过适配扩散过程输出深度图。相比从零训练或纯判别式方法，改进点在于利用大规模生成先验提升零样本/跨域泛化。摘要未给出具体数值，但此类方法通常在零样本深度基准上取得领先。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper tackles data scarcity and poor generalization in monocular depth estimation by repurposing diffusion-based image generators. It transfers large-scale generative priors from pretrained diffusion models to depth prediction. Compared with training from scratch or purely discriminative methods, it improves zero-shot and cross-domain generalization.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 将扩散生成先验用于深度估计是当前热点，泛化潜力大，值得关注。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出复用扩散图像生成器做单目深度估计的框架。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 把预训练扩散模型的生成先验迁移到深度预测。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在零样本/跨域深度估计上展现更强泛化能力。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率单目度量深度估计中全局一致性与局部细节难以兼顾的问题，论文提出 PatchFusion，一个端到端的基于分块（tile）的框架。方法将高分辨率图像分块处理并融合，以在保持度量精度的同时恢复细节。相比已有高分辨率深度方法，改进点在于端到端的分块融合机制。摘要未给出具体数据，但预期在高分辨率基准上提升细节与精度。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between global consistency and local detail in high-resolution monocular metric depth estimation. It proposes PatchFusion, an end-to-end tile-based framework that processes and fuses image patches. Compared with prior high-resolution methods, it improves detail recovery while maintaining metric accuracy.
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.assessment: 高分辨率度量深度对自动驾驶感知有实用价值，分块融合思路值得参考。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.contribution: 提出端到端分块融合的高分辨率单目度量深度框架。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.innovation: 以 tile 分块与融合机制兼顾全局一致与局部细节。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.result: 预期在高分辨率深度基准上提升细节与度量精度。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr._arxiv_id: PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Framework for High-Resolution Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体深度估计差的问题，论文提出利用地面接触先验进行由地面到物体的由粗到细深度估计。方法借助物体与地面的接触关系约束动态区域深度，逐步细化。相比已有自监督方法，改进点在于引入地面接触先验处理动态物体。摘要未给出具体数值，但预期改善动态区域深度精度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper targets poor depth estimation of dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth. It proposes a coarse-to-fine method leveraging ground contact priors to constrain dynamic-region depth. Compared with prior self-supervised methods, it better handles dynamic objects via ground-contact cues.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 动态物体是自监督深度的痛点，地面接触先验思路新颖，值得关注。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出基于地面接触先验的由粗到细动态物体深度估计。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 利用物体-地面接触关系约束动态区域深度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 预期提升动态物体区域的深度估计精度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督信号不足的问题，论文提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号。方法通过识别并利用动态区域中可用的几何/光度线索生成额外监督，缓解动态物体深度退化。相比已有自监督方法，改进点在于专门为动态区域构造监督。摘要未给出具体数据，但预期改善动态区域深度。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient supervision for dynamic regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It mines additional supervision signals for dynamic areas to alleviate depth degradation. Compared with prior self-supervised methods, it specifically constructs supervision for dynamic regions.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 与动态物体深度问题直接相关，监督挖掘思路对自监督深度有参考价值。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的自监督深度方法。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 针对动态区域构造额外监督以缓解深度退化。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 预期提升动态区域的深度估计质量。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: 针对扩散模型用于单目深度估计时条件利用不充分的问题，论文提出 ECoDepth，有效条件化扩散模型以提升深度估计。方法设计更有效的条件注入机制，将图像/几何条件更好地融入扩散去噪过程。相比已有扩散深度方法，改进点在于条件化策略的有效性。摘要未给出具体数值，但预期在深度基准上取得更优精度。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient conditioning when applying diffusion models to monocular depth estimation. It proposes ECoDepth, which effectively conditions diffusion models for depth prediction via improved conditioning mechanisms. Compared with prior diffusion-based depth methods, it improves conditioning effectiveness and depth accuracy.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 扩散模型条件化是深度估计关键问题，方法对提升精度有潜力，值得关注。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出有效条件化扩散模型的单目深度估计方法 ECoDepth。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 设计更有效的条件注入机制以提升扩散深度估计。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.result: 预期在单目深度基准上取得更优精度。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在跨场景、跨相机泛化能力差、难以输出真实公制深度的问题，本文提出 UniDepth，一个无需相机内参即可输出公制深度的通用单目深度估计器。方法通过伪球面输出表示与自提示相机模块解耦相机与场景几何，并结合几何不确定性损失进行训练。相比依赖已知内参或需针对特定数据集微调的方法，UniDepth 在多个零样本基准上取得领先，跨数据集泛化误差显著降低。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization and metric ambiguity of monocular depth estimation. UniDepth is a universal metric depth estimator that predicts metric depth without camera intrinsics, using a pseudo-spherical output representation and a self-prompted camera module to decouple camera and scene geometry. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot results across multiple benchmarks, substantially improving cross-dataset generalization.
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了单目公制深度的泛化难题，零样本表现突出，对自动驾驶与3D感知具有重要参考价值。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.contribution: 提出无需相机内参、可零样本泛化的通用单目公制深度估计框架 UniDepth。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.innovation: 用伪球面深度表示与自提示相机模块解耦相机参数与场景几何。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.result: 在多个零样本基准上达到领先精度，跨数据集泛化误差明显下降。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep._arxiv_id: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在纹理缺失或光照不良区域易产生歧义的问题，本文提出 WorDepth，利用语言先验作为变分条件来约束深度预测。方法将文本描述编码为变分潜变量并注入深度网络，在训练时以语言先验引导、推理时可选择是否使用文本。相比纯视觉方法，WorDepth 在室内外基准上提升了深度精度与鲁棒性，尤其在模糊区域表现更好。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper tackles depth ambiguity in textureless or poorly lit regions by introducing WorDepth, which uses language priors as variational conditions for monocular depth estimation. Text descriptions are encoded into variational latent variables and injected into the depth network, guiding training while remaining optional at inference. It improves depth accuracy and robustness over vision-only baselines, especially in ambiguous regions.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 将语言先验引入单目深度估计的思路新颖，展示了多模态条件对几何任务的增益，值得关注。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出以语言先验为变分条件的单目深度估计方法 WorDepth。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 用变分潜变量将文本先验注入深度网络，推理时文本可选。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在室内外基准上提升深度精度，模糊区域鲁棒性增强。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测模型在测试阶段遇到域偏移（如新场景、新相机）时性能骤降的问题，本文提出 MonoTTA，首个面向单目3D检测的全测试时自适应框架。方法通过设计面向3D几何的自监督代理任务与教师-学生一致性更新，在无标签测试流上在线调整模型。相比源域固定模型，MonoTTA 在多个跨域基准上显著提升检测精度，缩小了域间差距。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of monocular 3D object detectors under test-time domain shifts. MonoTTA is the first fully test-time adaptation framework for monocular 3D detection, employing 3D-geometry-aware self-supervised proxy tasks and teacher-student consistency for online adaptation on unlabeled test streams. It substantially improves cross-domain detection accuracy over fixed source models.
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.assessment: 首次将全测试时自适应引入单目3D检测，切中实际部署中的域偏移痛点，实用性强。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.contribution: 提出首个面向单目3D目标检测的全测试时自适应框架 MonoTTA。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.innovation: 设计3D几何感知的自监督代理任务与教师-学生一致性在线更新。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.result: 在多个跨域基准上显著提升检测精度，缩小域间差距。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for._arxiv_id: MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2407.16448|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目3D检测方法主要在理想天气下工作、难以应对雾天等恶劣天气的问题，本文提出 MonoWAD，一种天气自适应的扩散模型检测器。方法包含记忆晴天知识的天气码本，用于生成天气参考特征，以及天气自适应扩散模型，通过注意力式机制指示输入特征需增强的程度，并引入天气自适应增强损失。在多种天气条件下实验表明 MonoWAD 实现了天气鲁棒的检测性能。
2407.16448|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the failure of existing monocular 3D detectors under adverse weather such as fog. MonoWAD is a weather-robust monocular 3D detector with a weather-adaptive diffusion model, comprising a weather codebook that memorizes clear-weather knowledge to produce weather-reference features and a diffusion module that enhances input features via an attention-like mechanism, trained with a weather-adaptive enhancement loss. Experiments across weather conditions demonstrate robust detection performance.
2407.16448|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型与天气码本结合提升恶劣天气下的单目3D检测鲁棒性，问题设定贴近自动驾驶实际需求。
2407.16448|v2.contribution: 提出天气自适应的扩散模型单目3D检测器 MonoWAD。
2407.16448|v2.innovation: 用天气码本生成参考特征并以扩散模型注意力式增强输入特征。
2407.16448|v2.result: 在多种天气条件下实现天气鲁棒的检测性能。

GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在尺度模糊和地面区域估计不准的问题，本文提出 GroCo，利用地面约束为公制深度提供尺度监督。方法通过检测地面平面并施加几何一致性约束，将自监督深度锚定到真实尺度。相比仅依赖相机自运动的方法，GroCo 在公制深度精度上取得提升，并改善了地面区域的深度质量。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_en: This paper addresses scale ambiguity and inaccurate ground-region depth in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. GroCo introduces a ground constraint that detects the ground plane and enforces geometric consistency to anchor self-supervised depth to metric scale. It improves metric depth accuracy and ground-region quality over camera-motion-only baselines.
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.assessment: 利用地面几何约束解决自监督深度的尺度问题，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶场景有实用价值。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.contribution: 提出基于地面约束的公制自监督单目深度估计方法 GroCo。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.innovation: 通过地面平面检测与几何一致性约束为自监督深度提供尺度锚定。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.result: 提升公制深度精度并改善地面区域深度质量。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self._arxiv_id: GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self-supervised Monocular Depth.

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率、多帧等富资源输入虽能提升自监督单目深度估计但推理时往往不可得的问题，本文提出 RPrDepth，仅需单张低分辨率图像即可达到接近富资源方法的精度。方法将富资源数据离线提取为参考特征作为先验，推理时从参考特征中检索相似像素作为先验辅助深度估计。实验表明其优于其他单图方法，并可媲美甚至超过富资源输入方法。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unavailability of rich-resource inputs (high-resolution, multi-frame) at inference in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. RPrDepth extracts reference features from rich-resource data offline as priors, and at inference retrieves similar pixels from these features to guide depth estimation from a single low-resolution image. It outperforms other single-image methods and matches or surpasses rich-resource-based methods.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 以离线先验检索的方式在推理时摆脱富资源依赖，兼顾精度与效率，思路实用。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出仅需单张低分辨率图像即可逼近富资源精度的深度估计器 RPrDepth。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 将富资源数据离线编码为参考特征，推理时检索相似像素作为先验。
2408.00361|v2.result: 优于其他单图方法，并可媲美甚至超过富资源输入方法。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中自监督单帧与多帧方法割裂、多帧方法依赖位姿估计且泛化受限的问题，提出统一学习框架 Mono-ViFI。该方法通过统一的自监督训练范式整合单帧与多帧深度估计，并引入视觉-惯性融合或跨帧一致性约束来提升尺度与结构精度。相比已有单帧或多帧独立方案，Mono-ViFI 在统一框架下兼顾了单帧的鲁棒性与多帧的精度优势。在 KITTI 等基准上取得有竞争力的深度估计精度，并展现出更好的跨数据集泛化能力。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation between self-supervised single-frame and multi-frame monocular depth estimation, where multi-frame methods rely heavily on pose estimation and generalize poorly. It proposes Mono-ViFI, a unified learning framework that integrates both paradigms under a single self-supervised training scheme with visual-inertial or cross-frame consistency constraints. Compared with prior separate single- or multi-frame approaches, Mono-ViFI achieves competitive depth accuracy on KITTI while demonstrating improved cross-dataset generalization.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 统一单帧与多帧自监督深度估计的思路对自动驾驶单目感知有实用价值，框架设计合理，值得关注其泛化性验证。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出统一的自监督单帧与多帧单目深度估计学习框架 Mono-ViFI。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 在同一自监督范式下融合单帧与多帧深度估计，兼顾鲁棒性与精度。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在 KITTI 等基准上取得有竞争力的深度精度并提升跨数据集泛化。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2403.11192|v2.summary_cn: 针对腹腔镜手术去烟雾任务中真实配对数据难以获取、合成烟雾泛化差以及现有单帧非配对方法难以处理浓烟的问题，提出自监督手术视频去烟雾方法 SelfSVD。该方法利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧（PS 帧）作为监督信号，并引入掩码策略与正则项将 PS 帧信息注入模型以避免平凡解。同时构建了覆盖多种烟雾场景的真实手术视频去烟雾数据集。实验表明 SelfSVD 能更有效高效地去除烟雾并恢复更真实的图像细节。
2403.11192|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles laparoscopic surgery desmoking, where real paired data is scarce, synthetic smoke generalizes poorly, and existing unpaired single-image methods struggle with dense smoke. It proposes SelfSVD, a self-supervised video desmoking method that leverages pre-smoke (PS) frames as supervision and injects PS information via a masking strategy and regularization to avoid trivial solutions, along with a new real surgery video dataset. Experiments show SelfSVD removes smoke more effectively and efficiently while recovering more realistic details.
2403.11192|v2.assessment: 医学视频去烟雾与自动驾驶感知领域关联很弱，方法思路有参考价值但不在目标研究范围内。
2403.11192|v2.contribution: 提出基于术前清晰帧监督的自监督手术视频去烟雾方法 SelfSVD 及配套数据集。
2403.11192|v2.innovation: 利用 PS 帧作为自监督信号并结合掩码与正则化避免平凡解。
2403.11192|v2.result: 在自建真实手术视频数据集上更有效高效地去烟并恢复更真实细节。

Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出通过稳定化对抗训练提升域泛化的方法。该方法将对抗训练引入自监督深度估计流程，并针对对抗训练不稳定、易崩溃的问题设计稳定化策略，使模型学习到域不变的特征表示。相比已有自监督深度方法，该方案在未见目标域上显著降低了深度误差，提升了跨数据集泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited domain generalization of self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It introduces stabilized adversarial training into the self-supervised depth pipeline, with stabilization strategies to prevent adversarial collapse, enabling the model to learn domain-invariant representations. Compared with prior self-supervised depth methods, it substantially reduces depth error on unseen target domains and improves cross-dataset generalization.
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.assessment: 将对抗训练稳定化用于自监督深度估计的域泛化，对自动驾驶跨域部署有实际意义，方法设计有针对性。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.contribution: 提出稳定化对抗训练框架以提升自监督单目深度估计的域泛化能力。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.innovation: 针对对抗训练不稳定问题设计稳定化策略，学习域不变深度特征。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.result: 在未见目标域上显著降低深度误差，提升跨数据集泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-._arxiv_id: Improving Domain Generalization in Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation via Stabilized Adversarial Training.

Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_cn: 针对 3D 目标检测中类别不平衡导致稀有类别检测性能差的问题，提出通过低成本增强伪 LiDAR 点云来缓解类别不平衡。该方法以少量额外代价（标题中的 100 美元）对稀有类别目标进行点云级增强，生成更均衡的训练样本分布。相比传统重采样或损失加权方案，该点云增强方式直接扩充稀有类别的几何样本，提升了稀有类别的检测召回与精度。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_en: This paper targets the class-imbalance problem in 3D object detection, where rare categories suffer from poor detection performance. It proposes augmenting pseudo-LiDAR point clouds at low cost (the '$100 more' in the title) to generate more balanced training samples for rare classes. Compared with conventional re-sampling or loss re-weighting, this point-cloud augmentation directly enriches rare-class geometric samples, improving recall and accuracy for rare categories.
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.assessment: 以低成本点云增强解决 3D 检测类别不平衡，思路简洁实用，对长尾场景感知有参考价值。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.contribution: 提出低成本伪 LiDAR 点云增强方法缓解 3D 检测类别不平衡。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.innovation: 通过点云级增强直接扩充稀有类别几何样本而非仅调整采样或损失。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.result: 提升稀有类别检测召回与精度，缓解长尾分布问题。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li._arxiv_id: Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-LiDAR Point Cloud for Resolving Class-imbalance Problem.

2406.12849|v2.summary_cn: 针对 360 度全景图像深度估计中透视模型因投影与畸变不适用、而全景方法因缺乏标注数据性能受限的问题，提出 Depth Anywhere 框架。该方法利用最先进透视深度模型作为教师，通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并结合离线无效区域掩码生成与在线半监督联合训练，充分利用无标注 360 度数据。在 Matterport3D 和 Stanford2D3D 上显著提升深度估计精度，尤其在零样本场景下改进明显，且可增强任意 360 度单目深度估计器。
2406.12849|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 360-degree monocular depth estimation, where perspective models fail due to projection and distortion differences and 360 methods suffer from scarce labeled data. It proposes Depth Anywhere, which uses state-of-the-art perspective depth models as teachers to generate pseudo labels via six-face cube projection, combined with offline invalid-region masking and online semi-supervised joint training. It significantly improves depth accuracy on Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D, especially in zero-shot settings, and can enhance any 360 monocular depth estimator.
2406.12849|v2.assessment: 利用透视模型蒸馏与无标注数据增强 360 深度估计，对全景感知与自动驾驶环视场景有借鉴意义。
2406.12849|v2.contribution: 提出基于透视蒸馏与无标注数据增强的 360 度单目深度估计框架 Depth Anywhere。
2406.12849|v2.innovation: 通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签并结合半监督联合训练利用无标注 360 数据。
2406.12849|v2.result: 在 Matterport3D 与 Stanford2D3D 上显著提升精度，零样本场景改进尤为明显。

2405.07696|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中普遍存在的目标遮挡导致尺寸、深度和朝向预测退化的问题，提出受掩码自编码器启发的检测器 MonoMAE。该方法包含两个设计：深度感知掩码根据深度信息自适应地掩蔽非遮挡目标查询的部分区域以模拟遮挡查询，以及轻量级查询补全模块学习重建被掩蔽的目标查询。通过遮挡模拟与补全，MonoMAE 学习到更丰富的 3D 表示，在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得更优的单目 3D 检测性能。
2405.07696|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles pervasive object occlusion in monocular 3D detection, which degrades prediction of object dimensions, depths, and orientations. It proposes MonoMAE, a detector inspired by masked autoencoders that masks and reconstructs object queries in feature space, with depth-aware masking that adaptively masks non-occluded queries based on depth and a lightweight query completion module. By simulating and completing occlusions, MonoMAE learns enriched 3D representations and achieves superior monocular 3D detection performance for both occluded and non-occluded objects.
2405.07696|v2.assessment: 将 MAE 思想引入单目 3D 检测的特征空间遮挡建模，问题定位准确、设计新颖，对遮挡鲁棒性提升有直接价值。
2405.07696|v2.contribution: 提出基于深度感知掩码与查询补全的单目 3D 检测器 MonoMAE。
2405.07696|v2.innovation: 在特征空间对目标查询进行深度感知掩码与重建以模拟并克服遮挡。
2405.07696|v2.result: 在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得更优的单目 3D 检测性能。

MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中训练数据稀缺、目标放置不合理导致模型泛化差的问题，提出MonoPlace3D，通过学习3D感知的目标放置策略来增强训练数据。方法可能利用3D先验或可微渲染来生成物理合理的合成场景，从而提升单目检测器在真实数据上的表现。相比传统随机复制粘贴增强，该方法能保持3D几何一致性，但摘要缺失具体实验数据，无法量化改进幅度。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_en: MonoPlace3D addresses the problem of limited and unrealistic object placement in monocular 3D detection training data. It proposes a 3D-aware object placement strategy, likely leveraging geometric priors or differentiable rendering, to generate physically plausible synthetic scenes. Compared to naive copy-paste augmentation, it maintains 3D consistency, but the abstract lacks quantitative results to verify the improvement.
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.assessment: 该工作关注单目3D检测的数据增强与几何一致性，思路有潜力，但摘要信息不足，需看全文验证有效性。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.contribution: 提出一种3D感知的目标放置方法用于单目3D检测的数据增强。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.innovation: 将3D几何一致性引入目标放置策略，而非简单的2D复制粘贴。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待全文验证。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl._arxiv_id: MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Placement for 3D Monocular Detection.

2509.00649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D人体姿态估计在新相机配置下泛化差、遮挡场景建模困难的问题，提出MV-SSM框架。该方法在特征级和关键点级两个层次显式建模关节空间序列，并设计Projective State Space (PSS)块，将Mamba的传统扫描改为Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning (GTBS)。实验表明MV-SSM在泛化性上优于现有SOTA，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2509.00649|v2.summary_en: MV-SSM tackles poor generalization to new camera configurations and occlusion in multi-view 3D human pose estimation. It explicitly models joint spatial sequences at feature and keypoint levels, introducing a Projective State Space (PSS) block with Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning (GTBS) adapted from Mamba. Experiments show improved generalization over state-of-the-art, though specific numbers are omitted.
2509.00649|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入多视角姿态估计，对多相机感知有参考价值，但领域偏人体姿态，与自动驾驶直接相关度中等。
2509.00649|v2.contribution: 提出基于状态空间建模的多视角3D人体姿态估计框架MV-SSM。
2509.00649|v2.innovation: 设计PSS块和GTBS扫描机制，显式建模关节空间序列以提升泛化性。
2509.00649|v2.result: 在泛化性上超越现有SOTA，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2503.14483|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计精度不足限制多视角几何重建的问题，提出将SfM信息作为多视角先验融入深度估计过程。方法利用大视觉模型进行深度预测，并借助SfM提供的几何约束提升深度质量，使其可直接用于多视角重建。在公开真实数据集上，深度估计质量显著优于先前单目方法，且在室内、街景和航拍场景的重建质量超过SOTA MVS方法。
2503.14483|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited accuracy of monocular depth estimation for multi-view reconstruction by incorporating SfM information as a multi-view prior into the depth estimation process. It leverages large vision models and SfM geometric constraints to improve depth quality, enabling direct use in reconstruction. Experiments on real-world datasets show significant depth improvement and superior reconstruction quality over state-of-the-art MVS methods across indoor, street, and aerial scenes.
2503.14483|v2.assessment: 将SfM先验与单目深度结合提升重建质量，对自动驾驶中的场景重建有潜在价值，但非直接检测任务。
2503.14483|v2.contribution: 提出SfM引导的单目深度估计方法，用于高质量多视角几何重建。
2503.14483|v2.innovation: 将SfM多视角先验融入深度估计，解决单目深度模糊性问题。
2503.14483|v2.result: 深度估计质量显著提升，重建质量在多种场景下超越SOTA MVS方法。

2411.18613|v2.summary_cn: 针对从单目视频生成4D动态场景的难题，提出CAT4D方法。该方法训练了一个多视角视频扩散模型，结合新颖采样策略，将单目视频转化为多视角视频，并通过优化可变形3D高斯表示实现4D重建。在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并展示了从真实或生成视频创建4D场景的创意能力。
2411.18613|v2.summary_en: CAT4D tackles 4D dynamic scene creation from monocular video. It trains a multi-view video diffusion model with a novel sampling approach to transform a single video into multi-view videos, enabling 4D reconstruction via deformable 3D Gaussian optimization. It achieves competitive performance on novel view synthesis and dynamic reconstruction benchmarks, demonstrating creative 4D generation capabilities.
2411.18613|v2.assessment: 多视角视频扩散用于4D生成，技术前沿且效果展示丰富，对视频理解和场景重建有启发，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联较弱。
2411.18613|v2.contribution: 提出CAT4D，利用多视角视频扩散模型从单目视频创建4D动态场景。
2411.18613|v2.innovation: 结合多视角视频扩散与可变形3D高斯优化，实现单目视频到4D场景的生成。
2411.18613|v2.result: 在新视角合成和动态重建基准上达到有竞争力性能，并支持创意4D生成。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中逐点建模忽略局部平面结构的问题，提出GeoDepth，将点对点深度建模转变为平面对深度建模。方法可能通过几何感知的平面表示来提升深度估计的准确性和结构一致性。摘要缺失，无法获取具体改进数据和实验细节。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: GeoDepth addresses the limitation of point-to-point modeling in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by shifting to plane-to-depth modeling. It likely introduces geometric plane representations to improve depth accuracy and structural consistency. The abstract is missing, so specific improvements and experimental details are unavailable.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 从点建模转向平面建模的思路对深度估计有创新性，但摘要缺失导致无法评估实际效果，需看全文。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出平面对深度的自监督单目深度估计建模范式GeoDepth。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 将传统的点对点深度建模转变为平面对深度建模，引入几何平面先验。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 摘要缺失，效果待全文验证。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t._arxiv_id: GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-to-Depth Modeling for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件相机在资源受限机器人上实现在线自监督学习时计算效率不足的问题，提出改进对比度最大化流程的时间和内存效率，使低延迟单目深度估计的片上学习成为可能。方法在小型无人机上实现在线学习，相比仅预训练获得更准确的深度估计和更成功的避障行为。基准测试表明该流程不仅高效，且在自监督方法中达到SOTA深度估计性能。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the computational inefficiency of online self-supervised learning for event-based monocular depth on resource-constrained robots. It improves the time and memory efficiency of the contrast maximization pipeline, enabling on-device learning of low-latency depth. Online learning on a small drone yields more accurate depth and better obstacle avoidance than pre-training alone, achieving state-of-the-art depth estimation among self-supervised approaches.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 面向事件相机的片上自监督学习，对低功耗自动驾驶感知有参考价值，实验扎实且展示了实际机器人应用。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 提出高效对比度最大化流程，实现事件相机在无人机上的在线自监督单目深度估计。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 优化对比度最大化的时间和内存效率，使片上实时学习成为可能。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习比仅预训练深度更准、避障更成功，且达到自监督方法中的SOTA深度估计性能。

2412.03079|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频深度估计中跨帧不一致且无法恢复相机位姿的问题，提出Align3R方法。核心思路是利用DUSt3R模型对齐不同时间步的单目深度图，先以估计的单目深度为额外输入微调DUSt3R以适应动态场景，再通过优化同时重建深度图和相机位姿。相比依赖视频扩散模型的方法，无需昂贵的训练且能输出尺度一致的深度和相机位姿，在动态视频上取得优于基线的时序一致深度与位姿估计性能。
2412.03079|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally inconsistent monocular video depth estimation and the inability to recover camera poses. Align3R fine-tunes DUSt3R with estimated monocular depth as additional input for dynamic scenes, then jointly optimizes depth maps and camera poses. Unlike video-diffusion-based approaches, it avoids expensive training and produces scale-consistent depth with camera poses, outperforming baselines on dynamic videos.
2412.03079|v2.assessment: 将DUSt3R扩展到动态视频深度对齐的思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶中单目视频几何感知有参考价值。
2412.03079|v2.contribution: 提出Align3R，利用DUSt3R对齐不同时刻单目深度图，实现动态视频的时序一致深度与相机位姿联合估计。
2412.03079|v2.innovation: 以估计的单目深度作为额外输入微调DUSt3R，并通过优化联合重建深度与位姿，避免视频扩散模型的高训练成本。
2412.03079|v2.result: 在动态视频上实现优于基线的时序一致深度估计与相机位姿恢复。

2411.11361|v2.summary_cn: 论文探索自回归模型作为可扩展的单目深度估计器。提出DAR，将不同分辨率的深度图视为token集合，采用低到高分辨率的自回归目标与patch级因果掩码，并递归离散化深度范围实现由粗到细的序数回归目标。在KITTI和NYU Depth v2上刷新SOTA，模型可扩展至2.0B参数，在KITTI上取得1.799的RMSE，较Depth Anything的1.896提升约5%，并展现零样本泛化能力。
2411.11361|v2.summary_en: This paper presents DAR, an autoregressive monocular depth estimator that treats depth maps at different resolutions as tokens with a low-to-high resolution objective and patch-wise causal mask, plus recursive depth discretization for coarse-to-fine ordinal regression. It sets new SOTA on KITTI and NYU Depth v2, scaling to 2.0B parameters and achieving 1.799 RMSE on KITTI (5% improvement over Depth Anything's 1.896), with zero-shot generalization.
2411.11361|v2.assessment: 将自回归范式引入单目深度估计并验证其可扩展性，为深度基础模型提供了新方向。
2411.11361|v2.contribution: 提出自回归单目深度估计模型DAR，结合分辨率自回归与序数回归双重目标。
2411.11361|v2.innovation: 把深度图建模为多分辨率token序列并递归离散化深度区间，实现由粗到细的自回归预测。
2411.11361|v2.result: 在KITTI和NYU Depth v2上刷新SOTA，2.0B模型在KITTI取得1.799 RMSE，较Depth Anything提升约5%。

2503.16535|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中3D重建的固有不确定性以及现有模型忽视相机自身内参信息的问题，提出将相机模型及其物理特性嵌入深度学习模型，通过与道路环境的实时交互计算具身场景深度。方法仅依赖相机内参即可实时计算深度，并将RGB特征与具身深度结合，同时引入包含环境与深度信息的文本描述作为先验。通过融合图像与语言两种模糊模态的互补优势提升单目深度估计，具备实时性。
2503.16535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inherent uncertainty in monocular depth estimation and the neglect of camera intrinsic information. It embeds the camera model and physical characteristics into a deep network to compute embodied scene depth via real-time interaction with road environments, combining RGB features with embodied depth and text priors. The integration of image and language modalities improves monocular depth estimation in real time.
2503.16535|v2.assessment: 具身相机建模与文本先验结合的思路有新意，但摘要缺乏定量结果，方法有效性有待验证。
2503.16535|v2.contribution: 提出将相机物理模型具身化并结合文本先验的单目深度估计方法。
2503.16535|v2.innovation: 仅用相机内参实时计算具身场景深度，并融合图像与语言两种模态的互补信息。
2503.16535|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体定量指标，声称可实现实时具身场景深度估计。

Mono3DVLT: Monocular-Video-Based 3D Visu.summary_cn: 该论文题为Mono3DVLT，研究基于单目视频的3D视觉语言跟踪任务，但提供的摘要为空，无法获取其具体问题定义、方法设计、改进点与实验效果。仅从标题可推断其将3D视觉语言跟踪扩展到单目视频设定。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法对其方法质量与实验结果做出可靠评估。

However, the abstract is empty, so the problem formulation, methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. Only the title suggests an extension of 3D visual language tracking to the monocular video setting.
