2103.17115|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类细粒度特征易被忽略的问题，提出 DCNet，包含 Dense Relation Distillation 模块对支持特征与查询特征在所有空间位置进行密集匹配，以及 Context-aware Aggregation 模块自适应融合多尺度特征。相比已有少样本检测方法，该方法更充分地利用了标注新类样本的引导信息，能更好应对外观变化和遮挡。在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 少样本基准上取得了当时领先的检测精度。
2103.17115|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection where fine-grained features of novel objects are easily overlooked. It proposes DCNet with a Dense Relation Distillation module that densely matches support and query features across all spatial locations, and a Context-aware Aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-scale features. The method better exploits guidance from annotated novel samples and handles appearance changes and occlusions, achieving state-of-the-art results on PASCAL VOC and COCO few-shot benchmarks.
2103.17115|v2.assessment: 少样本检测的经典工作，密集关系蒸馏与上下文聚合的设计思路清晰，对数据稀缺场景下的检测研究有参考价值。
2103.17115|v2.contribution: 提出密集关系蒸馏与上下文感知聚合相结合的少样本检测框架 DCNet。
2103.17115|v2.innovation: 以全空间密集匹配方式充分利用支持特征，并自适应聚合多尺度上下文特征。
2103.17115|v2.result: 在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 少样本检测基准上取得领先性能。

2103.04612|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本检测中新类分类与表征之间的隐式矛盾（分类需要大类间间隔，表征需要小类内距离），提出 Class Margin Equilibrium (CME) 方法。CME 用全连接层解耦定位特征将检测转为分类问题，引入类间隔损失为新类预留间隔空间，并通过对抗扰动实现间隔均衡。在少样本检测基准上验证了该方法能同时优化特征空间划分与新类重建。
2103.04612|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies an implicit contradiction in few-shot detection between novel-class classification (requiring large inter-class margins) and representation (requiring small intra-class distances). It proposes Class Margin Equilibrium (CME), which decouples localization features via a fully connected layer, introduces a class margin loss to reserve margin space for novel classes, and achieves margin equilibrium through adversarial feature perturbation. Experiments on few-shot detection benchmarks validate the approach.
2103.04612|v2.assessment: 从间隔角度分析少样本检测的矛盾并提出均衡方案，视角新颖，对少样本学习理论分析有启发。
2103.04612|v2.contribution: 提出类间隔均衡方法 CME，系统性地同时优化特征空间划分与新类重建。
2103.04612|v2.innovation: 揭示并解决少样本检测中新类分类与表征之间的最大间隔-最小间隔矛盾。
2103.04612|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上验证了方法有效性。

2103.04224|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督域自适应目标检测中类别无关对齐导致的负迁移问题，提出 MeGA-CDA，将类别信息引入域适应过程。方法使用类别判别器实现类别感知的特征对齐，并通过记忆引导生成类别特定的注意力图，将特征路由到对应的类别判别器。在多个基准数据集上优于现有域自适应检测方法。
2103.04224|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles negative transfer in unsupervised domain adaptive object detection caused by category-agnostic alignment. It proposes MeGA-CDA, which employs category-wise discriminators for category-aware feature alignment and generates memory-guided category-specific attention maps to route features to the corresponding discriminators. The method outperforms existing approaches on several benchmark datasets.
2103.04224|v2.assessment: 类别感知域适应是自动驾驶感知跨域部署的关键问题，记忆引导注意力机制设计合理，实用性强。
2103.04224|v2.contribution: 提出记忆引导的类别感知注意力机制 MeGA-CDA 用于无监督域自适应目标检测。
2103.04224|v2.innovation: 利用记忆引导生成类别特定注意力图，实现类别感知的特征对齐，避免负迁移。
2103.04224|v2.result: 在多个域自适应检测基准上超越现有方法。

2011.10678|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测扩展类别需要成比例增加边界框标注的高成本问题，提出开放词汇目标检测这一新范式。方法利用有限类别的边界框标注和覆盖更广物体的图像-文本对进行训练，使检测器能检测和定位训练中无边界框标注的物体。相比零样本方法，在未标注类别上精度显著更高，同时有标注类别的检测精度几乎不受影响。
2011.10678|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of scaling object detectors to more categories, which requires proportionally more bounding box annotations. It formulates open-vocabulary object detection and trains detectors using bounding boxes for a limited set of categories plus image-caption pairs covering a much larger variety of objects. The method detects objects without bounding box annotations at significantly higher accuracy than zero-shot approaches while maintaining accuracy on annotated categories.
2011.10678|v2.assessment: 开放词汇检测的开创性工作，为利用弱监督信号扩展检测类别提供了新范式，对开放世界感知研究影响深远。
2011.10678|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇目标检测新范式及基于图像-文本对训练的检测方法。
2011.10678|v2.innovation: 利用图像-文本对以低成本扩展检测器可识别的类别，无需额外边界框标注。
2011.10678|v2.result: 在无边界框标注类别上精度显著优于零样本方法，有标注类别精度几乎不降。

2105.01294|v2.summary_cn: 针对极少样本（少于3个）场景下训练数据缺乏变化的问题，提出通过迁移基类的类内变化来构建新类的变化模型。方法引入 hallucinator 网络在 RoI 特征空间生成额外有用的训练样本，并集成到现代检测模型中。在两种不同候选框生成流程的少样本检测器上均取得显著提升，在 COCO 极端少样本基准上达到新 SOTA。
2105.01294|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of training data variation in extremely few-shot detection (fewer than three examples). It introduces a hallucinator network that transfers shared within-class variation from base classes to generate additional useful training examples in the RoI feature space, integrated into a modern detector. The approach improves two state-of-the-art few-shot detectors and achieves new state of the art in the extremely-few-shot regime on COCO.
2105.01294|v2.assessment: 从数据增强角度解决极少样本问题，hallucinator 在特征空间生成样本的思路简洁有效，实用价值较高。
2105.01294|v2.contribution: 提出基于幻觉器的特征空间样本生成方法以增强极少样本目标检测。
2105.01294|v2.innovation: 迁移基类的类内变化到新类，在 RoI 特征空间生成额外训练样本。
2105.01294|v2.result: 在 COCO 极端少样本基准上取得新 SOTA，并在两种检测器上均有显著提升。

2103.01903|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本检测中新类数据稀缺导致性能不稳定的问题，提出利用新类与基类之间恒定的语义关系进行显式关系推理。方法用大规模文本语料学习语义嵌入表示每个类概念，训练检测器将物体图像表征投影到该嵌入空间，并用动态关系图增强嵌入。所提 SRR-FSD 检测器对样本数量变化鲁棒稳定，在低显式和隐式样本下性能显著更优。
2103.01903|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of few-shot detection caused by data scarcity of novel classes, leveraging the constant semantic relation between novel and base classes. It represents each class concept by a semantic embedding learned from a large text corpus, trains the detector to project object image representations into this space, and augments embeddings with a dynamic relation graph. The resulting SRR-FSD detector is robust to shot variation and significantly better under low explicit and implicit shots.
2103.01903|v2.assessment: 将语义关系推理引入少样本检测，shot-stable 特性对实际长尾场景部署有重要意义。
2103.01903|v2.contribution: 提出语义关系推理少样本检测器 SRR-FSD，利用文本语义嵌入与动态关系图。
2103.01903|v2.innovation: 显式建模新类与基类间恒定语义关系，提升检测器对样本数量变化的稳定性。
2103.01903|v2.result: 在高样本下具竞争力，在低显式和隐式样本下性能显著更优。

2111.11656|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类特征空间分散、类间可分性差的问题，本文提出两阶段微调框架 FADI。该方法首先通过关联步骤让每个新类显式模仿一个特定基类的特征空间以构建紧凑的新类特征空间，再通过判别步骤增强类间可分性。相比传统整体微调范式隐式利用多个基类知识导致特征分散，FADI 显式建立新类与基类的对应关系。在 PASCAL VOC 和 MS COCO 等基准上，FADI 在少样本设定下取得了显著优于现有方法的检测精度。
2111.11656|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scattered feature space and poor inter-class separability in few-shot object detection caused by the holistic fine-tuning paradigm. It proposes FADI, a two-step fine-tuning framework that first associates each novel class with a specific base class to build a compact feature space, and then discriminates novel classes to enhance separability. Compared with prior methods that implicitly leverage multiple base classes, FADI explicitly constructs discriminative novel-class features and achieves superior performance on PASCAL VOC and MS COCO benchmarks.
2111.11656|v2.assessment: 该工作对少样本检测中的特征空间构建问题给出了清晰的两阶段解决方案，实验充分，对少样本/开放世界检测方向有参考价值。
2111.11656|v2.contribution: 提出两阶段微调框架 FADI，通过关联与判别步骤为新类构建紧凑且可分的特征空间。
2111.11656|v2.innovation: 显式让新类模仿特定基类特征空间，而非隐式利用多个基类知识，从而避免特征分散。
2111.11656|v2.result: 在 PASCAL VOC 和 MS COCO 少样本检测基准上取得优于现有方法的精度。

2110.14191|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测依赖大规模全标注数据的问题，本文研究混合监督目标检测，即利用基类的全标注和弱标注来学习新类。现有方法主要迁移类无关的目标性，本文将掩码先验和语义相似性从基类迁移到新类：掩码先验用于帮助检测目标，语义相似性用于对伪全标注去噪。在三个基准数据集上，该方法优于现有混合监督方法。
2110.14191|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles mixed supervised object detection, where novel categories are learned from weak annotations with the help of fully annotated base categories. It transfers mask prior and semantic similarity from base to novel categories, using mask prior to aid detection and semantic similarity to denoise pseudo full annotations. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate effectiveness over existing methods.
2110.14191|v2.assessment: 该工作通过迁移掩码先验和语义相似性提升了弱监督检测的伪标注质量，思路合理，但创新幅度相对有限。
2110.14191|v2.contribution: 提出迁移掩码先验与语义相似性的混合监督目标检测方法。
2110.14191|v2.innovation: 将基类学到的掩码先验和语义相似性迁移到新类，用于检测辅助和伪标注去噪。
2110.14191|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上优于现有混合监督方法。

2203.14911|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中未知类别目标常被误分为已知类的问题，本文基于未知目标通常分布在隐空间低密度区域的假设，提出OpenDet检测器。方法包含对比特征学习器（CFL）和未知概率学习器（UPL）：CFL通过实例级对比学习使已知类特征更紧凑，从而为未知类留出更多低密度区域；UPL基于预测不确定性优化未知概率，进一步在已知类簇周围划分低密度区域。相比传统阈值方法仅能维持有限低密度区域，OpenDet显著扩展了低密度区域覆盖范围，从而更易识别未知目标。
2203.14911|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set object detection (OSOD), where unknown-category objects are often misclassified as known classes. It proposes OpenDet, which separates high/low-density regions in latent space based on the consensus that unknown objects reside in low-density regions. OpenDet equips two learners: Contrastive Feature Learner (CFL) for compact known-class features and Unknown Probability Learner (UPL) for uncertainty-based unknown probability optimization. Compared to threshold-based methods with limited low-density regions, OpenDet expands these regions to better identify unknown objects.
2203.14911|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放集检测提供了新视角，通过显式扩展低密度区域提升未知目标召回，对自动驾驶中处理未知障碍物有直接参考价值。
2203.14911|v2.contribution: 提出OpenDet，通过对比学习和不确定性学习扩展隐空间低密度区域以识别未知目标。
2203.14911|v2.innovation: 利用实例级对比学习压缩已知类特征，并结合不确定性优化未知概率，主动扩展低密度区域。
2203.14911|v2.result: 在开放集检测基准上有效提升了未知类别的检测性能，缓解了未知目标误分为已知类的问题。

2112.02413|v2.summary_cn: 本文探索2D图像-文本预训练的CLIP模型能否泛化到3D点云识别，提出PointCLIP。方法将点云投影为多视角深度图，无需渲染，利用CLIP编码并与3D类别文本对齐，聚合多视角零样本预测实现2D到3D的知识迁移。此外设计跨视角适配器以提取全局特征并自适应融合少样本3D知识，仅微调轻量适配器即可大幅提升性能。实验还发现PointCLIP与经典3D监督网络具有互补性，简单集成即可提升基线性能。
2112.02413|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether CLIP, pre-trained on large-scale 2D image-text pairs, can generalize to 3D recognition, and proposes PointCLIP. It projects point clouds into multi-view depth maps without rendering, aligns CLIP-encoded features with 3D category texts, and aggregates view-wise zero-shot predictions for 2D-to-3D knowledge transfer. An inter-view adapter is designed to fuse few-shot 3D knowledge, and fine-tuning only the lightweight adapter largely improves performance. PointCLIP also shows complementarity with classical 3D-supervised networks.
2112.02413|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将CLIP成功迁移至3D点云理解，为多模态3D感知提供了零样本/少样本新范式，对自动驾驶中3D检测的开放词汇识别有启发。
2112.02413|v2.contribution: 提出PointCLIP，通过多视角深度图投影和跨视角适配器实现CLIP在3D点云上的零样本与少样本识别。
2112.02413|v2.innovation: 无需渲染的点云多视角投影与CLIP对齐，以及轻量跨视角适配器实现2D到3D知识迁移。
2112.02413|v2.result: 在少样本设置下仅微调适配器即可大幅提升性能，且与3D监督网络集成能提升基线表现。

2205.13384|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉搜索中画廊集增量增长导致模型需反复更新且需重新提取全部特征的问题，本文提出一种持续学习方法，实现向后兼容的特征嵌入。方法通过跨会话数据一致性、邻会话模型一致性和会话内判别性损失训练持续学习器，避免新模型对旧画廊集重新提取特征。此外，该方法还处理了不假设所有类别已知且允许新会话中出现新类别的模糊边界场景。实验表明该方法在多个基准上有效。
2205.13384|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term visual search where the gallery set grows incrementally, requiring model updates and costly feature re-extraction. It introduces a continual learning approach with backward-consistent feature embedding, enforced by inter-session data coherence, neighbor-session model coherence, and intra-session discrimination losses. The method also handles novel classes appearing in new sessions without assuming all categories known. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2205.13384|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了持续学习在视觉搜索中的实际部署问题，向后兼容特征嵌入对自动驾驶长期感知系统有参考意义。
2205.13384|v2.contribution: 提出首个同时处理向后兼容特征嵌入和允许新类别出现的持续学习视觉搜索方法。
2205.13384|v2.innovation: 通过跨会话数据一致性、邻会话模型一致性和会话内判别性损失实现向后兼容嵌入。
2205.13384|v2.result: 在多个基准上验证了方法在增量画廊集场景下的有效性，避免了全量特征重提取。

2203.06953|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中新类样本不足且需不遗忘旧类的问题，本文提出前瞻性学习方法FACT。与现有回顾性方法使更新模型接近旧模型不同，FACT通过为未来新类预留嵌入空间实现前向兼容：分配虚拟原型压缩已知类嵌入，并为新类预留空间，同时预测可能的新类并准备更新过程。虚拟原型作为嵌入空间中的代理，在推理时构建更强分类器。实验表明FACT能高效整合新类。
2203.06953|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where new classes arrive with few samples and old ones must not be forgotten. Unlike retrospective methods that keep the updated model close to the old one, it proposes ForwArd Compatible Training (FACT), which learns prospectively by reserving embedding space for future classes. Virtual prototypes squeeze known-class embeddings and reserve space for new ones, while possible new classes are forecasted. Experiments show FACT efficiently incorporates new classes.
2203.06953|v2.assessment: 该工作提出前向兼容训练范式，为FSCIL提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中持续学习新类别目标有借鉴价值。
2203.06953|v2.contribution: 提出FACT，通过虚拟原型预留嵌入空间实现前向兼容的少样本类增量学习。
2203.06953|v2.innovation: 前瞻性学习范式，利用虚拟原型压缩已知类并为未来新类预留嵌入空间。
2203.06953|v2.result: 在FSCIL基准上有效整合新类，同时保持对旧类的识别能力。

2203.14843|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中照片数据难以获取（伦理隐私限制）及模态单一的问题，提出使用草图作为新模态进行类支持。方法构建了DIY FSCIL框架，用户可自由绘制新类的少量草图供模型学习识别该类照片。框架融合梯度共识实现域不变学习、知识蒸馏保留旧类信息、图注意力网络进行新旧类间消息传递。实验表明在类支持场景下草图优于文本。
2203.14843|v2.summary_en: This paper pushes the boundary of few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by addressing whether models can learn from modalities other than photos and what if photos are inaccessible due to privacy. It advocates sketches as a new modality for class support and proposes the 'Doodle It Yourself' (DIY) FSCIL framework, where users sketch a few examples of a novel class. The framework integrates gradient consensus for domain-invariant learning, knowledge distillation for preserving old classes, and graph attention networks for message passing. Experiments show sketches outperform text as class support.
2203.14843|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了草图模态在FSCIL中的应用，为隐私受限场景下的增量学习提供了新思路，但领域相关性一般。
2203.14843|v2.contribution: 提出DIY FSCIL框架，利用用户草图作为新模态支持少样本类增量学习。
2203.14843|v2.innovation: 将草图引入FSCIL，结合梯度共识、知识蒸馏和图注意力网络实现跨模态增量学习。
2203.14843|v2.result: 实验表明草图作为类支持优于文本，在隐私受限场景下实现了有效的新类学习。

2203.16588|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对持续学习新类时需满足内存和计算约束（每类仅少量样本、学习新类计算成本恒定、模型内存随类别数线性增长）的问题，提出C-FSCIL。其架构由冻结的元学习特征提取器、可训练固定尺寸全连接层和可重写动态增长记忆组成，记忆存储与已遇类别数相同的向量。C-FSCIL提供三种更新模式，在准确率与计算内存成本间权衡。方法利用超维嵌入，使可表达的类别数远超向量空间固定维度且干扰极小，并通过准正交对齐提升类向量表示质量。
2203.16588|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning under memory and computational constraints: few samples per class, constant computational cost for learning a novel class, and at most linear memory growth with the number of classes. It proposes C-FSCIL, composed of a frozen meta-learned feature extractor, a trainable fixed-size fully connected layer, and a rewritable dynamically growing memory storing one vector per encountered class. C-FSCIL offers three update modes trading off accuracy and compute-memory cost, and exploits hyperdimensional embedding with quasi-orthogonal alignment for minimal interference.
2203.16588|v2.assessment: 该工作在严格约束下实现了高效的类增量学习，超维嵌入和固定尺寸分类器的设计对资源受限的自动驾驶持续感知有参考价值。
2203.16588|v2.contribution: 提出C-FSCIL，在内存和计算约束下实现少样本类增量学习。
2203.16588|v2.innovation: 结合冻结元学习特征提取器、固定尺寸全连接层和动态增长记忆，利用超维嵌入实现准正交类表示。
2203.16588|v2.result: 在满足恒定计算成本和线性内存增长的约束下，实现了有效的类增量学习，并提供三种更新模式权衡准确率与成本。

2204.00895|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘问题，在旧任务样本存储受限的条件下提出基于知识蒸馏的自适应特征巩固方法。该方法估计表征变化与模型更新导致的损失增量之间的关系，并利用骨干网络中每个特征图的重要性最小化损失增量的上界，从而限制重要特征的更新以保持鲁棒性、允许次要特征变化以维持灵活性。相比已有类增量学习方法，该策略在有限旧数据访问下更有效地缓解遗忘。在标准数据集上取得了显著的准确率提升。
2204.00895|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning under limited memory for storing previous-task examples. It proposes a knowledge-distillation-based method that estimates the relationship between representation changes and loss increases, and minimizes an upper bound of the loss increase using per-feature-map importance within the backbone. By restricting updates of important features while allowing flexibility in less critical ones, it effectively alleviates forgetting and achieves significant accuracy improvements over existing methods on standard datasets.
2204.00895|v2.assessment: 将特征重要性估计与知识蒸馏结合来约束增量更新，思路清晰且实用，对持续学习与检测器增量训练有参考价值。
2204.00895|v2.contribution: 提出基于特征图重要性的自适应特征巩固知识蒸馏框架，在有限旧数据下缓解类增量学习的灾难性遗忘。
2204.00895|v2.innovation: 通过估计表征变化与损失增量的关系并最小化其上界，实现按特征重要性的差异化更新约束。
2204.00895|v2.result: 在标准类增量学习数据集上准确率显著优于现有方法。

2204.03634|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有类增量学习多从少量基类起步、与实际大规模预训练场景不符的问题，探索以在大规模基类上强预训练模型为起点的类增量学习设定。提出两阶段训练方案：先克隆部分骨干并在新类数据上微调进行特征增强，再将基类与新类分类器融合为统一分类器。在ImageNet上整体准确率比最优CIL方法高出约10%，并在基类-新类重叠及分布偏移等实际场景下保持稳健。
2204.03634|v2.summary_en: This paper studies class-incremental learning starting from a strong model pre-trained on many base classes, hypothesizing that a strong base model provides good representations for novel classes with small adaptations. It proposes a two-stage scheme of feature augmentation (cloning part of the backbone and fine-tuning on novel data) and fusion (merging base and novel classifiers). It outperforms state-of-the-art CIL methods by about 10% overall accuracy on ImageNet and remains robust under base-novel overlap and distribution shift.
2204.03634|v2.assessment: 重新定义了更贴近现实的强预训练CIL设定，方法简单有效，对预训练模型时代的增量学习研究有启发。
2204.03634|v2.contribution: 提出面向强预训练模型的类增量学习两阶段框架，并系统分析基类-新类重叠与分布偏移等实际场景。
2204.03634|v2.innovation: 以特征增强加分类器融合的方式，在强基类预训练下用少量适配实现新类增量学习。
2204.03634|v2.result: 在ImageNet上整体准确率较最优CIL方法提升约10%，并在多种实际CIL设定下保持稳健。

2203.10593|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中一阶段检测器因缺少类别无关候选框而难以对未见类进行知识蒸馏、性能严重下降的问题，提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏方法HierKD。该方法引入全局级知识蒸馏，将预训练视觉-语言模型中未见类别的知识迁移到检测器，并与常见的实例级蒸馏结合，同时学习已见与未见类别。在MS-COCO上，零样本检测和广义零样本检测分别比此前最优一阶段检测器提升11.9%和6.7% AP50。
2203.10593|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary one-stage detection, where the lack of class-agnostic proposals hinders instance-level visual-to-visual distillation for unseen objects. It proposes HierKD, a hierarchical visual-language knowledge distillation method that adds global-level distillation from a pre-trained vision-language model and combines it with instance-level distillation to learn seen and unseen categories jointly. On MS-COCO it surpasses the previous best one-stage detector by 11.9% and 6.7% AP50 under zero-shot and generalized zero-shot detection.
2203.10593|v2.assessment: 把全局级蒸馏引入一阶段开放词汇检测，有效弥补无候选框的短板，对开放集/开放词汇检测研究有直接参考价值。
2203.10593|v2.contribution: 提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏HierKD，使一阶段检测器在无类别无关候选框条件下也能学习未见类知识。
2203.10593|v2.innovation: 将全局级知识蒸馏与实例级蒸馏结合，同时建模已见与未见类别的视觉-语言对齐。
2203.10593|v2.result: 在MS-COCO零样本与广义零样本检测上分别取得11.9%和6.7% AP50提升。

2208.13722|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测（SSOD）默认未标注数据不含分布外类别的非现实假设，提出开放集半监督目标检测（OSSOD）这一更实际的问题。作者发现现有SSOD方法在开放集条件下增益下降，原因是语义扩张——干扰性的OOD目标被误判为分布内伪标签参与半监督训练。为此将在线与离线OOD检测模块与SSOD方法集成，并发现基于自监督视觉Transformer的离线OOD检测器因对伪标签干扰更鲁棒而优于在线方案。该框架有效缓解语义扩张问题，在多个OSSOD设定下取得一致提升。
2208.13722|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and formalizes Open-Set Semi-Supervised Object Detection (OSSOD), where unlabeled data contain out-of-distribution classes, and shows that existing SSOD methods suffer from semantic expansion, i.e., OOD objects being mispredicted as in-distribution pseudo-labels. It integrates online and offline OOD detection modules with SSOD, finding that an offline OOD detector based on a self-supervised vision transformer is more robust to pseudo-label interference than online detectors. The framework effectively mitigates semantic expansion and yields consistent improvements across OSSOD settings.
2208.13722|v2.assessment: 问题定义贴近真实数据条件，对OOD检测器与SSOD结合的实证分析扎实，对开放集检测与半监督训练均有参考意义。
2208.13722|v2.contribution: 提出开放集半监督目标检测问题并给出结合OOD检测的解决方案，揭示语义扩张是性能下降的主因。
2208.13722|v2.innovation: 系统比较在线与离线OOD检测器在SSOD中的作用，证明自监督ViT离线检测器对伪标签干扰更鲁棒。
2208.13722|v2.result: 有效缓解语义扩张问题，在多个OSSOD设定下取得一致性能提升。

2207.12049|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中基类过拟合与样本级过拟合问题，提出基于视觉词袋（BoVW）表示的知识蒸馏框架。方法先设计位置感知BoVW模型从有限图像集中学习代表性视觉词，再在独立于检测器预学习的特征空间中编码图像，利用同一图像在两个特征空间中BoVW表示一致性作为蒸馏知识指导检测器学习。相比仅依赖微调的少样本检测方法，该框架在预训练和微调两阶段均抑制过拟合。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在基类和新类上均缓解了过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles class-specific overfitting on base classes and sample-specific overfitting on novel classes in few-shot object detection. It proposes a knowledge distillation framework built on a Position-Aware Bag-of-Visual-Words model that learns representative visual words from limited images and encodes images in a feature space pre-learned independently of detection. Consistency of BoVW representations across two feature spaces serves as distilled knowledge to regularize detector learning in both pre-training and fine-tuning stages.
2207.12049|v2.assessment: 将BoVW表示与知识蒸馏结合来约束少样本检测器是一个较新颖的角度，但摘要未提供量化结果，实际增益需看正文实验。
2207.12049|v2.contribution: 提出基于位置感知视觉词袋表示的知识蒸馏框架，用于抑制少样本目标检测中的基类与样本级过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.innovation: 利用同一图像在两个独立特征空间中BoVW表示的一致性作为蒸馏信号来指导检测器学习。
2207.12049|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体指标，仅声称在基类和新类上均有效缓解过拟合。

2207.11455|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）只能检测未知实例而无法区分多个未知类别的问题，提出未知类别分类的开放世界目标检测新问题UC-OWOD。方法采用两阶段检测器：先用未知标签感知候选框和未知判别分类头检测已知与未知目标，再用基于相似度的未知分类和未知聚类精炼模块区分多个未知类。同时设计两种新评测协议评估未知类检测，实验与可视化验证了有效性，代码已开源。
2207.11455|v2.summary_en: This work introduces Unknown-Classified Open World Object Detection (UC-OWOD), which extends OWOD by requiring unknown instances to be classified into distinct unknown classes. A two-stage detector is devised with unknown label-aware proposals and an unknown-discriminative classification head for detecting known/unknown objects, followed by similarity-based unknown classification and unknown clustering refinement. Two new evaluation protocols are designed, and extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2207.11455|v2.assessment: 将开放世界检测从二值未知检测推进到未知类细分，问题定义和评测协议对开放集检测方向有参考价值。
2207.11455|v2.contribution: 提出UC-OWOD问题定义、两阶段检测方法及两种未知类检测评测协议。
2207.11455|v2.innovation: 通过相似度分类与聚类精炼模块实现对多个未知类别的区分，而非仅检测未知目标。
2207.11455|v2.result: 大量实验与可视化证明方法有效，代码开源，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2207.11184|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测微调范式中基类到新类的类无关知识隐式迁移不可靠的问题，提出显式学习基类与新类之间的三类类无关共性：识别相关语义共性、定位相关语义共性和分布共性。设计基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，可联合高效地蒸馏这三类共性。实验表明该方法可方便地集成到多数现有微调方法中并持续大幅提升性能。
2207.11184|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that fine-tuning-based few-shot object detection implicitly assumes transferable class-agnostic knowledge from base to novel classes, which is unreliable without explicit modeling. It explicitly learns three types of base-novel commonalities—recognition-related semantic, localization-related semantic, and distribution commonalities—and distills them jointly via a memory-bank-based unified framework. Extensive experiments show consistent and large improvements when integrated into existing fine-tuning methods.
2207.11184|v2.assessment: 对基类-新类共性做了较系统的显式建模，记忆库蒸馏框架通用性强，适合作为少样本检测的即插即用模块。
2207.11184|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模并联合蒸馏三类基类-新类类无关共性的统一框架。
2207.11184|v2.innovation: 用记忆库统一蒸馏识别语义、定位语义与分布三类共性，可即插即用集成到现有微调方法。
2207.11184|v2.result: 可集成到多数现有微调方法并持续大幅提升性能，摘要未给出具体数值。

2205.15225|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标上的少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）问题，指出除灾难性遗忘和少样本过拟合外，3D场景还存在基类含大量合成实例而增量步仅有少量真实扫描样本的合成到真实数据差异挑战。方法使用Microshapes（正交基向量）以预定义规则描述任意3D物体，支持少样本增量训练并最小化合成到真实的数据差异。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2205.15225|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) for 3D point cloud objects, highlighting an additional challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting and few-shot overfitting: base classes may contain many synthetic instances while incremental novel classes have only a few real-scanned samples. It employs Microshapes (orthogonal basis vectors) to describe arbitrary 3D objects via a predefined rule set, enabling few-shot incremental training while minimizing synthetic-to-real variation.
2205.15225|v2.assessment: 将FSCIL扩展到3D点云并关注合成到真实的域差异，问题设定有新意，但与自动驾驶多相机/BEV主线相关度有限。
2205.15225|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究3D点云目标上的少样本类增量学习并提出基于Microshapes的解决方案。
2205.15225|v2.innovation: 用正交基向量Microshapes统一描述3D物体以缓解合成到真实的数据差异。
2205.15225|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体指标，仅声称支持少样本增量训练并减小合成-真实差异。

PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.summary_en: PromptDet targets open-vocabulary object detection using uncurated images. 2208.08165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（SGG）中所有物体类别必须在训练集中出现的封闭设定限制实际应用的问题，提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）这一新设定：模型在基础物体类别上训练，但需对未见过的目标物体类别推断关系。方法上采用两步策略，先在大规模粗粒度区域-描述数据上预训练，再用两种基于prompt的技术在不更新预训练模型参数的情况下微调，并支持对完全未见类别的推理。在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，该方法在Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著优于近期强SGG方法。
2208.08165|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary scene graph generation (Ov-SGG), a novel setting where models trained on base object classes must infer relations for unseen target classes. The authors propose a two-step approach that first pre-trains on large-scale coarse-grained region-caption data and then applies two prompt-based finetuning techniques without updating the pre-trained model's parameters, enabling inference over completely unseen classes. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome, GQA, and Open-Image show significant improvements over strong SGG baselines in both Ov-SGG and conventional closed SGG settings.
2208.08165|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇设定引入场景图生成，prompt-based参数高效微调思路有一定新意，但任务本身与自动驾驶感知的核心需求（如3D检测、BEV、Occupancy）关联较弱，主要价值在于开放集关系理解的方法论参考。
2208.08165|v2.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇场景图生成设定，并给出基于prompt微调的可行方案。
2208.08165|v2.innovation: 利用区域-描述预训练加两种prompt微调技术，在不更新模型参数的情况下支持对未见物体类别的关系推理。
2208.08165|v2.result: 在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image上，Ov-SGG设定及封闭SGG设定下均显著超越现有强基线方法。

2308.11093|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频中开放世界目标定位任务，现有开放词汇检测模型（如OWL-ViT）仅适用于单帧图像，直接逐帧检测加跟踪会导致时序不一致且任务特定视频数据稀缺。作者提出Video OWL-ViT，在预训练OWL-ViT基础上增加一个transformer解码器，通过将前一帧的输出token作为下一帧的对象查询，递归地传播对象表示，实现端到端视频训练。相比tracking-by-detection基线，该方法在保持开放世界能力的同时显著提升了时序一致性，在TAO-OW基准上验证了从大规模图像-文本预训练中迁移开放世界能力的有效性。
2308.11093|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally-consistent open-world object localization in video, where existing open-vocabulary image detectors like OWL-ViT lack temporal consistency when applied per-frame. The authors propose Video OWL-ViT, which augments the pretrained OWL-ViT with a transformer decoder that recurrently propagates object representations by using output tokens from one frame as object queries for the next, enabling end-to-end training on video data. The model achieves improved temporal consistency over tracking-by-detection baselines while retaining open-world capabilities, as demonstrated on the TAO-OW benchmark.
2308.11093|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测从图像扩展到视频是一个自然且重要的方向，该方法设计简洁有效，利用递归查询传播实现时序一致性，对自动驾驶中的开放世界视频感知有参考价值。
2308.11093|v2.contribution: 提出了Video OWL-ViT架构，通过递归transformer解码器将预训练开放词汇图像检测器适配到视频中的时序一致定位。
2308.11093|v2.innovation: 利用前一帧输出token作为下一帧对象查询的递归传播机制，实现端到端视频开放世界检测且无需任务特定视频标注。
2308.11093|v2.result: 在TAO-OW基准上相比tracking-by-detection基线提升了时序一致性，同时保持了开放世界检测能力。

2304.12161|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本目标检测问题，即仅用少量训练实例建模新类别。现有方法分为基于微调和基于元学习两类，前者虽简单但通常具有竞争力。作者聚焦于微调过程中的损失函数和数据增强，提出通过元学习原理来调节其动态特性，从而学习可提升少样本检测的归纳偏置。该方法在保持微调方法优势的同时，产生了可解释的损失函数，避免了高度参数化的复杂元模型，实验结果表明其有效性。
2304.12161|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot object detection, where novel categories must be modeled with few training instances. Observing that fine-tuning-based approaches remain competitive, the authors propose to meta-tune the loss functions and data augmentation dynamics to learn inductive biases that boost few-shot detection while retaining the simplicity of fine-tuning. The approach yields interpretable loss functions and avoids complex parametric meta-models, with experimental results validating its effectiveness.
2304.12161|v2.assessment: 从损失函数和增强策略的元学习角度切入少样本检测，思路新颖且可解释性强，但整体性能提升幅度和与最新方法的对比需进一步验证。
2304.12161|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于元学习原理调节损失函数和数据增强动态特性的少样本目标检测训练方案。
2304.12161|v2.innovation: 将元学习应用于微调过程中的损失函数和增强策略，学习可解释的归纳偏置而非复杂元模型。
2304.12161|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，同时保持了微调方法的简洁性和可解释性。

Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中视觉Transformer的预训练问题，现有方法通常直接使用图像级预训练模型，缺乏对区域级语义的理解。作者提出区域感知预训练方法，通过对比学习在区域级别对齐视觉特征与文本嵌入，使ViT骨干网络能够更好地支持开放词汇检测。该方法在多个开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著提升，证明了区域级预训练对开放词汇检测的重要性。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses the pretraining of Vision Transformers for open-vocabulary object detection, where existing methods typically rely on image-level pretrained models lacking region-level semantic understanding. The authors propose a region-aware pretraining approach that aligns visual features with text embeddings at the region level via contrastive learning, enabling the ViT backbone to better support open-vocabulary detection. The method achieves significant improvements on multiple open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.assessment: 区域级预训练是开放词汇检测的关键瓶颈之一，该工作系统性地解决了这一问题，对基于ViT的开放世界感知有重要参考价值。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出了面向开放词汇目标检测的区域感知预训练方法，在区域级别对齐视觉-语言表示。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.innovation: 将对比学习从图像级扩展到区域级，使ViT骨干网络获得细粒度的区域语义理解能力。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.result: 在多个开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著性能提升。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers.

Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇点云目标检测问题，现有3D检测方法依赖大量3D标注且只能检测固定类别。作者提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云检测方法，利用预训练的2D视觉-语言模型和点云-图像对齐来迁移知识，实现对新类别的3D检测。该方法在无需任何3D标注的情况下，在多个基准上取得了有竞争力的开放词汇3D检测性能，为自动驾驶中的开放世界3D感知提供了新思路。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary point-cloud object detection, where existing 3D detectors require extensive 3D annotations and are limited to fixed categories. The authors propose a method that transfers knowledge from pretrained 2D vision-language models via point-cloud-image alignment to detect novel 3D categories without any 3D annotation. The approach achieves competitive open-vocabulary 3D detection performance on multiple benchmarks, offering a new paradigm for open-world 3D perception in autonomous driving.
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.assessment: 无需3D标注的开放词汇点云检测是自动驾驶感知的前沿方向，该工作利用2D-3D知识迁移绕过了3D标注瓶颈，具有很高的实用价值。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.contribution: 提出了无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测方法，通过2D视觉-语言模型实现3D开放世界感知。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.innovation: 利用点云-图像对齐从预训练2D视觉-语言模型迁移知识到3D检测，完全避免了对3D标注的依赖。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.result: 在多个基准上实现了有竞争力的开放词汇3D检测性能，且无需任何3D标注。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detection without 3D Annotation.

2303.09674|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对广义少样本目标检测问题，即同时在标注充足的基类和标注有限的新类上实现精确检测。作者指出已有方法在提升新类泛化时牺牲基类性能，或保持基类精度但新类适应有限，根本原因在于缺乏对所有类别的充分判别性特征学习。为此提出DiGeo训练框架，通过离线单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）分类器引导类间分离，并引入自适应类特定边界增强类内紧凑性。在VOC、COCO和LVIS数据集上，单一模型即可有效提升新类泛化而不损害基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses generalized few-shot object detection, aiming for precise detection on both base classes with abundant annotations and novel classes with limited data. The authors identify insufficient discriminative feature learning as the root cause of existing methods' trade-offs, and propose DiGeo, a training framework that learns geometry-aware features with inter-class separation via an offline simplex equiangular tight frame (ETF) classifier and intra-class compactness via adaptive class-specific margins. Experiments on VOC, COCO, and LVIS show that a single model improves novel-class generalization without hurting base-class performance.
2303.09674|v2.assessment: 从特征几何角度分析少样本检测的基类-新类权衡问题，ETF分类器和自适应边界的组合设计有理论依据，但方法整体创新性中等。
2303.09674|v2.contribution: 提出了DiGeo训练框架，通过几何感知的特征学习同时提升基类和新类的少样本检测性能。
2303.09674|v2.innovation: 利用离线单纯形ETF分类器作为类中心引导类间分离，结合自适应类特定边界增强类内紧凑性。
2303.09674|v2.result: 在VOC、COCO和LVIS上，单一模型有效提升了新类泛化且未损害基类检测性能。

2212.12130|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中的框回归和掩码分割泛化问题，现有方法主要关注分类的知识迁移，而框和掩码预测仍采用类无关方式，限制了新类别的定位精度。作者提出CondHead，一种基于语义嵌入条件化参数化的动态网络头设计，包含动态聚合头和动态生成头两个流：前者由一组静态头条件聚合而成，作为专家学习复杂预测；后者动态生成参数编码通用类特定信息。通过条件设计，检测模型由语义嵌入桥接，能更好地检测新类别。
2212.12130|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the generalization of box regression and mask segmentation in open-vocabulary object detection, where prior works focus on classification transfer but employ class-agnostic box and mask prediction. The authors propose CondHead, a dynamic network head design that conditionally parameterizes heads on semantic embeddings, comprising a dynamically aggregated head (experts) and a dynamically generated head (general class-specific information). This conditional design bridges the detection model with semantic embeddings to better detect novel categories.
2212.12130|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测的改进从分类扩展到框回归和掩码分割是一个被忽视但重要的方向，CondHead的条件参数化设计思路清晰，对开放世界实例分割有参考价值。
2212.12130|v2.contribution: 提出了CondHead动态网络头设计，通过语义嵌入条件化参数化提升开放词汇检测中框回归和掩码分割的泛化能力。
2212.12130|v2.innovation: 将动态聚合头和动态生成头结合，以语义嵌入为条件桥接检测模型，实现类特定知识的定位预测。
2212.12130|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测任务上通过条件化网络头设计提升了新类别的框回归和掩码分割性能。

2302.13996|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器仅将单个区域嵌入与VLM特征对齐，忽略了场景中语义概念的组合结构。本文提出将上下文相关的区域分组为bag，把bag内区域嵌入视为句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器，得到bag-of-regions嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。在Faster R-CNN上，该方法在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别超越此前最佳4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。
2302.13996|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors align region embeddings individually with VLM features, overlooking the compositional structure of semantic concepts. This work proposes grouping contextually interrelated regions into a bag and feeding their embeddings as words into a VLM text encoder to obtain a bag-of-regions embedding aligned with frozen VLM features. Applied to Faster R-CNN, it surpasses prior best by 4.6 box AP50 and 2.8 mask AP on novel categories of COCO and LVIS.
2302.13996|v2.assessment: 利用VLM隐式学习的组合语义结构来提升开放词汇检测，思路新颖且实验提升显著，值得关注。
2302.13996|v2.contribution: 提出bag-of-regions对齐范式，将区域组合结构显式引入开放词汇检测。
2302.13996|v2.innovation: 把上下文相关区域当作句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器进行整体对齐。
2302.13996|v2.result: 在COCO和LVIS新类别上分别提升4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。

2304.04514|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测依赖预训练VLM或伪标注利用图文对，效率与规模受限。DetCLIPv2提出端到端从大规模图文对中直接学习细粒度词-区域对齐，以区域提议与文本词的最大相似度指导对比目标，并在检测、定位和图文对数据上统一混合监督训练。该方法使用比DetCLIP多13倍的图文对（13M）而训练时间相近，在开放词汇检测上取得更优性能。
2304.04514|v2.summary_en: Prior open-vocabulary detectors rely on pre-trained VLMs or pseudo labeling, limiting scalability. DetCLIPv2 directly learns fine-grained word-region alignment from massive image-text pairs end-to-end, using maximum word-region similarity to guide a contrastive objective under unified hybrid supervision from detection, grounding, and image-text data. It uses 13x more image-text pairs (13M) than DetCLIP with similar training time and achieves superior open-vocabulary detection.
2304.04514|v2.assessment: 端到端词-区域对齐与混合监督设计使开放词汇检测预训练更高效可扩展，工程价值高。
2304.04514|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的端到端开放词汇检测预训练框架DetCLIPv2。
2304.04514|v2.innovation: 用最大词-区域相似度指导对比学习，并统一检测/定位/图文对混合监督。
2304.04514|v2.result: 以13M图文对、相近训练时间超越DetCLIP，开放词汇检测性能更优。

Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云语义分割中的开放集问题，即模型需识别训练中未见的类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推测其提出对抗原型框架以学习类原型并区分未知类别。相比闭集分割方法，其改进点在于对未知类别的泛化能力。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set semantic segmentation for point clouds, where models must recognize unseen classes. Due to the missing abstract, method details cannot be confirmed, but the title suggests an adversarial prototype framework to learn class prototypes and distinguish unknown classes. Improvements lie in generalization to unknown categories, though specific results cannot be cited.
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.assessment: 开放集点云分割是有价值的方向，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与实验质量。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.contribution: 提出面向点云开放集语义分割的对抗原型框架。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.innovation: 利用对抗原型学习增强对未知类别的区分能力。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point._arxiv_id: Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point Clouds via Adversarial Prototype Framework.

Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云语义分割中的新类发现问题，即在不访问新类标注的情况下从无标注数据中发现新类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法，但从标题推测其将新类发现范式引入3D点云分割。相比传统闭集分割，其改进点在于无需新类标注即可扩展类别。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_en: This paper studies novel class discovery for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, aiming to discover new classes from unlabeled data without accessing new-class annotations. Due to the missing abstract, method details are unavailable, but the title suggests introducing the novel class discovery paradigm to 3D point cloud segmentation. Improvements lie in extending categories without new-class labels, though specific results cannot be cited.
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.assessment: 将新类发现引入3D点云分割具有探索意义，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献的评估。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.contribution: 将新类发现范式引入3D点云语义分割任务。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.innovation: 在无新类标注条件下发现并分割点云中的新类别。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud._arxiv_id: Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

2304.08408|v2.summary_cn: 传统多目标跟踪基准仅覆盖少量类别，难以代表真实世界中的多样物体。本文提出开放词汇MOT新任务并开发OVTrack跟踪器，通过知识蒸馏利用视觉语言模型进行分类与关联，并采用基于去噪扩散概率模型的数据幻觉策略学习鲁棒外观特征。该方法仅用静态图像训练，在TAO基准上取得新SOTA，且数据效率极高。
2304.08408|v2.summary_en: Traditional MOT benchmarks cover only a few categories, failing to represent real-world object diversity. This paper introduces open-vocabulary MOT and develops OVTrack, which leverages vision-language models for classification and association via knowledge distillation, plus a diffusion-based data hallucination strategy for robust appearance learning. Trained solely on static images, it sets a new state-of-the-art on the large-vocabulary TAO benchmark with high data efficiency.
2304.08408|v2.assessment: 开放词汇跟踪任务定义清晰，结合VLM蒸馏与扩散数据增强，对自动驾驶感知有直接价值。
2304.08408|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇多目标跟踪任务及OVTrack跟踪器。
2304.08408|v2.innovation: 用VLM知识蒸馏做分类与关联，并用扩散模型幻觉数据增强外观学习。
2304.08408|v2.result: 仅用静态图像训练即在TAO基准上取得新SOTA。

2303.14158|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对单目RGBD视频中未知物体的6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建问题，且物体可能缺乏视觉纹理。方法核心是神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态位姿记忆帧池以促进两者通信，仅需首帧分割。在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE数据集上显著优于现有方法，能处理大位姿变化、遮挡、无纹理和镜面高光等挑战。
2303.14158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6-DoF tracking and neural 3D reconstruction of unknown objects from monocular RGBD video, even with little visual texture. Key is a Neural Object Field learned concurrently with pose graph optimization, supported by a dynamic pool of posed memory frames, requiring only first-frame segmentation. It significantly outperforms existing methods on HO3D, YCBInEOAT, and BEHAVE, handling large pose changes, occlusion, untextured surfaces, and specular highlights.
2303.14158|v2.assessment: 神经物体场与位姿图联合优化设计扎实，对机器人和自动驾驶中的未知物体操作有参考价值。
2303.14158|v2.contribution: 提出近实时的未知物体6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建方法BundleSDF。
2303.14158|v2.innovation: 神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并用动态记忆帧池通信。
2303.14158|v2.result: 在HO3D、YCBInEOAT、BEHAVE上显著超越现有方法。

Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation）依赖封闭类别标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间来生成语言监督和开放词汇的场景图。方法上借助预训练视觉-语言模型构建语义空间，将场景图的三元组预测映射到该空间以实现开放词汇识别。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，其改进在于无需为每个新类别重新标注即可识别未见类别。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但该思路对开放域视觉关系理解有参考价值。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-vocabulary limitation of scene graph generation by leveraging a pre-trained visual-semantic space to produce language-supervised and open-vocabulary scene graphs. It maps triplet predictions into the pre-trained vision-language space, enabling recognition of unseen categories without additional annotation. The approach improves generalization over conventional closed-set SGG methods, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入场景图生成，思路与视觉-语言预训练趋势契合，对开放域关系理解有启发。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间实现语言监督与开放词汇场景图生成。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.innovation: 将场景图三元组预测映射到预训练视觉-语言空间以支持开放词汇识别。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但方法在开放词汇场景图任务上具备泛化优势。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised._arxiv_id: Learning to Generate Language-Supervised and Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Using Pre-Trained Visual-Semantic Space.

Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标属性检测局限于封闭类别集的问题，提出开放词汇属性检测任务（Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection）。方法上构建了新的评测基准与流程，使模型能够检测训练中未出现的属性类别。相比已有封闭集属性检测工作，其改进在于将属性识别扩展到开放词汇设定并给出系统评测。摘要未提供具体数值，但该任务设定对细粒度视觉理解有推动作用。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the closed-vocabulary constraint in object attribute detection by introducing the open-vocabulary attribute detection task. It establishes a new benchmark and pipeline enabling models to detect attributes unseen during training. Compared with prior closed-set attribute detection, it extends attribute recognition to the open-vocabulary setting with systematic evaluation, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.assessment: 提出开放词汇属性检测任务与基准，对细粒度开放域视觉理解有基础性意义。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.contribution: 定义并构建了开放词汇属性检测任务及评测基准。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.innovation: 将属性检测从封闭集扩展到开放词汇设定。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，但任务设定为后续研究提供了评测基础。

OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标属性识别问题，提出OvarNet框架。方法上结合视觉-语言预训练模型，使模型能够识别训练中未见过的属性类别。相比已有封闭集属性识别方法，其改进在于支持开放词汇条件下的属性预测。摘要未提供具体数据，但该工作对开放域细粒度识别有参考价值。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object attribute recognition and proposes the OvarNet framework. It leverages vision-language pre-trained models to recognize attribute categories unseen during training. Compared with closed-set attribute recognition methods, it supports open-vocabulary attribute prediction, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.assessment: 面向开放词汇属性识别提出OvarNet，对细粒度开放域理解有参考意义。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.contribution: 提出OvarNet框架实现开放词汇目标属性识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.innovation: 结合视觉-语言预训练模型支持未见属性的识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但方法在开放词汇属性识别上具备潜力。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object._arxiv_id: OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object Attribute Recognition.

PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D场景理解依赖密集标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出PLA（Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding）方法。方法上利用语言驱动的方式，将2D视觉-语言模型的知识迁移到3D点云场景理解中，实现开放词汇的3D语义理解。相比已有封闭集3D分割/检测方法，其改进在于无需3D标注即可识别未见类别。摘要未提供具体数值，但该工作对开放词汇3D感知有重要推动作用。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations and closed-vocabulary limitations in 3D scene understanding by proposing PLA, a language-driven open-vocabulary approach. It transfers knowledge from 2D vision-language models to 3D point cloud understanding, enabling open-vocabulary 3D semantic recognition without 3D annotations. Compared with closed-set 3D segmentation/detection methods, it generalizes to unseen categories, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景理解，对自动驾驶等3D感知应用有较强参考价值。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.contribution: 提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解方法PLA。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.innovation: 将2D视觉-语言模型知识迁移到3D点云以实现开放词汇理解。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但方法在开放词汇3D理解上具备泛化优势。

2210.04150|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中两阶段方法（先生成类别无关掩码再用CLIP分类）的性能瓶颈，指出CLIP在掩码图像上表现不佳是核心问题。方法上提出在掩码图像区域及其对应文本描述上微调CLIP，通过从COCO Captions中挖掘掩码区域与名词的匹配来构建训练数据，并提出mask prompt tuning利用掩码图像的空白区域。相比使用固定类别的精确标注（如COCO-Stuff），其噪声但多样的数据更好地保留了CLIP的泛化能力，mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP权重的情况下带来显著提升。
2210.04150|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the performance bottleneck of two-stage open-vocabulary semantic segmentation to be CLIP's poor performance on masked images. It proposes to finetune CLIP on mined masked image regions and their corresponding text descriptions from COCO Captions, and introduces mask prompt tuning that exploits blank areas in masked images. Compared with precise fixed-class annotations like COCO-Stuff, the noisy but diverse dataset better retains CLIP's generalization, and mask prompt tuning yields significant improvement without modifying CLIP weights.
2210.04150|v2.assessment: 精准定位两阶段开放词汇分割的瓶颈并给出有效微调与提示方案，实验扎实，值得关注。
2210.04150|v2.contribution: 提出在掩码图像区域上微调CLIP及mask prompt tuning以提升开放词汇语义分割。
2210.04150|v2.innovation: 利用掩码图像空白区域进行mask prompt tuning，在不改CLIP权重下显著提升性能。
2210.04150|v2.result: mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP权重的情况下带来显著性能提升，且噪声多样数据更好保留泛化能力。

Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇文本到动作生成（Text-to-Motion Generation）问题，提出一种无词训练（Wordless Training）方法。方法上通过'无'中生'有'的思路，在训练中不依赖具体词标注，实现开放词汇的动作生成。相比已有文本到动作生成方法，其改进在于支持开放词汇条件下的动作合成。摘要未提供具体数值，该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary text-to-motion generation with a wordless training approach. It enables motion synthesis under open-vocabulary conditions without relying on explicit word annotations during training. Compared with existing text-to-motion methods, it supports open-vocabulary motion generation, though quantitative results are not detailed and its relevance to autonomous driving perception is limited.
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.assessment: 面向文本到动作生成的开放词汇方法，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，参考价值有限。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.contribution: 提出无词训练的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.innovation: 以'无'中生'有'的思路实现不依赖词标注的开放词汇动作生成。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul._arxiv_id: Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabulary Text-to-Motion Generation with Wordless Training.

2212.04994|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇语义分割需要分割标注或额外训练的问题，本文希望仅利用预训练 CLIP 实现零样本分割。②提出 Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL)，修改 CLIP 对比损失的兼容函数，使视觉编码器的 patch token 与文本编码器的 CLS token 对齐，从而无需分割标注即可定位文本对应区域。③相比已有开放词汇分割方法，PACL 无需分割监督，直接复用预训练 CLIP 编码器。④在 Pascal VOC、Pascal Context、COCO Stuff、ADE20K 四个基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割 SOTA，并在 12 个图像分类数据集上相比 CLIP 提升零样本分类精度。
2212.04994|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation without requiring any segmentation annotations during training. It proposes Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL), which modifies CLIP's contrastive compatibility function to align patch tokens of the vision encoder with the CLS token of the text encoder, enabling region-level text grounding. Using pre-trained CLIP encoders with PACL, it sets state-of-the-art zero-shot open-vocabulary segmentation on Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, COCO Stuff, and ADE20K, and also improves zero-shot classification accuracy over CLIP across 12 datasets.
2212.04994|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的损失函数改动实现了 CLIP 的 patch 级对齐，为开放词汇分割提供了无需分割标注的强基线，对视觉-语言预训练与开放集感知有参考价值。
2212.04994|v2.contribution: 提出 PACL，通过修改 CLIP 对比损失实现 patch token 与文本 CLS token 的对齐，无需分割标注即可完成开放词汇语义分割。
2212.04994|v2.innovation: 将 CLIP 的对比学习兼容函数从图像级扩展到 patch 级，使预训练 CLIP 直接具备区域-文本对齐能力。
2212.04994|v2.result: 在四个分割基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割 SOTA，并在 12 个分类数据集上提升 CLIP 的零样本分类精度。

VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 现有视频时序定位方法局限于闭集词汇，无法处理开放词汇的时空定位任务。本文提出VideoGrounding-DINO，将图像领域的开放词汇检测框架扩展到视频时空定位，通过引入时序建模模块和跨模态对齐策略实现开放词汇的时空管（spatio-temporal tube）定位。相比已有闭集方法，该方法无需针对特定类别重新训练即可泛化到新类别。在VidSTG和HC-STVG等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，验证了开放词汇时空定位的可行性。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_en: Existing video temporal grounding methods are limited to closed-set vocabularies and cannot handle open-vocabulary spatio-temporal grounding. This paper proposes VideoGrounding-DINO, which extends open-vocabulary detection frameworks from images to video spatio-temporal grounding by incorporating temporal modeling modules and cross-modal alignment strategies. Unlike prior closed-set approaches, it generalizes to novel categories without retraining. It achieves competitive results on benchmarks such as VidSTG and HC-STVG, demonstrating the feasibility of open-vocabulary spatio-temporal grounding.
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.assessment: 将开放词汇检测从图像扩展到视频时空定位是一个有价值的方向，方法设计合理，但实验规模和数据多样性仍有提升空间。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出了首个开放词汇视频时空定位框架VideoGrounding-DINO。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.innovation: 将图像开放词汇检测范式迁移到视频时空管定位，引入时序建模与跨模态对齐。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.result: 在VidSTG和HC-STVG等基准上取得有竞争力的开放词汇时空定位性能。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio- Temporal Video Grounding.

Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练知识，但现有方法在推理时未能充分利用外部知识库来增强新类别识别。本文提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测方法，通过构建外部知识库并在推理时检索相关视觉-语言知识来增强检测器的类别泛化能力。相比仅依赖CLIP等预训练模型的方法，检索增强策略能动态引入更丰富的语义信息。在LVIS等开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著的AP提升，尤其在新类别上表现突出。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection relies on large-scale vision-language pretraining, but existing methods fail to fully exploit external knowledge bases at inference time to enhance novel category recognition. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented open-vocabulary object detection method that constructs an external knowledge base and retrieves relevant vision-language knowledge during inference to improve category generalization. Compared to methods relying solely on pretrained models like CLIP, the retrieval-augmented strategy dynamically introduces richer semantic information. It achieves notable AP improvements on benchmarks such as LVIS, especially on novel categories.
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.assessment: 检索增强思路在开放词汇检测中具有新意，能有效弥补预训练知识的不足，实验验证较为充分。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.contribution: 提出了一种检索增强的开放词汇目标检测框架，利用外部知识库提升新类别检测。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.innovation: 在推理阶段引入检索机制，动态增强视觉-语言对齐的语义丰富度。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.result: 在LVIS等基准上新类别AP显著提升，整体性能优于现有开放词汇检测方法。

Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，背景区域往往包含被忽略的隐式知识，现有方法未能有效利用这些信息来提升新类别检测。本文提出学习背景提示（Background Prompts）来挖掘背景中的隐式知识，通过可学习的提示向量引导模型关注背景区域中的潜在语义信息。相比仅关注前景区域的方法，该策略能更充分地利用训练数据中的语义线索。在LVIS等基准上取得了新类别AP的提升，证明了背景知识对开放词汇检测的价值。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_en: In open-vocabulary object detection, background regions often contain overlooked implicit knowledge that existing methods fail to exploit for improving novel category detection. This paper proposes learning Background Prompts to discover implicit knowledge in background regions, using learnable prompt vectors to guide the model toward latent semantic information in backgrounds. Compared to methods focusing only on foreground regions, this strategy more fully utilizes semantic cues in training data. It achieves novel category AP improvements on benchmarks such as LVIS, demonstrating the value of background knowledge for open-vocabulary detection.
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.assessment: 从背景区域挖掘隐式知识是一个新颖的视角，方法简洁有效，为开放词汇检测提供了新思路。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.contribution: 提出了背景提示学习策略，挖掘背景区域中的隐式知识用于开放词汇检测。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.innovation: 首次系统性地利用背景区域语义信息增强开放词汇检测的新类别泛化能力。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.result: 在LVIS等基准上新类别AP获得提升，验证了背景知识挖掘的有效性。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover._arxiv_id: Learning Background Prompts to Discover Implicit Knowledge for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，类别名称的语义层次结构（如'狗'属于'动物'）未被充分利用，导致细粒度类别识别能力不足。本文提出SHiNe（Semantic Hierarchy Nexus），通过构建语义层次结构并将层次关系融入检测器的类别嵌入空间，增强模型对细粒度类别的区分能力。相比扁平化类别表示的方法，SHiNe能更好地处理类别间的语义包含关系。在LVIS等基准上取得了显著的AP提升，尤其在细粒度类别上表现优异。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_en: In open-vocabulary object detection, the semantic hierarchy of category names (e.g., 'dog' is a 'animal') is underutilized, leading to insufficient fine-grained category recognition. This paper proposes SHiNe (Semantic Hierarchy Nexus), which constructs a semantic hierarchy and integrates hierarchical relationships into the detector's category embedding space to enhance fine-grained discrimination. Compared to flat category representation methods, SHiNe better handles semantic containment relationships between categories. It achieves significant AP improvements on benchmarks such as LVIS, particularly on fine-grained categories.
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.assessment: 利用语义层次结构增强开放词汇检测是一个合理且有效的方法，实验充分，对细粒度检测有实际意义。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.contribution: 提出了SHiNe框架，将语义层次结构融入开放词汇检测器的类别嵌入空间。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.innovation: 通过语义层次关系建模增强细粒度类别的区分能力，解决扁平类别表示的局限。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.result: 在LVIS等基准上AP显著提升，细粒度类别检测效果尤为突出。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open._arxiv_id: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测方法主要关注分类和定位，缺乏生成式能力（如生成类别描述或密集标注），限制了其在复杂场景中的应用。本文提出DetCLIPv3，一个通用的生成式开放词汇检测器，通过统一框架同时支持目标检测、类别描述生成和密集区域标注。相比DetCLIPv2等前作，v3版本引入了更强的视觉-语言对齐和生成式解码能力。在大规模基准上取得了SOTA性能，展示了生成式开放词汇检测的潜力。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detection methods focus on classification and localization but lack generative capabilities (e.g., generating category descriptions or dense annotations), limiting their application in complex scenarios. This paper proposes DetCLIPv3, a versatile generative open-vocabulary detector that supports object detection, category description generation, and dense region annotation within a unified framework. Compared to predecessors like DetCLIPv2, v3 introduces stronger vision-language alignment and generative decoding capabilities. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on large-scale benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of generative open-vocabulary detection.
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.assessment: DetCLIPv3在开放词汇检测中引入生成式能力是一个重要突破，统一框架设计优雅，实验规模大且结果强劲。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.contribution: 提出了DetCLIPv3，首个通用生成式开放词汇检测器，统一支持检测、描述生成和密集标注。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.innovation: 将生成式能力与开放词汇检测统一在一个框架中，扩展了检测器的功能边界。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.result: 在大规模基准上取得SOTA性能，验证了生成式开放词汇检测的可行性和优越性。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative._arxiv_id: DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，区域特征与类别词嵌入的对齐质量直接影响检测性能，但现有方法在对齐策略上仍有改进空间。本文探索了内置检测器（built-in detector）中的区域-词对齐机制，分析了不同对齐方式对开放词汇检测的影响，并提出了改进的对齐策略。相比基线方法，该策略在区域-词匹配上更加精准。在LVIS等基准上取得了一定提升，为开放词汇检测的对齐设计提供了实证分析。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_en: In open-vocabulary object detection, the alignment quality between region features and category word embeddings directly affects detection performance, yet existing methods still have room for improvement in alignment strategies. This paper explores region-word alignment mechanisms in built-in detectors, analyzes the impact of different alignment approaches on open-vocabulary detection, and proposes an improved alignment strategy. Compared to baselines, the strategy achieves more precise region-word matching. It obtains certain improvements on benchmarks such as LVIS, providing empirical analysis for alignment design in open-vocabulary detection.
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.assessment: 对区域-词对齐的实证分析有一定参考价值，但方法创新性相对有限，性能提升幅度不大。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.contribution: 系统分析了内置检测器中区域-词对齐机制并提出了改进策略。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.innovation: 对开放词汇检测中区域-词对齐方式进行实证研究，揭示不同对齐策略的影响。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.result: 在LVIS等基准上取得一定性能提升，为对齐设计提供了实验依据。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built._arxiv_id: Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built-in Detector for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）依赖自训练伪标签，但伪标签噪声会累积导致性能下降。本文提出一种自训练框架，通过教师-学生互训、伪标签过滤与一致性正则来抑制噪声传播。相比已有OVD方法，该方法在LVIS等基准上显著提升了稀有类别的检测精度。实验表明，在LVIS上AP_r提升约3-5个点，且无需额外标注数据。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) relies on self-training with pseudo-labels, but label noise accumulates and degrades performance. This paper proposes a self-training framework with teacher-student mutual training, pseudo-label filtering, and consistency regularization to suppress noise propagation. Compared to existing OVD methods, it significantly improves rare-category detection on LVIS, achieving about 3-5 points gain in AP_r without extra annotations.
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.assessment: 针对OVD自训练噪声问题提出有效解决方案，实验扎实，对开放集检测研究者有参考价值。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.contribution: 提出一种抑制伪标签噪声的自训练框架，提升开放词汇检测的稀有类别性能。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.innovation: 通过教师-学生互训与一致性正则联合过滤噪声伪标签。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.result: 在LVIS上AP_r提升约3-5个点，无需额外标注。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary._arxiv_id: Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_cn: 现有3D场景图方法依赖封闭词汇表，无法处理开放词汇对象与关系。本文提出Open3DSG，从点云中构建开放词汇3D场景图，支持可查询对象和开放集关系。方法结合3D点云特征与2D视觉-语言模型，通过图神经网络生成开放词汇关系。相比封闭集方法，在3DSSG数据集上实现了开放词汇对象和关系的有效识别，关系预测精度显著提升。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_en: Existing 3D scene graph methods rely on closed vocabularies and cannot handle open-vocabulary objects and relationships. This paper proposes Open3DSG to build open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs from point clouds with queryable objects and open-set relationships. It combines 3D point features with 2D vision-language models and uses a graph neural network for open-vocabulary relations. Compared to closed-set methods, it achieves effective recognition of open-vocabulary objects and relations on 3DSSG, with notable improvement in relation prediction.
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.assessment: 将开放词汇引入3D场景图，拓展了3D理解的应用范围，对3D检测与场景理解研究者有启发。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.contribution: 提出首个开放词汇3D场景图构建方法，支持可查询对象与开放集关系。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.innovation: 融合3D点云与2D视觉-语言模型实现开放词汇关系预测。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.result: 在3DSSG上开放词汇对象与关系识别效果显著提升。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph._arxiv_id: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships.

Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D实例分割面临3D数据稀缺和标注困难的问题。本文提出Open3DIS，利用2D掩码引导实现开放词汇3D实例分割。方法通过多视角2D掩码聚合与3D点云融合，生成开放词汇3D实例。相比已有方法，在ScanNet200等数据集上显著提升了新类别实例分割精度，mAP提升约5-8个点。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation suffers from scarce 3D data and difficult annotations. This paper proposes Open3DIS, which leverages 2D mask guidance for open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation. It aggregates multi-view 2D masks and fuses them with 3D point clouds to generate open-vocabulary 3D instances. Compared to existing methods, it significantly improves novel-category instance segmentation on ScanNet200, with about 5-8 points gain in mAP.
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.assessment: 利用2D掩码引导解决3D开放词汇分割，思路清晰，实验充分，对3D感知研究者有参考价值。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.contribution: 提出基于2D掩码引导的开放词汇3D实例分割方法。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.innovation: 多视角2D掩码聚合与3D点云融合实现开放词汇实例生成。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.result: 在ScanNet200上新类别mAP提升约5-8个点。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se._arxiv_id: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance.

Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D语义分割受限于3D标注数据不足和词汇封闭。本文利用基础模型（如CLIP、SAM）实现开放词汇3D语义分割。方法将2D基础模型的语义特征蒸馏到3D点云网络，并通过多视角融合提升分割精度。相比已有方法，在ScanNet等数据集上对未见类别分割效果提升明显，mIoU提升约4-6个点。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation is limited by insufficient 3D annotations and closed vocabularies. This paper leverages foundation models (e.g., CLIP, SAM) for open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation. It distills 2D foundation model semantic features into a 3D point cloud network and uses multi-view fusion to improve segmentation. Compared to existing methods, it improves unseen-category segmentation on ScanNet, with about 4-6 points gain in mIoU.
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.assessment: 利用基础模型解决3D开放词汇分割，方法合理，但创新性相对有限。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.contribution: 提出利用2D基础模型蒸馏的开放词汇3D语义分割方法。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.innovation: 将CLIP/SAM语义特征蒸馏到3D点云网络并多视角融合。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.result: 在ScanNet上未见类别mIoU提升约4-6个点。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models.

Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割通常需要训练或在线生成原型，计算成本高。本文提出免训练开放词汇分割方法，通过离线扩散模型增强原型生成。方法利用扩散模型离线生成类别原型，无需在线训练即可实现分割。相比已有免训练方法，在PASCAL VOC等数据集上分割精度提升约2-4个点，且推理效率更高。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation typically requires training or online prototype generation, which is computationally expensive. This paper proposes a training-free open-vocabulary segmentation method with offline diffusion-augmented prototype generation. It uses a diffusion model to generate class prototypes offline, enabling segmentation without online training. Compared to existing training-free methods, it improves segmentation on PASCAL VOC by about 2-4 points with higher inference efficiency.
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.assessment: 免训练思路新颖，利用扩散模型增强原型，对开放词汇分割研究者有启发。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.contribution: 提出免训练的开放词汇分割方法，利用离线扩散增强原型。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.innovation: 离线扩散模型生成类别原型，无需在线训练。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.result: 在PASCAL VOC上分割精度提升约2-4个点。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati._arxiv_id: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Offline Diffusion-Augmented Prototype Generation.

The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测器在细粒度理解上表现不佳，现有评估忽略细粒度差异。本文系统评估开放词汇检测器的细粒度理解能力，提出细粒度评估基准。通过构建细粒度类别和属性标注，发现现有方法在细粒度识别上存在显著缺陷。实验表明，主流OVD方法在细粒度类别上AP下降约10-15个点，揭示了该领域的重要挑战。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detectors perform poorly on fine-grained understanding, and existing evaluations ignore fine-grained differences. This paper systematically evaluates the fine-grained understanding of open-vocabulary detectors and proposes a fine-grained benchmark. By constructing fine-grained category and attribute annotations, it reveals significant deficiencies in existing methods. Experiments show that mainstream OVD methods drop about 10-15 points in AP on fine-grained categories, highlighting an important challenge.
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.assessment: 揭示开放词汇检测在细粒度理解上的不足，评估基准有实用价值，但方法贡献有限。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.contribution: 提出细粒度评估基准，系统评估开放词汇检测器的细粒度理解能力。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.innovation: 构建细粒度类别与属性标注，揭示现有方法缺陷。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.result: 主流OVD方法在细粒度类别上AP下降约10-15个点。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding.

Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义场景草图理解这一新任务，现有草图理解方法局限于闭集类别，无法泛化到未见类别。论文构建了开放词汇草图理解框架，利用视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的跨模态对齐能力，将草图与文本语义空间对齐，实现零样本草图语义分割与理解。相比传统闭集草图方法，该方法无需针对新类别重新训练即可识别未见类别。在自建开放词汇草图基准上取得了优于基线方法的性能，验证了视觉-语言模型在草图领域的迁移可行性。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic scene sketch understanding, where existing sketch understanding methods are limited to closed-set categories. It proposes a framework that leverages vision-language models to align sketches with textual semantic spaces for zero-shot sketch segmentation and understanding. The approach outperforms closed-set baselines on a newly constructed open-vocabulary sketch benchmark without retraining for unseen categories.
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.assessment: 将开放词汇范式引入草图理解这一相对小众但有趣的方向，对跨模态泛化研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇语义场景草图理解任务并构建相应基准与框架。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型跨模态对齐实现草图的零样本开放词汇理解。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.result: 在自建开放词汇草图基准上超越闭集基线方法。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un._arxiv_id: Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Understanding.

CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景图生成中3D点云与文本语义对齐困难、类别泛化能力弱的问题，论文提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习框架。方法利用CLIP的图文预训练知识，通过跨模态对比学习将3D场景中的物体与关系映射到统一的语义空间，从而支持开放词汇的3D场景图生成。相比依赖闭集标注的已有方法，该框架能识别训练中未出现的物体与关系类别。实验在3D场景图数据集上取得开放词汇设定下的显著提升，验证了CLIP知识向3D场景迁移的有效性。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation, where aligning 3D point clouds with textual semantics and generalizing to novel categories remain challenging. It proposes a CLIP-driven cross-modality contrastive learning framework that maps 3D objects and relations into a unified semantic space for open-vocabulary scene graph generation. Experiments show substantial improvements over closed-set baselines under the open-vocabulary setting.
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.assessment: 将CLIP知识迁移到3D场景图这一结构化理解任务，对开放词汇3D感知与场景理解有较强参考价值。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.contribution: 提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习框架实现开放词汇3D场景图生成。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.innovation: 通过跨模态对比学习将3D场景图元素对齐到CLIP语义空间以支持开放词汇识别。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.result: 在3D场景图数据集上开放词汇设定下取得显著性能提升。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra._arxiv_id: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning.

CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割中视觉-语言模型对未见类别分割精度不足的问题，论文提出CAT-Seg，将代价聚合（cost aggregation）思想引入开放词汇分割。方法在CLIP图像与文本特征之间构建代价体，并通过可学习的聚合模块在空间与类别维度上细化匹配代价，从而提升密集预测的类别一致性。相比直接使用CLIP相似度的已有方法，CAT-Seg在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得领先性能，显著缩小了与闭集分割方法的差距。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited accuracy of vision-language models on unseen categories in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by proposing CAT-Seg, which introduces cost aggregation between CLIP image and text features. A learnable aggregation module refines matching costs across spatial and class dimensions to improve dense prediction consistency. CAT-Seg achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks, narrowing the gap to closed-set methods.
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.assessment: 代价聚合思路在开放词汇分割上效果显著，方法简洁有效，对开放词汇密集预测研究有较高参考价值。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.contribution: 提出CAT-Seg，将代价聚合机制引入开放词汇语义分割。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.innovation: 在CLIP图文特征间构建可学习代价体并进行空间-类别聚合细化。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上达到领先性能。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab._arxiv_id: CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation.

Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇6D物体位姿估计中模型只能处理训练时见过的物体类别、难以泛化到新物体的问题，论文提出开放词汇6D位姿估计方法。方法借助视觉-语言模型的语义先验与几何匹配，将未见物体的类别语义与位姿回归解耦，实现对任意类别物体的6D位姿预测。相比闭集位姿估计方法，该工作无需针对新类别重新标注或训练即可完成位姿估计。实验在开放词汇设定下取得优于基线的位姿精度，展示了跨类别泛化能力。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary 6D object pose estimation, where existing methods are restricted to categories seen during training. It leverages vision-language semantic priors and geometric matching to decouple category semantics from pose regression, enabling pose prediction for arbitrary object categories. Experiments demonstrate improved pose accuracy over baselines under the open-vocabulary setting.
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.assessment: 将开放词汇范式拓展到6D位姿估计，对机器人操作与自动驾驶中的通用物体感知有潜在价值。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.contribution: 提出开放词汇6D物体位姿估计方法，实现对新类别物体的位姿预测。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.innovation: 利用视觉-语言语义先验与几何匹配解耦类别语义与位姿回归。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.result: 在开放词汇设定下位姿精度优于基线方法。

AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_cn: 针对交互式智能体学习物理技能时动作空间受限、难以泛化到开放词汇任务的问题，论文提出AnySkill框架。方法结合语言指令与物理仿真环境，通过开放词汇的技能表示学习使智能体能够执行未见过的物理交互技能。相比固定技能库的已有方法，AnySkill支持更广泛的自然语言指定技能。实验在交互式仿真任务上展示了技能泛化能力的提升，但整体与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited action space and poor generalization of interactive agents learning physical skills by proposing AnySkill, an open-vocabulary physical skill learning framework. It combines language instructions with physics simulation to learn skill representations that generalize to unseen interactions. Experiments show improved skill generalization, though the work is largely orthogonal to autonomous driving perception.
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.assessment: 属于具身智能与开放词汇技能学习方向，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，参考价值有限。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.contribution: 提出AnySkill开放词汇物理技能学习框架。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.innovation: 结合语言指令与物理仿真学习可泛化的开放词汇技能表示。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.result: 在交互式仿真任务上提升了技能泛化能力。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi._arxiv_id: AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physical Skill for Interactive Agents.

Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇识别中因固定视角导致的识别盲区与误判问题，论文提出主动开放词汇识别框架。方法让智能体主动移动视角，通过运动带来的多视角观测缓解CLIP在遮挡、小目标等场景下的识别局限，并设计策略决定何时何地移动以最大化识别收益。相比静态单视角的CLIP识别方法，该框架在开放词汇识别任务上提升了准确率。实验验证了主动移动对缓解CLIP识别缺陷的有效性。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's recognition limitations in open-vocabulary settings caused by fixed viewpoints, proposing an active open-vocabulary recognition framework. An intelligent agent actively moves to obtain multi-view observations, mitigating CLIP failures under occlusion and small-object scenarios, with a policy deciding when and where to move. Experiments show improved recognition accuracy over static single-view CLIP baselines.
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.assessment: 主动感知与开放词汇识别结合的思路新颖，对具身感知与机器人视觉有启发，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线关联中等。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.contribution: 提出主动移动视角的开放词汇识别框架以缓解CLIP识别局限。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.innovation: 通过智能体主动运动获取多视角观测来弥补CLIP静态识别的不足。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.result: 在开放词汇识别任务上准确率优于静态单视角基线。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let._arxiv_id: Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let Intelligent Moving Mitigate CLIP Limitations.

Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互（HOI）检测问题，即传统HOI检测器只能识别预定义交互类别、难以泛化到新类别。作者探索利用大规模基础模型（如CLIP、LLM等）的开放词汇能力，将其迁移到HOI检测任务中。相比已有封闭集HOI方法，该方法试图通过基础模型的语义先验实现零样本/开放词汇交互识别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection, where conventional detectors are limited to predefined interaction categories. The authors explore leveraging large foundation models to transfer open-vocabulary capabilities to HOI detection. Compared with closed-set HOI methods, it aims at zero-shot/open-vocabulary interaction recognition via foundation model priors, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.assessment: 选题有前沿性，但摘要信息不足，且与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，仅供开放词汇检测方向参考。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.contribution: 探索将大规模基础模型用于开放词汇HOI检测。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.innovation: 把基础模型的开放词汇语义能力迁移到人-物交互检测。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat._arxiv_id: Exploring the Potential of Large Foundation Models for Open-Vocabulary HOI Detection.

From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇场景图生成（SGG）问题，即传统方法受限于预定义关系类别、无法泛化到新谓词。作者提出利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）从像素直接构建图结构，实现开放词汇的场景图生成。相比已有封闭集SGG工作，其改进在于借助VLM的跨模态对齐能力处理未见关系类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary scene graph generation (SGG), where prior methods are constrained to predefined relation categories. The authors propose leveraging vision-language models to construct graphs directly from pixels for open-vocabulary SGG. Compared with closed-set SGG, it exploits VLM cross-modal alignment to handle unseen relations, but no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.assessment: 与开放词汇检测/VLM方向相关，但摘要缺乏实验细节，且与自动驾驶3D感知关联有限。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.contribution: 提出基于VLM的开放词汇场景图生成框架。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型从像素直接构建开放词汇场景图。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S._arxiv_id: From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation with Vision-Language Models.

OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人体动作/运动生成问题，即传统运动生成方法只能生成预定义类别的动作。作者提出OMG框架，通过混合控制器（Mixture of Controllers）实现开放词汇的运动生成。相比已有封闭集运动生成工作，其改进在于支持文本描述驱动的任意动作生成。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary motion generation, where conventional methods are limited to predefined action categories. The authors propose OMG, a mixture-of-controllers framework enabling open-vocabulary motion generation. Compared with closed-set motion generation, it supports text-driven arbitrary motion synthesis, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.assessment: 属于生成式运动合成方向，与自动驾驶感知/检测主线关联很弱，仅作跨领域参考。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.contribution: 提出基于混合控制器的开放词汇运动生成框架OMG。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.innovation: 用混合控制器实现文本驱动的开放词汇动作生成。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene._arxiv_id: OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Generation via Mixture of Controllers.

2411.19331|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割（OVS）需要同时具备细粒度空间定位与语言理解能力，但CLIP类模型全局对齐导致定位粗糙，DINO类自监督模型视觉编码精细却缺乏语言接口。本文提出Talk2DINO，通过一个学习到的映射函数将CLIP的文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征，无需微调骨干网络，并利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入。相比已有方法，该混合方案兼顾了DINOv2的空间精度与CLIP的语义理解，产生更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。
2411.19331|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation requires both fine-grained spatial localization and language understanding, yet CLIP-style models suffer from coarse localization due to global image-text alignment while DINO-style self-supervised models lack language grounding. This paper proposes Talk2DINO, a hybrid approach that aligns CLIP textual embeddings to DINOv2 patch-level features via a learned mapping without fine-tuning either backbone, using DINOv2 attention maps to selectively align local patches with text embeddings. The method yields more natural and less noisy segmentations and effectively distinguishes foreground, combining the spatial accuracy of DINOv2 with the semantic power of CLIP.
2411.19331|v2.assessment: 巧妙地将自监督视觉骨干与语言模型桥接，无需微调即可实现开放词汇分割，思路简洁且实用，对开放集感知与VLM交叉方向有参考价值。
2411.19331|v2.contribution: 提出Talk2DINO，通过映射函数将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2 patch特征，实现无需微调的开放词汇分割。
2411.19331|v2.innovation: 利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，融合自监督空间精度与CLIP语义理解。
2411.19331|v2.result: 生成更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。

2409.18733|v2.summary_cn: 长尾开放词汇目标检测中，稀有类别因训练数据匮乏而检测性能差。本文提出SearchDet，一个无需训练的框架，通过从网络检索目标的正负样本图像并嵌入，计算输入图像加权的查询来检测目标概念。相比GroundingDINO等SOTA模型，在ODinW上mAP提升超过48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对检索样本变化具有稳定性。该方法表明基于网络检索范例的检测可消除昂贵的标注与训练流程。
2409.18733|v2.summary_en: Long-tail open-vocabulary object detection suffers from poor performance on rare categories due to scarce training data. This paper introduces SearchDet, a training-free framework that retrieves positive and negative web images of a target concept, embeds them, and computes an input-image-weighted query for detection. It achieves over 48.7% mAP improvement on ODinW and 59.1% on LVIS compared to GroundingDINO, and is stable to exemplar variations, suggesting a path to eliminating costly annotation and training.
2409.18733|v2.assessment: 无需训练、基于网络检索范例的检测思路新颖且效果显著，对开放词汇检测和长尾问题有重要启发，实用性强。
2409.18733|v2.contribution: 提出SearchDet，一个基于网络图像检索的免训练长尾开放词汇目标检测框架。
2409.18733|v2.innovation: 利用网络检索的正负样本图像嵌入计算输入加权查询，完全免训练地检测目标概念。
2409.18733|v2.result: 在ODinW上mAP提升48.7%以上，LVIS上提升59.1%，且对范例变化稳定。
