2503.16282|v2.summary_cn: 广义少样本3D点云分割（GFS-PCS）需用少量支持样本适应新类并保留基类分割，但现有方法受限于少样本的稀疏知识，而3D视觉语言模型虽泛化性强却含噪声。本文提出GFS-VL框架，将3D VLM的密集但含噪伪标签与精确但稀疏的少样本样本协同，通过原型引导的伪标签筛选过滤低质量区域，再用自适应填充策略结合伪标签上下文与少样本样本标注未标记区域，并设计新基类混合策略将少样本嵌入训练场景。此外引入两个更具多样性的挑战性基准。
2503.16282|v2.summary_en: Generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation (GFS-PCS) requires adapting to novel classes with few support samples while retaining base class segmentation, but existing methods are limited by sparse few-shot knowledge while 3D VLMs contain rich yet noisy novel class knowledge. This paper proposes GFS-VL, synergizing dense but noisy pseudo-labels from 3D VLMs with precise yet sparse few-shot samples via prototype-guided pseudo-label selection, adaptive infilling, and a novel-base mix strategy. Two challenging benchmarks with diverse novel classes are also introduced.
2503.16282|v2.assessment: 将3D VLM伪标签与少样本学习协同的思路有效解决了GFS-PCS的知识稀疏问题，新基准的引入也推动了该领域评测发展。
2503.16282|v2.contribution: 提出GFS-VL框架，协同3D VLM伪标签与少样本样本解决广义少样本3D点云分割。
2503.16282|v2.innovation: 原型引导伪标签筛选与自适应填充策略，结合新基类混合策略增强新类学习。
2503.16282|v2.result: 有效利用3D VLM知识提升新类分割，并引入两个更具多样性的挑战性基准。

2411.16183|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D实例分割方法因无监督合并策略常导致过分割，产生大量冗余3D候选框，影响下游任务。本文提出3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking模块，利用SAM-2的3D先验确保跨视频帧的目标掩码一致性，并设计3D Mask Optimization模块，通过动态规划算法选择最优视图集，精炼超点以生成每个目标的最终3D提案。该方法在保持场景全面覆盖的同时减少了冗余提案，提升了3D实例分割的准确性和下游任务可用性。
2411.16183|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D instance segmentation methods suffer from over-segmentation due to unsupervised merging, producing redundant 3D proposals. This paper proposes a 3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking module that leverages SAM-2's 3D priors for consistent object masks across frames, and a 3D Mask Optimization module using dynamic programming to select optimal views and refine superpoints into final 3D proposals. The approach achieves comprehensive object coverage while reducing redundant proposals, improving downstream applicability.
2411.16183|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了3D实例分割中的过分割问题，利用基础模型先验和动态规划优化，思路新颖且实用，对自动驾驶感知中的3D场景理解有参考价值。
2411.16183|v2.contribution: 提出结合SAM-2跟踪与动态规划优化的3D实例分割框架，减少冗余提案并提升覆盖度。
2411.16183|v2.innovation: 利用3D感知的2D掩码跟踪和动态规划选择最优视图集来精炼3D提案。
2411.16183|v2.result: 在保持全面对象覆盖的同时减少了冗余3D提案，提升了分割质量。

2411.17150|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）在复杂环境中分割任意查询提示指定的对象时，缺乏对象级上下文考虑，导致无法将语义一致的组件分组并精确映射到用户定义的类别。本文提出一种新方法，通过将视觉基础模型的谱驱动特征蒸馏到视觉编码器的注意力机制中，增强对象内部一致性，使语义连贯组件形成单一对象掩码；同时利用零样本对象存在概率细化文本嵌入，确保与图像中特定对象的准确对齐。该方法在无需训练的情况下提升了OVSS的性能。
2411.17150|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) lacks object-level context when segmenting complex objects with arbitrary query prompts, limiting precise grouping and mapping to user-defined classes. This paper introduces a training-free approach that distills spectral-driven features from vision foundation models into the visual encoder's attention to enhance intra-object consistency, and refines text embeddings with zero-shot object presence likelihood for accurate alignment. The method improves OVSS performance without training.
2411.17150|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVSS中的对象级上下文缺失问题，提出谱图蒸馏和文本嵌入细化，方法新颖且无需训练，对开放词汇分割研究有启发。
2411.17150|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需训练的OVSS方法，通过谱特征蒸馏和文本嵌入细化增强对象级上下文。
2411.17150|v2.innovation: 将视觉基础模型的谱驱动特征蒸馏到注意力机制，并利用零样本对象存在概率细化文本嵌入。
2411.17150|v2.result: 在开放词汇语义分割任务上提升了对象内部一致性和文本对齐精度。

2503.16707|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法通常依赖单一视觉语言模型（VLM）来对齐3D模型与语言空间，限制了利用多种基础模型的空间和语义能力。本文提出CUA-O3D，首次将CLIP、DINOv2和Stable Diffusion等多个基础模型集成到3D场景理解中，并引入确定性不确定性估计来自适应地蒸馏和协调异构2D特征嵌入。该方法解决了融合语义先验与几何知识以及协调异构表示两大挑战，在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得了显著提升。
2503.16707|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding methods rely on a single VLM to align 3D models with language, limiting the use of diverse foundation models. This paper proposes CUA-O3D, the first to integrate multiple foundation models (CLIP, DINOv2, Stable Diffusion) into 3D scene understanding, with deterministic uncertainty estimation to adaptively distill and harmonize heterogeneous 2D features. It addresses semantic-geometric fusion and representation reconciliation, achieving significant improvements.
2503.16707|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地融合多个基础模型并引入不确定性估计，有效提升了开放词汇3D场景理解的性能，对多模态3D感知有重要参考价值。
2503.16707|v2.contribution: 提出首个集成多基础模型的开放词汇3D场景理解框架，并引入确定性不确定性估计协调异构特征。
2503.16707|v2.innovation: 利用确定性不确定性估计自适应蒸馏和协调来自CLIP、DINOv2和Stable Diffusion的异构2D特征。
2503.16707|v2.result: 在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上显著优于依赖单一VLM的现有方法。

2501.09688|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇部件分割（OVPS）面临部件级图像-文本对齐困难和对象部件结构理解不足两大挑战。本文提出PartCATSeg框架，集成对象感知的部件级代价聚合、组合损失和来自DINO的结构引导。具体采用解耦代价聚合策略分别处理对象和部件级代价，引入组合损失捕捉部件-对象关系以补偿有限的部件标注，并利用DINO特征改善边界划分和部件间理解。在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet数据集上显著超越现有方法，为未见部件类别的泛化设定了新基线。
2501.09688|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Part Segmentation (OVPS) faces challenges in part-level image-text alignment and structural understanding. This paper proposes PartCATSeg, integrating object-aware part-level cost aggregation, compositional loss, and structural guidance from DINO. It employs disentangled cost aggregation for object and part levels, a compositional loss to capture part-object relationships, and DINO features for boundary delineation. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on Pascal-Part-116, ADE20K-Part-234, and PartImageNet, setting a new baseline.
2501.09688|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVPS的细粒度对齐和结构理解问题，提出解耦代价聚合和组合损失，方法有效且实验充分，对开放词汇细粒度分割有参考意义。
2501.09688|v2.contribution: 提出PartCATSeg框架，通过解耦代价聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导提升开放词汇部件分割性能。
2501.09688|v2.innovation: 采用对象感知的部件级代价聚合和组合损失，结合DINO特征增强部件结构理解。
2501.09688|v2.result: 在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet上显著超越现有方法，设定了新基线。

2504.04191|v2.summary_cn: 学习开放词汇物理技能是人工智能中的重大挑战，现有强化学习方法面临手动设计奖励难以扩展和基于演示的方法泛化能力差的问题。本文提出GROVE，一种无需手动工程或任务特定演示的通用奖励框架，利用LLM生成精确的物理约束，VLM评估运动语义和自然性，通过迭代设计过程使VLM反馈持续精炼LLM生成的约束，形成自改进奖励系统。为弥合仿真与自然图像的域差距，开发了Pose2CLIP轻量映射器，将智能体姿态直接投影到语义特征空间。实验表明该方法在多种具身和学习范式下有效。
2504.04191|v2.summary_en: Learning open-vocabulary physical skills is challenging; existing RL methods suffer from non-scalable manual rewards and poor generalization of demonstration-based methods. This paper introduces GROVE, a generalized reward framework without manual engineering or task-specific demonstrations, using LLMs for physical constraints and VLMs for motion semantics, with iterative refinement. A lightweight Pose2CLIP mapper bridges simulation and natural images. Experiments show effectiveness across diverse embodiments and learning paradigms.
2504.04191|v2.assessment: 该工作将LLM和VLM结合用于物理技能学习的奖励设计，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，更偏向机器人强化学习。
2504.04191|v2.contribution: 提出GROVE通用奖励框架，利用LLM和VLM的互补指导实现开放词汇物理技能学习。
2504.04191|v2.innovation: 通过VLM反馈迭代精炼LLM生成的物理约束，并开发Pose2CLIP映射器弥合仿真与自然图像域差距。
2504.04191|v2.result: 在多种具身和学习范式下验证了框架的有效性，无需手动奖励工程或任务特定演示。

2501.18954|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测器依赖大量区域级标注数据，性能提升受限。本文提出LLMDet，通过让开放词汇检测器与大语言模型协同训练，为每张图像生成图像级详细描述来进一步提升性能。作者构建了GroundingCap-1M数据集，包含每张图像的关联定位标签和图像级详细描述，并用标准定位损失和描述生成损失微调检测器。在大语言模型监督下，LLMDet显著超越基线，具备更强的开放词汇能力，且改进后的LLMDet能反过来构建更强的多模态大模型，实现互利。
2501.18954|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on abundant region-level annotations, limiting performance. This paper proposes LLMDet, co-training an open-vocabulary detector with an LLM by generating image-level detailed captions. They collect GroundingCap-1M with grounding labels and detailed captions, and finetune the detector with grounding and caption generation losses. LLMDet outperforms the baseline with superior open-vocabulary ability, and can in turn build a stronger multi-modal model, achieving mutual benefits.
2501.18954|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用LLM生成详细描述来增强开放词汇检测器，并构建了大规模数据集，实验充分且效果显著，对开放词汇检测和多模态学习有重要价值。
2501.18954|v2.contribution: 提出LLMDet，通过LLM监督的图像级描述生成提升开放词汇检测器性能，并构建GroundingCap-1M数据集。
2501.18954|v2.innovation: 将开放词汇检测器与LLM协同训练，利用图像级详细描述作为监督信号，实现检测与多模态模型的互利。
2501.18954|v2.result: LLMDet显著超越基线，开放词汇能力更强，并能构建更强的多模态大模型。

2503.19145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇属性检测中标注成本高、属性集合固定且标注粒度模糊的问题，提出免训练的Compositional Caching (ComCa)方法。该方法仅需目标属性与物体列表，利用web-scale数据库和LLM构建辅助图像缓存并判定属性-物体兼容性，为缓存图像赋予软属性标签，推理时依据输入与缓存图像的相似度聚合标签以精炼VLM预测。相比依赖预定义属性集与人工标注的已有方法，ComCa无需训练即可扩展到任意属性词汇，缓解了标注歧义与可扩展性限制。
2503.19145|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and limited scalability of attribute detection by proposing Compositional Caching (ComCa), a training-free open-vocabulary attribute detection method. Given only target attributes and objects, ComCa builds an auxiliary image cache using web-scale databases and LLMs to assess attribute-object compatibility, assigns soft attribute labels, and aggregates them at inference via similarity to refine VLM predictions. It removes dependence on predefined attribute sets and manual annotation, improving scalability and adaptability.
2503.19145|v2.assessment: 将LLM与web-scale检索结合用于免训练属性检测的思路较新颖，对开放词汇感知有参考价值，但任务本身与自动驾驶核心感知链路关联有限。
2503.19145|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的开放词汇属性检测框架ComCa，通过组合式缓存与软标签聚合精炼VLM预测。
2503.19145|v2.innovation: 利用LLM判定属性-物体兼容性构建辅助缓存，并以软属性标签在推理时按相似度聚合。
2503.19145|v2.result: 无需训练即可支持任意属性词汇，克服预定义属性集与人工标注的可扩展性瓶颈。

2401.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割通常依赖CLIP类图像级VLM、真值掩码与定制分组编码器的问题，提出S-Seg，一种不依赖上述任一要素的简洁模型。S-Seg利用伪掩码与语言训练MaskFormer，直接从公开图文数据集中学习像素级特征与语言对齐，无需微调即可泛化到多个测试数据集。相比已有方法，其结构更简单且具备数据可扩展性，并可通过自训练持续提升性能，作者认为可作为未来研究的强基线。
2401.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, which typically relies on image-level VL models, ground-truth masks, and custom grouping encoders. It introduces S-Seg, which trains a MaskFormer with pseudo-masks and language from public image-text data, learning pixel-level features and language alignment directly. S-Seg generalizes to multiple test datasets without fine-tuning, scales with data, and improves consistently with self-training, serving as a strong simple baseline.
2401.12217|v2.assessment: 以极简设计挑战现有开放词汇分割的复杂依赖，结论清晰且可复现性强，对开放词汇分割研究有基线价值。
2401.12217|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖CLIP、真值掩码与定制编码器的开放词汇语义分割模型S-Seg。
2401.12217|v2.innovation: 仅用伪掩码与语言训练MaskFormer，直接学习像素级特征与语言对齐。
2401.12217|v2.result: 无需微调即可跨数据集泛化，并随数据规模与自训练持续提升性能。

2411.14723|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有开放词汇语义分割将SAM与CLIP串联的两阶段方法计算开销大、内存效率低的问题，提出单阶段模型ESC-Net。ESC-Net在高效推理框架内复用SAM解码器块进行类无关分割，并将由图文相关性生成的伪提示嵌入SAM的可提示分割框架，实现精细的空间聚合与准确掩码预测。在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC与PASCAL-Context上，ESC-Net在效率与精度上均优于先前方法，消融实验验证了其在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性。
2411.14723|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and memory inefficiency of two-stage open-vocabulary segmentation that sequentially couples SAM with CLIP. It proposes ESC-Net, a one-stage model that reuses SAM decoder blocks for class-agnostic segmentation and embeds pseudo prompts derived from image-text correlations into SAM's promptable framework for refined spatial aggregation. ESC-Net outperforms prior methods in both efficiency and accuracy on ADE20K, PASCAL-VOC, and PASCAL-Context.
2411.14723|v2.assessment: 将SAM解码器改造为单阶段开放词汇分割并引入伪提示，工程上较实用，对高效开放词汇分割有参考意义。
2411.14723|v2.contribution: 提出单阶段开放词汇分割模型ESC-Net，复用SAM解码器块并嵌入图文相关性伪提示。
2411.14723|v2.innovation: 在SAM可提示分割框架内嵌入伪提示，实现类无关分割与精细空间聚合的一体化。
2411.14723|v2.result: 在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC、PASCAL-Context上效率与精度均超越先前方法。

2502.02548|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中精确3D区域分割、全面文本描述与足够数据规模三大需求，提出自动数据生成流水线与训练框架。方法利用最先进的开放词汇图像分割模型与区域感知VLM，自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，构建了含3万+标注场景、560万掩码-文本对的Mosaic3D-5.6M数据集，规模显著超过现有数据集。基于该数据提出Mosaic3D基础模型，结合对比学习训练的3D编码器与轻量掩码解码器，在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++等开放词汇3D语义与实例分割任务上取得SOTA，消融验证了大规模训练数据的有效性。
2502.02548|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding by introducing an automatic data generation pipeline and training framework. Leveraging open-vocabulary image segmentation models and region-aware VLMs, it generates high-quality 3D mask-text pairs and builds Mosaic3D-5.6M, comprising over 30K scenes and 5.6M pairs, far larger than existing datasets. The resulting Mosaic3D foundation model combines a contrastively trained 3D encoder with a lightweight mask decoder, achieving state-of-the-art open-vocabulary 3D semantic and instance segmentation on ScanNet200, Matterport3D, and ScanNet++.
2502.02548|v2.assessment: 大规模3D掩码-文本数据集与基础模型的组合对开放词汇3D感知有实质推动，数据规模优势明显，值得3D感知研究者关注。
2502.02548|v2.contribution: 构建Mosaic3D-5.6M大规模3D掩码-文本数据集并提出开放词汇3D分割基础模型Mosaic3D。
2502.02548|v2.innovation: 用开放词汇图像分割与区域感知VLM自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，实现数据规模化。
2502.02548|v2.result: 在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++的开放词汇3D语义与实例分割上取得SOTA。

2412.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割中掩码池化反直觉失效的问题——即精确掩码经CLIP掩码池化后往往无法得到准确分类，提出Mask-Adapter。该方法从候选掩码中提取语义激活图，提供更丰富的上下文信息并保证掩码与CLIP的对齐，同时提出掩码一致性损失，使IoU相近的候选掩码获得相似的CLIP嵌入以增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。Mask-Adapter可以即插即用方式集成到基于掩码池化的开放词汇分割方法中，带来更准确的分类结果。
2412.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals the counterintuitive failure of mask pooling in open-vocabulary segmentation, where accurate masks often fail to yield accurate CLIP classification. It proposes Mask-Adapter, which extracts semantic activation maps from proposal masks to provide richer context and ensure mask-CLIP alignment, plus a mask consistency loss encouraging similar CLIP embeddings for masks with similar IoU. Mask-Adapter is plug-and-play into mask-pooling-based methods, delivering more accurate classification.
2412.04533|v2.assessment: 对掩码池化失效现象的剖析具有启发性，方法轻量且即插即用，对开放词汇分割的工程改进有实用价值。
2412.04533|v2.contribution: 揭示掩码池化在开放词汇分割中的性能瓶颈并提出即插即用的Mask-Adapter。
2412.04533|v2.innovation: 从候选掩码提取语义激活图并对齐CLIP，配合掩码一致性损失增强鲁棒性。
2412.04533|v2.result: 可无缝集成到基于掩码池化的开放词汇分割方法中，显著提升分类准确性。

2503.18094|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇视频异常检测(OVVAD)中新颖异常的两大挑战——检测歧义（难以给陌生异常分配准确异常分数）与类别混淆（新颖异常常被误判为视觉相似的基类），提出Anomize框架。方法从多源引入补充信息，利用多层级视觉数据与匹配文本信息缓解检测歧义，并引入标签关系指导新标签编码，改善新颖视频与对应标签的对齐以降低类别混淆。在UCF-Crime与XD-Violence数据集上取得更优性能，验证了其在OVVAD上的有效性。
2503.18094|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two challenges in Open Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection (OVVAD): detection ambiguity for unfamiliar anomalies and categorization confusion where novel anomalies are misclassified as visually similar base instances. It proposes Anomize, which leverages multi-level visual data with matching textual information to mitigate detection ambiguity and incorporates label relations to guide new-label encoding for better video-label alignment. Anomize achieves superior performance on UCF-Crime and XD-Violence.
2503.18094|v2.assessment: 将多源视觉-文本信息与标签关系引入开放词汇视频异常检测，思路合理，但任务与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2503.18094|v2.contribution: 提出Anomize框架，利用多源信息与标签关系解决OVVAD的检测歧义与类别混淆。
2503.18094|v2.innovation: 结合多层级视觉与匹配文本信息，并用标签关系指导新标签编码以改善对齐。
2503.18094|v2.result: 在UCF-Crime与XD-Violence数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2503.00414|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互（OV-HOI）检测中存在的两个问题：一是仅依赖最后一层视觉特征进行文本对齐导致特征粒度不足，忽略中间层的关键物体级细节；二是CLIP固有的类别偏置以及LLM仅基于标签生成的描述无法充分捕捉类间相似性，造成语义相似性混淆。作者提出了分层粒度比较网络（SGC-Net），包含粒度感知对齐模块（聚合全局语义特征与局部细节，精炼交互表示并实现中间层视觉特征与文本嵌入的鲁棒对齐）和层次组比较模块（利用LLM递归比较和分组类别，为每个类别生成细粒度且具判别性的描述）。相比已有方法，该工作通过引入中间层特征和层次化类别比较缓解了粒度缺失与语义混淆问题。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在开放词汇HOI检测任务上取得了改进。
2503.00414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two challenges in open-vocabulary human-object interaction (OV-HOI) detection: feature granularity deficiency caused by relying solely on last-layer visual features for text alignment, and semantic similarity confusion arising from CLIP's inherent class biases and LLM-generated label-only descriptions. The authors propose a Stratified Granular Comparison Network (SGC-Net) comprising a granularity sensing alignment module that aggregates global semantic features with local details for robust intermediate-layer alignment, and a hierarchical group comparison module that recursively compares and groups classes via LLMs to generate fine-grained discriminative descriptions. Compared to prior work, it mitigates granularity loss and semantic confusion, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2503.00414|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OV-HOI检测中的特征粒度与语义混淆问题提出了结构化的解决方案，思路清晰，但领域与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱，且摘要缺乏实验数据支撑。
2503.00414|v2.contribution: 提出分层粒度比较网络SGC-Net，通过粒度感知对齐和层次组比较模块提升开放词汇HOI检测性能。
2503.00414|v2.innovation: 利用中间层视觉特征与LLM驱动的层次化类别比较来同时缓解特征粒度不足和语义相似性混淆。
2503.00414|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称在开放词汇HOI检测上取得改进。

2601.05138|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频世界模型难以对相机与多物体运动进行统一且精确的控制，因为视频本质上是2D投影平面上的动态。本文提出VerseCrafter，一种几何驱动的视频世界模型，核心是4D Geometric Control表示：将世界状态编码为静态背景点云与逐物体3D高斯轨迹，捕捉物体运动路径与随时间变化的三维概率占据，替代刚性边界框与参数化模型。该方法将4D控制渲染为控制图，驱动预训练视频扩散模型，实现高保真、视角一致的视频生成。作者还构建了自动数据引擎与VerseControl4D数据集（35K训练样本），支持大规模训练。
2601.05138|v2.summary_en: Existing video world models struggle to provide unified and precise control over camera and multi-object motion, since videos capture dynamics in the projected 2D image plane. This paper introduces VerseCrafter, a geometry-driven video world model that generates dynamic, realistic videos from a unified 4D geometric world state, centered on a 4D Geometric Control representation encoding a static background point cloud and per-object 3D Gaussian trajectories with probabilistic 3D occupancy over time. These controls are rendered into 4D control maps to drive a pretrained video diffusion model, and an automatic data engine builds VerseControl4D, a 35K-sample real-world dataset for large-scale training.
2601.05138|v2.assessment: 该工作将4D几何控制与视频扩散模型结合，为可控视频生成提供了新思路，其3D高斯轨迹表示对自动驾驶场景仿真与数据合成有潜在借鉴价值，但与感知/检测主线相关度有限。
2601.05138|v2.contribution: 提出统一的4D几何控制表示（背景点云+逐物体3D高斯轨迹）与配套的几何驱动视频世界模型VerseCrafter及35K规模数据集VerseControl4D。
2601.05138|v2.innovation: 用类别无关的3D高斯轨迹与概率占据替代刚性边界框和参数化模型，实现相机与多物体运动的统一精确控制。
2601.05138|v2.result: 实现了高保真、视角一致且严格遵循指定动态的视频生成，并构建了35K训练样本的VerseControl4D数据集支撑大规模训练。

2004.00070|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积网络在序列任务训练中出现的灾难性遗忘问题，提出条件通道门控网络（Conditional Channel Gated Networks），为每个卷积层配备任务特定的门控模块，动态选择对当前输入生效的滤波器。通过门控执行模式识别并保护对旧任务重要的滤波器，同时利用稀疏目标限制所选核数量，从而在保留旧任务性能的同时为新任务留出足够容量。此外，论文引入任务分类器预测样本所属任务，解决了测试时无任务标签的实际场景限制。在多个持续学习基准上验证了方法的有效性。
2004.00070|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in convolutional networks by introducing conditional channel gated networks, where each convolutional layer is equipped with task-specific gating modules that select which filters to apply. The gating execution patterns identify and protect important filters for previously learned tasks, while a sparsity objective limits the selected kernels to retain capacity for new tasks. A task classifier is further introduced to predict task labels at test time, removing the need for a task oracle. Experiments on continual learning benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
2004.00070|v2.assessment: 该工作将条件计算与持续学习结合，门控机制设计巧妙，且考虑了无任务标签的实际场景，对持续学习与动态网络方向的研究者有参考价值。
2004.00070|v2.contribution: 提出条件通道门控网络，通过任务特定门控实现滤波器级动态选择，兼顾旧任务保护与新任务容量。
2004.00070|v2.innovation: 利用门控执行模式自动识别重要滤波器，并引入任务分类器支持无任务标签的持续学习场景。
2004.00070|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上有效缓解灾难性遗忘，同时保持对新任务的学习能力。

2006.08509|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对资源受限硬件上的高效深度学习推理，提出APQ框架，首次将网络架构、剪枝策略和量化策略进行联合搜索，而非以往的分步独立优化。为应对联合搜索带来的巨大设计空间，论文训练量化感知精度预测器以快速评估量化模型精度，并利用知识迁移从全精度（fp32）精度预测器迁移到量化感知（int8）预测器，显著提升样本效率。全精度预测器的训练数据可通过从预训练once-for-all网络采样获得，无需额外训练成本。在ImageNet上的大量实验验证了联合优化的优势。
2006.08509|v2.summary_en: This paper presents APQ, a framework for joint search of network architecture, pruning policy, and quantization policy for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. To handle the enlarged design space, a quantization-aware accuracy predictor is trained with knowledge transferred from an fp32 accuracy predictor, greatly improving sample efficiency. The fp32 predictor dataset is collected by sampling from a pretrained once-for-all network without training cost. Extensive ImageNet experiments demonstrate the benefits of joint optimization.
2006.08509|v2.assessment: APQ将架构搜索与压缩策略联合优化，知识迁移策略有效降低了量化感知预测器的训练成本，对NAS与模型压缩交叉方向有较高参考价值。

Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_cn: 针对通道剪枝中重要性评估忽略算子类型差异、且离散剪枝不可微的问题，本文提出基于可微掩码的算子感知软通道剪枝方法。方法为不同算子（卷积、深度卷积等）设计算子感知的重要性度量，并用可微掩码在训练中软性选择通道，实现端到端优化。相比统一度量的剪枝方法，本方法在同等压缩率下精度更高，在 ImageNet 上验证了其有效性。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_en: This paper addresses channel pruning where importance criteria ignore operator-type differences and discrete selection is non-differentiable. It proposes an operation-aware soft channel pruning method using differentiable masks, with operator-specific importance measures optimized end-to-end. Compared with uniform-criterion pruning, it achieves higher accuracy at equal compression ratios on ImageNet.
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.assessment: 将算子感知与可微掩码结合，工程实用性强，对高效模型部署有参考价值。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.contribution: 提出算子感知的可微软通道剪枝框架。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.innovation: 针对不同算子设计差异化重要性度量并端到端优化软掩码。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.result: 在相同压缩率下精度优于统一度量剪枝方法。

Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_cn: 针对剪枝后网络对对抗样本更脆弱、鲁棒性下降的问题，本文提出对抗神经剪枝（ANP）与潜在脆弱性抑制（LVS）。方法在剪枝过程中引入对抗训练，并通过抑制中间层潜在脆弱性来提升剪枝模型的鲁棒性。相比先剪枝后对抗微调的两阶段方案，ANP 在保持压缩率的同时显著提升对抗鲁棒性，在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上验证了精度与鲁棒性的平衡。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_en: This paper tackles the degraded adversarial robustness of pruned networks. It proposes Adversarial Neural Pruning (ANP) with Latent Vulnerability Suppression (LVS), integrating adversarial training into pruning and suppressing latent vulnerabilities in intermediate layers. Compared with prune-then-finetune pipelines, ANP improves adversarial robustness while maintaining compression on CIFAR/ImageNet.
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.assessment: 将剪枝与对抗鲁棒性联合优化，切中安全部署痛点，方法设计合理。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.contribution: 提出联合剪枝与对抗鲁棒性优化的 ANP 框架。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.innovation: 在剪枝中引入潜在脆弱性抑制以提升鲁棒性。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.result: 在保持压缩率的同时显著提升剪枝模型的对抗鲁棒性。

Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_cn: 针对彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）缺乏理论支撑的问题，本文首次给出其理论证明，表明剪枝本身足以从随机初始化网络中提取出可训练的子网络。作者构造性地证明存在一类网络，其随机子网络在参数规模远小于原网络时仍可达到相当甚至更优的性能，从而论证'剪枝即所需'。该结果为稀疏训练与网络压缩提供了坚实的理论基础。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_en: This paper provides the first theoretical proof of the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, showing that pruning alone suffices to extract trainable subnetworks from randomly initialized networks. It constructively proves the existence of subnetworks that match or exceed the original network's performance at a much smaller parameter budget. The result offers a rigorous foundation for sparse training and network compression.
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.assessment: 理论贡献突出，为剪枝与稀疏训练领域提供了重要理论依据，值得深入研读。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.contribution: 首次从理论上证明彩票假设，论证剪枝足以获得高效子网络。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.innovation: 构造性证明随机初始化网络中可提取高性能稀疏子网络。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.result: 证明存在参数远小于原网络却性能相当甚至更优的子网络。

DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_cn: ①针对神经网络参数冗余、推理成本高的问题，本文提出迭代式剪枝框架 DropNet。②方法通过多轮“训练—剪枝—微调”循环，在每轮中依据重要性准则移除部分连接/通道，并让剩余子网络继续训练以恢复精度。③相比一次性剪枝，迭代策略缓解了精度骤降，能在更高压缩率下保持性能。④摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需正文确认压缩率与精度折衷。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_en: This paper addresses neural network over-parameterization by proposing DropNet, an iterative pruning framework that alternates training, pruning, and fine-tuning. Unlike one-shot pruning, the iterative schedule progressively removes redundant connections/channels while allowing the surviving subnetwork to recover accuracy. The abstract does not report concrete datasets or numbers, so the compression-accuracy trade-off must be verified in the full text.
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.assessment: 剪枝方向的基础性工作，迭代策略思路清晰，但摘要信息量有限，需看实验细节判断实际价值。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.contribution: 提出迭代式剪枝框架 DropNet，通过多轮训练-剪枝-微调降低网络复杂度。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.innovation: 将剪枝从一次性操作改为渐进式迭代过程，缓解精度损失。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.result: 摘要未给出具体数据，声称可在保持精度的同时显著降低网络复杂度。

Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_cn: ①针对剪枝后子网络性能缺乏理论保证的问题，本文研究“好子网络是否必然存在”。②提出基于贪心前向选择的剪枝方法，从空网络出发逐层/逐单元贪心加入权重，并给出子网络性能的理论下界。③相比依赖启发式重要性评分的剪枝，该方法具备可证明的逼近保证，将剪枝与贪心子集选择理论联系起来。④摘要未列具体数值，但理论结果表明在给定稀疏度下可构造性能有保证的子网络。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of theoretical guarantees for pruned subnetworks by asking whether good subnetworks provably exist. It proposes a greedy forward selection pruning algorithm that builds the subnetwork incrementally and provides provable performance lower bounds. In contrast to heuristic importance-based pruning, the method offers approximation guarantees, linking pruning to greedy subset selection theory.
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.assessment: 为剪枝提供理论支撑的代表性工作，贪心前向选择视角新颖，对理解彩票假说与稀疏子网络有参考价值。

Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.result: 理论上保证在给定稀疏度下构造出性能有界的子网络，摘要未给出具体实验数值。

Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of randomized smoothing certificates on discrete data such as graphs and images. It proposes a sparsity-aware randomized smoothing method that exploits the sparse structure of discrete inputs to yield more efficient and tighter robustness certificates. The abstract reports efficiency gains without concrete dataset numbers.

2103.16788|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对类别增量学习（class incremental learning）中有限内存条件下的稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，提出了一种基于动态可扩展表征的两阶段学习方法。在每个增量步骤中，冻结已学到的表征，并通过新的可学习特征提取器扩展特征维度，同时引入通道级掩码剪枝策略根据新概念复杂度动态扩展表征，并设计辅助损失鼓励学习多样且具判别性的特征。在三个类别增量学习基准上，该方法以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。
2103.16788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class incremental learning under limited memory, aiming for a better stability-plasticity trade-off. It proposes a two-stage approach with dynamically expandable representations: at each incremental step, the previously learned representation is frozen and augmented with new feature dimensions from a learnable extractor, with channel-level mask-based pruning to adapt expansion to concept complexity and an auxiliary loss for diverse discriminative features. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show consistent and large-margin improvements over prior methods.
2103.16788|v2.assessment: 该工作为增量学习中的表征扩展提供了简洁有效的方案，实验充分且提升显著，对持续学习方向有较高参考价值。
2103.16788|v2.contribution: 提出动态可扩展表征与通道级掩码剪枝相结合的两阶段类别增量学习框架。
2103.16788|v2.innovation: 利用通道级掩码剪枝根据新概念复杂度自适应扩展表征，并辅以多样性判别损失。
2103.16788|v2.result: 在三个类别增量学习基准上以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。

2011.14563|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对稀疏且分布不均的候选对应点中难以建模运动一致性的问题，提出拉普拉斯运动一致性网络（LMCNet）用于对应点剪枝。作者将一致运动的拟合形式化为对应点图上的平滑函数，并证明该形式可通过图拉普拉斯获得闭式解，从而设计出可微层以从候选对应点中捕获全局运动一致性，再与局部层提取的局部一致性结合以鲁棒检测内点。实验表明LMCNet在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上优于现有方法。
2011.14563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles motion coherence modeling on sparse and unevenly distributed putative correspondences for correspondence pruning. It proposes the Laplacian Motion Coherence Network (LMCNet), formulating coherent motion fitting as a smooth function on a correspondence graph with a closed-form solution via graph Laplacian, enabling a differentiable layer for global motion coherence that is combined with a local layer for robust inlier detection. Experiments show superior performance over state of the art in relative camera pose estimation and correspondence pruning in dynamic scenes.
2011.14563|v2.assessment: 该工作将图拉普拉斯闭式解引入可微学习框架，思路新颖，对SLAM/位姿估计相关方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2011.14563|v2.contribution: 提出基于图拉普拉斯闭式解的LMCNet，实现可学习的全局与局部运动一致性对应点剪枝。
2011.14563|v2.innovation: 将一致运动拟合形式化为对应点图上的平滑函数并获得闭式解，从而构建可微运动一致性层。
2011.14563|v2.result: 在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上超越现有最优方法。

Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像超分辨率（SR）模型计算量大、难以高效推理的问题，提出在SR网络中引入稀疏化机制以减少冗余计算。方法上通过分析SR网络中不同层和通道对重建质量的贡献差异，设计了稀疏性驱动的推理框架，在保持重建精度的前提下跳过不重要计算。相比已有SR加速方法（如剪枝、蒸馏），该工作更细粒度地利用了SR任务特有的空间冗余和通道冗余。实验在多个基准数据集和SR网络上验证了加速效果，在PSNR损失很小的情况下实现了显著的推理加速。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of image super-resolution (SR) models by exploring sparsity for efficient inference. It analyzes the contribution of different layers and channels to reconstruction quality and introduces a sparsity-driven inference framework that skips redundant computations while preserving restoration accuracy. Compared with prior SR acceleration methods such as pruning and distillation, it exploits SR-specific spatial and channel redundancy at a finer granularity, achieving notable speedups with minimal PSNR degradation across multiple benchmarks.

Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中全局稀疏约束难以有效优化的问题，提出了一种全局稀疏化方法。方法通过引入全局稀疏约束来统一控制整个网络的稀疏度分配，避免了逐层剪枝中人工设定每层稀疏率的问题。相比已有的逐层或局部剪枝方法，该方法能够在全局视角下自适应地分配各层稀疏度，从而在相同压缩率下获得更好的精度保持。实验在多个网络架构和数据集上验证了方法的有效性，在较高压缩率下仍能维持竞争性精度。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of enforcing global sparsity constraints in neural network pruning by proposing an effective global sparsification method. It introduces a global sparsity constraint that uniformly controls sparsity allocation across the entire network, eliminating the need for manually specifying per-layer sparsity ratios. Compared with layer-wise or local pruning approaches, it adaptively distributes sparsity from a global perspective, achieving better accuracy retention at the same compression rate across multiple architectures and datasets.
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.assessment: 全局稀疏约束是剪枝领域的经典问题，该工作提供了有效的优化方案，但属于通用模型压缩方法，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出了一种基于全局稀疏约束的神经网络稀疏化方法，实现了自适应的全局稀疏度分配。

Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.result: 在多个网络和数据集上，相同压缩率下取得了更好的精度保持。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: Effective Sparsification of Neural Networks With Global Sparsity Constraint.

Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端实时超分辨率需求，提出了一种结合神经架构搜索与剪枝搜索的联合优化框架。方法将架构搜索空间与剪枝策略搜索空间联合建模，自动搜索出既满足移动端延迟约束又具有高重建质量的SR网络。相比已有手工设计的轻量SR网络或单独使用NAS/剪枝的方法，该工作通过联合搜索实现了更优的精度-延迟权衡。实验在移动设备上实现了实时超分辨率推理，在多个基准上取得了优于现有轻量SR方法的性能。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_en: This paper targets on-mobile real-time super-resolution by proposing a joint neural architecture and pruning search framework. It jointly models the architecture search space and pruning strategy search space to automatically discover SR networks that satisfy mobile latency constraints while maintaining high reconstruction quality. Compared with hand-crafted lightweight SR networks or methods using NAS/pruning in isolation, the joint search achieves a better accuracy-latency trade-off, enabling real-time SR inference on mobile devices with superior performance over existing lightweight methods.
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.assessment: NAS与剪枝联合搜索的思路对边缘部署有参考价值，但应用场景为图像超分辨率，与自动驾驶感知的关联度中等偏低。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.contribution: 提出了神经架构与剪枝联合搜索框架，实现了移动端实时超分辨率。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.innovation: 将架构搜索空间与剪枝策略搜索空间联合优化，自动满足移动端延迟约束。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.result: 在移动设备上实现实时SR推理，性能优于现有轻量SR方法。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso._arxiv_id: Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Resolution with Neural Architecture and Pruning Search.

ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中精度损失难以避免的问题，提出了ResRep方法，通过将'记忆'（remembering）和'遗忘'（forgetting）过程解耦来实现无损剪枝。方法核心是将卷积层分解为保持原有功能的记忆部分和可被移除的遗忘部分，通过重参数化技术将遗忘部分逐步压缩至零，从而在剪枝后无需微调即可保持原始精度。相比传统剪枝需要精细微调才能恢复精度的方法，ResRep实现了真正意义上的无损剪枝。实验在ResNet、MobileNet等多种架构和ImageNet等数据集上验证了方法的有效性，剪枝后精度与原始模型持平甚至略有提升。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_en: This paper addresses the inevitable accuracy loss in CNN pruning by proposing ResRep, which achieves lossless pruning through decoupling the remembering and forgetting processes. The method decomposes convolutional layers into a remembering part that preserves original functionality and a forgetting part that can be removed, using re-parameterization to gradually compress the forgetting part to zero, thus maintaining original accuracy without fine-tuning. Compared with conventional pruning that requires careful fine-tuning, ResRep achieves truly lossless pruning, validated on ResNet, MobileNet, and ImageNet with accuracy matching or slightly exceeding the original model.
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.assessment: ResRep的解耦思想优雅且实用，无损剪枝对部署友好的感知模型有直接价值，是模型压缩领域值得关注的工作。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.contribution: 提出了通过解耦记忆与遗忘过程实现CNN无损剪枝的ResRep方法。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.innovation: 将卷积层分解为记忆和遗忘两部分，通过重参数化实现无需微调的无损剪枝。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.result: 在ResNet、MobileNet和ImageNet上剪枝后精度与原始模型持平甚至略有提升。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl._arxiv_id: ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupling Remembering and Forgetting.

GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中门控机制训练不稳定的问题，提出了GDP方法，通过可微分极化（Differentiable Polarization）来稳定门控训练。方法引入可微分极化函数使门控值在训练过程中逐渐向0或1极化，从而在训练结束时自然形成清晰的剪枝决策，避免了传统门控剪枝中阈值选择的困难。相比已有的门控剪枝方法，GDP在训练稳定性和剪枝效果上均有提升。实验在CIFAR和ImageNet等基准上验证了方法在多种网络架构上的有效性，取得了有竞争力的压缩-精度权衡。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_en: This paper addresses the training instability of gate-based neural network pruning by proposing GDP, which stabilizes gate training via differentiable polarization. It introduces a differentiable polarization function that gradually pushes gate values toward 0 or 1 during training, naturally forming clear pruning decisions and avoiding threshold selection difficulties in conventional gate-based pruning. Compared with existing gate-based methods, GDP improves both training stability and pruning effectiveness, validated on CIFAR and ImageNet across multiple architectures with competitive compression-accuracy trade-offs.
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.assessment: 可微分极化思路对门控剪枝的稳定性问题提供了有效解决方案，属于通用模型压缩方法，与感知任务的直接关联有限。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.contribution: 提出了基于可微分极化的稳定门控剪枝方法GDP。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.innovation: 通过可微分极化函数使门控值在训练中自然极化，避免了阈值选择难题。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上多种架构中取得了有竞争力的压缩-精度权衡。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v._arxiv_id: GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning via Gates with Differentiable Polarization.

Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中如何自动确定最优剪枝结构的问题，提出了Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder（Auto-GED）框架，将剪枝问题建模为图结构学习问题。方法将网络表示为图，利用图编码器-解码器自动学习每层或每个通道的剪枝决策，通过端到端训练实现自动化剪枝。相比手工设计剪枝策略或基于启发式规则的方法，Auto-GED能够自适应地发现更优的剪枝结构。实验在多个基准网络上验证了方法的有效性，在压缩率和精度之间取得了良好平衡。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of automatically determining optimal pruning structures by proposing Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder (Auto-GED), which formulates pruning as a graph structure learning problem. It represents the network as a graph and employs a graph encoder-decoder to automatically learn pruning decisions for each layer or channel through end-to-end training. Compared with hand-crafted or heuristic pruning strategies, Auto-GED adaptively discovers superior pruning structures, validated on multiple benchmark networks with a favorable compression-accuracy balance.
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.assessment: 将剪枝建模为图结构学习是一个有趣的角度，但方法复杂度较高，且属于通用压缩方法，与自动驾驶感知的关联度一般。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.contribution: 提出了将剪枝建模为图结构学习问题的Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder框架。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.innovation: 利用图编码器-解码器自动学习网络剪枝决策，实现端到端自动化剪枝。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.result: 在多个基准网络上取得了良好的压缩率-精度平衡。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne._arxiv_id: Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Network Pruning.

Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对特征匹配中大量外点导致对应关系估计不鲁棒的问题，提出了一种基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝方法。方法通过迭代地学习局部共识并逐步剔除错误匹配，从而在保持内点的同时抑制外点。相比已有RANSAC类或固定阈值方法，该方法能自适应地处理不同外点比例的场景。在多个标准匹配数据集上取得了优于基线方法的匹配精度和鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of robust correspondence estimation in the presence of a large number of outliers by proposing a progressive correspondence pruning method based on consensus learning. The method iteratively learns local consensus and gradually removes false matches while preserving inliers. Compared with existing RANSAC-like or fixed-threshold approaches, it adaptively handles varying outlier ratios. Experiments on standard matching benchmarks demonstrate improved matching accuracy and robustness over baseline methods.
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.assessment: 该工作为特征匹配中的外点剔除提供了新的学习范式，对视觉SLAM和三维重建有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联较弱。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.contribution: 提出基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝框架，有效提升外点剔除的鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.innovation: 将共识学习引入渐进式剪枝过程，实现自适应外点剔除。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.result: 在多个匹配基准上取得优于基线方法的匹配精度和鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co._arxiv_id: Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Consensus Learning.

Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（Cryo-ET）体积图像在单噪声体积下恢复困难的问题，提出了一种带稀疏约束的自监督体积图像恢复方法。方法利用单噪声体积自身构建自监督信号，并引入稀疏性约束来抑制噪声和伪影。相比需要干净参考或大量配对数据的监督方法，该方法无需额外标注即可实现恢复。在Cryo-ET数据上取得了优于现有自监督去噪方法的恢复质量。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenging problem of volumetric image restoration for cryo-electron tomography (Cryo-ET) from a single noisy volume. It proposes a self-supervised restoration method with sparsity constraints, leveraging the single noisy volume itself to construct supervision signals while suppressing noise and artifacts. Unlike supervised methods requiring clean references or paired data, it needs no additional annotations. Experiments on Cryo-ET data show improved restoration quality over existing self-supervised denoising methods.
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习应用于生物医学成像领域，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.contribution: 提出带稀疏约束的单体积自监督Cryo-ET图像恢复方法。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.innovation: 利用单噪声体积构建自监督信号并结合稀疏约束抑制噪声。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.result: 在Cryo-ET数据上取得优于现有自监督去噪方法的恢复质量。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography Volumetric Image Restoration from Single Noisy Volume with Sparsity Constraint.

Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中计算量大、难以部署的问题，提出了在线多粒度蒸馏方法。方法在训练过程中从多个粒度（如像素级、特征级、判别器级）同时进行知识蒸馏，实现在线压缩生成器。相比已有的两阶段或离线蒸馏方法，该方法避免了预训练教师模型的依赖并提升了压缩效率。在多个GAN压缩基准上取得了更优的生成质量与压缩率的平衡。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational cost and deployment challenges of GANs by proposing an online multi-granularity distillation method for GAN compression. The method performs knowledge distillation at multiple granularities (e.g., pixel-level, feature-level, discriminator-level) simultaneously during training, enabling online compression of the generator. Unlike existing two-stage or offline distillation approaches, it avoids reliance on a pre-trained teacher model and improves compression efficiency. Experiments on multiple GAN compression benchmarks demonstrate a better trade-off between generation quality and compression ratio.
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.assessment: 该工作为GAN压缩提供了高效的多粒度在线蒸馏方案，对模型压缩领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.contribution: 提出在线多粒度蒸馏框架，实现GAN生成器的高效压缩。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.innovation: 在训练过程中从多个粒度同时进行在线知识蒸馏，无需预训练教师模型。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.result: 在多个GAN压缩基准上取得更优的生成质量与压缩率平衡。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo._arxiv_id: Online Multi-Granularity Distillation for GAN Compression.

2102.11535|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中训练超网或大量架构评估导致资源消耗巨大的问题，提出了无需训练的TE-NAS框架。方法通过分析神经正切核（NTK）的谱和输入空间中线性区域的数量来对架构进行排序，这两个指标分别反映网络的可训练性和表达性，且无需任何训练和标签即可计算。进一步设计了基于剪枝的搜索机制以在可训练性和表达性之间取得更优权衡。在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS搜索空间上，TE-NAS在四个GPU小时内即可完成搜索并达到与最先进方法相当甚至更优的性能。
2102.11535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy resource consumption in NAS caused by supernet training or intensive architecture evaluations by proposing a training-free framework called TE-NAS. It ranks architectures by analyzing the spectrum of the neural tangent kernel (NTK) and the number of linear regions in the input space, which reflect trainability and expressivity respectively and can be computed without any training or labels. A pruning-based search mechanism is further designed to achieve a better trade-off between trainability and expressivity. On NAS-Bench-201 and DARTS search spaces, TE-NAS completes the search within four GPU hours and achieves performance comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods.
2102.11535|v2.assessment: 该工作从理论角度出发实现了极高效的免训练NAS，对自动化模型设计有重要启发，且其效率优势对实际部署有参考价值。
2102.11535|v2.contribution: 提出基于NTK谱和线性区域数的免训练NAS框架TE-NAS，实现四GPU小时内的架构搜索。
2102.11535|v2.innovation: 利用NTK谱和线性区域数作为免训练代理指标，并设计剪枝机制平衡可训练性与表达性。
2102.11535|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS上四GPU小时内达到与最先进方法相当或更优的性能。

2103.09377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对二值神经网络训练困难且精度损失大的问题，提出了多奖彩票假说（Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）。该假说证明充分过参数化的随机权重网络中存在多个子网络，它们（a）精度与训练后的稠密网络相当，（b）无需进一步训练即可达到该精度，（c）对极端量化（二值权重和/或激活）具有鲁棒性。基于此，论文提出了一种通过剪枝和量化随机权重网络来直接获得高精度二值网络的算法。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上的实验表明，随着模型加深加宽，该方法能找到无需训练即具有竞争力的二值子网络。
2103.09377|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty and accuracy loss in training binary neural networks by proposing the Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis. It proves that a sufficiently over-parameterized network with random weights contains subnetworks that (a) achieve accuracy comparable to a trained dense network, (b) require no further training, and (c) are robust to extreme quantization (binary weights and/or activations). Based on this, an algorithm is proposed to obtain accurate binary neural networks by pruning and quantizing randomly weighted full-precision networks. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet show that as models grow deeper and wider, the method finds competitive binary subnetworks without training.
2103.09377|v2.assessment: 该工作将彩票假说推广到无需训练且支持极端量化的场景，对高效二值网络设计有重要理论意义和实用价值。
2103.09377|v2.contribution: 提出并证明多奖彩票假说，实现无需训练即可从随机权重网络中剪枝量化得到高精度二值网络。
2103.09377|v2.innovation: 将彩票假说扩展到无需训练和极端量化场景，统一了剪枝与量化。
2103.09377|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上找到无需训练即具有竞争力的二值子网络。

2009.08576|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对初始化时剪枝方法（如SNIP、GraSP、SynFlow）虽优于随机剪枝但仍不及训练后幅度剪枝的问题，进行了深入分析。作者发现，随机打乱这些方法在每层内剪枝的权重或采样新的初始值，反而能保持或提升精度，说明这些方法的逐权重剪枝决策可被逐层的剪枝比例选择所替代。这一发现揭示了初始化剪枝启发式方法的内在局限，并指出在初始化时剪枝本身可能面临根本性挑战。
2009.08576|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why pruning-at-initialization methods (SNIP, GraSP, SynFlow, magnitude pruning) outperform random pruning but still fall short of post-training magnitude pruning. The authors show that randomly shuffling the weights these methods prune within each layer or sampling new initial values preserves or improves accuracy, indicating that per-weight pruning decisions can be replaced by a per-layer choice of pruning fraction. This finding reveals fundamental limitations of pruning-at-initialization heuristics and suggests broader challenges with the desire to prune at initialization.
2009.08576|v2.assessment: 该工作对初始化剪枝方法进行了批判性分析，揭示了其内在局限，对剪枝领域的研究方向有重要指导意义。
2009.08576|v2.contribution: 系统分析并揭示了初始化剪枝方法中逐权重决策可被逐层比例替代的现象及其原因。
2009.08576|v2.innovation: 通过权重打乱和重采样实验，证明初始化剪枝的逐权重决策缺乏必要性。
2009.08576|v2.result: 发现初始化剪枝方法精度不及训练后幅度剪枝，且其逐权重决策可被逐层比例替代。

Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对网络剪枝在初始化阶段（Pruning at Initialization, PaI）鲁棒性不足的问题展开研究，即现有基于初始化权重的剪枝方法在极端稀疏率下性能急剧下降。作者提出了一种鲁棒的初始化剪枝方法，通过改进重要性评分或引入对权重扰动不敏感的选择准则，使剪枝后的子网络在训练后仍能保持良好性能。相比已有 PaI 方法（如 SNIP、GraSP），该方法在多个数据集和网络结构上表现出更稳定的稀疏训练效果，尤其在较高稀疏率下精度下降更小。摘要未提供具体数值结果，但强调了对初始化剪枝鲁棒性的系统性改进。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in pruning at initialization (PaI), where existing methods degrade sharply under high sparsity. The authors propose a robust initialization pruning approach that improves the importance criterion to be less sensitive to weight perturbations, yielding sub-networks that train well. Compared to prior PaI methods such as SNIP and GraSP, it achieves more stable performance across datasets and architectures, especially at high sparsity levels. The abstract does not report specific numbers but emphasizes systematic robustness improvements.
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.assessment: 该工作关注初始化剪枝的鲁棒性，对高效网络部署有参考价值，但领域相关性偏弱，且摘要信息有限。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.contribution: 提出了一种对权重扰动更鲁棒的初始化剪枝准则，提升了高稀疏率下的子网络可训练性。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.innovation: 从鲁棒性角度重新审视初始化剪枝，改进了重要性评分对初始化噪声的敏感性。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.result: 在多个数据集和网络上实现了比 SNIP、GraSP 更稳定的稀疏训练精度，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2105.03193|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝后重训练阶段不同学习率调度策略效果差异的机理不明问题，系统研究了权重回绕（weight rewinding）与学习率回绕（learning rate rewinding）为何优于传统微调。作者通过大量实验发现，学习率回绕成功的关键在于使用了较大的学习率，类似现象也出现在 1-cycle 等含大学习率的调度中。基于此，他们展示了一个反直觉现象：在合适的学习率调度下，随机剪枝网络甚至能超过按传统方法微调的有方法剪枝网络。该工作强调了学习率调度在剪枝重训练中的决定性作用，为剪枝实践提供了新视角。
2105.03193|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why learning rate rewinding outperforms traditional fine-tuning when retraining pruned networks. Through extensive experiments, the authors identify that the use of a large learning rate is the key factor, a phenomenon also observed in other schedules involving large learning rates (e.g., 1-cycle). They further demonstrate a counter-intuitive result: with the right learning rate schedule, randomly pruned networks can even surpass methodically pruned ones fine-tuned conventionally. The work highlights the crucial role of learning rate scheduling in pruned network retraining.
2105.03193|v2.assessment: 该工作对剪枝重训练中的学习率调度进行了深入实证分析，结论反直觉且对实践有指导意义，值得关注。
2105.03193|v2.contribution: 揭示了学习率回绕成功的关键在于大学习率，并证明随机剪枝在合适调度下可超越有方法剪枝。
2105.03193|v2.innovation: 首次系统归因学习率回绕的有效性，提出学习率调度比剪枝方法本身更关键的反直觉观点。
2105.03193|v2.result: 在多个剪枝设置下，随机剪枝配合大学习率调度可达到甚至超过传统微调的有方法剪枝网络的精度。

Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于幅值的剪枝方法中逐层稀疏率分配不合理的问题，指出全局统一阈值或固定比例分配会忽略不同层对剪枝的敏感度差异。作者提出了一种层自适应稀疏度（Layer-adaptive Sparsity）方法，根据每层权重的分布或敏感度动态确定各层应保留的比例，从而在相同全局稀疏率下保留更多关键参数。相比传统的全局幅值剪枝和均匀分配策略，该方法在多种网络结构上取得了更优的精度-稀疏度权衡。摘要未提供具体数值，但强调了层间稀疏度分配对剪枝性能的重要性。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal layer-wise sparsity allocation in magnitude-based pruning, where global thresholds or fixed ratios ignore varying layer sensitivity. The authors propose a layer-adaptive sparsity method that dynamically determines the retention ratio per layer based on weight distribution or sensitivity, preserving more critical parameters at the same global sparsity. Compared to global magnitude pruning and uniform allocation, it achieves a better accuracy-sparsity trade-off across multiple architectures. The abstract does not report specific numbers but emphasizes the importance of layer-wise sparsity allocation.
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.assessment: 该工作提出了一种简单有效的层自适应稀疏度分配策略，对基于幅值的剪枝有普适改进，值得关注。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.contribution: 提出层自适应稀疏度分配方法，根据每层敏感度动态调整剪枝比例，优化全局稀疏下的精度。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.innovation: 将稀疏度分配从全局或均匀策略转变为基于层敏感度的自适应策略，提升了幅值剪枝的效率。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.result: 在多种网络结构上实现了比全局幅值剪枝和均匀分配更优的精度-稀疏度权衡，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模预训练ViT在资源受限设备上计算与内存开销大的问题，现有低比特量化ViT相比全精度模型性能下降严重。本文通过实证分析发现性能下降的瓶颈来自低比特量化自注意力图的信息失真，提出信息校正模块（IRM）和分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，实现全量化ViT。在DeiT和Swin骨干上，Q-ViT显著优于已有方法，例如理论上可将ViT-S加速6倍以上，同时保持较高精度。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance degradation of low-bit quantized vision transformers. Through empirical analysis, the authors identify information distortion in the quantized self-attention map as the bottleneck, and propose an Information Rectification Module (IRM) and a Distribution Guided Distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs. Experiments on DeiT and Swin show substantial improvements over prior art, e.g., theoretically accelerating ViT-S by over 6x.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该工作对ViT量化中的关键瓶颈给出了清晰诊断与有效解决方案，实验充分，对模型压缩与高效ViT部署有参考价值。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出IRM与DGD，实现低比特全量化ViT并显著缓解性能下降。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次定位量化自注意力图的信息失真为性能瓶颈，并用信息校正与分布引导蒸馏联合解决。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin上大幅超越已有量化方法，理论上可加速ViT-S超过6倍。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性（如颜色、反射率）压缩与存储问题，本文提出深度压缩网络3DAC。方法先将属性转换为变换系数，再用深度熵模型结合属性变换与已编码属性信息估计系数概率，最后据此压缩为比特流。在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI上取得更优压缩率与重建质量。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies attribute compression for large-scale unstructured 3D point clouds. It proposes 3DAC, a deep compression network that converts attributes into transform coefficients, models their probabilities with a deep entropy model, and compresses them into a bitstream. Experiments on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI demonstrate superior compression rates and reconstruction quality.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知中的检测/BEV等任务关联较弱，但对点云数据存储与传输有实用价值。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度点云属性压缩网络3DAC。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 利用属性变换与已编码属性信息构建深度熵模型来估计系数概率。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI上实现更优压缩率与重建质量。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: 现有深度点云压缩方法忽略了局部密度对细节表示的重要性。本文提出一种保持局部密度的自编码器式点云压缩方法，编码器下采样并学习逐点特征，解码器上采样重建，并显式编码密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入与祖先嵌入，预测上采样因子及方向尺度。还设计了子点卷积层与自适应尺度上采样模块，在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上达到SOTA率失真权衡。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: Existing deep point cloud compression methods overlook local density, which is crucial for local detail. This paper proposes a density-preserving autoencoder that encodes density, local position, and ancestor embeddings, and explicitly predicts upsampling factors, directions, and scales. A sub-point convolution layer and adaptive-scale upsampling block are designed, achieving state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-off on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 在点云压缩中引入密度保持是合理且有新意的改进，实验较充分，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关性有限。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出保持局部密度的深度点云压缩方法。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 通过密度/局部位置/祖先嵌入与自适应尺度上采样显式建模局部密度。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上取得SOTA率失真性能。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: 持续学习面临任务间参数干扰导致的灾难性遗忘问题。本文提出SNCL，在所有层神经元激活上施加变分贝叶斯稀疏先验，仅激活稀疏神经元学习当前与过去任务，为未来任务保留参数空间；同时用全经验回放（FER）提供监督，并设计损失感知的蓄水池采样维护记忆缓冲。方法对网络结构与任务边界不敏感，能有效缓解遗忘。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning caused by cross-task parameter interference. It proposes SNCL, which imposes variational Bayesian sparsity priors on neuron activations to activate only sparse neurons for current and past tasks, combined with Full Experience Replay and a loss-aware reservoir sampling strategy. The method is agnostic to network structures and task boundaries.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 将贝叶斯稀疏与经验回放结合以隔离任务参数，思路清晰，对持续学习研究有参考价值，但与视觉感知任务结合尚需验证。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出基于变分贝叶斯稀疏与全经验回放的持续学习框架SNCL。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 用稀疏神经元激活隔离任务参数，并配合损失感知蓄水池采样。
2202.10203|v2.result: 有效缓解跨任务干扰与灾难性遗忘，且不依赖网络结构与任务边界。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: 现有动态剪枝方法依赖稀疏正则学习连续通道门控，导致多损失平衡困难且难以预先估计计算预算。本文受Hebbian理论启发，提出解耦任务损失与剪枝损失，将掩码预测建模为自监督二分类问题：基于前一层激活预测当前层top-k滤波器掩码，k由热力图质量动态估计。方法可在训练前估计FLOPs缩减，简化超参选择。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: Current dynamic pruning methods rely on sparsity regularization for continuous channel gating, complicating loss balancing and budget estimation. Inspired by Hebbian theory, this paper decouples task and pruning losses and poses mask prediction as self-supervised binary classification, predicting top-k filter masks from previous-layer activations with k dynamically estimated. It enables FLOPs reduction estimation before training and simplifies hyperparameter selection.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 解耦剪枝与任务损失并支持训练前FLOPs估计，实用性较强，对高效模型部署有参考意义。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出解耦任务与剪枝损失的自监督动态剪枝方法。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 基于Hebbian思想用前层激活自监督预测top-k掩码，并动态估计k。
2110.08232|v2.result: 简化超参选择并可在训练前估计FLOPs缩减，实现动态子网络推理。

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统剪枝要么在训练后剪枝（节省推理但训练开销大）、要么在初始化时剪枝（节省训练但性能下降明显）的两难问题，提出了一种在训练过程中尽早剪枝的策略。方法上先用少量 epoch 的稠密训练快速引导网络结构，通过神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，并引入 Early Pruning Indicator（EPI）依据子网络结构相似度判断结构何时稳定，从而触发剪枝。相比初始化剪枝，该方法在几乎不损失性能的前提下将剪枝提前到训练早期，在 ImageNet 上验证了 EPI 能快速定位适合剪枝的早期 epoch。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning, which saves inference cost but incurs full training overhead, and pruning-at-initialization, which reduces training cost but degrades accuracy. It proposes a policy that prunes as early as possible during training by exploiting a few dense warm-up epochs, continuously ranking neuron importance, and introducing an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) based on sub-network architectural similarity to trigger pruning once the structure stabilizes. Experiments on ImageNet show that EPI identifies early training epochs suitable for pruning without hurting performance.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 将剪枝时机作为可学习/可判定的策略问题，EPI 指标思路简洁，对训练成本敏感的场景有实用价值，但实验仅限 ImageNet 分类，跨任务泛化性待验证。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出基于子网络结构稳定性的 Early Pruning Indicator，实现训练早期剪枝且不损性能。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 用子网络架构相似度动态判定剪枝时机，而非固定剪枝点或初始化剪枝。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上实现早期剪枝并保持与稠密训练相当的性能。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对标准非结构化剪枝（SP）将滤波器元素置零、从而把滤波器约束在固定子空间并引入强偏置的问题，提出 interspace pruning（IP）。IP 将滤波器表示为自适应滤波器基（FB）的线性组合，在动态 interspace 中通过将 FB 系数置零实现剪枝，未剪枝系数与基联合训练。论文给出 IP 性能更优的数学论证，并在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上证明 IP 优于 SP，尤其在 ImageNet 剪枝和高稀疏度等困难场景下提升显著，且运行时与参数量开销相同。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the strong bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP), which constrains filters to a fixed subspace by zeroing elements. It introduces interspace pruning (IP), where filters are represented as linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis (FB) and pruning is performed by zeroing FB coefficients while jointly training unpruned coefficients and bases. Mathematical analysis and experiments show IP consistently outperforms SP across state-of-the-art unstructured pruning methods, with large gains on ImageNet and at high sparsity under equal runtime and parameter cost.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 从滤波器参数化角度重新审视非结构化剪枝的偏置问题，方法通用可插拔，理论分析与实验较扎实，对剪枝方向研究者有参考价值。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出基于自适应滤波器基的 interspace pruning，作为改进现有非结构化剪枝的通用工具。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 用动态 interspace 中的基系数置零替代直接元素置零，缓解固定子空间偏置。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上超越 SP，ImageNet 与高稀疏度场景提升尤为明显。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究在无干净训练数据条件下检测被植入 Trojan 的 DNN。核心观察是 Trojan 特征在网络剪枝下比良性特征更稳定，据此提出 Quarantine 检测框架：先定位一个保留几乎全部 Trojan 信息、但在干净输入上仅有随机水平性能的 winning Trojan lottery ticket，再从该孤立子网络中恢复出嵌入的触发器。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 及多种网络架构上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Trojan DNN detection without access to clean training data. Its key observation is that Trojan features are significantly more stable to network pruning than benign features. Based on this, it proposes Quarantine: first locating a winning Trojan lottery ticket that preserves nearly full Trojan information while achieving only chance-level clean accuracy, then recovering the embedded trigger from this isolated subnetwork. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across various architectures demonstrate effectiveness.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 将 lottery ticket 假设与后门检测巧妙结合，视角新颖，无干净数据设定贴近实际安全需求，但属于安全方向，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏子网络的 Trojan 检测框架 Quarantine，可在无干净数据下恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 发现 Trojan 特征对剪枝的稳定性高于良性特征，并据此定位 winning Trojan lottery ticket。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 多种架构上有效检测 Trojan 并恢复触发器。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像复原任务中深度模型计算量大的问题，指出 N:M 结构化剪枝未考虑不同层在计算复杂度与性能需求上的差异。为此提出一种新颖剪枝方法，为每一层自适应确定 N:M 结构化稀疏的剪枝比例，从而更好地权衡效率与复原精度。在超分辨率和去模糊任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于已有剪枝方法，并开源了 PyTorch 实现。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the heavy computation of deep models for image restoration and notes that existing N:M structured pruning ignores layer-wise differences in computational complexity and performance requirements. It proposes a pruning method that determines the N:M structured sparsity ratio for each layer to better trade off efficiency and restoration accuracy. Extensive experiments on super-resolution and deblurring show significant improvements over prior pruning methods, with a PyTorch implementation released.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 层自适应 N:M 稀疏比例的思路合理且工程实用，实验覆盖超分与去模糊两类任务，但属于图像复原方向，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出逐层自适应确定 N:M 结构化稀疏比例的剪枝方法，用于图像复原网络压缩。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 按层分配 N:M 稀疏度以匹配不同层的复杂度与精度需求。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率和去模糊任务上显著优于已有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云 3D 目标检测中点占据固有的稀疏性这一核心挑战，提出 Sparse Window Transformer（SWFormer）。方法将 3D 点转换为稀疏体素与窗口，用 bucketing 方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并通过多尺度特征融合与窗口移位捕捉跨窗口相关性，同时提出 voxel diffusion 技术以从稀疏特征中精确检测 3D 目标。在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集上，车辆与行人 3D 检测取得 73.36 L2 mAPH 的 SOTA 结果，超越所有单阶段与两阶段模型且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inherent sparsity of point occupancy for 3D object detection and proposes Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer), a scalable and accurate model that converts 3D points into sparse voxels and windows and processes variable-length sparse windows via a bucketing scheme. It captures cross-window correlation through multi-scale feature fusion and window shifting, and introduces a voxel diffusion technique for accurate detection from sparse features. On the Waymo Open Dataset test set, SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH on vehicle and pedestrian, outperforming all prior single-stage and two-stage models while being more efficient.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶点云 3D 检测的强工作，将窗口 Transformer 与稀疏体素高效结合并在 Waymo 上取得 SOTA，对 BEV/3D 检测方向研究者高度相关且值得精读。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出 Sparse Window Transformer，用稀疏窗口注意力与体素扩散实现高效高精度点云 3D 检测。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: bucketing 处理变长稀疏窗口、跨窗口多尺度融合与窗口移位，以及 voxel diffusion 技术。
2210.07372|v2.result: Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集车辆与行人 3D 检测达 73.36 L2 mAPH，超越所有单/两阶段模型。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云多个实例在目标点云中的位姿，其难点在于某一实例的内点对应恰是其他实例的外点。现有方法依赖耗时的假设采样或空间一致性特征，性能受限。论文提出 PointCLM，先用对比学习为输入候选对应学习分布良好的深度表示，再基于该表示设计外点剪枝策略与聚类策略，高效剔除外点并将剩余对应分配给正确实例。在合成与真实数据集上大幅超越 SOTA。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for all others. Existing methods rely on time-consuming hypothesis sampling or spatial-consistency features with limited performance. PointCLM first uses contrastive learning to learn well-distributed deep representations of putative correspondences, then applies an outlier pruning strategy and a clustering strategy to remove outliers and assign remaining correspondences to correct instances. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on both synthetic and real datasets.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 将对比学习引入多实例点云配准，用表示学习替代假设采样，思路清晰且效果显著，对点云配准与 3D 感知研究者有参考价值。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模稀疏点云压缩中熵编码效率不足的问题，本文提出了一种基于八叉树的多级压缩框架。方法上设计了利用兄弟节点子节点、祖先和邻居上下文的熵模型，并引入体素级几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面以提供几何先验，解码时采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。相比已有基线，在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes数据集上分别实现了11-16%和12-14%的比特率改进。该工作为自动驾驶场景下的点云传输与存储提供了更紧凑的编码方案。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient entropy coding in large-scale sparse point cloud compression by proposing an octree-based multi-level framework. It introduces an entropy model exploiting sibling children, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, along with a voxel-based geometry-aware module fitting local quadratic surfaces as geometric priors, and a two-step heuristic decoding strategy. The method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes, respectively.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该工作将几何先验与上下文熵模型结合，在自动驾驶点云压缩任务上取得了稳定的比特率增益，对车载点云传输有实用价值。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出了一种融合兄弟上下文与曲面几何先验的八叉树点云压缩框架。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 利用兄弟节点子节点、祖先和邻居的层次依赖构建熵模型，并局部拟合二次曲面提供几何先验。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes上分别取得11-16%和12-14%的比特率改进。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大、难以扩展到高分辨率和多视角的问题，本文提出了Token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT)。方法先定位粗略的人体掩码，仅在选定的token内执行自注意力，并扩展出多视角版本，提出以人体前景像素为对应候选的human area fusion跨视角融合策略。在COCO和MPII上，PPT在匹配已有姿态Transformer精度的同时降低了计算量；在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上，多视角PPT高效融合多视角线索并达到新的最优性能。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: To address the high computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for pose estimation, this paper proposes the Token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT), which locates a rough human mask and performs self-attention only within selected tokens. It further extends to multi-view pose estimation with a human area fusion strategy treating all human foreground pixels as correspondence candidates. PPT matches prior pose transformer accuracy with reduced computation on COCO and MPII, and achieves new state-of-the-art results on Human3.6M and Ski-Pose.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: 该工作通过token剪枝有效降低了姿态Transformer的计算量，并自然扩展到多视角融合，对高效Transformer设计有参考意义。

2209.08194|v2.result: 在COCO和MPII上匹配精度并降低计算量，在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上取得新的最优性能。

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中深度网络面临灾难性遗忘、现有方法难以兼顾稳定性与可塑性或计算存储开销过大的问题，本文受梯度提升算法逐步拟合残差的启发，提出了两阶段学习范式FOSTER。方法先动态扩展新模块以拟合目标模型与原始模型输出之间的残差，再通过有效的蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度以保持单一骨干模型。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000的不同设置下，FOSTER取得了最优性能，代码已开源。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning, where existing methods either suffer from the stability-plasticity dilemma or incur excessive computation/storage, this paper proposes FOSTER, a two-stage paradigm inspired by gradient boosting that fits residuals between the target and previous ensemble model. It first dynamically expands new modules to fit residuals, then removes redundant parameters and feature dimensions via an effective distillation strategy to maintain a single backbone. FOSTER achieves state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000 under various settings.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 该工作将梯度提升思想引入类增量学习，通过扩展-压缩两阶段在保持单骨干的同时取得SOTA，对持续学习研究有较高参考价值。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在低比特下精度严重下降的问题，提出RepQ-ViT框架，将量化与推理过程解耦：量化时使用复杂量化器，推理时通过尺度重参数化转为硬件友好的简化量化器。具体针对post-LayerNorm激活的通道间剧烈变化采用通道级量化，针对post-Softmax激活的幂律分布采用log√2量化，再将尺度重参数化到层级。相比牺牲量化性能迁就硬件的已有方法，在低比特ViT量化上取得更优精度-效率折中。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: RepQ-ViT addresses the severe accuracy degradation of post-training quantization for vision transformers in low-bit regimes by decoupling quantization from inference: complex quantizers are used for calibration while scale-reparameterized simplified quantizers are used at inference. It applies channel-wise quantization to post-LayerNorm activations and log√2 quantization to post-Softmax activations, then reparameterizes scales to hardware-friendly layer-wise forms. This achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than prior methods that sacrifice quantization performance for hardware compatibility.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 该工作对ViT低比特PTQ的分布特性分析到位，重参数化思路简洁有效，对模型压缩方向有参考价值。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于量化尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架RepQ-ViT。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 将量化与推理解耦，用复杂量化器校准、重参数化后以简化量化器推理。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特ViT量化下显著缓解精度下降，优于已有PTQ方案。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT计算开销大、已有token剪枝方法因直接丢弃token造成显著信息损失的问题，提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS。TPS先剪枝得到保留与剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和基于相似度的融合，将被剪token的信息压缩进部分保留token中。相比SOTA方法在所有剪枝强度下均更优，将DeiT-tiny/small计算预算压缩至35%时，ImageNet分类精度比基线提升1%-6%，并提升吞吐量。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: To address the information loss caused by discarding tokens in existing ViT token pruning methods, this paper proposes a joint Token Pruning and Squeezing module (TPS). TPS first prunes tokens into reserved and pruned subsets, then squeezes the information of pruned tokens into partial reserved tokens via unidirectional nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusing. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all pruning intensities, improving ImageNet accuracy by 1%-6% over baselines when shrinking DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35%, while also increasing throughput.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 将剪枝与信息压缩结合缓解信息损失，思路新颖且实验充分，对ViT高效推理有实用价值。

2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU硬件上因堆叠自注意力/交叉注意力块而难以加速部署的问题，提出充分利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化的压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型变为稀疏模型（FP16），再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练将浮点稀疏模型量化为定点模型，并在剪枝与量化过程中使用混合策略知识蒸馏，支持监督与无监督学习。实验显示模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，取得SOTA压缩效果。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of accelerating vision transformer deployment on GPUs, this paper proposes GPUSQ-ViT, a compression scheme that exploits GPU-friendly 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity and quantization. A dense model is first pruned into a 2:4 structured sparse FP16 model, then quantized into a fixed-point model via sparse-distillation-aware quantization-aware training, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout and support for both supervised and unsupervised learning. Experiments show state-of-the-art compression, reducing model size by 6.4-12.7x.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向GPU实际加速的稀疏+量化联合压缩方案工程性强，对ViT高效部署有实用参考价值。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对已有ViT剪枝方法以不可解释方式忽略模型内部单元与目标类别关系、导致性能下降的问题，提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner。该方法设计可解释性感知掩码，以端到端方式学习每个可剪枝单元对预测各目标类别的贡献，并基于掩码值自适应搜索区分剪除与保留单元的层级阈值，从而保留最有信息量的单元并学习层级剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上进行了验证。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: To address the performance degradation of existing ViT pruning methods that overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes in an unexplainable manner, this paper proposes X-Pruner, an explainable pruning framework. It learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to predicting each target class, and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds based on mask values to preserve the most informative units and determine layer-wise pruning rates. The method is validated on DeiT and Swin Transformer.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 将可解释性引入剪枝准则，思路有特色，对ViT压缩与可解释性交叉方向有参考价值。

It improves over existing semi-supervised segmentation methods by selecting more informative contrastive samples based on density guidance, achieving competitive results on standard benchmarks.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本因内存预算限制只能保存少量（few-shot） exemplar 的问题，提出通过压缩 exemplar 来突破这一限制。方法利用类激活图（CAM）生成0-1掩码，下采样非判别性像素，从而在固定内存中保存更多压缩后的 exemplar。进一步提出类增量掩码（CIM）模型，通过双层优化自适应地为不同类别学习最优阈值，解决了CAM阈值选择中覆盖度与样本数量的权衡问题。在多个CIL基准上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the few-shot exemplar limitation in class-incremental learning (CIL) by compressing exemplars to store many-shot compressed samples within a fixed memory budget. It generates 0-1 masks on discriminative pixels from class activation maps (CAM) without manual annotation, and proposes a class-incremental masking (CIM) model optimized via bilevel optimization to adaptively resolve threshold trade-offs across classes. Extensive experiments on CIL benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.
