Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计通常依赖 LiDAR 或立体相机生成训练所需的稀疏深度监督信号，限制了其在新场景和低成本平台上的部署。本文提出 MED（Mixture of Exponential Disparity）概率体积方法，用概率分布建模视差而非直接回归深度，从而在完全无 LiDAR 的情况下实现自监督训练。相比已有依赖外部深度传感器或复杂多帧几何约束的工作，该方法通过概率建模缓解了自监督信号中的噪声与遮挡问题。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但作者声称在多个基准上达到与使用 LiDAR 监督的方法相当的性能。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation typically relies on LiDAR or stereo cameras to provide sparse depth supervision, which limits deployment on new scenes and low-cost platforms. This paper proposes MED (Mixture of Exponential Disparity) probability volumes, modeling disparity as a probability distribution rather than regressing depth directly, enabling fully LiDAR-free self-supervised training. Compared with prior work that depends on external depth sensors or complex multi-frame geometric constraints, the probabilistic formulation mitigates noise and occlusion in self-supervised signals. The authors claim performance comparable to LiDAR-supervised methods on several benchmarks, though no specific quantitative numbers are provided in the abstract.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作对降低自监督深度估计对 LiDAR 的依赖具有实际意义，概率体积建模思路对自动驾驶低成本感知方案有参考价值。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出 MED 概率体积方法，实现完全无需 LiDAR 的自监督单目深度估计。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 用混合指数视差概率分布替代直接深度回归，缓解自监督信号噪声。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 声称在多个基准上达到与 LiDAR 监督方法相当的性能。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角多人物3D姿态估计问题，提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法，将多相机视角的特征体通过平面扫描构建代价体，从而在3D空间中定位人体关节。相比已有方法，其改进在于利用平面扫描机制显式建模多视角几何一致性，避免了复杂的跨视角匹配。在多个基准数据集上取得了优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing a plane sweep stereo approach that constructs cost volumes from multi-camera features to localize human joints in 3D space. The key improvement lies in explicitly modeling multi-view geometric consistency via plane sweeping, avoiding complex cross-view matching. It achieves superior 3D pose estimation accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该工作将平面扫描立体引入多视角多人3D姿态估计，思路清晰，但与人车自动驾驶感知场景的直接关联有限。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 利用平面扫描机制显式建模多视角几何一致性来定位3D人体关节。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角人群计数中跨视角和跨场景泛化能力差的问题，提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法。方法通过设计视角不变的表示学习和场景自适应机制，使模型在未见过的视角和场景下仍能准确估计人群密度。相比已有工作，其改进在于同时解决视角变化和场景域偏移两个挑战，在跨场景评测中显著降低了计数误差。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of multi-view crowd counting across views and scenes by proposing a cross-view cross-scene approach. It designs view-invariant representation learning and scene adaptation mechanisms so that the model can accurately estimate crowd density in unseen views and scenes. Compared with prior work, it simultaneously addresses view variation and scene domain shift, significantly reducing counting errors in cross-scene evaluations.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 该工作关注多视角人群计数的跨域泛化，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 同时解决视角变化和场景域偏移的视角不变表示学习与场景自适应机制。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在跨场景评测中显著降低计数误差。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类问题，提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测学习视角间的一致表示。方法利用对比学习在缺失视角情况下对齐不同视角的特征，并通过预测任务恢复缺失视角的信息。相比已有不完整多视角聚类方法，其改进在于将对比学习与预测机制结合，在多个数据集上取得了更优的聚类性能。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing COMPLETER, a framework that learns consistent representations across views via contrastive prediction. It leverages contrastive learning to align features across views under missing-view conditions and recovers missing-view information through a prediction task. Compared with existing incomplete multi-view clustering methods, it combines contrastive learning with prediction, achieving better clustering performance on multiple datasets.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 该工作将对比预测引入不完整多视角聚类，方法设计合理，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联度较低。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类框架COMPLETER。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 将对比学习与预测机制结合以处理缺失视角下的表示对齐。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在多个数据集上取得更优的聚类性能。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: 该论文针对未知通用反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建问题，提出一种能够处理未知反射率的光滑表面重建方法。方法通过多视角光度一致性建模和反射率估计，在无纹理且反射率未知的条件下恢复表面几何。相比已有工作，其改进在于放宽了对已知反射率的假设，在合成和真实数据上取得了更准确的重建结果。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance. It proposes a method that models multi-view photometric consistency and estimates reflectance to recover surface geometry without assuming known reflectance. Compared with prior work, it relaxes the known-reflectance assumption and achieves more accurate reconstruction on synthetic and real data.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 该工作关注无纹理光滑表面的多视角重建，属于计算摄影/几何重建范畴，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出未知通用反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 放宽已知反射率假设，联合估计反射率与表面几何。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在合成和真实数据上取得更准确的重建结果。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，提出DeepVideoMVS方法，通过循环时空融合将历史场景几何信息高效传播到当前时刻。方法在轻量级编码器-解码器基础上，于瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM单元，并利用上一时刻深度预测将隐藏状态变换到当前相机平面，实现几何合理的状态传播。相比已有MVS方法，其在数百个室内场景的大多数评测指标上取得更优深度预测，同时保持实时性能。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-view depth prediction on posed video streams by proposing DeepVideoMVS, which propagates scene geometry from previous time steps to the current one via recurrent spatio-temporal fusion. It places a ConvLSTM cell at the bottleneck of a lightweight encoder-decoder and warps the previous hidden state into the current camera plane using the previous depth prediction. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 该工作将循环时空融合引入视频多视角深度估计，方法简洁高效，对自动驾驶中时序深度感知有参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环时空融合的在线视频多视角深度预测方法DeepVideoMVS。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 利用上一时刻深度预测将ConvLSTM隐藏状态变换到当前相机平面实现几何合理的状态传播。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景的大多数指标上超越已有MVS方法并保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督非刚性表面配准中自由度大且缺乏标注数据的问题，提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。方法用多个刚性变换的逐点组合表示非刚性变换，使解空间受约束并可用循环框架迭代求解；同时引入在投影多视角2D深度图上度量3D形状相似性的可微损失，实现无需真值监督的端到端训练。在多个数据集上大幅超越已有最优方法。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration, which is challenging due to high degrees of freedom and lack of labeled data, by proposing the Recurrent Multi-View Alignment Network (RMA-Net). It represents non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations, enabling iterative solving with a recurrent framework, and introduces a differentiable loss measuring 3D shape similarity on projected multi-view 2D depth images for end-to-end training without ground-truth supervision. It outperforms prior state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 该工作将循环框架与多视角可微损失结合用于无监督非刚性配准，方法设计巧妙，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出无监督非刚性表面配准的循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 用刚性变换逐点组合表示非刚性变换并引入多视角2D深度图可微相似性损失。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越已有最优方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计中稀疏点扩散到深度图时精度不足的问题，提出可微扩散（differentiable diffusion）方法，将点建模为带解析透射率的高斯并通过可微splatting同时优化点的位置、深度和权重，使扩散后的深度图最小化多视图重投影误差。该方法还设计了高效优化流程，可同时优化复杂场景重建所需的5万多个点。在光场和宽基线图像上通过自监督训练，相比从稀疏点直接扩散的基线，平均误差和离群误差均有改善，并与图像处理和深度学习方法进行了定性定量对比。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose diffusion into a depth map minimizes multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. It proposes differentiable splatting that models points as Gaussians with analytic transmittance and an efficient routine that jointly optimizes point positions, depths, and weights for over 50k points. Self-supervised experiments on light-field and wide-baseline images show reduced average and outlier errors compared to diffusing inaccurate sparse points, with qualitative and quantitative comparisons against image processing and deep learning baselines.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将经典点云splatting与可微优化结合用于多视图深度估计，思路新颖，但整体性能与主流深度学习方法仍有差距，适合关注可微渲染与深度估计交叉方向的研究者参考。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，通过可微splatting联合优化稀疏点的位置、深度和权重以生成高质量稠密深度图。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 将点建模为带解析透射率的高斯并实现5万+点的高效联合优化，把扩散过程嵌入多视图重投影误差的可微优化中。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在光场和宽基线图像自监督设定下，平均误差和离群误差相比从稀疏点直接扩散的基线均有改善。

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中普遍采用的表示分布对齐策略，论文指出其存在导致表示空间聚类可分性下降以及抑制模型对视图进行优先级排序能力的缺陷。为此提出一个简单的基线模型，完全放弃表示对齐，性能即可与当前最优方法相当或更优；进一步加入对比学习组件，形成选择性对齐机制，在保留视图优先级能力的同时显著提升性能。实验在多个数据集上大幅超越当时的最优方法。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naïvely aligning view representation distributions in deep multi-view clustering, showing that such alignment reduces cluster separability and inhibits the model's ability to prioritize views. It proposes a simple baseline that avoids representation alignment altogether yet matches or surpasses state-of-the-art methods, and further augments it with a contrastive learning component that performs selective alignment while preserving view prioritization. Experiments show large-margin improvements over the state of the art on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 对多视图聚类中表示对齐这一常见做法提出了有说服力的反思，方法简洁且实验提升明显，但主题与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 提出放弃表示对齐的多视图聚类基线，并通过对比学习实现选择性对齐以保留视图优先级能力。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 揭示朴素表示对齐的缺陷，并用对比学习组件替代全局对齐，实现选择性对齐。
2103.07738|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越当时的多视图聚类最优方法。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率多视图立体（MVS）中3D代价体正则化方法计算和内存开销大的问题，提出PatchmatchNet，首次将迭代式多尺度Patchmatch嵌入端到端可训练架构，并用学习到的自适应传播与评估方案改进Patchmatch核心算法。该方法计算速度快、内存占用低，适合资源受限设备处理高分辨率图像。在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上取得有竞争力的性能和泛化能力，且比所有现有最优模型至少快2.5倍，内存占用减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and memory cost of 3D cost volume regularization in high-resolution multi-view stereo by proposing PatchmatchNet, a learnable cascade formulation of Patchmatch. It introduces an iterative multi-scale Patchmatch in an end-to-end trainable architecture and improves the core algorithm with a learned adaptive propagation and evaluation scheme per iteration. Experiments on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D show competitive performance and generalization while being at least 2.5× faster than state-of-the-art methods with half the memory usage.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 将经典Patchmatch算法与可学习架构结合，在效率与精度之间取得良好平衡，对多视图立体和深度估计方向有较高参考价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出端到端可训练的级联PatchmatchNet，实现高效高分辨率多视图立体匹配。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 首次在端到端架构中引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch，并设计可学习的自适应传播与评估方案。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上性能有竞争力，速度比现有最优方法至少快2.5倍，内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 针对新视角合成中需要泛化到新场景的问题，提出IBRNet，通过插值稀疏邻近视图合成复杂场景的新视角。其核心是一个包含多层感知机和光线变换器的网络架构，在连续5D位置（3D空间位置+2D视角方向）估计辐射亮度和体密度，并在渲染时从多个源视图动态提取外观信息。与逐场景优化的神经场景表示方法不同，IBRNet学习通用的视图插值函数，仅用多视图位姿图像监督即可训练。实验表明其优于其他泛化到新场景的新视角合成方法，逐场景微调后可与最优单场景神经渲染方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles generalizable novel view synthesis by proposing IBRNet, which interpolates a sparse set of nearby views to render complex scenes. Its core architecture combines an MLP and a ray transformer to estimate radiance and volume density at continuous 5D locations, drawing appearance information on the fly from multiple source views at render time. Unlike per-scene neural rendering, IBRNet learns a generic view interpolation function trained only with multi-view posed images, outperforming recent generalizable methods and matching state-of-the-art single-scene methods after per-scene fine-tuning.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 将经典IBR思想与Transformer结合，实现了泛化性强的新视角合成，对多视图几何与神经渲染交叉方向有重要参考价值。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出IBRNet，学习通用的多视图图像插值函数以实现泛化到新场景的新视角合成。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 结合MLP与光线变换器在连续5D位置估计辐射和密度，并在渲染时动态从源视图提取外观信息。
2102.13090|v2.result: 优于其他泛化到新场景的新视角合成方法，逐场景微调后可与最优单场景神经渲染方法竞争。

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中的数据关联问题因光照不一致、运动模式变化和跨相机轨迹遮挡而极具挑战。本文提出动态图模型DyGLIP，将数据关联建模为图上的链接预测任务，利用更好的特征表示并能在相机切换时恢复丢失的轨迹。相比已有方法，该模型不依赖相机重叠比例，在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法，且适用于在线设置并可扩展至增量模式。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking (MC-MOT), which is challenging due to inconsistent lighting, varying motion patterns, and cross-camera occlusions. It proposes DyGLIP, a dynamic graph model with link prediction that learns better feature representations and can recover lost tracks during camera transitions. The method outperforms existing MC-MOT algorithms by a large margin on several practical datasets and works favorably in online settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 将图链接预测引入MC-MOT数据关联，思路清晰且实用性强，对多相机感知与跟踪方向有较高参考价值。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态图与链接预测的多相机多目标跟踪数据关联框架DyGLIP。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 用动态图链接预测建模跨相机轨迹关联，并支持相机切换时的轨迹恢复。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法，且适用于在线与增量设置。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型广基线场景（如工地、体育场、公共空间）中相机网络3D位姿估计困难、传统SfM因难以匹配跨视角关键点而失效的问题，本文提出利用行人重识别（re-ID）来建立跨相机对应关系。方法先用re-ID关联跨相机人体框，将框对应转换为点对应，再用多视图几何与光束法平差求解相机位姿。该方法无需专用标定物，仅依赖场景中可见行人，适用于需频繁重标定的场景，并在多个不同场景数据集上进行了大量实验。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles wide-baseline multi-camera pose estimation in large environments where standard SfM fails due to difficulty in matching keypoints across very different views. It leverages person re-identification to associate human bounding boxes across cameras, converts box correspondences into point correspondences, and solves camera pose via multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment. Requiring only visible people rather than calibration targets, the method suits scenarios needing frequent recalibration and is validated on datasets from diverse scenes.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 将行人重识别用于广基线相机标定是一个巧妙且实用的思路，对多相机部署与标定有参考意义。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出利用行人重识别建立跨相机对应关系以实现广基线多相机标定的方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 以场景中行人为'关键点'，用re-ID替代传统标定物完成相机位姿求解。
2104.08568|v2.result: 无需专用标定物即可标定，在多个不同场景数据集上验证了有效性。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 神经辐射场类方法在场景中存在运动物体时会失去预测能力，本文提出STaR，在无任何人工标注的情况下从多视角RGB视频中自监督地跟踪与重建含单个刚体运动的动态场景。方法联合优化两个神经辐射场参数及一组刚性位姿，将动态场景分解为静态背景与运动物体两部分并分别编码。在合成与真实数据集上，该方法能渲染出时空维度均具新视角的逼真图像。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: Neural radiance field methods lose predictive power once objects in a scene move. This paper presents STaR, a self-supervised method that tracks and reconstructs dynamic scenes with a single rigidly moving object from multi-view RGB videos without manual annotation. It jointly optimizes two neural radiance fields and a set of rigid poses to decompose the scene into static and moving parts, rendering photorealistic novel views in both spatial and temporal dimensions on synthetic and real datasets.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 将刚性运动建模融入神经辐射场，自监督分解动态场景，对动态场景重建与自监督视觉有启发。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督联合优化双神经辐射场与刚性位姿的动态场景跟踪与重建方法STaR。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 无需人工标注即可将动态场景分解为静态与运动两部分并分别用神经辐射场编码。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上实现时空维度均逼真的新视角渲染。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: 自监督学习在图像、音频、文本上成效显著，但表格数据缺乏空间、时间或语义结构，难以设计有效的数据增强，阻碍了其进展。本文提出SubTab框架，将表格数据的输入特征划分为多个子集，从而把表格学习转化为多视图表示学习问题。作者认为在自编码器设定下从特征子集重建数据比从损坏版本重建更能捕捉潜在表示，测试时通过子集隐变量的聚合进行协同推断。实验表明SubTab达到当时最优水平。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised learning has succeeded on images, audio, and text but struggles on tabular data, where spatial, temporal, or semantic structure for augmentation is lacking. This paper introduces SubTab, which divides input features into multiple subsets to cast tabular learning as a multi-view representation learning problem. Reconstructing data from feature subsets rather than corrupted versions better captures latent representations, and collaborative inference aggregates subset latent variables at test time, achieving state-of-the-art results.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 将多视图自监督思想迁移到表格数据，思路新颖，但与视觉/自动驾驶领域相关度较低。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出将表格数据特征划分为多子集以进行多视图自监督表示学习的框架SubTab。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 用特征子集重建替代损坏重建，并通过子集隐变量聚合实现协同推断。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在表格数据自监督表示学习上达到当时最优水平。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: 现有程序性活动理解数据集多为单视角、缺乏自然错误与修正标注，难以研究真实装配场景中的动作理解。本文提出Assembly101，包含4321段拆装101种玩具车的视频，首次同时采集8个静态视角与4个第一视角，标注超10万粗粒度与100万细粒度动作片段及1800万3D手部姿态。相比已有数据集，其多视角、长尾分布与自然错误修正特性支持跨视角迁移、新玩具泛化等研究，并新增错误检测任务。在识别、预测与时间分割三个基准上提供了系统评测。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: Existing procedural activity datasets are mostly single-view and lack natural mistakes/corrections, limiting realistic action understanding. Assembly101 introduces 4,321 videos of assembling/disassembling 101 toy vehicles with simultaneous 8 static and 4 egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. It benchmarks recognition, anticipation, temporal segmentation, and a novel mistake detection task, enabling studies on cross-view transfer, long-tailed distributions, and generalization to new toys.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、标注丰富且多视角同步，为程序性活动理解与多视角视频分析提供了重要基准，值得视频理解与多相机感知研究者关注。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了首个多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，含大规模多粒度标注与3D手部姿态。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 首次同步采集静态与第一视角，并引入自然错误检测任务及跨视角泛化评测。
2203.14712|v2.result: 提供超10万粗粒度、100万细粒度动作片段和1800万3D手部姿态，支持四项基准任务。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_cn: 多视角相机3D目标检测中，现有方法难以有效融合跨传感器全局信息且可扩展性不足。本文提出SpatialDETR，基于Transformer从多视角图像进行3D目标检测，通过全局跨传感器注意力机制实现鲁棒且可扩展的检测。相比已有工作，其利用全局注意力增强跨视角与跨传感器特征交互，提升检测鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: Multi-view camera 3D object detection struggles with global cross-sensor fusion and scalability. SpatialDETR proposes a transformer-based approach with global cross-sensor attention for robust and scalable 3D detection from multi-view images. It improves cross-view and cross-sensor feature interaction, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与全局跨传感器注意力结合用于多视角3D检测，思路新颖，对自动驾驶多相机感知有参考价值。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的SpatialDETR，实现多视角图像的可扩展3D目标检测。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.innovation: 引入全局跨传感器注意力机制，增强跨视角与跨传感器特征融合。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，但声称实现鲁棒且可扩展的3D检测。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer._arxiv_id: SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer-Based 3D Object Detection From Multi-view Camera Images With Global Cross-Sensor Attention.

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: 半监督目标检测中，伪标签仅关注分类分数而忽略定位精度，一致性训练仅考虑标签级而忽略特征级尺度不变性，导致无标签数据学习效率低。本文提出PseCo，设计噪声伪框学习（NPL）包含预测引导标签分配（PLA）和正样本一致性投票（PCV），并引入多视角尺度不变学习（MSL）实现特征级一致性。相比已有方法，PLA对粗糙伪框更鲁棒，PCV利用回归一致性反映定位质量，MSL增强尺度不变性。在COCO和VOC上取得显著提升（摘要截断未给出具体数值）。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: Semi-supervised object detection suffers from noisy pseudo boxes and label-level-only consistency. PseCo introduces Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) with Prediction-guided Label Assignment (PLA) and Positive-proposal Consistency Voting (PCV), plus Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL) for feature-level consistency. It improves robustness to coarse pseudo boxes and scale invariance, achieving notable gains on COCO and VOC.
2203.16317|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了SSOD中伪标签与一致性训练的关键缺陷，提出的NPL和MSL模块设计合理，对半监督检测研究有较高参考价值。
2203.16317|v2.contribution: 提出PseCo框架，通过NPL和MSL解决半监督目标检测中伪标签噪声与尺度不变性问题。
2203.16317|v2.innovation: PLA和PCV提升伪框定位质量，MSL实现特征级多视角尺度不变学习。
2203.16317|v2.result: 在COCO和VOC上取得显著性能提升（摘要截断未给出具体数值）。

2203.05625|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D目标检测中，如何让查询有效感知3D位置信息是关键问题。本文提出PETR，通过位置嵌入变换将3D坐标的位置信息编码进图像特征，生成3D位置感知特征，使目标查询能够感知3D位置并完成端到端检测。相比已有方法，PETR以简洁的Transformer架构实现3D位置感知，无需复杂几何投影。在nuScenes数据集上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一，可作为强基线。
2203.05625|v2.summary_en: Multi-view 3D detection requires object queries to perceive 3D positions. PETR proposes position embedding transformation that encodes 3D coordinates into image features to produce 3D position-aware features, enabling end-to-end detection. It achieves state-of-the-art 50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP on nuScenes, ranking 1st, and serves as a simple yet strong baseline.
2203.05625|v2.assessment: PETR以简洁优雅的位置嵌入变换解决了多视角3D检测中的3D位置感知问题，性能SOTA且代码开源，是该领域必读工作。
2203.05625|v2.contribution: 提出PETR，通过位置嵌入变换生成3D位置感知特征，实现端到端多视角3D检测。
2203.05625|v2.innovation: 将3D坐标位置信息编码进图像特征，使目标查询直接感知3D位置。
2203.05625|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一。

2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督多视图立体（MVS）中非朗伯表面和遮挡导致的跨视图对应歧义问题，提出RC-MVSNet，通过神经渲染引入深度渲染一致性损失约束物体表面附近的几何特征以缓解遮挡，并设计参考视图合成损失为非朗伯表面生成一致监督。在DTU和Tanks&Temples基准上，该方法在无监督MVS框架中达到SOTA，并与许多有监督方法性能相当。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence ambiguity in unsupervised multi-view stereo caused by non-Lambertian surfaces and occlusions. It proposes RC-MVSNet, which imposes a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain geometry features near object surfaces and a reference view synthesis loss to provide consistent supervision for non-Lambertian surfaces. Experiments on DTU and Tanks&Temples show state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised MVS frameworks and competitive results against supervised methods.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 将神经渲染引入无监督MVS以解决对应歧义，思路新颖且实验充分，对多视图几何与3D重建方向有参考价值。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督多视图立体框架RC-MVSNet，通过深度渲染一致性和参考视图合成损失解决跨视图对应歧义。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 利用神经渲染的深度渲染一致性损失和参考视图合成损失，分别缓解遮挡和非朗伯表面带来的监督困难。
2203.03949|v2.result: 在DTU和Tanks&Temples上达到无监督MVS的SOTA，并接近部分有监督方法。

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D视觉方法依赖任务特定几何结构（如代价体、对极约束）导致域泛化差的问题，提出Depth Field Networks（DeFiNe），学习隐式多视图一致场景表示，并引入3D数据增强作为几何归纳先验以增加视图多样性，同时将视图合成作为辅助任务提升深度估计。在立体和视频深度估计上达到SOTA，且零样本域泛化性能大幅提升。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor domain generalization in 3D vision methods that rely on task-specific geometric structures such as cost volumes or epipolar constraints. It proposes Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe), which learn an implicit multi-view consistent scene representation, introduce 3D data augmentation as a geometric inductive prior, and use view synthesis as an auxiliary task. DeFiNe achieves state-of-the-art stereo and video depth estimation and significantly improves zero-shot domain generalization.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 以隐式表示替代显式几何约束来提升泛化性，思路与当前通用Transformer架构趋势一致，对多视图感知和深度估计有参考价值。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出Depth Field Networks，学习隐式多视图一致场景表示，无需显式几何约束即可实现SOTA立体和视频深度估计。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 用隐式场景表示替代代价体/对极约束等显式几何结构，并引入3D数据增强和视图合成辅助任务提升泛化性。
2207.14287|v2.result: 在立体和视频深度估计上达到SOTA，零样本域泛化性能大幅提升。

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角图像中重建高保真头发几何与外观的问题，现有体素化方法难以实现实时渲染和直观的形状风格控制。作者提出Neural Strands框架，基于神经头皮纹理（neural scalp texture）在纹理像素级别编码单根发丝几何与外观，并设计了基于发丝光栅化的神经渲染管线，实现抗锯齿、视角一致的实时渲染。相比体素化方法，该方法首次实现了从多视角输入中联合学习外观与显式发丝几何，并支持形状与风格编辑。实验表明该方法在多种发型上兼顾了渲染保真度与效率。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of reconstructing accurate hair geometry and appearance from multi-view images, where volumetric representations struggle with real-time rendering and intuitive style control. The authors propose Neural Strands, a framework that encodes per-strand geometry and appearance via a neural scalp texture and introduces a strand-accurate, anti-aliased neural rendering pipeline based on rasterization. Unlike volumetric counterparts, it enables the first joint learning of appearance and explicit hair geometry from multi-view setups, achieving high-fidelity, view-consistent rendering with intuitive shape and style control across various hairstyles.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该工作将显式发丝表示与神经渲染结合，在头发建模这一细分方向上有明显推进，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经头皮纹理的显式发丝表示与光栅化神经渲染框架，实现多视角头发几何与外观的联合学习。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 用纹理像素级发丝编码替代体素表示，首次从多视角输入中联合学习显式头发几何与外观并支持实时渲染。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上实现了高保真、视角一致的实时渲染，并支持直观的形状与风格控制。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，观察到基于视角的表面表示在高分辨率细节和纹理建模上优于点云或体素表示。作者提出MvDeCor，将3D形状渲染为多视角图像，在对比学习框架下构建密集对应学习任务，使学到的2D表示具有视角不变性和几何一致性。在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上，该方法在细粒度部件分割上超越现有最优方案，且在训练视角稀疏或形状带纹理时优势更明显。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles fine-grained 3D shape segmentation under limited labeled data by leveraging self-supervised 2D learning, motivated by the observation that view-based surface representations better capture high-resolution details than point clouds or voxels. The authors propose MvDeCor, which renders 3D shapes from multiple views and performs dense correspondence learning within a contrastive framework, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent 2D representations. Experiments on RenderPeople and PartNet show state-of-the-art fine-grained part segmentation, with larger gains when training views are sparse or shapes are textured.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 将2D自监督对比学习引入3D形状分割的思路清晰有效，对自监督表示学习研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出多视角密集对应学习的自监督框架MvDeCor，用于细粒度3D形状部件分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 在对比学习框架下通过多视角渲染构建密集对应任务，融合2D语义与3D几何推理。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在RenderPeople和PartNet上细粒度部件分割超越现有最优方法，稀疏视角或带纹理场景下提升更显著。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准数据集的问题，构建了一个包含998个日常桌面物体3D模型及847,000张真实RGB-D图像的数据集。作者以半自动化方式对每张图像的相机位姿和物体位姿进行了精确标注，并提供了标注工具源码和评估基线。该数据集可支持形状重建、物体位姿估计、形状检索等多种3D任务，实验表明其能填补多视角3D重建真实世界基准的空白。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction by introducing a dataset of 998 everyday tabletop objects with 847,000 real RGB-D images. Camera and object poses are annotated semi-automatically for each image, and annotation tools plus evaluation baselines are released. The dataset supports tasks such as shape reconstruction, object pose estimation, and shape retrieval, and is shown to fill the gap in real-world benchmarks for learned multi-view 3D reconstruction.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 数据集类工作对3D重建与位姿估计社区有实用价值，但技术方法创新有限，与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线关联一般。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 发布包含998个物体、847K张真实RGB-D图像及精确位姿标注的多视角3D重建数据集。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 以半自动化标注流程提供大规模真实世界桌面物体的相机与物体位姿标注及配套工具。
2203.11397|v2.result: 填补了多视角3D重建真实世界基准的空白，并提供标注工具与评估基线。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于学习的多视角立体（MVS）中代价体融合步骤依赖额外网络学习2D线索、忽视3D空间关联且计算开销大的问题，提出MVSTER。该方法利用极线Transformer同时学习2D语义与3D空间关联：借助可拆卸的单目深度估计器增强2D语义，并通过交叉注意力沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联；同时采用级联结构，用熵正则化最优传输在各阶段传播更精细的深度估计。实验表明MVSTER在DTU基准上相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别取得34%和14%的相对提升，同时效率显著更高。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and underuse of 3D spatial correlations in cost volume fusion for learning-based multi-view stereo (MVS). The authors propose MVSTER, which employs an epipolar Transformer to jointly learn 2D semantics and 3D spatial associations: a detachable monocular depth estimator enhances 2D semantics, and cross-attention builds data-dependent 3D associations along epipolar lines. A cascade structure with entropy-regularized optimal transport propagates finer depth estimates across stages. MVSTER achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction on DTU with 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet, respectively, at significantly higher efficiency.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 极线Transformer与级联最优传输的结合在MVS上兼顾精度与效率，对多视角几何感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出基于极线Transformer的高效多视角立体方法MVSTER，联合建模2D语义与3D空间关联。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 用交叉注意力沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联，并以熵正则化最优传输在级联结构中传播深度估计。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU上相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别取得34%和14%的相对提升，且效率显著更高。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角场景下的域适应问题，提出通过通道增强与知识迁移的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心思路是在部分视角缺失时增强特征通道表达并迁移源域知识以提升目标域性能。该方向与多模态/多视角学习相关，但缺乏可评估的技术细节。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper targets incomplete multi-view domain adaptation and proposes a method based on channel enhancement and knowledge transfer. As the abstract is missing, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, the approach likely enhances channel-wise feature representations and transfers source-domain knowledge to improve target-domain performance under missing views.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度，仅从标题判断与多视角域适应相关，参考价值有限。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.innovation: 在视角不完整条件下结合通道增强与知识迁移进行域适应（细节无法确认）。

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）由多个独立阶段组成、误差累积明显的问题，提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法PS-NeRF。给定非朗伯物体在多未知方向光下的多视角图像，该方法先用多光照图像估计每视角表面法线以正则化NeRF导出的法线，再基于阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化表面法线、空间变化BRDF和光照。优化后的物体可用于新视角渲染、重光照和材质编辑。在合成与真实数据集上，该方法在形状重建精度上显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) caused by disjoint processing stages, proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. Given multi-view images of a non-Lambertian object under unknown directional lights, it first estimates per-view normal maps from multi-light images to regularize NeRF-derived normals, then jointly optimizes normals, spatially-varying BRDFs, and lights via a shadow-aware differentiable rendering layer. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show substantially more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods, enabling novel-view rendering, relighting, and material editing.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 将神经逆渲染与多视角光度立体统一到端到端优化框架，在形状重建精度上有明显提升，对逆渲染与神经渲染研究者有较高价值。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法PS-NeRF，统一求解MVPS中的几何、材质与光照。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 用多光照法线正则化NeRF法线，并通过阴影感知可微渲染层联合优化法线、BRDF与光照。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS与神经渲染方法，并支持重光照与材质编辑。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: 针对现有 amodal 实例分割数据集多聚焦于自动驾驶街景、缺乏购物场景多视角遮挡标注的问题，论文提出 MUVA 大规模多视角 amodal 实例分割基准。该方法在购物场景下采集多相机数据并标注被遮挡物体的完整可见与不可见区域，构建了包含多视角一致性的评测协议。相比已有单视角或街景数据集，MUVA 更强调跨视角遮挡推理与实例级 amodal 掩码预测。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但作为基准工作为多视角 amodal 分割提供了新的评测平台。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper introduces MUVA, a large-scale benchmark for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios. It addresses the lack of datasets covering multi-view occlusion reasoning outside autonomous driving by collecting and annotating complete object masks across multiple cameras. The benchmark provides evaluation protocols for cross-view amodal segmentation, offering a new testbed for occlusion-aware multi-camera perception.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 作为多视角 amodal 分割的新基准，对多相机感知与遮挡推理研究有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其标注规模与评测协议。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 构建了购物场景下大规模多视角 amodal 实例分割基准 MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 将 amodal 分割从单视角/街景扩展到多视角购物场景并强调跨视角一致性。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 提供了新的多视角 amodal 分割评测平台，具体性能数据摘要未给出。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: 现有 V2V 协同感知工作假设所有车辆配备同类型传感器，限制了跨模态协作的规模与收益。论文提出 HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，可处理不同数量与类型智能体的动态 V2V 协作。方法设计异构 3D 图 Transformer，联合推理智能体间与智能体内部的交互，融合多视角图像与 LiDAR 点云特征。在 OPV2V 数据集上，HM-ViT 在异构模态 V2V 协同感知任务上超越 SOTA 方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: Existing V2V cooperative perception methods assume homogeneous sensor configurations, limiting cross-modal collaboration. This paper presents HM-ViT, the first unified multi-agent hetero-modal cooperative perception framework that handles varying numbers and types of agents. A heterogeneous 3D graph transformer jointly reasons inter-agent and intra-agent interactions to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR point clouds, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on the OPV2V dataset.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 首次系统解决异构模态 V2V 协同感知问题，图 Transformer 设计合理，实验在 OPV2V 上验证有效，对多相机与协同感知方向有较高参考价值。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个统一的多智能体异构模态 V2V 协同感知框架 HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合推理智能体间与内部交互以融合图像与点云。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在 OPV2V 数据集上超越 SOTA 异构模态协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: 域偏移会显著降低目标检测模型在实际应用中的性能，现有域对抗学习（DAL）方法试图从源域解耦域不变特征，但忽略了共同特征中隐含的非因果因素。论文从因果机制出发，提出多视角对抗判别器（MAD）域泛化模型，包含虚假相关生成器（SCG）通过随机增强增加源域多样性，以及多视角域分类器（MVDC）将特征映射到多个潜在空间以去除非因果因素。该方法在未见域目标检测上净化了域不变特征，摘要未给出具体数值但声称优于已有 DAL 方法。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: Domain shift degrades object detection performance, and existing domain adversarial learning methods ignore implicit non-causal factors in common features. This paper proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) domain generalization model with a Spurious Correlations Generator and a Multi-View Domain Classifier to remove non-causal factors across multiple latent spaces. The method purifies domain-invariant features and improves unseen-domain object detection over prior DAL approaches.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 从因果视角重新审视域对抗学习，多视角潜在空间去除非因果因素思路新颖，对域泛化目标检测有启发，但摘要缺少定量结果。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出基于多视角对抗判别的域泛化目标检测模型 MAD。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多视角潜在空间映射去除共同特征中的非因果因素以净化域不变特征。
2304.02950|v2.result: 在未见域目标检测上优于已有域对抗学习方法，具体数值摘要未给出。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: 纯视觉 3D 检测因缺乏直接深度测量而难以精确估计深度，现有方法多通过网络设计（如可变形层、大感受野）改进。论文提出正交思路，通过多智能体协作提升纯相机 3D 检测，即 CoCa3D，智能体之间通信共享互补信息并选择最具信息量的线索以优化通信效率。多视角共享消息可消歧单智能体深度估计并补全遮挡与远距离区域。在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%，初步结果显示相机协作可超越 LiDAR。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: Camera-only 3D detection suffers from imprecise depth estimation, and prior work mainly improves network design. This paper proposes CoCa3D, a collaborative camera-only 3D detection framework where agents share complementary information and select the most informative cues to improve communication efficiency. Multi-view messages disambiguate single-agent depth and complement occluded and long-range regions, improving prior SOTA by 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ in AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 以多智能体协作替代单目网络设计来提升纯视觉 3D 检测，思路新颖且提升幅度显著，对多相机协同感知与纯视觉 3D 检测方向极具参考价值。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协作式纯相机 3D 检测框架 CoCa3D，通过多智能体通信提升深度估计。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 用多视角协作消息消歧单智能体深度并选择信息量最大的线索优化通信。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: 针对多视角点云配准中位姿图初始化不可靠与历史信息利用不足的问题，论文提出一种鲁棒的多视角点云配准方法。方法包含可靠的位姿图初始化策略与历史重加权机制，以提升配准在噪声与异常情况下的鲁棒性。相比已有方法，该工作强调初始化质量与迭代过程中历史信息的动态加权。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但面向多视角点云配准这一 3D 感知基础问题。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multi-view point cloud registration by proposing reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting. The method improves initialization quality and dynamically reweights historical information during optimization to handle noise and outliers. It targets a fundamental 3D perception problem, though the abstract does not report quantitative results.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 多视角点云配准是 3D 感知的基础环节，位姿图初始化与历史重加权思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验充分性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出结合可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权的鲁棒多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 通过可靠初始化与历史信息动态重加权提升配准鲁棒性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 提升了多视角点云配准鲁棒性，具体数值摘要未给出。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: 针对纯视觉自动驾驶中感知与预测联合建模的需求，论文提出 TBP-Former，学习时序鸟瞰图（BEV）金字塔以联合进行感知与预测。方法构建时序 BEV 金字塔表示，在不同时间尺度上聚合特征，并在此基础上同时完成目标检测与轨迹预测。相比已有单帧或固定尺度 BEV 方法，TBP-Former 强调时序多尺度建模以提升联合感知预测性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但为视觉中心自动驾驶的联合感知预测提供了新框架。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper proposes TBP-Former, which learns a temporal bird's-eye-view (BEV) pyramid for joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving. The method aggregates features across multiple temporal scales in a BEV pyramid and performs detection and trajectory prediction jointly. It advances temporal multi-scale BEV modeling over single-frame or fixed-scale approaches, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 时序 BEV 金字塔用于联合感知与预测的思路契合视觉中心自动驾驶趋势，对 BEV 与多相机感知方向有较高参考价值，但需关注实验数据。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出学习时序 BEV 金字塔的 TBP-Former 用于联合感知与预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 构建时序多尺度 BEV 金字塔表示以联合建模检测与轨迹预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 为视觉中心自动驾驶联合感知预测提供新框架，具体数值摘要未给出。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角输入进行3D-4D视图合成的问题，提出神经像素合成方法。方法通过神经渲染与像素级组合实现跨视角、跨时间的新视图生成。相比已有工作，改进了多视角几何一致性与动态场景下的合成质量。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-view inputs by proposing a neural pixel composition approach. The method combines neural rendering with pixel-level composition to generate novel views across viewpoints and time. It improves geometric consistency and synthesis quality in dynamic scenes compared to prior work, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 该工作探索多视角时空视图合成，对自动驾驶场景重建有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体技术细节与实验验证。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出神经像素合成框架用于多视角3D-4D视图生成。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 将神经渲染与像素级组合结合以处理跨视角跨时间合成。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视图聚类（IMVC）中样本缺失导致原型不对齐的问题，提出跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。方法采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，并设计原型对齐机制缓解缺失视图带来的偏差。相比现有对比学习方法，避免了强制跨视图表示完全一致的问题。摘要未给出具体数据集上的量化提升。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) where missing samples cause unaligned and biased cluster prototypes. It proposes a Cross-view Partial Sample and Prototype Alignment Network (CPSPAN) that uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision and aligns prototypes across views. Unlike contrastive-based methods that force identical representations, CPSPAN preserves view discrepancy, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 该工作针对不完整多视图聚类提出改进，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，主要贡献在聚类方法层面。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出CPSPAN网络解决不完整多视图聚类中的原型不对齐问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 采用成对观测对齐作为代理监督并设计原型对齐机制。
2303.15689|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态场景下多帧深度估计中多视图几何一致性被破坏的问题，提出学习融合单目与多视图线索的方法。方法将多视图和单目线索编码为代价体，通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块实现静态区域几何信息向动态区域传播，无需启发式掩码。相比依赖显式动态掩码的方法，避免了掩码质量不可控和融合不充分的问题。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称在动态区域显著提升。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes where multi-view geometric consistency is violated. It proposes a cross-cue fusion (CCF) module that encodes multi-view and monocular cues as volumes and fuses them without heuristic masks, allowing geometric information from static areas to propagate to dynamic regions. Unlike mask-based methods, it avoids uncontrolled mask quality and underutilized fusion, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自动驾驶动态场景深度估计提出无掩码融合方案，思路新颖，对多相机感知与BEV方向有参考价值。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出跨线索融合模块实现单目与多视图线索的自适应融合。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 无需启发式掩码，将两类线索编码为代价体进行跨线索传播。
2304.08993|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，声称在动态区域显著提升。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对城市多层级多视角理解缺乏统一数据集的问题，提出OmniCity数据集。数据集包含多视角卫星图像、街景全景和单视图图像，覆盖纽约市25K地理位置的10万+像素级标注图像，并提出利用卫星标签图与视图变换关系的街景标注流水线。相比现有基准，OmniCity提供更多图像、更丰富标注类型和更多视角，并引入街景全景细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper presents OmniCity, a dataset for omnipotent city understanding from multi-level and multi-view images. It contains over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from 25K geo-locations in New York City, including satellite, panorama, and mono-view images, with an efficient annotation pipeline leveraging satellite label maps and view transformations. Compared to existing benchmarks, OmniCity offers more images, richer annotations, more views, and introduces a novel fine-grained building instance segmentation task on street-level panoramas.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 该数据集对自动驾驶城市场景理解与多视角感知研究有重要价值，标注规模与任务多样性突出。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建OmniCity多层级多视角城市理解数据集及基准。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 利用卫星标签与视图变换实现高效街景标注，引入全景细粒度实例分割任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 包含10万+像素级标注图像，覆盖25K地理位置，提供多任务基准。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图3D表面重建缺乏多传感器多模态数据的问题，提出一个多传感器大规模数据集。数据集包含来自智能手机、RealSense、Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪的配准RGB与深度数据，覆盖107个场景、100个视角、14种光照条件，约140万张图像。相比现有数据集，强调材质多样性挑战，为3D重建算法评估与训练提供资源。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a multi-sensor large-scale dataset for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction. It includes registered RGB and depth data from smartphones, RealSense, Kinect, industrial cameras, and structured-light scanners, covering 107 scenes, 100 viewing directions, 14 lighting conditions, and about 1.4 million images. The dataset emphasizes diverse material properties challenging for existing algorithms, providing a resource for evaluation and training of 3D reconstruction methods.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建研究有支撑价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联中等，主要贡献在数据资源层面。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 构建多传感器多模态大规模3D重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 涵盖多分辨率多模态传感器与多样化材质场景。
2203.06111|v2.result: 包含约140万张图像，107个场景，100个视角，14种光照条件。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多视图聚类方法忽略所有样本结构关系的问题，提出全局与跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。方法通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，并利用结构引导对比学习对齐共识表示与视图特定表示。相比逐视图聚合方法，更充分利用相似样本的互补性，且模块可嵌入不完整多视图聚类任务。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view clustering methods that ignore structural relationships among all samples. It proposes a Global and Cross-view Feature Aggregation network (GCFAggMVC) that obtains consensus representation via cross-sample and cross-view aggregation, and aligns consensus with view-specific representations using structure-guided contrastive learning. Unlike view-wise aggregation methods, it better exploits complementary information among similar samples and can be plugged into incomplete multi-view clustering, though no quantitative results are reported.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 该工作在多视图聚类方法上有一定改进，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，主要面向通用聚类任务。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出GCFAggMVC网络实现全局与跨视图特征聚合的多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 跨样本跨视图聚合结合结构引导对比学习对齐表示。
2305.06799|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: 该论文针对高分辨率新视角合成中辐射场（radiance fields）重建质量受限于低分辨率多视角输入的问题，提出将多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化进行交叉引导的联合框架。方法上通过超分辨率分支与辐射场分支相互提供监督信号，使超分结果更符合三维一致性、辐射场优化获得更丰富的细节先验。相比先超分再重建或先重建再超分的串行方案，该交叉引导策略缓解了二者目标不一致导致的伪影与模糊。摘要未提供具体量化指标，但该思路对高分辨率NVS与自动驾驶仿真数据合成有参考价值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of radiance field reconstruction under low-resolution multi-view inputs for high-resolution novel view synthesis. It proposes a cross-guided optimization framework that jointly couples multi-view image super-resolution with radiance field optimization, so that the two branches mutually provide supervision. Unlike naive serial pipelines, the cross-guidance enforces 3D consistency in the super-resolved images and supplies richer detail priors to the radiance field, reducing artifacts and blur. The abstract reports no quantitative numbers, but the paradigm is relevant to high-fidelity NVS and simulation data generation.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 将超分与辐射场优化做双向耦合而非简单串联，思路清晰，对高分辨率新视角合成与仿真数据生成有实用价值，但缺乏量化结果支撑。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化的交叉引导联合框架，实现高分辨率新视角合成。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 用双向交叉引导替代传统串行超分-重建流程，使超分与辐射场优化互相约束、互相增强。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 摘要未给出具体数值指标，声称在保持三维一致性的同时提升高分辨率新视角合成的细节质量。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角视觉任务中三维几何信息被压缩进二维特征、几何感知能力不足的问题，提出 POEM 方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体（MVS）的三维点上重建手部网格。核心思路是用一组嵌入 MVS 空间、携带多视角图像特征并环绕手部的三维点来表示复杂手部网格，并设计基于点的特征融合与跨集合点注意力两个操作来聚合跨视角信息。在三个具有挑战性的多视角数据集上，POEM 在手部网格重建上超越当时最先进方法。虽然任务为手部重建，但其“以点作为跨视角特征融合媒介”的范式对多相机三维感知具有迁移价值。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation that multi-view methods typically encode 3D information into 2D features, weakening geometric awareness. It proposes POEM, which directly operates on 3D points embedded in multi-view stereo to reconstruct hand meshes, representing a complex hand mesh by a set of points that are embedded in MVS, carry multi-view image features, and encircle the hand. Two operations, point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention, are designed to aggregate cross-view information. POEM outperforms state-of-the-art hand mesh reconstruction on three challenging multi-view datasets.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 以三维点作为跨视角特征融合媒介的思路简洁有效，对多相机三维感知中的特征融合设计有借鉴意义，但任务本身与自动驾驶场景距离较远。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出直接在嵌入多视角立体的三维点上重建手部网格的 POEM 方法。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 用携带多视角特征的三维点集合表示手部网格，并设计点特征融合与跨集合点注意力实现跨视角几何感知。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个挑战性多视角数据集上手部网格重建性能超越当时最先进方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体（MVS）在弱纹理区域匹配失败、深度估计不可靠的问题，提出自适应块变形（Adaptive Patch Deformation）策略以增强对无纹理区域的鲁棒性。方法通过让匹配块在采样时自适应地形变，使其更好地贴合局部几何与纹理分布，从而在低纹理区域获得更稳定的匹配代价。相比固定窗口或固定采样的传统 MVS 方法，该策略提升了弱纹理场景下的重建完整度。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但其弱纹理鲁棒性思路对自动驾驶中路面、墙面等低纹理区域的三维重建有参考意义。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper targets the failure of multi-view stereo in textureless regions, where matching becomes ambiguous and depth estimation unreliable. It proposes an Adaptive Patch Deformation strategy that warps matching patches adaptively to better align with local geometry and texture distribution, yielding more stable matching costs in low-texture areas. Compared with fixed-window or fixed-sampling MVS pipelines, the approach improves reconstruction completeness in textureless scenes. No quantitative results are given in the abstract, but the textureless-robustness idea is relevant to reconstructing low-texture surfaces such as roads and walls in autonomous driving.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 针对 MVS 弱纹理难题提出自适应块变形，问题定位准确且思路直观，对自动驾驶中低纹理区域的三维重建有潜在价值，但缺少量化验证。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应块变形策略以提升多视角立体在无纹理区域的匹配鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 让匹配块采样随局部几何与纹理自适应形变，替代固定窗口/固定采样范式。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在无纹理区域获得更稳定的匹配与更完整的重建。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离、依赖后处理启发式匹配的问题，提出ADA-Track端到端框架，通过交替执行检测与关联并引入可学习的注意力关联模块，实现检测与跟踪的联合优化。相比已有两阶段或纯检测后关联方法，该方法在nuScenes跟踪基准上取得显著提升，AMOTA等指标优于同期方法，同时保持端到端可训练。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: ADA-Track addresses multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking by proposing an end-to-end framework that alternates between detection and association, replacing heuristic post-hoc matching with a learnable attention-based association module. It jointly optimizes detection and tracking, achieving state-of-the-art AMOTA on nuScenes tracking benchmarks compared to two-stage or detection-then-association baselines.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 该工作将检测与关联统一到端到端框架，对多相机BEV跟踪有重要参考价值，实验充分且指标领先。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架ADA-Track。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 用可学习注意力关联模块替代启发式匹配，实现检测与关联的联合优化。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes跟踪基准上AMOTA等指标优于同期方法。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: 针对多视角图像进行3D室内物体检测时几何信息利用不足的问题，提出CN-RMA，将射线行进聚合与组合网络结合，从多视角图像中重建并聚合3D特征用于检测。相比已有基于代价体或BEV投影的方法，该方法通过射线行进更精细地采样空间特征，在室内3D检测数据集上取得更优的定位与分类精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: CN-RMA tackles 3D indoor object detection from multi-view images by combining a ray marching aggregation with a combined network to better exploit geometric cues. Compared to cost-volume or BEV-projection baselines, it achieves improved localization and classification accuracy on indoor 3D detection benchmarks.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 射线行进聚合思路对多视角3D检测有借鉴意义，但室内场景与自动驾驶域差异较大，相关性中等。

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: 针对无参考点云质量评估中标注稀缺、特征表达不足的问题，提出结合多视角融合的对比预训练方法，通过自监督对比学习获取点云质量相关表征。相比已有无参考质量评估方法，该方法利用多视角融合增强特征鲁棒性，在多个点云质量数据集上取得更高的相关性指标。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses no-reference point cloud quality assessment by proposing a contrastive pre-training framework with multi-view fusion to learn quality-aware representations under scarce labels. It improves correlation metrics on multiple point cloud quality datasets compared to prior no-reference methods.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知主线相关性较低，但自监督对比预训练思路可迁移参考。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出多视角融合对比预训练用于无参考点云质量评估。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将多视角融合引入对比预训练以增强质量相关特征表达。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个点云质量数据集上相关性指标优于已有无参考方法。

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: 针对帕金森病运动症状评估依赖主观量表、缺乏客观量化的问题，提出TULIP多相机3D精度评估系统，利用多相机重建3D人体运动并进行精细量化。相比单相机或可穿戴传感器方案，该系统提供更精确的3D运动学指标，在临床评估中展示出与专家评分的一致性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: TULIP targets objective assessment of Parkinson's disease by using multi-camera 3D reconstruction to precisely quantify motor symptoms. Compared to single-camera or wearable-sensor approaches, it provides more accurate 3D kinematic metrics that correlate with expert clinical ratings.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 提出多相机3D精度评估系统TULIP用于帕金森病运动症状量化。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 将多相机3D重建用于临床运动症状的客观精细量化。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 3D运动学指标与专家评分具有一致性。

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: 针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖大量3D标注的问题，提出SelfPose3d自监督框架，利用多视角几何一致性和可微三角化在无3D标签下训练。相比需要3D真值的监督方法，该方法在多个多人姿态数据集上达到接近监督方法的精度，显著降低标注需求。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: SelfPose3d addresses multi-person multi-view 3D pose estimation without 3D annotations by leveraging multi-view geometric consistency and differentiable triangulation in a self-supervised framework. It approaches supervised accuracy on several benchmarks while eliminating the need for 3D ground truth.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督多视角几何一致性思路对多相机感知有启发，但任务与自动驾驶检测差异较大。

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: 针对实际多视角场景中视图噪声导致自监督聚类性能下降的问题，系统研究了噪声视图的副作用并提出缓解策略，通过视图可靠性加权与鲁棒融合提升聚类鲁棒性。相比忽略噪声视图的已有方法，该工作在含噪多视角数据上取得更稳定的聚类指标。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views in practical multi-view self-supervised clustering and proposes mitigation strategies via view-reliability weighting and robust fusion. It achieves more stable clustering metrics on noisy multi-view data than methods that ignore view noise.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知主线相关性低，但噪声视图鲁棒融合思路对多传感器融合有间接参考。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统研究并缓解多视角自监督聚类中噪声视图的副作用。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 引入视图可靠性加权与鲁棒融合以应对噪声视图。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在含噪多视角数据上聚类指标更稳定。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中LiDAR深度监督仅分布在物体表面、缺乏3D中心深度且远距离物体深度估计困难的问题，本文提出OPEN检测器。方法上先用物体级深度编码器以像素级深度图为先验估计物体级深度，再通过物体级位置嵌入将深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比已有像素级深度监督方法，OPEN显式建模物体中心深度，缓解了DETR类检测器对中心深度缺失的敏感问题。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称提升了多视角3D检测精度。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of pixel-wise depth supervision in multi-view 3D detection, where LiDAR depth lies on object surfaces and lacks 3D center depth, especially for distant objects. It proposes OPEN, which employs an object-wise depth encoder to estimate object-level depth from a pixel-wise depth prior and injects it into the transformer decoder via object-wise position embedding. This explicit object-center depth modeling improves over prior pixel-wise supervision for DETR-based 3D detectors.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该工作切中多视角3D检测中深度监督与DETR解码器不匹配的关键痛点，物体级位置嵌入思路简洁有效，值得关注。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级位置嵌入，将物体中心深度显式注入Transformer解码器以提升多视角3D检测。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 用物体级深度编码器从像素级深度先验中估计物体中心深度，并以位置嵌入形式注入解码器。
2407.10753|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在多视角3D检测上取得优于像素级深度监督方法的性能。

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型在核心视觉感知能力上的不足，提出Blink基准。方法上将14类经典计算机视觉任务重构为3807道多选题，配以单/多张图像和视觉提示，涵盖相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测和多视角推理等。结果显示人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%，表明这些感知能力尚未在多模态LLM中涌现。分析还指出专用CV模型表现更好，为未来改进指明方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Blink, a benchmark for multimodal LLMs focusing on core visual perception abilities. It reformats 14 classic CV tasks into 3,807 multiple-choice questions with visual prompting. Humans achieve 95.70% accuracy, while GPT-4V and Gemini reach only 51.26% and 45.72%, indicating such perception abilities have not emerged in current multimodal LLMs.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: Blink揭示了当前多模态LLM在基础视觉感知上的显著短板，为VLM与视觉感知结合的研究提供了重要评测基准，值得关注。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 提出Blink基准，系统评测多模态LLM在14类核心视觉感知任务上的能力。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 将经典CV感知任务重构为多选题形式，揭示多模态LLM感知能力尚未涌现。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类准确率95.70%，GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%。

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: 针对微小目标异常检测缺乏大规模多视角与视觉-文本联合基准的问题，论文构建了MANTA数据集，包含38个类别、13.73万张图像（其中8.6K张带像素级异常标注），每张图像从5个视角采集，并配套875词的陈述性知识（含what/why/how解释）和2K道多难度选择题。作者还提出了视觉-文本任务基线并在多种设置下对先进方法进行了广泛评测，揭示了该任务的挑战性。该数据集为微小目标异常检测与视觉-文本推理研究提供了新的评测平台。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: The paper introduces MANTA, a large-scale multi-view and visual-text anomaly detection dataset for tiny objects, comprising 137.3K images across 38 categories with 8.6K pixel-level anomalous annotations captured from five viewpoints, plus declarative knowledge (875 words) and 2K constructivist multiple-choice questions. A visual-text baseline is proposed and extensive benchmarking reveals the challenges of this task. It provides a new benchmark for tiny-object anomaly detection and visual-text reasoning.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 数据集规模与多视角、视觉-文本设计对异常检测和VLM交叉研究有参考价值，但任务偏工业/微小目标异常，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度中等。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模多视角视觉-文本微小目标异常检测数据集MANTA及配套基线。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 将多视角采集与陈述性知识、建构式选择题结合，形成视觉-文本联合异常检测基准。
2412.04867|v2.result: 提供13.73万图像、8.6K像素级异常标注与2K选择题，并通过广泛基准实验揭示任务挑战。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中解空间大、结果不理想，以及图像与部分点云配对数据难以获取的问题，论文提出PCDreamer，利用大模型内相对视角一致的多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视角图像，编码全局与局部形状线索。作者设计了形状融合模块从图像与点云多模态输入生成初始完整形状，并用形状整合模块剔除扩散先验不一致带来的不可靠点。实验表明其在恢复精细细节方面具有优越性能。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: To address the large solution space in point cloud completion and the difficulty of obtaining paired image-partial point cloud data, PCDreamer leverages view-consistent multi-view diffusion priors from large models to generate novel views encoding global and local shape cues. A shape fusion module produces an initial complete shape from images and point clouds, and a shape consolidation module removes unreliable points caused by diffusion inconsistency. Experiments demonstrate superior performance, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 将多视角扩散先验引入点云补全的思路新颖，对3D生成与感知中的形状补全有借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶检测主线相关度一般。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出利用多视角扩散先验进行点云补全的PCDreamer框架。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 用大模型多视角扩散先验生成新视角图像，并通过融合与整合模块处理扩散不一致性。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在点云补全任务上取得优越性能，尤其在恢复精细细节方面表现突出。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角重建3D方法易产生几何伪影、可控性差，而原生3D生成模型分辨率与质量受限的问题，论文提出Sharp-It，一个多视角到多视角的扩散模型，输入从低质量物体渲染的3D一致多视角图像，并行地在多视角集合上扩散并跨视角共享特征，以增强几何细节与纹理。增强后的多视角图像可重建出高质量3D模型，从而弥合直接3D生成与多视角重建之间的质量差距。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: To bridge the quality gap between direct 3D generative models and multi-view reconstruction pipelines, Sharp-It is a multi-view-to-multi-view diffusion model that takes a 3D-consistent multi-view set rendered from a low-quality object and enriches its geometric details and texture. The model operates on the multi-view set in parallel with cross-view feature sharing, enabling reconstruction of a high-quality 3D model from the enriched views.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 多视角到多视角扩散与跨视角特征共享的设计对3D生成有参考价值，但属于图形学/生成方向，与自动驾驶感知相关度较低。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视角到多视角扩散模型Sharp-It用于3D合成与编辑。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 在多视角集合上并行扩散并跨视角共享特征，增强低质量3D对象的几何与纹理。
2412.02631|v2.result: 弥合了直接3D生成与多视角重建的质量差距，可从增强多视角重建高质量3D模型。

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在人脸感知能力上缺乏系统评测基准的问题，本文构建了 FaceBench 数据集，包含五视角、最多三级层次化人脸属性结构（210+属性、700+属性值），共 49,919 个评测 VQA 对和 23,841 个微调对。作者还基于该数据训练了 Face-LLaVA 基线模型，并与主流 MLLM 及人类表现进行对比。结果显示现有 MLLM 在细粒度人脸属性理解上远未令人满意，而 Face-LLaVA 显著优于对比模型。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view multi-level facial attribute VQA dataset (49,919 evaluation and 23,841 fine-tuning pairs) to benchmark face perception in MLLMs. It further trains a Face-LLaVA baseline on the proposed data. Experiments show existing MLLMs struggle with fine-grained facial attributes, while Face-LLaVA substantially outperforms them.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 属于 VLM 评测基准工作，与人脸感知相关，但与自动驾驶/3D 感知领域几乎无交集，仅对多模态评测方法学有间接参考价值。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了层次化多视角人脸属性 VQA 基准 FaceBench 及 Face-LLaVA 基线。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 提出五视角三级层次化人脸属性结构并配套大规模 VQA 评测与微调数据。
2503.21457|v2.result: 揭示现有 MLLM 细粒度人脸理解不足，Face-LLaVA 显著超越主流模型。
