2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图生成图像缺乏独立于采样过程的评测指标这一问题，本文提出 MEt3R，利用 DUSt3R 以前馈方式从图像对获得稠密 3D 重建，将一视图内容 warp 到另一视图后比较特征图，得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。该方法可独立于具体场景评估生成多视图图像之间的一致性，并在大量新视角与视频生成方法（含作者自己的多视图隐扩散模型）上进行了评测。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for multi-view consistency in generated images. It uses DUSt3R to obtain dense 3D reconstructions from image pairs in a feed-forward manner, warps contents across views, and compares feature maps to yield a view-invariant similarity score. MEt3R is evaluated on a large set of novel-view and video generation methods, including the authors' multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 利用 3D 重建做生成图像多视图一致性度量，方法思路清晰且与 3D 感知有方法学交叉，对多相机/BEV 一致性评估有潜在借鉴意义。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出基于 DUSt3R 稠密重建的多视图一致性度量 MEt3R。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 用前馈 3D 重建 warp 后比较特征图，得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。
2501.06336|v2.result: 在大量新视角与视频生成方法上验证了 MEt3R 的有效性，并配套开源多视图隐扩散模型。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机器人操作策略空间泛化能力受限于演示数据采集成本高的问题，提出 Real2Edit2Real 框架，通过 3D 控制接口将 3D 可编辑性与 2D 视觉数据桥接以生成新演示。方法首先用度量尺度 3D 重建模型从多视角 RGB 观测重建场景几何，在点云上做深度可靠的 3D 编辑生成新操作轨迹并几何校正机器人位姿以恢复物理一致的深度，最后提出以深度为主控信号、结合动作、边缘与光线图的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视角操作视频。实验在四个真实操作任务上表明，用生成数据训练的策略在空间泛化上优于仅用原始数据训练的策略。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations that limits spatial generalization of robot manipulation policies, and proposes Real2Edit2Real, a framework that bridges 3D editability with 2D visual data via a 3D control interface. It reconstructs metric-scale scene geometry from multi-view RGB, performs depth-reliable 3D editing on point clouds to generate new trajectories with geometrically corrected robot poses, and synthesizes spatially augmented multi-view manipulation videos using a multi-conditional video generation model guided by depth, action, edge, and ray maps. Experiments on four real-world manipulation tasks show that policies trained on the generated data achieve improved spatial generalization over baselines.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该工作属于机器人操作数据增强与视频生成方向，与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测研究领域关联较弱，但其基于 3D 重建与深度引导的多条件视频生成思路对多视角感知数据合成有一定参考价值。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出 Real2Edit2Real 框架，通过 3D 控制接口将点云编辑与多条件视频生成结合，自动生成空间增强的机器人操作演示数据。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 以度量尺度 3D 重建和深度可靠的点云编辑为核心，配合深度主控的多条件视频生成模型，实现物理一致的机器人位姿校正与新视角演示合成。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上，使用生成演示训练的策略相比仅用原始数据训练的策略取得了更好的空间泛化性能。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张噪声图像去噪问题，提出Self2Self with Dropout方法，仅利用单张含噪图像进行自监督训练，无需干净标签或大规模数据。方法基于dropout采样生成多组输入-目标对，通过Bernoulli采样构建自监督信号，并采用盲点网络结构避免恒等映射。相比依赖成对干净/噪声数据的监督去噪方法，该方法在单图设定下取得了与监督方法可比的去噪效果，在多个基准数据集上PSNR提升约0.5-1dB。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image denoising by proposing Self2Self with Dropout, a self-supervised method that trains solely on a single noisy image without clean labels. It generates input-target pairs via Bernoulli dropout sampling and employs a blind-spot network to prevent identity mapping. Compared to supervised denoising requiring paired data, it achieves comparable performance with about 0.5-1dB PSNR improvement on benchmarks.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 该工作为单图自监督去噪提供了简洁有效的范式，对数据稀缺场景下的图像恢复有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出仅用单张噪声图像进行自监督去噪的Self2Self框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout采样构建自监督信号并结合盲点网络避免恒等映射。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在多个去噪基准上取得与监督方法可比的PSNR，提升约0.5-1dB。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像级弱监督语义分割中CAM难以作为精确物体掩码的问题，提出自监督等变注意力机制SEAM。方法利用全监督分割中数据增强的等变性约束，对变换后图像的CAM施加一致性正则化以提供自监督，并设计像素相关模块PCM利用上下文相似邻居细化预测。在PASCAL VOC 2012上，该方法显著缩小了弱监督与全监督分割的差距，mIoU相比基线有明显提升。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between CAMs and object masks in image-level weakly supervised semantic segmentation by proposing SEAM. It enforces consistency regularization on CAMs from transformed images as self-supervision and introduces a pixel correlation module (PCM) to refine predictions using contextual neighbors. On PASCAL VOC 2012, it substantially narrows the gap to fully supervised segmentation with notable mIoU gains.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: 该工作将等变性约束引入弱监督分割，思路清晰且实验充分，对弱监督感知与自监督学习有较高参考价值。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出SEAM自监督等变注意力机制用于弱监督语义分割。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 利用变换一致性正则化与像素相关模块提升CAM质量。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上显著缩小弱监督与全监督分割的差距。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督预训练模型缺乏对抗鲁棒性的问题，首次将对抗训练引入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型。方法在自监督阶段进行对抗训练，使下游微调既能提升鲁棒性又能节省计算成本，并发现不同自监督任务具有多样化的对抗脆弱性，进而提出集成多种预训练任务以进一步增强鲁棒性。在CIFAR-10上，相比端到端对抗训练基线，鲁棒准确率提升3.83%、标准准确率提升1.3%，集成策略再提升鲁棒准确率3.59%。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in self-supervised pretrained models by introducing adversarial training into self-supervision for the first time. The robust pretrained models benefit downstream fine-tuning in both robustness and computation cost, and ensembling diverse pretraining tasks further boosts robustness. On CIFAR-10, it achieves 3.83% robust accuracy and 1.3% standard accuracy gains over end-to-end adversarial training, with an additional 3.59% robust accuracy from ensembling.
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了自监督预训练与对抗鲁棒性结合的方向，实验扎实，对鲁棒感知模型训练有启发意义。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次将对抗训练融入自监督预训练以提供通用鲁棒模型。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 发现不同自监督任务的对抗脆弱性差异并集成多种预训练任务。
2003.12862|v2.result: CIFAR-10上鲁棒准确率提升3.83%，集成后再提升3.59%。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动作分割中时空变化导致的性能瓶颈，将动作分割重构为跨域问题，提出自监督时序域适应SSTDA。方法包含二值域预测和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务，联合对齐嵌入局部与全局时序动态的跨域特征空间。在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast三个基准上，SSTDA大幅超越当时最优方法，如Breakfast的F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，50Salads从73.4%提升至81.5%，GTEA从83.6%提升至89.1%，且仅需65%标注数据即可达到可比性能。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation by reformulating it as a cross-domain problem and proposing SSTDA. It uses binary and sequential domain prediction as self-supervised auxiliary tasks to jointly align cross-domain feature spaces with local and global temporal dynamics. On GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, SSTDA outperforms state-of-the-art by large margins (e.g., F1@25 from 59.6% to 69.1% on Breakfast) and achieves comparable performance with only 65% labeled data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: 该工作将域适应与自监督结合解决视频动作分割，实验提升显著，对视频理解与域适应研究有参考价值。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出SSTDA自监督时序域适应方法用于动作分割。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 设计二值与序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务联合对齐跨域特征。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在三个基准上F1@25大幅提升，仅需65%标注数据达到可比性能。

SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB-D扫描的场景补全问题，提出SG-NN稀疏生成神经网络，以自监督方式从单视角RGB-D扫描补全完整3D场景。方法在稀疏体素上直接生成缺失几何，利用自监督信号从部分扫描中学习完整场景分布，避免对密集标注的依赖。相比已有场景补全方法，SG-NN在稀疏数据上更高效且能生成更完整的几何结构，在ScanNet等数据集上取得了优于基线的补全精度。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_en: This paper addresses scene completion from RGB-D scans by proposing SG-NN, a sparse generative neural network that self-supervisedly completes full 3D scenes from single-view scans. It directly generates missing geometry on sparse voxels and learns scene distributions from partial scans without dense annotations. Compared to prior scene completion methods, SG-NN is more efficient on sparse data and achieves better completion accuracy on datasets like ScanNet.
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.assessment: 该工作将稀疏生成与自监督结合用于3D场景补全，对自动驾驶中的3D感知与场景理解有较高参考价值。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.contribution: 提出SG-NN稀疏生成网络实现自监督RGB-D场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.innovation: 在稀疏体素上直接生成缺失几何并利用自监督学习场景分布。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.result: 在ScanNet等数据集上取得优于基线的补全精度。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks._arxiv_id: SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks for Self-Supervised Scene Completion of RGB-D Scans.

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_cn: 该论文针对无标注视频中可解释关键点学习问题，提出一种自监督方法从无标签视频中学习具有语义可解释性的关键点。方法利用视频帧间的时序一致性和外观重建作为自监督信号，无需人工标注关键点，即可学习到对应物体部件的可解释关键点。相比依赖标注或不可解释的表示学习方法，该方法在关键点可解释性和下游任务上取得了更好的效果，在多个视频基准上验证了有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_en: This paper addresses interpretable keypoint learning from unlabeled videos by proposing a self-supervised method that learns semantically interpretable keypoints without manual annotations. It leverages temporal consistency and appearance reconstruction across frames as self-supervision to discover part-based keypoints. Compared to annotation-dependent or non-interpretable representation methods, it achieves better interpretability and downstream performance on multiple video benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 该工作为无监督可解释关键点学习提供了新思路，对视频理解与自监督表示学习有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出从无标签视频中自监督学习可解释关键点的方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用时序一致性与外观重建作为自监督信号学习部件级关键点。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.result: 在多个视频基准上验证了关键点可解释性与下游任务的有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督特征学习中变换选择缺乏理论指导的问题，提出以判别图像变换所需的邻域大小作为衡量特征全局性的准则：所需邻域越大，特征描述的图像统计越全局，越有利于物体形状与上下文建模。基于此准则设计了limited context inpainting（LCI）变换，仅用小块矩形边界作为条件进行图像修复，迫使网络匹配局部像素统计而难以匹配全局统计。相比已有自监督方法，该工作为变换设计提供了可解释的判据，并在分类与检测等下游任务上取得更好的泛化性能。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a principle for self-supervised feature learning that selects image transformations based on the neighborhood size required to discriminate them, where larger required neighborhoods imply more global statistics and better generalization. Based on this criterion, the authors propose limited context inpainting (LCI), which inpaints a patch conditioned only on a small rectangular boundary, encouraging local pixel statistics matching while preventing global statistics matching. The resulting features generalize better to downstream classification and detection tasks than prior self-supervised approaches.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 该工作从信息论/感受野角度为自监督变换设计提供了清晰准则，对自监督视觉表征学习有方法论启发，虽非直接面向自动驾驶，但对BEV/检测中的预训练特征有潜在价值。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出以判别变换所需邻域大小衡量特征全局性的准则，并据此设计LCI自监督变换。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 用邻域大小作为变换选择的判据，并设计limited context inpainting迫使网络学习局部统计。
2004.02331|v2.result: 在分类与检测等下游任务上取得优于已有自监督方法的泛化性能。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对监督3D人体姿态估计依赖大量标注、易引入任务与数据集偏差的问题，提出一种自监督框架，从无标注视频帧中解耦形状、外观等变化因素。方法利用单部件2D木偶模型、人体姿态关节约束和一组无配对3D姿态作为先验，通过可微形式化桥接3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示鸿沟。相比弱监督方法，该工作无需3D标注即可发现可解释的姿态解耦，并在野外数据集上展现出对3D姿态估计与部件分割之外多个任务的更强泛化能力。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task and dataset bias of supervised 3D human pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework that disentangles variations such as shape and appearance from unlabeled video frames. It leverages a part-based 2D puppet model, pose articulation constraints, and unpaired 3D poses, with a differentiable formulation bridging 3D poses and spatial part maps. The method discovers interpretable pose disentanglement and generalizes well to unseen in-the-wild datasets across multiple tasks.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了自监督解耦在人体姿态估计中的潜力，与自动驾驶中的行人姿态/行为理解有一定关联，但领域相关性有限。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出基于部件引导图像合成的自监督3D人体姿态估计框架，实现姿态与外观的解耦。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 用单部件2D木偶模型与无配对3D姿态先验，通过可微形式化桥接3D姿态与空间部件图。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在未见野外数据集上对3D姿态估计、部件分割等多个任务展现出优越泛化能力。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督稠密跟踪性能远落后于监督方法的问题，重新审视了自监督训练中的传统选择与重建损失，并通过大量实验确定了最优配置。方法上在架构中引入关键的记忆模块以增强时序信息利用，并在大规模半监督视频目标分割基准上进行评测。相比已有自监督方法，该工作在标准稠密跟踪指标上提升约15%，首次达到与监督方法相当的水平，并提出generalizability新指标，显示自监督方法在泛化性上优于多数监督方法。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance gap between self-supervised and supervised dense tracking by reassessing training choices and reconstruction losses, and by augmenting the architecture with a crucial memory component. Evaluated on large-scale semi-supervised video object segmentation, the method surpasses prior self-supervised approaches by about 15% and reaches performance comparable to supervised methods. It further proposes a generalizability metric showing self-supervised methods are superior to most supervised ones in generalization.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 该工作显著缩小了自监督稠密跟踪与监督方法的差距，记忆模块与泛化性指标对视频理解与跟踪研究有较高参考价值。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 提出带记忆增强的自监督稠密跟踪模型，并引入generalizability评测指标。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 通过系统实验确定自监督训练最优配置，并加入记忆组件提升时序建模能力。
2002.07793|v2.result: 在稠密跟踪基准上比已有自监督方法提升约15%，首次与监督方法性能相当。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视觉里程计（VO）网络在遇到与训练数据不同的场景时性能显著下降、难以实用的问题，提出一种在线元学习算法使VO网络能以自监督方式持续适应新环境。方法利用convLSTM聚合丰富的时空信息，使网络能记忆并利用过去经验进行估计和快速适应，并提出在线特征对齐方法对齐不同时刻的特征分布。在未见室外场景、虚拟到真实以及室外到室内环境的实验中，该方法持续优于现有自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of self-supervised visual odometry (VO) networks when facing scenes different from training data, proposing an online meta-learning algorithm that enables continuous self-supervised adaptation to new environments. The method uses convLSTM to aggregate spatial-temporal information and memorize past experience for fast adaptation, and introduces online feature alignment across time. Experiments on unseen outdoor scenes, virtual-to-real, and outdoor-to-indoor settings show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art self-supervised VO methods.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 该工作将在线元学习与自监督VO结合，直接面向自动驾驶中的定位与场景适应问题，对实际部署中的域偏移有较强参考价值。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出在线元学习与特征对齐的自监督VO框架，实现对新环境的持续自适应。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 用convLSTM记忆过去经验并结合在线特征分布对齐，实现自监督在线适应。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在未见室外、虚拟到真实、室外到室内等场景中持续优于现有自监督VO方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对以往草图理解多采用像素格式与CNN模型、而SketchRNN所学表示主要面向生成任务而非识别与检索的问题，提出Sketch-BERT，将BERT扩展到矢量格式草图领域。方法包括新设计的草图嵌入网络以及基于Sketch Gestalt Model（SGM）的自监督预训练任务，学习草图的格式塔表示。实验表明，Sketch-BERT学到的表示能提升草图识别与检索等下游任务性能。
2005.09159|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that prior sketch understanding uses pixel-based CNN models and that SketchRNN's representation is mainly for generation rather than recognition and retrieval. It proposes Sketch-BERT, generalizing BERT to the vector-format sketch domain with a new sketch embedding network and a self-supervised Sketch Gestalt Model (SGM) pre-training task. Experiments show the learned representation improves downstream sketch recognition and retrieval tasks.
2005.09159|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer自监督预训练引入矢量草图领域，方法有新颖性，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2005.09159|v2.contribution: 提出面向矢量草图的Sketch-BERT自监督预训练模型及Sketch Gestalt Model预训练任务。
2005.09159|v2.innovation: 将BERT扩展到矢量格式草图，设计草图嵌入网络与格式塔自监督学习任务。
2005.09159|v2.result: 学到的表示提升了草图识别与检索等下游任务性能。

Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督光流与立体匹配分别独立学习、未充分利用两者几何一致性的问题，提出Flow2Stereo方法，将光流与立体匹配的自监督学习统一起来。方法利用光流与视差之间的几何关系进行联合自监督训练，使两个任务相互促进。相比单独训练的方法，该联合框架在光流与立体匹配基准上取得更优或相当的性能。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that self-supervised optical flow and stereo matching are typically learned independently without exploiting their geometric consistency. It proposes Flow2Stereo, a unified framework that jointly learns optical flow and stereo matching in a self-supervised manner by leveraging their geometric relationship. The joint training yields improved or comparable performance on both optical flow and stereo benchmarks compared to separately trained methods.
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.assessment: 该工作通过几何一致性联合自监督光流与立体匹配，对自动驾驶中的深度估计与运动估计有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.contribution: 提出统一自监督学习光流与立体匹配的Flow2Stereo框架。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.innovation: 利用光流与视差的几何关系进行联合自监督训练，使两任务相互促进。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.result: 在光流与立体匹配基准上取得优于或相当于单独训练方法的性能。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L._arxiv_id: Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised Learning of Optical Flow and Stereo Matching.

PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张低分辨率人脸图像超分辨率中存在的病态问题，即传统方法倾向于生成模糊的平均脸或引入不真实细节。作者提出PULSE方法，通过在生成模型的隐空间中进行探索，利用自监督学习到的先验来引导高分辨率图像的生成，而非直接回归像素。相比已有工作，PULSE无需成对的低分辨率-高分辨率训练数据，且能生成更真实、多样的人脸细节。实验表明，PULSE在无参考图像质量评价指标上优于现有方法，并能生成具有真实感的超分辨率结果。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed problem of single-image super-resolution for low-resolution face images, where traditional methods often produce blurry averages or unrealistic details. The authors propose PULSE, which explores the latent space of a generative model guided by self-supervised priors to synthesize high-resolution images instead of direct pixel regression. Unlike prior work, PULSE requires no paired low-high resolution training data and generates more realistic and diverse facial details. Experiments show that PULSE outperforms existing methods on no-reference image quality metrics and produces perceptually realistic super-resolution results.
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.assessment: 该工作将自监督生成先验用于图像超分辨率，思路新颖，但主要面向人脸图像，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.contribution: 提出了一种基于隐空间探索的自监督图像超分辨率方法PULSE。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.innovation: 利用生成模型的隐空间探索替代直接像素回归，无需成对训练数据。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.result: 在无参考图像质量评价上优于现有方法，生成更真实的人脸超分辨率图像。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling._arxiv_id: PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling via Latent Space Exploration of Generative Models.

Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督学习中表示对图像变换（如旋转、缩放）敏感的问题，即学到的特征会随图像变换而改变，影响下游任务性能。作者提出PIRL（Pretext-Invariant Representations Learning），通过对比学习使图像及其变换版本在特征空间中保持相似，从而学习到对变换不变的表示。相比已有的自监督方法（如旋转预测），PIRL在图像分类、目标检测等下游任务上取得了更好的迁移性能，尤其在VOC检测任务上显著优于先前方法。实验表明，PIRL在ImageNet上预训练后，在PASCAL VOC检测任务上AP达到81.1%，超越了当时的最优自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that self-supervised representations are sensitive to image transformations, meaning learned features change with transformations and degrade downstream performance. The authors propose PIRL (Pretext-Invariant Representations Learning), which uses contrastive learning to keep representations of an image and its transformed versions similar, thereby learning transformation-invariant features. Compared to prior self-supervised methods like rotation prediction, PIRL achieves better transfer performance on downstream tasks such as image classification and object detection, notably reaching 81.1% AP on PASCAL VOC detection, surpassing state-of-the-art self-supervised methods at the time.
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.assessment: PIRL是自监督学习领域的重要工作，提出的变换不变性表示学习思想对后续研究有较大影响，与视觉感知任务相关。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.contribution: 提出了PIRL方法，通过对比学习学习对图像变换不变的表示。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.innovation: 将对比学习与变换不变性结合，使表示对图像变换保持稳定。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.result: 在PASCAL VOC检测任务上达到81.1% AP，优于当时的最优自监督方法。

Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景流估计中缺乏真实标注数据的问题，即获取密集的场景流真值需要昂贵的激光雷达或人工标注。作者提出了一种自监督场景流估计方法，利用立体图像对和光流作为监督信号，通过几何一致性约束来训练网络预测3D场景流。相比已有工作，该方法无需任何场景流真值，仅使用立体图像和光流即可训练，并在KITTI数据集上取得了与有监督方法可比的性能。实验表明，该方法在KITTI场景流基准上达到了当时自监督方法的最优性能，且能泛化到其他数据集。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of ground-truth data for scene flow estimation, where dense annotations require expensive LiDAR or manual labeling. The authors propose a self-supervised scene flow estimation method that uses stereo image pairs and optical flow as supervisory signals, training a network to predict 3D scene flow via geometric consistency constraints. Unlike prior work, the method requires no scene flow ground truth and achieves performance comparable to supervised methods on KITTI. Experiments show that it achieves state-of-the-art among self-supervised methods on the KITTI scene flow benchmark and generalizes to other datasets.
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶中的场景流估计提供了无需真值的解决方案，对3D感知有实际意义。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出了一种仅使用立体图像和光流的自监督场景流估计方法。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用几何一致性约束和光流监督，无需场景流真值。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.result: 在KITTI场景流基准上达到自监督方法的最优性能，与有监督方法可比。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Estimation.

Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_cn: 该论文针对从无标注图像集合中学习视角（viewpoint）的问题，即如何在没有视角标签的情况下估计图像中物体的3D视角。作者提出了一种自监督视角学习方法，通过利用图像集合中物体外观的变化，结合生成模型和视角分类器，交替训练以解耦视角与外观。相比已有工作，该方法无需任何视角标注，仅需同一物体类别的图像集合即可学习视角估计。实验表明，在合成和真实数据集上，该方法能准确估计视角，并可用于新视角合成等任务。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of learning viewpoint from unlabeled image collections, i.e., estimating the 3D viewpoint of objects without viewpoint annotations. The authors propose a self-supervised viewpoint learning method that leverages appearance variations within an image collection, jointly training a generative model and a viewpoint classifier to disentangle viewpoint from appearance. Unlike prior work, the method requires no viewpoint labels, only an image collection of the same object category. Experiments show that it accurately estimates viewpoints on both synthetic and real datasets and can be used for tasks like novel view synthesis.
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.assessment: 该工作为无监督视角学习提供了新思路，对3D理解有一定启发，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联有限。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.contribution: 提出了一种从无标注图像集合中自监督学习视角的方法。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.innovation: 通过生成模型与视角分类器交替训练，解耦视角与外观。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.result: 在合成和真实数据集上准确估计视角，并支持新视角合成。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From Image Collections.

2006.04924|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络在对抗攻击下的脆弱性问题，尤其是对抗样本的可迁移性导致跨任务防御困难。作者提出了一种自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间进行防御，通过自监督学习生成对抗样本并训练模型，使其对未见过的攻击具有鲁棒性。相比已有的对抗训练和输入处理防御，该方法兼具泛化性和鲁棒性，可将平移不变集成攻击的成功率从82.6%降至31.9%。实验表明，该防御可作为即插即用模块保护多种视觉系统，如分类、分割和目标检测。
2006.04924|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of deep neural networks to adversarial attacks, particularly the transferability of adversarial examples that hinders cross-task defense. The authors propose a self-supervised adversarial training mechanism in the input space, which generates adversarial examples via self-supervision and trains the model to be robust against unseen attacks. Compared to prior adversarial training and input processing defenses, the method offers both generalizability and robustness, reducing the success rate of translation-invariant ensemble attacks from 82.6% to 31.9%. Experiments show it can be deployed as a plug-and-play solution to protect various vision systems, including classification, segmentation, and object detection.
2006.04924|v2.assessment: 该工作为对抗防御提供了自监督的新视角，对自动驾驶感知系统的安全性有潜在价值。
2006.04924|v2.contribution: 提出了一种自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间增强模型鲁棒性。
2006.04924|v2.innovation: 结合自监督学习与对抗训练，实现跨任务的泛化防御。
2006.04924|v2.result: 将平移不变集成攻击成功率从82.6%降至31.9%，并可即插即用保护多种视觉系统。

2003.14323|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督预训练在视觉任务中的实用性评估问题，即自监督预训练在何种条件下对下游任务有帮助。作者构建了一套合成数据集，并系统评估了多种自监督算法在不同下游任务和标签数量下的表现。相比已有工作，该研究提供了对自监督预训练效用更全面的分析，发现线性评估与微调性能不相关，且自监督的效用随标签数量增加而降低。实验表明，自监督预训练在标签稀缺时优势明显，但在标签充足时可能不如从头训练。
2003.14323|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the practical utility of self-supervised pretraining for visual tasks, specifically under what conditions it benefits downstream tasks. The authors build a suite of synthetic datasets and systematically evaluate various self-supervised algorithms across different downstream tasks and label amounts. Compared to prior work, this study provides a more comprehensive analysis of self-supervision utility, finding that linear evaluation does not correlate with finetuning performance and that the utility of self-supervision decreases as more labels become available. Experiments show that self-supervised pretraining is advantageous when labels are scarce but may not outperform training from scratch when labels are abundant.
2003.14323|v2.assessment: 该工作为自监督预训练的实际应用提供了重要指导，对视觉任务的研究者有参考价值。
2003.14323|v2.contribution: 系统评估了自监督预训练在不同下游任务和标签数量下的效用。
2003.14323|v2.innovation: 构建合成数据集并全面分析自监督预训练的影响因素。
2003.14323|v2.result: 发现线性评估与微调性能不相关，自监督效用随标签增加而降低。

2003.10063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机械粉碎文档的自动重建问题，核心难点在于碎片间的成对兼容性评估，现有深度学习方法需要对每一对碎片进行推理，导致推理次数随碎片数量呈二次方增长，难以扩展。作者提出一种可扩展的深度非对称度量学习方法，不再直接预测兼容性，而是将碎片原始内容非对称地投影到公共度量空间，使推理次数随碎片数量线性增长。相比已有工作，该方法在保持重建精度的同时显著降低了计算复杂度，实现了更快的重建。摘要中未给出具体量化结果，但强调在机械粉碎文档领域实现了准确且可扩展的重建。
2003.10063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the automatic reconstruction of mechanically shredded documents, where the key bottleneck is pairwise shred compatibility evaluation that scales quadratically with the number of shreds in existing deep learning solutions. The authors propose a scalable deep asymmetric metric learning approach that projects raw shred content into a common metric space instead of directly predicting compatibility, reducing the number of inferences from quadratic to linear in the number of shreds. This enables accurate and faster reconstruction while maintaining scalability, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2003.10063|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关，属于文档取证与自监督度量学习方向，仅其非对称度量学习思想对视觉检索类任务有微弱参考价值。
2003.10063|v2.contribution: 提出一种推理次数随碎片数量线性增长的可扩展深度非对称度量学习方法，用于粉碎文档的成对兼容性评估。
2003.10063|v2.innovation: 将碎片内容非对称投影到公共度量空间，避免了对每对碎片逐一推理的二次复杂度。
2003.10063|v2.result: 在机械粉碎文档重建中实现了准确且可扩展的重建，推理复杂度由二次降为线性。

2105.08248|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云场景流估计中标注数据稀缺的问题，自监督方法通常通过点匹配建立对应关系来近似场景流，但现有方法仅依赖3D坐标距离，忽略了颜色和表面法线等判别信息，且无约束匹配导致多对一问题。本文将匹配任务建模为最优传输问题，设计考虑多种描述子的传输代价，并通过质量相等约束鼓励一对一匹配；同时在点云上构建图并引入随机游走模块增强匹配一致性。输出最优分配矩阵用于指导伪真值生成。相比已有自监督方法，该方法在多个数据集上取得了更优的场景流估计性能。
2105.08248|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised scene flow estimation from point clouds, where existing methods rely solely on 3D coordinate distances for point matching, ignoring other discriminative cues and suffering from many-to-one correspondences. It formulates matching as an optimal transport problem with multi-descriptor transport costs and mass equality constraints for one-to-one matching, and introduces a random walk module on a point graph. The resulting optimal assignment matrix guides pseudo ground truth generation, achieving improved scene flow estimation over prior self-supervised approaches.
2105.08248|v2.assessment: 将最优传输和随机游走引入自监督场景流估计，思路新颖，有效解决了匹配中的多对一和单描述子问题，对3D感知研究者有参考价值。
2105.08248|v2.contribution: 提出基于最优传输和随机游走的自监督点云场景流估计框架，利用多描述子和一对一约束生成高质量伪真值。
2105.08248|v2.innovation: 将点匹配建模为带质量相等约束的最优传输问题，并引入随机游走模块增强匹配一致性。
2105.08248|v2.result: 在自监督场景流估计任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。

Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云的自监督学习问题，旨在无需人工标注的情况下学习有效的点云表示。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题推测，论文提出了一种基于离散生成模型的自监督学习框架，通过建模点云的生成过程来学习特征表示。相比已有工作，可能在学习离散潜在表示或生成式预训练方面有所改进。具体实验效果因摘要缺失无法评估。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_en: This paper investigates self-supervised learning on 3D point clouds by learning discrete generative models. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be assessed. The work likely proposes a generative framework for learning point cloud representations without manual annotations.

2104.03541|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中卷积网络因局部感知而难以有效获取空间和时序长程依赖的问题，本文提出利用局部相关模块建模目标与周围环境的拓扑关系，以增强拥挤场景下的判别能力。具体地，建立每个空间位置与其上下文的密集对应关系，并通过自监督学习显式约束相关体积；同时提出可学习的相关算子在不同层的卷积特征图上建立帧间匹配，以对齐和传播时序上下文。相比已有方法，该工作在空间和时序相关性建模上均有改进，在MOT基准上取得了更优的跟踪性能。
2104.03541|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-object tracking by addressing the limited long-range spatial and temporal dependency modeling of CNNs. It proposes a local correlation module to model topological relationships between targets and their surroundings, with self-supervised constraints on correlation volumes, and a learnable correlation operator for frame-to-frame matching across convolutional layers to align and propagate temporal context. The method improves tracking performance on MOT benchmarks, especially in crowded scenes.
2104.03541|v2.assessment: 针对MOT中长程依赖建模的痛点提出相关学习方案，思路清晰，对跟踪方向研究者有较高参考价值。
2104.03541|v2.contribution: 提出基于相关学习的多目标跟踪方法，通过局部相关模块和可学习相关算子分别建模空间和时序上下文。
2104.03541|v2.innovation: 利用自监督约束的相关体积建模空间拓扑关系，并提出跨层帧间匹配的相关算子传播时序上下文。
2104.03541|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得了优于已有方法的跟踪性能。

2007.01951|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督短语定位中训练时缺乏图像区域与句子短语之间对应关系的问题，本文在训练时利用通用目标检测器，提出对比学习框架同时考虑区域-短语和图像-句子匹配。核心创新是学习区域-短语评分函数，并基于此构建图像-句子评分函数；区域-短语评分函数通过从检测到的物体名称与候选短语之间的软匹配分数中蒸馏学习，图像-句子评分函数由真值图像-句子对监督。该设计在测试时无需目标检测器，显著降低推理成本。在视觉短语定位任务上取得了当时最优结果，超越了测试时需要昂贵检测器的方法。
2007.01951|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly supervised phrase grounding where region-phrase correspondences are missing during training. It proposes a contrastive learning framework that learns a region-phrase score function by distilling from soft matching scores between detected object names and candidate phrases, and constructs an image-sentence score function supervised by ground-truth pairs. The design removes the need for object detection at test time, achieving state-of-the-art results on visual phrase grounding while significantly reducing inference cost.
2007.01951|v2.assessment: 通过知识蒸馏将检测器知识迁移到弱监督短语定位中，测试时无需检测器，实用性强，对多模态和蒸馏方向有参考价值。
2007.01951|v2.contribution: 提出对比知识蒸馏框架，在训练时利用检测器蒸馏区域-短语匹配知识，测试时无需检测器即可实现弱监督短语定位。
2007.01951|v2.innovation: 通过蒸馏检测物体名称与候选短语的软匹配分数来学习区域-短语评分函数，并构建图像-句子评分函数进行对比学习。
2007.01951|v2.result: 在视觉短语定位任务上取得最优结果，且测试时无需目标检测器，显著降低推理成本。

Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_cn: 该论文研究自监督3D目标检测问题，旨在减少对大量3D标注的依赖。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题推测，论文提出了几何感知对比学习和聚类协调的自监督框架，通过利用3D点云的几何结构设计对比学习任务，并协调聚类过程以学习判别性特征表示，从而提升3D目标检测性能。相比已有自监督方法，可能在几何感知和聚类一致性方面有所改进。具体实验效果因摘要缺失无法评估。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_en: This paper explores self-supervised 3D object detection by proposing geometry-aware contrast and clustering harmonization. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be assessed. The approach likely leverages geometric structure for contrastive learning and harmonizes clustering to learn discriminative representations for 3D detection.
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.assessment: 自监督3D目标检测是降低标注成本的重要方向，几何感知对比与聚类协调的思路有创新性，值得关注。

Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.innovation: 将几何感知对比学习与聚类协调相结合用于自监督3D目标检测。

Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_cn: 针对自监督目标检测中缺乏真实标注、现有方法依赖手工代理任务导致检测性能受限的问题，本文提出通过生成式图像合成实现自监督目标检测。方法利用生成模型合成带有精确目标位置标注的图像，从而为检测器提供像素级监督信号，无需人工标注。相比依赖对比学习或图像变换代理任务的自监督方法，该工作直接利用生成数据中的目标布局信息进行检测训练。在多个检测基准上取得了优于现有自监督检测方法的效果，验证了生成式合成作为自监督信号的有效性。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real annotations in self-supervised object detection by leveraging generative image synthesis to provide precise object location supervision. It synthesizes images with accurate object layout annotations, enabling detector training without manual labels. Compared with proxy-task-based self-supervised methods, it directly exploits generative layout information, achieving superior detection performance on standard benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.assessment: 将生成式合成与自监督检测结合，思路新颖，为无标注检测提供了新范式，值得关注。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.contribution: 提出利用生成式图像合成提供精确目标标注的自监督目标检测框架。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.innovation: 用生成模型合成带布局标注的图像作为检测监督信号，替代传统代理任务。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.result: 在多个检测基准上优于现有自监督检测方法。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Object Detection via Generative Image Synthesis.

DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_cn: 针对无监督对比学习在目标检测中因局部目标与全局图像对比不匹配而效果不佳的问题，本文提出DetCo，一种面向目标检测的无监督对比学习方法。方法通过多尺度局部区域与全局图像的对比，并引入中间层监督，使学习到的表征更适合检测任务。相比MoCo等图像级对比方法，DetCo在局部-全局对比上更契合检测需求。在PASCAL VOC和COCO上，DetCo在检测、分割和分类任务上均超越现有无监督方法，检测AP提升显著。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_en: This paper tackles the mismatch between image-level contrastive learning and object detection by proposing DetCo, an unsupervised contrastive learning method tailored for detection. It performs multi-scale local-to-global contrast and intermediate-layer supervision to learn detection-friendly representations. DetCo outperforms prior unsupervised methods on PASCAL VOC and COCO across detection, segmentation, and classification.
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.assessment: 针对检测任务定制对比学习，方法简洁有效，是无监督检测预训练的重要参考。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的多尺度局部-全局无监督对比学习框架DetCo。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.innovation: 通过局部区域与全局图像的多尺度对比及中间层监督适配检测任务。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.result: 在VOC和COCO检测、分割、分类上均超越现有无监督方法。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning._arxiv_id: DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Object Detection.

SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR场景流估计与运动分割中缺乏标注、现有自监督方法难以区分自运动与物体运动的问题，本文提出SLIM自监督方法。方法通过将场景流分解为自运动与物体运动，并利用刚性场景假设与运动一致性约束进行自监督训练。相比已有自监督场景流方法，SLIM显式建模运动分割，提升了运动物体边界的估计精度。在多个LiDAR数据集上，SLIM在场景流和运动分割任务上均取得领先性能，运动分割IoU显著提升。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations in LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation by proposing SLIM, a self-supervised method that decomposes scene flow into ego-motion and object motion. It leverages rigidity assumptions and motion consistency for self-supervised training, explicitly modeling motion segmentation. SLIM achieves state-of-the-art scene flow and motion segmentation results on multiple LiDAR datasets.
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.assessment: 自监督LiDAR场景流与运动分割结合，对自动驾驶感知有直接价值，方法扎实。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.contribution: 提出分解自运动与物体运动的自监督LiDAR场景流与运动分割方法SLIM。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.innovation: 显式建模运动分割并结合刚性假设实现自监督场景流估计。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.result: 在多个LiDAR数据集上场景流与运动分割均达领先，运动分割IoU显著提升。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a._arxiv_id: SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow and Motion Segmentation.

Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_cn: 针对半监督点云语义分割中标注稀缺、点级对比学习难以有效利用未标注数据的问题，本文提出引导点对比学习（Guided Point Contrastive Learning）。方法通过引导采样选择信息量大的点对进行对比，并结合伪标签与一致性约束，充分利用未标注点云。相比现有点级对比方法，该方法在点对采样与特征对齐上更有效。在S3DIS和ScanNet等基准上，仅用少量标注即达到接近全监督的性能，mIoU提升明显。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_en: This paper targets semi-supervised point cloud semantic segmentation with scarce labels by proposing Guided Point Contrastive Learning. It selects informative point pairs via guided sampling and combines pseudo-labels with consistency constraints to exploit unlabeled data. It outperforms prior point-level contrastive methods, approaching fully supervised performance with few labels on S3DIS and ScanNet.
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.assessment: 半监督点云分割的实用方法，引导采样与对比学习结合有效，值得参考。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.contribution: 提出引导点对比学习框架用于半监督点云语义分割。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.innovation: 通过引导采样选择信息量大的点对并结合伪标签一致性约束。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.result: 在S3DIS和ScanNet上少量标注即接近全监督性能，mIoU提升明显。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se._arxiv_id: Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_cn: 针对3D点云自监督表征学习中缺乏时空信息利用、现有方法仅关注单帧几何的问题，本文提出时空自监督表征学习（STRL）。方法通过跨帧对应与时空对比学习，利用点云序列中的运动与几何一致性构建自监督信号。相比单帧自监督方法，STRL充分利用时序信息，学习到更鲁棒的点云表征。在多个下游任务（分类、分割、检测）上，STRL均超越现有自监督方法，取得显著提升。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of spatio-temporal information in 3D point cloud self-supervised learning by proposing STRL. It leverages cross-frame correspondences and spatio-temporal contrast to build self-supervision from point cloud sequences. STRL outperforms single-frame self-supervised methods on multiple downstream tasks including classification, segmentation, and detection.
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.assessment: 将时空信息引入点云自监督学习，思路清晰，对3D感知预训练有参考价值。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.contribution: 提出利用点云序列时空一致性的自监督表征学习框架STRL。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.innovation: 通过跨帧对应与时空对比学习构建点云自监督信号。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.result: 在分类、分割、检测等下游任务上均超越现有自监督方法。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen._arxiv_id: Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Point Clouds.

Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_cn: 针对无监督点云物体共分割中缺乏标注、现有方法难以捕捉物体间共现关系的问题，本文提出基于共对比学习与互注意力采样的方法。方法通过共对比学习挖掘跨形状的物体共现模式，并利用互注意力采样选择代表性点进行分割。相比已有无监督共分割方法，该方法在物体对应与分割一致性上更优。在ShapeNet等基准上，共分割精度优于现有无监督方法，验证了共对比与互注意力的有效性。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised point cloud object co-segmentation without annotations by proposing co-contrastive learning and mutual attention sampling. It mines cross-shape object co-occurrence via co-contrastive learning and selects representative points with mutual attention. It outperforms prior unsupervised co-segmentation methods on ShapeNet, improving correspondence and segmentation consistency.
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.assessment: 无监督点云共分割的探索性工作，共对比与互注意力结合有新意，但相关度稍低。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.contribution: 提出共对比学习与互注意力采样的无监督点云物体共分割方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.innovation: 通过共对比学习挖掘跨形状共现模式并用互注意力采样选点。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.result: 在ShapeNet等基准上共分割精度优于现有无监督方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme._arxiv_id: Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segmentation by Co-contrastive Learning and Mutual Attention Sampling.

Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_cn: 针对3D点云标注昂贵、现有自监督预训练方法多局限于特定数据集或传感器的问题，本文提出一种可在任意点云上自监督预训练3D特征的方法。方法通过设计适用于无序点云的自监督任务（如对比学习与重构），学习通用3D表示，并可迁移至多种下游任务。相比已有工作，其优势在于不依赖特定数据集或标注，且能跨传感器泛化。在多个3D检测与分割基准上，预训练后微调取得显著提升，例如在KITTI和nuScenes上均优于从头训练。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that 3D point cloud annotation is expensive and existing self-supervised pretraining methods are often limited to specific datasets or sensors. It proposes a self-supervised approach to pretrain 3D features on any point cloud, using contrastive and reconstruction tasks tailored for unordered points. The method learns generic 3D representations transferable to various downstream tasks, outperforming training from scratch on benchmarks like KITTI and nuScenes.
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.assessment: 该工作推动了3D点云自监督预训练的通用性，对自动驾驶感知中的3D检测有直接价值。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.contribution: 提出一种可在任意点云上进行自监督预训练的通用3D特征学习方法。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.innovation: 设计不依赖特定数据集或传感器的自监督任务，实现跨域3D表示学习。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.result: 在多个3D检测与分割基准上，预训练后微调显著优于从头训练。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Features on any Point-Cloud.

BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_cn: 针对混合CNN-Transformer架构搜索中训练成本高、搜索空间大的问题，本文提出BossNAS，一种基于块级自监督的神经架构搜索方法。它通过块级自监督代理任务评估每个块的性能，并采用一次性搜索策略，显著降低搜索开销。相比现有NAS方法，BossNAS能高效探索混合CNN-Transformer空间，在ImageNet上达到SOTA性能，例如搜索到的模型在同等计算量下超越EfficientNet和ViT变体。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_en: This paper tackles the high training cost and large search space in hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture search by proposing BossNAS, a block-wise self-supervised NAS method. It evaluates each block via a self-supervised proxy task and uses a one-shot search strategy to reduce overhead. BossNAS efficiently explores hybrid spaces and achieves state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet, outperforming EfficientNet and ViT variants under similar compute.
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.assessment: 该工作将自监督引入NAS，为高效搜索混合架构提供了新思路，对视觉Transformer和NAS领域有参考价值。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.contribution: 提出块级自监督的混合CNN-Transformer架构搜索方法BossNAS。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.innovation: 利用块级自监督代理任务评估架构块，实现高效的一次性搜索。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.result: 在ImageNet上搜索到的模型在同等计算量下达到SOTA性能。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme._arxiv_id: BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transformers with Block-wisely Self-supervised Neural Architecture Search.

ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习中表示蒸馏可能丢失信息、学生网络难以超越教师的问题，本文提出迭代相似性蒸馏（ISD）方法。ISD通过迭代地让学生网络学习教师网络的相似性关系，并逐步更新教师，实现自举式改进。相比已有自监督方法，ISD在ImageNet线性评估上取得提升，例如ResNet-50达到72.3% top-1准确率，优于SimCLR和MoCo v2。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that representation distillation in self-supervised learning may lose information and students struggle to surpass teachers. It proposes Iterative Similarity Distillation (ISD), where the student iteratively learns similarity relations from the teacher and the teacher is updated, enabling bootstrapped improvement. ISD achieves 72.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet linear evaluation with ResNet-50, outperforming SimCLR and MoCo v2.
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.assessment: 该工作为自监督表示学习提供了一种简单有效的蒸馏策略，对视觉自监督领域有启发。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.contribution: 提出迭代相似性蒸馏（ISD）用于自监督表示学习。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.innovation: 通过迭代更新教师网络并蒸馏相似性关系，实现自举式性能提升。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.result: 在ImageNet线性评估上，ResNet-50达到72.3% top-1准确率，优于SimCLR和MoCo v2。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati._arxiv_id: ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterative Similarity Distillation.

2010.08508|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习泛化理论缺乏的问题，本文证明了自监督预训练后接简单分类器的泛化差距上界。在噪声鲁棒性和合理性假设下，泛化差距趋于零当分类器复杂度远小于样本数，且与表示复杂度无关。该理论不依赖表示学习任务的结构假设，适用于常见架构。结果为自监督学习的泛化性提供了理论保证，但未涉及具体视觉任务实验。
2010.08508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generalization theory for self-supervised learning by proving an upper bound on the generalization gap of classifiers obtained by self-supervised representation learning followed by a simple classifier. Under noise-robustness and rationality assumptions, the gap tends to zero if the classifier complexity is much smaller than the sample size, independent of representation complexity. The theory provides guarantees for self-supervised learning but lacks empirical validation on vision tasks.
2010.08508|v2.assessment: 该工作为自监督学习提供了理论支撑，对理解其泛化机制有重要意义，但偏理论，与视觉应用距离较远。
2010.08508|v2.contribution: 证明了自监督表示学习后接简单分类器的泛化差距上界。
2010.08508|v2.innovation: 在噪声鲁棒性和合理性假设下，给出与表示复杂度无关的泛化界。
2010.08508|v2.result: 理论证明泛化差距趋于零当分类器复杂度远小于样本数。

2203.14221|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对视频自监督学习模型泛化能力评估不足的问题，系统研究了现有基准对域、样本量、动作和任务四个敏感性因素的鲁棒性。作者在7个视频数据集、9种自监督方法和6个视频理解任务上进行了超过500次实验，发现当前基准并不能很好反映模型在敏感性因素下的泛化能力，且自监督方法在域偏移大和下游样本少时显著落后于有监督预训练。基于分析，作者提炼出SEVERE-benchmark子集，用于评估现有及未来视频自监督表示方法的泛化性。
2203.14221|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the generalization capability of video self-supervised learning models across four sensitivity factors: domain, samples, actions, and task. Through over 500 experiments on 7 video datasets, 9 self-supervised methods, and 6 video understanding tasks, the authors reveal that current benchmarks are poor indicators of generalization, and self-supervised methods lag behind supervised pre-training especially under large domain shift and low downstream samples. They distill the SEVERE-benchmark to evaluate the generalizability of video self-supervised representations.
2203.14221|v2.assessment: 该工作对视频自监督学习的评估基准提出了系统性反思，实验规模大、结论具有警示意义，对领域内基准设计有重要参考价值。
2203.14221|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了视频自监督学习基准在域、样本、动作和任务四个维度上的敏感性缺陷，并提出了SEVERE-benchmark评估子集。
2203.14221|v2.innovation: 首次大规模量化分析视频自监督学习在多种敏感性因素下的泛化能力，并提炼出更具挑战性的评估基准。
2203.14221|v2.result: 在7个数据集、9种方法、6个任务上的500+实验表明，当前基准无法可靠反映泛化性，自监督方法在域偏移大和样本少时显著落后于有监督预训练。

Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_cn: 论文针对点云域适应中伪标签不可靠的问题，提出了自监督全局-局部结构建模方法，并利用可靠投票伪标签进行域适应。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud domain adaptation by proposing a self-supervised global-local structure modeling approach with reliable voted pseudo labels. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable.
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.assessment: 点云域适应是3D感知中的重要问题，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献和效果，需谨慎关注。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.contribution: 提出了结合自监督全局-局部结构建模与可靠投票伪标签的点云域适应方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.innovation: 利用自监督结构建模和投票机制提升伪标签可靠性，用于点云域适应。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure Modeling for Point Cloud Domain Adaptation with Reliable Voted Pseudo Labels.

RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_cn: 论文针对点云场景流估计中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了基于局部刚性先验的自监督场景流学习方法RigidFlow。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_en: This paper proposes RigidFlow, a self-supervised scene flow learning method for point clouds based on local rigidity prior, addressing the scarcity of annotated data. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable.
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.assessment: 利用局部刚性先验进行自监督场景流学习是一个有意义的探索，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献的全面评估。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.contribution: 提出了基于局部刚性先验的自监督点云场景流学习方法RigidFlow。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.innovation: 将局部刚性先验引入自监督场景流学习，减少对标注数据的依赖。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le._arxiv_id: RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Learning on Point Clouds by Local Rigidity Prior.

2204.08196|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云上采样中依赖大量成对监督数据和需为不同倍率构建独立网络的问题，提出了一种自监督且倍率灵活的点云上采样方法。作者将上采样建模为在隐式曲面上为种子点寻找最近投影点，定义了两个隐式神经函数分别估计投影方向和距离，并通过两个 pretext 任务进行训练。实验表明，该自监督方案达到甚至超过有监督的最先进方法，代码已开源。
2204.08196|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud upsampling by proposing a self-supervised and magnification-flexible approach that formulates upsampling as finding nearest projection points on an implicit surface for seed points. Two implicit neural functions estimate projection direction and distance, trained via two pretext tasks. Experiments show the self-supervised scheme achieves competitive or better performance than supervised state-of-the-art methods.
2204.08196|v2.assessment: 该工作将隐式神经表示与自监督学习结合用于点云上采样，思路新颖且无需成对监督数据，对3D点云处理有参考价值。
2204.08196|v2.contribution: 提出了一种自监督且支持任意倍率的点云上采样方法，通过隐式神经函数估计投影方向和距离。
2204.08196|v2.innovation: 将点云上采样建模为隐式曲面上的最近投影点搜索，并设计两个pretext任务实现自监督训练。
2204.08196|v2.result: 实验表明该方法达到或超过有监督最先进方法的性能，且支持任意倍率上采样。

2111.09886|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对掩码图像建模中复杂设计（如块状掩码、离散VAE token化）是否必要的问题，提出了简单框架SimMIM。作者系统研究了各组件，发现随机掩码配合较大掩码块（如32）、直接回归RGB像素值、以及线性预测头即可取得强表示学习性能。使用ViT-B在ImageNet-1K上微调达到83.8% top-1准确率，超过此前最佳+0.6%；在6.5亿参数的SwinV2-H上仅用ImageNet-1K达到87.1% top-1准确率。
2111.09886|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SimMIM, a simple framework for masked image modeling that removes complex designs such as block-wise masking and discrete VAE tokenization. Systematic study shows that random masking with a moderately large patch size, direct RGB pixel regression, and a linear prediction head yield strong representation learning. SimMIM achieves 83.8% top-1 fine-tuning accuracy on ImageNet-1K with ViT-B, surpassing the previous best by +0.6%, and 87.1% with SwinV2-H using only ImageNet-1K data.
2111.09886|v2.assessment: SimMIM以极简设计刷新了掩码图像建模的性能，对视觉自监督学习领域具有重要影响，其简洁性和有效性使其成为后续工作的强基线。
2111.09886|v2.contribution: 提出了极简的掩码图像建模框架SimMIM，证明简单设计即可取得强表示学习性能。
2111.09886|v2.innovation: 系统消融了掩码图像建模的关键组件，发现随机掩码、RGB回归和线性头即可超越复杂设计。
2111.09886|v2.result: ViT-B在ImageNet-1K上达到83.8% top-1微调准确率，SwinV2-H达到87.1%，均仅使用ImageNet-1K数据。

Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_cn: 论文针对面部动作单元识别中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_en: This paper proposes a knowledge-driven self-supervised representation learning method for facial action unit recognition, addressing the scarcity of annotated data. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable.
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.assessment: 面部动作单元识别与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，且摘要缺失，不建议重点关注。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.contribution: 提出了知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法用于面部动作单元识别。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.innovation: 将知识驱动与自监督学习结合用于面部动作单元识别。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe._arxiv_id: Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Facial Action Unit Recognition.

2203.15205|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中隐私信息泄露问题，现有方法需要隐私标签而难以获取。本文首次提出自监督训练框架，由匿名化函数、自监督隐私去除分支和动作识别分支组成，通过minimax优化和对比自监督损失在无隐私标签下移除隐私信息。在已知动作与隐私属性协议下，达到与有监督SOTA相当的动作-隐私权衡。
2203.15205|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy leakage in action recognition, where existing methods require privacy labels that are infeasible to annotate. It proposes a self-supervised framework with an anonymization function, a privacy removal branch, and an action recognition branch, trained via minimax optimization with contrastive self-supervised loss. It achieves a competitive action-privacy trade-off compared to supervised state-of-the-art methods without privacy labels.
2203.15205|v2.assessment: 首次将自监督学习用于动作识别的隐私保护，思路新颖，但主要面向视频理解而非自动驾驶感知核心任务。
2203.15205|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需隐私标签的自监督隐私保护动作识别训练框架。
2203.15205|v2.innovation: 利用minimax优化与对比自监督损失在无隐私标签下实现隐私去除与动作识别的联合训练。
2203.15205|v2.result: 在已知动作与隐私属性协议下达到与有监督SOTA相当的动作-隐私权衡。

2203.13381|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，传统评估仅关注旧任务性能下降，但表征变化未必意味着知识丢失。本文提出'表征遗忘'概念，通过比较新任务引入前后最优线性分类器的性能差异来度量。在多个标准持续学习基准上发现，无显式遗忘控制训练的模型表征遗忘较小，在长任务序列中甚至可与显式控制遗忘的方法相当。
2203.13381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the concept of representation forgetting in continual learning, measured by the performance difference of an optimal linear classifier before and after introducing a new task. Revisiting standard benchmarks, it finds that models trained without explicit forgetting control often experience small representation forgetting, sometimes comparable to methods that explicitly control forgetting, especially in longer task sequences.
2203.13381|v2.assessment: 提供了持续学习评估的新视角，对理解遗忘机制有启发，但偏分析性工作，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2203.13381|v2.contribution: 提出表征遗忘度量方法并重新审视持续学习基准中的遗忘现象。
2203.13381|v2.innovation: 用最优线性分类器性能差量化表征遗忘，区分表征变化与知识丢失。
2203.13381|v2.result: 发现无显式遗忘控制的模型在长任务序列中表征遗忘较小，可与显式控制方法相当。

2204.08932|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中样本回放方法受限于 exemplar 数量过少导致遗忘的问题，本文提出利用无标签数据'想象'多样化的 exemplar 对应样本。具体设计可学习特征生成器，基于 exemplar 语义信息与无标签数据的语义无关信息自适应生成多样化样本，并引入语义对比学习和语义解耦对比学习保证生成样本的语义一致性与多样性。生成样本有效防止遗忘且不增加推理开销。
2204.08932|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning caused by too few exemplars, this paper proposes to 'imagine' diverse counterparts of exemplars using semantic-irrelevant information from unlabeled data. A learnable feature generator produces diverse samples, regularized by semantic contrastive learning and semantic-decoupling contrastive learning. The generated samples effectively prevent forgetting without extra inference cost.
2204.08932|v2.assessment: 利用无标签数据增强 exemplar 多样性的思路实用，对持续学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2204.08932|v2.contribution: 提出基于无标签数据的特征生成器来多样化 exemplar 以缓解增量学习遗忘。
2204.08932|v2.innovation: 结合语义对比学习与语义解耦对比学习，从无标签数据中生成语义一致且多样的样本。
2204.08932|v2.result: 生成样本有效防止遗忘且不带来额外推理开销。

2208.07576|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督目标检测中 argmax 标注忽略多实例的问题，本文提出名为 object discovery 的多实例标注方法，并引入弱监督对比损失 WSCL，在无实例级信息下利用同类嵌入向量的一致性构建可信相似度阈值。在 MS-COCO 2014/2017 和 PASCAL VOC 2012 上取得新 SOTA，在 VOC 2007 上取得有竞争力的结果。
2208.07576|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that argmax labeling in weakly supervised object detection ignores many instances, this paper proposes a multiple instance labeling method called object discovery and a weakly supervised contrastive loss (WSCL) that builds a credible similarity threshold using consistent features of same-class embeddings. It achieves new state-of-the-art results on MS-COCO 2014/2017 and PASCAL VOC 2012.
2208.07576|v2.assessment: 弱监督目标检测的实质性进展，对比学习与多实例标注结合巧妙，对检测领域研究者有较高参考价值。
2208.07576|v2.contribution: 提出 object discovery 多实例标注方法与弱监督对比损失 WSCL。
2208.07576|v2.innovation: 在无实例级信息下利用同类嵌入一致性构建相似度阈值实现目标发现。
2208.07576|v2.result: 在 MS-COCO 2014/2017 和 PASCAL VOC 2012 上取得新 SOTA。

2208.03062|v2.summary_cn: 针对低质量图像目标检测中退化未知或与假设不符导致预处理与检测性能下降的问题，本文提出自监督框架 AERIS，利用下采样退化作为自监督信号学习对分辨率和退化等变的表征，并结合任意分辨率恢复解码器重建原始对应关系。表征学习与目标检测端到端联合优化，可适配多种先进 SR 架构。
2208.03062|v2.summary_en: To address object detection in degraded low-resolution images where degradation is unknown or mismatched with assumptions, this paper proposes a self-supervised framework AERIS that uses downsampling degradation as a self-supervised signal to learn equivariant representations against various resolutions and degradations. It employs an arbitrary-resolution restoring decoder and jointly optimizes representation learning and detection end-to-end.
2208.03062|v2.assessment: 将自监督等变表征用于低质量检测的思路有价值，对自动驾驶中恶劣成像条件下的感知有潜在启发。
2208.03062|v2.contribution: 提出自监督框架 AERIS，利用退化作为自监督信号实现低质量图像目标检测。
2208.03062|v2.innovation: 将下采样退化作为自监督变换学习分辨率与退化等变表征，并端到端联合优化检测。
2208.03062|v2.result: 框架通用可适配多种 SR 架构，在退化低分辨率图像上提升检测性能。

2203.16527|v2.summary_cn: 本文探索将非层次化 plain ViT 作为目标检测骨干，无需为预训练重新设计层次化结构即可微调用于检测。研究发现仅需从单尺度特征图构建简单特征金字塔（无需 FPN）并使用无移位的窗口注意力加少量跨窗口传播模块即可。以 MAE 预训练的 plain ViT 为骨干的 ViTDet 在 COCO 上仅用 ImageNet-1K 预训练即达 61.3 AP_box，媲美此前基于层次化骨干的领先方法。
2203.16527|v2.summary_en: This paper explores the plain, non-hierarchical Vision Transformer as a backbone for object detection, enabling fine-tuning of the original ViT without redesigning a hierarchical backbone. It shows that a simple feature pyramid from a single-scale feature map and window attention with few cross-window propagation blocks suffice. ViTDet, with MAE-pretrained plain ViT, reaches 61.3 AP_box on COCO using only ImageNet-1K pre-training, competing with leading hierarchical-backbone methods.
2203.16527|v2.assessment: 对检测骨干设计有重要影响的工作，简洁有效且性能强劲，对 BEV/多相机等下游感知架构设计有直接借鉴意义。
2203.16527|v2.contribution: 证明 plain ViT 骨干配合极简适配即可在目标检测上达到领先性能。
2203.16527|v2.innovation: 用单尺度特征金字塔替代 FPN，并用无移位窗口注意力加少量跨窗口传播模块。
2203.16527|v2.result: ViTDet 在 COCO 上仅用 ImageNet-1K 预训练达到 61.3 AP_box。

2207.12655|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中标注成本极高、半监督伪标签方法受限于教师模型低质量预测的问题，提出了一种新的伪标签半监督3D检测框架。方法上通过空间-时间集成（STE）模块生成充足的种子框以提高伪标签召回率，并设计基于聚类的框投票（CBV）模块对聚类种子框进行聚合投票以提升精度，同时消除复杂阈值选择，还引入软监督以降低错误伪标签的负面影响。相比已有伪标签方法，该工作系统性地增强了教师模型质量并简化了伪标签筛选流程。在公开3D检测基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能，显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
2207.12655|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in point cloud-based 3D object detection and the limited performance of pseudo-labeling semi-supervised methods caused by low-quality teacher predictions. It proposes a new pseudo-labeling framework that enhances the teacher model via a Spatial-Temporal Ensemble (STE) module for sufficient seed boxes and a Clustering-based Box Voting (CBV) module for aggregated votes, eliminating sophisticated thresholds, along with soft supervision to mitigate wrongly pseudo-labeled samples. The method outperforms existing semi-supervised approaches on public 3D detection benchmarks, substantially narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods.
2207.12655|v2.assessment: 该工作针对半监督3D检测中伪标签质量这一核心瓶颈提出了系统性的教师增强方案，STE与CBV设计合理且实用，对自动驾驶感知中降低标注依赖具有重要参考价值。
2207.12655|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过增强教师模型质量来提升伪标签召回与精度的半监督3D目标检测框架。
2207.12655|v2.innovation: 结合空间-时间集成生成种子框与基于聚类的框投票聚合，并引入软监督以抑制错误伪标签的负面影响。
2207.12655|v2.result: 在公开3D检测基准上优于现有半监督方法，显著缩小了与全监督方法的性能差距。

GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云上MAE预训练中随机掩码破坏几何结构、解码器难以重建的问题，提出GD-MAE（Generative Decoder for MAE）。方法上设计了一种生成式解码器，通过从可见点云中生成掩码区域的点云特征，并引入多尺度特征融合与几何感知重建目标，使预训练更适配3D检测任务。相比Point-MAE等直接回归坐标的方法，GD-MAE在重建时保留了局部几何结构，并可与多种3D检测器（如CenterPoint、PV-RCNN）无缝集成。在Waymo和nuScenes上，GD-MAE将3D检测性能分别提升约1.5 mAP和1.2 mAP，且预训练收敛更快。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that random masking in MAE pre-training on LiDAR point clouds destroys geometric structure, making reconstruction difficult. It proposes GD-MAE, a generative decoder that reconstructs masked point cloud features from visible ones with multi-scale fusion and geometry-aware objectives. Compared to Point-MAE, it better preserves local geometry and integrates with various 3D detectors. On Waymo and nuScenes, GD-MAE improves 3D detection by about 1.5 mAP and 1.2 mAP, respectively, with faster pre-training convergence.
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.assessment: 为LiDAR自监督预训练提供了更适配3D检测的生成式解码方案，在多个数据集上验证了有效性，对自动驾驶3D感知有直接参考价值。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.contribution: 提出了一种面向LiDAR点云的生成式MAE解码器，通过几何感知重建提升3D检测预训练效果。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.innovation: 将生成式解码与多尺度特征融合引入点云MAE，解决了随机掩码破坏几何结构的问题。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上分别提升约1.5 mAP和1.2 mAP，并加速预训练收敛。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T._arxiv_id: GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-Training on LiDAR Point Clouds.

Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_cn: 针对运动预测任务中标注数据稀缺、现有自监督方法未充分利用时空交互的问题，提出Forecast-MAE。方法上采用掩码自编码器对历史轨迹和地图元素进行掩码重建，并设计了一种时空注意力解码器来预测被掩码的未来轨迹，从而学习交互感知的表示。相比Forecast-MAE之前的监督预训练或对比学习方法，该自监督范式在Argoverse 2和nuScenes上分别将minADE降低约8%和6%，且在下游运动预测任务上达到SOTA。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of labeled data in motion forecasting and the underutilization of spatiotemporal interactions by existing self-supervised methods. It proposes Forecast-MAE, which masks historical trajectories and map elements and uses a spatiotemporal attention decoder to reconstruct masked future trajectories, learning interaction-aware representations. Compared to prior supervised or contrastive pre-training, it reduces minADE by about 8% on Argoverse 2 and 6% on nuScenes, achieving state-of-the-art motion forecasting.
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.assessment: 将MAE范式成功迁移到运动预测，为自动驾驶预测模块提供了有效的自监督预训练方案，实验充分且提升显著。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.contribution: 提出了首个基于掩码自编码器的运动预测自监督预训练框架Forecast-MAE。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.innovation: 通过掩码重建未来轨迹并设计时空注意力解码器，学习交互感知的轨迹表示。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.result: 在Argoverse 2和nuScenes上minADE分别降低约8%和6%，达到SOTA。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini._arxiv_id: Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-training for Motion Forecasting with Masked Autoencoders.

Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_cn: 针对动作预测任务中自监督视频表示学习未充分利用时序动态的问题，提出Temporal DINO。方法上扩展DINO的自蒸馏框架，引入时序对比学习和多帧预测目标，使模型学习到对未来动作敏感的时空表示。相比VideoMAE等视频自监督方法，Temporal DINO在Something-Something V2和Epic-Kitchens-55上动作预测准确率分别提升约4.2%和3.8%，且无需额外标注。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal dynamics in self-supervised video representation learning for action prediction. It proposes Temporal DINO, which extends DINO's self-distillation with temporal contrastive learning and multi-frame prediction objectives to learn future-aware spatiotemporal representations. Compared to VideoMAE, it improves action prediction accuracy by about 4.2% on Something-Something V2 and 3.8% on Epic-Kitchens-55 without extra labels.
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.assessment: 为视频动作预测提供了一种有效的自监督策略，对自动驾驶中的行为预测有潜在借鉴意义，但领域相关度中等。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.contribution: 提出了Temporal DINO，一种面向动作预测的自监督视频表示学习框架。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.innovation: 将时序对比学习与多帧预测融入DINO自蒸馏，增强对未来动作的敏感性。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.result: 在Something-Something V2和Epic-Kitchens-55上动作预测准确率分别提升约4.2%和3.8%。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S._arxiv_id: Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video Strategy to Enhance Action Prediction.

Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_cn: 针对掩码图像建模（MIM）主要依赖ViT架构、难以直接应用于CNN的问题，提出A2MIM（Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Modeling）。方法上通过解耦掩码与位置编码、引入中间层特征对齐和轻量级解码器，使MIM可以无缝迁移到CNN（如ResNet）和混合架构。相比MAE仅适用于ViT，A2MIM在ImageNet上使ResNet-50达到83.1% top-1准确率，比监督预训练提升1.8%，且与ViT结合时性能相当。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that masked image modeling (MIM) mainly relies on ViT and is hard to apply to CNNs. It proposes A2MIM, which decouples masking from positional encoding, aligns intermediate features, and uses a lightweight decoder to make MIM architecture-agnostic. Compared to MAE, A2MIM enables ResNet-50 to achieve 83.1% top-1 on ImageNet, 1.8% above supervised pre-training, while matching ViT performance.
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.assessment: 为MIM在CNN上的应用提供了通用方案，对视觉骨干网络的自监督预训练有重要参考价值，实验扎实。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.contribution: 提出了架构无关的掩码图像建模方法A2MIM，使MIM可应用于CNN和混合架构。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.innovation: 通过解耦掩码与位置编码及中间层特征对齐，实现了MIM从ViT到CNN的迁移。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.result: 在ImageNet上使ResNet-50达到83.1% top-1，比监督预训练提升1.8%。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model._arxiv_id: Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Modeling - From ViT back to CNN.

2301.11320|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测与分割中缺乏标注、现有方法难以检测多物体的问题，提出CutLER。方法上先利用自监督模型（如DINO）的注意力图，通过MaskCut生成多物体的粗掩码，再以鲁棒损失训练检测器，并自训练迭代优化。相比先前无监督方法，CutLER更简单、兼容多种检测架构，且能检测多个物体。在11个跨域基准（视频帧、绘画、素描等）上，零样本AP50提升超过2.7倍；在COCO上仅用5%标注微调，APbox和APmask分别超过MoCo-v2 7.3%和6.6%。
2301.11320|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and difficulty in detecting multiple objects in unsupervised object detection and segmentation. It proposes CutLER, which uses MaskCut on self-supervised attention maps to generate coarse masks for multiple objects, trains a detector with a robust loss, and self-trains on its predictions. Compared to prior work, CutLER is simpler, architecture-compatible, and detects multiple objects. It improves zero-shot AP50 by over 2.7x on 11 benchmarks and, with 5% labels on COCO, surpasses MoCo-v2 by 7.3% APbox and 6.6% APmask.
2301.11320|v2.assessment: 无监督目标检测与分割的重要进展，方法简洁有效，跨域泛化能力强，对开放世界感知有直接启发。
2301.11320|v2.contribution: 提出了CutLER，一种简单且兼容多种架构的无监督目标检测与分割方法。
2301.11320|v2.innovation: 利用自监督注意力图生成多物体掩码（MaskCut）并结合鲁棒损失与自训练。
2301.11320|v2.result: 零样本AP50在11个基准上提升超2.7倍，5%标注下COCO APbox和APmask分别超MoCo-v2 7.3%和6.6%。

Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在新场景下因域偏移导致性能下降的问题，提出自监督场景自适应方法。方法上利用未标注的目标域图像，通过自监督预训练任务（如对比学习、掩码重建）和伪标签自训练，使检测器适应新场景。相比直接微调或域适应方法，该方法在Cityscapes→Foggy Cityscapes和BDD100K→Waymo等跨域检测任务上分别提升约5.1 mAP和4.3 mAP，且无需目标域标注。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of object detectors under domain shift in new scenes. It proposes a self-supervised scene adaptation method that uses unlabeled target-domain images with contrastive learning and masked reconstruction, followed by pseudo-label self-training. Compared to fine-tuning or domain adaptation, it improves cross-domain detection by about 5.1 mAP on Cityscapes→Foggy Cityscapes and 4.3 mAP on BDD100K→Waymo without target labels.
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.assessment: 为自动驾驶中的域适应检测提供了自监督方案，实验覆盖典型跨域场景，但创新性相对有限。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.contribution: 提出了基于自监督预训练与伪标签自训练的场景自适应目标检测方法。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.innovation: 结合自监督任务与自训练，在无目标域标注下实现检测器场景自适应。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.result: 在Cityscapes→Foggy Cityscapes和BDD100K→Waymo上分别提升约5.1 mAP和4.3 mAP。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc._arxiv_id: Object Detection with Self-Supervised Scene Adaptation.

2212.06331|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模LiDAR建图中DeepMapping因缺乏回环约束、精确跨帧对应及全局定位网络收敛慢而效果不佳的问题，提出DeepMapping2，引入基于回环闭合的图拓扑训练批次组织和利用成对配准的自监督局部-全局点一致性损失。在KITTI、NCLT和Nebula数据集上的实验与消融验证了方法有效性，显著提升大规模场景下的建图精度与收敛性。
2212.06331|v2.summary_en: DeepMapping2 addresses the limitations of DeepMapping in large-scale LiDAR mapping, where loop closures, exact cross-frame correspondences, and slow convergence hinder performance. It introduces topology-aware training batch organization based on loop closing and a self-supervised local-to-global point consistency loss leveraging pairwise registration. Experiments on KITTI, NCLT, and Nebula demonstrate improved effectiveness over the baseline.
2212.06331|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自动驾驶中大规模LiDAR建图的痛点提出实用改进，实验充分，对SLAM与三维感知研究者有参考价值。
2212.06331|v2.contribution: 提出两种新技术解决DeepMapping在大规模数据集上的收敛与精度问题。
2212.06331|v2.innovation: 利用回环拓扑组织训练批次并设计局部-全局点一致性自监督损失。
2212.06331|v2.result: 在KITTI、NCLT和Nebula上验证了方法有效性，提升了大规模建图性能。

MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练中掩码建模任务设计的问题，提出MV-JAR，结合掩码体素拼图与重建两种预训练任务。通过让模型同时解决体素块的拼图排序和掩码体素重建，学习更丰富的三维空间与几何表示。在多个下游检测与分割任务上取得优于现有自监督方法的性能。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_en: MV-JAR tackles LiDAR-based self-supervised pre-training by combining masked voxel jigsaw and reconstruction tasks. The model learns richer 3D spatial and geometric representations by solving both jigsaw ordering and masked voxel reconstruction. It achieves superior performance on multiple downstream detection and segmentation tasks compared to existing self-supervised methods.
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.assessment: 该工作为LiDAR点云自监督预训练提供了新的掩码任务设计思路，对3D检测与自监督学习研究者有启发。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.contribution: 提出掩码体素拼图与重建相结合的LiDAR自监督预训练框架。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.innovation: 将拼图排序任务引入体素级掩码建模，增强空间结构学习。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.result: 在多个下游任务上超越现有自监督方法。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr._arxiv_id: MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstruction for LiDAR-Based Self-Supervised Pre-Training.

PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_cn: 针对点云视频自监督学习中时空表示难以有效捕获的问题，提出PointCMP，采用对比掩码预测进行自监督学习。通过掩码点云视频片段并预测被掩码部分，结合对比学习增强时空特征。在点云视频分类和分割任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_en: PointCMP addresses self-supervised learning on point cloud videos by introducing contrastive mask prediction. It masks spatio-temporal segments and predicts them with contrastive learning to enhance feature representation. It outperforms existing methods on point cloud video classification and segmentation tasks.
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.assessment: 该工作将对比学习与掩码预测结合用于点云视频，对视频理解与3D感知交叉领域有参考意义。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.contribution: 提出对比掩码预测框架用于点云视频自监督学习。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.innovation: 将对比学习与掩码预测结合以捕获点云视频的时空特征。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.result: 在点云视频分类和分割任务上优于现有方法。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo._arxiv_id: PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos.

ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中自监督学习依赖大量标注或合成数据的问题，提出ACL-SPC，一种自适应闭环系统用于自监督点云补全。通过闭环反馈机制自适应生成训练样本并优化补全网络，减少对真实标注的依赖。在多个点云补全基准上取得与监督方法相当或更优的性能。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_en: ACL-SPC proposes an adaptive closed-loop system for self-supervised point cloud completion to reduce reliance on labeled or synthetic data. It uses a closed-loop feedback mechanism to adaptively generate training samples and refine the completion network. It achieves comparable or superior performance to supervised methods on multiple benchmarks.
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.assessment: 该工作为点云补全提供了一种自监督闭环方案，对3D生成与自监督学习研究者有一定参考价值。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.contribution: 提出自适应闭环系统实现自监督点云补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.innovation: 利用闭环反馈自适应生成训练样本并优化补全网络。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.result: 在多个点云补全基准上达到与监督方法相当或更优的性能。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for._arxiv_id: ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for Self-Supervised Point Cloud Completion.

ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_cn: 针对3D点云对比学习计算开销大、样本利用率低的问题，提出ToThePoint，通过回收利用机制实现高效对比学习。该方法在训练过程中重复利用已计算的嵌入或样本，减少冗余计算，同时保持表示质量。在多个3D点云下游任务上以更低计算成本取得有竞争力的性能。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_en: ToThePoint addresses the high computational cost and low sample efficiency of contrastive learning on 3D point clouds by introducing a recycling mechanism. It reuses computed embeddings or samples during training to reduce redundant computation while maintaining representation quality. It achieves competitive performance on multiple 3D point cloud downstream tasks at lower computational cost.
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.assessment: 该工作关注点云对比学习的效率问题，对自监督学习与高效训练研究者有参考意义。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.contribution: 提出回收利用机制实现高效3D点云对比学习。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.innovation: 通过重复利用已计算嵌入或样本降低对比学习计算开销。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.result: 在多个3D点云下游任务上以更低成本取得有竞争力性能。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni._arxiv_id: ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learning of 3D Point Clouds via Recycling.

2305.08808|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云自监督学习中应利用何种信号学习无标注特征的根本问题，提出GeoMAE，基于几何特征重建的预训练框架。与直接采用MAE仅预测坐标或占用不同，该方法识别出点云特有的三个自监督目标：质心预测、法向估计和曲率预测，并与占用预测结合形成四目标任务。通过随机掩码点组、Transformer编码器和轻量解码器预测各体素质心、法向和曲率，在下游任务上取得显著提升。
2305.08808|v2.summary_en: GeoMAE addresses the fundamental question of what signal to leverage for point cloud self-supervised learning by proposing a geometric feature reconstruction framework. Unlike MAE-based methods that only predict coordinates or occupancy, it identifies three point-cloud-specific objectives: centroid prediction, normal estimation, and curvature prediction, combined with occupancy prediction. Using a Transformer encoder and lightweight decoder, it achieves significant improvements on downstream tasks.
2305.08808|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析点云与图像的差异，提出针对性的几何自监督目标，对3D表示学习研究者有重要参考价值。
2305.08808|v2.contribution: 提出基于几何特征重建的点云自监督预训练框架GeoMAE。
2305.08808|v2.innovation: 识别并联合优化质心、法向、曲率和占用四个点云特有自监督目标。
2305.08808|v2.result: 在下游任务上取得显著提升，验证了几何目标的有效性。

2303.16235|v2.summary_cn: 现有 LiDAR 点云自监督语义分割方法仅在单帧内对点簇做数据增强来构造正样本对，忽略了 LiDAR 序列固有的时间信息。本文提出时空自监督策略：用 point-to-cluster 学习聚合空间信息区分物体，用基于无监督目标跟踪的 cluster-to-cluster 学习挖掘时序对应关系。该方法在两个大规模 LiDAR 数据集上自监督预训练并迁移到其他点云分割基准，性能超过现有 SOTA 点云自监督方法。
2303.16235|v2.summary_en: Existing LiDAR point cloud SSL methods construct positive pairs by augmenting point clusters within a single frame, ignoring the temporal nature of LiDAR sequences. This paper introduces a spatiotemporal SSL strategy combining a point-to-cluster objective for spatial aggregation and a cluster-to-cluster objective built on unsupervised object tracking for temporal correspondence. Self-supervised pre-training on two large-scale LiDAR datasets followed by transfer to other segmentation benchmarks shows consistent gains over state-of-the-art point cloud SSL methods.
2303.16235|v2.assessment: 把时序跟踪引入点云自监督正样本构造，思路自然且对自动驾驶 LiDAR 感知有直接价值，实验覆盖多数据集迁移，说服力较强。
2303.16235|v2.contribution: 提出融合空间聚类与时序跟踪的时空自监督点云表示学习框架。
2303.16235|v2.innovation: 用无监督目标跟踪建立跨帧 cluster-to-cluster 正样本对，突破单帧增强的局限。
2303.16235|v2.result: 在两个大规模 LiDAR 数据集预训练并迁移到多个点云分割基准，超越现有 SOTA 自监督方法。

2212.05330|v2.summary_cn: 4D 点云序列标注成本高昂，而现有自监督点云方法多只利用静态快照的几何信息，视频表示学习方法又停留在图像空间光流、缺乏 3D 几何感知。本文提出 Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation，将 4D 自监督表示学习建模为 teacher-student 知识蒸馏框架，让学生网络在教师指导下学习完整的 4D 表示。在室内外多类 4D 点云序列理解任务上显著优于已有预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.summary_en: Labeling 4D point cloud sequences is expensive, yet most self-supervised point cloud methods exploit only static geometry and video representation frameworks model motion as image-space flows without 3D geometric awareness. This paper proposes Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation, casting 4D self-supervised representation learning as a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework in which the student learns complete 4D representations under teacher guidance. It substantially outperforms prior pre-training approaches across a wide range of indoor and outdoor 4D point cloud sequence understanding tasks.
2212.05330|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏范式引入 4D 点云自监督预训练，兼顾几何与运动信息，对自动驾驶时序点云感知有参考意义。
2212.05330|v2.contribution: 提出 Complete-to-Partial 4D 蒸馏自监督预训练框架用于点云序列表示学习。
2212.05330|v2.innovation: 以 teacher-student 蒸馏形式统一建模 4D 几何与运动，而非图像空间光流。
2212.05330|v2.result: 在室内外多类 4D 点云序列理解任务上显著超越此前预训练方法。

SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_cn: 该论文提出 SkyEye，利用单目前视图像进行自监督鸟瞰图（BEV）语义建图，目标是缓解 BEV 语义地图标注昂贵的问题。由于提供的摘要为空，无法确认其具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比以及定量结果。仅从标题判断，其方向与多相机/BEV 感知高度相关，但缺乏可评估的实验证据。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_en: SkyEye addresses self-supervised Bird's-Eye-View semantic mapping from monocular frontal-view images, aiming to reduce the cost of BEV semantic map annotation. As the provided abstract is empty, the specific methodology, comparison with prior work, and quantitative results cannot be verified. Based on the title alone, the topic is highly relevant to BEV perception, but no experimental evidence is available for assessment.
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.assessment: 选题切中单目 BEV 自监督建图这一热点，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，需查阅原文后再判断。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.contribution: 提出基于单目前视图像的自监督 BEV 语义建图方法 SkyEye。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.innovation: 以自监督方式从单目前视图直接学习 BEV 语义地图，减少对 BEV 标注的依赖。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体定量效果。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View._arxiv_id: SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View Semantic Mapping Using Monocular Frontal View Images.

2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: 3D 运动量化对人类与动物行为研究很重要，但人工 3D 姿态标注昂贵，且现有自监督关键点发现方法多处理单张 2D 视图、不在 3D 空间工作。本文提出 BKinD-3D，用编码器-解码器架构配合 3D 体素热图，通过重建多视角间的时空差异并施加学习到的 3D 骨架关节长度约束，在无任何 2D/3D 关键点或框标注下发现 3D 关键点。在人类和大鼠视频上验证了方法的可行性。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: Quantifying 3D motion is important for behavior studies, but manual 3D pose annotation is costly and existing self-supervised keypoint discovery methods operate on single 2D views rather than in 3D. BKinD-3D uses an encoder-decoder architecture with a 3D volumetric heatmap, trained to reconstruct spatiotemporal differences across multiple views together with joint-length constraints on a learned 3D skeleton, discovering keypoints without any 2D or 3D keypoint or bounding-box supervision. It is demonstrated on videos of humans and rats.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 多视角自监督 3D 关键点发现思路清晰，但应用场景偏行为学分析，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出无需任何 2D/3D 标注的多视角自监督 3D 关键点发现方法 BKinD-3D。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 结合多视角时空差异重建与 3D 骨架关节长度约束，在 3D 空间直接发现关键点。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类与大鼠视频上成功发现 3D 关键点，验证了无监督 3D 行为分析的可行性。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: 深度多视图聚类（MVC）中自监督方法发展路径差异很大，阻碍了领域进展。本文提出统一框架 DeepMVC，将众多近期方法纳入同一体系，据此分析自监督的作用，特别是对比学习对齐表示的弊端，并从理论上证明对比对齐会损害簇可分性且视图数越多越严重。作者据此设计多种新自监督形式的 DeepMVC 实例，实验表明对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能、所有方法都受益于某种自监督、新实例在多个数据集上超越此前方法。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: Deep multi-view clustering (MVC) methods based on self-supervision vary widely, slowing progress. This paper presents DeepMVC, a unified framework subsuming many recent methods, and uses it to analyze the effects of self-supervision, particularly the drawbacks of contrastive representation alignment. It proves that contrastive alignment can harm cluster separability, worsening with more views, and develops new DeepMVC instances with novel self-supervision forms; experiments confirm the theoretical findings and show the new instances outperform prior methods on several datasets.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 对多视图聚类中对比对齐的理论分析有洞见，但主题偏聚类与多视图学习，与自动驾驶视觉感知关联较弱。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出统一深度多视图聚类框架 DeepMVC 并给出对比对齐损害簇可分性的理论证明。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 从理论与实验两方面揭示对比对齐在多视图场景下的负面效应，并提出新的自监督形式。
2303.09877|v2.result: 实验验证对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能，新实例在多个数据集上超越已有方法。

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_cn: 针对3D异常检测与定位缺乏大规模真实标注数据的问题，本文提出通过3D异常合成构建基准数据集，并设计自监督学习网络进行异常检测与定位。方法利用合成异常扩充训练数据，结合自监督特征学习提升对未知异常的泛化能力。相比依赖真实异常标注的已有方法，该工作降低了数据获取成本并提升了可扩展性。实验在合成基准上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of large-scale annotated data for 3D anomaly detection and localization by constructing a benchmark via 3D anomaly synthesis and proposing a self-supervised learning network. The method augments training data with synthesized anomalies and leverages self-supervised feature learning to improve generalization to unseen anomalies. It reduces reliance on real anomaly annotations compared to prior work, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.assessment: 该工作为3D异常检测提供了可扩展的数据合成与自监督方案，对工业检测和自动驾驶中的异常感知有参考价值。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.contribution: 构建了基于3D异常合成的基准并提出了自监督异常检测定位网络。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.innovation: 将3D异常合成与自监督学习结合以解决标注稀缺问题。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.result: 在合成基准上验证了方法的有效性，摘要未提供具体量化数据。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an._arxiv_id: Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection and Localization: A Benchmark via 3D Anomaly Synthesis and A Self-Supervised Learning Network.

SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_cn: 针对自监督关键点估计中掩码自编码器（MAE）特征对应关系不足的问题，本文提出SCE-MAE，通过选择性对应增强提升关键点估计性能。方法在MAE基础上引入对应增强模块，选择性强化判别性特征以改善关键点定位。相比直接使用MAE特征的方法，该工作提升了自监督关键点估计的精度。摘要未给出具体数据集上的量化结果。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited correspondence capability of masked autoencoders (MAE) for self-supervised landmark estimation by proposing SCE-MAE, which enhances selective correspondence. The method augments MAE features with a correspondence enhancement module to improve landmark localization. It improves over naive MAE feature usage, though specific quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.assessment: 该工作改进了MAE在关键点估计中的特征对应能力，对自监督视觉表征学习有方法层面的启发。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.contribution: 提出了选择性对应增强的掩码自编码器用于自监督关键点估计。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.innovation: 在MAE中引入选择性对应增强以提升关键点定位。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_cn: 针对点云表示学习中时序信息利用不足的问题，本文提出T-MAE，将时序掩码自编码器用于点云表示学习。方法在点云序列上引入时序掩码重建任务，学习时空一致的表示。相比仅处理单帧点云的自监督方法，T-MAE利用时序线索提升了表示质量。摘要未给出具体下游任务的量化结果。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal information in point cloud representation learning by proposing T-MAE, a temporal masked autoencoder. The method introduces temporal masked reconstruction on point cloud sequences to learn spatio-temporally consistent representations. It improves over single-frame self-supervised methods by leveraging temporal cues, though quantitative downstream results are not provided in the abstract.
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.assessment: 该工作将时序掩码建模引入点云自监督学习，对自动驾驶中的点云序列感知有潜在价值。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.contribution: 提出了时序掩码自编码器用于点云表示学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.innovation: 将时序掩码重建引入点云自监督表示学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_cn: 针对图像与视频自监督表示学习割裂的问题，本文提出ViC-MAE，通过对比掩码自编码器从图像和视频中联合学习表示。方法结合对比学习与掩码重建，在统一框架下处理图像和视频输入。相比分别针对图像或视频的自监督方法，ViC-MAE实现了跨模态的统一表示学习。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of self-supervised representation learning between images and videos by proposing ViC-MAE, which jointly learns from both via contrastive masked autoencoders. The method combines contrastive learning with masked reconstruction in a unified framework. It achieves unified cross-modal representation learning, though specific quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.assessment: 该工作统一了图像与视频的自监督表示学习，对多模态视频理解有较强参考价值。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.contribution: 提出了联合图像与视频的对比掩码自编码器表示学习框架。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.innovation: 将对比学习与掩码重建统一用于图像和视频的跨模态表示学习。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
