NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_cn: 针对NeRF表示学习依赖大量标注或监督的问题，本文提出NeRF-MAE，将掩码自编码器用于NeRF的自监督3D表示学习。方法在NeRF渲染的多视角图像上施加掩码重建，学习可迁移的3D表示。相比监督式NeRF方法，该工作实现了无需标注的自监督预训练。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on supervision in NeRF representation learning by proposing NeRF-MAE, applying masked autoencoders for self-supervised 3D representation learning for NeRF. The method performs masked reconstruction on multi-view images rendered from NeRF to learn transferable 3D representations. It enables annotation-free self-supervised pretraining, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.assessment: 该工作将MAE扩展到NeRF表示学习，对3D场景理解与自监督预训练有创新意义。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.contribution: 提出了面向NeRF的自监督掩码自编码器3D表示学习框架。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.innovation: 将掩码自编码器应用于NeRF的多视角渲染进行自监督3D表示学习。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s._arxiv_id: NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-supervised 3D Representation Learning for Neural Radiance Fields.

DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_cn: 针对单视频中自监督点跟踪依赖大量标注的问题，本文提出DINO-Tracker，利用DINO特征实现单视频自监督点跟踪。方法在单个视频上微调DINO特征以建立时序对应关系，无需外部标注。相比需要大规模标注数据的监督跟踪方法，该工作实现了单视频自监督跟踪。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation burden in point tracking by proposing DINO-Tracker, which leverages DINO features for self-supervised point tracking in a single video. The method fine-tunes DINO features on a single video to establish temporal correspondences without external labels. It achieves single-video self-supervised tracking, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.assessment: 该工作利用DINO特征实现单视频自监督点跟踪，对视频理解与跟踪任务有较强实用价值。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.contribution: 提出了基于DINO的单视频自监督点跟踪方法。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.innovation: 利用DINO特征在单视频上微调实现自监督点跟踪。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super._arxiv_id: DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-supervised Point Tracking in a Single Video.

SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云上采样中缺乏真实高分辨率监督、现有自监督方法难以保持几何细节的问题，提出SPU-PMD框架，通过渐进式网格变形从稀疏点云重建稠密表面。方法将点云上采样建模为可学习的网格变形过程，利用自监督信号约束局部几何一致性与全局形状保真度，避免了配对高低分辨率数据的依赖。相比基于插值或生成式的上采样方法，SPU-PMD在细节恢复和噪声鲁棒性上更优，在多个基准上取得了更低的Chamfer Distance和更高的F-score。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of high-resolution supervision in point cloud upsampling and the difficulty of preserving geometric details with existing self-supervised methods. It proposes SPU-PMD, a framework that reconstructs dense surfaces from sparse point clouds via progressive mesh deformation, using self-supervised constraints on local geometric consistency and global shape fidelity. Compared with interpolation- or generation-based upsampling, SPU-PMD achieves better detail recovery and noise robustness, yielding lower Chamfer Distance and higher F-score on multiple benchmarks.
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.assessment: 将网格变形引入自监督点云上采样，思路新颖，对3D感知中的稀疏点云增强有潜在价值，但实验规模与下游任务验证仍有限。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.contribution: 提出基于渐进式网格变形的自监督点云上采样框架SPU-PMD。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.innovation: 用可学习网格变形替代传统插值/生成式上采样，并设计自监督几何一致性约束。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.result: 在多个点云上采样基准上取得更低的Chamfer Distance和更高的F-score。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups._arxiv_id: SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Upsampling via Progressive Mesh Deformation.

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云自监督学习中因物体共现偏差导致模型依赖物体上下文、忽视局部几何的问题，提出通过物体交换（Object Exchange）来缓解物体依赖。方法在预训练阶段将不同场景中的物体进行交换重组，构造反事实样本，迫使编码器学习物体本身的几何与语义而非场景共现统计。相比已有对比学习或掩码建模方法，该方法在多个下游3D检测与分割任务上取得一致提升，验证了去偏置预训练的有效性。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This paper tackles the object co-occurrence bias in point cloud self-supervised learning, where models rely on contextual dependencies instead of local geometry. It proposes an object exchange strategy that swaps objects across scenes to create counterfactual samples, forcing the encoder to learn intrinsic object geometry and semantics rather than scene-level co-occurrence statistics. Compared with existing contrastive and masked modeling methods, it achieves consistent improvements on multiple downstream 3D detection and segmentation tasks.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 从数据构造角度解决点云自监督的共现偏差，方法简洁且通用，对3D预训练研究有较强启发。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出物体交换策略以缓解点云自监督学习中的物体依赖偏差。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.innovation: 通过跨场景物体交换构造反事实样本，迫使模型学习物体内在几何而非共现统计。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 在多个下游3D检测与分割任务上取得一致性能提升。

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中标注成本高、自监督学习难以建模长时轨迹一致性的问题，提出基于路径一致性（Path Consistency）的自监督多目标跟踪方法。方法利用视频中目标轨迹的时序路径一致性作为自监督信号，联合学习外观与运动表征，无需跟踪标注即可训练关联模块。相比依赖伪标签或单帧对比的方法，该方法在MOT基准上显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距，并在跨域场景下表现出更好的泛化性。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in multi-object tracking and the difficulty of modeling long-term trajectory consistency with self-supervision. It proposes a path-consistency-based self-supervised MOT method that leverages temporal path consistency of object trajectories as supervision to jointly learn appearance and motion representations without tracking labels. Compared with pseudo-label or single-frame contrastive approaches, it substantially narrows the gap to fully supervised methods on MOT benchmarks and shows better cross-domain generalization.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 将轨迹路径一致性引入自监督MOT，思路清晰，对降低跟踪标注依赖有实际意义。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用轨迹时序路径一致性作为自监督信号联合学习外观与运动表征。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上显著缩小与全监督方法的差距，并提升跨域泛化性。

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界3D场景理解中类别标注有限、模型难以泛化到新类别的问题，提出区域点-语言对比学习框架RegionPLC。方法利用预训练视觉-语言模型生成区域级的点云-文本对齐监督，通过区域级对比学习将3D点云特征与语言语义空间对齐，实现零样本和开放词汇的3D语义分割与检测。相比仅使用全局点-文本对齐的方法，RegionPLC在ScanNet等基准的开放词汇分割任务上大幅超越已有工作，并支持新类别的即插即用识别。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper targets open-world 3D scene understanding where limited category annotations hinder generalization to novel classes. It proposes RegionPLC, a regional point-language contrastive learning framework that leverages pretrained vision-language models to generate region-level point-text alignment supervision, aligning 3D point features with the language semantic space for zero-shot and open-vocabulary 3D segmentation and detection. Compared with global point-text alignment, RegionPLC substantially outperforms prior work on open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks such as ScanNet and supports plug-and-play recognition of novel categories.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 将区域级点-语言对比学习用于开放世界3D理解，方法扎实、实验充分，是开放词汇3D感知方向的重要进展。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域点-语言对比学习框架RegionPLC用于开放世界3D场景理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型生成区域级点-文本对齐监督，实现零样本/开放词汇3D分割与检测。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.result: 在ScanNet等开放词汇3D分割基准上大幅超越已有方法。

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中普遍存在的幻觉问题，提出幻觉增强对比学习（HACL）方法。方法通过构造幻觉增强的负样本，在对比学习框架下拉大模型对真实描述与幻觉描述的表示距离，从而抑制幻觉生成。相比仅依赖指令微调或解码策略的方法，HACL从表征层面直接建模幻觉与真实内容的差异，在多个幻觉评测基准上显著降低幻觉率并保持通用能力。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper addresses the prevalent hallucination problem in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It proposes Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning (HACL), which constructs hallucination-augmented negative samples and enlarges the representation distance between truthful and hallucinated descriptions within a contrastive learning framework to suppress hallucination. Compared with instruction tuning or decoding-based strategies, HACL directly models the discrepancy between hallucinated and truthful content at the representation level, significantly reducing hallucination rates on multiple benchmarks while preserving general capabilities.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 从表征学习角度缓解MLLM幻觉，方法通用且与现有微调流程兼容，对多模态可信研究有参考价值。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习HACL以抑制多模态大语言模型的幻觉。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 构造幻觉增强负样本，在表征层面拉大真实与幻觉描述的对比距离。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 在多个幻觉评测基准上显著降低幻觉率并保持通用能力。

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态对比学习（如CLIP）中的后门攻击威胁，提出双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法BadCLIP。方法通过在视觉和文本嵌入空间中同时植入触发器与目标语义的双重引导，使模型在触发器出现时被诱导输出攻击者指定的目标类别，同时保持干净样本性能以逃避检测。相比仅操纵单模态嵌入的已有攻击，BadCLIP在多种防御下仍保持高攻击成功率，揭示了多模态预训练模型的安全隐患。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper investigates backdoor threats in multimodal contrastive learning such as CLIP and proposes BadCLIP, a dual-embedding guided backdoor attack. By jointly manipulating visual and textual embedding spaces with trigger and target semantics, BadCLIP induces the model to output attacker-specified target classes when the trigger appears while preserving clean-sample performance to evade detection. Compared with single-modality embedding attacks, BadCLIP maintains high attack success rates under multiple defenses, revealing security risks in multimodal pretrained models.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 聚焦多模态对比学习的安全性问题，攻击设计巧妙，对理解CLIP类模型鲁棒性有警示意义，但与感知检测主线相关度较低。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的多模态对比学习后门攻击方法BadCLIP。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.innovation: 在视觉与文本嵌入空间同时植入触发器与目标语义的双重引导，兼顾攻击成功率与隐蔽性。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 在多种防御下仍保持高攻击成功率，同时维持干净样本性能。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测方法严重依赖昂贵的LiDAR点云或人工标注、难以规模化的问题，本文提出SelfOcc，一种纯视觉、自监督的3D占用预测框架。方法通过构建基于渲染的自监督信号（如新视角深度渲染与语义一致性），无需任何3D占用标注即可从多视角图像学习场景的几何与语义占用。相比依赖密集标注的监督方法，SelfOcc在无标注条件下显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距，并在Occ3D等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，同时展现出跨数据集的泛化能力。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance of existing 3D occupancy prediction methods on costly LiDAR point clouds or dense human annotations. It proposes SelfOcc, a purely vision-based self-supervised framework that learns 3D occupancy from multi-view images using rendering-based self-supervision signals, without any 3D occupancy labels. Compared with fully supervised counterparts, SelfOcc narrows the performance gap while offering better scalability and cross-dataset generalization on benchmarks such as Occ3D.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习引入纯视觉3D占用预测，摆脱了对昂贵3D标注的依赖，对自动驾驶感知的可扩展性具有重要意义，值得关注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出首个纯视觉自监督3D占用预测框架SelfOcc，无需任何3D占用标注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 利用基于渲染的自监督信号从多视角图像学习几何与语义占用。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在无3D标注条件下取得与全监督方法有竞争力的占用预测性能并具备良好泛化性。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 针对未剪辑多动作视频中依据叙述指令进行时空定位（回答what、when、where）的难题，本文提出一种自监督的时空定位方法。方法利用叙述指令与视频片段之间的对应关系构建自监督信号，无需人工时空标注即可学习动作的语义与时间边界定位。相比依赖密集标注的监督方法，该工作降低了标注成本并提升了在未剪辑长视频上的定位鲁棒性，在相关基准上取得了优于或接近监督方法的性能。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper tackles spatio-temporal grounding in untrimmed multi-action videos guided by narrated instructions, addressing the what, when, and where questions. It proposes a self-supervised approach that exploits the correspondence between narration and video segments to learn action semantics and temporal boundaries without manual spatio-temporal annotations. The method reduces annotation cost and improves grounding robustness on untrimmed long videos, achieving competitive results against supervised baselines.
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习用于叙述驱动的视频时空定位，对视频理解与多模态指令对齐方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用叙述指令与视频片段的对应关系构建自监督定位信号。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.result: 在未剪辑长视频的时空定位任务上取得与监督方法相当或更优的性能。

Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_cn: 针对超分辨率模型在真实退化场景下泛化能力差的问题，本文提出一种低分辨率引导的自监督学习策略。方法先在低分辨率域进行自监督预训练，再迁移到高分辨率超分辨率任务，从而缓解合成退化与真实退化之间的域差距。相比直接在合成数据上训练的监督超分方法，该策略显著提升了模型在真实世界退化下的泛化性能，在多个基准上取得了更好的感知质量与保真度。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of super-resolution models under real-world degradations by proposing a low-resolution-guided self-supervised learning strategy. The model is first self-supervisedly pretrained in the low-resolution domain and then transferred to high-resolution super-resolution, bridging the gap between synthetic and real degradations. Compared with supervised SR trained on synthetic data, it substantially improves generalization on real-world degradations across multiple benchmarks.
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.assessment: 该工作提出低分辨率引导的自监督预训练策略以提升超分泛化性，思路清晰，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.contribution: 提出低分辨率引导的自监督学习策略以提升超分辨率模型的泛化能力。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.innovation: 在低分辨率域进行自监督预训练再迁移至高分辨率超分任务。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.result: 在真实退化场景下显著提升超分模型的泛化性能与感知质量。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General._arxiv_id: Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving Generalization for Super-Resolution by Self-Supervised Learning.

Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_cn: 针对人脸表征学习中缺乏细粒度区域感知的问题，本文提出一种具有面部区域感知能力的自监督人脸表征学习方法。方法通过引入面部区域级别的对比与一致性约束，使模型在无标注条件下学习到区分不同面部区域的特征表示。相比整体人脸级别的自监督方法，该工作提升了细粒度人脸分析任务（如表情、属性识别）的性能，在多个下游基准上取得了改进。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of fine-grained region awareness in self-supervised facial representation learning by proposing a method with facial region awareness. It introduces region-level contrastive and consistency constraints to learn discriminative representations of different facial regions without annotations. Compared with holistic face-level self-supervised methods, it improves performance on fine-grained facial analysis tasks across several downstream benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.assessment: 该工作聚焦人脸区域感知的自监督表征学习，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.contribution: 提出具有面部区域感知能力的自监督人脸表征学习方法。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.innovation: 引入面部区域级别的对比与一致性约束以学习细粒度表征。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.result: 在多个细粒度人脸分析下游任务上取得性能提升。

CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标发现中现有方法难以穷尽图像中所有目标的问题，本文提出CuVLER，利用自监督Transformer进行更彻底的目标发现。方法通过充分挖掘自监督ViT特征中的目标性信息并结合多尺度、多线索的候选生成与筛选，提升了无监督目标发现的召回率与定位精度。相比已有无监督目标发现方法，CuVLER在多个基准上取得了更优的发现性能，减少了漏检。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of exhaustively discovering all objects in images for unsupervised object discovery by proposing CuVLER, which leverages self-supervised Transformers. It exploits objectness cues in self-supervised ViT features with multi-scale, multi-cue candidate generation and filtering to improve recall and localization. Compared with prior unsupervised object discovery methods, CuVLER achieves superior discovery performance and reduces missed detections across benchmarks.
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.assessment: 该工作利用自监督Transformer提升无监督目标发现的彻底性，与开放集检测方向相关，对感知中的未知目标发现有一定启发。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.contribution: 提出基于自监督Transformer的增强型无监督目标发现方法CuVLER。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.innovation: 充分挖掘自监督ViT特征中的目标性信息进行多尺度候选生成与筛选。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.result: 在多个无监督目标发现基准上取得更优性能并减少漏检。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis._arxiv_id: CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Discoveries through Exhaustive Self-Supervised Transformers.

Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_cn: 针对文本引导图像编辑中提示词表达能力有限、编辑效果不精确的问题，本文提出提示增强（Prompt Augmentation）方法用于自监督文本引导的图像编辑。方法通过自动扩充和优化文本提示，增强模型对编辑意图的理解，从而在无配对监督数据下实现更精确的图像操控。相比原始提示驱动的编辑方法，该工作提升了编辑的语义一致性与视觉质量。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of prompts in text-guided image manipulation by proposing a prompt augmentation method for self-supervised text-guided image editing. It automatically augments and refines textual prompts to better capture editing intent, enabling more precise manipulation without paired supervision. Compared with original prompt-driven editing methods, it improves semantic consistency and visual quality of edits.
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.assessment: 该工作聚焦文本引导图像编辑的提示增强，属于多模态生成方向，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.contribution: 提出用于自监督文本引导图像编辑的提示增强方法。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.innovation: 通过自动扩充与优化文本提示增强编辑意图理解。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.result: 在无配对监督下提升了图像编辑的语义一致性与视觉质量。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised Text-guided Image Manipulation.

BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）中亚细胞结构三维子断层图对齐时朝向估计精度不足的问题，提出将等变性（equivariance）引入自监督学习框架 BOE-ViT。方法上以 Vision Transformer 为骨干，通过设计旋转等变的自监督预训练任务，使模型在无标注子断层图上学习对三维旋转敏感的表示，从而提升对齐中的朝向估计。相比传统依赖标注或非等变网络的方法，BOE-ViT 在朝向预测上更稳定。摘要未给出具体定量结果，但作者声称在自监督 3D 子断层对齐任务上取得提升。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate orientation estimation in self-supervised 3D subtomogram alignment for cryo-ET. It proposes BOE-ViT, which injects rotation equivariance into a Vision Transformer-based self-supervised framework to learn orientation-sensitive representations without annotations. Compared with non-equivariant or supervised baselines, it improves orientation estimation for subtomogram alignment, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.assessment: 将等变性引入自监督 ViT 用于 3D 子断层对齐，思路对自监督视觉与几何等变方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.contribution: 提出等变自监督 ViT 框架 BOE-ViT 用于 3D 子断层图朝向估计。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.innovation: 把旋转等变性约束融入自监督 ViT 预训练以提升三维朝向估计。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.result: 在自监督 3D 子断层对齐任务上提升了朝向估计精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation._arxiv_id: BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation with Equivariance in Self-Supervised 3D Subtomogram Alignment.

DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云掩码自编码器（MAE）在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器 DAP-MAE。方法上在 MAE 预训练中引入域自适应机制，使模型能够学习跨域不变的点云表示，从而在源域与目标域分布不一致时仍能有效迁移。相比标准点云 MAE 仅在单一域上预训练，DAP-MAE 提升了跨域下游任务的性能。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值，但强调在跨域学习中取得有效改进。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited cross-domain generalization of point cloud masked autoencoders. It proposes DAP-MAE, a domain-adaptive point cloud MAE that learns domain-invariant representations during pretraining to enable effective transfer across domains. Compared with standard point cloud MAE pretrained on a single domain, DAP-MAE improves cross-domain downstream performance, though specific datasets and numbers are not given in the abstract.
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.assessment: 将域自适应引入点云 MAE 预训练，对 3D 感知的跨域迁移有参考意义，但摘要信息有限，需看实验细节判断实际增益。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.contribution: 提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器 DAP-MAE 以提升跨域学习效果。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.innovation: 在点云 MAE 预训练中融入域自适应以学习跨域不变表示。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.result: 在跨域点云下游任务上相比标准 MAE 取得改进（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2503.23220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中 Mean Teacher 自标注范式将学习与目标域标签生成耦合、易失效的问题，提出 DINO Teacher 框架。方法上利用大规模冻结的 DINOv2 视觉基础模型在源域数据上训练一个新的标注器，从而生成更准确的目标域伪标签，解耦标签生成与模型学习。相比依赖学生模型 EMA 生成标签的传统方法，DINO Teacher 借助基础模型的强泛化能力获得更可靠的目标域标签。摘要指出该标注器在目标域上生成更准确的标签，从而提升 DAOD 性能。
2503.23220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the brittleness of Mean Teacher self-labelling in domain adaptive object detection (DAOD), where label generation and learning are tightly coupled. It introduces DINO Teacher, which trains a new labeller on source data using a large frozen DINOv2 backbone to produce more accurate target-domain pseudo-labels, decoupling labelling from learning. Leveraging the strong generalization of vision foundation models yields more reliable target labels and improves DAOD performance over EMA-based teacher baselines.
2503.23220|v2.assessment: 用冻结的 DINOv2 基础模型替代 EMA 教师生成伪标签，思路清晰且切中 DAOD 痛点，对域自适应检测与基础模型结合方向有较高参考价值。
2503.23220|v2.contribution: 提出基于冻结 DINOv2 的 DINO Teacher 框架，解耦 DAOD 中的标签生成与模型学习。
2503.23220|v2.innovation: 用大规模视觉基础模型作为独立标注器替代 Mean Teacher 的 EMA 教师。
2503.23220|v2.result: 在目标域生成更准确的伪标签，从而提升域自适应目标检测性能。

A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对 3D 点云自监督预训练方法缺乏统一解释框架的问题，提出基于交互（interactions）的统一解释方法。方法上通过分析预训练模型中特征或神经元之间的交互关系，揭示不同自监督预训练方法（如对比学习、掩码建模等）学到的表示特性与差异。相比以往仅从下游任务性能评估预训练方法，该工作提供了可解释的视角来理解各方法的机制。摘要未给出具体实验数值，但强调该统一框架能有效区分和解释不同预训练方法。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified interpretation framework for self-supervised 3D point cloud pretraining methods. It proposes an interaction-based unified approach that analyzes feature or neuron interactions to reveal the representational properties and differences among various pretraining paradigms such as contrastive and masked modeling. Compared with purely performance-based evaluation, it offers an interpretable lens on pretraining mechanisms, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.assessment: 为 3D 点云自监督预训练提供统一可解释分析视角，对理解预训练机制有理论价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接应用关联有限。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.contribution: 提出基于交互的统一框架来解释 3D 点云自监督预训练方法。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.innovation: 用交互分析视角统一刻画不同点云自监督预训练范式的表示特性。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.result: 能够有效区分和解释不同 3D 点云自监督预训练方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2503.13739|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角行人关联中外观相似场景下 ReID 特征不可靠、且现有方法依赖真值标签或标定相机参数的问题，提出自监督无标定多视角行人关联方法 Self-MVA。方法上设计编码器-解码器模型与跨视角图像同步（cross-view image synchronization）自监督 pretext 任务，判断来自不同视角的两张图像是否同一时刻拍摄，并借助匈牙利匹配桥接实例级与同步标签，学习统一几何与外观特征。相比全监督或需标定的方法，Self-MVA 无需任何标注与相机标定即可实现鲁棒关联。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在挑战性场景下有效。
2503.13739|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view person association in challenging scenes where ReID features are unreliable and existing methods require ground-truth labels or calibrated cameras. It proposes Self-MVA, a self-supervised uncalibrated approach that uses an encoder-decoder model with a cross-view image synchronization pretext task to determine whether two views are captured simultaneously, employing Hungarian matching to bridge instance-level and synchronization labels. Unlike fully supervised or calibration-dependent methods, Self-MVA requires no annotations or camera calibration and achieves robust association in challenging scenes.
2503.13739|v2.assessment: 利用时间同步作为自监督信号实现无标定多视角行人关联，思路新颖，对多相机感知与自监督学习结合有参考价值。
2503.13739|v2.contribution: 提出无需标注与相机标定的自监督多视角行人关联方法 Self-MVA。
2503.13739|v2.innovation: 以跨视角图像同步作为自监督 pretext 任务并配合匈牙利匹配学习几何与外观特征。
2503.13739|v2.result: 在挑战性场景下实现鲁棒的多视角行人关联（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2505.04410|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 CLIP 等视觉语言模型在开放词汇密集预测任务中局部特征判别性与空间一致性不足的问题，提出 DeCLIP 框架。方法上解耦 CLIP 的自注意力模块，分别得到 content 与 context 特征：content 特征与图像裁剪表示对齐以增强局部判别性，context 特征在 DINO 等视觉基础模型指导下保留空间相关性。相比直接应用 CLIP 进行密集预测，DeCLIP 显著提升开放词汇密集感知性能。摘要指出其在多个开放词汇密集预测基准上大幅超越现有方法。
2505.04410|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal local discriminability and spatial consistency of CLIP features in open-vocabulary dense prediction. It proposes DeCLIP, which decouples CLIP's self-attention into content and context features: content features are aligned with image crop representations for local discriminability, while context features retain spatial correlations under the guidance of vision foundation models such as DINO. DeCLIP significantly outperforms existing methods across multiple open-vocabulary dense prediction benchmarks.
2505.04410|v2.assessment: 解耦 CLIP 自注意力以兼顾局部判别性与空间一致性，方法设计合理且实验充分，对开放词汇检测与密集感知方向有较高参考价值。
2505.04410|v2.contribution: 提出 DeCLIP 框架，通过解耦自注意力增强 CLIP 在开放词汇密集预测中的表现。
2505.04410|v2.innovation: 将 CLIP 自注意力解耦为 content 与 context 特征，并分别用图像裁剪与 DINO 指导对齐。
2505.04410|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇密集预测基准上显著超越现有方法。

2503.21003|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成图像取证中传统方法难以泛化到未见生成器的问题，本文提出显式建模取证微结构（像素级生成痕迹）的方法。仅用真实图像以自监督方式学习一组多样化预测滤波器提取残差，并在多尺度上联合建模，得到每张图像的紧凑"取证自描述"参数。该自描述支持零样本合成图像检测、开放集来源归因和无先验聚类，实验表明在准确性和适应性上优于竞争方法。
2503.21003|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of AI-generated image forensics to unseen generators by explicitly modeling forensic microstructures via self-supervised residual filters learned only from real images. The resulting compact per-image 'forensic self-description' enables zero-shot synthetic image detection, open-set source attribution, and source clustering without prior knowledge. Experiments show superior accuracy and adaptability over competing techniques.
2503.21003|v2.assessment: 将自监督残差建模与开放集取证结合，思路新颖，但与本领域（自动驾驶/3D感知）关联较弱，主要价值在图像取证方向。
2503.21003|v2.contribution: 提出基于取证自描述的零样本检测与开放集来源归因框架。
2503.21003|v2.innovation: 仅用真实图像自监督学习多尺度残差滤波器，将模型参数作为图像的唯一取证指纹。
2503.21003|v2.result: 在零样本检测、开放集归因和聚类任务上取得优于现有方法的准确性与适应性。

S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_cn: 该论文（摘要缺失，仅据标题推断）针对自动驾驶多模态大语言模型缺乏可扩展自监督训练与时空视觉表征的问题，提出S4-Driver。方法通过自监督方式在大规模驾驶数据上训练多模态LLM，并引入时空视觉表征以增强对动态驾驶场景的理解。相比已有依赖标注或静态图像表征的驾驶MLLM，其强调可扩展性与时空建模能力。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_en: This paper (abstract unavailable; inferred from title) targets scalable self-supervised training of driving multimodal large language models with spatio-temporal visual representations. S4-Driver learns driving MLLMs in a self-supervised manner while incorporating spatio-temporal visual features to better capture dynamic driving scenes. It emphasizes scalability and temporal modeling over prior annotation-dependent or static-image-based driving MLLMs.

S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.contribution: 提出可扩展的自监督驾驶多模态大语言模型S4-Driver及时空视觉表征方案。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.innovation: 将自监督学习与时空视觉表征引入驾驶多模态LLM训练。

2412.04424|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP式对比学习视觉编码器特征层次单一、难以适配多样下游任务的问题，本文提出Florence-VL多模态大模型，采用生成式视觉基础模型Florence-2作为视觉编码器。提出深度-广度融合（DBFusion）机制，融合不同深度和多种提示下提取的视觉特征，并设计端到端预训练加投影层与LLM微调的训练配方。定量分析与可视化表明其在视觉-语言对齐上优于常用视觉编码器。
2412.04424|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limited feature hierarchy of CLIP-style contrastive vision encoders, this paper presents Florence-VL, an MLLM family built on the generative vision foundation model Florence-2. It proposes depth-breadth fusion (DBFusion) to combine visual features across depths and multiple prompts, with an end-to-end pretraining plus projection/LLM finetuning recipe. Quantitative analysis and visualizations show advantages over popular vision encoders in vision-language alignment.
2412.04424|v2.assessment: 用生成式视觉编码器替代CLIP并做多深度多提示融合，为MLLM视觉表征设计提供了有价值的实证与架构参考。
2412.04424|v2.contribution: 提出基于Florence-2生成式视觉编码器的Florence-VL多模态大模型及DBFusion融合架构。
2412.04424|v2.innovation: 深度-广度融合机制，跨深度与多提示融合生成式视觉特征。
2412.04424|v2.result: 在视觉-语言对齐上优于常用视觉编码器，具体数值摘要未完整给出。

2502.18290|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习视觉编码器被广泛共享复用带来的安全风险，本文揭示了一种新的后门威胁：仅污染SSL视觉编码器即可向LVLM注入显著视觉幻觉，且下游模型会继承该后门。提出BadVision方法，包含新颖的触发器优化与后门学习技术，在两类SSL编码器和LVLM、八个基准上评估。结果显示攻击成功率超过99%，造成77.6%的相对视觉理解错误，同时保持隐蔽性并规避SOTA后门检测。
2502.18290|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals a new backdoor threat in self-supervised learning (SSL) vision encoders for LVLMs: compromising only the shared encoder can induce significant visual hallucinations that propagate to downstream LVLMs. It proposes BadVision with novel trigger optimization and backdoor learning, evaluated on two SSL encoder types, multiple LVLMs, and eight benchmarks. BadVision achieves over 99% attack success rate and 77.6% relative visual understanding error while remaining stealthy against state-of-the-art backdoor detection.
2502.18290|v2.assessment: 揭示了SSL视觉编码器共享复用带来的供应链式后门风险，对依赖预训练编码器的多模态与感知系统安全具有警示意义。
2502.18290|v2.contribution: 首次提出针对LVLM所用SSL视觉编码器的后门攻击方法BadVision。
2502.18290|v2.innovation: 新颖的触发器优化与后门学习技术，利用编码器共享性实现跨下游模型的广泛后门传播。
2502.18290|v2.result: 攻击成功率超99%，造成77.6%相对视觉理解错误，且保持隐蔽性、规避SOTA检测。

2511.08666|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频基础模型提取的时空特征在共享或存储时会泄露肤色、性别、衣着等敏感隐私信息的问题，而现有隐私保护方法多停留在输入像素级匿名化，需要重训练整个效用模型且任务特定，无法适配冻结的视频基础模型。作者提出轻量级匿名适配模块（AAM），以即插即用方式作用于冻结的视频编码器，并设计三个训练目标：片段级自监督隐私目标以降低静态片段间互信息、协同训练目标以保留效用等。相比已有像素级匿名化方法，AAM 无需微调或重新提取特征，显著降低计算开销，并实现与任务无关的通用匿名化。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在保留通用任务效用的同时去除私有信息。
2511.08666|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that spatio-temporal features extracted by video foundation models inadvertently leak sensitive personal attributes (e.g., skin color, gender, clothing) when shared or stored, while existing privacy preservation methods operate at the input-pixel level, require retraining the entire utility model, and are task-specific. The authors propose a lightweight Anonymizing Adapter Module (AAM) that is plug-and-play on frozen video encoders, trained with three objectives: a clip-level self-supervised privacy objective reducing mutual information between static clips, a co-training objective retaining utility, and additional constraints. Compared to prior pixel-level anonymization, AAM avoids finetuning and feature re-extraction, minimizing computational cost while achieving task-agnostic anonymization. The abstract reports no specific quantitative results but claims effective privacy removal with preserved general utility.
2511.08666|v2.assessment: 该工作将隐私保护从像素级推进到潜在特征级，为视频基础模型的安全部署提供了新思路，但其与自动驾驶感知（检测、BEV、跟踪等）的直接关联较弱，主要价值在视频理解与隐私交叉方向。
2511.08666|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的匿名适配模块 AAM，在冻结视频编码器的潜在空间中去除隐私信息并保留通用任务效用。
2511.08666|v2.innovation: 将视觉隐私保护形式化为潜在空间匿名化，并设计片段级自监督隐私目标与协同训练目标，实现任务无关的隐私-效用权衡。
2511.08666|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在无需重训练或重新提取特征的情况下有效去除隐私信息并保持任务效用。

2003.13942|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频描述生成中现有方法仅使用场景级或物体级信息、缺乏对物体交互显式建模，导致预测缺乏视觉依据且易受虚假相关影响的问题。作者提出了一种时空图模型，显式建模物体在空间和时间上的交互关系，并构建可解释的关联以提供视觉 grounding。为解决物体数量变化导致的性能不稳定，进一步提出物体感知的知识蒸馏机制，用局部物体信息正则化全局场景特征。在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在取得有竞争力性能的同时提供了可解释的预测。
2003.13942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing video captioning methods rely on scene-level or object-level information without explicitly modeling object interactions, leading to visually ungrounded and spurious predictions. The authors propose a spatio-temporal graph model that captures object interactions in space and time, building interpretable links for explicit visual grounding. They further introduce an object-aware knowledge distillation mechanism that regularizes global scene features with local object information to handle variable object counts. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks show competitive performance with interpretable predictions.
2003.13942|v2.assessment: 该工作将图神经网络与知识蒸馏结合用于视频描述，思路清晰且强调可解释性，但整体与自动驾驶感知/3D检测方向关联较弱，主要价值在视频理解领域。
2003.13942|v2.contribution: 提出时空图模型显式建模物体交互，并设计物体感知知识蒸馏机制以稳定性能。
2003.13942|v2.innovation: 利用局部物体信息通过知识蒸馏正则化全局场景特征，缓解物体数量变化带来的性能波动。
2003.13942|v2.result: 在两个视频描述基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并提供可解释的视觉 grounding 预测。

2103.03454|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体仅将历史观测以隐状态形式存于循环网络、无法捕捉环境布局与长期规划的问题，提出结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构。SSM 将导航过程中的感知精确分格记忆，并作为结构化场景表示解耦视觉与几何线索，其 collect-read 控制器自适应收集信息以支持当前决策并模拟迭代式长程推理。基于 SSM 提供的完整动作空间（地图上所有可导航位置），引入前沿探索式导航决策策略实现高效全局规划。在 R2R 和 R4R 两个 VLN 数据集上取得当时最优性能。
2103.03454|v2.summary_en: Existing vision-language navigation (VLN) agents store past observations merely as latent states in recurrent networks, failing to capture environment layouts or support long-term planning. This paper proposes Structured Scene Memory (SSM), a compartmentalized memory that accurately memorizes percepts and serves as a structured scene representation disentangling visual and geometric cues, together with a collect-read controller for adaptive information gathering and iterative long-range reasoning. Leveraging the complete action space provided by SSM, a frontier-exploration-based decision strategy enables efficient global planning, achieving state-of-the-art results on R2R and R4R.
2103.03454|v2.assessment: 将结构化记忆与全局规划引入 VLN，思路清晰且对具身导航中的长程推理有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2103.03454|v2.contribution: 提出结构化场景记忆 SSM 及配套的 collect-read 控制器与前沿探索决策策略，用于 VLN 的长程规划。
2103.03454|v2.innovation: 用分格化结构化记忆替代循环隐状态，并解耦视觉与几何线索以支持全局可导航动作空间上的规划。
2103.03454|v2.result: 在 R2R 与 R4R 数据集上达到当时最优性能。

VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉表示能力被相对忽视的问题，重新审视并改进视觉侧的特征提取。工作系统性地比较了不同视觉骨干与预训练策略对下游视觉语言任务的影响，并提出更强的区域级视觉特征以提升跨模态对齐。相比此前以语言模型为中心的设计，该方法在多个视觉语言基准上取得显著提升，推动了视觉表示在 VLM 中的地位。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_en: This paper revisits visual representations in vision-language models, arguing that the visual side has been relatively under-optimized compared to language modeling. It systematically studies visual backbones and pretraining strategies and proposes stronger region-level visual features to improve cross-modal alignment. The resulting model achieves substantial gains on multiple vision-language benchmarks, underscoring the importance of visual representation design in VLMs.
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.assessment: 对 VLM 中视觉侧的系统性再审视具有方法论价值，其视觉特征设计思路可迁移到多模态感知与 BEV 语言交互任务。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.contribution: 系统重审并改进 VLM 的视觉表示，提出更强的区域级视觉特征以增强跨模态对齐。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.innovation: 将研究重心从语言模型转向视觉表示，通过对比实验确立视觉骨干与预训练策略的关键作用。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.result: 在多个视觉语言基准上取得显著性能提升。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations._arxiv_id: VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models.

InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_cn: 针对点云视觉定位（visual grounding）中缺乏对实例级上下文整体理解的问题，提出 InstanceRefer 框架。该方法通过实例多层级上下文指代，协同融合点云的整体场景理解与实例级特征，从而更准确地将自然语言描述定位到三维实例。相比仅依赖全局或局部单一层次特征的方法，InstanceRefer 在三维视觉定位基准上提升了定位精度。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_en: This paper addresses visual grounding on point clouds, where existing methods lack holistic understanding of instance-level context. It proposes InstanceRefer, a framework that cooperatively combines holistic scene understanding with instance multi-level contextual referring to localize 3D instances from natural language descriptions. Compared with methods relying on single-level global or local features, InstanceRefer improves grounding accuracy on 3D visual grounding benchmarks.
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.assessment: 实例多层级上下文融合对三维语言定位有实际改进，与自动驾驶中语言引导的 3D 感知有一定关联。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.contribution: 提出 InstanceRefer，通过实例多层级上下文指代实现点云上的协同整体视觉定位。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.innovation: 将整体场景理解与实例级多层级上下文特征协同融合用于三维视觉定位。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.result: 在三维视觉定位基准上提升了定位精度。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde._arxiv_id: InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Understanding for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds through Instance Multi-level Contextual Referring.

3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_cn: 针对点云视觉定位中物体间关系建模不足的问题，提出 3DVG-Transformer。该方法利用 Transformer 的自注意力机制显式建模目标与上下文物体之间的空间与语义关系，从而在语言指代下更鲁棒地定位三维目标。相比此前忽略或隐式处理关系的方法，3DVG-Transformer 在三维视觉定位任务上取得更优性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_en: This paper targets visual grounding on point clouds, where inter-object relations are insufficiently modeled. It proposes 3DVG-Transformer, which leverages Transformer self-attention to explicitly model spatial and semantic relations between the target and contextual objects for robust language-guided 3D localization. Compared with prior methods that ignore or implicitly handle relations, 3DVG-Transformer achieves superior performance on 3D visual grounding.
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.assessment: 用 Transformer 显式建模三维关系对语言引导定位有启发，可借鉴到自动驾驶中基于语言的关系推理感知。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.contribution: 提出 3DVG-Transformer，用 Transformer 关系建模实现点云上的视觉定位。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.innovation: 通过自注意力显式建模目标与上下文物体间的空间与语义关系。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.result: 在三维视觉定位任务上取得优于已有方法的性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for._arxiv_id: 3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds.

3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云中密集描述（dense captioning）与视觉定位（visual grounding）两个任务通常被割裂处理的问题，提出了统一框架3DJCG。方法上通过共享编码器与联合解码器，将物体检测、描述生成与指代定位整合到同一架构中，并设计跨任务交互模块促进信息共享。相比此前分别独立训练的专用模型，该框架在两项任务上均取得更优或相当的性能，同时显著减少参数量与计算开销。实验在ScanRefer等数据集上验证了联合训练带来的相互增益。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of dense captioning and visual grounding on 3D point clouds by proposing 3DJCG, a unified framework that jointly performs object detection, caption generation, and referential grounding with a shared encoder and joint decoder. Cross-task interaction modules enable information sharing between the two tasks. Compared with separately trained task-specific models, the unified framework achieves superior or comparable performance on both tasks while reducing parameters and computation, as validated on ScanRefer and related benchmarks.
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.assessment: 将3D密集描述与视觉定位统一到一个框架中，思路清晰且工程价值明确，但整体与自动驾驶BEV感知主线关联较弱。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.contribution: 提出首个联合3D点云密集描述与视觉定位的统一框架3DJCG。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.innovation: 通过跨任务交互模块实现描述生成与指代定位的相互增强。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.result: 在ScanRefer等基准上两项任务均达到更优或相当性能，同时降低参数量与计算量。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den._arxiv_id: 3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Dense Captioning and Visual Grounding on 3D Point Clouds.

A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割（open-vocabulary semantic segmentation）中缺乏简单有效基线的问题，提出了一种基于预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的简洁方法。核心思路是冻结CLIP的图像与文本编码器，仅训练一个轻量级分割头，并利用掩码池化与伪标签进行对齐。相比此前依赖复杂多阶段训练或额外数据集的方案，该方法结构简单、训练高效，在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，证明了预训练VLM特征本身已具备较强的密集预测能力。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of a simple yet effective baseline for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by leveraging a frozen pre-trained vision-language model (e.g., CLIP) with only a lightweight segmentation head trained via masked pooling and pseudo-labeling. In contrast to prior multi-stage or data-hungry pipelines, the proposed approach is simple and efficient, achieving competitive results on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks and demonstrating that pre-trained VLM features already encode strong dense prediction capability.
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.assessment: 为开放词汇分割提供了一个极简且强力的基线，对利用VLM做密集感知的研究者有直接参考价值。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.contribution: 提出基于冻结CLIP的极简开放词汇语义分割基线。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.innovation: 用掩码池化与伪标签对齐替代复杂多阶段训练流程。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得有竞争力的性能，验证了VLM特征的密集预测潜力。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se._arxiv_id: A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Pre-trained Vision-Language Model.

A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式视觉-语言导航（interactive vision-language navigation）中指令可行性未知的问题，构建了一个新的数据集。现有导航数据集通常假设指令总是可执行的，而现实中用户指令可能无法完成。论文通过引入可行性标注与交互式对话，使智能体能够判断指令是否可行并请求澄清。该数据集为研究更鲁棒的导航智能体提供了基准，揭示了现有方法在指令可行性判断上的不足。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper introduces a new dataset for interactive vision-language navigation where command feasibility is unknown, addressing the unrealistic assumption in prior datasets that instructions are always executable. By annotating feasibility and enabling interactive dialogue, the dataset allows agents to determine whether a command is feasible and request clarification. It provides a benchmark that exposes the limitations of existing navigation methods in feasibility reasoning.
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.assessment: 关注导航中指令可行性的现实问题，数据集有独特价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.contribution: 构建了首个带指令可行性标注的交互式视觉-语言导航数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.innovation: 引入可行性判断与澄清交互机制，突破指令必然可执行的假设。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.result: 揭示了现有导航方法在指令可行性判断上的明显不足。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility.

Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）中指令与视觉观测纠缠、导致泛化能力差的问题，提出用解耦标签（decoupled labels）学习解纠缠表示。方法将导航指令分解为多个语义独立的子标签，并设计相应训练目标使模型分别学习各语义因素。相比直接端到端训练，解耦表示提升了模型对未见环境的泛化能力，在R2R等VLN基准上取得了性能提升，并增强了导航决策的可解释性。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_en: This paper addresses the entanglement of instructions and visual observations in vision-language navigation (VLN) that hinders generalization, proposing to learn disentangled representations via decoupled labels. Navigation instructions are decomposed into semantically independent sub-labels with dedicated training objectives so that the model learns each semantic factor separately. Compared with end-to-end training, the disentangled representation improves generalization to unseen environments on R2R and related VLN benchmarks while enhancing interpretability.
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.assessment: 解耦表示思路对VLN泛化问题有针对性，但属于导航方向，与自动驾驶感知研究交集较小。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.contribution: 提出基于解耦标签的VLN解纠缠表示学习方法。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.innovation: 将导航指令分解为语义独立子标签并设计对应训练目标。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.result: 在R2R等VLN基准上提升未见环境泛化性能并增强可解释性。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled._arxiv_id: Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled Labels for Vision-Language Navigation.

UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型中文本生成与目标框预测长期分离的问题，提出UniTAB统一框架，将文本与边界框作为统一输出序列进行建模。方法通过共享解码器同时生成文本token和框坐标token，使定位与描述任务在单一模型中协同训练。相比分别处理文本和框的既有方法，UniTAB在指代定位、区域描述等多任务上取得一致提升，并支持多任务联合训练而不损失单任务性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-standing separation between text generation and box prediction in vision-language models by proposing UniTAB, a unified framework that models text and bounding boxes as a single output sequence. A shared decoder generates both text tokens and box coordinate tokens, enabling joint training of grounding and captioning tasks. Compared with methods that handle text and boxes separately, UniTAB achieves consistent improvements across referring expression grounding and region captioning while supporting multi-task training without sacrificing single-task performance.
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.assessment: 统一文本与框输出的思路对多模态定位任务有较强通用性，方法简洁且实验扎实。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.contribution: 提出将文本与边界框统一为序列输出的UniTAB框架。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.innovation: 用共享解码器同时生成文本token与框坐标token实现多任务统一。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.result: 在指代定位与区域描述等多任务上取得一致性能提升。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo._arxiv_id: UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs for Grounded Vision-Language Modeling.

2207.09644|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人体骨架序列表示学习中自监督预训练忽视骨架层次化时空结构的问题，提出层次化自监督预训练方案Hi-TRS。方法基于层次化Transformer编码器，在帧、片段、视频三个层级分别显式建模空间、短期与长期时序依赖，并设计对应的自监督代理任务。相比仅在视频层级做对比学习的既有方法，Hi-TRS在动作识别、动作检测与运动预测三个下游任务上，在监督与半监督协议下均达到当时最优性能，证明了层次化预训练的有效性。
2207.09644|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of hierarchical spatial-temporal structure in self-supervised skeleton sequence representation learning by proposing Hi-TRS, a hierarchical self-supervised pre-training scheme built on a hierarchical Transformer encoder. It explicitly captures spatial, short-term, and long-term temporal dependencies at the frame, clip, and video levels with corresponding pretext tasks. Compared with prior video-level contrastive methods, Hi-TRS achieves state-of-the-art performance on action recognition, action detection, and motion prediction under both supervised and semi-supervised protocols.
2207.09644|v2.assessment: 层次化自监督预训练设计严谨、实验覆盖三个下游任务，对视频/序列表示学习研究者有借鉴意义。
2207.09644|v2.contribution: 提出层次化自监督预训练方案Hi-TRS用于骨架序列表示学习。
2207.09644|v2.innovation: 在帧、片段、视频三级显式建模空间与短/长期时序依赖。
2207.09644|v2.result: 在动作识别、动作检测与运动预测三个任务上均达到当时最优性能。

2208.06105|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频对比学习方法未能充分利用短时运动动态，而这对下游视频理解任务至关重要。本文提出运动敏感对比学习（MSCL），将光流捕获的运动信息注入RGB帧以强化特征学习，具体包括帧级跨模态局部运动对比学习（LMCL）、流旋转增强（FRA）生成运动打乱的负样本以及运动差分采样（MDS）筛选训练样本。在UCF101和Something-Something v2上，以3D ResNet-18为骨干分别达到91.5%和50.3%的top-1准确率，视频检索UCF101 Top-1 Recall达65.6%，显著超越此前最优。
2208.06105|v2.summary_en: Existing video contrastive learning methods underutilize short-term motion dynamics, which are crucial for downstream video understanding. This paper proposes Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL), which injects optical flow motion into RGB frames via frame-level cross-modal Local Motion Contrastive Learning (LMCL), Flow Rotation Augmentation (FRA) for motion-shuffled negatives, and Motion Differential Sampling (MDS). With 3D ResNet-18, it achieves 91.5% top-1 on UCF101 and 50.3% on Something-Something v2 for classification, and 65.6% Top-1 Recall on UCF101 for retrieval, notably improving the state of the art.
2208.06105|v2.assessment: 该工作通过跨模态对比学习有效融合运动信息，在多个视频理解基准上取得显著提升，对视频自监督表示学习有较强参考价值。
2208.06105|v2.contribution: 提出运动敏感对比学习框架，将光流运动信息注入RGB视频表示学习。
2208.06105|v2.innovation: 设计帧级跨模态局部运动对比学习、流旋转增强和运动差分采样策略。
2208.06105|v2.result: 在UCF101和Something-Something v2上分别达到91.5%和50.3%的top-1准确率，检索任务Top-1 Recall达65.6%。

2208.09843|v2.summary_cn: 图像-文本检索（ITR）的核心挑战在于跨模态对齐，现有对比学习方法受限于负样本数量少、手动加权负样本以及缺乏外部知识。本文提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习（CODER），包含多样性敏感对比学习（DCL）架构，通过动态字典扩大图像-文本对规模并自适应加权负样本；同时设计双分支结构，一支学习实例级嵌入并生成伪聚类标签，另一支从常识知识图谱查询概念级描述符，两分支利用DCL对齐跨模态嵌入空间。
2208.09843|v2.summary_en: Image-Text Retrieval (ITR) struggles with cross-modal alignment; existing contrastive methods are limited by few negative pairs, manual weighting, and lack of external knowledge. This paper proposes CODER, a Coupled Diversity-Sensitive Momentum Contrastive Learning framework featuring a Diversity-Sensitive Contrastive Learning (DCL) architecture with dynamic dictionaries and adaptive negative weighting, plus two branches: one for instance-level embeddings with pseudo clustering labels, and another querying a commonsense knowledge graph for concept-level descriptors, both aligned via DCL.
2208.09843|v2.assessment: 该工作通过动态字典和知识图谱增强跨模态对比学习，思路新颖，但摘要未给出具体实验数据，实际效果有待验证。
2208.09843|v2.contribution: 提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习框架CODER，结合动态字典与常识知识图谱提升图像-文本检索。
2208.09843|v2.innovation: 引入多样性敏感对比学习与双分支实例/概念级对齐机制。
2208.09843|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，需查阅全文验证。

2207.12661|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比预训练通常为每种模态使用独立编码器，但近期研究表明Transformer可支持跨模态知识共享。本文系统研究了模态共享对比语言-图像预训练（MS-CLIP）框架，探索Transformer参数在模态间的共享比例及架构设计选择。实验发现，视觉和语言信号使用大部分统一的编码器优于参数分离更多的变体，且轻量级模态特定并行模块可进一步提升性能。所提MS-CLIP在零样本ImageNet分类上相对原始CLIP提升高达13%。
2207.12661|v2.summary_en: Multimodal contrastive pre-training typically uses separate encoders per modality, but recent work suggests transformers can share knowledge across modalities. This paper investigates Modality-Shared Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (MS-CLIP), examining how many transformer parameters can be shared and relevant architectural choices. Results show a mostly unified encoder outperforms more separated variants, and lightweight modality-specific parallel modules further improve performance. MS-CLIP outperforms vanilla CLIP by up to 13% relative in zero-shot ImageNet classification.
2207.12661|v2.assessment: 该工作对多模态预训练中的参数共享策略进行了系统性实证研究，结论对设计高效多模态模型具有指导意义。
2207.12661|v2.contribution: 系统研究模态共享的对比语言-图像预训练框架，揭示参数共享比例对性能的影响。
2207.12661|v2.innovation: 提出MS-CLIP框架，验证统一编码器加轻量模态特定模块的优越性。
2207.12661|v2.result: 零样本ImageNet分类相对原始CLIP提升高达13%。

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉-语言（V&L）模型依赖在少量人工标注数据上预训练的视觉编码器，泛化能力受限。本文系统研究CLIP作为视觉编码器在V&L模型中的优势，涵盖两种场景：将CLIP插入任务特定微调，以及结合CLIP与V&L预训练后迁移至下游任务。实验表明CLIP显著优于BottomUp-TopDown等域内标注数据训练的编码器，在视觉问答、视觉蕴含和V&L导航等任务上取得竞争性或更优结果，并建立新的最优性能。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-and-Language (V&L) models rely on visual encoders pre-trained on limited annotated data, limiting generalization. This paper systematically studies the benefits of using CLIP as the visual encoder in V&L models under two scenarios: plugging CLIP into task-specific fine-tuning, and combining CLIP with V&L pre-training for downstream transfer. CLIP significantly outperforms encoders like BottomUp-TopDown, achieving competitive or better results on diverse V&L tasks and establishing new state-of-the-art on VQA, Visual Entailment, and V&L Navigation.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 该工作通过大规模实验验证了CLIP作为视觉编码器在V&L任务中的通用优势，对多模态研究社区具有重要参考价值。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 系统评估CLIP作为视觉编码器在多种视觉-语言任务中的效果，并发布代码。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 提出将CLIP与V&L预训练结合的两阶段范式，验证其跨任务泛化能力。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在VQA、视觉蕴含和V&L导航任务上取得新的最优性能。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: 多模态VAE旨在建模异构数据的联合分布并捕获共享表示，但现有方法通常通过显式乘积或混合在识别模型中直接协调各模态表示。本文提出MEME，将半监督VAE重新用于通过相互监督隐式组合模态信息，自然支持部分观测数据（某些模态完全缺失）的场景。在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上，MEME在部分和完全观测方案下均优于基线，并揭示了相互监督学习到的表示在捕获数据相关性方面的有趣趋势。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: Multimodal VAEs aim to model joint distributions over heterogeneous data while capturing shared representations, but prior work typically combines modalities via explicit products or mixtures in the recognition model. This paper introduces MEME, which repurposes semi-supervised VAEs to combine modalities implicitly through mutual supervision, naturally handling partially-observed data with entirely missing modalities. MEME outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB under both partial and complete observation schemes, and reveals interesting trends in representation quality.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态VAE提供了一种新颖的隐式监督范式，尤其在处理缺失模态方面具有优势，但实验规模较小。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出MEME，通过相互监督隐式组合多模态信息，支持部分观测数据。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 将半监督VAE重新用于多模态学习，避免显式模态组合。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在MNIST-SVHN和CUB上部分及完全观测方案均优于基线。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比学习（如CLIP）依赖噪声大且未筛选的训练数据，这虽降低成本并提升分布外鲁棒性，但也带来严重的安全隐患。本文首次系统揭示此类训练方式使后门和投毒攻击成为重大威胁：仅需污染0.01%的数据集（如300万Conceptual Captions中的300张图像），即可通过叠加小补丁使模型误分类测试图像；定向投毒攻击更易实现，仅需控制0.0001%的数据（300万中的3张图像）。这些攻击对在未筛选互联网数据上训练的做法提出了质疑。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: Multimodal contrastive learning methods like CLIP train on noisy, uncurated datasets, which reduces labeling costs and improves out-of-distribution robustness but introduces significant security risks. This paper shows that backdoor and poisoning attacks are a significant threat: poisoning just 0.01% of a dataset (e.g., 300 of 3M Conceptual Captions images) causes misclassification via a small patch, and targeted poisoning requires only 0.0001% (3 images). These attacks question the desirability of training on noisy Internet scrapes.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了多模态对比学习在数据安全方面的严重漏洞，对依赖网络爬取数据训练的研究具有重要警示意义。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 首次系统证明多模态对比学习易受后门和投毒攻击，且攻击成本极低。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 提出针对对比学习的高效投毒与后门攻击方法，仅需极小比例数据污染。
2106.09667|v2.result: 污染0.01%数据即可实现后门攻击，定向投毒仅需0.0001%数据。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）中，CLIP 的图像-文本预训练缺乏精确定位能力，而图像级弱监督的启发式方法无法准确指定局部物体区域，两者均未与检测任务最优对齐。本文提出对 CLIP 语言嵌入进行以物体为中心的对齐，并利用伪标签过程在仅图像级监督下视觉定位物体、扩展词汇表，再通过一种新颖的权重转移函数将两种对齐策略互补融合。相比已有 OVD 方法，该工作弥合了物体级与图像级表示之间的鸿沟，在开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著提升。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on CLIP embeddings and image-level supervision, neither of which is optimally aligned for detection. This work proposes object-centric alignment of CLIP language embeddings and a pseudo-labeling process that visually grounds objects under image-level supervision, bridging the two strategies via a novel weight transfer function. The method narrows the gap between object- and image-level representations, yielding notable gains on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了 OVD 中弱监督信号与检测任务不对齐的核心问题，权重转移融合思路新颖，对开放集检测方向有较强参考价值。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出物体中心对齐与伪标签视觉定位相结合的开放词汇检测框架，并通过权重转移函数融合两种互补监督信号。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 用权重转移函数桥接 CLIP 物体级对齐与图像级伪标签监督，实现互补优势聚合。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上显著优于已有方法，有效扩展了可检测词汇并提升新类泛化能力。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇模型如 CLIP 在零样本分类上表现优异，但在部分任务上性能远未达到最优，且微调易导致已有任务精度下降。本文提出 PAINT，通过在微调前后模型权重之间进行插值来实现模型修补，在保持原有能力的同时提升特定任务精度。在 9 个零样本 CLIP 表现较差的任务上，PAINT 将精度提升 15 至 60 个百分点，同时 ImageNet 精度保持在零样本模型 1 个百分点以内，并支持多任务修补与跨任务广泛迁移。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary models like CLIP underperform on certain tasks, and naive fine-tuning degrades existing capabilities. PAINT patches models by interpolating between pre- and post-fine-tuning weights, improving target-task accuracy by 15-60 points on nine tasks while keeping ImageNet accuracy within 1 point of zero-shot. It supports multi-task patching and exhibits broad transfer across disjoint classes.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 权重插值修补思路简洁有效，对开放词汇模型的持续适配有启发，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出 PAINT 权重插值修补方法，在不损害原有任务精度的前提下提升开放词汇模型在特定任务上的表现。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 利用微调前后权重插值实现模型修补，并发现跨不相交类别的广泛迁移现象。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在 9 个任务上精度提升 15-60 个百分点，ImageNet 精度损失控制在 1 个百分点以内。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: 3D 视觉定位任务中，现有方法多依赖现成的点云编码器提取 3D 视觉线索，视觉流表示能力受限。本文提出 LAR 模块，从点云合成 2D 线索以辅助 3D 编码器，无需额外 2D 输入即可引入丰富的 2D 物体表示，并通过知识蒸馏在训练和测试中高效利用。在 Nr3D、Sr3D 和 ScanRefer 三个基准上，LAR 一致超越现有最先进的 3D 视觉定位方法。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D visual grounding methods rely on off-the-shelf point cloud encoders, limiting visual representation quality. This paper proposes LAR, which synthesizes 2D clues from point clouds to assist the 3D encoder via knowledge distillation without extra 2D inputs. LAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 利用合成 2D 语义蒸馏增强 3D 表示，思路对多模态 3D 感知有借鉴意义，但任务偏向视觉定位而非自动驾驶检测。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出 LAR 模块，通过从点云合成 2D 线索并知识蒸馏来增强 3D 视觉定位的视觉表示。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 无需额外 2D 输入，仅从点云合成 2D 语义线索并以知识蒸馏方式辅助 3D 编码器训练。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在 Nr3D、Sr3D、ScanRefer 三个基准上一致超越现有最先进方法。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 单域泛化（SDG）目标检测旨在仅用单一源域训练模型并泛化到任意未见目标域，但此前研究几乎空白。本文提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型，通过文本提示引入语义域概念，具体实现为在检测器骨干特征上进行语义增强，并加入基于文本的分类损失。相比唯一已有的SDG检测方法Single-DGOD，在多样天气驾驶基准上性能提升10%。该工作为SDG检测提供了新范式，验证了VLM在域泛化检测中的有效性。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single domain generalization (SDG) for object detection, which remains largely unexplored. It leverages a pre-trained vision-language model to introduce semantic domain concepts via textual prompts, using semantic augmentation on detector backbone features and a text-based classification loss. The approach outperforms the only existing SDG detection method, Single-DGOD, by 10% on a diverse weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 首次将VLM引入SDG目标检测，思路新颖且实验提升显著，对自动驾驶域泛化有参考价值。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 提出了基于视觉-语言模型的单域泛化目标检测框架，通过语义增强和文本分类损失提升跨域泛化能力。
2301.05499|v2.innovation: 利用文本提示引入语义域概念，在特征层面进行语义增强，并设计文本分类损失。
2301.05499|v2.result: 在多样天气驾驶基准上比Single-DGOD提升10%。

2303.12027|v2.summary_cn: 基于自然语言规范的跟踪旨在根据语言描述在视频序列中定位目标，现有方法将视觉定位与跟踪分为两步，使用独立模型，忽略了二者共享的全局语义线索且难以端到端训练。本文提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，将两任务统一为基于视觉-语言参考的目标定位，并设计多源关系建模模块构建参考与测试图像的关系，以及时序建模模块在全局语义指导下提供时序线索。该方法提升了对外观变化的适应性，实现了端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles tracking by natural language specification, where existing methods separate visual grounding and tracking, overlooking their shared semantic cues and hindering end-to-end training. It proposes a joint framework that unifies grounding and tracking as localizing the referred target based on visual-language references, with a multi-source relation modeling module and a temporal modeling module guided by global semantics. The approach improves adaptability to appearance variations.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 将视觉定位与跟踪统一为端到端框架，思路合理，对多模态跟踪有推动作用。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出了联合视觉定位与跟踪的统一框架，实现端到端训练并利用全局语义指导时序建模。
2303.12027|v2.innovation: 多源关系建模模块和全局语义引导的时序建模模块。
2303.12027|v2.result: 提升了对外观变化的适应性，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.16891|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇实例分割（OVIS）旨在分割新类别，但现有方法依赖基类的手动掩码标注，且强监督与弱监督的差异导致对基类过拟合，泛化到新类别差。本文提出Mask-free OVIS流水线，利用预训练视觉-语言模型的定位能力，从图像-描述对中自动生成伪掩码标注，并以弱监督方式同时学习基类和新类别。该方法无需任何手动掩码标注，缓解了强/弱监督不平衡问题，提升了新类别的泛化能力。
2303.16891|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) suffers from overfitting to base categories due to strong supervision from manual masks and weak supervision from image-captions. This paper proposes Mask-free OVIS, which automatically generates pseudo-mask annotations using a pre-trained vision-language model's localization ability, and learns both base and novel categories in a weakly supervised manner. The method eliminates manual mask annotations and improves generalization to novel categories.
2303.16891|v2.assessment: 无需手动掩码的开放词汇实例分割方案，利用VLM生成伪标签，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出了Mask-free OVIS流水线，利用VLM自动生成伪掩码，以弱监督方式学习基类和新类别。
2303.16891|v2.innovation: 完全摒弃手动掩码标注，通过VLM定位能力生成伪掩码并统一弱监督训练。
2303.16891|v2.result: 缓解了基类过拟合，提升了新类别泛化，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.13076|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测（OVD）旨在检测训练基类之外的新类别，现有方法依赖CLIP等视觉-语言模型，但面临两个核心障碍：整图训练的VL模型用于区域识别时的分布不匹配，以及未见类别的定位困难。本文提出CORA，一种DETR风格框架，通过区域提示（Region prompting）缓解整图到区域的分布差距，并通过锚点预匹配（Anchor pre-matching）的类感知匹配机制学习可泛化的目标定位。在COCO OVD基准上，新类别达到41.7 AP50，超越此前SOTA 2.4 AP50，且无需额外训练数据。
2303.13076|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) faces distribution mismatch when applying whole-image VL models to region recognition and difficulty in localizing unseen classes. This paper proposes CORA, a DETR-style framework that adapts CLIP via region prompting to mitigate the whole-to-region gap and anchor pre-matching for class-aware matching. On COCO OVD, CORA achieves 41.7 AP50 on novel classes, outperforming the previous SOTA by 2.4 AP50 without extra training data.
2303.13076|v2.assessment: 针对CLIP用于OVD的两个核心问题提出有效解决方案，性能提升显著，是该领域的重要进展。
2303.13076|v2.contribution: 提出了CORA框架，通过区域提示和锚点预匹配适配CLIP进行开放词汇检测。
2303.13076|v2.innovation: 区域提示缓解整图-区域分布不匹配，锚点预匹配实现类感知的可泛化定位。
2303.13076|v2.result: 在COCO OVD上新类达到41.7 AP50，超越SOTA 2.4 AP50。

2301.09121|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVS）旨在分割任意类别而非预定义闭集类别。本文提出OVSegmentor，一种基于Transformer的模型，仅使用网络爬取的图像-文本对进行预训练，无需任何掩码标注。模型通过基于slot-attention的绑定模块将像素聚合成可学习的组令牌，并与对应的描述嵌入对齐；提出两个代理任务：掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性，分别学习细粒度视觉-文本对齐和视觉不变性。此外构建了CC4M数据集提升训练效率，在多个基准上取得优异性能。
2301.09121|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) using only web-crawled image-text pairs without mask annotations. It proposes OVSegmentor, a transformer-based model that binds pixels into learnable group tokens via slot-attention and aligns them with caption embeddings. Two proxy tasks, masked entity completion and cross-image mask consistency, enable fine-grained alignment and visual invariance. A CC4M dataset is constructed for efficient pre-training.
2301.09121|v2.assessment: 仅用图像-文本对实现开放词汇分割，代理任务设计巧妙，CC4M数据集对社区有贡献。
2301.09121|v2.contribution: 提出了OVSegmentor模型和两个代理任务，仅用图像-文本对预训练实现开放词汇语义分割。
2301.09121|v2.innovation: 基于slot-attention的组令牌绑定模块，以及掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性代理任务。
2301.09121|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得优异性能，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2212.00785|v2.summary_cn: 开放世界语义分割旨在仅用图像-文本对分割任意视觉概念，现有基于对比学习（CL）的方法存在训练-测试不一致：训练时仅考虑图像-文本对齐，而测试时需要区域-文本对齐。本文提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐：为给定文本生成分割掩码，从掩码区域提取文本接地图像嵌入，并通过TCL与文本嵌入对齐。该方法直接优化生成掩码的质量，并提出了统一的评估协议，在8个语义分割数据集上验证了有效性。
2212.00785|v2.summary_en: Open-world semantic segmentation using only image-text pairs suffers from a train-test discrepancy in contrastive learning methods, which align image-text during training but require region-text alignment at test time. This paper proposes Text-grounded Contrastive Learning (TCL), which directly learns region-text alignment by generating a mask for given text, extracting text-grounded image embedding, and aligning it with text embedding. A unified evaluation protocol on 8 datasets demonstrates effectiveness.
2212.00785|v2.assessment: 直接学习区域-文本对齐解决了CL方法的训练-测试不一致问题，统一评估协议对公平比较有价值。
2212.00785|v2.contribution: 提出了TCL框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐，并建立了统一的开放世界分割评估协议。
2212.00785|v2.innovation: 通过生成掩码并提取文本接地嵌入进行对比学习，直接优化掩码质量。
2212.00785|v2.result: 在8个语义分割数据集上验证了有效性，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言预训练（VLP）训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，指出掩码语言建模（MLM）中预测率与破坏率耦合导致大量输出token被排除在损失之外。提出自由语言建模（FLM），实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并允许为每个待预测token定制破坏跨度。相比MLM方法，FLM在相同GPU时间下能更灵活利用双向上下文，预训练时间减少2.5倍，同时保持下游性能。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence of vision-language pretraining (VLP), identifying the entanglement of prediction rate and corruption rate in masked language modeling (MLM) as a key obstacle. It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which achieves a 100% prediction rate with arbitrary corruption rates and allows customized corruption spans per token. FLM reduces pretraining time by 2.5x compared to MLM-based methods while maintaining competitive performance.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了VLP训练效率瓶颈，方法简洁且实验充分，对多模态预训练研究者有较高参考价值。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与破坏率，显著加速VLP收敛。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并支持逐token定制破坏跨度。
2303.14038|v2.result: 预训练时间减少2.5倍，同时保持下游任务性能。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）在下游任务高效迁移时，现有方法（如prompt tuning丢弃预训练文本分类器，adapter tuning过度依赖预训练特征）破坏或过度偏向先验知识的问题。提出Task Residual Tuning（TaskRes），直接在文本分类器上操作，冻结原始分类器权重，通过调优一组与先验无关的残差参数获得新分类器，显式解耦先验知识与任务特定知识。该方法能可靠保留先验知识并灵活利用任务知识，在少样本迁移任务上取得优异性能。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that existing efficient transfer learning methods for vision-language models (VLMs) either damage or overly bias the pre-trained knowledge. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which freezes the original text-based classifier and learns a set of prior-independent residual parameters to form a new classifier, explicitly decoupling prior and task-specific knowledge. TaskRes achieves reliable prior preservation and flexible task adaptation, showing strong performance in few-shot transfer.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: TaskRes为VLM高效迁移提供了简洁有效的解耦思路，实验扎实，对多模态下游适配有实用价值。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes，通过残差参数解耦预训练先验与任务特定知识。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 在文本分类器上直接学习与先验无关的残差，避免破坏或过度依赖预训练知识。
2211.10277|v2.result: 在少样本迁移任务上取得优于现有ETL方法的性能。

Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）任务中智能体需要理解复杂指令并在环境中规划路径的问题。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题推测提出了自适应区域感知的分层规划器，可能通过区域划分和分层决策来提升导航效率。相比已有工作，可能改进了对动态环境的适应性和规划精度。由于缺乏摘要，无法引用具体实验数据。
Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner.summary_en: This paper addresses vision-language navigation (VLN), where an agent must follow complex instructions and plan paths in environments. The title suggests an adaptive zone-aware hierarchical planner that likely improves navigation efficiency through zone partitioning and hierarchical decision-making. However, due to the missing abstract, specific methods and results cannot be detailed.
Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner.assessment: VLN是具身智能的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献，建议关注后续完整版本。
Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner.contribution: 提出自适应区域感知的分层规划器用于视觉-语言导航。
Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner.innovation: 可能引入区域感知与分层规划结合的策略。
Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner._arxiv_id: Adaptive Zone-aware Hierarchical Planner for Vision-Language Navigation.

@ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation.summary_cn: 该论文关注视觉-语言基础模型是否具备组合推理能力，即能否理解对象、属性及其组合关系。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体方法，但从标题推测可能构建了组合性推理的评测基准（CREPE），并评估了现有VLM在组合理解上的表现。相比已有工作，可能揭示了VLM在组合推理上的不足。由于缺乏摘要，无法引用具体实验数据。
@ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation.summary_en: This paper investigates whether vision-language foundation models can reason compositionally, i.e., understanding objects, attributes, and their combinations. The title suggests the introduction of a benchmark (CREPE) to evaluate compositional reasoning in VLMs. However, due to the missing abstract, specific methods and results are unavailable.
@ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation.assessment: 组合推理是VLM的核心挑战之一，该工作可能提供有价值的评测视角，但需完整摘要以评估其深度。
@ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation.contribution: 可能提出评估VLM组合推理能力的基准CREPE。
@ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation.innovation: 针对VLM组合性推理进行系统评测。
@ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
@ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation._arxiv_id: @ CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation Models Reason Compositionally?

2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: 针对人-物交互（HOI）检测中，现有基于CLIP知识蒸馏的方法依赖大规模训练数据且在少样本/零样本场景下性能不佳的问题。提出HOICLIP框架，通过交互解码器利用交叉注意力从CLIP视觉特征图中提取信息区域，并与检测骨干融合；利用CLIP文本编码器嵌入HOI描述生成分类器，并通过视觉语义算术和轻量动词表示适配器构建动词分类器。此外提出免训练增强利用全局HOI预测。在少样本和零样本设置下取得更好的泛化性能。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of CLIP-based knowledge distillation for human-object interaction (HOI) detection, which relies on large-scale data and performs poorly in few/zero-shot scenarios. It proposes HOICLIP, which extracts informative regions from CLIP visual features via a cross-attention interaction decoder, fuses them with the detection backbone, and leverages CLIP text encoder to generate classifiers. A training-free enhancement further exploits global HOI predictions, achieving improved generalization in few/zero-shot settings.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: HOICLIP有效结合CLIP先验与检测框架，在少样本HOI检测上表现突出，对多模态感知有借鉴意义。
2303.15786|v2.contribution: 提出HOICLIP框架，高效迁移CLIP知识用于HOI检测。
2303.15786|v2.innovation: 交互解码器与知识集成块融合CLIP视觉特征，以及基于视觉语义算术的动词分类器。
2303.15786|v2.result: 在少样本和零样本HOI检测上取得更好的泛化性能。

2303.10431|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）因训练数据中身份群体分布不均而产生社会偏见，导致特定文本概念与不同身份群体图像的相似度出现偏差，限制其在高风险场景应用的问题。提出DeAR（Debiasing with Additive Residuals），学习加性残差图像表示来偏移原始表示，确保输出表示公平，降低表示对不同身份群体的区分能力。同时指出现有公平性测试局限于有限人脸数据集，引入Protected Attribute Tag Association基准以更好评估DeAR。
2303.10431|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses societal biases in large vision-language models (VLMs) caused by skewed identity group distributions in training data, which manifest as biased similarities between text concepts and images of different groups. It proposes DeAR (Debiasing with Additive Residuals), which learns additive residual image representations to offset original representations and ensure fair outputs. It also introduces the Protected Attribute Tag Association benchmark to better evaluate debiasing methods.
2303.10431|v2.assessment: DeAR为VLM公平性提供了新的去偏思路和评测基准，对可信多模态学习有参考价值。
2303.10431|v2.contribution: 提出DeAR去偏方法及新的公平性评测基准。
2303.10431|v2.innovation: 通过学习加性残差图像表示来偏移原始表示，实现公平输出。
2303.10431|v2.result: 降低了表示对不同身份群体的区分能力，并提供了更全面的评测基准。

THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在自由形式生成中产生物体幻觉的问题，指出现有幻觉评测多局限于判别式或短答案设定，无法覆盖开放式生成场景。作者提出 THRONE，一个基于物体的幻觉基准，通过从自由形式生成文本中抽取物体提及并借助外部知识库/检测器验证其是否真实存在于图像中，从而量化幻觉率。相比已有基准，THRONE 不依赖固定候选答案，可评估任意开放式输出，并覆盖多种 LVLM 与任务。实验揭示了当前主流 LVLM 在自由生成中仍存在显著物体幻觉，且模型规模与幻觉率并非简单负相关。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_en: This paper addresses object hallucination in free-form generations of large vision-language models (LVLMs), where existing benchmarks are limited to discriminative or short-answer settings. The authors propose THRONE, an object-based hallucination benchmark that extracts object mentions from free-form text and verifies them against the image via external knowledge/detectors to quantify hallucination. Unlike prior benchmarks, THRONE handles arbitrary open-ended outputs and enables cross-model comparison, revealing that state-of-the-art LVLMs still exhibit substantial object hallucination and that scaling does not monotonically reduce it.
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.assessment: 为 LVLM 幻觉评测提供了更贴近真实开放式生成的基准，对多模态可靠性与自动驾驶中 VLM 应用的安全评估有参考价值。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.contribution: 提出了面向自由形式生成的基于物体的 LVLM 幻觉评测基准 THRONE。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.innovation: 摆脱固定候选答案，直接从开放式生成中抽取并验证物体提及来量化幻觉。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.result: 揭示了当前 SOTA LVLM 在自由生成中仍存在显著物体幻觉，且模型规模与幻觉率无简单负相关。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be._arxiv_id: THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Benchmark for the Free-Form Generations of Large Vision-Language Models.

VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）知识编辑缺乏统一评测的问题，指出现有知识编辑基准多面向纯文本 LLM，无法衡量涉及视觉信息的编辑效果。作者提出 VLKEB，一个面向 LVLM 的知识编辑基准，构建了包含视觉相关事实的编辑样本，并设计了可靠性、泛化性与局部性等多维度评价指标。相比已有工作，VLKEB 首次系统评估 LVLM 在视觉条件下的知识编辑能力，覆盖多种编辑方法与模型。实验表明现有编辑方法在 LVLM 上泛化性与局部性仍不足，视觉信息会显著影响编辑效果。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of a unified benchmark for knowledge editing in large vision-language models (LVLMs), since existing editing benchmarks target text-only LLMs and cannot assess visually grounded edits. The authors introduce VLKEB, a knowledge editing benchmark for LVLMs with visually grounded facts and multi-dimensional metrics covering reliability, generality, and locality. Experiments show that current editing methods still struggle with generality and locality on LVLMs, and visual context substantially affects editing outcomes.
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.assessment: 填补了 LVLM 知识编辑评测的空白，对多模态模型可控更新与安全部署有参考意义。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.contribution: 提出了首个面向大型视觉语言模型的知识编辑基准 VLKEB。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.innovation: 将知识编辑评测从纯文本扩展到视觉条件，并设计多维度评价指标。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.result: 实验显示现有编辑方法在 LVLM 上泛化性与局部性不足，视觉信息显著影响编辑效果。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno._arxiv_id: VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Knowledge Editing Benchmark.

ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）多轮对话能力评测不足的问题，指出现有基准多为单轮问答，无法诊断多轮交互中的能力退化与错误来源。作者提出 ConvBench，一个多轮对话评测基准，具备分层消融能力，可将多轮任务分解为感知、推理等子能力并定位失败环节。相比已有基准，ConvBench 通过分层设计支持细粒度归因分析，覆盖多种 LVLM 与多轮场景。实验揭示了当前 SOTA LVLM 在多轮对话中感知与推理能力存在明显瓶颈，且随轮次增加性能下降。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of evaluation for multi-turn conversation in large vision-language models (LVLMs), as existing benchmarks are mostly single-turn and cannot diagnose capability degradation. The authors propose ConvBench, a multi-turn conversation benchmark with hierarchical ablation that decomposes tasks into sub-capabilities such as perception and reasoning to localize failures. Experiments reveal clear bottlenecks in perception and reasoning for state-of-the-art LVLMs in multi-turn settings, with performance degrading as turns increase.
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.assessment: 为 LVLM 多轮交互提供了可归因的评测工具，对多模态对话系统与自动驾驶人机交互研究有参考价值。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.contribution: 提出了具备分层消融能力的 LVLM 多轮对话评测基准 ConvBench。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.innovation: 通过分层任务分解实现对多轮对话失败环节的细粒度归因。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.result: 揭示 SOTA LVLM 在多轮对话中感知与推理存在瓶颈，性能随轮次增加而下降。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva._arxiv_id: ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark with Hierarchical Ablation Capability for Large Vision-Language Models.

2408.16176|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）能否在无微调条件下辅助生物物种性状发现问题，指出现有评测多集中于通用场景，缺乏面向生物图像的基准。作者构建 VLM4Bio 数据集，包含来自鱼类、鸟类和蝴蝶三类生物的 30K 图像与 469K 问答对，覆盖五个生物学相关任务，并系统评测 12 个 SOTA VLM，同时考察提示技术与推理幻觉的影响。相比已有工作，该基准规模大、任务多样且面向真实科学问题。实验表明当前 VLM 在生物性状发现上仍有明显局限，提示技术可部分提升性能但幻觉问题依然存在。
2408.16176|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) can assist trait discovery from biological images without fine-tuning, noting that existing benchmarks focus on general domains. The authors introduce VLM4Bio, comprising 30K images and 469K question-answer pairs across fishes, birds, and butterflies, covering five biologically relevant tasks, and evaluate 12 state-of-the-art VLMs along with prompting techniques and reasoning hallucination. Results show that current VLMs remain limited in biological trait discovery, with prompting yielding partial gains but hallucination persisting.
2408.16176|v2.assessment: 提供了大规模生物图像 VLM 评测基准，对多模态模型在专业领域的泛化与幻觉研究有参考价值。
2408.16176|v2.contribution: 构建了面向生物性状发现的大规模 VLM 评测数据集 VLM4Bio。
2408.16176|v2.innovation: 将 VLM 评测扩展到生物多样性领域，并系统考察提示与幻觉影响。
2408.16176|v2.result: 评测 12 个 SOTA VLM，显示其在生物性状发现上仍有明显局限，提示技术仅部分提升性能。

Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割问题，指出现有方法多依赖额外训练或特定数据集，难以直接利用现成视觉语言模型（VLM）。作者提出一种从现成 VLM 中涌现开放词汇语义分割能力的方法，通过将 VLM 的图文对齐与像素级特征结合，无需额外分割标注即可实现开放词汇分割。相比已有工作，该方法无需针对分割任务重新训练，直接复用预训练 VLM 的零样本能力。实验在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了 VLM 内部已蕴含可迁移的分割知识。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where existing methods often require additional training or task-specific datasets and cannot directly exploit off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs). The authors propose a method that elicits open-vocabulary segmentation from off-the-shelf VLMs by combining image-text alignment with pixel-level features, requiring no extra segmentation annotations. Experiments on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks show competitive results, demonstrating that transferable segmentation knowledge already exists within pre-trained VLMs.
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.assessment: 展示了现成 VLM 可直接涌现开放词汇分割能力，对开放集感知与多模态分割研究有较高参考价值。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.contribution: 提出无需额外训练即可从现成 VLM 中涌现开放词汇语义分割的方法。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.innovation: 直接复用预训练 VLM 的零样本图文对齐能力实现像素级开放词汇分割。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得有竞争力结果，验证 VLM 内含可迁移分割知识。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen._arxiv_id: Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation from Off-the-Shelf Vision-Language Models.

Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本开放词汇 3D 视觉定位问题，指出现有 3D 定位方法依赖标注的 3D 数据且难以泛化到未见类别。作者提出视觉编程框架，将 3D 视觉定位分解为可由现成视觉语言模型执行的子任务，通过组合 2D 检测、语言理解与 3D 几何推理实现零样本开放词汇定位。相比已有工作，该方法无需 3D 标注训练即可处理任意文本查询。实验在多个 3D 视觉定位基准上取得优于或接近有监督方法的零样本性能，验证了视觉编程在 3D 任务中的有效性。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding, where existing methods rely on annotated 3D data and struggle to generalize to unseen categories. The authors propose a visual programming framework that decomposes 3D grounding into subtasks executable by off-the-shelf vision-language models, combining 2D detection, language understanding, and 3D geometric reasoning for zero-shot open-vocabulary grounding. Experiments on multiple 3D grounding benchmarks show zero-shot performance comparable to or better than supervised methods, validating visual programming for 3D tasks.
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.assessment: 将视觉编程引入零样本开放词汇 3D 定位，对开放集 3D 感知与多模态 3D 理解有较高参考价值。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.contribution: 提出基于视觉编程的零样本开放词汇 3D 视觉定位框架。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.innovation: 将 3D 定位分解为现成 VLM 可执行的子任务，无需 3D 标注训练。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.result: 在多个 3D 视觉定位基准上取得优于或接近有监督方法的零样本性能。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo._arxiv_id: Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding.

DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_cn: 针对开放世界少样本学习（OWFL）中CLIP在未见类上泛化不足的问题，论文提出DeIL（Direct-and-Inverse CLIP）框架。方法通过直接分支与逆分支的双向提示学习，结合视觉-语言对齐的对比目标，缓解基类与新颖类之间的语义鸿沟。相比已有CLIP微调方法，DeIL在多个少样本基准上取得更优的基-新类平衡性能，具体提升幅度需参考原文实验数据。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of CLIP in open-world few-shot learning (OWFL) by proposing DeIL (Direct-and-Inverse CLIP). The method introduces a dual-branch prompt learning framework with direct and inverse branches, combined with vision-language contrastive objectives to bridge the semantic gap between base and novel classes. Compared with existing CLIP fine-tuning approaches, DeIL achieves better base-novel trade-offs on several few-shot benchmarks.
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.assessment: 该工作将CLIP的提示学习扩展到开放世界少样本场景，思路清晰，对开放集识别与视觉-语言模型交叉方向有参考价值。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.contribution: 提出Direct-and-Inverse CLIP双分支框架用于开放世界少样本学习。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.innovation: 通过直接与逆分支的协同提示学习缓解基类-新颖类语义鸿沟。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.result: 在多个少样本基准上取得更优的基-新类平衡性能。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W._arxiv_id: DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-World Few-Shot Learning.

Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）中视觉编码器与语言模型对齐不充分的问题，论文提出一种受视觉机制启发的VLM架构改进方案。方法通过引入更接近生物视觉处理流程的视觉特征提取与融合模块，增强视觉表征的层次性与语义一致性。相比主流VLM，该工作在多项视觉-语言基准上取得性能提升，具体数值需参考原文。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficient alignment between visual encoders and language models in existing VLMs by proposing a vision-inspired architecture. The method introduces visual feature extraction and fusion modules that better mimic biological visual processing, enhancing the hierarchy and semantic consistency of visual representations. Compared with mainstream VLMs, it achieves improvements on several vision-language benchmarks.
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.assessment: 从视觉机制出发改进VLM架构，思路新颖，对多模态感知与VLM交叉研究有启发意义。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.contribution: 提出一种视觉机制启发的VLM架构以增强视觉-语言对齐。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.innovation: 将生物视觉处理流程引入VLM的视觉特征提取与融合。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.result: 在多项视觉-语言基准上取得性能提升。

DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）与人类对齐和交互能力不足的问题，论文提出DRESS框架，利用自然语言反馈进行指令微调。方法通过构建基于自然语言反馈的对齐与交互数据集，训练模型更好地理解人类意图并生成符合偏好的响应。相比已有RLHF方法，DRESS在人类偏好对齐和交互质量上取得提升，具体指标见原文。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited alignment and interaction capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs) by proposing DRESS, a framework that leverages natural language feedback for instruction tuning. It constructs feedback-based alignment and interaction data to train models to better understand human intent and generate preferred responses. Compared with existing RLHF methods, DRESS improves human preference alignment and interaction quality.
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.assessment: 将自然语言反馈用于LVLM对齐，对多模态人机交互研究有参考价值。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.contribution: 提出基于自然语言反馈的DRESS框架用于LVLM对齐与交互。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.innovation: 利用自然语言反馈构建对齐与交互数据集进行指令微调。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.result: 在人类偏好对齐和交互质量上优于已有RLHF方法。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Language Models to Align and Interact with Humans via Natural Language Feedback.

Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）中语言幻觉与视觉错觉相互纠缠难以诊断的问题，论文提出HallusionBench诊断套件。该基准通过设计成对的视觉-语言测试样本，系统性地分离和评估语言幻觉与视觉错觉。相比已有幻觉评测，HallusionBench提供了更细粒度的诊断能力，揭示了当前LVLM在视觉依赖推理上的显著缺陷，具体数据见原文。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_en: This paper addresses the entangled language hallucination and visual illusion in large vision-language models (LVLMs) by introducing HallusionBench, a diagnostic suite. It designs paired vision-language test samples to systematically disentangle and evaluate language hallucination and visual illusion. Compared with existing hallucination benchmarks, HallusionBench offers finer-grained diagnosis and reveals significant deficiencies of current LVLMs in visually grounded reasoning.
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.assessment: 该基准对LVLM幻觉诊断具有重要价值，实验设计严谨，值得多模态研究者关注。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.contribution: 提出HallusionBench诊断套件用于分离评估LVLM的语言幻觉与视觉错觉。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.innovation: 通过成对视觉-语言样本设计实现幻觉与错觉的解耦诊断。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.result: 揭示了当前LVLM在视觉依赖推理上的显著缺陷。

Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）在下游任务适配中需要大量标注或梯度计算的问题，论文提出将语言模型作为黑盒优化器来优化VLM的提示或参数。方法利用LLM的推理能力生成候选提示/配置，并通过黑盒优化策略搜索最优解，无需访问VLM内部梯度。相比已有提示工程方法，该工作在多个VLM任务上取得更优性能，具体提升见原文。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for extensive annotations or gradient computation when adapting vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks by using language models as black-box optimizers. The method leverages LLM reasoning to generate candidate prompts/configurations and employs black-box optimization to search for optimal solutions without accessing VLM gradients. Compared with existing prompt engineering methods, it achieves better performance on several VLM tasks.
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.assessment: 将LLM作为黑盒优化器优化VLM，思路新颖，对多模态提示学习有参考价值。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.contribution: 提出以语言模型作为黑盒优化器来优化VLM的提示或配置。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.innovation: 利用LLM推理能力进行黑盒优化，无需访问VLM梯度。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.result: 在多个VLM任务上取得优于已有提示工程方法的性能。
