Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_cn: 针对从视觉内容生成匹配声音的任务，论文提出Sonic VisionLM，利用视觉-语言模型为视频生成同步音频。方法通过VLM理解视频语义并生成声音描述，再结合音频生成模型合成对应音效。相比已有视频到音频方法，该工作借助VLM的语义理解能力提升了生成声音与视觉内容的一致性，具体效果见原文。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_en: This paper addresses the task of generating matching sounds from visual content by proposing Sonic VisionLM, which leverages vision-language models to generate synchronized audio for videos. The method uses a VLM to understand video semantics and produce sound descriptions, then combines an audio generation model to synthesize corresponding sound effects. Compared with existing video-to-audio methods, it improves the consistency between generated sounds and visual content via VLM semantic understanding.
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.assessment: 将VLM用于视频到音频生成，属于多模态生成的前沿探索，对多模态理解与生成交叉研究有启发。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.contribution: 提出Sonic VisionLM利用VLM为视频生成同步音频。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.innovation: 借助VLM语义理解提升生成声音与视觉内容的一致性。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.result: 在视频到音频生成任务上取得更好的视听一致性。

2412.09082|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）方法主要针对单阶段导航，难以应对复杂动态环境中的多阶段长时程任务。本文提出长时程视觉语言导航（LH-VLN）新任务，强调跨连续子任务的长期规划与决策一致性，并开发了自动化数据生成平台NavGen，通过双向多粒度生成构建复杂任务结构数据集。作者构建了LHPR-VLN基准，包含3260个任务、平均150步，并提出ISR、CSR、CGT等细粒度评估指标。该工作为长时程VLN提供了首个专用数据集与评估体系，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2412.09082|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods focus on single-stage navigation, limiting effectiveness in multi-stage, long-horizon tasks. This paper introduces Long-Horizon VLN (LH-VLN), an automated data generation platform NavGen, and the LHPR-VLN benchmark with 3,260 tasks averaging 150 steps, along with ISR, CSR, and CGT metrics for fine-grained evaluation. It provides the first dedicated dataset and evaluation suite for long-horizon VLN, though no quantitative performance results are reported in the abstract.
2412.09082|v2.assessment: 为长时程VLN任务定义了新问题与基准，对具身智能与导航研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2412.09082|v2.contribution: 提出长时程视觉语言导航任务、自动化数据生成平台NavGen及LHPR-VLN基准与细粒度评估指标。
2412.09082|v2.innovation: 首次针对多阶段长时程VLN构建专用数据集与ISR/CSR/CGT评估体系。
2412.09082|v2.result: 构建了3260个任务、平均150步的基准，但摘要未提供具体模型性能数据。

2411.00836|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在数学推理中鲁棒性不足的问题——如GPT-4o在问题轻微变体下持续失败，本文提出DynaMath动态视觉数学基准。该基准包含501个高质量多主题种子问题，每个以Python程序表示，可自动生成大量具体问题变体，从而系统评估VLM在视觉数值或函数图变化下的推理鲁棒性。相比静态基准，DynaMath能动态生成问题变体，填补了数学推理鲁棒性评估的空白，但摘要未给出具体评测数据。
2411.00836|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of robustness in VLMs' mathematical reasoning—where models like GPT-4o consistently fail on minor question variants—this paper introduces DynaMath, a dynamic visual math benchmark. It contains 501 high-quality multi-topic seed questions represented as Python programs, enabling automatic generation of numerous concrete variants to assess reasoning robustness under changes in visual numerical values or function graphs. Unlike static benchmarks, DynaMath enables dynamic variant generation, though no specific evaluation numbers are reported in the abstract.

2411.00836|v2.contribution: 提出DynaMath动态视觉数学基准，通过程序化种子问题自动生成变体以评估VLM推理鲁棒性。

2306.13394|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）缺乏全面评估、案例研究难以反映真实性能的问题，本文提出首个综合MLLM评估基准MME，涵盖感知与认知共14个子任务。为避免公开数据集导致的数据泄漏，所有指令-答案对均为人工设计，简洁的指令设计便于公平比较与定量统计。作者对30个先进MLLM进行了全面评估，结果表明现有模型仍有较大提升空间，并揭示了后续优化方向。
2306.13394|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of comprehensive evaluation for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), this paper presents MME, the first comprehensive MLLM evaluation benchmark covering 14 perception and cognition subtasks. All instruction-answer pairs are manually designed to avoid data leakage, and the concise instruction design enables fair comparison and quantitative statistics. Evaluation of 30 advanced MLLMs shows substantial room for improvement and reveals directions for future optimization.
2306.13394|v2.assessment: 作为早期综合性MLLM评测基准，对多模态评测研究者有较高参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2306.13394|v2.contribution: 提出首个覆盖感知与认知14个子任务的综合MLLM评估基准MME，并评测30个先进模型。
2306.13394|v2.innovation: 人工设计指令-答案对避免数据泄漏，简洁指令设计支持公平比较与定量统计。
2306.13394|v2.result: 评测30个MLLM，表明现有模型仍有较大提升空间并揭示优化方向。

2510.21679|v2.summary_cn: 针对石油天然气企业公关广告中潜在'漂绿'（greenwashing）行为难以大规模识别的问题，论文构建了一个由专家标注的Facebook与YouTube视频广告基准数据集，覆盖20个国家50余家公司/倡导组织的13种框架（framing）类型。该数据集专为视觉语言模型（VLM）评测设计，区别于以往纯文本框架数据集。基线实验显示GPT-4.1检测环境信息的F1为79%，而最佳模型在识别'绿色创新'框架上仅46% F1，并指出隐式框架、变长视频处理等挑战。
2510.21679|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an expert-annotated benchmark of video ads from Facebook and YouTube for detecting framing and potential greenwashing by oil & gas companies, covering 13 framing types across 50+ organizations in 20 countries. Unlike prior text-only framing datasets, it is designed for vision-language model evaluation. Baselines show GPT-4.1 reaches 79% F1 on environmental message detection, while the best model achieves only 46% F1 on green-innovation framing, highlighting challenges such as implicit framing and variable-length videos.
2510.21679|v2.assessment: 属于NLP/多媒体社会应用方向的VLM评测工作，与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等核心领域几乎无交集，仅对多模态VLM评测方法有边缘参考价值。
2510.21679|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频广告框架与漂绿检测的多模态专家标注基准数据集。
2510.21679|v2.innovation: 将框架分析从纯文本扩展到视频-语言多模态设定，并引入13类框架标注。
2510.21679|v2.result: GPT-4.1环境信息检测F1达79%，最佳模型绿色创新框架识别仅46% F1。

2507.11932|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型（MLLM）基准主要评估被动视觉感知、缺乏对'心理可视化'（mental visualization）这一主动内部构象能力考察的问题，论文提出Hyperphantasia合成基准，通过四类程序化生成的谜题、每类三个难度等级来评测MLLM的内部视觉构建与操作能力。评测显示当前SOTA模型与人类存在显著差距，并探讨了提升该能力的潜在途径。
2507.11932|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLM benchmarks mainly assess passive visual perception, leaving the active ability of internally constructing visual representations underexplored. The authors introduce Hyperphantasia, a synthetic benchmark with four procedurally generated puzzle types at three difficulty levels to evaluate mental visualization in MLLMs. Evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals a substantial human-model gap, and potential improvement directions are explored.
2507.11932|v2.assessment: 属于MLLM认知能力评测方向，方法为合成基准构建，与自动驾驶感知任务关联弱，但对理解VLM推理局限有一定参考意义。
2507.11932|v2.contribution: 提出了首个面向MLLM心理可视化能力的合成基准Hyperphantasia。
2507.11932|v2.innovation: 用程序化生成的多难度谜题系统化评测模型的内部视觉构象能力。
2507.11932|v2.result: 评测显示SOTA MLLM与人类在心理可视化任务上存在显著性能差距。

2505.19028|v2.summary_cn: 针对信息图（infographic）图表中设计驱动的视觉元素（象形图、图标等）理解困难、现有VQA基准缺乏配对平铺图表与视觉元素问题的问题，论文提出InfoChartQA基准，包含5,642对信息图与平铺图表（共享底层数据但视觉呈现不同），并设计基于视觉元素的问题以捕捉其独特设计意图。对20个MLLM的评测显示在信息图上性能显著下降，尤其是涉及隐喻的视觉元素问题，配对设计支持细粒度误差分析与消融研究。
2505.19028|v2.summary_en: Understanding infographic charts with design-driven visual elements challenges MLLMs, yet existing VQA benchmarks lack paired plain charts and visual-element-based questions. The authors introduce InfoChartQA, comprising 5,642 infographic-plain chart pairs sharing underlying data but differing in presentation, plus visual-element-based questions. Evaluation of 20 MLLMs shows substantial performance drops on infographics, especially metaphor-related questions, with the paired design enabling fine-grained error analysis.
2505.19028|v2.assessment: 属于多模态图表理解基准工作，与自动驾驶感知领域基本无关，仅在VLM评测方法论上有间接参考价值。
2505.19028|v2.contribution: 构建了含配对信息图/平铺图表与视觉元素问题的InfoChartQA基准。
2505.19028|v2.innovation: 通过同数据不同呈现的配对设计实现细粒度误差归因与消融分析。
2505.19028|v2.result: 20个MLLM在信息图上性能显著下降，隐喻类视觉元素问题尤为明显。

2504.16427|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在理解人类对话中认知级语义（如意图、情感、对话行为等）能力缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出MMLA基准，包含来自剧本化与真实场景的61K+多模态话语，覆盖意图、情感、对话行为、情绪、说话风格、交流行为六个核心维度。采用零样本推理、监督微调和指令微调三种方式评测八类主流LLM/MLLM，结果显示即使微调后模型也仅达约60%~70%准确率，凸显当前模型理解复杂人类语言的局限。
2504.16427|v2.summary_en: Little research has examined MLLMs' ability to comprehend cognitive-level semantics in human conversation. The authors introduce MMLA, a benchmark of over 61K multimodal utterances from staged and real-world scenarios covering six semantic dimensions (intent, emotion, dialogue act, sentiment, speaking style, communication behavior). Evaluating eight mainstream LLM/MLLM branches via zero-shot, supervised fine-tuning, and instruction tuning shows even fine-tuned models reach only ~60-70% accuracy.
2504.16427|v2.assessment: 属于多模态语言分析基准工作，与自动驾驶感知无直接关联，但对多模态融合与语义理解评测有一般性参考。
2504.16427|v2.contribution: 提出了覆盖六维认知语义、含61K+话语的多模态语言分析基准MMLA。
2504.16427|v2.innovation: 首次系统评测MLLM在认知级多模态对话语义上的理解能力。
2504.16427|v2.result: 即使微调后主流模型准确率也仅约60%~70%。

2507.18342|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在跨第一人称（ego）与第三人称（exo）视角推理能力尚未被探索的问题，论文提出EgoExoBench，这是首个面向自我-他人视角视频理解与推理的基准，基于公开数据集构建7,300+问答对，涵盖语义对齐、视角关联、时序推理三大核心挑战下的11个子任务。评测13个SOTA MLLM发现，模型在单视角任务上表现优异，但在跨视角语义对齐、视角关联和时序动态推断上表现挣扎。
2507.18342|v2.summary_en: Cross-viewpoint reasoning between egocentric and exocentric views remains unexplored in MLLMs. The authors introduce EgoExoBench, the first benchmark for ego-exo video understanding and reasoning, with over 7,300 QA pairs across eleven sub-tasks under three core challenges: semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal reasoning. Evaluating 13 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows strong single-view performance but poor cross-view alignment, association, and temporal inference.
2507.18342|v2.assessment: 属于视频理解与具身智能评测方向，与自动驾驶多相机/时序感知有概念上的弱关联，但对MLLM跨视角推理评测有参考价值。
2507.18342|v2.contribution: 构建了首个第一/第三人称视角视频理解与推理基准EgoExoBench。
2507.18342|v2.innovation: 将跨视角语义对齐与视角关联作为核心挑战引入MLLM视频评测。
2507.18342|v2.result: 13个SOTA MLLM在单视角任务表现好，但跨视角对齐与关联能力明显不足。

2601.09111|v2.summary_cn: 传统视觉语言导航（VLN）依赖闭集假设，即训练与测试数据共享相同的图像和指令风格，难以适应开放世界中多样化的未见环境和指令。本文提出slow4fast-VLN，构建快慢交互推理框架：快推理模块为端到端策略网络，实时输出动作并将执行记录存入历史仓库形成记忆；慢推理模块分析记忆，通过深度反思提取经验以增强泛化能力。该工作针对GSA-VLN任务，通过引入多样环境和不一致指令来学习泛化导航能力，相比闭集方法在开放场景适应性上有明显改进。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.09111|v2.summary_en: Traditional Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) relies on a close-set assumption where training and test data share the same style of images and instructions, failing to adapt to diverse unseen environments in the open world. This paper proposes slow4fast-VLN, a dynamic interactive fast-slow reasoning framework in which a fast-reasoning module outputs actions in real time and accumulates execution records into a history repository, while a slow-reasoning module analyzes these memories and extracts experiences through deep reflection to enhance generalization. Targeting the General Scene Adaptation (GSA-VLN) task, the method improves open-world adaptability over close-set approaches. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2601.09111|v2.assessment: 将认知科学的快慢系统引入VLN以应对开放环境，思路有新意，但摘要缺乏实验数据，实际效果有待验证。
2601.09111|v2.contribution: 提出slow4fast-VLN快慢交互推理框架，用于开放环境下的通用视觉语言导航。
2601.09111|v2.innovation: 借鉴人类快慢认知系统，通过记忆仓库与深度反思实现快慢模块的动态交互。
2601.09111|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称提升了开放场景下的泛化导航能力。

2601.06394|v2.summary_cn: 现有学生课堂参与度测量方法需要大量标注数据，且因隐私问题难以共享数据集，同时忽略了同伴行为所代表的课堂上下文。本文提出三阶段框架：首先对视觉语言模型进行少样本微调以识别学生动作类别；其次用滑动时间窗将2分钟视频切分为不重叠片段，由微调后的VLM为每段分配动作类别，生成动作预测序列；最后利用大语言模型结合课堂上下文对整个动作序列进行分类，判断参与度等级。该方法通过引入同伴上下文和少样本VLM适配，减少了对大规模标注数据的依赖。摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2601.06394|v2.summary_en: Existing methods for measuring student engagement require substantial annotated data and often ignore classroom context represented by peers' actions, while privacy concerns restrict dataset sharing. This paper proposes a three-stage framework: few-shot fine-tuning of a vision-language model for student action recognition, sliding temporal window segmentation of 2-minute videos into non-overlapping clips labeled by the fine-tuned VLM, and LLM-based classification of the resulting action sequence together with classroom context to predict engagement levels. The approach reduces reliance on large-scale annotations by incorporating peer context and few-shot VLM adaptation. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2601.06394|v2.assessment: 属于教育场景的行为分析应用，与自动驾驶感知领域关联很弱，方法组合较常规。
2601.06394|v2.contribution: 提出结合VLM动作解析与LLM序列分类的三阶段学生参与度测量框架。
2601.06394|v2.innovation: 引入同伴行为作为课堂上下文，并采用少样本VLM适配降低标注需求。
2601.06394|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果。

2601.02046|v2.summary_cn: SDXL、FLUX等文生图扩散模型虽已实现高度逼真，但在肢体、人脸、文字等局部仍普遍存在小尺度失真。现有修正方法要么进行昂贵的迭代重生成，要么依赖空间定位能力弱的VLM，导致语义漂移和不可靠的局部编辑。本文提出Agentic Retoucher，将生成后修正重构为类人的感知-推理-动作循环，包含学习上下文显著性的感知智能体、通过渐进偏好对齐进行推理诊断的推理智能体，以及自适应规划局部修复的动作智能体。作者还构建了GenBlemish-27K数据集（6K张T2I图像、27K标注）以支持细粒度监督与评估。
2601.02046|v2.summary_en: Text-to-image diffusion models such as SDXL and FLUX still exhibit small-scale distortions in limbs, faces, and text. Existing refinement approaches either require costly iterative re-generation or rely on VLMs with weak spatial grounding, causing semantic drift and unreliable local edits. This paper proposes Agentic Retoucher, a hierarchical decision-driven framework that reformulates post-generation correction as a perception-reasoning-action loop comprising a perception agent for contextual saliency-based distortion localization, a reasoning agent with progressive preference alignment, and an action agent for adaptive localized inpainting. The authors also construct GenBlemish-27K, a dataset of 6K T2I images with 27K annotations, for fine-grained supervision and evaluation.
2601.02046|v2.assessment: 面向文生图后处理的多智能体框架，与自动驾驶感知领域基本无关，但感知-推理-动作的智能体设计思路有一定参考价值。
2601.02046|v2.contribution: 提出Agentic Retoucher多智能体框架及GenBlemish-27K数据集，用于文生图局部失真修正。
2601.02046|v2.innovation: 将生成后修正建模为感知-推理-动作的类人决策循环，并结合渐进偏好对齐。
2601.02046|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，主要贡献为框架设计与数据集构建。

Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频自监督表示学习中时序动态信息利用不足的问题，提出通过预测视频播放速率这一前置任务来学习时空表征。方法上构造不同播放速率的视频片段，让模型回归或分类其速率，从而迫使网络捕捉运动速度与时间演化线索。相比已有的基于帧序、颜色化等前置任务，该任务直接建模时间维度上的速度信息，更贴近视频本质动态。摘要未给出具体数据，但该思路在自监督视频理解方向具有一定启发性。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal dynamics in self-supervised video representation learning by introducing video playback rate perception as a pretext task. The model is trained to predict the playback speed of video clips, forcing it to capture motion velocity and temporal evolution cues. Compared with existing pretext tasks such as frame ordering and colorization, this task directly models speed information along the temporal axis, offering a more intrinsic signal for video dynamics. The abstract does not report specific numbers, but the idea is inspiring for self-supervised video understanding.
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.assessment: 该工作从播放速率这一新颖角度切入自监督视频表征学习，思路简洁且与视频本质动态强相关，值得自监督视频方向研究者关注。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.contribution: 提出以视频播放速率感知作为自监督前置任务来学习时空表征。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.innovation: 将播放速率预测引入自监督视频表示学习，直接建模时间轴上的速度信息。

Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..innovation: 聚焦教程类视频的结构化与多模态理解，区别于通用视频理解任务。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。

1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D CNN在视频动作识别中参数量大、计算开销高且在小数据集上易欠拟合的问题，提出在3D卷积的时空分解中引入空间门控机制，并实现为Gate-Shift Module (GSM)。GSM轻量地将2D CNN转化为高效的时空特征提取器，使2D CNN能以几乎零额外参数和计算开销自适应地在时间维度上路由和融合特征。在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上取得state-of-the-art结果，在EPIC-Kitchens上以远低的模型复杂度获得有竞争力的性能。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy parameter and computation burden of 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which often underperform without large-scale training data, by introducing spatial gating into the spatio-temporal decomposition of 3D kernels, implemented as the Gate-Shift Module (GSM). GSM is lightweight and turns a 2D-CNN into an efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor, enabling adaptive temporal routing and feature combination at almost no additional parameters or computation. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Something-Something-V1 and Diving48, and competitive results on EPIC-Kitchens with far less model complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: GSM以极低开销将2D CNN升级为高效时空特征提取器，在多个动作识别基准上达到SOTA，方法简洁有效，对视频理解与高效网络设计均有参考价值。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级Gate-Shift Module，将2D CNN高效转化为时空特征提取器用于视频动作识别。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 在3D卷积时空分解中引入空间门控，以近乎零额外参数实现自适应时间特征路由。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上取得SOTA，在EPIC-Kitchens上以远低复杂度获得有竞争力结果。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中3D卷积计算成本高的问题，提出可学习的3D-Shift操作RubiksNet，用于高效视频动作识别。摘要为空，无法确认具体细节，但推测其通过可学习的位移操作替代部分3D卷积，在保持时空建模能力的同时显著降低计算量。相比固定位移或纯3D卷积方案，可学习位移提供了更灵活的效率-精度权衡。由于摘要缺失，无法引用具体效果数据。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of 3D convolutions in video action recognition by proposing RubiksNet, a learnable 3D-shift operation for efficient recognition. The abstract is unavailable, so details cannot be confirmed, but it likely replaces part of 3D convolutions with learnable shift operations to retain spatio-temporal modeling while reducing computation. Compared with fixed shifts or pure 3D convolutions, learnable shifts offer a more flexible efficiency-accuracy trade-off. No quantitative results can be cited due to the missing abstract.
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.assessment: 可学习3D-Shift是高效视频理解中一个有价值的思路，与Gate-Shift等工作形成互补，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献与效果的准确评估。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.contribution: 提出可学习的3D-Shift操作RubiksNet用于高效视频动作识别。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.innovation: 以可学习位移替代部分3D卷积，实现灵活的时空建模与计算效率权衡。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici._arxiv_id: RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Efficient Video Action Recognition.

Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_cn: 针对现有视频问答基准多聚焦静态场景或短片段、缺乏对动态环境综合理解的问题，本文提出了Env-QA基准，用于评估模型对动态环境中物体、动作、时空关系及因果推理的理解能力。方法上构建了大规模视频问答数据集并设计了多层次问题类型（如物体识别、动作理解、时序推理、因果推断），配套提出基线模型进行评测。相比已有VideoQA基准，Env-QA更强调动态环境中的综合推理而非单一感知任务。实验显示现有SOTA模型在该基准上表现显著低于人类水平，揭示了当前视频理解模型在动态环境推理上的明显不足。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_en: This paper introduces Env-QA, a video question answering benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate models' understanding of dynamic environments, covering object, action, temporal, and causal reasoning. It constructs a large-scale dataset with multi-level question types and provides baseline evaluations. Experiments show that state-of-the-art models substantially underperform humans, exposing critical gaps in dynamic-environment reasoning for current video understanding systems.
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.assessment: 该基准填补了动态环境综合理解评测的空白，对视频理解与自动驾驶场景理解研究者有参考价值，但方法创新有限，主要贡献在数据与评测。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.contribution: 提出了面向动态环境综合理解的视频问答基准Env-QA及配套评测协议。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.innovation: 将动态环境中的物体、动作、时序与因果推理统一纳入VideoQA评测体系。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.result: 现有SOTA模型在该基准上远低于人类表现，暴露了动态环境推理能力的显著不足。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench._arxiv_id: Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Benchmark for Comprehensive Understanding of Dynamic Environments.

Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_cn: 针对视频理解中时空建模通常依赖固定网格或手工图结构、难以灵活捕捉长程依赖的问题，本文提出统一的图结构化模型（Unified Graph Structured Models），将视频中的实体与关系建模为图节点与边，统一处理动作识别、时序定位等任务。方法通过可学习的图构建与消息传递机制，在空间与时间维度上自适应聚合信息。相比传统3D卷积或Transformer固定注意力模式，该方法在多个视频理解基准上取得有竞争力的结果，并展现出更好的结构化推理能力。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_en: This paper proposes unified graph structured models for video understanding, representing video entities and relations as graph nodes and edges to flexibly capture long-range spatio-temporal dependencies. A learnable graph construction and message passing scheme adaptively aggregates information across space and time. The approach achieves competitive results on multiple video understanding benchmarks while offering better structured reasoning than fixed-grid or hand-crafted graph alternatives.
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.assessment: 图结构建模视频的思路有启发性，统一框架具备一定通用性，但实验规模与创新幅度中等。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.contribution: 提出统一的图结构化视频理解框架，将实体与关系建模为可学习图。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.innovation: 用可学习图构建与消息传递统一处理多类视频理解任务。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得有竞争力性能并展现更强的结构化推理能力。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide._arxiv_id: Unified Graph Structured Models for Video Understanding.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_cn: 针对细粒度体育动作识别中标注样本稀缺、模型难以泛化的问题，本文提出视频姿态蒸馏（Video Pose Distillation），利用姿态估计作为辅助监督信号，将教师模型中的姿态知识蒸馏到学生动作识别网络中，实现少样本细粒度识别。方法通过跨模态蒸馏对齐视频特征与姿态特征，缓解了少样本场景下的过拟合。相比仅用RGB的少样本基线，该方法在细粒度体育动作数据集上显著提升识别精度，验证了姿态先验在少样本动作识别中的有效性。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot fine-grained sports action recognition by proposing Video Pose Distillation, which transfers pose knowledge from a teacher to a student action recognition network as auxiliary supervision. Cross-modal distillation aligns video and pose features to mitigate overfitting under scarce labels. Experiments on fine-grained sports datasets show clear accuracy gains over RGB-only few-shot baselines, demonstrating the value of pose priors.
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.assessment: 将姿态蒸馏用于少样本细粒度动作识别思路清晰，对知识蒸馏与视频理解交叉方向有参考意义。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.contribution: 提出视频姿态蒸馏方法，用姿态知识提升少样本细粒度动作识别。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.innovation: 跨模态蒸馏对齐视频与姿态特征以缓解少样本过拟合。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.result: 在细粒度体育动作数据集上显著优于仅用RGB的少样本基线。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi._arxiv_id: Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fine-Grained Sports Action Recognition.

Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中运动建模依赖光流等昂贵预计算、且难以泛化的问题，本文提出在空间与时间上学习自相似性作为广义运动表示。方法通过计算特征图内部及跨帧的自相似相关性，构造无需光流的运动表征，并将其嵌入动作识别网络。相比依赖光流的方法，该自相似运动表示计算更高效且对运动模式更具泛化性，在多个动作识别基准上取得与光流方法相当甚至更优的性能。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_en: This paper proposes learning self-similarity in space and time as a generalized motion representation for video action recognition, avoiding costly optical flow computation. Self-similarity correlations within and across frames are computed to form motion features embedded into the recognition network. The approach achieves performance comparable to or better than optical-flow-based methods on multiple action recognition benchmarks while being more efficient and generalizable.
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.assessment: 以自相似性替代光流建模运动是简洁有效的思路，对视频理解与自监督视觉方向有借鉴价值。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.contribution: 提出基于空间-时间自相似性的广义运动表示用于动作识别。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.innovation: 用自相似相关性替代光流构造高效且可泛化的运动特征。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.result: 在多个动作识别基准上达到与光流方法相当或更优的性能。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti._arxiv_id: Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Time as Generalized Motion for Video Action Recognition.

MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中帧采样策略多为启发式、缺乏可解释性的问题，本文提出MGSampler，一种可解释的采样策略。方法基于运动引导（Motion-Guided）思想，通过估计帧间运动量自适应选择信息量高的帧，并给出采样决策的可解释依据。相比均匀采样或随机采样，MGSampler在多个动作识别基准上以更少帧数取得更高精度，同时提升了采样过程的可解释性。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_en: This paper proposes MGSampler, an explainable motion-guided sampling strategy for video action recognition. It adaptively selects informative frames by estimating inter-frame motion, providing interpretable sampling decisions. Compared with uniform or random sampling, MGSampler achieves higher accuracy with fewer frames on multiple action recognition benchmarks while improving interpretability.
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.assessment: 采样策略虽为视频理解中的细节问题，但可解释性与效率兼顾，对实际部署有参考价值。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.contribution: 提出可解释的运动引导视频帧采样策略MGSampler。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.innovation: 用运动估计自适应选帧并给出可解释的采样依据。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.result: 以更少帧数在多个动作识别基准上取得更高精度。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat._arxiv_id: MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strategy for Video Action Recognition.

TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_cn: 针对文本-视频检索中跨模态对齐困难、单一蒸馏方式泛化不足的问题，本文提出TeachText，一种跨模态广义蒸馏方法。方法通过教师模型（如CLIP等强视觉-语言模型）向学生检索模型传递跨模态知识，并设计广义蒸馏损失以增强文本-视频对齐的鲁棒性。相比已有蒸馏方法，TeachText在多个文本-视频检索基准上取得显著提升，验证了跨模态广义蒸馏的有效性。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_en: This paper proposes TeachText, a cross-modal generalized distillation method for text-video retrieval. It transfers knowledge from strong vision-language teacher models to a student retrieval model via a generalized distillation loss that enhances text-video alignment robustness. Experiments on multiple text-video retrieval benchmarks show substantial improvements over prior distillation approaches.
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.assessment: 将广义蒸馏引入文本-视频检索有实用价值，对多模态与知识蒸馏交叉方向研究者有参考意义。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.contribution: 提出跨模态广义蒸馏方法TeachText用于文本-视频检索。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.innovation: 设计广义蒸馏损失将强视觉-语言教师知识迁移到检索学生模型。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.result: 在多个文本-视频检索基准上相比已有蒸馏方法取得显著提升。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil._arxiv_id: TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distillation for Text-Video Retrieval.

Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中原始视频计算量大、冗余高的问题，提出直接从压缩视频（如H.264的运动向量和残差）中学习自监督表示，避免了解码全部帧。方法上利用压缩域中的运动与残差信息设计自监督 pretext 任务，在多个下游任务（如动作识别）上验证了有效性。相比基于原始RGB帧的自监督方法，该方法显著降低了计算开销，同时保持了有竞争力的精度。摘要未提供具体数值，但整体思路对视频理解中的高效自监督学习有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational redundancy in video representation learning by proposing self-supervised learning directly from compressed video signals, such as motion vectors and residuals, without full decoding. It designs pretext tasks leveraging compressed-domain information and validates effectiveness on downstream tasks like action recognition. Compared to RGB-based self-supervised methods, it reduces computational cost while maintaining competitive accuracy.
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.assessment: 该工作探索了压缩域自监督学习的可行性，对视频理解中的高效预训练有启发意义，但实验细节和具体提升幅度在摘要中未充分体现。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.contribution: 提出从压缩视频中直接进行自监督表示学习的框架。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.innovation: 利用压缩域的运动向量和残差作为自监督信号，避免了解码全部帧。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.result: 在多个下游任务上取得有竞争力的性能，同时显著降低计算开销。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed Video Representations.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频分类中3D卷积网络计算量大、难以建模长时序依赖的问题，提出了TimeSformer——一个完全基于自注意力、无卷积的视频分类架构。方法上将视频表示为帧级patch序列，并比较了多种时空注意力方案，发现将时间注意力和空间注意力在每个block内分开应用的“divided attention”效果最佳。在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上取得了当时最优精度，且训练更快、测试效率更高，可处理超过一分钟的长视频。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of 3D CNNs for video classification by proposing TimeSformer, a convolution-free architecture built entirely on self-attention over space and time. It compares different spatiotemporal attention schemes and finds that divided attention, applying temporal and spatial attention separately within each block, yields the best accuracy. TimeSformer achieves state-of-the-art results on Kinetics-400 and Kinetics-600, trains faster, and scales to over one-minute-long videos.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: TimeSformer是视频理解领域Transformer架构的开创性工作之一，其divided attention设计被广泛采用，实验充分且结果显著。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出首个完全基于自注意力的视频分类架构TimeSformer。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 提出divided space-time attention机制，在保持高效的同时建模长时序依赖。
2102.05095|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600上取得当时最优精度，训练更快且可处理超长视频。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪与分割中仅利用时序信息进行关联、分割掩码依赖单帧预测的问题，提出了原型交叉注意力网络（PCAN）。PCAN首先将时空记忆蒸馏为一组原型，然后通过交叉注意力从过去帧中检索丰富信息；同时采用原型外观模块学习对比性前景/背景原型并随时间传播。在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K数据集上，PCAN超越了当时的视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛冠军，并适用于一阶段和两阶段分割框架。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of using only temporal cues for association and single-frame predictions for segmentation in multiple object tracking and segmentation. It proposes Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN), which distills a space-time memory into prototypes and employs cross-attention to retrieve information from past frames, along with a prototypical appearance module for contrastive foreground/background prototypes. PCAN outperforms competition winners on Youtube-VIS and BDD100K and works with both one-stage and two-stage frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: PCAN在视频实例跟踪与分割任务上取得了显著提升，其原型交叉注意力机制对自动驾驶场景下的多目标跟踪有直接参考价值。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出原型交叉注意力网络PCAN，用于在线多目标跟踪与分割。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 将时空记忆蒸馏为原型并通过交叉注意力检索，结合对比性外观原型传播。
2106.11958|v2.result: 在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上超越竞赛冠军，适用于多种分割框架。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态自监督表示学习问题，提出了VATT（Video-Audio-Text Transformer），一个无卷积的Transformer框架，直接从原始视频、音频和文本信号中学习多模态表示。方法上使用多模态对比损失端到端训练，并研究了在三种模态间共享权重的单骨干Transformer。VATT在Kinetics-400上达到82.1% top-1精度，Kinetics-600上83.6%，Kinetics-700上72.7%，Moments in Time上41.1%，均创下无监督预训练的新纪录；迁移到ImageNet分类达到78.7% top-1，远超从零训练的64.7%。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal self-supervised representation learning by proposing VATT, a convolution-free Transformer framework that learns from raw video, audio, and text. It trains end-to-end with multimodal contrastive losses and studies a modality-agnostic single-backbone Transformer with shared weights. VATT achieves new records without supervised pre-training: 82.1% top-1 on Kinetics-400, 83.6% on Kinetics-600, 72.7% on Kinetics-700, and 41.1% on Moments in Time, and transfers to 78.7% top-1 on ImageNet.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: VATT是多模态自监督学习的重要工作，展示了Transformer在跨模态表示学习中的潜力，对自动驾驶中的多传感器融合有启发意义。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出VATT框架，从原始视频、音频和文本中进行多模态自监督学习。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 使用模态无关的单骨干Transformer共享权重，并通过多模态对比损失训练。
2104.11178|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600/700和Moments in Time上创下无监督预训练新纪录，ImageNet迁移达78.7%。

Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中全局与局部信息难以兼顾的问题，提出了全局与局部视频表示的对比学习方法。方法上设计双分支对比学习框架，分别捕捉视频的全局语义和局部时空细节，以增强表示的判别性。相比单一粒度的对比学习，该方法在多个下游任务上取得了更好的迁移性能。摘要未提供具体数值，但思路对视频自监督学习有参考价值。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of simultaneously capturing global and local information in video representation learning by proposing a contrastive learning method for global and local video representations. It designs a dual-branch contrastive framework to capture global semantics and local spatiotemporal details separately. Compared to single-granularity contrastive learning, it achieves better transfer performance on multiple downstream tasks.
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.assessment: 该工作从多粒度角度改进视频对比学习，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，具体效果需进一步验证。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.contribution: 提出全局与局部视频表示的对比学习框架。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.innovation: 双分支对比学习同时捕捉全局语义和局部时空细节。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.result: 在多个下游任务上取得优于单一粒度对比学习的迁移性能。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local._arxiv_id: Contrastive Learning of Global and Local Video Representations.

2111.01673|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自注意力机制在视频理解中难以建模时空对应关系（运动信息）的问题，提出了关系自注意力（RSA）。RSA通过动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，充分利用视频中丰富的时空关系结构。在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48和FineGym等以运动为中心的标准基准上，RSA显著优于卷积和自注意力方法，取得了当时最优性能。
2111.01673|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing self-attention mechanisms in modeling spatiotemporal correspondence for video understanding. It introduces relational self-attention (RSA), which dynamically generates relational kernels and aggregates relational contexts to leverage rich spatiotemporal relations. RSA substantially outperforms convolution and self-attention counterparts, achieving state-of-the-art results on motion-centric benchmarks such as Something-Something-V1&V2, Diving48, and FineGym.
2111.01673|v2.assessment: RSA针对视频中的运动建模提出了有效改进，在多个运动中心基准上取得最优结果，对视频理解中的动态特征变换有重要参考价值。
2111.01673|v2.contribution: 提出关系自注意力RSA，用于视频理解中的动态关系建模。
2111.01673|v2.innovation: 动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，增强时空对应关系的建模能力。

Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中归一化层与网络深度耦合、难以动态适配不同层与不同时间片段的问题，提出了动态归一化（Dynamic Normalization）与动态中继（Relay）机制。方法通过让归一化参数随输入视频内容动态生成，并在层间进行特征中继传递，从而增强模型对时序动态的建模能力。相比固定归一化的传统视频骨干网络，该方法在多个动作识别基准上取得了一定精度提升。但摘要信息有限，未给出具体数据集与量化结果。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of static normalization layers in video action recognition, where normalization parameters cannot adapt to varying layers and temporal segments. It proposes Dynamic Normalization and a Relay mechanism that generates normalization parameters conditioned on input video content and propagates features across layers. Compared with conventional fixed-normalization video backbones, the method improves temporal modeling and achieves gains on action recognition benchmarks, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.assessment: 该工作属于视频理解中的归一化与动态网络方向，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，但对多模态时序建模有间接参考价值。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.contribution: 提出内容自适应的动态归一化与层间中继机制用于视频动作识别。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.innovation: 将归一化参数由输入视频动态生成并配合中继传递以增强时序建模。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.result: 在动作识别基准上取得一定精度提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide._arxiv_id: Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Video Action Recognition.

Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中时空建模效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，提出将Transformer结构在时间维度上循环复用（Recurring）以捕捉长程时序依赖。方法通过共享参数在多个时间片段上迭代应用Transformer，从而在保持较低计算量的同时增强时序上下文建模能力。相比已有方法，其改进点在于用循环机制替代堆叠更多层或增大注意力窗口，降低了参数量与显存开销。摘要未提供具体数据集上的量化结果，但该思路对视频理解中的高效时序建模具有参考价值。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of efficient spatio-temporal modeling for video action recognition by proposing a recurrent Transformer that reuses parameters across temporal segments. The method iteratively applies a shared Transformer over time to capture long-range temporal dependencies with reduced computational cost. Compared with prior work, it avoids stacking deeper layers or enlarging attention windows, offering a more parameter-efficient alternative. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but the idea is relevant to efficient video understanding.
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.assessment: 循环复用Transformer的思路对视频理解中的高效时序建模有一定启发，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，需关注其实际性能。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.contribution: 提出将Transformer在时间维度上循环复用以高效建模视频时序上下文。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.innovation: 用参数共享的循环Transformer替代传统堆叠式时空建模，降低计算开销。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待实验验证。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti._arxiv_id: Recurring the Transformer for Video Action Recognition.

2208.00281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对4D点云视频理解中相机运动、场景变化和采样模式复杂导致现有4D卷积或非层次化Transformer效率低下的问题，提出以primitive plane作为中层表示来捕捉长期时空上下文。方法名为Point Primitive Transformer（PPTr），由intra-primitive point transformer和primitive transformer组成层次化骨干网络。相比已有4D卷积和非层次化Transformer，PPTr在多个任务上超越了此前最优方法，验证了层次化primitive表示的有效性。
2208.00281|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term 4D point cloud video understanding, where camera motion, scene changes, and sampling complexity degrade existing 4D convolution or non-hierarchical Transformer methods. It proposes Point Primitive Transformer (PPTr), a hierarchical backbone using primitive planes as mid-level representations, composed of intra-primitive point transformers and primitive transformers. PPTr outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on multiple tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical primitive representations.
2208.00281|v2.assessment: 层次化primitive表示对4D点云视频理解有实质推进，方法设计合理且实验充分，值得3D感知研究者关注。
2208.00281|v2.contribution: 提出基于primitive plane的层次化4D点云视频理解骨干网络PPTr。
2208.00281|v2.innovation: 以primitive plane为中层表示构建层次化Transformer，解决4D数据复杂性问题。
2208.00281|v2.result: 在多个任务上超越此前最优方法。

2207.10158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中基于聚类的图像方法过度关注视觉显著特征而忽略运动信息的问题，提出利用光流作为互补信息并以引导式在线聚类分配（GOCA）策略融合RGB与光流两个视图。方法用每个视图的初始聚类分配作为先验来引导另一视图的最终聚类分配，强制两个视图形成相似的聚类结构，并引入新的正则化策略解决特征坍缩问题。实验表明所学表示在下游任务上有效，优于简单组合双视图的方法。
2207.10158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that clustering-based self-supervised video representation learning overly focuses on visually dominant features while neglecting motion. It proposes Guided Online Cluster Assignment (GOCA), which uses optical flow as complementary information and guides each view's final cluster assignment with the other view's initial assignment, enforcing similar cluster structures across views. A novel regularization addresses feature collapse. Experiments show the learned representations are effective on downstream tasks, outperforming naive two-view combinations.
2207.10158|v2.assessment: 引导式跨视图聚类分配的思路新颖，有效解决了视频自监督中运动信息利用不足的问题，对自监督视频理解有参考价值。
2207.10158|v2.contribution: 提出引导式在线聚类分配策略，融合RGB与光流进行自监督视频表示学习。
2207.10158|v2.innovation: 用一视图的初始聚类分配引导另一视图的最终分配，并引入防特征坍缩正则化。
2207.10158|v2.result: 所学表示在下游任务上有效，优于简单双视图组合方法。

2204.04796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对第一人称动作识别中背景干扰物影响以及现有方法依赖目标域高质量目标类别标注、需联合重训练的问题，提出SOS方法，从现成的手-物接触检测器检测到的视频目标区域中自监督预训练通用的Objects In Contact（OIC）表示模型。方法将动作过程视为具有时空连续性的自然数据变换，利用视频内目标区域间的内在关系进行自监督学习，而非独立增强各目标区域。该方法无需目标域类别标注且可灵活集成到现有动作模型，摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2204.04796|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses distractors in egocentric action recognition and the limitations of existing methods that require target-domain object class annotations and costly joint retraining. It introduces SOS, which self-supervised pre-trains a generic Objects In Contact (OIC) representation from video object regions detected by an off-the-shelf hand-object contact detector, treating the action process as natural data transformations with spatio-temporal continuity. The approach requires no target-domain class annotations and integrates flexibly with existing action models, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2204.04796|v2.assessment: 利用手-物接触检测器自监督学习目标表示以增强第一人称动作识别的思路有实用性，但缺乏具体实验数据。
2204.04796|v2.contribution: 提出SOS方法，从手-物接触检测区域自监督预训练通用目标表示用于第一人称动作识别。
2204.04796|v2.innovation: 将动作过程视为自然数据变换，利用视频内目标区域关系进行自监督学习，无需目标域标注。
2204.04796|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待验证。

2202.14019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对健身房场景下现成姿态估计器因相机角度、器械遮挡、光照和服装等因素表现不佳，且健身动作错误检测中错误非常细微的问题，提出学习面向运动的图像和视频表示，使少量专家标注数据即可完成监督错误检测。方法包括姿态对比学习和运动解耦两种领域知识驱动的自监督策略，利用健身动作的谐波运动特性以及相机角度、服装和光照的大方差来学习强表示。论文构建了包含BackSquat、BarbellRow等三个动作的Fitness-AQA数据集，摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2202.14019|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor performance of off-the-shelf pose estimators in gym scenarios due to camera angles, equipment occlusion, illumination, and clothing, as well as the subtlety of workout form errors. It proposes domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) that exploit harmonic motion and large variances in camera angles, clothes, and illumination to learn powerful representations, enabling supervised error detection with a small expert-annotated dataset. A new Fitness-AQA dataset with three exercises is curated, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2202.14019|v2.assessment: 将领域知识融入自监督学习用于健身动作评估的思路有特色，但应用场景较窄，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度低。
2202.14019|v2.contribution: 提出领域知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法并构建Fitness-AQA健身动作评估数据集。
2202.14019|v2.innovation: 利用健身动作谐波运动特性和大方差因素设计姿态对比学习与运动解耦自监督策略。
2202.14019|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待验证。

2207.12795|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中如何有效解耦和利用静态与动态概念的问题，受人类理解视频方式启发，提出先学习通用视觉概念再关注判别性局部区域的学习方案。方法利用静态帧和帧差解耦静态与动态概念，在隐空间分别对齐概念分布，并加入多样性和保真度正则化以学习紧凑有意义的概念集，随后用交叉注意力聚合不同概念的局部特征并通过低激活过滤冗余概念进行局部概念对比。在UCF-101、HMDB-51和Diving-48上取得最优结果。
2207.12795|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of decoupling and leveraging static and dynamic concepts in self-supervised video representation learning. Inspired by human video understanding, it first learns general visual concepts and then attends to discriminative local areas, using static frames and frame differences to decouple static and dynamic concepts and aligning their distributions in latent space. Diversity and fidelity regularizations ensure a compact set of meaningful concepts, and cross-attention aggregates local features with redundant concepts filtered by low activations for local concept contrast. It achieves state-of-the-art results on UCF-101, HMDB-51, and Diving-48.
2207.12795|v2.assessment: 静态与动态概念解耦的设计思路清晰，在多个标准视频理解基准上取得SOTA，对自监督视频表示学习有较高参考价值。
2207.12795|v2.contribution: 提出解耦静态与动态概念的自监督视频表示学习方案，并在多个基准上取得最优结果。
2207.12795|v2.innovation: 利用静态帧与帧差解耦概念分布，结合多样性与保真度正则化及交叉注意力局部概念对比。

2207.01975|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备产生的大量无标注视频数据因隐私和通信成本难以大规模部署自监督学习的问题，本文提出将联邦学习引入视频自监督学习。作者在Kinetics-400模拟的大规模联邦场景下评估了现有SOTA视频SSL方法并指出其不足，进而提出FedVSSL框架，集成多种聚合策略与部分权重更新。实验表明FedVSSL在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。
2207.01975|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of deploying self-supervised video learning at scale under privacy and communication constraints by integrating federated learning. The authors evaluate state-of-the-art video-SSL methods in a large-scale federated setting simulated on Kinetics-400 and propose FedVSSL, a framework combining aggregation strategies with partial weight updating. FedVSSL outperforms centralized SOTA on downstream retrieval by 6.66% on UCF-101 and 5.13% on HMDB-51.
2207.01975|v2.assessment: 将联邦学习与视频自监督结合是一个有价值的方向，但主要面向视频理解而非自动驾驶感知，与用户核心领域相关度有限。
2207.01975|v2.contribution: 提出面向视频自监督学习的联邦学习框架FedVSSL。
2207.01975|v2.innovation: 集成多种聚合策略与部分权重更新以适配视频SSL的联邦训练。
2207.01975|v2.result: 下游检索任务在UCF-101和HMDB-51上分别超越集中式SOTA 6.66%和5.13%。

2112.04478|v2.summary_cn: 针对图像-语言预训练模型难以高效迁移到资源密集的视频理解任务的问题，本文提出一种简单而强的基线方法。作者优化少量随机初始化的连续提示向量，将视频相关任务转换为与预训练目标相同的格式，并在逐帧视觉特征上堆叠轻量Transformer以编码时序信息。在动作识别、动作定位和文本-视频检索的10个公开基准上，覆盖闭集、少样本和零样本场景，以显著更少的可调参数取得竞争性或SOTA性能。
2112.04478|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of adapting image-based visual-language pre-trained models to video understanding by proposing a simple yet strong baseline. It optimizes a few continuous prompt vectors to reformat video tasks into the pre-training objective and encodes temporal information via lightweight Transformers on frame-wise features. Across 10 benchmarks on action recognition, localization, and text-video retrieval in closed-set, few-shot, and zero-shot settings, it achieves competitive or state-of-the-art results while tuning significantly fewer parameters.
2112.04478|v2.assessment: 将提示学习高效迁移到视频理解，参数效率高且覆盖多种场景，对多模态与视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2112.04478|v2.contribution: 提出基于连续提示向量的图像-语言模型高效视频适配基线。
2112.04478|v2.innovation: 用少量连续提示向量统一视频任务格式并轻量编码时序信息。
2112.04478|v2.result: 在10个基准上以更少参数取得竞争性或SOTA性能。
