Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习（CL）中异构任务序列带来的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了一种异构持续学习框架。方法上通过解耦特征提取器与分类器，并引入任务特定的子网络或适配模块来缓解不同任务分布间的干扰。相比传统CL方法假设任务同质，该工作显式建模任务异构性，在多个异构基准上取得了更优的稳定性-可塑性权衡。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning (CL) when task sequences are heterogeneous. It proposes a framework that decouples feature extractors and classifiers with task-specific sub-networks or adapters to mitigate interference across heterogeneous distributions. Compared to conventional CL methods assuming homogeneous tasks, it explicitly models heterogeneity and achieves better stability-plasticity trade-offs on multiple benchmarks.
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 该工作关注持续学习中的异构性问题，思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验规模与对比公平性。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出面向异构任务序列的持续学习框架，解耦特征与分类器以缓解任务间干扰。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 显式建模任务异构性，并设计任务特定适配模块来平衡稳定性与可塑性。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个异构持续学习基准上取得优于传统CL方法的稳定性-可塑性权衡。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出双边记忆巩固（Bilateral Memory Consolidation）机制。方法上可能同时从样本回放与参数正则化两个方向进行记忆巩固，以更全面地保留旧任务知识。相比单一策略的CL方法，双边机制在多个持续学习基准上提升了旧任务保持能力。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a bilateral memory consolidation mechanism. It likely consolidates memory from both sample replay and parameter regularization directions to more comprehensively preserve old-task knowledge. Compared to single-strategy CL methods, the bilateral mechanism improves old-task retention on multiple benchmarks.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 双边记忆巩固思路合理，但需关注其与现有回放+正则化组合方法的本质差异及实验充分性。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出双边记忆巩固机制，从样本与参数两个维度协同缓解遗忘。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 将回放与正则化以双边方式结合，形成更全面的记忆巩固策略。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.result: 在多个持续学习基准上提升了旧任务保持能力。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti._arxiv_id: Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Continual Learning.

2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有持续学习（CL）研究忽视计算预算约束的问题，指出现实系统主要受计算与时间预算限制而非存储限制。作者构建了大规模基准，在计算受限设定下评估了多种CL采样策略、蒸馏损失与部分微调方法，在ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2上进行了数据增量、类别增量和时间增量实验，总计超过1500 GPU小时。核心发现是：在计算受限下，所有传统CL方法无一例外均无法超越一个简单的最小基线。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits continual learning (CL) under computational budget constraints, arguing that real-world systems are limited by compute and time rather than storage. The authors build a large-scale benchmark and evaluate various CL sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2 across data-, class-, and time-incremental settings, totaling over 1500 GPU-hours. The key finding is that under compute-constrained settings, all traditional CL approaches fail to outperform a simple minimal baseline.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该工作以大规模实证揭示了计算受限下CL方法的失效，对领域具有重要警示与基准价值，值得关注。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 构建计算受限持续学习大规模基准，并揭示传统CL方法在该设定下均不敌简单基线。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在计算预算约束下重新审视持续学习方法的有效性。
2303.11165|v2.result: 在超过1500 GPU小时的实验中，所有传统CL方法在计算受限下均未能超越最小基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频数据持续学习（CL）中标注稀缺与遗忘严重的问题，提出PIVOT方法。PIVOT利用图像域预训练模型的丰富知识，通过提示（prompting）机制进行持续学习，从而减少可训练参数量并抑制遗忘，且无需任何域内预训练。相比此前方法，PIVOT是首个在无域内预训练下有效使用提示机制进行CL的方法，在20任务ActivityNet设定上比SOTA提升27%。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning (CL) for video data under annotation scarcity and severe forgetting, proposing PIVOT. PIVOT leverages rich knowledge from image-domain pre-trained models via prompting mechanisms, reducing trainable parameters and mitigating forgetting without any in-domain pre-training. It is the first approach to effectively use prompting for CL without in-domain pre-training, improving state-of-the-art by 27% on the 20-task ActivityNet setup.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: PIVOT将提示学习引入视频持续学习并取得显著提升，方法简洁有效，对视频CL方向有较强参考价值。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出PIVOT，首次在无域内预训练下利用图像域预训练模型提示机制进行视频持续学习。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 将提示机制与图像域预训练知识迁移结合，用于视频持续学习以减少可训练参数与遗忘。
2212.04842|v2.result: 在20任务ActivityNet设定上比SOTA方法提升27%。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习在数据损坏（corruption）场景下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出MetaMix方法。方法上采用时间自适应的数据变换策略，通过元学习方式动态调整数据增强/混合策略以适应不同任务阶段的损坏分布。相比固定增强的CL方法，MetaMix在损坏鲁棒性持续学习设定下提升了模型对分布偏移的适应能力。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper targets the lack of robustness in continual learning under data corruption, proposing MetaMix. It employs temporally self-adaptive data transformation, using meta-learning to dynamically adjust augmentation/mixing strategies to adapt to corruption distributions across task stages. Compared to fixed-augmentation CL methods, MetaMix improves adaptation to distribution shifts in corruption-robust continual learning settings.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: 将损坏鲁棒性与持续学习结合具有一定新意，但需关注其元学习开销与实验覆盖范围。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出MetaMix，通过时间自适应数据变换提升持续学习在数据损坏下的鲁棒性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 利用元学习动态调整数据增强/混合策略以适应不同任务阶段的损坏分布。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.result: 在损坏鲁棒持续学习设定下提升了模型对分布偏移的适应能力。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti._arxiv_id: MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Continual Learning with Temporally Self-Adaptive Data Transformation.

VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉问答（VQA）模型在持续学习场景下无法适应新知识且遗忘旧知识的问题，提出了VQACL这一新的持续学习设定。作者构建了相应的VQA持续学习基准与评估协议，并分析了现有CL方法在该设定下的表现。相比传统分类CL，VQACL更贴近多模态推理任务的持续学习需求，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper addresses the inability of visual question answering (VQA) models to adapt to new knowledge while retaining old knowledge in continual learning, proposing VQACL, a novel continual learning setting. The authors construct a corresponding VQA continual learning benchmark and evaluation protocol, and analyze existing CL methods under this setting. Compared to traditional classification CL, VQACL better reflects the needs of continual learning for multimodal reasoning tasks, providing a standardized evaluation platform.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: VQACL将持续学习拓展到VQA多模态任务，设定新颖且具基准价值，但方法层面的贡献相对有限。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.contribution: 提出VQACL视觉问答持续学习新设定，并构建相应基准与评估协议。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.innovation: 首次将持续学习设定系统性地引入视觉问答任务，填补多模态持续学习评测空白。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.result: 建立了VQA持续学习基准，并揭示了现有CL方法在该设定下的表现与不足。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering._arxiv_id: VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering Continual Learning Setting.

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（continual learning）中稳定性与可塑性难以兼顾、梯度投影方法在特征空间上耦合的问题；②提出将稳定性/可塑性在特征空间进行解耦的梯度投影框架，通过分离特征子空间来分别约束旧任务保持与新任务学习；③相比传统梯度投影（如GPM、Adam-NSCL）仅在参数空间做正交约束，该方法在特征空间显式解耦，缓解了任务间干扰；④在标准类增量/任务增量基准上取得优于现有梯度投影方法的精度，验证了解耦策略对稳定性-可塑性权衡的有效性。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning, where existing gradient projection methods entangle the two objectives in parameter space. It proposes a feature-space decoupling framework that separates stable and plastic feature subspaces to constrain old-task retention and new-task learning respectively. Compared with prior gradient projection approaches that only enforce orthogonality in parameter space, the method explicitly decouples interference at the feature level, yielding improved accuracy on standard class- and task-incremental benchmarks.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 对持续学习中的梯度投影范式提出了有意义的重新思考，特征空间解耦思路清晰，适合关注增量学习与表征学习的读者。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出在特征空间解耦稳定性与可塑性的梯度投影持续学习框架。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 将稳定性/可塑性约束从参数空间迁移到特征子空间进行显式解耦。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 在标准持续学习基准上取得优于现有梯度投影方法的精度。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中学习新任务与记忆旧任务相互冲突、单一记忆结构难以兼顾的问题；②提出一种双层记忆框架（bilevel memory），并引入知识投影机制，将学习与记忆过程解耦为两个层级；③相比传统单一记忆回放或正则化方法，该框架通过知识投影在任务间传递结构化知识，减少遗忘；④在任务增量学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，验证了解耦学习与记忆的有效性。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: This paper targets task-incremental learning where learning new tasks conflicts with remembering old ones under a single memory structure. It proposes a bilevel memory framework with a knowledge projection mechanism that decouples learning and remembering into two levels. Compared with conventional replay or regularization methods, the framework transfers structured knowledge across tasks via projection, reducing forgetting and achieving superior performance on task-incremental benchmarks.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 双层记忆与知识投影的解耦设计对增量学习研究有参考价值，思路新颖且实验较充分。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出解耦学习与记忆的双层记忆框架及知识投影机制。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 用双层记忆结构将新任务学习与旧任务记忆显式分离。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 在任务增量学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放的类增量学习中批归一化（BN）统计量被新旧类数据不均衡分布所偏置的问题；②提出对BN进行再平衡的方法，通过校正BN的均值/方差统计以缓解类别不平衡带来的偏差；③相比直接使用混合回放数据更新BN的常规做法，该方法显式再平衡BN统计量，改善新旧类判别；④在类增量学习基准上提升了精度，验证了BN再平衡对缓解灾难性遗忘与偏置的有效性。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: This paper addresses the bias in batch normalization statistics caused by imbalanced old/new class distributions in exemplar-based class-incremental learning. It proposes a rebalancing scheme that corrects BN mean and variance statistics to mitigate this bias. Compared with naively updating BN on mixed replay data, the method explicitly rebalances statistics, improving discrimination between old and new classes and boosting accuracy on class-incremental benchmarks.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 从BN统计偏置这一常被忽视的角度切入类增量学习，方法简洁有效，实用性强。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出针对样本回放类增量学习的批归一化再平衡方法。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 显式校正BN统计量以缓解新旧类分布不均衡导致的偏置。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 在类增量学习基准上提升了精度。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中知识迁移不足、任务间特征复用有限的问题；②提出DKT（Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer），利用Transformer架构在任务间进行多样化知识迁移；③相比传统基于CNN的增量学习方法，DKT借助注意力机制实现跨任务特征与知识的灵活迁移，缓解遗忘；④在类增量学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，验证了Transformer在增量学习中的知识迁移优势。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient knowledge transfer and limited feature reuse across tasks in class-incremental learning. It proposes DKT, a Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer that leverages attention to transfer diverse knowledge across tasks. Compared with CNN-based incremental methods, DKT enables flexible cross-task feature and knowledge transfer, mitigating forgetting and achieving superior performance on class-incremental benchmarks.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将Transformer引入类增量学习并强调多样化知识迁移，方向契合当前架构趋势，值得关注。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出用于类增量学习的多样化知识迁移Transformer框架DKT。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 利用Transformer注意力实现跨任务的多样化知识迁移。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 在类增量学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中模型容量固定、难以在保持旧知识的同时扩展新知识的问题；②提出稠密网络扩展（Dense Network Expansion）方法，通过动态扩展网络容量并稠密连接新旧分支来适应新任务；③相比固定容量或稀疏扩展的增量学习方法，该方法通过稠密扩展实现更充分的知识复用与容量增长；④在类增量学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，验证了稠密扩展策略的有效性。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses the fixed-capacity limitation in class-incremental learning, where models struggle to expand new knowledge while retaining old one. It proposes Dense Network Expansion, which dynamically grows network capacity with dense connections between old and new branches to adapt to new tasks. Compared with fixed-capacity or sparse-expansion methods, it enables richer knowledge reuse and capacity growth, achieving superior performance on class-incremental benchmarks.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 网络扩展是缓解增量学习遗忘的有效途径，稠密扩展设计合理，对容量增长类方法有参考价值。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出用于类增量学习的稠密网络扩展方法。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 通过稠密连接动态扩展网络容量以兼顾新旧任务。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.result: 在类增量学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: 针对视频语言模型在持续学习场景下缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文提出了 ViLCo-Bench，一个面向视频语言持续学习的基准。该基准构建了多任务的视频-语言指令数据流，系统评估现有 VLM 在时序任务上的灾难性遗忘与知识迁移能力。相比以往仅关注图像或单任务的持续学习评测，ViLCo-Bench 首次将视频时序理解与语言对齐纳入持续学习框架。实验揭示了现有方法在视频持续学习上遗忘严重、跨任务泛化不足的问题，为后续方法提供了量化基线。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark for continual learning in video-language models. It constructs multi-task video-language instruction streams and systematically evaluates catastrophic forgetting and knowledge transfer of existing VLMs. Unlike prior image-only or single-task continual learning benchmarks, it is the first to integrate temporal video understanding with language alignment, revealing severe forgetting and limited cross-task generalization.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 作为首个视频语言持续学习基准，为多模态持续学习研究提供了标准化评测平台，值得关注。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个面向视频语言模型的持续学习基准 ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将视频时序理解与语言对齐统一纳入持续学习评测框架。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 揭示了现有 VLM 在视频持续学习中的严重遗忘与泛化不足问题。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型在持续学习中灾难性遗忘严重的问题，本文提出基于混合专家适配器（MoE Adapters）的方法。通过在冻结的 VLM 中插入 MoE 适配器，并设计专家路由与参数隔离机制，实现新任务学习与旧知识保留的平衡。相比传统单一适配器或正则化方法，MoE 结构能更有效地分配容量、减少任务间干扰。实验表明该方法在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法，有效缓解遗忘并保持零样本能力。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning of vision-language models by proposing Mixture-of-Experts adapters. By inserting MoE adapters into a frozen VLM with expert routing and parameter isolation, it balances new-task learning and old-knowledge retention. Experiments show clear improvements over prior methods in mitigating forgetting while preserving zero-shot capability.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 将 MoE 适配器引入 VLM 持续学习，思路新颖且效果显著，对多模态持续学习有较强参考价值。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出了基于混合专家适配器的视觉语言模型持续学习方法。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 利用 MoE 路由与参数隔离缓解 VLM 持续学习中的任务干扰。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法并保持零样本能力。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La._arxiv_id: Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Mixture-of-Experts Adapters.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动预测模型在持续学习中遗忘旧场景的问题，本文提出基于元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲保留策略的方法。通过元学习提取可迁移的表示，并设计记忆缓冲的保留与采样策略，缓解灾难性遗忘。相比传统经验回放方法，该方法在有限缓冲下更高效地保留关键场景知识。实验表明其在运动预测持续学习任务上优于基线，提升了旧场景预测精度。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in motion prediction models for autonomous driving via meta-representation learning and an optimal memory buffer retention strategy. It learns transferable representations and designs buffer retention/sampling to mitigate forgetting under limited memory. Experiments show improved accuracy on old scenarios over baselines.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 将持续学习引入自动驾驶运动预测，问题设定贴近实际，对自动驾驶感知-预测一体化有参考意义。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出了面向运动预测模型的元表示学习与记忆缓冲持续学习框架。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 结合元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲保留策略缓解运动预测遗忘。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 在运动预测持续学习任务上优于基线并提升旧场景精度。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction._arxiv_id: Continual Learning for Motion Prediction Model via Meta-Representation Learning and Optimal Memory Buffer Retention Strategy.

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中表示退化与遗忘问题，本文提出等角表示学习（Equi-Angular Representations）方法。通过约束特征在超球面上均匀分布，提升类间可分性并缓解任务间干扰。相比传统基于回放或正则化的在线持续学习方法，该方法从表示几何角度改善稳定性-可塑性平衡。实验表明其在多个在线持续学习基准上取得更优性能，减少遗忘。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper proposes learning equi-angular representations for online continual learning to address representation degradation and forgetting. By enforcing uniform feature distribution on a hypersphere, it improves inter-class separability and reduces task interference. Experiments show better stability-plasticity trade-off and reduced forgetting on online CL benchmarks.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 从表示几何角度切入在线持续学习，思路独特，对表示学习与持续学习交叉方向有启发。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出了等角表示学习以改善在线持续学习的稳定性-可塑性平衡。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 通过超球面均匀分布约束提升类间可分性并缓解遗忘。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上取得更优性能并减少遗忘。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中模型可塑性下降的问题，本文提出通过协同学习（Collaborative Learning）提升可塑性。通过引入辅助网络或同伴模型进行协同训练，增强模型对新任务的适应能力，同时保持旧知识。相比仅关注稳定性（抗遗忘）的现有方法，该方法更强调可塑性恢复。实验表明其在在线持续学习基准上提升了新任务学习能力且不显著增加遗忘。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper improves plasticity in online continual learning via collaborative learning. By introducing auxiliary or peer models for collaborative training, it enhances adaptation to new tasks while retaining old knowledge. Experiments show improved new-task learning without significantly increasing forgetting on online CL benchmarks.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 聚焦在线持续学习中被忽视的可塑性问题，协同学习思路有实用价值。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出了通过协同学习提升在线持续学习可塑性的方法。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.innovation: 引入协同训练机制以恢复模型对新任务的可塑性。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 在在线持续学习基准上提升新任务学习能力且不显著增加遗忘。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型可能被恶意攻击导致遗忘的问题，本文提出 BrainWash，一种针对持续学习的投毒攻击方法。通过向训练数据注入精心设计的毒化样本，诱导模型遗忘特定类别或任务。相比传统数据投毒，该攻击专门利用持续学习的记忆更新机制。实验表明该攻击能有效使模型遗忘目标知识，揭示了持续学习系统的安全脆弱性。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper proposes BrainWash, a poisoning attack that induces forgetting in continual learning models. By injecting crafted poisoned samples, it manipulates the memory update mechanism to erase targeted knowledge. Experiments show effective targeted forgetting, exposing security vulnerabilities of continual learning systems.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 从安全视角审视持续学习，揭示其被投毒攻击导致遗忘的风险，对可信持续学习研究有警示意义。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 提出了针对持续学习模型的投毒攻击方法 BrainWash。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 利用持续学习记忆更新机制实现定向遗忘攻击。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 实验证明该攻击能有效诱导模型遗忘目标知识。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: 针对无回放持续学习（rehearsal-free CL）中提示（prompt）学习易受任务间干扰、旧任务提示漂移的问题，本文提出 Consistent Prompting（CPrompt）框架。方法通过任务特定提示与任务共享提示的解耦设计，并引入提示一致性约束，使新任务学习时旧任务提示保持稳定。相比此前基于 prompt 的无回放方法，CPrompt 在多个类增量基准上显著缓解了灾难性遗忘。在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet-R 等基准上取得了优于 SOTA 无回放方法的精度，同时保持较低参数量。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: This paper addresses prompt drift and inter-task interference in rehearsal-free continual learning. It proposes Consistent Prompting (CPrompt), which decouples task-specific and task-shared prompts and enforces prompt consistency to stabilize old-task prompts during new-task learning. It outperforms prior prompt-based rehearsal-free methods on class-incremental benchmarks such as CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-R while keeping parameter overhead low.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 在无回放持续学习这一热门方向上给出了简洁有效的提示一致性方案，实验扎实，对关注持续学习与参数高效微调的研究者有参考价值。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出 Consistent Prompting 框架，通过提示解耦与一致性约束缓解无回放持续学习中的提示漂移。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 将任务特定/共享提示解耦并显式施加提示一致性约束以抑制任务间干扰。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R 等类增量基准上超越现有无回放 SOTA，且参数开销低。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: 针对无样本（exemplar-free）持续学习中旧类因缺乏旧数据而严重遗忘的问题，本文提出用新数据“复活”旧类的方法。核心思路是利用新任务数据中与旧类语义相关的样本，通过特征/原型对齐与生成式重放来恢复旧类判别边界。相比传统无样本方法仅靠正则化或原型保持，该方法更主动地重建旧类表示。在 CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 等无样本类增量基准上取得明显提升，缩小了与有样本方法的差距。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting of old classes in exemplar-free continual learning. It proposes to 'resurrect' old classes using new-task data via semantic alignment and generative replay to restore old-class decision boundaries. It outperforms regularization- and prototype-only exemplar-free baselines on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet, narrowing the gap to exemplar-based methods.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 为无样本持续学习提供了利用新数据恢复旧类的新视角，思路新颖，对持续学习与表示学习研究者有启发。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出利用新数据复活旧类的无样本持续学习框架。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 借助新任务中语义相关样本重建旧类表示与判别边界。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 在 CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 等无样本基准上显著优于现有方法。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f._arxiv_id: Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning.

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_cn: 针对全景分割持续学习中灾难性遗忘与训练成本高的问题，本文提出 ECLIPSE 框架。方法基于视觉提示微调（Visual Prompt Tuning），为每个任务学习轻量提示并冻结主干，同时设计提示选择与融合机制以适配全景分割的密集预测特性。相比全参数微调或重放方法，ECLIPSE 大幅降低可训练参数与存储开销。在持续全景分割基准上取得优于现有方法的 PQ 指标，同时训练效率显著提升。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and high training cost in continual panoptic segmentation. It proposes ECLIPSE, a visual prompt tuning framework that learns lightweight per-task prompts with a frozen backbone and a prompt selection/fusion mechanism tailored to dense prediction. It achieves higher PQ than prior continual panoptic segmentation methods while greatly reducing trainable parameters and training cost.
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.assessment: 将视觉提示微调成功扩展到全景分割持续学习，兼顾性能与效率，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习部署有实际意义。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.contribution: 提出基于视觉提示微调的持续全景分割框架 ECLIPSE。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 面向密集预测设计任务提示选择与融合机制，冻结主干实现高效持续学习。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.result: 在持续全景分割基准上 PQ 超越现有方法，训练参数与成本大幅降低。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in._arxiv_id: ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in Panoptic Segmentation with Visual Prompt Tuning.

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中低秩适配（LoRA）因参数子空间重叠导致新旧任务相互干扰的问题，本文提出 InfLoRA。方法通过分析 LoRA 更新子空间与旧任务特征空间的关系，设计无干扰的低秩子空间分配，使新任务更新正交于旧任务关键子空间。相比直接堆叠 LoRA 或正则化方法，InfLoRA 从子空间层面消除干扰。在多个类增量与域增量基准上取得优于现有 PEFT 持续学习方法的精度，且参数开销可控。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: This paper tackles inter-task interference in LoRA-based continual learning caused by overlapping low-rank subspaces. It proposes InfLoRA, which allocates interference-free low-rank subspaces so that new-task updates are orthogonal to old-task critical subspaces. It outperforms existing PEFT-based continual learning methods on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks with modest parameter overhead.
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.assessment: 从子空间正交性角度解决 LoRA 持续学习干扰问题，理论动机清晰，对参数高效持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.contribution: 提出无干扰低秩适配 InfLoRA 用于持续学习。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.innovation: 通过子空间正交分配消除新旧任务在 LoRA 更新中的相互干扰。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.result: 在类增量与域增量基准上超越现有 PEFT 持续学习方法。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap._arxiv_id: InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning.

Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_cn: 针对视觉持续学习中分类器偏向新类、旧类判别不足的问题，本文提出用语言引导的监督信号增强持续学习。方法利用预训练视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的文本嵌入为各类生成语义分类器，并与视觉分类器联合优化，缓解任务间分类器漂移。相比仅用视觉监督的持续学习方法，语言引导提供了任务无关的类语义先验。在多个类增量基准上取得稳定提升，尤其在少样本旧类上改善明显。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_en: This paper addresses classifier bias toward new classes in visual continual learning. It proposes language-guided supervision that leverages text embeddings from pretrained vision-language models to form semantic classifiers jointly optimized with visual ones, mitigating classifier drift. It consistently improves class-incremental benchmarks, especially for few-shot old classes.
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.assessment: 将视觉-语言先验引入持续学习分类器设计，思路实用，对关注多模态与持续学习结合的研究者有参考意义。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.contribution: 提出语言引导监督以增强视觉持续学习。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.innovation: 利用预训练视觉-语言模型的文本嵌入构建语义分类器缓解分类器漂移。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.result: 在多个类增量基准上稳定提升，少样本旧类改善尤为明显。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with._arxiv_id: Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with Language-Guided Supervision.

Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_cn: 针对视觉惯性里程计（VIO）在环境变化（光照、场景、运动模式改变）下性能退化的问题，本文提出 Adaptive VIO，将在线持续学习引入深度 VIO。方法在推理过程中利用自监督信号在线微调网络，并设计防遗忘与稳定性机制避免在线更新导致的漂移。相比固定权重的深度 VIO，Adaptive VIO 能适应新环境而无需离线重训。在多个公开 VIO 基准与真实场景中取得更低的轨迹误差，验证了在线持续学习的有效性。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of visual-inertial odometry under environmental changes. It proposes Adaptive VIO, which performs online continual learning with self-supervised signals during inference, combined with anti-forgetting and stability mechanisms to prevent drift. It achieves lower trajectory errors than fixed-weight deep VIO on public benchmarks and real-world sequences without offline retraining.
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.assessment: 把在线持续学习落地到自动驾驶 VIO 任务，问题真实、系统完整，对自动驾驶定位与持续学习交叉方向很有价值。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.contribution: 提出带在线持续学习的深度视觉惯性里程计 Adaptive VIO。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.innovation: 在推理阶段用自监督在线微调并设计防遗忘机制适应环境变化。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.result: 在多个 VIO 基准与真实场景中取得更低轨迹误差，无需离线重训。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome._arxiv_id: Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odometry with Online Continual Learning.

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与知识迁移问题，本文提出交互式持续学习框架，将快速直觉式学习与慢速推理式学习相结合。方法上借鉴双系统认知理论，设计快慢两个模块协同工作，快速模块负责高效适应新任务，慢速模块负责深度推理与知识整合。相比已有持续学习方法，该框架在任务序列上实现了更好的稳定性-可塑性平衡。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and knowledge transfer in continual learning by proposing an interactive framework that combines fast intuitive learning with slow deliberative reasoning. Drawing on dual-system cognitive theory, it designs fast and slow modules that collaboratively adapt to new tasks while consolidating knowledge. Compared with existing continual learning methods, the framework achieves a better stability-plasticity trade-off, though no specific benchmark numbers are reported in the abstract.
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.assessment: 将认知科学双系统理论引入持续学习具有一定新意，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，需关注其实际有效性。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出快慢双系统交互的持续学习框架。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 借鉴认知科学双系统理论设计快慢协同学习机制。

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中预训练模型适配与遗忘问题，本文提出将卷积提示与语言模型相结合的持续学习方法。方法上利用卷积提示模块适配预训练视觉模型，并借助语言模型的语义知识指导类别增量学习。相比已有提示式持续学习方法，该工作引入语言模型增强了语义泛化能力。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This paper tackles continual learning by combining convolutional prompting with language models. It employs convolutional prompts to adapt pre-trained vision models and leverages language model semantics to guide class-incremental learning. Compared with existing prompt-based continual learning methods, it enhances semantic generalization, though no specific benchmark results are provided in the abstract.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 将卷积提示与语言模型结合用于持续学习思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验验证的充分性。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示与语言模型结合的持续学习方法。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 利用语言模型语义知识增强卷积提示的持续学习能力。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: 针对联邦持续学习中的可追溯性与隐私保护问题，本文提出可追溯联邦持续学习框架。方法上在联邦学习架构中引入持续学习机制，并设计可追溯模块以追踪模型更新来源与知识演化过程。相比已有联邦持续学习方法，该工作增强了学习过程的可审计性与透明度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses traceability and privacy in federated continual learning by proposing a traceable federated continual learning framework. It integrates continual learning into a federated architecture and designs a traceability module to track model update provenance and knowledge evolution. Compared with existing federated continual learning methods, it improves auditability and transparency, though no specific benchmark results are reported.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 可追溯性在联邦持续学习中是一个较少被关注的维度，具有一定研究价值，但摘要缺乏实验细节。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追溯的联邦持续学习框架。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 在联邦持续学习中引入可追溯机制以追踪知识演化。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中的遗忘与知识利用不足问题，本文提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。方法上通过多层次监督信号增强特征学习，并利用反向自蒸馏机制促进知识从新任务向旧任务的迁移。相比已有在线持续学习方法，该框架在知识保留与迁移之间取得更好平衡。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper targets forgetting and insufficient knowledge reuse in online continual learning by proposing a framework with multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. It enhances feature learning via multi-level supervision and promotes knowledge transfer from new to old tasks through reverse self-distillation. Compared with existing online continual learning methods, it achieves a better balance between knowledge retention and transfer, though no specific benchmark results are reported.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的组合在在线持续学习中具有一定新意，但需关注实验验证。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 利用反向自蒸馏促进新旧任务间的知识迁移。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing._arxiv_id: Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing Online Continual Learning with Multi-Level Supervision and Reverse Self-Distillation.

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: 针对统一故障检测中的持续学习问题，本文提出可靠持续学习框架 RCL。方法上设计可靠的持续学习策略，使模型在持续学习过程中保持对分布内与分布外样本的故障检测能力。相比已有故障检测方法，该工作将持续学习与故障检测统一起来，提升了检测的鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning for unified failure detection by proposing the RCL framework. It designs reliable continual learning strategies to maintain failure detection capability for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution samples during continual learning. Compared with existing failure detection methods, it unifies continual learning and failure detection, improving detection robustness, though no specific benchmark results are reported.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 将持续学习与故障检测统一是一个有价值的方向，但摘要缺乏实验数据支撑。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出用于统一故障检测的可靠持续学习框架 RCL。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 将持续学习与故障检测统一以提升检测鲁棒性。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni._arxiv_id: RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Unified Failure Detection.

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习中的遗忘与参数扩展问题，本文提出可扩展子空间集成方法。方法上为每个任务学习可扩展的子空间，并通过子空间集成实现类增量学习，避免对预训练模型的灾难性遗忘。相比已有基于预训练模型的类增量学习方法，该工作通过子空间扩展与集成提升了学习能力。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting and parameter expansion in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning by proposing an expandable subspace ensemble. It learns an expandable subspace per task and performs class-incremental learning via subspace ensemble, avoiding catastrophic forgetting of the pre-trained model. Compared with existing pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning methods, it improves learning capability through subspace expansion and ensemble, though no specific benchmark results are reported.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 可扩展子空间集成在预训练模型类增量学习中具有一定新意，但摘要缺乏实验细节。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出用于预训练模型类增量学习的可扩展子空间集成方法。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 通过可扩展子空间与集成实现类增量学习。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra._arxiv_id: Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘与通信开销的矛盾，提出了一种高效的回放（replay）机制。方法上通过在客户端选择性存储与全局聚合代表性样本，并结合梯度对齐约束来缓解任务间干扰。相比已有联邦增量学习方法，其改进在于降低了回放样本的存储与传输成本，同时保持跨任务知识迁移。实验在多个联邦增量基准上取得了更优的精度-开销权衡，具体数据摘要中未给出。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and communication overhead in federated incremental learning by proposing an efficient replay mechanism. It selectively stores and globally aggregates representative samples across clients with gradient alignment constraints to mitigate inter-task interference. Compared with existing federated incremental methods, it reduces replay storage and transmission costs while preserving cross-task knowledge transfer, achieving a better accuracy-cost trade-off on federated incremental benchmarks.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 该工作将高效回放引入联邦增量学习，对边缘端持续学习部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出面向联邦增量学习的高效回放机制以平衡遗忘抑制与通信开销。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 在客户端选择性回放与全局聚合之间引入梯度对齐约束。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.result: 在联邦增量基准上取得更优的精度-开销权衡。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In._arxiv_id: Towards Efficient Replay in Federated Incremental Learning.

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中模型泛化能力不足的问题，提出 OrCo 方法，通过正交性（orthogonality）与对比（contrast）约束来塑造更具判别性的特征空间。方法在基类训练阶段引入正交正则与对比损失，使新类在少量样本下也能被有效区分。相比已有 FSCIL 方法，其改进在于同时优化特征正交性与类间对比度，缓解基类过拟合。实验在 CIFAR100、miniImageNet 等基准上取得领先精度，具体数值摘要中未给出。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: This paper tackles limited generalization in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) with OrCo, which enforces orthogonality and contrast to shape a more discriminative feature space. Orthogonal regularization and contrastive losses are introduced during base training so that novel classes can be separated with few samples. Compared with prior FSCIL methods, it jointly optimizes feature orthogonality and inter-class contrast to alleviate base-class overfitting, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on CIFAR100 and miniImageNet.
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.assessment: 正交性与对比学习的结合在 FSCIL 中思路清晰，对增量学习研究者有借鉴意义，但应用场景偏通用分类。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.contribution: 提出结合正交性与对比约束的 FSCIL 特征学习框架 OrCo。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.innovation: 在基类训练中同时施加正交正则与对比损失以提升新类泛化。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.result: 在 CIFAR100、miniImageNet 等 FSCIL 基准上取得领先精度。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via._arxiv_id: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: 该论文针对无回放类增量学习（replay-free CIL）中旧知识遗忘的问题，受神经发生（neurogenesis）启发提出 NICE 上下文编码方法。方法通过动态扩展网络容量并引入上下文编码来隔离不同任务的特征表示，避免存储旧样本。相比已有无回放方法，其改进在于以生物启发的容量增长机制替代固定网络，缓解任务间干扰。实验在标准 CIL 基准上优于现有无回放方法，具体数据摘要中未给出。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in replay-free class incremental learning (CIL) with NICE, a neurogenesis-inspired contextual encoding approach. It dynamically expands network capacity and introduces contextual encoding to isolate task-specific representations without storing old samples. Compared with existing replay-free methods, it replaces a fixed network with a biologically inspired capacity-growth mechanism to mitigate inter-task interference, outperforming prior replay-free methods on standard CIL benchmarks.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 神经发生启发的容量扩展思路新颖，对无回放增量学习有启发，但需关注模型膨胀带来的推理成本。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出神经发生启发的无回放类增量学习框架 NICE。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 以动态容量扩展与上下文编码实现任务隔离。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.result: 在标准 CIL 基准上优于现有无回放方法。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E._arxiv_id: NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual Encoding for Replay-free Class Incremental Learning.

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的类别不平衡问题（imbalanced CIL），提出梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法。方法通过分析不同类别梯度对更新的贡献差异，动态调整梯度权重以平衡新旧类与头尾类的学习。相比已有 CIL 方法，其改进在于从梯度层面显式处理不平衡，而非仅依赖损失重加权或样本回放。实验在多个不平衡 CIL 基准上提升了整体与尾部类精度，具体数据摘要中未给出。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper targets class imbalance in class-incremental learning (CIL) with a Gradient Reweighting approach. It analyzes the differing contributions of per-class gradients and dynamically reweights them to balance learning across old/new and head/tail classes. Compared with prior CIL methods, it explicitly handles imbalance at the gradient level rather than relying solely on loss reweighting or replay, improving overall and tail-class accuracy on imbalanced CIL benchmarks.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 从梯度层面处理不平衡是较新颖的视角，对增量学习与长尾问题交叉方向有参考价值。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出面向不平衡类增量学习的梯度重加权方法。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 在梯度层面动态调整类别权重以平衡新旧与头尾类学习。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.result: 在不平衡 CIL 基准上提升整体与尾部类精度。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced._arxiv_id: Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced Class-Incremental Learning.

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线无任务边界类增量学习（online task-free CIL）问题，提出 DYSON 动态特征空间自组织方法。方法通过在线聚类与特征空间动态重组，在无任务标签与单遍数据流条件下自适应地组织类别表示。相比已有在线 CIL 方法，其改进在于无需任务边界即可动态调整特征空间结构，缓解任务混淆。实验在在线 CIL 基准上取得更优性能，具体数据摘要中未给出。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: This paper addresses online task-free class incremental learning (CIL) with DYSON, a dynamic feature-space self-organization method. It performs online clustering and dynamic reorganization of the feature space to adaptively structure class representations under task-boundary-free, single-pass data streams. Compared with existing online CIL methods, it adjusts feature-space structure without task boundaries to mitigate task confusion, achieving superior performance on online CIL benchmarks.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 面向在线无任务边界的设定更贴近真实部署，特征空间自组织思路对持续学习研究者有吸引力。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出在线无任务边界类增量学习的动态特征空间自组织框架 DYSON。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 以在线聚类与特征空间动态重组实现无任务边界的类别组织。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.result: 在在线 CIL 基准上取得更优性能。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: 该论文针对无样本类增量学习（non-exemplar CIL）中特征漂移与类间混淆问题，提出特征校准与分离（FCS）方法。方法通过特征校准模块纠正旧类特征分布偏移，并利用分离约束增强新旧类间的判别性。相比已有无样本 CIL 方法，其改进在于同时处理特征漂移与类间重叠，无需存储旧样本。实验在 CIFAR100、ImageNet 等基准上取得领先精度，具体数据摘要中未给出。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: This paper tackles feature drift and inter-class confusion in non-exemplar class incremental learning (CIL) with Feature Calibration and Separation (FCS). A calibration module corrects distribution shifts of old-class features, while separation constraints enhance discriminability between old and new classes. Compared with prior non-exemplar CIL methods, it jointly handles feature drift and class overlap without storing old samples, achieving leading accuracy on CIFAR100 and ImageNet benchmarks.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 特征校准与分离的组合在无样本 CIL 中较为实用，对增量学习研究者有参考价值。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出无样本类增量学习中的特征校准与分离框架 FCS。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 联合特征校准与类间分离约束以缓解特征漂移与混淆。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.result: 在 CIFAR100、ImageNet 等基准上取得领先精度。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation._arxiv_id: FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation for Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多实例学习（MIL）模型在全切片图像分析中难以适应演进数据集、传统持续学习（CL）改进有限的问题，作者分析了注意力MIL模型中的遗忘机制，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。据此提出注意力知识蒸馏（AKD）与伪包记忆池（PMP）两个组件：AKD在会话间保留注意力层知识以缓解灾难性遗忘，PMP通过仅存储最具信息量的patch（伪包）降低内存占用。实验表明该方法在多个WSI数据集上同时提升了准确率与内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of multiple instance learning (MIL) models for whole slide imaging under evolving datasets, showing that forgetting in attention-based MIL concentrates in attention layers. It proposes Attention Knowledge Distillation (AKD) to retain attention-layer knowledge across sessions and a Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool (PMP) that stores only the most informative patches to reduce memory footprint. Experiments on diverse WSI datasets demonstrate improved accuracy and memory efficiency.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 将持续学习与MIL结合并定位遗忘来源的思路清晰，但属医学影像应用，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出面向注意力MIL的持续学习框架，包含AKD与PMP两个组件。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 通过分析定位遗忘集中于注意力层，并设计伪包记忆池降低内存。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个WSI数据集上同时提升准确率与内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于预训练模型（PTM）的持续学习方法因固定适配器集合导致持续学习能力受限、周期性新增任务模块造成线性增长与知识复用不足的问题，提出SEMA（自扩展预训练模型与模块化适配）。SEMA在不同表征层级检测到无法处理的显著分布偏移时，自动决定复用或新增适配器模块，模块由功能适配器与表征描述符组成。该方法在稳定性-可塑性平衡上优于固定模块方案，并避免了线性模型增长。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: Existing PTM-based continual learning methods suffer from limited plasticity due to fixed adapter sets and linear model growth from periodically adding task-specific modules. This paper proposes SEMA, which automatically reuses or adds modular adapters on demand based on detected distribution shifts at different representation levels, with each module comprising a functional adapter and a representation descriptor. SEMA improves the stability-plasticity balance while avoiding linear model growth.
2403.18886|v2.assessment: 按需自扩展适配器的思路对PTM持续学习有较好参考价值，方法设计合理，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2403.18886|v2.contribution: 提出按需自扩展的模块化适配框架SEMA用于PTM持续学习。
2403.18886|v2.innovation: 依据表征层级的分布偏移自动决定适配器复用或新增。
2403.18886|v2.result: 在稳定性-可塑性平衡上优于固定模块方法并抑制模型线性增长。

Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.summary_cn: 该论文题为《Online Task-Free Continual Learning via Dynamic Expansionable Memory Distribution》，针对在线无任务边界持续学习场景。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法、改进点与实验数据。仅从标题推断其提出动态可扩展记忆分布机制以应对任务边界未知的在线学习。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.summary_en: This paper targets online task-free continual learning, where task boundaries are unavailable. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method, improvements, and experimental results cannot be verified; the title suggests a dynamically expandable memory distribution mechanism.
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.assessment: 主题与持续学习相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与效果，信息不足。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.contribution: 提出面向在线无任务持续学习的动态可扩展记忆分布方法（据标题推断）。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.innovation: 动态可扩展的记忆分布机制（据标题推断）。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。
Online Task-Free Continual Learning via._arxiv_id: Online Task-Free Continual Learning via Dynamic Expansionable Memory Distribution.

2503.23283|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中既要缓解灾难性遗忘又要保持跨任务可解释性这一被较少探索的问题，提出融合语言引导的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）框架。方法利用概念瓶颈层与CLIP模型对齐语义一致性，学习可跨任务泛化的人类可理解概念，从而在保留知识的同时提供透明的决策依据。在多个数据集上取得优于SOTA的性能，摘要提到提升幅度最高达某数值（原文截断）。
2503.23283|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored challenge of maintaining interpretability while mitigating catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. It introduces a language-guided Concept Bottleneck Model framework that aligns a concept bottleneck layer with CLIP to learn human-understandable, cross-task generalizable concepts, providing transparent decision-making. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several datasets by up to a reported margin.
2503.23283|v2.assessment: 将可解释性与持续学习结合的方向有新意，CLIP对齐概念的设计合理，但属通用CL方法，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2503.23283|v2.contribution: 提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型框架用于可解释持续学习。
2503.23283|v2.innovation: 用概念瓶颈层与CLIP对齐学习跨任务可泛化的人类可理解概念。
2503.23283|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越SOTA，提升幅度最高达摘要所述数值。

2505.24816|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习（CIL）中现有基于适配器的方法为每个新任务新建适配器导致参数冗余且无法利用跨任务共享知识的问题，提出CL-LoRA双适配器架构：任务共享适配器学习跨任务知识，任务特定适配器捕捉各任务独有特征。共享适配器采用随机正交矩阵并结合带梯度重分配的知识蒸馏保留共享知识，任务特定适配器引入可学习块级权重以缓解任务间干扰并保持可塑性。在无样本回放的CIL设定下取得有竞争力的性能。
2505.24816|v2.summary_en: Existing adapter-based class-incremental learning methods create new adapters per task, causing parameter redundancy and poor cross-task knowledge reuse. This paper proposes CL-LoRA, a dual-adapter architecture with task-shared adapters (using random orthogonal matrices and knowledge distillation with gradient reassignment) and task-specific adapters with learnable block-wise weights to balance inter-task interference and plasticity. It achieves competitive performance in rehearsal-free CIL.
2505.24816|v2.assessment: 双适配器与梯度重分配蒸馏的设计对PEFT式持续学习有实用价值，方法完整，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2505.24816|v2.contribution: 提出结合任务共享与任务特定适配器的CL-LoRA用于无回放类增量学习。
2505.24816|v2.innovation: 随机正交矩阵共享适配器与梯度重分配知识蒸馏、块级权重机制。
2505.24816|v2.result: 在无样本回放的类增量学习基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

2503.21076|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中线性分类器难以在学习新任务时维持稳定分类空间的问题，受Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）在简单持续回归任务中保持学习稳定性的启发，提出Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器（KAC）。作者研究了KAN样条函数的影响，并引入径向基函数（RBF）以更好兼容持续学习，将多种近期方法中的线性分类器替换为KAC。在多个持续学习基准上均取得性能提升，验证了KAC的有效性与鲁棒性。
2503.21076|v2.summary_en: Linear classifiers in continual learning struggle to maintain a stable classification space when learning new tasks. Inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' stability in continual regression, this paper proposes the Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier (KAC), replacing spline functions with Radial Basis Functions for better continual learning compatibility. Substituting linear classifiers with KAC in several recent methods yields consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks.
2503.21076|v2.assessment: 以KAN替换线性分类器的思路新颖且即插即用，跨方法验证增强了说服力，但属通用CL组件，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2503.21076|v2.contribution: 提出基于KAN结构的Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器KAC用于持续学习。
2503.21076|v2.innovation: 引入RBF替代样条函数以提升KAN在持续学习中的兼容性。
2503.21076|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上替换线性分类器后均取得性能提升。

2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文借鉴艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线理论，提出 view-batch 模型来调整学习调度，优化同一批样本重训练的回忆间隔。方法包含两个具体实现：保证最优回忆间隔的回放策略，以及一种自监督学习方式，使网络在足够'休息'后从相同样本中学习更广泛的知识。相比传统回放方法，该工作从认知科学角度重新设计了重放时序，但摘要未给出具体数据集上的量化结果。
2503.18371|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by drawing on Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve theory. It introduces a view-batch model that adjusts learning schedules to optimize the recall interval between retraining the same samples, implemented via a replay method guaranteeing optimal recall intervals and a self-supervised learning scheme. The approach reframes replay timing from a cognitive-science perspective, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2503.18371|v2.assessment: 将认知科学遗忘曲线引入持续学习调度设计，思路新颖，但缺乏实验数据支撑，实际增益有待验证。
2503.18371|v2.contribution: 提出基于遗忘曲线的 view-batch 学习调度模型及配套回放与自监督策略。
2503.18371|v2.innovation: 用回忆间隔概念重新设计持续学习中的样本重放时序。
2503.18371|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果尚不明确。

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘，本文提出 Drift-Resistant Space（DRS），无需显式特征建模或存储旧任务样本即可应对特征漂移。核心方法 LoRA Subtraction（LoRA-）是一种参数高效微调技术，在处理新任务前从预训练权重中减去旧任务的 LoRA 权重以构建 DRS。相比依赖静态特征或过时统计量的现有方法，LoRA- 提升了稳定性与效率并简化了实现，但摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning (EFCL) by proposing Drift-Resistant Space (DRS), which handles drift without explicit feature modeling or storing previous-task samples. The key method, Low-Rank Adaptation Subtraction (LoRA-), subtracts old-task LoRA weights from the pre-trained weights before learning new tasks to construct the DRS. Compared to methods relying on static features or outdated statistics, LoRA- improves stability and efficiency, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: 将 LoRA 减法用于构建抗漂移特征空间，思路简洁且参数高效，对 EFCL 方向有较好参考价值。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出 Drift-Resistant Space 及 LoRA Subtraction 参数高效微调方法。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 通过减去旧任务 LoRA 权重动态构建抗漂移空间，无需存储旧样本。
2503.18985|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，声称在稳定性与效率上优于依赖静态特征的现有方法。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（OCL）中现有回放方法忽视模型适应性、难以从在线数据增量学习可泛化判别特征的问题，本文提出即插即用模块 S6MOD。该模块在骨干网络后增加分支，通过离散化混合（mixture of discretization）选择性调整状态空间模型参数，并设计类条件路由算法与对比离散化损失进行优化。实验表明 S6MOD 可集成到多种现有方法中显著提升适应性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of existing replay-based online continual learning (OCL) methods, which struggle to learn generalizable discriminative features incrementally. It proposes S6MOD, a plug-and-play module that adds a branch after the backbone where a mixture of discretization selectively adjusts selective state space model parameters, together with a class-conditional routing algorithm and a contrastive discretization loss. Experiments show S6MOD integrates with various methods and substantially improves adaptability, though no specific numbers are reported.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型与离散化混合引入 OCL，模块化设计便于集成，但摘要缺乏量化结果。
2412.18177|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的 S6MOD 模块及类条件路由与对比离散化损失。
2412.18177|v2.innovation: 用离散化混合增强选择性状态空间模型的在线适应能力。
2412.18177|v2.result: 摘要称可显著提升多种模型的适应性，但未给出具体指标。

Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogen.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogeneity for Federated Continual Learning via Tail Anchor》，针对联邦持续学习中的时空数据异构性问题提出 Tail Anchor 方法。但由于摘要内容为空，无法获取其具体方法细节、改进点与实验结果，仅能从标题推断其研究联邦持续学习场景下的数据异构性处理。
Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogen.summary_en: This paper, titled 'Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogeneity for Federated Continual Learning via Tail Anchor,' targets spatial-temporal data heterogeneity in federated continual learning with a Tail Anchor approach. However, the abstract is empty, so the specific methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed.
Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogen.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估方法质量与效果，仅标题显示其关注联邦持续学习的数据异构问题。
Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogen.contribution: 提出 Tail Anchor 方法处理联邦持续学习中的时空数据异构性（依据标题推断）。
Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogen._arxiv_id: Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogeneity for Federated Continual Learning via Tail Anchor.

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: 针对高频数据流下在线持续学习（OCL）需在变化的内存约束中实现实时学习的问题，本文提出 Ferret 框架。它采用细粒度流水线并行策略与迭代梯度补偿算法，处理高频数据并缓解并行训练中的陈旧梯度问题，同时通过自动化模型划分与流水线规划适应不同内存预算。在 20 个基准和 5 种 OCL 算法上的实验显示，达到相同在线精度时内存开销最多降低 3.7 倍，并在多种内存预算下持续优于对比方法。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Ferret, a framework for online continual learning (OCL) that enhances online accuracy while adapting to varying memory budgets in high-frequency data streams. Ferret combines fine-grained pipeline parallelism with an iterative gradient compensation algorithm to handle high-frequency data with minimal latency and counteract stale gradients, plus automated model partitioning and pipeline planning for memory adaptation. Experiments across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms show up to 3.7× lower memory overhead at equal online accuracy and consistent superiority across memory budgets.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 系统层面的 OCL 框架，实验规模大且指标明确，对资源受限的在线持续学习部署有实用价值。
2503.12053|v2.contribution: 提出适应变化内存预算的高效在线持续学习框架 Ferret。
2503.12053|v2.innovation: 细粒度流水线并行结合迭代梯度补偿，并自动化模型划分与流水线规划。
2503.12053|v2.result: 达到相同在线精度时内存开销最多降低 3.7 倍，并在多种内存预算下优于对比方法。

BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spaces for Continual Learning》，提出 BiLoRA 方法，旨在为持续学习构建近似正交的参数空间以缓解灾难性遗忘。但由于摘要内容为空，无法获取其具体方法设计、与已有工作的对比以及实验效果，仅能从标题推断其基于 LoRA 的正交参数空间思路。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.summary_en: This paper, titled 'BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spaces for Continual Learning,' proposes BiLoRA to construct almost-orthogonal parameter spaces for mitigating catastrophic forgetting. However, the abstract is empty, so the methodology, comparisons, and experimental results cannot be evaluated; only the LoRA-based orthogonal parameter space idea can be inferred from the title.
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估方法质量与效果，仅标题显示其探索 LoRA 正交参数空间用于持续学习。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.contribution: 提出 BiLoRA 近似正交参数空间方法用于持续学习（依据标题推断）。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac._arxiv_id: BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spaces for Continual Learning.

Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频类增量学习（Video Class-Incremental Learning）中时空表征随任务更新而漂移、旧类别易遗忘的问题，提出学习条件化的时空提示分布（Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions）。方法通过为不同任务/类别生成条件化的时空 prompt 分布，替代固定 prompt，从而在冻结主干的前提下适配新任务并保留旧知识。相比已有 prompt-based 增量方法，其改进在于将 prompt 从静态参数扩展为条件分布，更好匹配视频时空动态。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in video class-incremental learning, where spatio-temporal representations drift as new tasks arrive. It proposes learning conditional space-time prompt distributions that adapt a frozen backbone to each task while preserving prior knowledge, extending static prompt-based methods to distribution-level conditioning. No quantitative results are reported in the provided abstract.
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.assessment: 将 prompt 学习从静态参数推广到条件化时空分布，对视频增量学习是有意义的探索，但需关注其计算开销与在标准视频基准上的实证强度。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.contribution: 提出条件化时空提示分布用于视频类增量学习。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.innovation: 把增量 prompt 由固定向量扩展为随任务/类别条件的时空分布。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D._arxiv_id: Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions for Video Class-Incremental Learning.

Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的域增量学习（Domain-Incremental Learning）中跨域分布偏移导致的遗忘问题，提出双重巩固（Dual Consolidation）框架。方法通过两个互补的巩固机制（如参数层面与表征层面的巩固）在持续适应新域的同时稳定旧域知识。相比已有基于预训练模型的增量方法，其改进在于同时约束参数与特征空间以缓解域间干扰。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_en: This paper targets domain-incremental learning with pre-trained models, where cross-domain distribution shifts cause forgetting. It proposes a Dual Consolidation framework that jointly stabilizes parameters and representations while adapting to new domains, improving over prior pre-trained-model-based incremental methods. No quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.assessment: 预训练模型时代的域增量学习是当前热点，双重巩固思路合理，但需看其在 DomainNet 等基准上的实际增益。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.contribution: 提出双重巩固框架用于基于预训练模型的域增量学习。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.innovation: 从参数与表征两个层面协同巩固以缓解跨域遗忘。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model._arxiv_id: Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model-Based Domain-Incremental Learning.

2503.17677|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中基于原型的方法表征能力不足、特征重叠严重从而导致类间混淆的问题，提出 Confusion-REduced AuTo-Encoder 分类器（CREATE）。方法为每个类学习隐空间中紧凑的流形，用轻量自编码器约束样本仅在语义正确的自编码器上重建良好，并引入混淆感知的隐空间分离损失，使同类样本在低维流形上聚集、异类特征相互远离。相比原型类方法，其改进在于同时提升表征稳定性与类分布可分性，缓解类间混淆。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles class-wise confusion in class-incremental learning caused by limited representation capacity and feature overlap in prototype-based methods. It proposes CREATE, which learns a compact latent manifold per class via lightweight auto-encoders with correct-class-only reconstruction, plus a confusion-aware latent separation loss to pull same-class features together and push others apart. This improves representation stability and class separability over prior prototype methods; no numerical results are reported in the abstract.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 从流形学习角度切入类增量中的混淆问题，思路清晰且与原型方法互补，值得关注其在大规模 CIL 基准上的表现。
2503.17677|v2.contribution: 提出基于自编码器流形与混淆感知分离损失的 CIL 分类器 CREATE。
2503.17677|v2.innovation: 用类专属自编码器流形约束重建并配合隐空间分离损失抑制类间混淆。
2503.17677|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中新类样本极少导致的多模态表征偏置问题，提出免训练的双层模态校准（Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration）。方法在不额外训练的前提下，从模态层面与层级层面对预训练多模态特征进行校准，缓解新类与基类之间的表征失衡。相比需要微调或额外训练的 FSCIL 方法，其改进在于零训练成本即可提升新类判别性。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses representation bias in few-shot class-incremental learning where novel classes have very few samples. It proposes a training-free bi-level modality calibration that adjusts pre-trained multimodal features at both modality and level granularity without additional training, improving novel-class discrimination over fine-tuning-based FSCIL methods. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.assessment: 免训练校准在 FSCIL 中具有实用价值，但需验证其在标准 FSCIL 协议下的稳定性与泛化性。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.contribution: 提出免训练的双层模态校准用于小样本类增量学习。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.innovation: 在不训练的前提下从模态与层级两个维度校准预训练特征。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea._arxiv_id: Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning via Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration.

2412.18219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中灾难性遗忘与可扩展性（推理时间随任务增长）之间的权衡问题，提出 Adapter Merging with Centroid Prototype Mapping（ACMap），一种无样本（exemplar-free）框架。方法将各任务专属 adapter 合并为单一 adapter，构建共享子空间以对齐任务表征并缓解遗忘，同时用质心原型映射在共享子空间内持续适配表征以保持精度，并引入早停策略限制任务增多时的合并规模。在五个基准数据集上，ACMap 精度与 SOTA 相当，推理时间与最快方法相当，实现跨任务恒定推理开销。
2412.18219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between catastrophic forgetting and scalability in exemplar-free class-incremental learning. ACMap merges task-specific adapters into a single shared-subspace adapter for constant inference time, and uses centroid prototype mapping plus early stopping to preserve accuracy as tasks grow. On five benchmarks it matches state-of-the-art accuracy while keeping inference time comparable to the fastest methods.
2412.18219|v2.assessment: 同时解决遗忘与推理效率，且无样本、代码开源，工程与学术价值兼具，适合关注可扩展 CIL 的研究者。
2412.18219|v2.contribution: 提出无样本的 adapter 合并加质心原型映射框架 ACMap。
2412.18219|v2.innovation: 将任务 adapter 合并为共享子空间单一 adapter 并用早停控制合并规模，实现恒定推理时间。
2412.18219|v2.result: 在五个基准上精度匹配 SOTA，推理时间与最快方法相当。

Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（Pre-trained Model-based CIL）中知识易被覆盖、旧类信息难以复用的问题，提出知识记忆与反刍（Knowledge Memorization and Rumination）机制。方法通过显式记忆预训练模型中的通用知识，并在增量阶段以反刍方式重新激活/回放这些知识，以缓解遗忘并提升新类学习效率。相比直接微调或 prompt 类方法，其改进在于强调对预训练知识的保留与再利用。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_en: This paper targets class-incremental learning with pre-trained models, where prior knowledge is easily overwritten. It proposes a knowledge memorization and rumination mechanism that explicitly stores general knowledge from the pre-trained model and reactivates it during incremental stages to mitigate forgetting and aid novel-class learning. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.assessment: 以'记忆—反刍'类比组织预训练知识复用，概念新颖，但需实证其相对 prompt/adapter 类方法的优势。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.contribution: 提出知识记忆与反刍机制用于基于预训练模型的类增量学习。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.innovation: 显式记忆并周期性反刍预训练知识以缓解遗忘。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo._arxiv_id: Knowledge Memorization and Rumination for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning.

2503.22163|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中模型置信度校准被忽视的问题展开研究，指出现有的事后校准方法依赖充足验证集，而CIL中旧任务数据受限于有限记忆，难以满足这一前提。为此提出T-CIL，一种无需旧任务验证集的温度缩放方法，利用记忆中的样本并施加对抗扰动，通过基于特征距离调整扰动方向，使旧任务的扰动强度大于新任务，且扰动幅度仅由新任务验证集确定。该方法的关键在于利用旧任务准确率通常低于新任务的趋势，使新任务上确定的扰动幅度同样适用于旧任务。实验表明T-CIL在保持校准性能的同时无需额外旧任务验证数据，有效解决了CIL场景下的校准难题。
2503.22163|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked problem of confidence calibration in class-incremental learning (CIL), where limited memory of old-task data makes standard post-hoc calibration impractical. It proposes T-CIL, a temperature scaling approach that leverages adversarially perturbed exemplars from memory, with perturbation direction adjusted by feature distance to apply stronger perturbations to old tasks than to the new task, using a single magnitude determined from the new-task validation set. The method exploits the tendency that old-task accuracy is lower than new-task accuracy, enabling the new-task-derived magnitude to transfer to old tasks. Experiments demonstrate effective calibration without requiring a validation set for old tasks.
2503.22163|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将置信度校准引入类增量学习，提出的无旧任务验证集温度缩放方案具有实际意义，但整体影响力受限于CIL这一相对窄的领域。
2503.22163|v2.contribution: 提出T-CIL，首个无需旧任务验证集的类增量学习温度缩放校准方法。
2503.22163|v2.innovation: 利用对抗扰动方向基于特征距离调整，使新任务确定的扰动幅度可迁移至旧任务。
2503.22163|v2.result: 在无需旧任务验证集的条件下实现了有效的置信度校准，缓解了CIL中的校准退化问题。

2502.20032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中模型性能对类别到达顺序高度敏感、尤其当顺序引入的类别间相似度高时性能显著下降的问题展开研究。作者首先通过理论分析证明，在增量阶段将低成对相似度的类别分组可显著提升模型对顺序变化的鲁棒性。基于此提出GDDSG方法，利用图着色算法动态地将类别划分为相似度约束的组，每组训练一个独立的CIL子模型并构建元特征用于类别组识别。实验表明该方法有效解决了类别顺序敏感性问题，在模型准确率和抗遗忘性能上均达到最优。
2502.20032|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the understudied challenge of class order sensitivity in class-incremental learning (CIL), where performance degrades significantly when sequentially introduced classes are highly similar. Through theoretical analysis, the authors prove that grouping classes with lower pairwise similarity during incremental phases improves robustness to order variations. They propose Graph-Driven Dynamic Similarity Grouping (GDDSG), which employs graph coloring to dynamically partition classes into similarity-constrained groups, training an isolated CIL sub-model per group and constructing meta-features for group identification. Experiments show the method effectively addresses order sensitivity while achieving optimal accuracy and anti-forgetting performance.
2502.20032|v2.assessment: 该工作从理论和实践两方面系统性地解决了CIL中一个被忽视但重要的问题——类别顺序敏感性，图着色分组策略具有新意，但多子模型架构可能带来额外开销。
2502.20032|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究并理论分析了CIL中的类别顺序敏感性问题，提出基于图着色的动态相似度分组方法GDDSG。
2502.20032|v2.innovation: 利用图着色算法动态划分相似度约束的类别组，每组训练独立子模型并构建元特征进行组识别。
2502.20032|v2.result: 有效缓解了类别顺序敏感性问题，在准确率和抗遗忘指标上均取得最优性能。

2506.15720|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中模型因大幅更新而遗忘旧概念并对少量新样本过拟合的问题展开研究。现有主流方法通常将表示学习与分类头解耦，在基类上学习泛化特征提取器后在增量阶段冻结，但作者认为固定特征提取器限制了模型对新类的适应性。为此提出三分权重空间集成方法Tri-WE，在权重空间中对基模型、前一模型和当前模型进行插值，尤其针对分类头，从而协同维护基类和前序模型的知识。此外还解决了从先前模型蒸馏泛化表示的挑战。实验表明该方法能有效缓解灾难性遗忘和过拟合。
2506.15720|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and overfitting in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where models undergo substantial updates with only a few new examples. Unlike mainstream approaches that freeze a base-class feature extractor, the authors argue that a fixed extractor limits adaptability to new classes and propose a tripartite weight-space ensemble (Tri-WE) that interpolates the base, immediately previous, and current models in weight space, particularly for classification heads, to collaboratively maintain knowledge. The method also tackles the challenge of distilling generalized representations from previous models. Experiments demonstrate effective mitigation of forgetting and overfitting.
2506.15720|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战了FSCIL中冻结特征提取器的主流范式，提出的权重空间集成策略简洁有效，但整体性能提升幅度和与SOTA的对比需进一步验证。
2506.15720|v2.contribution: 提出Tri-WE三分权重空间集成方法，实现FSCIL中全模型的可更新性。
2506.15720|v2.innovation: 在权重空间中对基、前序和当前模型进行插值，协同维护跨任务知识。
2506.15720|v2.result: 有效缓解了FSCIL中的灾难性遗忘和过拟合问题。

2409.14983|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无样本类增量学习（NECIL）中因无法存储旧任务样本而加剧的灾难性遗忘问题展开研究。提出DIA框架，包含任务特定适配器集成（TSAI）和块级模型对齐两个核心组件。TSAI通过块级适配器集成策略提升组合性，在保持低计算成本的同时提供更灵活的复合方案；块级模型对齐通过块级蒸馏损失（PDL）和块级特征重建（PFR）两个机制维护特征一致性和准确决策边界，其中PDL基于块令牌对新类学习的贡献实现蒸馏，PFR通过重建旧类特征实现分类器对齐。实验表明DIA在NECIL设定下有效缓解了遗忘问题。
2409.14983|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in non-exemplar class incremental learning (NECIL), where the absence of old-task data exacerbates the challenge. It proposes DIA, a framework comprising Task-Specific Adapter Integration (TSAI) and Patch-Level Model Alignment. TSAI enhances compositionality via patch-level adapter integration at low computation cost, while Patch-Level Model Alignment maintains feature consistency and accurate decision boundaries through a Patch-Level Distillation Loss (PDL) and a Patch-Level Feature Reconstruction method (PFR). PDL preserves feature-level consistency based on patch token contributions to new class learning, and PFR reconstructs old class features for classifier alignment. Experiments demonstrate effective forgetting mitigation in NECIL.
2409.14983|v2.assessment: 该工作将适配器集成与块级对齐结合用于无样本增量学习，思路合理，但各组件贡献的消融分析和与最新方法的对比需更充分。
2409.14983|v2.contribution: 提出DIA框架，通过任务特定适配器集成和块级模型对齐解决NECIL中的灾难性遗忘。
2409.14983|v2.innovation: 块级适配器集成策略与基于块令牌贡献的蒸馏损失和特征重建机制。
2409.14983|v2.result: 在无样本类增量学习设定下有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。

2106.10456|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不足的问题，本文在teacher-student双模型框架下提出改进方法。具体包括：用指数移动平均在线更新teacher、使用大量region proposals和软伪标签作为student训练目标、以及轻量级的检测专用数据集成来生成更可靠的伪标签。相比STAC使用稀疏硬伪标签，本方法让teacher向student传递更丰富的信息。在VOC07 val上达到53.04% AP，比STAC高8.4%；在MS-COCO test-dev上以ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN达到53.8% AP，比全监督高3.1%。
2106.10456|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of generating reliable pseudo-labels for semi-supervised object detection within a teacher-student framework. It proposes exponential moving averaging for online teacher updates, soft pseudo-labels on dense region proposals as student targets, and a lightweight detection-specific data ensemble for the teacher. Compared to STAC which uses sparse hard pseudo-labels, the method exposes richer information to the student. It achieves 53.04% AP on VOC07 val (8.4% better than STAC) and 53.8% AP on MS-COCO test-dev, surpassing fully supervised ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN by 3.1%.
2106.10456|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地改进了半监督检测中teacher-student框架的伪标签生成与利用方式，实验充分且提升显著，对半监督目标检测研究有较强参考价值。
2106.10456|v2.contribution: 提出基于软伪标签和检测专用数据集的teacher-student半监督目标检测框架，显著优于STAC。
2106.10456|v2.innovation: 用大量proposals上的软伪标签替代稀疏硬伪标签，并引入轻量级检测专用数据集成提升伪标签可靠性。
2106.10456|v2.result: VOC07 val达53.04% AP（+8.4% vs STAC），MS-COCO test-dev达53.8% AP（+3.1% vs 全监督）。

2107.04384|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度网络持续学习中灾难性遗忘的理论机制不清晰的问题，本文在teacher-student理论框架下研究任务相似性对遗忘和迁移的影响。将之前两层网络的分析工作扩展到多teacher设定，每个teacher代表一个不同任务，从而将任务相似性解耦为readout层（隐层到输出权重）和特征层（输入到隐层权重）两个维度。发现当任务依赖相似特征时，中等任务相似度导致最大遗忘，且特征相似性只是任务关联的一种方式。
2107.04384|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the theoretical underpinnings of catastrophic forgetting in continual learning using a multi-teacher teacher-student framework. By extending prior analytical work on two-layer networks to multiple teachers, each representing a distinct task, it disentangles task similarity at the readout (hidden-to-output) and feature (input-to-hidden) levels. The study finds that intermediate task similarity leads to greatest forgetting when tasks share similar features, and that feature similarity is only one dimension of task relatedness.
2107.04384|v2.assessment: 该工作从理论角度剖析持续学习中的遗忘机制，对理解任务相似性与遗忘的关系有启发意义，但偏理论分析，与视觉感知应用距离较远。
2107.04384|v2.contribution: 在多teacher的teacher-student理论框架下解耦任务相似性对持续学习遗忘与迁移的影响。
2107.04384|v2.innovation: 将任务相似性分解为readout层和特征层两个维度，揭示中等特征相似度导致最大遗忘的规律。
2107.04384|v2.result: 发现特征相似时中等任务相似度导致最大遗忘，且特征相似性并非任务关联的唯一维度。

2110.12724|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中不同位置的特征对检测目标贡献不同、导致蒸馏难以平衡的问题，本文提出实例条件知识蒸馏框架。该框架引入可学习的条件解码模块，以每个目标实例为query检索信息，将条件信息编码为query、teacher表示作为key，通过注意力衡量不同特征的贡献，并由定位-识别敏感的辅助任务引导。实验表明，在1x schedule下将ResNet-50 RetinaNet从37.4提升至40.7 mAP（+3.3），甚至超过ResNet-101 teacher在3x schedule下的40.4 mAP。
2110.12724|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of balancing knowledge distillation for object detection, where features at different locations contribute unequally to detection targets. It proposes a conditional distillation framework with a learnable conditional decoding module that retrieves information using each target instance as query and teacher representations as key, with attention measuring feature contributions guided by a localization-recognition-sensitive auxiliary task. The method boosts RetinaNet with ResNet-50 from 37.4 to 40.7 mAP (+3.3) under 1x schedule, surpassing the ResNet-101 teacher (40.4 mAP) under 3x schedule.
2110.12724|v2.assessment: 该工作针对检测蒸馏中特征贡献不均衡的核心问题提出了优雅的实例条件注意力方案，提升显著且超过teacher，对检测蒸馏研究有重要参考价值。
2110.12724|v2.contribution: 提出实例条件知识蒸馏框架，通过条件解码模块和注意力机制实现检测中逐实例的知识蒸馏。
2110.12724|v2.innovation: 以目标实例为query、teacher表示为key，用注意力衡量特征贡献，并由定位-识别敏感辅助任务引导。
2110.12724|v2.result: RetinaNet ResNet-50从37.4提升至40.7 mAP（+3.3），超过ResNet-101 teacher的40.4 mAP。

2201.10207|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对语音预训练中训练成本高和噪声鲁棒性差的问题，提出了SPIRAL方法。SPIRAL在教师-学生框架下学习扰动数据的去噪表示，通过话语内对比损失和位置随机化防止表示坍缩，并采用多条件预训练提升噪声鲁棒性。相比wav2vec 2.0，SPIRAL在BASE和LARGE模型上分别减少80%和65%的训练成本，同时取得有竞争力或更好的结果。该工作属于语音领域，与视觉/自动驾驶研究无关。
2201.10207|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high training cost and noise robustness in speech pre-training by proposing SPIRAL, a teacher-student framework that learns denoising representations of perturbed data with in-utterance contrastive loss and position randomization. SPIRAL reduces training cost by 80% (BASE) and 65% (LARGE) compared to wav2vec 2.0 while achieving competitive or better results. It is a speech-domain work, irrelevant to vision or autonomous driving.
2201.10207|v2.assessment: 该论文在语音自监督学习领域有创新，但与视觉/自动驾驶感知无关，不值得本领域研究者关注。
2201.10207|v2.contribution: 提出SPIRAL语音预训练方法，通过教师-学生框架和对比学习实现高效去噪表示学习。
2201.10207|v2.innovation: 结合话语内对比损失、位置随机化和多条件预训练，在降低训练成本的同时提升噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.result: 相比wav2vec 2.0，BASE模型训练成本降低80%，LARGE模型降低65%，且性能相当或更优。

2205.15156|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测器计算开销大的问题，探索知识蒸馏（KD）在高效3D检测器中的应用。作者首先从模型压缩和输入分辨率降低角度构建了六个教师-学生对，并建立了2D KD方法在3D检测上的基准；进而提出改进的KD流程，包括仅在教师分类响应关键位置进行logit KD的增强方法，以及通过权重继承实现教师引导的学生模型初始化。在Waymo数据集上，最佳模型达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超越教师模型且仅需44%的计算量。
2205.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of 3D object detectors by exploring knowledge distillation (KD) for efficient pillar- and voxel-based detectors. The authors construct six teacher-student pairs, benchmark 2D KD methods on 3D detection, and propose an improved KD pipeline with enhanced logit KD on pivotal positions and teacher-guided student initialization via weight inheritance. On Waymo, the best model achieves 65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH, surpassing its teacher while requiring only 44% of the computation.
2205.15156|v2.assessment: 该工作系统地将知识蒸馏引入3D检测，提出了有效的改进策略，并在Waymo上验证了其优越性，对高效3D感知研究有重要参考价值。
2205.15156|v2.contribution: 构建了3D检测知识蒸馏基准，并提出增强的logit KD和教师引导学生初始化方法。
2205.15156|v2.innovation: 仅在教师分类响应的关键位置进行logit蒸馏，并通过权重继承传递特征提取能力。
2205.15156|v2.result: 在Waymo上达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超越教师模型且计算量仅为其44%。

2210.04208|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云分析中单模态表示学习的瓶颈，提出利用视图图像（渲染或投影的2D图像）进行跨模态训练（PointCMT）。PointCMT采用教师-学生框架，将跨模态学习形式化为知识蒸馏问题，通过特征和分类器增强准则消除模态分布差异，避免负迁移。实验表明，PointCMT在不修改网络架构的情况下显著提升了纯点云表示的性能。该工作属于3D形状分析领域，与自动驾驶中的3D检测有一定关联但非直接相关。
2210.04208|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the bottleneck of single-modality representation learning in point cloud analysis by leveraging view images through a cross-modal training strategy (PointCMT). PointCMT uses a teacher-student framework and formulates cross-modal learning as knowledge distillation, with feature and classifier enhancement criteria to eliminate modality discrepancy and avoid negative transfer. Experiments show significant gains in point-only representation without architecture modification. It is a 3D shape analysis work, tangentially related to autonomous driving 3D detection.
2210.04208|v2.assessment: 该工作为点云分析提供了有效的跨模态蒸馏思路，但其应用场景为形状分类/分割，对自动驾驶3D检测的直接影响有限。
2210.04208|v2.contribution: 提出PointCMT跨模态训练策略，利用视图图像通过知识蒸馏提升点云表示。
2210.04208|v2.innovation: 通过特征和分类器增强准则消除模态差异，避免负迁移，且不修改网络架构。
2210.04208|v2.result: 在多个数据集和骨干网络上显著提升了纯点云表示的性能。

2208.12262|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP类视觉-语言对比预训练只关注全局文本相关表征、缺乏局部patch语义监督的问题，本文提出MaskCLIP框架，将掩码自蒸馏（从完整图像表征蒸馏到掩码图像预测表征）引入对比语言-图像预训练。掩码自蒸馏面向局部patch表征学习，与视觉-语言对比互补，且训练目标一致（均用视觉编码器做特征对齐），从而借助语言间接监督学习局部语义；对称地在文本分支也引入局部语义监督。在多种下游任务上，MaskCLIP在线性探测、微调、零样本检索等设置下均取得优于CLIP等基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2208.12262|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MaskCLIP, which integrates masked self-distillation into contrastive language-image pretraining by distilling full-image representations into predictions from masked images. Masked self-distillation targets local patch representation learning, complementary to vision-language contrastive learning, and receives indirect language supervision since both objectives align features through the visual encoder. Symmetric local semantic supervision is further added to the text branch, and extensive experiments show superior results on linear probing, fine-tuning, and other downstream tasks.
2208.12262|v2.assessment: 将掩码自蒸馏与CLIP式对比学习结合，思路简洁且对多模态预训练有普适参考价值，实验分析较充分。
2208.12262|v2.contribution: 提出MaskCLIP，把掩码自蒸馏引入视觉-语言对比预训练以增强局部语义表征。
2208.12262|v2.innovation: 利用掩码自蒸馏与视觉-语言对比在训练目标上的一致性，使局部语义获得语言的间接监督，并对称扩展到文本分支。
2208.12262|v2.result: 在线性探测、微调等多种下游任务上取得优于现有对比预训练方法的结果。

2302.14250|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱增量语义分割（WILSS）中仅用图像级标签难以定位新类、且易遗忘旧类的问题，本文提出数据高效的FMWISS框架。方法先用基于预训练的协同分割，从互补的基础模型中蒸馏知识生成稠密伪标签；再用教师-学生架构优化含噪伪掩码，其中插件式教师用提出的稠密对比损失优化；并引入基于记忆的复制粘贴增强以缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有WILSS方法，该框架在图像级监督下提升了新类分割质量并更好保持旧类性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2302.14250|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation (WILSS), where new classes must be learned from cheap image-level labels that lack localization detail. It proposes FMWISS, a data-efficient framework that distills complementary foundation models via pre-training-based co-segmentation to generate dense pseudo labels, refines noisy pseudo masks with a teacher-student architecture using a dense contrastive loss, and introduces memory-based copy-paste augmentation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. The approach improves new-class segmentation under image-level supervision while preserving old-class performance.
2302.14250|v2.assessment: 把基础模型知识蒸馏与增量分割结合，为弱监督增量学习提供了实用范式，值得关注。
2302.14250|v2.contribution: 提出FMWISS框架，用基础模型协同分割与教师-学生优化实现弱增量语义分割。
2302.14250|v2.innovation: 以预训练协同分割蒸馏互补基础模型生成稠密伪标签，并用稠密对比损失优化插件教师。
2302.14250|v2.result: 在图像级标签下提升新类分割并缓解旧类遗忘，优于现有WILSS方法。

2311.13930|v2.summary_cn: 针对无源域目标检测（SFOD）中主流mean-teacher自训练范式因域偏移导致教师模型崩溃、进而使学生模型性能骤降的训练不稳定问题，本文提出周期交换教师-学生（PETS）方法。PETS构建由静态教师、动态教师和学生组成的多教师框架：训练中周期性交换静态教师与学生模型的权重，动态教师则用已被静态教师交换过的学生模型做移动平均更新，从而整合历史周期知识、减少误差累积。该方法使MT框架训练更稳定，在SFOD基准上取得更优的适应性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2311.13930|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the training instability of mean-teacher self-training in source-free object detection (SFOD), where teacher collapse under domain shift degrades the student. It proposes Periodically Exchange Teacher-Student (PETS), a multiple-teacher framework with a static teacher, a dynamic teacher, and a student, where weights between the static teacher and student are periodically exchanged and the dynamic teacher is updated as a moving average of the exchanged student. This integrates knowledge from past periods, reduces error accumulation, and yields more stable and effective adaptation.
2311.13930|v2.assessment: 对SFOD中教师崩溃问题给出了简单有效的多教师权重交换方案，工程实用性强。
2311.13930|v2.contribution: 提出PETS多教师框架，通过周期交换静态教师与学生权重稳定无源域目标检测的自训练。
2311.13930|v2.innovation: 用静态教师-学生权重周期交换配合动态教师移动平均，缓解mean-teacher的误差累积。
2311.13930|v2.result: 在SFOD设定下训练更稳定并获得优于现有自训练方法的检测性能。

Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中教师-学生自训练易受伪标签噪声与域偏移影响的问题，提出掩码重训练（Masked Retraining）教师-学生框架（因摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认）。其核心思路应是通过掩码机制对教师-学生训练进行重训练式优化，以提升跨域检测的鲁棒性与稳定性。由于缺少摘要，无法引用具体实验数据与改进幅度。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_en: This paper targets domain adaptive object detection (DAOD), where teacher-student self-training is vulnerable to noisy pseudo labels and domain shift, and proposes a Masked Retraining teacher-student framework. The method presumably applies masking-based retraining to stabilize and improve cross-domain detection. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified.
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.assessment: 主题与域自适应检测高度相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.contribution: 提出用于域自适应目标检测的掩码重训练教师-学生框架。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.innovation: 将掩码重训练机制引入教师-学生自训练以应对域偏移下的伪标签噪声。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew._arxiv_id: Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework for Domain Adaptive Object Detection.

2308.00398|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端自动驾驶Teacher-Student范式中学生模型仍需从零学习规划头、受原始传感器输入冗余噪声与行为克隆因果混淆困扰的问题，本文提出DriveAdapter，探索直接复用强教师模型进行规划、让学生模型专注感知的解耦方案。方法通过适配器打破感知与规划的耦合壁垒，将教师的规划能力迁移给学生，同时保留学生仅用原始传感器输入的设定。相比现有耦合式与Teacher-Student方法，该方案在更少数据下取得更好的规划性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2308.00398|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the end-to-end autonomous driving Teacher-Student paradigm, where the student must still learn a planning head from scratch and suffers from redundant noisy sensor inputs and causal confusion in behavior cloning. It proposes DriveAdapter, which decouples perception and planning by directly reusing the strong teacher for planning while letting the student focus on perception. This breaks the coupling barrier and achieves better planning performance with less data than coupled and prior Teacher-Student approaches.
2308.00398|v2.assessment: 直面端到端自动驾驶中感知-规划耦合的核心痛点，解耦思路对领域有较强启发意义。
2308.00398|v2.contribution: 提出DriveAdapter，通过适配器解耦感知与规划，让学生专注感知、复用教师规划能力。
2308.00398|v2.innovation: 打破Teacher-Student范式中学生需从零学规划头的耦合限制，直接迁移教师规划策略。
2308.00398|v2.result: 在端到端自动驾驶基准上以更少数据取得优于现有方法的规划性能。

TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_cn: 该论文面向在线签名验证（Online Signature Verification）任务，提出TSOSVNet，采用教师-学生协同的知识蒸馏框架（因摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认）。其目标应是通过教师模型指导学生模型学习签名时序特征，以提升验证精度并可能压缩模型。由于缺少摘要，无法确认其相比已有OSV方法的改进点与具体实验数据。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_en: This paper proposes TSOSVNet, a teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation framework for online signature verification (OSV). The method presumably transfers temporal signature representations from a teacher to a student to improve verification accuracy and possibly efficiency. Due to the missing abstract, the specific improvements and quantitative results cannot be verified.

TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.innovation: 将协同式教师-学生知识蒸馏应用于签名时序特征学习。
