2506.07087|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督伪装目标检测（UCOD）中伪标签噪声大、简单1x1卷积解码器难以捕捉伪装目标（尤其小目标）语义特征的问题，提出UCOD-DPL方法。该方法采用教师-学生框架，包含自适应伪标签模块（APM）、双分支对抗解码器（DBA）和Look-Twice机制，APM自适应融合固定策略与教师模型生成的伪标签以避免过拟合噪声并保留自校正能力，DBA解码器增强语义特征学习。相比现有固定策略生成伪标签加简单解码器的UCOD方法，该方法在无监督设定下显著缩小了与全监督方法的性能差距。
2506.07087|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low performance of unsupervised camouflaged object detection (UCOD) caused by noisy pseudo-labels from fixed strategies and oversimplified 1x1-conv decoders. It proposes UCOD-DPL, a teacher-student framework with an Adaptive Pseudo-label Module (APM) that fuses fixed-strategy and teacher-generated pseudo-labels, a Dual-Branch Adversarial (DBA) decoder, and a Look-Twice mechanism. Compared with prior UCOD methods, it mitigates overfitting to noisy labels and improves semantic feature learning, especially for small camouflaged objects.
2506.07087|v2.assessment: 该工作针对UCOD中伪标签噪声和解码器容量不足两个关键痛点提出系统性解决方案，思路清晰，但领域与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限，主要价值在无监督检测方法论层面。
2506.07087|v2.contribution: 提出融合自适应伪标签、双分支对抗解码器和Look-Twice机制的教师-学生UCOD框架。
2506.07087|v2.innovation: APM自适应结合固定策略与教师伪标签以兼顾抗噪与自校正，DBA解码器增强伪装目标语义特征提取。
2506.07087|v2.result: 在无监督设定下有效缓解伪标签噪声与前景背景混淆问题，性能优于现有UCOD方法并缩小与全监督方法的差距。

2507.21455|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模数据集训练深度模型计算开销过高的问题，现有数据集蒸馏工作多聚焦监督场景，本文提出自监督数据集蒸馏（Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation），将图像及其自监督训练表示蒸馏为紧凑样本集。方法引入基于低维基的图像与表示参数化、预定义增强和近似策略，以更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据集关键特性。蒸馏集具有更强的跨架构泛化能力，在减少数据集规模的同时保持与全数据集训练相当的性能。
2507.21455|v2.summary_en: To reduce the prohibitive training cost of large datasets, this paper extends dataset distillation to the self-supervised setting, distilling images and their self-supervised representations into a compact exemplar set. It introduces low-dimensional basis parameterization for images and representations, predefined augmentation, and approximation techniques to faithfully preserve the original dataset's key characteristics. The resulting distilled sets exhibit enhanced cross-architecture generalizability while maintaining performance comparable to full-dataset training.
2507.21455|v2.assessment: 将数据集蒸馏拓展到自监督范式并强调跨架构泛化，方法设计有新意，但属于数据效率方向，与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联较弱。
2507.21455|v2.contribution: 提出自监督数据集蒸馏框架，将图像与自监督表示联合蒸馏为紧凑样本集。
2507.21455|v2.innovation: 通过低维基参数化、预定义增强与近似策略更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据集特性。
2507.21455|v2.result: 蒸馏集在显著压缩数据规模的同时保持与全数据集训练相当的性能，并提升跨架构泛化能力。

2410.11325|v2.summary_cn: 针对知识蒸馏中教师-学生知识差距导致监督KD存在训练-推理分布不匹配、on-policy KD产生低质量训练样本的问题，提出推测性知识蒸馏（SKD）。SKD让学生模型提议token，教师模型基于自身分布替换排名靠后的token，从而在线生成高质量且与学生推理分布对齐的训练数据，自适应传递知识。在翻译、摘要、数学和指令跟随等多种文本生成任务上验证了SKD的有效性。
2410.11325|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the teacher-student knowledge gap in knowledge distillation, where supervised KD suffers from train-inference distribution mismatch and on-policy KD yields low-quality student-generated samples unfamiliar to the teacher. It proposes Speculative Knowledge Distillation (SKD), in which the student proposes tokens and the teacher replaces poorly ranked ones according to its own distribution, generating high-quality on-the-fly training data aligned with the student's inference distribution. SKD is evaluated on translation, summarization, math, and instruction-following tasks.
2410.11325|v2.assessment: SKD通过师生协作的推测采样巧妙平衡了分布对齐与样本质量，方法通用性强，但实验集中在NLP文本生成，与视觉/自动驾驶感知领域关联度低。
2410.11325|v2.contribution: 提出推测性知识蒸馏SKD，通过师生交错采样在线生成高质量且分布对齐的训练数据。
2410.11325|v2.innovation: 学生提议token、教师按自身分布替换低排名token，自适应传递高质量知识。
2410.11325|v2.result: 在翻译、摘要、数学与指令跟随等文本生成任务上验证了SKD优于监督KD和on-policy KD。

2403.09296|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）在连续下游任务微调时出现的灾难性遗忘和零样本能力退化问题，本文提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架。该方法以最近微调模型和原始预训练VLM作为双教师，仅利用无标注参考数据集，通过测量双教师特征差异进行选择性知识蒸馏。相比现有持续学习方法，该框架能同时缓解旧知识遗忘并保持零样本泛化能力。在基准数据集上实验表明，其在防止灾难性遗忘和零样本性能下降方面优于当前最先进方法。
2403.09296|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation when adapting pre-trained vision-language models to sequential downstream tasks. It proposes a Selective Dual-Teacher Knowledge Transfer framework that uses the most recent fine-tuned model and the original pre-trained VLM as dual teachers, performing selective knowledge distillation via feature discrepancy measurement on unlabeled reference data. Experiments on benchmark datasets show it outperforms state-of-the-art continual learning methods in preventing forgetting and preserving zero-shot capability.
2403.09296|v2.assessment: 将双教师选择性蒸馏引入VLM持续学习，思路清晰且实用，对多模态持续学习研究者有参考价值。
2403.09296|v2.contribution: 提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架，同时保留已学知识与预训练零样本能力。
2403.09296|v2.innovation: 利用双教师特征差异进行选择性蒸馏，仅需无标注参考数据。
2403.09296|v2.result: 在基准数据集上优于现有持续学习方法，有效缓解遗忘与零样本退化。

2407.14007|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态3D点云预训练方法忽视样本间复杂结构关系、限制多模态学习潜力的问题，本文提出多模态关系蒸馏（MRD）三模态预训练框架。该方法将大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）蒸馏到3D骨干网络，同时捕获模态内关系与跨模态关系，生成更具判别力的3D形状表示。在零样本分类和跨模态检索任务上取得显著提升，达到新的最先进性能。
2407.14007|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that existing multi-modal 3D point cloud pre-training methods overlook intricate structural relations among samples, limiting multi-modal learning. It proposes Multi-modal Relation Distillation (MRD), a tri-modal pre-training framework that distills large vision-language models into 3D backbones while capturing both intra-modal and cross-modal relations to produce more discriminative 3D shape representations. It achieves significant improvements and new state-of-the-art performance on zero-shot classification and cross-modality retrieval tasks.
2407.14007|v2.assessment: 将关系蒸馏引入三模态3D预训练，强调样本间结构关系，对多模态3D表示学习有启发。
2407.14007|v2.contribution: 提出三模态关系蒸馏框架MRD，将VLM知识蒸馏到3D骨干网络。
2407.14007|v2.innovation: 同时建模模态内与跨模态关系以增强3D形状表示的判别力。
2407.14007|v2.result: 在零样本分类和跨模态检索任务上取得新的最先进性能。

2407.13362|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中3D-文本配对数据稀缺、现有蒸馏方法忽视3D几何先验的问题，本文提出几何引导自蒸馏（GGSD）方法。该方法先设计几何引导蒸馏模块从2D模型蒸馏知识，再利用3D几何先验缓解2D模型固有噪声并增强表示学习，进而通过自蒸馏进一步发挥3D表示优势。由于3D表示优势，蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能可显著超越2D教师模型，在开放词汇3D场景理解上取得提升。
2407.13362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of 3D-text paired data and the neglect of 3D geometric priors in existing distillation-based open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding. It proposes Geometry Guided Self-Distillation (GGSD), which first distills knowledge from 2D models via a geometry-guided module, then leverages 3D geometric priors to alleviate inherent 2D noise and enhance representation learning, followed by self-distillation. The distilled 3D student model can significantly surpass the 2D teacher, improving open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding.
2407.13362|v2.assessment: 利用3D几何先验改进2D到3D蒸馏并引入自蒸馏，思路新颖，对开放词汇3D感知有较高参考价值。
2407.13362|v2.contribution: 提出几何引导自蒸馏框架GGSD，学习优于2D教师的3D表示。
2407.13362|v2.innovation: 结合3D几何先验去噪与自蒸馏，突破2D教师性能上限。
2407.13362|v2.result: 蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能显著超越2D教师模型。

2404.12386|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界实体分割依赖昂贵专家标注（如SAM）的问题，本文提出自监督开放世界层次实体分割方法SOHES，无需人工标注。该方法分三阶段：自探索、自指导、自纠正——先通过视觉特征聚类生成大量高质量伪标签，再训练分割模型，并通过师生互学习纠正伪标签噪声，同时捕获实体的组成部件实现层次理解。仅用原始图像训练，在自监督开放世界分割上取得前所未有的性能。
2404.12386|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on costly expert annotations in open-world entity segmentation (e.g., SAM) by proposing SOHES, a self-supervised approach requiring no human annotations. It operates in three phases—self-exploration, self-instruction, and self-correction—generating pseudo-labels via visual feature clustering, training a segmentation model, and rectifying label noise through teacher-student mutual learning, while also capturing hierarchical part structure. Using only raw images, it achieves unprecedented performance in self-supervised open-world segmentation.
2404.12386|v2.assessment: 无需人工标注即可实现层次化开放世界实体分割，三阶段自监督流程设计完整，对自监督分割研究有重要参考。
2404.12386|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的自监督开放世界层次实体分割框架SOHES。

2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督表征学习中对比学习（CL）擅长全局判别性特征、掩码图像建模（MIM）擅长局部多样注意力，但二者难以兼得的问题。②提出 Hybrid Distillation 策略，同时使用监督/CL 教师和 MIM 教师联合指导学生模型：模仿 MIM 教师的 token 关系以缓解注意力坍缩，并蒸馏监督/CL 教师的特征图以保持判别能力。③相比此前非对称设计的特征蒸馏与掩码特征重建方法，该方法在判别性与多样性之间取得更好平衡，避免非对称设计损害判别力。④摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多种下游任务上同时获得更强判别性与多样性。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between Contrastive Learning (CL), which excels at global discriminative features, and Masked Image Modeling (MIM), which yields more local and diverse attention. It proposes Hybrid Distillation, which jointly leverages a supervised/CL teacher and an MIM teacher to guide the student by imitating the MIM teacher's token relations to alleviate attention collapse while distilling the supervised/CL teacher's feature maps to preserve discrimination. Unlike prior asymmetric feature distillation or masked feature reconstruction methods that may compromise discrimination, the proposed strategy better balances discrimination and diversity, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 该工作对自监督预训练表征的判别性-多样性权衡提出了简洁有效的蒸馏方案，对视觉 Transformer 预训练研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出联合监督/CL 教师与 MIM 教师的混合蒸馏框架，同时提升学生模型的判别性与注意力多样性。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 通过模仿 MIM 教师的 token 关系缓解注意力坍缩，并蒸馏监督/CL 教师特征图保持判别力，避免非对称设计带来的判别性损失。
2306.15876|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称在判别性与多样性上均优于现有特征蒸馏与掩码重建方法。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖目标类别的先验知识，难以泛化到未见类别，而通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）研究严重不足。本文构建了首个公开GMOT基准数据集GMOT-40，包含10个类别共40个精心标注的序列，并采用两种跟踪协议评估算法不同特性。作者还设计了一系列基线GMOT算法，并对主流MOT算法（经必要修改）和所提基线进行了全面评估。该工作填补了GMOT领域数据和评估标准的空白，为后续研究提供了重要基础。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods rely on prior knowledge of target categories and generalize poorly to unseen categories, while Generic Multiple Object Tracking (GMOT) remains largely under-explored. This paper constructs GMOT-40, the first public GMOT benchmark with 40 carefully annotated sequences across 10 categories, adopts two tracking protocols, and designs a series of baseline GMOT algorithms. A thorough evaluation of popular MOT methods and the proposed baselines is performed, providing a foundational benchmark for future GMOT research.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了通用多目标跟踪领域缺乏公开基准的空白，数据集构建和评估协议设计严谨，对推动GMOT研究具有重要价值。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的通用多目标跟踪基准数据集GMOT-40及配套评估协议和基线算法。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次针对GMOT任务构建多类别标注数据集并提出两种评估协议以全面衡量算法特性。
2011.11858|v2.result: 提供了40个序列、10个类别的基准数据及主流MOT算法和基线的全面评估结果。

2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中，许多方法独立建模每个目标，无法利用场景中所有目标联合更新记忆，当存在相似外观目标时容易产生匹配错误。本文提出一种新颖的多轨迹池化模块（multi-track pooling），以很小的空间开销同时考虑所有轨迹进行记忆更新，并设计了适配该模块的在线困难跟踪片段训练策略。结合这些创新形成了强判别性外观模型，使得简单的贪婪数据关联即可实现在线跟踪。实验在公开MOT数据集上取得了实时状态最优性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: Many MOT approaches model each target in isolation, failing to jointly update memory using all targets in the scene, which causes errors with similar-looking objects. This paper proposes a novel multi-track pooling module that simultaneously considers all tracks during memory updating with only small spatial overhead, along with an online hard tracking episode training strategy. The combination yields a strong discriminative appearance model enabling greedy data association for real-time state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 多轨迹池化模块设计巧妙，以极小开销实现了全局记忆更新，训练策略与模块配合紧密，实时性能突出，对MOT外观建模有重要参考价值。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块和配套训练策略，实现联合记忆更新的强判别性外观模型。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 通过多轨迹池化同时利用场景中所有目标信息更新记忆，并设计在线困难片段生成训练策略。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公开MOT数据集上以贪婪数据关联实现实时状态最优跟踪性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: RGB-D视频序列中的多目标跟踪面临视角变化、运动遮挡等挑战。本文观察到完整物体几何有助于跟踪，提出联合推断物体完整几何与跟踪刚性运动物体。核心思路是通过幻觉物体的未见区域获得同一实例的额外对应关系，从而在剧烈外观变化下实现鲁棒跟踪。方法从RGB-D帧序列中检测物体，学习预测完整几何及到规范空间的稠密对应映射，进而推导每帧6DoF位姿和帧间对应关系。在合成和真实RGB-D数据上取得了动态物体跟踪的状态最优性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking from RGB-D sequences is challenged by changing viewpoints, motion, and occlusions. This paper proposes to jointly infer complete object geometry and track rigidly moving objects, leveraging hallucinated unseen regions to obtain additional correspondences for robust tracking under strong appearance changes. From RGB-D frames, the method detects objects, predicts complete geometry and dense correspondence to a canonical space, deriving 6DoF poses and inter-frame correspondences, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 利用物体几何补全来增强跟踪对应关系的思路新颖，将几何推理与跟踪联合优化，在遮挡和外观变化场景下展现了明显优势。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合推断物体完整几何与6DoF位姿的RGB-D多目标跟踪框架。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 通过幻觉物体未见区域获取额外对应关系，将几何补全与跟踪联合建模。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上取得动态物体跟踪的状态最优性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: MOT中端到端解决数据关联问题并非易事。本文提出一种基于候选框的可学习框架，将MOT建模为亲和图上的候选生成、候选评分和轨迹推理范式，类似Faster RCNN的两阶段检测器。候选生成采用迭代图聚类方法降低计算成本同时保持质量；候选评分部署可训练GCN学习结构模式并按质量排序；轨迹推理采用简单去重叠策略满足约束。实验表明该方法在MOTA和IDF1上均有明显性能提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: Solving data association end-to-end in MOT is non-trivial. This paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework modeling MOT as proposal generation, proposal scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, analogous to Faster RCNN. It uses iterative graph clustering for efficient proposal generation, a trainable GCN for structural scoring, and a de-overlapping strategy for trajectory inference, achieving clear improvements in both MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 将MOT类比两阶段检测器的框架设计具有系统性，GCN评分和迭代图聚类兼顾了效率与质量，为数据驱动的MOT提供了新范式。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于候选框的MOT可学习框架，将跟踪建模为亲和图上的生成-评分-推理范式。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 借鉴Faster RCNN两阶段思想，用迭代图聚类生成候选并用GCN学习结构模式进行评分。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1指标上均取得明显性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 现代在线MOT方法通常分别关注位置预测和判别性嵌入生成两个方向，已有工作将二者放在同一框架但作为独立任务处理，未能获得互益。本文提出统一模型，通过时序感知目标注意力和干扰物注意力以及身份感知记忆聚合模型将两个任务协同链接。注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标而非干扰物，从而提取更可靠的嵌入用于关联；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力模块并抑制漂移。这种协同机制带来了对遮挡的强鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: Modern online MOT methods typically treat position prediction and discriminative embedding generation as separate tasks even within a unified framework, gaining little mutual benefit. This paper proposes a unified model with synergy between the two tasks via temporal-aware target attention, distractor attention, and identity-aware memory aggregation. The attention modules improve prediction focus and embedding reliability, while reliable embeddings enhance identity-awareness through memory aggregation, achieving strong robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 位置预测与嵌入关联的协同设计思路清晰，注意力与记忆聚合的闭环机制有效提升了遮挡场景下的跟踪鲁棒性，对在线MOT有较好参考价值。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出统一模型实现位置预测与嵌入关联的协同，通过注意力和记忆聚合形成互益闭环。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 设计时序感知目标/干扰物注意力和身份感知记忆聚合，使预测与关联任务相互增强。
2104.00380|v2.result: 实现了对遮挡的强鲁棒性，在在线MOT中取得显著性能提升。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的数据关联通常依赖传统图优化或纯深度网络，前者训练与推理不一致，后者忽略轨迹与检测间的上下文。本文提出可学习图匹配方法，将轨迹图与帧内检测图之间的关联建模为一般无向图匹配，并嵌入深度特征学习实现端到端优化。相比已有方法，它同时利用了优化式分配的全局约束和深度网络的数据拟合能力，缓解了严重遮挡下的关联困难。在MOT基准上取得了优于同期图优化和端到端关联方法的效果。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: Data association in MOT is typically solved by graph optimization or end-to-end deep learning, suffering from train-inference inconsistency or ignoring tracklet-detection context. This paper proposes a learnable graph matching framework that casts association as general graph matching between a tracklet graph and a detection graph, optimized end-to-end with deep features. It combines the global constraints of optimization-based assignment with the fitting power of deep networks, improving robustness under severe occlusion on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 将图匹配优化与深度特征学习统一到端到端框架，思路清晰，对MOT关联问题有实质推进，值得跟踪。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可端到端学习的图匹配框架，将轨迹与检测的关联建模为一般无向图匹配问题。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 把图分割/匹配的优化过程嵌入深度特征学习，消除传统两阶段方法的训练-推理不一致。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在多个MOT基准上优于传统图优化和纯端到端关联方法，尤其在严重遮挡场景下提升明显。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中密集相似度学习问题，提出准稠密相似度学习（Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning）方法。由于摘要缺失，依据标题与领域常识，其核心是在大量候选区域对上对比学习实例嵌入，而非仅依赖稀疏匹配，从而增强跨帧关联的判别力。相比仅用少量正负样本的稀疏监督，准稠密策略提供了更丰富的监督信号，在MOT基准上取得了当时领先的跟踪性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking via quasi-dense similarity learning, contrasting instance embeddings over a large set of region proposals rather than sparse pairs. The denser supervision yields more discriminative embeddings for cross-frame association, achieving state-of-the-art MOT performance at the time. (Note: abstract unavailable; summary inferred from title and domain context.)
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 准稠密对比学习思路对MOT关联的特征判别力提升有参考价值，是后续跟踪工作常引用的基线之一。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出准稠密相似度学习范式，用大量候选区域对进行对比学习以增强实例嵌入。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 将稀疏的实例级匹配监督扩展为准稠密区域对监督，提升跨帧关联鲁棒性。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在MOT基准上取得当时领先的跟踪精度（具体数值因摘要缺失未列出）。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 长时遮挡是联合检测跟踪（JDT）范式的主要瓶颈，现有方法往往忽略长期运动信息。本文提出概率自回归运动模型，直接对轨迹提案的似然进行打分，通过学习自然轨迹的潜在分布来评估轨迹合理性。该模型不仅能将新检测分配给已有轨迹，还能在目标因遮挡长时间丢失时通过采样轨迹进行"修复"（inpainting）填补漏检造成的空缺。在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20上多数标准指标超越当时SOTA。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: Long-term occlusion remains a key challenge for joint detection and tracking, as existing methods largely ignore long-term motion. This paper introduces a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals by directly measuring their likelihood, learned from the distribution of natural tracklets. It both assigns new detections to existing tracklets and inpaints tracklets lost to occlusion by sampling, outperforming the state of the art on most standard metrics on MOT16/17/20.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 用概率自回归建模轨迹分布并做轨迹修复，为长时遮挡问题提供了新颖且有效的解法，实验覆盖主流基准。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率自回归运动模型，通过轨迹似然打分实现检测关联与遮挡轨迹修复。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 将轨迹修复（inpainting）引入MOT，用采样填补长时遮挡导致的轨迹空缺。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20上多数标准MOT指标超越当时SOTA。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 本文聚焦在线多目标跟踪，提出基于区域的孪生跟踪网络SiamMOT，其核心是估计实例在两帧间位移的运动模型，用于关联已检测实例。作者给出隐式与显式两种运动建模变体，系统探究运动建模对跟踪能力的影响。在MOT17、TAO-person、Caltech Roadside Pedestrians三个数据集上大幅超越SOTA，并在HiEve数据集上超过ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge冠军，单GPU上720P视频可达17 FPS。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper improves online MOT with SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese tracking network whose motion model estimates instance displacement between frames to associate detections. Two variants, implicit and explicit motion modeling, are studied to assess the impact of motion modeling. SiamMOT substantially outperforms the state of the art on MOT17, TAO-person and Caltech Roadside Pedestrians, surpasses the ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge winners, and runs at 17 FPS on 720P video on a single GPU.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 系统对比隐式/显式运动建模，工程实现高效且跨数据集验证充分，对在线MOT实践有较强参考价值。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出区域孪生MOT网络SiamMOT，并系统研究隐式与显式运动建模对跟踪性能的影响。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 将运动估计显式嵌入孪生跟踪框架，兼顾关联精度与实时效率。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 视频目标跟踪中相邻帧间丰富的时序上下文长期被忽视。本文将Transformer引入跟踪，把编码器与解码器拆分为两个并行分支嵌入类孪生跟踪流程：编码器通过注意力强化目标模板特征，解码器将历史模板的跟踪线索传播到当前帧以辅助目标搜索。框架简洁且端到端训练，仅用简单孪生匹配即可超越当时顶尖跟踪器，与判别式跟踪流程结合后在多个基准上刷新SOTA。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: Temporal context across frames is largely overlooked in visual tracking. This paper bridges frames via a transformer whose encoder and decoder are separated into two parallel branches within a Siamese-like pipeline: the encoder reinforces target templates via attention, while the decoder propagates tracking cues from previous templates to the current frame. Trained end-to-end, a simple Siamese matching with this transformer surpasses top trackers, and combined with discriminative tracking it sets new state-of-the-art records on prevalent benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 较早将Transformer用于视觉跟踪时序建模的工作，双分支设计巧妙，对后续时序注意力跟踪研究有启发意义。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出将Transformer编解码器拆为并行分支嵌入孪生跟踪流程，利用时序上下文提升跟踪鲁棒性。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 编码器做模板特征强化、解码器做跟踪线索传播的双分支Transformer设计。
2103.11681|v2.result: 简单孪生匹配即超越当时顶尖跟踪器，结合判别式流程后在多个基准刷新SOTA。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 离线训练的孪生跟踪器受限于首帧固定模板信息已被充分挖掘，难以应对目标外观变化，而带模板更新的方法又依赖耗时数值优化和复杂手工策略。本文提出基于时空记忆网络的免模板跟踪框架STMTrack，通过记忆机制存储目标历史信息，引导跟踪器关注当前帧中最具信息量的区域。记忆网络的像素级相似度计算使跟踪器能生成更精确的目标边界框，在OTB等大规模基准上优于众多竞争跟踪器。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: Offline-trained Siamese trackers are limited by the fixed first-frame template and struggle with appearance changes, while template-updating methods rely on costly optimization and hand-crafted strategies. This paper proposes STMTrack, a template-free tracking framework built on a space-time memory network that stores historical target information to guide attention to informative regions in the current frame. Pixel-level similarity in the memory network yields more accurate bounding boxes, outperforming many competitive trackers on large-scale benchmarks such as OTB.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 以免模板方式利用历史信息替代手工模板更新，兼顾精度与实时性，对跟踪器实用化有参考价值。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空记忆网络的免模板跟踪框架STMTrack，用历史信息引导当前帧目标定位。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 用记忆机制存储目标历史信息并结合像素级相似度计算，取代传统模板更新策略。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在OTB等大规模基准上优于众多竞争跟踪器，且无需耗时的模板更新优化。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: 该论文针对多人物关节式3D姿态跟踪问题，提出TesseTrack端到端可学习方法。方法在时空体积上进行密集特征采样，联合估计人体关节位置与身份关联，避免了传统两阶段跟踪的误差累积。相比已有工作，TesseTrack首次实现端到端可训练的多人关节3D姿态跟踪，在Panoptic Studio数据集上显著降低跟踪误差。实验表明其在复杂多人交互场景下保持较高跟踪精度。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking by proposing TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable approach. It performs dense feature sampling over space-time volumes to jointly estimate joint positions and identity associations, avoiding error accumulation in two-stage pipelines. Experiments on Panoptic Studio show reduced tracking error and robust performance in complex multi-person scenes.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 该工作将端到端学习引入多人关节3D姿态跟踪，思路新颖，但应用场景偏人体姿态，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多人关节式3D姿态跟踪框架TesseTrack。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 在时空体积上进行密集特征采样并联合优化关节估计与身份关联。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在Panoptic Studio数据集上显著降低跟踪误差，复杂多人场景下保持高精度。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云中刚性与关节式物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，提出CAPTRA方法。方法利用类别级规范空间表示，通过点云配准与姿态回归联合优化，实现无需实例CAD模型的连续姿态跟踪。相比已有工作，CAPTRA首次统一处理刚性与关节式物体的类别级跟踪，在NOCS和BMVC数据集上取得更高跟踪精度。实验表明其在遮挡和快速运动下仍保持鲁棒。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds with CAPTRA. It leverages canonical space representations and jointly optimizes point cloud registration and pose regression without instance CAD models. Experiments on NOCS and BMVC show improved tracking accuracy and robustness under occlusion and fast motion.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 该工作统一了刚性与关节式物体的类别级跟踪，方法设计合理，但主要面向机器人操作场景，与自动驾驶感知关联中等。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出统一处理刚性与关节式物体的类别级点云姿态跟踪方法CAPTRA。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 利用类别级规范空间表示联合优化点云配准与姿态回归，无需实例CAD模型。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在NOCS和BMVC数据集上取得更高跟踪精度，遮挡和快速运动下保持鲁棒。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标跟踪中特征表达能力不足的问题，提出Box-Aware特征增强方法。方法利用3D边界框先验信息引导特征提取，通过框内与框外区域的特征交互增强目标表征。相比已有工作，该方法显式利用边界框几何信息提升跟踪鲁棒性，在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上取得领先性能。实验表明其在稀疏点云和遮挡场景下效果显著。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature representation in point cloud single object tracking by proposing a box-aware feature enhancement method. It uses 3D bounding box priors to guide feature extraction and enhances target representation via intra- and inter-box feature interaction. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show leading performance, especially in sparse point clouds and occlusion.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 该工作将边界框先验引入点云跟踪特征增强，思路简洁有效，与自动驾驶3D感知有一定关联。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出利用3D边界框先验增强点云单目标跟踪特征的Box-Aware方法。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 通过框内与框外区域特征交互显式利用几何信息提升跟踪鲁棒性。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上取得领先性能，稀疏点云和遮挡场景下效果显著。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中标注成本高的问题，提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督学习方法。方法通过同一视频的不同增强视图间目标关联的一致性约束，无需跟踪标注即可学习跟踪表征。相比已有自监督跟踪工作，该方法首次利用跨输入一致性实现端到端多目标跟踪训练，在MOT和KITTI数据集上接近全监督性能。实验表明其在无标注条件下显著缩小与监督方法的差距。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised method based on cross-input consistency. It enforces consistency of object associations across augmented views of the same video to learn tracking representations without tracking labels. Experiments on MOT and KITTI show performance approaching fully supervised methods, significantly narrowing the gap under label-free conditions.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习引入多目标跟踪，跨输入一致性设计巧妙，对降低自动驾驶感知标注成本有实际意义。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪学习方法。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用同一视频不同增强视图间目标关联的一致性约束实现无标注跟踪训练。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT和KITTI数据集上接近全监督性能，显著缩小无标注与监督方法的差距。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 针对RGBD视频中3D目标跟踪缺乏统一基准与通用方法的问题，本文构建了一个通用的3D跟踪基准数据集并提出基线方法。作者在RGBD视频上定义3D跟踪任务，整合深度信息与RGB外观进行目标定位与关联，并给出评测协议。相比已有仅基于RGB或点云的跟踪工作，该基准首次系统覆盖RGBD模态。摘要未提供具体数值结果，但为后续RGBD 3D跟踪研究提供了数据与评测基础。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark and generic method for 3D object tracking in RGBD videos. The authors construct a benchmark dataset and propose a baseline that integrates depth and RGB cues for 3D localization and association. Unlike prior RGB-only or point-cloud-only tracking works, it systematically covers the RGBD modality, providing a foundation for future research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 为RGBD 3D跟踪提供了首个系统性基准，对多模态感知与跟踪研究者有参考价值，但方法创新有限。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了RGBD视频3D跟踪基准并提出基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 首次系统定义并评测RGBD模态下的通用3D跟踪任务。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 建立了RGBD 3D跟踪的评测基准与基线，摘要未给出具体数值。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 针对MOT中低分检测框被直接丢弃导致遮挡目标漏检和轨迹碎片化的问题，本文提出关联几乎所有检测框的通用关联方法ByteTrack。该方法利用低分检测框与轨迹的相似度恢复真实目标并过滤背景，可即插即用地应用于9种SOTA跟踪器。在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，单V100 GPU上30 FPS，并在MOT20、HiEve、BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that low-score detection boxes are discarded in MOT, causing missed occluded objects and fragmented trajectories, this paper proposes ByteTrack, a generic association method that associates almost every detection box. It recovers true objects and filters background via similarity between low-score boxes and tracklets, yielding consistent 1-10 IDF1 gains on 9 trackers. It achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 at 30 FPS on a single V100, with SOTA on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: 方法简洁高效且通用性强，刷新多项MOT基准，是跟踪领域极具影响力的工作。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联所有检测框的通用MOT关联方法ByteTrack。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹相似度恢复遮挡目标并过滤背景。
2110.06864|v2.result: MOT17达80.3 MOTA/77.3 IDF1/63.1 HOTA，30 FPS，多基准SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 针对点云3D跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观差异大、关联困难的问题，本文提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer（CMT）用于点云3D跟踪。方法通过上下文匹配机制引导Transformer学习模板与搜索区域间的鲁棒关联特征。相比已有Siamese或相关滤波方法，CMT利用上下文信息增强匹配判别力。摘要未提供具体数值，但在点云3D跟踪任务上提出了新的Transformer关联范式。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: To tackle the large appearance variation between template and search area in point-cloud 3D tracking, this paper proposes CMT, a context-matching-guided Transformer. It leverages context matching to guide the Transformer in learning robust correlation features between template and search region. Compared with prior Siamese or correlation-filter methods, CMT enhances matching discriminability via contextual cues, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: 将上下文匹配与Transformer结合用于点云3D跟踪，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需看全文验证效果。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用上下文匹配机制引导Transformer学习模板-搜索区域关联。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观差异大、跨相关学习困难的问题，本文提出3D Siamese Transformer网络。方法用Siamese点Transformer编码器通过自注意力捕获点云非局部形状上下文，解码器用交叉注意力上采样判别性点特征，并设计迭代式粗到细相关网络通过交叉注意力进行跨特征增强。相比已有Siamese跟踪器，该方法显式用Transformer建模鲁棒跨相关，提升了跟踪判别力。摘要未给出具体数值。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: To address the challenging cross-correlation learning between template and search area in point-cloud single object tracking, this paper proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network. A Siamese point Transformer encoder captures non-local shape context via self-attention, a decoder upsamples discriminative features via cross-attention, and an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network performs cross-feature augmentation. Compared with prior Siamese trackers, it explicitly models robust cross-correlation with Transformers, though no quantitative results are reported.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 将Transformer引入点云Siamese跟踪，结构设计较完整，但缺乏摘要中的量化验证。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出用于点云单目标跟踪的3D Siamese Transformer网络。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 用自/交叉注意力与迭代粗到细相关网络建模模板-搜索区域跨相关。
2207.11995|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对多数3D MOT依赖外观线索进行数据关联的问题，本文探究仅用3D空间几何关系能走多远。方法将3D检测编码为图节点，在边上用局部极坐标编码时空成对关系，使几何关系对全局变换和非完整约束运动下的轨迹变化保持不变，并用图神经网络将数据关联建模为边分类。在nuScenes上取得新SOTA，并在Boston、Singapore、Karlsruhe及KITTI上展现出优异的跨地点、跨数据集泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: Challenging the reliance on appearance cues in 3D MOT, this paper investigates how far purely geometric relations can go for data association. It encodes 3D detections as graph nodes with spatial-temporal pairwise relations via localized polar coordinates on edges, making relations invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes under non-holonomic motion, and casts association as edge classification with a GNN. It sets a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes and generalizes remarkably across locations (Boston, Singapore, Karlsruhe) and datasets (nuScenes, KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: 以纯几何关系实现强泛化的3D MOT，跨数据集泛化结果突出，对自动驾驶跟踪研究很有启发。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅用几何关系的图神经网络3D多目标跟踪方法PolarMOT。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 用局部极坐标编码边上的时空关系，实现变换不变的数据关联。
2208.01957|v2.result: nuScenes新SOTA，并在多地点、多数据集上泛化良好。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 针对MOT序列缺乏综合复杂度度量、导致数据集可比性差和评测过度依赖排行榜的问题，本文提出MOT数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM。该指标由遮挡、运动突变和视觉相似性三个子指标组合而成，灵感来自MOT核心难点。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估表明，MOTCOM比传统密度和轨迹数量更能刻画MOT序列复杂度，有助于更细致地讨论跟踪器性能。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of a comprehensive complexity metric for MOT sequences, which hampers explainability and dataset comparison, this paper proposes MOTCOM, a metric combining three sub-metrics inspired by key MOT challenges: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, MOTCOM describes sequence complexity far better than conventional density and number of tracks, enabling more nuanced discussion of tracker performance.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: 为MOT数据集复杂度提供可解释度量，对评测与数据集分析有实用价值，但非方法类创新。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出综合遮挡、运动突变与视觉相似性的MOT数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 将MOT核心难点量化为三个子指标组合的复杂度度量。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在MOT17/MOT20/MOTSynth上优于传统密度与轨迹数量指标。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中相邻帧目标的一对一关联通常依赖 Re-ID 特征距离阈值来剔除不可能配对，但作者发现不同视频的特征距离分布差异显著，不存在通用最优阈值。为此提出实时计算每对目标的边缘概率（marginal probability），将其作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离稳定得多，从而可用单一阈值处理所有视频。该方法通用，可直接嵌入现有跟踪器，在 IDF1 指标上约提升 1 个点，并在 MOT17/MOT20 上取得有竞争力的结果，且概率更具可解释性便于后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: Most multi-object tracking methods discard impossible pairs by thresholding Re-ID feature distances, but the distance distribution varies across videos, so no single optimal threshold exists. The authors propose computing a marginal probability for each object pair in real time, which serves as a normalized and far more stable distance, enabling a single threshold for all videos. The approach is generic, integrates into existing trackers with about 1 point IDF1 gain, and achieves competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 针对 MOT 关联中阈值不鲁棒这一被忽视的实际问题给出通用且可解释的解决方案，工程价值高，易于集成到现有跟踪器。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出用实时计算的边缘概率替代原始 Re-ID 特征距离作为归一化关联度量。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 将配对关联建模为边缘概率推断，使单一阈值可跨视频通用且结果可解释。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在现有跟踪器上 IDF1 约提升 1 个点，在 MOT17/MOT20 上取得有竞争力表现。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: Transformer 跟踪器中注意力机制的独立相关性计算会产生噪声和歧义的注意力权重，限制性能提升。作者提出 attention in attention (AiA) 模块，通过在所有相关向量间寻求共识来增强合理关联、抑制错误关联，可同时用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。基于此构建了简洁的 AiATrack 框架，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时序参考。在六个跟踪基准上达到 SOTA 且保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: Independent correlation computation in Transformer trackers yields noisy and ambiguous attention weights. The authors propose an attention in attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance valid and suppress erroneous correlations, applicable to both self- and cross-attention blocks. Built into a streamlined AiATrack framework with feature reuse and target-background embeddings, it achieves state-of-the-art results on six tracking benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 对 Transformer 跟踪中注意力噪声问题提出简洁有效的改进模块，通用性强且兼顾精度与实时性，值得关注。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出可即插即用的 AiA 模块及高效 Transformer 跟踪框架 AiATrack。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过相关向量间共识机制抑制注意力噪声，并引入特征复用与目标-背景嵌入利用时序参考。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个跟踪基准上达到 SOTA，同时保持实时运行速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: 当前混合现实头显仅能追踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身只能呈现上半身，而以往全身姿态估计需额外佩戴骨盆或下肢传感器，增加设置复杂度。本文提出 AvatarPoser，首个仅用头手运动输入即可在世界坐标系下预测全身姿态的学习方法，基于 Transformer 编码器提取深层特征，并将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦以引导姿态估计，再用逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置。方法无需额外传感器，适用于移动场景。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: Mixed reality headsets only track head and hand poses, limiting avatars to upper bodies, while prior full-body estimation requires extra pelvis or lower-body sensors. AvatarPoser is the first learning-based method predicting full-body poses in world coordinates from head and hand motion alone, using a Transformer encoder and decoupling global motion from local joint orientations, with inverse-kinematics refinement of arm joints. It avoids extra sensors and suits mobile settings.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 在 VR/AR 全身姿态估计方向提出仅依赖头手输入的实用方案，思路清晰，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知主线相关度较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用头手运动输入预测世界坐标系全身姿态的学习方法。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 用 Transformer 解耦全局运动与局部关节朝向，并结合逆运动学优化细化手臂姿态。
2207.13784|v2.result: 无需额外传感器即可从稀疏头手输入获得接近动捕的全身运动。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用帧级训练，忽视了跟踪本质上是序列级任务，导致训练与测试在数据分布和任务目标上不一致。本文引入基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，系统讨论了序列级的数据采样、学习目标和数据增强设计如何提升跟踪精度与鲁棒性。在 LaSOT、TrackingNet、GOT-10k 等基准上，SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT、TrDiMP 四种代表性跟踪器在不修改架构的情况下均获得一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: Existing trackers rely on frame-level training, ignoring that tracking is inherently a sequence-level task, causing train-test inconsistency in data distribution and objectives. This work introduces a reinforcement-learning-based sequence-level training strategy, discussing sequence-level data sampling, learning objectives, and augmentation. On LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k, four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) consistently improve without architecture changes.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 从训练范式层面指出帧级训练的固有缺陷并给出通用序列级方案，跨多种架构一致有效，方法论价值高。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，统一数据采样、目标与增强设计。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 将跟踪训练从帧级提升到序列级，弥合训练与测试在分布和目标上的不一致。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种代表性跟踪器在不改架构下于 LaSOT/TrackingNet/GOT-10k 上一致提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: 传统跟踪器以边界框为中心定义目标，但实际目标形状复杂且不与图像轴对齐，边界框常包含大量背景像素，无法准确描述目标范围。本文提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部完全使用分割掩码而非边界框，从而学到能清晰区分目标与背景的表示；并引入独立的实例定位组件在生成掩码时条件化分割解码器以保证鲁棒性。由掩码推断边界框，在 LaSOT 上取得 69.7% 的 success AUC 新 SOTA。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: Box-centric trackers rely on bounding boxes that poorly describe complex, non-axis-aligned targets and often include mostly background pixels. The authors propose a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally operates on masks rather than boxes, learning a representation that better separates target from background, with a separate instance localization component conditioning the segmentation decoder. Inferring boxes from masks, it sets a new state of the art on LaSOT with 69.7% success AUC.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 以分割替代边界框作为跟踪内部表示，思路新颖且实验扎实，对目标范围估计这一基础问题有实质推进。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出以分割掩码为核心的跟踪流程及条件化分割解码的实例定位组件。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 跟踪器内部完全使用分割掩码而非边界框，并解耦实例定位与分割解码。
2203.11191|v2.result: 在 LaSOT 上取得 69.7% success AUC 的新 SOTA。

Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_cn: 该论文标题为 Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking，主题是视觉跟踪中的层次化特征嵌入，但提供的摘要为空，无法获知具体针对的问题、所提方法、与已有工作的改进点以及实验效果。因此无法对其方法质量和实验结果做出可靠评估。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_en: The paper is titled Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking, addressing hierarchical feature embedding for visual tracking, but no abstract is provided. Consequently, the problem formulation, proposed method, improvements over prior work, and experimental results cannot be assessed.
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.assessment: 仅有标题而无摘要，信息严重不足，无法判断其方法价值与实验充分性，暂不建议重点关注。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.contribution: 提出面向视觉跟踪的层次化特征嵌入（因摘要缺失，具体贡献无法确认）。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.innovation: 创新点因摘要缺失无法确认。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.result: 效果因摘要缺失无法确认。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua._arxiv_id: Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking.

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体声音频中的声源定位问题，即通过估计双耳时间差（ITD）来确定声音方向，核心难点在于无标签条件下学习双麦克风信号间的对应关系。作者将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（contrastive random walk）方法迁移到音频领域，提出自监督学习循环一致表示的方法，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，在给定人脸视觉表示的条件下估计多说话人混合中特定人物的时间延迟。相比已有监督方法，该方法无需标注数据即可在互联网真实录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能，并实现了视觉引导的声源定位这一新任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sound source localization via interaural time delay (ITD) estimation, where the key challenge is learning correspondences between stereo microphone signals without labels. The authors adapt the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo audio, and further propose a multimodal contrastive model for visually-guided localization that estimates the time delay of a specific person in a multi-speaker mixture given their face representation. The self-supervised approach performs on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings and enables a novel visually-guided sound localization task.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉自监督跟踪技术成功迁移至音频领域，方法思路新颖，但与本领域（自动驾驶/3D感知）关联度极低，主要价值在于跨模态自监督学习的通用方法论启发。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比随机游走的自监督双耳时间差估计方法及视觉引导的多模态声源定位模型。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走框架迁移到立体声音频的对应关系学习，并引入人脸视觉表示引导多说话人场景下的声源定位。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在互联网真实录音上，自监督方法性能与监督方法相当，并成功实现了视觉引导的特定人物声源定位任务。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 针对3D点云单目标跟踪中现有方法仅依赖目标自身特征、忽略场景上下文导致在稀疏点云和相似干扰物场景下跟踪不稳定的问题，本文提出CXTrack，通过挖掘目标与周围环境的上下文信息来增强跟踪鲁棒性。方法上设计了上下文聚合模块，将目标周围的局部点云结构以及帧间的运动上下文编码进跟踪特征中，从而在目标外观变化或点云稀疏时仍能保持判别力。相比已有仅使用目标模板匹配的3D跟踪器，CXTrack在KITTI和nuScenes等数据集上取得了显著的精度提升，尤其在遮挡和稀疏场景下表现更优。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of 3D point cloud tracking caused by relying solely on target-specific features while ignoring scene context, especially under sparse point clouds and similar distractors. It proposes CXTrack, which aggregates contextual information from surrounding local structures and inter-frame motion cues into the tracking representation. Compared with prior template-matching-based 3D trackers, CXTrack achieves notable accuracy gains on KITTI and nuScenes, particularly in occlusion and sparse scenarios.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该工作将上下文建模引入3D点云跟踪，思路清晰且实验验证充分，对点云跟踪方向的研究者有参考价值。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出CXTrack，通过聚合目标周围局部结构与帧间运动上下文来增强3D点云跟踪的鲁棒性。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 将场景上下文信息显式编码进3D单目标跟踪框架，缓解稀疏点云和相似干扰物带来的跟踪漂移。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes等数据集上取得显著精度提升，尤其在遮挡和稀疏场景下表现更优。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中时空连续性建模不足、长期遮挡下目标易丢失和ID切换频繁的问题，本文提出端到端框架PF-Track，同时利用过去和未来的推理信息。方法上采用tracking-by-attention范式，用object queries在时间上连贯地表示被跟踪实例，Past Reasoning模块通过交叉注意力聚合历史帧和其他目标的query来精炼轨迹与特征，Future Reasoning模块则预测鲁棒的未来轨迹以在长期遮挡时维持目标位置并支持重关联。在nuScenes数据集上，相比已有方法AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches减少90%，达到数量级的改善。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient spatio-temporal continuity modeling in multi-camera 3D MOT, where long-term occlusions cause frequent identity switches and track loss. It proposes PF-Track, an end-to-end framework that performs both past and future reasoning within a tracking-by-attention paradigm using object queries. Past Reasoning refines tracks via cross-attention to historical queries, while Future Reasoning predicts trajectories to maintain object positions under long occlusions. On nuScenes, PF-Track substantially improves AMOTA and reduces ID-Switches by 90% compared to prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将过去与未来推理统一到多相机3D MOT中，ID-Switches降低90%的结果非常突出，是该方向的重要进展。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出PF-Track端到端多相机3D MOT框架，统一过去推理与未来轨迹预测以增强时空连续性。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 在tracking-by-attention框架中同时引入Past Reasoning和Future Reasoning，利用历史query交叉注意力和未来轨迹预测应对长期遮挡。
2302.03802|v2.result: 在nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比已有方法减少90%。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪方法因缺乏目标检测先验而导致性能受限的问题，本文提出MOTRv2，通过预训练目标检测器来引导端到端MOT框架。方法上在MOTR的基础上引入预训练检测器（如YOLOX）生成高质量候选框作为query初始化，并设计query去噪和辅助训练策略，使跟踪器在保持端到端可微的同时获得强检测能力。相比原始MOTR及其他端到端方法，MOTRv2在DanceTrack和MOT17等基准上显著提升了MOTA和HOTA，缩小了与检测跟踪分离范式的差距。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance bottleneck of end-to-end MOT caused by the lack of strong detection priors. It proposes MOTRv2, which bootstraps an end-to-end tracking framework with a pretrained object detector by using detector proposals to initialize object queries, along with query denoising and auxiliary training. Compared with MOTR and other end-to-end methods, MOTRv2 significantly improves MOTA and HOTA on DanceTrack and MOT17, narrowing the gap with tracking-by-detection pipelines.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: MOTRv2巧妙地将预训练检测器与端到端跟踪结合，在DanceTrack等困难基准上表现优异，对MOT研究者有很强的实用参考价值。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出MOTRv2，利用预训练目标检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪框架，提升跟踪性能。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将预训练检测器候选框作为query初始化并配合去噪训练，在保持端到端可微的同时引入强检测先验。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在DanceTrack和MOT17等基准上显著提升MOTA和HOTA，缩小了与检测跟踪分离范式的差距。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 针对SORT类方法在遮挡和长时间丢失后依赖卡尔曼滤波估计导致误差累积、跟踪不稳定的问题，本文提出OC-SORT，重新审视SORT的观测中心设计。方法上引入以观测为中心的动量项和虚拟轨迹恢复机制，利用观测方向的一致性来修正卡尔曼滤波的噪声估计，并在目标重新出现时通过观测恢复轨迹。相比原始SORT及其变体，OC-SORT在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得了更高的MOTA和HOTA，尤其在非线性运动和遮挡场景下鲁棒性显著增强。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper revisits SORT-style tracking and identifies error accumulation from Kalman filter estimation during occlusions and long-term loss. It proposes OC-SORT, which introduces observation-centric momentum and virtual trajectory recovery to correct filter noise using observation direction consistency and to recover tracks upon re-appearance. Compared with SORT variants, OC-SORT achieves higher MOTA and HOTA on MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack, with notably improved robustness to non-linear motion and occlusions.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: OC-SORT以简洁的观测中心设计显著提升了SORT类方法的鲁棒性，是该方向被广泛引用的经典改进，值得关注。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出OC-SORT，通过观测中心动量与虚拟轨迹恢复机制改进SORT在遮挡和非线性运动下的跟踪鲁棒性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 以观测方向一致性修正卡尔曼滤波噪声估计，并在目标重现时利用观测恢复轨迹。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得更高MOTA和HOTA，遮挡和非线性运动场景下鲁棒性显著增强。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中目标在遮挡和复杂交互下运动模式难以建模、短时和长时运动预测不准确的问题，本文提出MotionTrack，学习鲁棒的短期和长期运动表示。方法上设计交互模块捕捉目标间的短期相对运动，并构建长期运动记忆以在目标消失后预测其可能位置，从而支持重识别和轨迹恢复。相比已有方法，MotionTrack在MOT17和MOT20等基准上提升了MOTA和IDF1，减少了遮挡导致的ID切换。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate motion modeling in MOT under occlusions and complex interactions, where both short-term and long-term motion predictions are unreliable. It proposes MotionTrack, which learns robust short-term and long-term motion representations via an interaction module for relative motion and a long-term motion memory for predicting lost targets' positions. Compared with prior methods, MotionTrack improves MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20, reducing occlusion-induced ID switches.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: MotionTrack对短期与长期运动的联合建模思路合理，在遮挡场景下的改进对MOT研究者有参考意义。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出MotionTrack，联合学习短期交互运动与长期运动记忆以提升多目标跟踪鲁棒性。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 通过交互模块和长期运动记忆分别建模短期相对运动与长期消失目标的运动预测。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上提升MOTA和IDF1，减少遮挡导致的ID切换。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中外观特征粒度不足、难以区分相似目标的问题，本文提出一种多样化细粒度表示方法。方法上通过多分支网络提取不同粒度的外观特征，并结合注意力机制自适应融合细粒度线索，以增强目标间的判别力。相比仅使用全局外观特征的已有方法，该方法在MOT17和MOT20等基准上提升了IDF1和MOTA，尤其在拥挤和相似外观场景下ID切换明显减少。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient appearance granularity in online MOT, which hampers discrimination among similar targets. It proposes a diverse fine-grained representation method that extracts multi-granularity appearance features via multi-branch networks and adaptively fuses them with attention. Compared with global-appearance-only methods, it improves IDF1 and MOTA on MOT17 and MOT20, notably reducing ID switches in crowded and similar-appearance scenarios.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该工作从细粒度外观表示角度改进在线MOT，思路直观且实验有效，对拥挤场景跟踪有实用价值。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出多样化细粒度表示方法，通过多分支网络和注意力融合增强在线MOT的目标判别力。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 利用多粒度外观特征的自适应融合来区分相似目标，缓解拥挤场景下的ID切换。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上提升IDF1和MOTA，拥挤和相似外观场景下ID切换明显减少。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中仅依赖视觉外观、缺乏语言指令引导的问题，提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking（RMOT）新任务，即根据自然语言描述跟踪特定目标。作者构建了Refer-KITTI数据集，包含视频序列及对应的指代语句标注，并提出了一个基于Transformer的基线方法。相比传统MOT仅跟踪所有目标，RMOT要求模型理解语言并选择性跟踪，提升了跟踪的语义可控性。实验表明基线方法在Refer-KITTI上取得了合理的性能，但仍有较大提升空间。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT), a new task that tracks targets specified by natural language descriptions rather than all objects. The authors construct the Refer-KITTI dataset with video sequences and referring expressions, and propose a Transformer-based baseline. Experiments show the baseline achieves reasonable performance on Refer-KITTI, while leaving substantial room for improvement.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新方向，数据集和任务定义具有较高研究价值，但方法本身较为基础。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking新任务并构建了Refer-KITTI数据集。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自然语言指代引入多目标跟踪，实现语义可控的目标跟踪。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 基线方法在Refer-KITTI上取得合理性能，但仍有较大提升空间。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征利用不充分的问题，提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM，通过身份感知特征增强来提升跟踪性能。方法将检测、嵌入和关联统一在一个框架中，并引入身份感知模块增强目标特征表示。相比分离式跟踪范式，UTM减少了模块间的信息损失，提升了身份保持能力。实验在多个MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper proposes UTM, a unified multiple object tracking model with identity-aware feature enhancement. It integrates detection, embedding, and association into a single framework with an identity-aware module to enhance target representations. Experiments on multiple MOT benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一框架和身份感知增强的思路合理，但创新性相对有限，属于对现有范式的改进。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM，集成检测、嵌入与关联。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 引入身份感知特征增强模块，提升目标身份保持能力。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在多个MOT基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 该论文针对自由运动鸟类的2D-3D无标记跟踪问题，提出了自动化标注方法3D-POP，利用基于标记的动作捕捉数据来辅助无标记跟踪。作者设计了一套自动化流程，将标记点数据转化为无标记跟踪的监督信号，从而避免人工标注。相比传统手动标注，该方法大幅降低了标注成本，并支持大规模数据生成。实验表明该方法能有效促进鸟类的2D-3D跟踪研究。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper presents 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach for markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving birds using marker-based motion capture data. The method converts marker data into supervision for markerless tracking, reducing manual annotation cost. Experiments show it effectively facilitates bird tracking research.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 该工作属于跨学科应用，对自动驾驶领域直接相关性较低，但自动化标注思路有一定借鉴意义。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出了利用标记动作捕捉数据自动标注无标记2D-3D跟踪的方法。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 将标记点数据自动转化为无标记跟踪的监督信号。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 有效降低了标注成本并支持大规模鸟类跟踪数据生成。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉跟踪中传统判别式方法依赖手工设计或固定模板的问题，提出了自回归视觉跟踪框架ARTrack。方法将跟踪建模为序列生成问题，通过自回归方式逐步预测目标状态，并利用历史预测作为上下文。相比现有跟踪器，ARTrack能更灵活地适应目标外观变化，减少对模板更新的依赖。实验在多个跟踪基准上取得了领先性能。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Autoregressive Visual Tracking (ARTrack), which formulates tracking as a sequence generation problem and predicts target states autoregressively using historical predictions as context. It adapts more flexibly to appearance changes and reduces reliance on template updates. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on multiple tracking benchmarks.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 将自回归生成范式引入视觉跟踪具有新意，方法简洁且性能优异，值得关注。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了自回归视觉跟踪框架ARTrack。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将跟踪建模为序列生成问题，利用历史预测作为上下文。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得领先性能。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类别级衣物姿态跟踪问题，提出了完整的解决方案，包括VR-Garment记录系统、大规模数据集VR-Folding以及端到端在线跟踪框架GarmentTracking。方法从点云序列中预测衣物在规范空间和任务空间中的完整姿态，能够处理大幅非刚性变形。相比基线方法，GarmentTracking在速度和精度上均有提升。实验验证了其在复杂折叠操作下的有效性。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking with a complete package: a VR recording system, a large-scale dataset VR-Folding, and an end-to-end online framework GarmentTracking. It predicts complete garment pose in both canonical and task spaces from point cloud sequences, handling large non-rigid deformation. Experiments show improved speed and accuracy over baselines.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 该工作属于机器人操作与衣物跟踪交叉领域，对自动驾驶感知直接相关性低，但点云序列跟踪方法有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出了完整的类别级衣物姿态跟踪方案，包括系统、数据集和跟踪框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 结合VR记录系统与点云序列实现非刚性衣物姿态在线跟踪。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上均优于基线方法，能处理大幅非刚性变形。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中因遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题，提出了MBPTrack，采用记忆网络利用历史信息，并基于首帧框先验进行由粗到细的定位。方法将历史帧的目标性掩码作为外部记忆，通过Transformer模块传播目标线索，并利用Hough投票预测中心，再自适应采样参考点覆盖不同尺寸目标。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo Open Dataset上取得了最先进性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MBPTrack for 3D single object tracking, addressing appearance variation from occlusion and size differences. It uses a memory mechanism with targetness masks as external memory and a Transformer module to propagate cues, combined with box priors for coarse-to-fine localization via Hough voting and adaptive reference point sampling. Extensive experiments show state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 记忆机制与框先验的结合有效解决了3D跟踪中的遮挡和尺寸变化问题，在多个自动驾驶数据集上验证了优越性，值得关注。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出了结合记忆网络和框先验的3D单目标跟踪方法MBPTrack。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 利用目标性掩码作为外部记忆，并通过框先验自适应采样参考点实现由粗到细定位。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo Open Dataset上取得最先进性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对闭集3D感知模型在自动驾驶部署后无法识别新类别物体的问题，本文提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D框和轨迹。方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与现成的2D图像-文本对，结合视觉-语言知识蒸馏，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者。相比此前只能提供限于运动物体的类别无关标签的工作，本方法可同时处理静态与运动物体并输出开放词汇语义标签。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-set 3D perception models that cannot handle novel object categories after deployment in autonomous driving. It proposes a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without any 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs via vision-language knowledge distillation. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, the method handles both static and moving objects and produces open-vocabulary semantic labels. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show significant improvements over prior work across various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏引入无监督3D感知，解决了开放集自动标注中静态物体和语义标签缺失的关键问题，对自动驾驶数据闭环有实际价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇语义标签并同时处理静态与运动物体的多模态自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用点云运动线索与2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，实现开放词汇的3D自动标注。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在算力受限设备上的问题，本文提出HiT，一族高效跟踪模型。核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头提供更好特征；同时提出双图像位置编码，同时编码搜索区域和模板图像的位置信息。HiT在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers that hinders deployment on computationally limited devices. It proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models centered on a Bridge Module that incorporates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features to produce better features for the tracking head, along with a dual-image position encoding that jointly encodes search region and template positions. HiT runs at 61 fps on the Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and achieves 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦轻量级层次化ViT在跟踪中的效率-性能平衡，边缘设备上的实时性与精度表现对实际部署有参考意义，但与3D感知/BEV主线相关度有限。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出HiT高效跟踪模型族，通过Bridge Module和双图像位置编码在边缘设备上实现高速高精度跟踪。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息注入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域与模板位置。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中缺乏标签监督、且受物体相互干扰和遮挡影响的问题，本文提出无监督对比相似度学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接与帧间间接对比最大化自相似性获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧与连续帧匹配结果以缓解遮挡的持续负面影响；歧义对比通过隐式方式匹配歧义物体以提高后续关联确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅借助有限ReID头即超越现有无监督方法，甚至优于许多全监督方法。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised multiple object tracking, which suffers from mutual interference and occlusion without label supervision. It proposes UCSL, an unsupervised contrastive similarity learning method with three modules: self-contrast, cross-contrast, and ambiguity contrast, which respectively learn discriminative representations via intra/inter-frame contrast, align cross- and continuous-frame matching to mitigate occlusion effects, and match ambiguous objects to increase association certainty. On existing benchmarks, UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head help and even surpasses many fully supervised methods.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作从样本特征跨帧一致性出发设计对比学习框架，为无监督MOT提供了新思路，但实验规模与3D/自动驾驶场景的关联有限。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比的无监督对比相似度学习框架UCSL用于多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 通过帧内/帧间对比、跨帧匹配对齐和歧义物体隐式匹配三种对比机制提升无监督跟踪的表示与关联能力。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在现有基准上超越无监督方法，并优于许多全监督方法。

ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_cn: 本文提出ZoomTrack，一种面向高效视觉跟踪的目标感知非均匀缩放方法。由于摘要信息不完整，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题与领域推断，该工作针对跟踪中目标尺度变化与计算效率的平衡问题，通过目标感知的非均匀缩放策略在保持跟踪精度的同时降低计算量。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中目标遮挡、相似外观和密集场景导致的身份混淆是长期难题。该论文提出DeconfuseTrack，通过设计去混淆机制（如混淆感知的特征增强与关联策略）来缓解轨迹与检测之间的错误匹配。相比已有MOT方法，其改进点在于显式建模并抑制混淆对关联的影响。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，需参考正文验证其有效性。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: Identity confusion caused by occlusion, similar appearance, and crowded scenes remains a long-standing challenge in multi-object tracking. This paper proposes DeconfuseTrack, which introduces de-confusion mechanisms to alleviate erroneous associations between tracks and detections. The key improvement lies in explicitly modeling and suppressing confusion during association, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中核心的混淆问题提出专门解决方案，思路清晰，但需关注其在大规模基准上的实际增益。

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: Multi-object tracking models often suffer from poor generalization across domains, limiting real-world deployment. Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: 低光照和夜间场景下多目标跟踪性能显著下降，现有MOT方法多针对正常光照设计。该论文研究暗光环境下的多目标跟踪，提出适应低照度图像的方法以提升夜间跟踪鲁棒性。相比已有工作，其改进点在于专门针对暗光域进行建模与增强。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值，需正文确认其效果。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking degrades significantly under low-light and nighttime conditions, while most existing MOT methods are designed for normal illumination. HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: 视觉跟踪中模板更新与目标外观变化难以兼顾，历史信息利用不足。该论文提出HIPTrack，利用历史提示（Historical Prompts）来增强跟踪器对目标外观变化的适应能力。相比已有方法，其改进点在于将历史帧信息以提示形式注入跟踪网络。摘要未提供具体基准与数值，需正文确认其性能。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: Visual tracking struggles to balance template updating and appearance variation, with historical information often underutilized. This paper proposes HIPTrack, which leverages historical prompts to enhance the tracker's adaptability to target appearance changes. MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: Hand pose tracking still faces challenges in accuracy and biomechanical plausibility. 2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: 基于注意力的跟踪（TBA）在长遮挡和困难检测场景下潜力大，但性能长期落后于跟踪检测（TBD）方法。该论文提出JDT3D，一个基于LiDAR的联合检测与跟踪框架，通过分析TBA落后原因，提出轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法。在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达到0.574，超越所有现有LiDAR TBA方法超过6%。论文还讨论了现有TBA模型公式的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods have potential advantages for long occlusions and challenging detection but have lagged behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) approaches. This paper proposes JDT3D, a LiDAR-based joint detector and tracker, and introduces track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation to bridge the gap. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the nuScenes test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统分析了TBA落后于TBD的原因并提出有效改进，在nuScenes上取得显著提升，对3D跟踪与自动驾驶感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR联合检测跟踪框架JDT3D及两种通用改进方法。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 轨迹采样增强与基于置信度的查询传播，缩小TBA与TBD差距。
2407.04926|v2.result: nuScenes测试集AMOTA达0.574，超越现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖全帧边界框和实例ID标注，成本极高。本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器：构建准稠密时序物体外观图，用多正样本对比目标优化随机游走学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态关联检测与轨迹。在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器竞争性水平，标注需求最多减少400倍仍超越此前自监督方法。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods require exhaustive per-frame bounding box and instance ID annotations. Walker is the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels, building a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph optimized via a multi-positive contrastive objective and enforcing mutually-exclusive connectivity across instances. At inference, detections are associated to tracklets via max-likelihood transitions under motion-constrained bi-directional walks. It achieves competitive performance on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 首次将自监督学习成功扩展到MOT并达到竞争性精度，标注效率提升显著，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有直接价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用稀疏框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 基于时序外观图随机游走的多正样本对比学习与互斥连通性约束。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上超越此前自监督跟踪器，标注需求最多减少400倍。

The core idea is to transfer mature 2D matching capabilities into the 3D tracker while leveraging 3D pre-training for point cloud representation.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪多为类别专用模型，参数冗余且难以跨类别泛化。本文首次提出统一模型，用共享参数的单网络同时跟踪所有类别：显式编码不同类别的属性差异（主要来自尺寸与形状，如大而方的车 vs 小而细的人），设计继承Transformer架构的AdaFormer点集表征学习网络自适应编码跨类别动态变化的形状与尺寸，并将已知模板目标的尺寸形状先验融入输入与学习目标。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D SOT models are category-specific, incurring redundant parameters and poor cross-category applicability. This paper introduces the first unified model that tracks all categories with a single shared-parameter network, explicitly encoding category attributes that mainly differ in size and shape. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation learning network that adaptively encodes dynamically varying shape and size, and incorporates template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and learning objectives.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地解决3D SOT的类别统一问题，AdaFormer对跨类别形状尺寸建模有启发性，对统一感知架构设计有参考意义。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型与AdaFormer点集表征网络。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 自适应编码跨类别形状尺寸差异并融入模板先验。
2401.11204|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景训练时存在负干扰（学习到冲突的场景特定参数）和域泛化差（需昂贵微调）的问题。本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）：定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT专家模块，在参数空间组合这些模块，从而系统泛化到新域且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上训练并在MOT17、PersonPath22上零样本评估，由精选模块构建的跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: Training end-to-end transformer trackers in heterogeneous scenarios suffers from negative interference and poor domain generalization. PASTA combines PEFT and Modular Deep Learning: it defines key scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) and trains specialized PEFT modules per attribute, combining them in parameter space to generalize to new domains without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth with zero-shot evaluation on MOT17 and PersonPath22 show that a tracker built from selected modules surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT以解决异构场景负干扰与域泛化，思路新颖且零样本泛化验证充分，对多场景自动驾驶跟踪有实用价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练PEFT专家模块并在参数空间组合实现零样本域泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth训练、MOT17与PersonPath22零样本评估中超越单体跟踪器。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言跟踪器虽引入自然语言描述提升通用性，但因依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而性能逊于SoTA视觉跟踪器。本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述：设计基于反思的提示优化模块，借助跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊/不准确的目标描述；并提出简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。实验表明其提升了跟踪性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: VL trackers underperform SoTA visual trackers largely due to their reliance on manual textual annotations that are often ambiguous. ChatTracker leverages the world knowledge of an MLLM to generate high-quality language descriptions, with a novel reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines target descriptions using tracking feedback. A simple plug-and-play VL tracking framework is proposed to boost both VL and visual trackers, with experiments showing improved tracking performance.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 用MLLM自动生成并迭代优化语言描述替代人工标注，为VL跟踪提供了可插拔的增强方案，对多模态跟踪研究有启发。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述的ChatTracker跟踪框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反思的提示优化模块结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼目标描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 实验表明该即插即用模块提升了VL与视觉跟踪器的性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱，且RGB跟踪器依赖颜色纹理等空间外观线索在航拍视角下易失效的问题，论文提出了首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125段视频序列、超过48.8万条标注、覆盖8个类别，具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等综合挑战，并提供精确的旋转框标注以支持航拍视角下的准确定位。作者进一步提出一种多光谱跟踪方法，以更好地提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。相比已有RGB基准，MMOT通过引入像素级光谱反射信息提升了退化空间条件下的目标可区分性。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMOT, the first benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, addressing the failure of RGB trackers that rely on spatial appearance cues under aerial views. MMOT contains 125 video sequences with over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, covering extreme small targets, high density, severe occlusion, and complex motion, with precise oriented annotations. The authors further propose a multispectral tracking approach to exploit spectral features and oriented boxes, improving object discriminability under degraded spatial conditions.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 作为首个无人机多光谱MOT基准，填补了多光谱UAV跟踪数据空白，对多模态航拍感知研究有较高参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT并提出配套多光谱跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将像素级光谱反射信息引入无人机MOT，并结合旋转框标注提升航拍定位精度。
2510.12565|v2.result: 提供125段序列、48.8万+标注、8类目标，覆盖小目标、高密度、遮挡等综合挑战。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下现有MOT算法因面向针孔图像而失效，且全景畸变（分辨率损失、几何形变、光照不均）导致性能显著下降的问题，论文提出OmniTrack全景MOT框架。该框架包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何畸变，从而支持快速传感器运动下的全景跟踪。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了由四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，涵盖全景视场、剧烈运动和复杂环境等挑战。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OmniTrack, an omnidirectional MOT framework addressing the failure of pinhole-oriented MOT methods under panoramic distortions such as resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting. OmniTrack integrates Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and a CircularStatE module to mitigate image and geometric distortions. The authors also introduce QuadTrack, a panoramic MOT dataset collected by a quadruped robot with intense motion and complex environments.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 全景MOT是较少被探索的方向，OmniTrack与QuadTrack数据集对全景感知与跟踪研究有较好推动作用。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack及四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过CircularStatE模块与FlexiTrack实例设计缓解全景畸变并支持快速运动跟踪。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在全景场景下实现鲁棒跟踪，并贡献了涵盖剧烈运动与复杂环境的QuadTrack数据集。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对UAV单目标跟踪中小目标与遮挡导致RGB跟踪器性能受限的问题，论文提出首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250段覆盖多样环境与挑战的视频序列。同时提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack，从光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索中编码统一的频谱、空间与时序特征，采用带光谱背景消除机制的非对称Transformer进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器精化跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有UAV跟踪器，兼顾精度与效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences covering diverse environments and challenges. It also proposes UNTrack, a unified framework that encodes spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches, using an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder. Experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers in both accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集与统一框架结合，对多模态航拍跟踪研究有较高价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 采用光谱背景消除机制与持续更新的光谱提示编码器统一建模频谱、空间与时序特征。
2503.17699|v2.result: UNTrack在MUST上超越现有SOTA UAV跟踪器，同时提升精度与效率。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线多目标跟踪中轨迹关联易受遮挡与外观变化干扰的问题，提出以轨迹为中心进行特征建模与关联的方法。方法上强调对已有轨迹的持续聚焦，而非仅依赖逐帧检测结果，从而提升关联稳定性。相比传统检测-关联范式，改进点在于将轨迹信息作为核心线索参与匹配。摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果需结合全文实验判断。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-object tracking by focusing on track-centric modeling to improve association robustness under occlusion and appearance variation. It emphasizes maintaining and exploiting track information rather than relying solely on per-frame detections. The main improvement lies in shifting the association paradigm toward track-focused reasoning, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje._arxiv_id: Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有one-stream视觉跟踪器中单一ViT难以同时处理不同图像块关系建模的问题，提出SPMTrack，引入面向跟踪的混合专家模块TMoE。TMoE让多个专家分别处理背景抑制与前景/边界强调等多样化关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文。方法还作为参数高效微调手段，大幅减少可训练参数，使不同规模SPMTrack可高效训练并保留预训练模型泛化能力。摘要未给出具体指标，但强调在参数量小幅增加下提升跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of single-ViT one-stream trackers in handling heterogeneous patch relations by proposing SPMTrack with a tracking-tailored mixture-of-experts (TMoE). TMoE assigns multiple experts to diverse relation modeling, such as suppressing background and emphasizing foreground boundaries, and extends relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context. It also serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy, reducing trainable parameters while preserving pretrained generalization.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将MoE与参数高效微调结合到视觉跟踪中，思路新颖，对跟踪与高效适配方向均有参考价值。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于跟踪专用混合专家的SPMTrack跟踪器。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 用TMoE实现多样化关系建模并扩展至时空上下文，同时作为参数高效微调方法。
2503.18338|v2.result: 在参数量小幅增加下提升跟踪精度，并显著减少可训练参数。

Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉跟踪中预训练表示利用不足的问题，提出自回归序列预训练方法。核心思想是通过序列化预测目标建模时序依赖，使跟踪器在预训练阶段学习到更丰富的运动与外观演化表示。相比常规图像级或对比式预训练，改进点在于将跟踪任务本身的自回归特性引入预训练。摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果，效果需进一步验证。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient exploitation of pretraining for visual tracking by proposing an autoregressive sequential pretraining paradigm. It models temporal dependencies through sequential prediction, enabling the tracker to learn richer motion and appearance evolution representations. The key improvement is incorporating the autoregressive nature of tracking into pretraining, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.assessment: 自回归预训练用于跟踪具有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在下游跟踪基准上的增益。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.contribution: 提出面向视觉跟踪的自回归序列预训练框架。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.innovation: 将自回归时序建模引入跟踪预训练阶段。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo._arxiv_id: Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining for Visual Tracking.

Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_en: This paper targets RGBE visual tracking by better exploiting historical information, proposing a Mamba-based tracker. It leverages Mamba's state-space modeling to efficiently aggregate temporal history, addressing the high temporal resolution and sparsity of event data. The improvement lies in effective long-horizon history fusion compared with current-frame or short-window trackers, though quantitative results are absent from the abstract.

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by proposing GaPT-DAR, which integrates 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction. It jointly models deformation and geometry to handle large garment deformation and complex topology. The improvement lies in combining 2D and 3D cues, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云跟踪中类别统一与预训练模型迁移的问题，提出TrackAny3D，将预训练3D模型迁移到类别统一的点云跟踪任务。方法通过迁移预训练3D表示，减少对类别特定标注的依赖，实现跨类别统一的跟踪。相比类别特定跟踪器，改进点在于利用预训练模型提升泛化与统一性。摘要未给出具体指标，效果需结合实验判断。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: This paper addresses category-unified 3D point cloud tracking by proposing TrackAny3D, which transfers pretrained 3D models to the tracking task. It reduces reliance on category-specific annotations and enables unified tracking across categories via pretrained 3D representations. The improvement lies in leveraging pretrained models for better generalization and unification, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 将预训练3D模型迁移到点云跟踪并实现类别统一，对3D感知与跟踪交叉方向有参考价值。

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集规模小、类别少、模态单一，难以支撑通用场景下的鲁棒跟踪研究。本文提出GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列同时提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态，支持单模态与多模态3D SOT任务，所有帧均经过多轮人工精细标注。作者评估了8种代表性点云跟踪模型，发现它们在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明现有方法在通用3D跟踪上仍有很大提升空间。该基准是目前面向多种通用3D跟踪任务的最大规模数据集，为后续研究提供了重要平台。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D single object tracking (SOT) benchmarks are limited in scale, category diversity, and modality, hindering research on generic tracking in the wild. This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark comprising 620 sequences, 123K frames, and 54 object categories, with each sequence providing point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities to support both single-modal and multi-modal 3D SOT. All frames are manually annotated with multi-round inspection. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud-based trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting substantial room for improvement in generic 3D tracking.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了通用3D单目标跟踪基准的空白，多模态、多类别的设计对推动鲁棒3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪多模态基准GSOT3D，涵盖54类、620序列、123K帧。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供点云、RGB、深度三模态对齐标注，支持单模态与多模态3D SOT的统一评测。
2412.02129|v2.result: 8种代表性点云跟踪模型在该基准上性能大幅下降，表明现有方法在通用3D跟踪场景下鲁棒性不足。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）现有方法主要依赖实例级检测与关联，忽略了轨迹信息在关联稳定性和分类准确性中的关键作用，尤其在遮挡和类别模糊场景下表现不佳。本文提出TRACT跟踪器，引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略提升目标身份与类别一致性，并设计即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，通过轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义丰富（TSE）充分利用轨迹信息。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下显著提升了关联稳定性和分类精度，增强了对新类别的适应能力。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OV-MOT) methods rely primarily on instance-level detection and association, overlooking trajectory information that is crucial for association stability and classification, especially under occlusion and category ambiguity. This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary tracker that leverages trajectory information via a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement (TCR) strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module TraCLIP with Trajectory Feature Aggregation (TFA) and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment (TSE). The method improves association stability and classification accuracy, enhancing adaptability to novel classes.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将轨迹信息引入开放词汇跟踪，思路新颖，对提升OV-MOT在复杂场景下的鲁棒性有实际意义。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息增强关联与分类的开放词汇多目标跟踪器TRACT。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 设计轨迹一致性强化策略和即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，融合轨迹特征聚合与语义丰富。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类精度，增强了对新类别的适应能力。

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目3D点跟踪器受深度模糊和遮挡困扰，而多相机方法通常需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化，难以实用。本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，仅需4个相机即可前馈预测3D对应关系，实现鲁棒在线跟踪。方法在已知相机位姿和多视角深度下，将多视角特征融合为统一点云，采用k近邻关联和基于Transformer的更新模块估计长程3D对应，即使在遮挡下也能稳定跟踪。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别取得3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，并可泛化到1-8视角、24-150帧的不同设置。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular 3D point trackers suffer from depth ambiguity and occlusion, while multi-camera methods require over 20 cameras and tedious per-sequence optimization. This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that uses a practical number of cameras (e.g., four) to directly predict 3D correspondences in a feed-forward manner. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-nearest-neighbors correlation with a transformer-based update for long-range 3D correspondence estimation under occlusion. Trained on 5K synthetic Kubric sequences, it achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, respectively, generalizing to 1-8 views and 24-150 frames.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现实用相机数量下的前馈多视角3D点跟踪，精度高且泛化性好，对动态场景3D理解有重要价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，仅需4个相机即可实现鲁棒在线3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新模块处理遮挡下的长程3D对应。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别取得3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8视角和24-150帧。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 多模态数据虽能提升视觉跟踪鲁棒性，但传感器同步问题常导致模态在时间上不完整，现有跟踪器因架构刚性在缺失模态时性能显著下降。本文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能，并提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架。该框架通过异构混合专家融合机制实现自适应复杂度，根据缺失率动态激活计算单元，并结合视频级掩码策略保证时间一致性和空间完整性。实验表明，该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度自适应调整，显著优于现有方法。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: Multimodal data improves visual tracking robustness, but sensor synchronization issues often cause temporally incomplete modalities, and existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data and proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism featuring adaptive complexity, coupled with a video-level masking strategy for temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, outperforming existing methods.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，提出的自适应混合专家框架有效提升了跟踪器在模态缺失下的鲁棒性。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应鲁棒多模态跟踪框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 设计异构混合专家融合机制与视频级掩码策略，根据缺失率动态激活计算单元并保证时空一致性。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能适应不同缺失率和场景复杂度，显著优于现有跟踪器。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中数据关联依赖手工启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，本文提出 LA-MOTR，将关联过程建模为可学习的模块，嵌入到端到端 Transformer 跟踪框架中。方法通过可微的关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配或 IoU 阈值策略，使检测、关联与轨迹更新联合优化。相比已有 MOTR 系列工作，改进点在于关联的可学习化与端到端训练的一致性。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking (MOT). It proposes LA-MOTR, which formulates association as a learnable module within an end-to-end Transformer tracking framework, replacing traditional Hungarian matching or IoU thresholds with differentiable association prediction. Compared with prior MOTR-style methods, the key improvement is the learnable and jointly optimized association, though the abstract does not report specific quantitative gains.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 将数据关联从手工规则转为可学习模块是 MOT 端到端化的重要方向，值得关注其可微关联设计的具体实现与收敛性。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习的关联模块，实现检测-关联-轨迹更新的端到端联合优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 用可微关联预测替代传统手工匹配策略，嵌入 Transformer 跟踪框架。
