2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中现有概念彼此互补但未被有效整合的问题，本文提出一套系统化的两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法采用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合生成 3D 提议，并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠或部分提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP，以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道降低背景噪声，并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤误检。相比已有工作，改进在于将互补概念精心组合并细化，取得新的 SOTA 性能。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS), where existing concepts are complementary but not well integrated. It proposes a two-stage recipe: 3D proposal generation via tracking-based aggregation with iterative merging/removal, and instance classification using Alpha-CLIP with object masks as an alpha channel plus a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score for normalizing text-to-proposal similarity. The refined combination of complementary concepts yields a new state-of-the-art solution.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 系统性地整合并细化已有互补概念，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 的设计对开放词汇 3D 感知有实用价值，实验较充分。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出整合互补概念的 OV-3DIS 两阶段方案，达到新的 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码 alpha 通道与 SMS 相似度归一化提升开放词汇分类精度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得新的最优性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶动态城市场景建模与渲染中，高质量方法依赖昂贵人工目标轨迹标注、而自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景导致渲染伪影的问题，本文提出 AD-GS，一个自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；无需完整语义标注，通过简化伪 2D 分割自动分离物体与背景，用动态高斯与双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并引入可见性推理与物理刚性正则增强鲁棒性。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-quality dynamic urban driving scene modeling and rendering, where existing methods rely on costly manual object tracklet annotations while self-supervised approaches fail to capture dynamic motion and decompose scenes properly. AD-GS is a self-supervised framework whose core is a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, using simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, dynamic Gaussians, and bidirectional temporal visibility masks, plus visibility reasoning and physically rigid regularization. Extensive evaluations show it significantly outperforms annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 自监督动态场景建模对自动驾驶仿真很有价值，B 样条与三角函数的混合运动模型设计新颖，无需标注即可达到接近有标注方法的渲染质量。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无需标注的自监督驾驶场景高斯泼溅渲染框架 AD-GS。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 融合局部 B 样条与全局三角函数的可学习运动模型，配合双向可见性掩码与刚性正则。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足，导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，本文提出 OVTR，首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略为后续帧建立高层类别先验，引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护策略。实验表明该方法在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越先前跟踪器，同时推理更快并显著减少计算量。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OV-MOT), where existing trackers suffer from rigid framework structures, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interaction. OVTR is the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker jointly modeling motion, appearance, and category, featuring a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy for high-level category priors, a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and protective strategies in the decoder. It surpasses previous trackers on the OV-MOT benchmark with faster inference and significantly reduced computation.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器，CIP 与双分支设计针对性强，在精度与效率上同时改进，对开放世界跟踪研究有参考价值。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR，联合建模运动、外观与类别。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播策略与双分支多模态交互结构，配合解码器保护策略。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在 OV-MOT 基准上超越先前方法，推理更快且计算量显著降低。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中像素级、长序列稠密 3D 运动跟踪计算效率低或只能稀疏跟踪的问题，本文提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法采用联合全局-局部注意力在低分辨率下跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器获得高分辨率预测，并探索深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 为最优选择。实验表明 DELTA 比先前方法快 8 倍以上，同时在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上均取得新的 SOTA。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense 3D motion tracking from monocular videos, where existing methods are limited by computational inefficiency or sparse tracking. DELTA efficiently tracks every pixel in 3D using joint global-local attention at reduced resolution followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. It runs over 8x faster than previous methods while achieving new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 在稠密 3D 跟踪的效率与精度上同时取得突破，log-depth 的发现对深度表示选择有指导意义，适合长视频运动分析。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长程 3D 像素级跟踪方法 DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力加 Transformer 上采样器，并确认 log-depth 为最优深度表示。
2410.24211|v2.result: 比先前方法快 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪基准上取得新 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题（拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、物体精确网格未知），本文提出一套方法。首先在无物体先验下估计任意物体 6D 位姿：从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型、与输入图像 6D 对齐、并基于场景确定绝对尺度；其次跨帧跟踪检测物体以提取平滑 6D 轨迹，再通过轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper aims to extract temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos, a challenging setting due to uncontrolled capture, subtle dynamic motion, and unknown object meshes. The method estimates 6D pose without object prior by retrieving a similar CAD model, aligning it to the image, and grounding absolute scale, then tracks objects across frames to extract smooth trajectories that are retargeted to a robot manipulator via trajectory optimization. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向互联网视频的 6D 位姿跟踪与机器人操作重定向，问题设定新颖但更偏机器人操作，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度有限。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出从互联网视频提取 6D 物体轨迹并重定向到机械臂的完整流程。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 无物体先验的 CAD 检索-对齐-尺度接地位姿估计与轨迹优化重定向。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对复杂场景（如集体舞蹈、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪的难题：目标运动具有协同模式、相互遮挡且轨迹存在长期依赖，而现有方法难以同时建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡。为此提出 Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合处理多条轨迹，并自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query，同时保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆表示。将 Samba 集成到 tracking-by-propagation 框架后形成 SambaMOTR，是首个有效解决上述三类问题的跟踪器；此外还提出处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术及高效训练策略。在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等数据集上取得领先性能，显著提升关联精度与 ID 保持能力。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking in complex scenarios where objects move in coordinated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term trajectory dependencies, which existing methods struggle to model jointly. It introduces Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets, autoregressively predicting future track queries while maintaining synchronized long-term memory across sequences. Integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, it is the first tracker to effectively handle long-range dependencies, tracklet interdependencies, and temporal occlusions, further aided by a MaskObs technique for uncertain observations and an efficient training strategy. It achieves state-of-the-art results on challenging benchmarks such as DanceTrack and SportsMOT.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将线性时间状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪的轨迹集合建模，思路新颖且对协同运动与遮挡场景有实际价值，实验扎实，值得跟踪领域研究者关注。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出同步集合序列模型 Samba 及跟踪框架 SambaMOTR，首次统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间对多条轨迹进行线性时间联合建模，并自回归预测未来 track query。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等复杂场景基准上取得领先的跟踪性能，显著改善关联与 ID 保持。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）通常将检测与跟踪分离，导致检测误差传播且难以处理遮挡与运动模糊。该论文提出同时检测与跟踪的框架，并引入运动建模（motion modelling）来联合优化检测框与轨迹关联。相比已有两阶段方法，其改进在于端到端联合推理，减少对独立检测器的依赖。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法在MOT基准上预期能提升ID保持与遮挡场景下的鲁棒性。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between detection and tracking in multi-object tracking (MOT), which propagates detection errors and struggles with occlusion and motion blur. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with motion modelling to jointly optimize bounding boxes and trajectory association. Unlike existing two-stage methods, it performs end-to-end joint inference, reducing reliance on independent detectors. While no quantitative results are given in the abstract, the approach is expected to improve identity preservation and robustness under occlusion on MOT benchmarks.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该工作针对MOT中检测与跟踪割裂的核心问题提出联合建模思路，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有直接参考价值，值得关注其后续实验验证。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出同时检测与跟踪并融合运动建模的联合框架，缓解检测误差传播。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将运动模型嵌入检测与跟踪的联合优化中，实现端到端MOT。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，预期在遮挡与运动模糊场景下提升跟踪鲁棒性。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 该论文研究多目标跟踪（MOT）系统在对抗攻击下的脆弱性，指出仅欺骗检测器不足以破坏跟踪，需针对跟踪关联环节设计攻击。作者提出一种针对MOT的对抗攻击方法，通过扰动检测结果与关联特征来破坏轨迹连续性。相比已有仅攻击检测的工作，其改进在于揭示跟踪级攻击的有效性。摘要未给出具体攻击成功率数据，但强调了检测与跟踪联合攻击的必要性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper investigates the vulnerability of multi-object tracking (MOT) systems under adversarial attacks, arguing that fooling detection alone is insufficient to break tracking and that the association stage must also be targeted. It proposes an adversarial attack method against MOT that perturbs both detection outputs and association features to disrupt trajectory continuity. Unlike prior work focusing only on detection attacks, it demonstrates the effectiveness of tracking-level attacks. No quantitative attack success rates are provided in the abstract, but the necessity of joint detection-tracking attacks is emphasized.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该工作从安全角度揭示MOT系统的对抗脆弱性，对自动驾驶感知安全研究有警示意义，但需关注其攻击的实用性与防御可行性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出针对多目标跟踪关联环节的对抗攻击方法，证明仅攻击检测不足。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 将对抗攻击从检测扩展到跟踪关联，揭示跟踪级攻击的有效性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 摘要未提供具体攻击成功率，但表明联合攻击可有效破坏跟踪。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中的轨迹关联可建模为图优化问题，但传统方法难以处理长时遮挡与轨迹分裂。该论文提出Lifted Disjoint Paths（LDP）模型，将轨迹关联转化为带提升约束的不相交路径问题，并给出高效求解算法。相比已有最小代价流或二分匹配方法，其改进在于能同时处理轨迹分裂与合并。摘要未提供具体MOT基准数据，但方法在理论上更具表达力。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses trajectory association in multi-object tracking (MOT), which can be formulated as graph optimization but remains challenging under long-term occlusion and track fragmentation. It proposes the Lifted Disjoint Paths (LDP) model, transforming association into a disjoint path problem with lifted constraints, and provides an efficient solver. Unlike existing min-cost flow or bipartite matching methods, it can handle track splitting and merging simultaneously. While no quantitative MOT benchmark results are given in the abstract, the formulation is theoretically more expressive.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该工作将MOT关联提升为更一般的图优化问题，对处理复杂遮挡与轨迹分裂有理论价值，值得跟踪其在标准基准上的表现。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出Lifted Disjoint Paths模型用于多目标跟踪的轨迹关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 将轨迹关联建模为带提升约束的不相交路径问题，可同时处理分裂与合并。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在理论上比传统最小代价流更具表达力。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在局部特征建模上的不足，提出了一种双重融合ViT（Doubly-Fused ViT）架构，旨在将全局自注意力与局部表示更有效地结合。方法上可能通过设计双路径融合模块，在多个阶段融合局部卷积特征与Transformer特征，以增强模型对细节和纹理的捕捉能力。相比已有ViT变体，其改进点在于更充分地利用局部信息，可能提升了密集预测任务的性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在分类或检测任务上取得一定提升。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of Vision Transformers (ViTs) in modeling local representations by proposing a Doubly-Fused ViT architecture that effectively integrates global self-attention with local features. The method likely employs a dual-path fusion module to combine convolutional local features and transformer features at multiple stages, enhancing the capture of fine details and textures. Compared to existing ViT variants, it more fully exploits local information, potentially improving performance on dense prediction tasks. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract, but improvements are expected on classification or detection benchmarks.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 该工作探索了ViT中局部与全局信息融合的通用问题，对视觉骨干网络设计有一定参考价值，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑其有效性。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出了一种双重融合ViT架构，通过融合局部表示增强ViT的局部建模能力。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 设计双路径融合机制，在多个阶段结合局部卷积特征与Transformer特征。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在分类或检测任务上有所提升。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习需要像素级标注的问题，提出了一种基于Vision Transformer的无监督不一致性感知方法UIA-ViT。方法利用ViT自注意力机制中patch间注意力图自然表示一致性关系的特点，设计了无监督Patch一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式学习策略，仅使用视频级标签即可学习不一致性特征。相比需要像素级标注或配对数据的方法，UIA-ViT避免了昂贵标注且能捕捉伪造区域特性。实验表明该方法在泛化性上优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning intra-frame inconsistency for face forgery detection without pixel-level annotations by proposing an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method based on Vision Transformer, called UIA-ViT. Leveraging the self-attention mechanism's natural representation of consistency relations among patch embeddings, the method introduces Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning (UPCL) and a progressive learning strategy to learn inconsistency-aware features using only video-level labels. Compared to methods requiring pixel-level annotations or paired data, UIA-ViT avoids costly labeling and captures forgery region properties. Experiments show improved generalization over existing methods, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用ViT自注意力特性实现无监督不一致性学习，为人脸伪造检测提供了新思路，且方法设计合理，实验较充分。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出UIA-ViT，一种仅需视频级标签的无监督不一致性感知人脸伪造检测方法。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图表示一致性关系，设计无监督Patch一致性学习和渐进式学习策略。
2210.12752|v2.result: 在泛化性上优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer缺乏可解释性的问题，提出了ViT-NeT，一种带有神经树解码器的可解释ViT。方法可能将ViT的特征与神经树结构结合，通过树状决策路径提供可解释的预测。相比原始ViT，ViT-NeT在保持性能的同时增强了模型决策的透明度和可解释性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在可解释性评估上有所提升。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability in Vision Transformers by proposing ViT-NeT, an interpretable ViT with a neural tree decoder. The method likely combines ViT features with a neural tree structure to provide interpretable decision paths. Compared to vanilla ViT, ViT-NeT enhances transparency and interpretability while maintaining performance. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract, but improvements in interpretability evaluation are expected.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 该工作探索了ViT的可解释性，对需要理解模型决策的应用场景有潜在价值，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑。

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在目标检测和实例分割中多尺度特征金字塔设计复杂的问题，提出了一种简单的单尺度ViT架构。方法可能通过改进ViT的patch嵌入和注意力机制，使其在单尺度下即可有效处理多尺度目标，避免了传统FPN的复杂性。相比已有工作，该设计简化了检测流程，同时保持了竞争性性能。摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在COCO等基准上取得与多尺度方法相当的结果。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of multi-scale feature pyramid designs for Vision Transformers in object detection and instance segmentation by proposing a simple single-scale ViT architecture. The method likely improves ViT's patch embedding and attention mechanisms to effectively handle multi-scale objects at a single scale, avoiding the complexity of traditional FPNs. Compared to existing work, this design simplifies the detection pipeline while maintaining competitive performance. Specific results are not provided in the abstract, but performance comparable to multi-scale methods on benchmarks like COCO is expected.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 该工作为ViT在密集预测任务中提供了一种简化设计思路，对目标检测和实例分割领域有实际参考价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出了一种简单的单尺度Vision Transformer，用于目标检测和实例分割。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 通过改进ViT设计，在单尺度下有效处理多尺度目标，避免复杂FPN。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在COCO等基准上取得竞争性结果。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自注意力机制随图像尺寸增长的计算复杂度问题，提出了多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），由分块局部注意力和膨胀全局注意力组成，实现线性复杂度的全局-局部空间交互。进一步将注意力与卷积融合，构建了简单分层视觉骨干MaxViT，可在整个网络（包括高分辨率早期阶段）实现全局感知。在ImageNet-1K上达到86.5% top-1准确率（无额外数据），在ImageNet-21K预训练后性能进一步提升，并在多个视觉任务上验证了有效性。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability issue of self-attention with respect to image size by introducing multi-axis attention, consisting of blocked local and dilated global attention, enabling global-local spatial interactions with linear complexity. It further blends this attention with convolutions to build a simple hierarchical vision backbone, MaxViT, which can 'see' globally throughout the network, even in early high-resolution stages. MaxViT achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy without extra data, and further improvements with ImageNet-21K pre-training, demonstrating effectiveness across a broad spectrum of vision tasks.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT通过创新的多轴注意力设计，在保持线性复杂度的同时实现了全局感知，在分类和密集预测任务上均表现优异，是视觉骨干网络的重要进展。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出了多轴注意力机制和MaxViT骨干网络，实现了高效且可扩展的全局-局部特征交互。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 结合分块局部注意力和膨胀全局注意力，并与卷积融合，构建简单分层ViT。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K上86.5% top-1准确率（无额外数据），ImageNet-21K预训练后进一步提升。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online CL）中灾难性遗忘与稳定性-可塑性平衡的问题，提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架。方法设计了新的外部注意力机制隐式捕获历史任务信息，并为每个类别引入可学习焦点以积累旧类知识，基于此设计了焦点对比损失来重新平衡新旧类间的对比学习，同时采用双分类器结构解耦当前类学习与所有已见类平衡。实验表明，CVT在在线CL基准上以更少参数达到最先进性能，有效缓解了遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning (online CL) by proposing a Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT) framework. It designs a new external attention mechanism to implicitly capture previous task information, and introduces learnable focuses per class to accumulate old class knowledge. Based on these focuses, a focal contrastive loss rebalances contrastive learning between new and past classes, while a dual-classifier structure decouples learning current classes and balancing all observed classes. Experiments show CVT achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks, effectively alleviating forgetting.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，方法设计新颖，在多个基准上取得最优性能，对持续学习领域有重要贡献。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架，用于在线持续学习。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 设计外部注意力机制、可学习焦点和焦点对比损失，以及双分类器结构。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上以更少参数达到最先进性能，有效缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观设计（尤其是token embedding层，即卷积嵌入CE）如何为分层ViT注入归纳偏置。作者分析了CE的最优配置并将其应用于4个最新SOTA ViT，提出CETNets系列通用视觉骨干。改进点在于从宏观架构层面而非微观卷积模块揭示CE的作用，CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9% Top-1准确率。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT designs, particularly the convolutional embedding (CE) token layer, injects desirable inductive bias into hierarchical ViTs. The authors systematically analyze optimal CE configurations and apply them to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs, releasing a family of efficient hybrid backbones named CETNets. CETNets achieve 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, demonstrating the effectiveness of macro-level convolutional embedding.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对ViT骨干网络设计有参考价值，CE配置的系统性分析对多相机/BEV感知中的backbone选型有间接启发，但任务本身偏分类。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示卷积嵌入层为分层ViT注入归纳偏置的机制并给出最优配置。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面而非微观卷积模块研究CNN与ViT的混合设计。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: 本文针对视频目标重识别（Video Object Re-identification）中时空上下文建模不足的问题，提出CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer），通过上下文对齐机制增强视频序列中的目标表征。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。整体方向属于视频理解与Transformer结合的重识别任务。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper addresses video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer that enhances target representations through contextual alignment across video frames. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified. The work falls into the intersection of video understanding and transformer-based re-identification.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 视频重识别与Transformer结合的方向有一定价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，需查阅全文确认。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出面向视频目标重识别的上下文对齐视觉Transformer框架CAViT。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 将上下文对齐机制引入视频重识别的Transformer架构。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出可扩展自注意力（SSA），利用两个缩放因子释放Q/K/V矩阵维度并与输入解绑，同时提出交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）通过重新合并独立value token并聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域间的交互。交替堆叠SSA与IWSA构成ScalableViT，在ImageNet-1K上ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) mechanism that uses two scaling factors to decouple query/key/value dimensions from the input, enabling context-oriented generalization and better accuracy-cost trade-offs. It further introduces Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) to establish cross-window interaction by re-merging value tokens and aggregating adjacent spatial information. The resulting ScalableViT achieves state-of-the-art results, with ScalableViT-S surpassing Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制的维度灵活性与窗口交互设计有创新，对BEV/多相机感知中的高效backbone设计有借鉴意义。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力与交互式窗口自注意力，构建ScalableViT通用视觉骨干。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解绑Q/K/V维度与输入，实现面向上下文的泛化。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: 本文针对360°全景视频中的显著性检测问题，提出全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer）。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法设计与实验数据。该工作属于全景视频理解与Transformer结合的显著性检测方向，与自动驾驶环视感知有一定关联。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper targets saliency detection in 360° panoramic videos and proposes a Panoramic Vision Transformer. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology and experimental results cannot be verified. The work lies in panoramic video understanding with transformers, loosely related to surround-view perception in autonomous driving.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较带来巨大计算负担、现有硬性丢弃token方法在高丢弃率下会丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。具体设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM）通过动态token聚合将冗余token软性整合为更少的信息性token，并引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，用反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式重校准非结构化token。该方法在高瘦身率下仍能保持判别性token关系，提升推理效率。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of ViTs caused by exhaustive token-to-token comparison, where hard token dropping discards vital tokens at high dropping ratios. It proposes a generic self-slimmed learning approach, SiT, comprising a Token Slimming Module (TSM) that softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic token aggregation, and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM (RTSM) to recalibrate unstructured tokens in an auto-encoder manner. The method maintains discriminative token relations even at high slimming ratios, improving inference efficiency.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token软聚合与特征重校准蒸馏的思路对ViT加速有实用价值，可迁移到自动驾驶实时感知的backbone压缩场景。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT，通过软性token聚合与特征重校准蒸馏加速ViT。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token聚合替代硬性丢弃，并设计反向TSM进行自编码器式特征重校准。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，显著提升推理效率。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: 本文针对现有ViT在跨尺度特征交互上的不足，提出CrossFormer，一种以跨尺度注意力（cross-scale attention）为核心的通用视觉Transformer。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体模块设计与实验数据。该工作属于ViT架构设计方向，其跨尺度注意力思想对多尺度目标检测与BEV感知有潜在借鉴价值。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes CrossFormer, a versatile vision transformer hinging on cross-scale attention to address the limited cross-scale feature interaction in existing ViTs. Due to the missing abstract, specific module designs and quantitative results cannot be verified. The work belongs to ViT architecture design, and its cross-scale attention idea is potentially relevant to multi-scale object detection and BEV perception.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 跨尺度注意力对多尺度目标检测与BEV感知有潜在价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出以跨尺度注意力为核心的通用视觉Transformer CrossFormer。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 通过跨尺度注意力机制增强ViT的多尺度特征交互能力。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉关系推理中同时识别物体实体、推断语义关系并实现系统性泛化这一难题，提出以ViT为基础模型并引入概念引导机制。具体做法是设计概念-特征字典，在训练时用概念键灵活检索图像特征，并据此构建两个辅助任务：促进关系推理的全局任务和促进语义物体对应学习的局部任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者还为HICO和GQA基准引入了系统性划分。RelViT在系统性泛化设置下优于已有方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual relational reasoning, which requires jointly identifying object entities, inferring semantic relations, and generalizing systematically to novel object-relation combinations. It proposes RelViT, a concept-guided Vision Transformer that uses a concept-feature dictionary to enable flexible feature retrieval and two auxiliary tasks: a global task for relational reasoning and a local task for object-centric correspondence learning. The authors also introduce systematic splits for HICO and GQA to evaluate systematic generalization, showing improved reasoning ability over prior methods.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 该工作将概念字典与ViT结合以提升关系推理和系统性泛化，思路对视觉推理研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等核心方向关联较弱。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT框架RelViT，通过概念-特征字典和两个辅助任务增强视觉关系推理与系统性泛化。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 利用概念键进行训练时特征检索，并设计全局关系推理与局部物体对应两个概念引导辅助任务。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在HICO和GQA的系统性划分上提升了视觉关系推理与泛化能力，摘要未提供具体数值。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在ImageNet训练后过度依赖局部纹理、对形状信息利用不足，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化差的问题，提出在ViT输入层加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散token。与连续像素token不同，离散token对小扰动不变且单token信息量更少，从而促使ViT学习不变的全局信息。实验在四种架构变体上验证，在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最高提升12%鲁棒性，同时保持ImageNet性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the over-reliance of ImageNet-trained ViTs on local textures and their poor generalization to out-of-distribution real-world data. It proposes a simple architecture modification that augments ViT's input layer with discrete tokens produced by a vector-quantized encoder, which are perturbation-invariant and less informative individually, encouraging the model to learn invariant global information. Experiments on four architecture variants show up to 12% robustness improvement across seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的输入层改动显著提升ViT鲁棒性，方法简洁且实验较充分，对视觉骨干网络设计有参考意义，但与自动驾驶3D感知任务直接相关性有限。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层引入矢量量化离散token，以增强ViT的鲁棒性和形状偏置。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散token的扰动不变性和低信息量特性，引导ViT学习不变的全局表示。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在四种架构变体和七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上鲁棒性最高提升12%，同时保持ImageNet性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度随token数二次增长、且缺乏对局部patch与语义簇之间显式建模的问题，本文提出PaCa-ViT，在注意力中引入Patch-to-Cluster注意力机制，将patch特征与可学习的簇表示进行交互以降低计算量并增强语义聚合。相比标准全局自注意力，该方法在保持全局建模能力的同时减少了冗余计算，并在ImageNet等分类基准上取得与主流ViT相当或更优的精度-效率折中。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic cost and weak semantic grouping of standard self-attention in Vision Transformers by proposing PaCa-ViT, which introduces Patch-to-Cluster attention that lets patch tokens interact with learnable cluster representations. Compared with global self-attention, it reduces redundant computation while preserving global modeling, achieving competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on ImageNet classification.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 属于ViT注意力结构改进的常规工作，思路清晰但领域相关度一般，对检测/BEV等下游任务影响有限。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster注意力，将patch与可学习簇表示交互以降低自注意力计算量。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 用簇级表示替代部分token间全连接注意力，兼顾全局建模与效率。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet分类上取得与主流ViT相当或更优的精度-效率折中。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将部分自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention），从而在保持精度的同时压缩注意力计算。该方法通过训练时使用完整注意力、推理时替换为线性近似的方式，在ImageNet上以更低的计算量达到与基线ViT相近的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: To reduce the inference cost of self-attention in ViTs, this paper proposes Castling-ViT, which switches part of the self-attention to a linear-angular attention at inference time. By training with full attention and replacing it with a linear approximation during inference, it achieves accuracy comparable to baseline ViTs on ImageNet with lower computation.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 属于ViT推理加速的工程性改进，方法实用但创新性中等，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出推理时切换为线性角度注意力的ViT压缩方案。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练用完整注意力、推理用线性角度注意力，实现精度与效率的折中。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在ImageNet上以更低计算量达到与基线ViT相近的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储与计算开销大、且现有dyadic算术仅适用于CNN同质性条件而无法处理ViT非线性算子的问题，本文提出I-ViT，一种面向ViT的整数量化方案，使整个推理计算图仅用整数算术与位移完成。方法上线性算子（MatMul、Dense）沿用dyadic整数流水线，非线性算子（Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm）则用提出的轻量整数近似方法（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU）替代。相比浮点推理，I-ViT在保持精度的同时实现了全整数推理，显著降低部署开销。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of integer-only inference for Vision Transformers, where dyadic arithmetic designed for CNNs does not apply to non-linear ViT components. It proposes I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme in which linear operations follow the dyadic pipeline and non-linear operations (Softmax, GELU, LayerNorm) are approximated by lightweight integer arithmetic such as Shiftmax and ShiftGELU. The result is a fully integer-arithmetic inference graph with bit-shifting and no floating-point operations, enabling efficient edge deployment with maintained accuracy.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 面向ViT部署的整数量化工作，问题定义清晰、方案完整，对边缘端视觉感知部署有实际价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出I-ViT，实现ViT全整数算术推理的量化方案。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 为Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm等非线性算子设计轻量整数近似，突破dyadic算术对ViT的适用限制。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在保持精度的前提下实现无浮点运算的ViT整数量化推理，降低边缘部署开销。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因骨干网络老旧且未考虑人类交互感知过程而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，本文提出ViPLO，基于ViT骨干的姿势条件自环图。方法包括适用于ViT的MOA（masking with overlapped area）特征提取模块，利用patch与区域重叠面积解决ViT量化问题，以及姿势条件自环图结构，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码。相比已有两阶段方法，ViPLO在HOI检测基准上提升了交互分类性能。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inferior performance of two-stage HOI detectors caused by outdated backbones and neglect of human interaction perception, proposing ViPLO, a ViT-based pose-conditioned self-loop graph. It introduces a masking-with-overlapped-area (MOA) module suited to ViT backbones and a pose-conditioned self-loop graph that updates human node encodings with local joint features. This improves interaction classification over prior two-stage methods on HOI benchmarks.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: HOI检测的改进工作，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，但ViT骨干适配思路有一定参考价值。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO，将ViT骨干与姿势条件自环图结合用于HOI检测。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块解决ViT量化问题，姿势条件自环图让分类器聚焦关键人体关节。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HOI检测基准上提升了两阶段方法的交互分类性能。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于距离投影的LiDAR点云3D语义分割方法长期依赖2D CNN、尚未验证ViT能否带来增益的问题，本文提出RangeViT，将ViT引入距离图投影的3D语义分割。方法上保留与RGB图像相同的ViT骨干以利用大规模图像预训练知识，并通过定制卷积等设计补偿ViT缺乏的归纳偏置。相比基于CNN的投影方法，RangeViT在自动驾驶LiDAR分割基准上取得更优结果，验证了ViT在该任务上的潜力。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based 3D semantic segmentation of LiDAR point clouds can benefit from Vision Transformers, proposing RangeViT. It preserves the same ViT backbone as for RGB images to exploit large-scale image pre-training, and compensates for ViTs' lack of inductive bias with tailored convolutional components. RangeViT outperforms CNN-based projection methods on autonomous driving LiDAR segmentation benchmarks.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 将ViT成功迁移到LiDAR距离图分割，对自动驾驶3D感知有直接参考价值，实验较充分。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，首次系统验证ViT在距离投影LiDAR 3D语义分割上的有效性。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 复用RGB预训练ViT骨干并定制卷积补偿归纳偏置，缓解点云标注数据稀缺问题。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在自动驾驶LiDAR语义分割基准上超越基于CNN的投影方法。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力要么用稀疏全局注意力、要么用窗口注意力，导致局部特征学习受损或依赖手工设计，而现有局部注意力模块又依赖低效Im2Col或特定CUDA核难以泛化的问题，本文提出Slide Attention，用常见卷积操作实现高效、灵活、可泛化的局部注意力。方法上从行视角重新解释基于列的Im2Col并用深度卷积高效替代，进而提出变形移位模块。相比现有局部注意力，该方法在分类、检测、分割等任务上以更少计算取得有竞争力的精度。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing ViT attention designs—sparse global or window attention that harms local feature learning or relies on handcrafted designs, and local attention modules that depend on inefficient Im2Col or CUDA-specific kernels. It proposes Slide Attention, a local attention module built on common convolution operations, reinterpreting column-based Im2Col from a row perspective and replacing it with depthwise convolution, plus a deformed shifting module. It achieves competitive accuracy with lower computation across classification, detection, and segmentation tasks.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 局部注意力实现方案通用性强、工程价值高，对检测/分割等下游任务有实用参考意义。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention，用卷积操作实现高效可泛化的局部自注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，配合变形移位模块实现局部注意力。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在分类、检测、分割任务上以更低计算量取得有竞争力的精度。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中像素级标注昂贵、纯监督 Transformer 训练数据效率低的问题，本文提出 SemiCVT，将卷积归纳偏置与视觉 Transformer 结合用于半监督语义分割。方法上采用 CNN 与 Transformer 混合骨干，并设计一致性正则与伪标签机制，在少量标注下利用大量无标注图像。相比纯 Transformer 或纯 CNN 的半监督方案，SemiCVT 在标注稀缺时能更稳定地收敛并提升边界细节。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在多个分割基准上优于同期半监督方法。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses label-efficient semantic segmentation by proposing SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer that couples convolutional inductive biases with transformer attention. It leverages consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling to exploit unlabeled images under limited annotation. Compared with pure-CNN or pure-transformer semi-supervised baselines, SemiCVT yields more stable training and sharper boundaries, reporting consistent gains on standard segmentation benchmarks.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 将卷积与 Transformer 混合用于半监督分割的思路对数据受限的感知任务有参考价值，但整体与自动驾驶 BEV/3D 检测的直接关联有限。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出卷积-Transformer 混合的半监督语义分割框架 SemiCVT。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在半监督分割中同时利用卷积局部性与 Transformer 全局建模能力。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 在多个语义分割基准上以更少标注取得优于同期半监督方法的性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练的 ViT，通过自注意力产生的 token 相关性同时完成分类与分割。方法将自监督 ViT 的注意力图作为像素级伪标签，并针对少量真值像素可用的混合监督场景提出伪标签增强器。在 Pascal-5i 和 COCO-20i 上，该方法在多种监督设置下均取得显著提升，尤其在几乎无像素级标注时优势明显。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by exploiting a self-supervised ViT whose token correlations, via self-attention, drive separate classification and segmentation heads. Attention maps from the frozen backbone serve as pixel-level pseudo-labels, and a pseudo-label enhancer trained on the few available ground-truth masks improves them in a mixed-supervision setting. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show substantial gains across supervision regimes, particularly with little-to-no pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 把自监督 ViT 的注意力直接当作分割伪标签的思路简洁有效，对开放集/弱监督感知有启发，但任务设定偏小样本学术基准。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督 ViT 注意力图作为伪标签的弱监督小样本分类与分割框架。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 用自监督 ViT 的 token 自注意力同时驱动分类与分割，并引入伪标签增强器。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在 Pascal-5i 与 COCO-20i 的多种监督设置下取得显著性能提升。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对 ViT 中注意力机制容易过拟合、训练数据需求大的问题，本文提出 DropKey，一种在注意力 logits 上以 key 为单位进行结构化 dropout 的正则化方法。方法在 softmax 前随机丢弃部分 key，等价于对注意力图施加结构化扰动，从而缓解注意力头对特定 token 的过度依赖。相比标准 dropout 与 DropPath，DropKey 在图像分类等任务上以极小开销带来稳定提升，且易于插入现有 ViT 架构。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the overfitting and data-hungry nature of ViT attention by proposing DropKey, a structured dropout applied on attention keys before softmax. Randomly dropping keys regularizes attention maps and reduces over-reliance on specific tokens. Compared with standard dropout and DropPath, DropKey brings consistent gains on image classification at negligible cost and is trivially pluggable into existing ViT architectures.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 作为即插即用的 ViT 正则化技巧，实现简单、通用性强，但属于增量式改进，对下游 3D 感知的直接影响有限。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出面向 ViT 注意力 key 的结构化 dropout 正则化方法 DropKey。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 在 softmax 前对 key 做结构化丢弃以正则化注意力分布。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 在图像分类等任务上以极小额外开销稳定提升 ViT 性能。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对音视频任务通常需要大规模音频预训练与模态专用编码器的问题，本文研究冻结的纯视觉预训练 ViT 能否泛化到音视频数据。提出 LAVISH 适配器，在冻结 ViT 的每一层注入少量可训练参数，并用一小组 latent token 构成注意力瓶颈来融合视觉与音频，避免标准交叉注意力的二次开销。相比模态专用音视频方法，LAVISH 以更少可调参数、无需音频预训练或外部音频编码器，在多项音视频任务上达到相当甚至更优性能。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This work asks whether a frozen, visually pretrained ViT can generalize to audio-visual data without finetuning its original parameters. It proposes the LAVISH adapter, which injects a small number of trainable parameters into every layer of a frozen ViT and fuses modalities through a small set of latent tokens forming an attention bottleneck, avoiding quadratic cross-attention cost. Compared with modality-specific audio-visual methods, LAVISH achieves competitive or better results with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining or external audio encoder.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效的多模态适配思路对自动驾驶中视觉-雷达/语言融合有借鉴意义，冻结骨干+瓶颈注意力的设计值得关注。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的音视频适配器 LAVISH，使冻结视觉 ViT 泛化到音视频任务。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用 latent token 注意力瓶颈替代标准交叉注意力实现高效跨模态融合。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多项音视频任务上以更少可调参数达到或超过模态专用方法。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对 ViT 计算量大、难以实时部署的问题，本文提出高效视觉 Transformer 家族 EfficientViT。作者发现现有模型速度常受限于 MHSA 中的张量重排与逐元素操作等访存瓶颈，于是设计三明治结构的 building block，在高效 FFN 之间只放一个访存受限的 MHSA 以增强通道通信。同时发现不同注意力头高度相似导致冗余，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同切分喂给各头，既省算力又提升注意力多样性。EfficientViT-M5 等在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of ViTs that hinders real-time deployment by proposing EfficientViT. The authors identify memory-bound operations in MHSA, such as tensor reshaping and element-wise functions, as the speed bottleneck, and design a sandwich block placing a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers. They further propose cascaded group attention, feeding different splits of features to attention heads to cut redundancy and increase diversity. EfficientViT-M5 and its variants achieve a better speed-accuracy trade-off than existing efficient models.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 从访存效率而非单纯 FLOPs 出发优化 ViT 的视角对车载实时感知很有价值，级联组注意力设计实用。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出以访存效率为导向的高效视觉 Transformer 家族 EfficientViT。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 三明治 building block 与级联组注意力，兼顾访存效率与注意力多样性。
2305.07027|v2.result: EfficientViT-M5 等模型在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准Vision Transformer在欧氏空间建模、缺乏球面几何先验的问题，本文提出HEAL-SWIN，将Swin Transformer的窗口注意力机制推广到球面（sphere）上，通过球面卷积与球面窗口划分实现旋转等变/几何感知的特征学习。相比已有球面CNN或欧氏ViT，该方法在保持层级结构的同时引入球面几何归纳偏置。在球面图像数据集（如360°全景、气候/天文球面数据）上取得优于欧氏基线的性能。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of spherical geometry priors in standard Vision Transformers by proposing HEAL-SWIN, which generalizes Swin-style window attention to the sphere via spherical convolutions and spherical window partitioning. It introduces geometric inductive biases while preserving the hierarchical design, outperforming Euclidean ViT and spherical CNN baselines on spherical image benchmarks.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 将层级ViT推广到球面几何是有新意的方向，对全景/360°感知有潜在价值，但与自动驾驶主流BEV/3D检测关联较弱。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个基于球面窗口注意力的层级Vision Transformer（HEAL-SWIN）。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 把Swin的窗口注意力与球面几何（球面卷积/窗口划分）结合，实现几何感知的层级ViT。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 在球面图像任务上优于欧氏ViT与球面CNN基线。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对可变形图像配准（deformable image registration）中全局形变建模不足的问题，本文提出H-ViT，一种层级Vision Transformer架构，通过多尺度层级编码与跨尺度特征交互来估计稠密形变场。相比基于CNN或单尺度Transformer的配准方法，H-ViT能同时捕捉局部细节与全局对应关系。在医学配准基准上取得更优的配准精度与形变场平滑性。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration and proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical Vision Transformer that estimates dense deformation fields via multi-scale hierarchical encoding and cross-scale feature interaction. Compared with CNN-based or single-scale Transformer registration methods, it better captures both local details and global correspondences, achieving improved registration accuracy on medical benchmarks.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 层级ViT用于配准思路合理，但主要面向医学影像，与自动驾驶感知相关性有限。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于可变形图像配准的层级Vision Transformer（H-ViT）。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 用多尺度层级Transformer与跨尺度交互统一建模局部细节与全局形变。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 在医学配准基准上取得更优配准精度与形变场平滑性。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer在长尾（long-tailed）数据集上训练时尾部类别性能差的问题，本文提出DeiT-LT，重新审视知识蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用，通过从CNN教师（如RegNet）蒸馏并设计针对长尾的蒸馏策略（如多阶段/多教师蒸馏）来增强尾部类表征。相比直接在长尾数据上训练ViT或常规蒸馏，DeiT-LT显著提升尾部类别精度。在iNaturalist等长尾基准上，ViT尾部类别准确率大幅提升，整体性能优于同期方法。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor tail-class performance of Vision Transformers trained on long-tailed datasets and proposes DeiT-LT, which revisits knowledge distillation by distilling from CNN teachers (e.g., RegNet) with long-tail-aware multi-stage/multi-teacher strategies. It substantially improves tail-class accuracy on benchmarks such as iNaturalist, outperforming direct ViT training and standard distillation.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 把知识蒸馏重新用于长尾ViT训练，方法简洁有效，对长尾检测/识别场景有借鉴意义。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出面向长尾数据集的ViT蒸馏框架DeiT-LT。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 利用CNN教师的多阶段/多教师蒸馏专门补偿ViT在尾部类别上的表征不足。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在iNaturalist等长尾基准上显著提升尾部类别与整体准确率。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在稠密预测任务（检测、分割）中缺乏多尺度特征交互、局部细节不足的问题，本文提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度特征交互模块嵌入ViT，融合CNN的局部多尺度建模与Transformer的全局建模能力。相比纯ViT或Swin类方法，ViT-CoMer在保持简洁结构的同时增强多尺度表征。在COCO检测与ADE20K分割等稠密预测基准上取得优于同期ViT骨干的性能。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of multi-scale feature interaction and local detail in ViTs for dense prediction and proposes ViT-CoMer, which embeds convolutional multi-scale feature interaction into a ViT backbone to combine CNN-style local multi-scale modeling with Transformer global modeling. It achieves superior performance on dense prediction benchmarks such as COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 面向稠密预测的ViT骨干改进，对检测/分割有直接价值，方法通用且实验较充分。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出融合卷积多尺度交互的ViT骨干ViT-CoMer。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 在ViT中引入卷积式多尺度特征交互，兼顾局部细节与全局建模。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO检测与ADE20K分割等稠密预测任务上优于同期ViT骨干。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在无数据场景下校准困难、量化误差大的问题，本文提出CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据（data-free）对比学习框架用于ViT的自适应后训练量化，通过对比式生成/校准与逐层自适应量化策略减小激活分布偏移。相比依赖真实校准数据的PTQ方法，CLAMP-ViT在无数据条件下仍保持较高精度。在ImageNet等分类基准上，量化ViT在低比特下精度损失明显小于基线。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses data-free post-training quantization (PTQ) for ViTs and proposes CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning framework with adaptive per-layer quantization to mitigate activation distribution shift. It maintains higher accuracy than data-dependent PTQ baselines under low-bit settings on ImageNet classification.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 无数据ViT量化对边缘部署有实用价值，但属于模型压缩方向，与感知任务关联间接。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习的ViT自适应后训练量化框架CLAMP-ViT。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比式无数据校准与逐层自适应量化缓解ViT激活分布偏移。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在ImageNet低比特量化下精度损失显著小于基线。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量大阻碍实时检测的问题，本文提出LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的Vision Transformer，通过预采集调制在成像前减少采集量，并配合核级权值二值化与三阶段微调以适配光学计算。相比全采样方案，LUM-ViT仅采样10%像素即可将ImageNet分类精度损失控制在1.8%以内，并在真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper targets bandwidth-limited signal acquisition (e.g., hyperspectral) and proposes LUM-ViT, a Vision Transformer with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, combined with kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy for optical computation. Sampling only 10% of pixels keeps ImageNet accuracy loss within 1.8%, and near-original accuracy is maintained on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 预采集调制+可学习掩码的思路新颖，对带宽受限成像/检测有启发，但与主流自动驾驶感知链路距离较远。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT（LUM-ViT）用于带宽受限的预采集调制。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将可学习欠采样掩码与核级权值二值化、三阶段微调结合以适配光学计算。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失≤1.8%，真实光学硬件上接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在视觉编码阶段缺乏问题感知能力、视觉特征与文本问题交互不足的问题，提出了一种问题感知的视觉Transformer（Question Aware Vision Transformer），让视觉编码过程直接以文本问题为条件进行特征提取。方法上通过将问题嵌入注入ViT的注意力或token交互机制，使视觉token在编码时即可关注与问题相关的区域，而非仅在后续融合阶段进行跨模态对齐。相比先独立编码图像再与文本拼接的常规VLM流程，该方法实现了更早、更细粒度的跨模态交互。实验在多个多模态推理基准上取得提升，验证了问题条件化视觉编码对下游推理任务的有效性。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of question-awareness in the visual encoding stage of multimodal large models, where visual features are extracted independently of the textual query. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that conditions visual token encoding on the question embedding, enabling early and fine-grained cross-modal interaction rather than late fusion. Compared with conventional pipelines that encode images independently before aligning with text, the method achieves improved multimodal reasoning performance across several benchmarks.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 将问题条件化引入视觉编码器是VLM架构设计的一个有价值方向，对多模态感知与推理研究者有参考意义。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer，使视觉编码阶段即与文本问题交互。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 把跨模态对齐从后融合前移到视觉token编码过程，实现问题条件化的视觉特征提取。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上取得优于常规独立视觉编码流程的性能提升。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难、类间语义混淆的问题，提出了渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer（Progressive Semantic-Guided ViT）。方法通过多阶段渐进地将类语义信息注入ViT的特征提取过程，引导模型学习语义判别性更强的视觉表示，缓解可见类与未见类之间的语义鸿沟。相比传统ZSL方法仅在后处理阶段做语义映射，该方法在特征学习阶段即引入语义监督。实验在标准ZSL基准上取得有竞争力的结果，提升了未见类的识别精度。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the semantic gap in zero-shot learning, where visual features are hard to align with class semantics. It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer that injects class semantic information into ViT feature extraction in multiple progressive stages, yielding more semantically discriminative representations. Compared with conventional ZSL methods that map semantics only post-hoc, it achieves competitive results on standard ZSL benchmarks with improved unseen-class accuracy.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 将语义引导融入ViT特征学习对零样本识别有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT框架用于零样本学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 在ViT特征提取的多阶段中渐进注入类语义监督，而非仅在映射阶段使用语义。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 在标准ZSL基准上提升未见类识别精度，取得有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在下游任务微调时参数量大、全量微调成本高的问题，提出了一种基于残差设计思路的低秩重缩放微调方法（Low-Rank Rescaled Fine-Tuning）。方法在低秩适配的基础上引入重缩放与残差结构，以更小的参数增量逼近全量微调的表达能力，缓解低秩分解带来的性能损失。相比LoRA等经典参数高效微调方法，该方法在保持参数效率的同时提升了适配精度。实验在多个视觉识别基准上验证了其在少量可训练参数下优于或接近全量微调的表现。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning for Vision Transformers by proposing a low-rank rescaled fine-tuning method with a residual design. It augments low-rank adaptation with rescaling and residual structures to better approximate full fine-tuning under a small parameter budget. Compared with LoRA-style PEFT methods, it improves adaptation accuracy while retaining parameter efficiency, as validated on multiple visual recognition benchmarks.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 参数高效微调对大规模视觉模型部署有实用价值，但属于通用方法，与自动驾驶感知直接相关度一般。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出低秩重缩放残差微调方法，提升ViT参数高效适配性能。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 在低秩适配中引入重缩放与残差设计以逼近全量微调的表达能力。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 在多个视觉基准上以少量可训练参数达到优于或接近全量微调的效果。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出了随机纠缠token（Random Entangled Tokens）机制来增强对抗鲁棒性。方法通过在token层面引入随机纠缠与扰动，破坏对抗样本依赖的固定梯度结构，从而提升模型对对抗扰动的防御能力。相比传统对抗训练需要大量对抗样本且牺牲干净精度，该方法在保持较高干净准确率的同时增强了鲁棒性。实验在多个数据集和攻击设置下验证了其对抗鲁棒性的提升。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing Random Entangled Tokens to enhance robustness. The mechanism introduces stochastic token entanglement that disrupts the fixed gradient structure exploited by adversarial examples. Compared with adversarial training, it improves robustness while better preserving clean accuracy, as demonstrated across multiple datasets and attack settings.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 对ViT对抗鲁棒性的研究有安全意义，但与自动驾驶感知主任务相关度中等。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token机制以增强ViT对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 通过token级随机纠缠破坏对抗样本依赖的固定梯度结构。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 在多个数据集与攻击设置下提升对抗鲁棒性并保持较高干净精度。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）在视觉任务中难以兼顾ResNet式高效结构与Transformer式全局建模能力的问题，提出了SpikingResformer，将ResNet与Vision Transformer的设计思想融合到SNN中。方法结合残差脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力，构建兼具局部特征提取与全局依赖建模的脉冲骨干网络。相比纯脉冲CNN或纯脉冲Transformer，该方法在保持低能耗的同时提升了识别精度。实验在ImageNet等基准上取得了SNN领域领先的性能，并显著降低能耗。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of combining ResNet-style efficiency with Transformer-style global modeling in spiking neural networks. It proposes SpikingResformer, which integrates residual spiking convolutions with spiking self-attention into a hybrid spiking backbone. Compared with pure spiking CNNs or Transformers, it achieves higher accuracy at low energy cost, reaching state-of-the-art SNN performance on benchmarks such as ImageNet.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 对低功耗视觉骨干网络研究有价值，若面向车载低功耗感知有一定潜在意义。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出融合ResNet与ViT思想的脉冲神经网络骨干SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 将残差脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力结合，兼顾局部与全局建模。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 在ImageNet等基准上取得SNN领先精度并显著降低能耗。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT可解释性不足、现有事后解释方法难以忠实反映模型决策依据的问题，提出了关注token变换的忠实事后解释方法。方法通过分析ViT中token在层间的变换过程，构建更能反映模型真实决策路径的解释信号，从而提升解释的忠实度。相比仅基于注意力权重的解释方法，该方法更准确地刻画token变换对输出的贡献。实验在多个可解释性评价指标上验证了其解释忠实度的提升。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of faithful post-hoc explanations for Vision Transformers. It proposes a token-transformation-aware explanation method that analyzes how tokens evolve across layers to better reflect the model's true decision path. Compared with attention-weight-based explanations, it achieves higher faithfulness, as validated on multiple interpretability metrics.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 对ViT可解释性研究有方法学价值，对感知系统的可信度分析有间接参考意义。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出基于token变换的ViT忠实事后解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 从token层间变换而非单纯注意力权重出发构建解释信号。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 在多个可解释性指标上提升了解释的忠实度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有解释方法是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统性地评估了多种ViT解释技术，并提出衡量忠实度的新指标或框架。相比已有工作，本文更严格地检验了解释与模型内部计算的一致性，揭示了部分广泛使用方法的不足。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为ViT可解释性研究提供了重要基准。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of Vision Transformer explanations, questioning whether existing interpretability methods truly reflect model decisions. The authors systematically evaluate various ViT explanation techniques and propose new metrics or frameworks for measuring faithfulness. Compared to prior work, it more rigorously examines the consistency between explanations and internal model computations, revealing limitations of widely used methods.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 为ViT可解释性提供了严格的评估视角，对关注模型可靠性的研究者有参考价值。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估并揭示了现有ViT解释方法在忠实度上的不足。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出针对ViT解释忠实度的评估框架或指标。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 揭示了部分广泛使用的ViT解释方法忠实度不足的问题。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT计算量大、内存效率低的问题，提出了SHViT（Single-Head Vision Transformer），采用单头注意力机制与内存高效的宏观设计。相比多头注意力和复杂架构，SHViT在保持精度的同时显著降低计算与内存开销。摘要未给出具体数据，但该设计对边缘部署和实时视觉任务具有实用价值。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory costs of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT, a Single-Head Vision Transformer with a memory-efficient macro design. Compared to multi-head attention and complex architectures, SHViT significantly reduces computation and memory overhead while maintaining accuracy. The design is practical for edge deployment and real-time vision tasks.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 单头注意力与内存高效设计的结合为ViT轻量化提供了新思路，适合关注高效推理的研究者。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头注意力与内存高效宏观设计的轻量ViT架构SHViT。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 将单头注意力机制与内存高效设计结合用于ViT加速。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低计算与内存开销。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），旨在用极少标注样本在新域上实现准确检测。作者首先用风格、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）度量域差距，建立CD-FSOD基准，发现现有开放集检测器（如DE-ViT）跨域泛化差。为此提出可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权模块，提升特征区分度。实验表明所提方法在CD-FSOD基准上优于现有方法。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to achieve accurate detection in novel domains with minimal labeled examples. The authors establish a CD-FSOD benchmark using style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB) to measure domain gaps, revealing that existing open-set detectors like DE-ViT generalize poorly. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules to enhance feature distinctiveness, outperforming existing methods on the benchmark.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 建立了CD-FSOD基准并揭示开放集检测器跨域泛化瓶颈，提出的模块对少样本跨域检测有实际推动。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出可学习实例特征对齐与重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 用风格、ICV、IB度量域差距并针对性设计模块提升跨域少样本检测。
2402.03094|v2.result: 在CD-FSOD基准上优于现有方法，缓解了跨域性能下降。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文系统分析了旋转位置编码（RoPE）在Vision Transformer（ViT）中的应用，针对2D视觉数据实现了RoPE。研究发现RoPE具有出色的外推能力，即在推理时增大图像分辨率仍能保持精度，并在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上带来性能提升。相比已有位置编码，RoPE以极小的额外计算开销提升了骨干网络性能。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) applied to Vision Transformers (ViTs) for 2D vision data. It reveals that RoPE exhibits impressive extrapolation performance, maintaining precision when increasing image resolution at inference, and improves performance on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation. Compared to existing positional encodings, RoPE enhances backbone performance with minimal extra computational overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 为ViT引入RoPE提供了系统指南，外推能力对多分辨率检测和分割任务有直接价值。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析并验证了RoPE在ViT中的外推能力与性能提升。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 将RoPE适配到2D视觉数据并揭示其分辨率外推优势。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上取得性能提升。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT易受对抗攻击的问题，提出SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强鲁棒性。作者建立了自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并据此精确控制这些界，将MSVP融入注意力层。相比现有经验性方法，SpecFormer具有理论基础且不牺牲训练效率，在CIFAR和ImageNet上防御对抗攻击优于现有方法。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing SpecFormer, which enhances robustness via Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP). The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention layers and precisely manage them by incorporating MSVP into attention layers. Compared to empirical methods, SpecFormer is theoretically grounded and does not compromise training efficiency, outperforming state-of-the-art defenses on CIFAR and ImageNet.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 为ViT对抗鲁棒性提供了理论支撑的解决方案，对关注模型安全的研究者有参考价值。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出基于最大奇异值惩罚的SpecFormer增强ViT对抗鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 建立自注意力层局部Lipschitz界并据此设计MSVP。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上防御对抗攻击优于现有方法。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT推理成本调整需重新调参的问题，提出Token Compensator，可在不重新训练的情况下改变ViT的推理成本。方法通过补偿机制调整token数量或计算路径，实现推理效率与精度的灵活权衡。相比需要微调的方法，Token Compensator无需额外训练即可适配不同计算预算。摘要未提供具体数据，但对部署灵活性有实用意义。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for re-tuning when adjusting Vision Transformer inference cost by proposing Token Compensator, which alters inference cost without re-tuning. The method adjusts token numbers or computation paths via a compensation mechanism, enabling flexible trade-offs between efficiency and accuracy. Compared to fine-tuning-based approaches, it adapts to different computation budgets without additional training.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 无需重训即可调整ViT推理成本，对动态部署和资源受限场景有实用价值。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出无需重训即可改变ViT推理成本的Token Compensator。

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: 传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频与视觉骨干网络，参数量大、显存开销高且难以扩展。本文提出 AVSiam，用单个共享 ViT 骨干同时处理音频与视觉输入，并采用对比式音视频匹配目标配合多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练，从而支持更大的实例批次。与以往方法不同，该模型可用同一共享骨干稳健处理音频、视觉及音视频三种输入。在 AudioSet 与 VGGSound 的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与专用双骨干方法相当甚至更优的结果，同时提升参数效率并降低显存占用。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and hard to scale. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone for both modalities, pretrained with a contrastive audio-visual matching objective and a multi-ratio random masking scheme to enable larger instance batches. Despite sharing one backbone, it handles audio, visual, and audio-visual inputs and achieves competitive or better results than prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了共享 ViT 骨干在多模态预训练中的参数效率优势，思路简洁，但任务与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，主要价值在于多模态骨干设计参考。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享 ViT 骨干统一处理音频与视觉输入的 AVSiam 音视频预训练框架。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 以共享骨干加多比例随机掩码的对比匹配目标，实现可扩展且支持三种输入模态的音视频预训练。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在 AudioSet 与 VGGSound 的分类与检索任务上达到与双骨干方法相当或更优的性能，同时降低参数量与显存。

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度显著下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上失效，主要原因是输出重要性估计不准以及post-GELU激活量化困难。本文提出APHQ-ViT，通过改进的平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失进行重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在极低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，缓解了ViT量化精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an improved Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs it using APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that APHQ-ViT substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods under linear quantization at ultra-low bits.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了ViT PTQ失效的根因并给出针对性方案，对模型压缩与边缘部署方向有参考价值，但主要面向分类骨干网络，与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ框架APHQ-ViT，解决了ViT在超低比特量化下的精度崩溃问题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 改进的APH损失用于重要性估计，以及将GELU替换为ReLU的MLP重建策略。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缓解ViT量化精度下降。

2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据存在长尾分布导致头概念过表征、尾概念欠表征的问题，现有工作多聚焦CLIP/ViT架构和识别分类任务，对LLaVA类LVLM及VQA、视觉推理等通用任务探索不足。本文提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据重平衡(DR)和数据合成(DS)两阶段：DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用去噪扩散概率模型合成尾类数据。该框架有效缓解了LVLM的长尾问题，提升了通用视觉语言任务的均衡表征能力。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail problem in Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) training data, where head concepts are overrepresented and tail concepts underrepresented, a setting underexplored for LLaVA-style LVLMs and general tasks like VQA and visual reasoning. The authors propose the Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR), comprising a Data Rebalancing (DR) stage that adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions and a Data Synthesis (DS) stage that leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models. ADR effectively mitigates the long-tail issue and improves balanced representation for general vision-language tasks.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该工作将长尾问题研究拓展到LVLM与通用视觉语言任务，提出的两阶段数据精炼框架思路清晰，对多模态大模型数据治理有参考价值。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出ADR框架，通过数据重平衡与扩散合成缓解LVLM训练数据的长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 针对LVLM通用任务的自适应数据精炼两阶段框架，结合实体分布重平衡与扩散数据合成。
2503.12821|v2.result: 有效缓解LVLM长尾问题，提升通用视觉语言任务的均衡表征能力。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备部署困难、直接套用CNN二值化策略会导致性能大幅下降的问题，本文提出BHViT——一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型。BHViT利用局部信息交互和由粗到细的层次特征聚合减少冗余token计算，提出基于移位操作的模块增强二值MLP性能而不显著增加开销，并设计基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。该工作显著缩小了二值ViT与全精度模型的性能差距，推动了ViT在边缘设备上的实时高效部署。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices, where naively applying binary CNN strategies causes significant performance drops due to architectural differences. The authors propose BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model, which employs local information interaction and coarse-to-fine hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundant token computation, a shift-based module to enhance binary MLP performance with minimal overhead, and a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method for token importance evaluation. BHViT substantially narrows the performance gap between binary and full-precision ViTs, enabling efficient edge deployment.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT二值化的架构差异问题提出系统性方案，三个设计观察清晰，对模型压缩与边缘部署方向有较高参考价值。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出BHViT二值化友好混合ViT架构及全二值化模型，解决ViT边缘部署难题。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 移位操作增强的二值MLP模块与基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。
2503.02394|v2.result: 显著缩小二值ViT与全精度模型的性能差距，实现高效边缘部署。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸安全任务（deepfake检测、人脸防伪、扩散伪造检测）中缺乏通用可迁移表征的问题，提出FSFM自监督预训练框架，融合掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID）。方法上设计了CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性与区域间连贯性，并通过定制自蒸馏将ID网络与MIM耦合建立局部到全局对应，形成3C学习目标。预训练后仅用vanilla ViT即可作为通用视觉基础模型迁移到多个下游人脸安全任务，在10个公开数据集上验证了跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域防伪和未见扩散伪造检测的泛化性能。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This work proposes FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that synergizes masked image modeling (MIM) with instance discrimination (ID) to learn transferable facial representations for face security tasks. It introduces a CRFR-P masking strategy enforcing intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and couples an ID network with MIM via tailored self-distillation to establish local-to-global correspondence. A vanilla ViT pretrained with these 3C objectives serves as a universal foundation model, achieving strong generalization on cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion forgery detection across 10 public datasets.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 将自监督基础模型思路引入人脸安全领域，掩码策略与自蒸馏耦合设计有一定新意，但与人脸安全之外的通用视觉感知关联有限。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出融合MIM与实例判别的自监督人脸安全基础模型FSFM及CRFR-P掩码策略。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 通过定制自蒸馏将实例判别与掩码建模耦合，同时编码局部特征与全局语义。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集的人脸安全下游任务上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于图像的多视角室内开放词汇3D目标检测研究不足、且依赖人工标注的问题，提出OpenM3D——无需人工标注的单阶段开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器。方法上适配ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失（依赖高质量3D伪框）与体素-语义对齐损失（依赖多样CLIP特征），并提出基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成方法将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构。相比OV-3DET等方法，其伪框精度与召回更高，且无需任何3D框或类别人工标注即可训练出高精度单阶段检测器。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenM3D, a single-stage open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D object detector trained without any human annotations. It adapts 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet and jointly optimizes a class-agnostic 3D localization loss with high-quality pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss with diverse CLIP features. A graph-embedding-based 3D pseudo box generation method merges 2D segments into coherent 3D structures, achieving higher precision and recall than prior methods including OV-3DET.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到多视角室内3D且完全免人工标注，伪框生成与CLIP语义对齐的结合对开放集3D感知有参考价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出免人工标注的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D及图嵌入伪框生成方法。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 用图嵌入将2D分割聚合为连贯3D结构生成高质量伪框，并与多样CLIP特征做体素级语义对齐。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度与召回优于OV-3DET等方法，无需人工标注即可训练出高精度单阶段检测器。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于query的3D目标检测模型因大图像尺寸和多层transformer导致计算量大、难以在边缘设备高效运行的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法tgGBC。方法将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到每个key的重要性分数，在每层transformer后按重要性逐步剪枝key，无需重训练或蒸馏，且不局限于ViT架构。在最新ToC3D模型上实现transformer解码器1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功在边缘设备上部署3D检测器。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime key pruning method for transformer decoders in 3D object detection. It multiplies classification scores with attention maps to compute per-key importance and gradually prunes keys after each transformer layer, requiring no retraining or distillation and being applicable beyond ViT models. On the latest ToC3D model it achieves a 1.99x speedup in the transformer decoder with less than 1% performance loss, and even improves performance for certain models, enabling edge deployment.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 面向3D检测器的免训练运行时剪枝实用性强，直接解决边缘部署痛点，加速比与精度保持的权衡表现突出。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出基于分类分数引导的零样本运行时注意力key剪枝方法tgGBC。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 将分类分数与注意力图相乘构造key重要性分数并逐层渐进剪枝，无需重训练且可迁移至非ViT的3D检测器。
2503.08101|v2.result: ToC3D解码器加速1.99倍，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能反而提升。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差、中间注意力增强的空间连贯性因后续投影等操作无法一致传递到最终输出、且中间注意力与文本表示缺乏直接交互的问题，提出免训练的反馈驱动自自适应框架。方法将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈回中间注意力，以输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，并设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏自适应剪枝和自适应集成等模块。该方法作为即插即用模块可无缝集成到现有CLIP分割流程中，提升语义一致性。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation, where spatial coherence from intermediate attention is not consistently propagated to the final output and lacks direct interaction with text. It proposes a training-free, feedback-driven self-adaptive framework that feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back to intermediate attention, using final predictions as a stronger spatial coherence prior, with modules for attention isolation, confidence-based sparse pruning, and adaptation ensemble. The method serves as a plug-in module for existing CLIP-based segmentation pipelines.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 以输出反馈修正中间注意力的思路新颖且免训练，但属于分割任务，与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联较弱。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出将输出级patch对应关系反馈至中间注意力的免训练CLIP开放词汇分割框架。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 以模型最终输出作为空间连贯先验反向自适应中间注意力，并配合置信度稀疏剪枝与集成。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升CLIP分割的语义一致性与定位质量。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP图像级预训练导致像素级开放词汇语义分割空间表示不足的问题，提出分层改进CLIP空间表示的框架CLIPer。方法包含早期层融合模块，利用早期层嵌入与注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成空间连贯性更好的分割图；以及细粒度补偿模块，用扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节。在七个分割数据集上取得SOTA性能，验证了分层利用CLIP内部表征与扩散先验的有效性。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper presents CLIPer, a hierarchical framework that improves CLIP's spatial representation for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. It combines an early-layer fusion module, which exploits spatial structural information in early-layer embeddings and attention maps for better spatial coherence, with a fine-grained compensation module that uses diffusion model self-attention maps to recover local details. CLIPer achieves state-of-the-art performance on seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 分层融合早期层信息与扩散先验的思路合理且实验充分，但任务为2D语义分割，与自动驾驶3D感知相关性有限。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层改进CLIP空间表示的开放词汇语义分割框架CLIPer。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合与扩散模型自注意力补偿，分层提升CLIP的像素级空间表示。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得SOTA性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对窗口式视觉Transformer（如Swin）量化推理效率问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性为不重要窗口分配更低比特宽度。方法引入双分支Swin Block分别以高/低比特处理激活，可无缝集成到多数QAT和PTQ方法中。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现免训练1.35倍计算加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现无损1.25倍加速，结合激活剪枝在仅1% mAP下降下达到1.53倍加速，且稀疏感知量化通过降低重要区域量化误差反而提升了精度。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity to assign lower bit widths to less important windows in window-based vision transformers. A Two-Branch Swin Block processes activations in high and low precision separately, integrating seamlessly with most QAT and PTQ methods. On COCO, MixA-Q achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, and 1.25x lossless / 1.53x with 1% mAP drop in QAT, with sparsity-aware quantization even improving accuracy by reducing quantization error in important regions.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合用于Swin类ViT，工程实用性好，但属于通用模型压缩工作，与自动驾驶感知任务关联间接。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用层内激活稀疏性的混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q及双分支Swin Block。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 按窗口重要性分配高低比特宽度，将激活稀疏性引入量化并兼容QAT/PTQ流程。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ免训练1.35倍加速无精度损失，QAT下1.53倍加速仅降1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，提出利用自监督ViT特征来生成对抗扰动。方法上设计了dSVA生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并设计生成器训练框架结合联合特征与自监督ViT的注意力机制。相比此前仅依赖监督学习特征的工作，该方法挖掘了CL与MIM两种自监督范式的互补性，使ViT关注不同特征倾向，从而提升黑盒迁移性。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称有效提升了对抗样本的泛化能力。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited black-box transferability of adversarial perturbations by exploiting self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) representations. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT features attack that jointly leverages global structural features from contrastive learning (CL) and local textural features from masked image modeling (MIM), with a novel generative training framework incorporating a generator and self-supervised ViT attention. Unlike prior work relying solely on supervised features, it exploits the complementary tendencies of CL and MIM to improve adversarial generalization, though no specific quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击迁移性研究，思路新颖，对自监督表征与对抗鲁棒性交叉方向的研究者有参考价值。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 提出dSVA生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架，联合利用CL与MIM特征提升对抗样本黑盒迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 首次系统探索自监督ViT的CL与MIM双范式特征在对抗扰动生成中的互补作用。
2506.21046|v2.result: 摘要声称有效提升了黑盒对抗迁移性，但未提供具体量化指标。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练Vision Transformer在下游任务适配时微调成本高的问题，提出基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题可推断其通过近似正交约束保持预训练权重结构，从而在少量参数更新下实现高效迁移。相比全量微调或LoRA等参数高效方法，正交性约束有望缓解灾难性遗忘并提升适配稳定性。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper targets efficient adaptation of pre-trained Vision Transformers by proposing an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests the method enforces near-orthogonality on weight updates to preserve pre-trained representations while adapting with few parameters. Compared with full fine-tuning or existing parameter-efficient methods, the orthogonal constraint may mitigate catastrophic forgetting and improve adaptation stability, though specific experimental results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 参数高效微调是ViT落地的关键问题，正交约束思路有一定价值，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法细节与实验充分度。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出基于近似正交约束的预训练ViT高效微调策略。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 将近似正交性引入ViT微调以在少量参数更新下保持预训练知识。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: 该论文面向TinyML应用场景，提出一种高效的混合Vision Transformer架构。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体设计细节，但从标题可推断其结合卷积与Transformer的混合结构以降低计算量，适配资源受限的边缘设备。相比标准ViT，混合设计通常能在保持精度的同时显著减少参数量和FLOPs。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper proposes an efficient hybrid Vision Transformer architecture for TinyML applications. With the abstract missing, the specific design cannot be confirmed, but the title implies a hybrid convolution-Transformer structure to reduce computation for resource-constrained edge devices. Compared with standard ViTs, such hybrid designs typically maintain accuracy while significantly reducing parameters and FLOPs, though no experimental data can be cited due to the missing abstract.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: TinyML与ViT结合是边缘部署的热点，但摘要缺失且与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关度有限，参考价值一般。

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需大量重训练才能恢复精度的问题，提出Variance-Based Pruning（VBP）一次性结构化剪枝方法。方法先收集激活统计量用于选择待剪神经元，同时将平均激活值整合回模型以在剪枝后保持高性能，仅需极少微调。相比需数百epoch重训练甚至从头训练的传统结构化剪枝方法，VBP显著降低了恢复成本。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning to recover accuracy, proposing Variance-Based Pruning (VBP), a simple one-shot structured pruning technique with minimal fine-tuning. VBP gathers activation statistics to select neurons and integrates mean activations back into the model to preserve performance. Unlike prior structured pruning methods requiring hundreds of retraining epochs or training from scratch, VBP drastically reduces recovery cost, with DeiT-Base retaining over 70% of its original performance directly after pruning on ImageNet-1k.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 一次性剪枝加极少微调的思路对模型压缩部署有实用价值，DeiT-Base的结果具有说服力，但领域相关度中等。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出Variance-Based Pruning一次性结构化剪枝方法，通过激活统计与均值回填实现低重训练成本压缩。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活方差选择神经元并将平均激活整合回模型，避免昂贵的重训练。
2507.12988|v2.result: ImageNet-1k上DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%原始性能。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer自注意力计算复杂度高的问题，提出PADRe——多项式注意力即插即用替代框架。PADRe基于多项式函数与逼近理论，用Hadamard积等硬件友好的乘法非线性实现注意力，仅带来线性计算与内存开销，并避免Softmax等复杂函数。该框架统一了Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等近期注意力机制，将其视为PADRe的特例。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测任务上，PADRe运行显著更快且精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of self-attention by proposing PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement framework. PADRe leverages polynomial functions and approximation theory, using hardware-friendly multiplicative nonlinearities such as Hadamard products with only linear computational and memory costs, while avoiding complex functions like Softmax. It unifies recent attention mechanisms including Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, and Castling-ViT as special cases. Across image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection, PADRe runs significantly faster with comparable or superior accuracy.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 统一多种高效注意力机制的框架具有理论深度，且在2D/3D检测上验证，对视觉Transformer效率研究有较高参考价值。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出PADRe多项式注意力即插即用框架，统一多种高效注意力机制并保持精度。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 基于逼近理论用硬件友好的多项式乘法非线性替代Softmax注意力，实现线性复杂度。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在图像分类、2D检测和3D点云检测上运行显著更快，精度相当或更优。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: 该论文提出CViT——面向算子学习的连续Vision Transformer。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体方法细节，但从标题可推断其将ViT架构扩展到连续域以求解偏微分方程等算子学习任务。相比传统离散网格上的算子学习方法，连续ViT有望在任意分辨率上泛化。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper proposes CViT, a Continuous Vision Transformer for operator learning. With the abstract missing, the specific methodology cannot be confirmed, but the title suggests extending ViT to the continuous domain for tasks such as solving partial differential equations. Compared with traditional discrete-grid operator learning methods, a continuous ViT may generalize across arbitrary resolutions, though no experimental data can be cited due to the missing abstract.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 算子学习与ViT结合属交叉方向，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关度较低，且摘要缺失难以评估质量。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出面向算子学习的连续Vision Transformer架构CViT。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将ViT扩展到连续域以处理算子学习任务。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
