Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）与视觉 Transformer 结合时，传统自注意力机制在脉冲域中计算开销大、时序建模效率低的问题，提出了带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉 Transformer。方法上借鉴生物视觉的扫视机制，设计了一种稀疏、事件驱动的注意力计算方式，使脉冲神经元仅在关键区域激活，从而降低脉冲发放率与能耗。相比已有脉冲 Transformer 工作，其改进点在于将注意力从全局稠密计算转为类似眼动的选择性采样，更契合 SNN 的稀疏事件特性。摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果，效果需以正文实验为准。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and inefficient temporal modeling of conventional self-attention when integrated into spiking neural networks (SNNs). It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention, which mimics biological saccades to perform sparse, event-driven attention so that spiking neurons fire only in salient regions. Compared with prior spiking Transformers, the key improvement is replacing dense global attention with selective, eye-movement-like sampling that better matches the sparse event-driven nature of SNNs. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract and must be verified in the full text.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 选题处于 SNN 与 ViT 交叉的前沿方向，但摘要信息量有限，且与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，需看正文实验才能判断实际价值。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出一种受生物扫视机制启发的稀疏脉冲注意力视觉 Transformer 架构。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 将眼动式选择性采样引入脉冲域注意力计算，以降低脉冲发放与能耗。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果有待正文验证。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练开销高的问题，本文首次系统探索了端到端的稀疏化方案，在固定小参数预算下动态提取并训练稀疏子网络，同时联合优化模型参数与连接结构。方法从非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），并引入可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏性。在ImageNet上，该方法在降低训练内存与推理复杂度的同时保持了可比精度，为ViT高效训练提供了统一框架。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive end-to-end exploration of sparsity in Vision Transformers, dynamically extracting and training sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget while jointly optimizing weights and connectivity. The approach extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding prune-and-grow of self-attention heads, and further co-explores data and architecture sparsity via a learnable token selector. Extensive ImageNet results show reduced training memory and inference complexity without sacrificing accuracy.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将稀疏化贯穿ViT训练与推理全流程，对高效ViT研究有较强参考价值，但摘要未给出具体精度数据，需查看全文验证实际收益。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 首次提出端到端稀疏化ViT训练框架，统一整合非结构化/结构化稀疏与数据稀疏。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 在固定参数预算下动态提取稀疏子网络，并用可学习token选择器协同优化数据与架构稀疏性。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上降低了训练内存与推理复杂度，同时保持与密集ViT可比的精度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构依赖人工设计的问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索自动化设计过程，不仅搜索架构还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是利用权重共享超网计算的E-T Error引导不同搜索维度的逐步演化，并基于搜索过程给出通用ViT设计指南。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在目标检测、语义分割和VQA等下游任务上验证了泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes to automate Vision Transformer design via neural architecture search that searches both the architecture and the search space, gradually evolving search dimensions guided by E-T Error computed with a weight-sharing supernet. The resulting S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT, and ViT on ImageNet, with effectiveness further demonstrated on object detection, semantic segmentation, and VQA. Extensive analysis provides design guidelines for general vision transformers.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间本身的思路有新意，且在下游检测任务上验证了泛化性，对ViT架构自动化设计有参考价值。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的NAS方法，并给出通用ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 利用权重共享超网的E-T Error引导搜索维度逐步演化，实现搜索空间的自动进化。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在检测、分割、VQA等任务上展现泛化性。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出ViT的离散patch token化过程会在注意力图中引入锯齿伪影，导致混叠效应，产生难以区分的失真。为此提出即插即用的混叠消除模块ARM来缓解该问题，并在多种任务和多个ViT家族上验证了有效性与泛化性。该轻量设计在多个知名结构上取得稳定提升，同时改善了ViT的数据效率和鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that the discontinuous patch-wise tokenization in ViTs introduces jagged artifacts into attention maps, causing aliasing effects. A plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) is proposed to alleviate this issue, consistently boosting several well-known ViT structures across multiple tasks while also improving data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理中的混叠角度分析ViT的token化缺陷，视角新颖且模块轻量通用，但提升幅度和具体数据在摘要中未量化。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 揭示ViT中patch token化导致的混叠问题，并提出即插即用的ARM模块。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将传统混叠理论引入ViT分析，设计轻量抗混叠模块改善注意力图质量。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多个ViT家族和任务上取得稳定精度提升，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT将图像视为1D token序列、缺乏局部结构建模与尺度不变性等内在归纳偏置的问题，本文提出ViTAE，通过卷积显式引入归纳偏置。具体地，ViTAE使用多个不同膨胀率的卷积构成空间金字塔缩减模块，将输入下采样并嵌入为富含多尺度上下文的token，获得尺度不变性；同时在每个Transformer层中并行加入卷积分支与多头自注意力融合。该方法减少了对大规模数据和长训练计划的依赖，在多个视觉任务上取得优异表现。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ViTAE to address the lack of intrinsic inductive bias in ViTs, which treat images as 1D token sequences and struggle with local structure and scale variance. ViTAE employs spatial pyramid reduction modules with multi-rate dilated convolutions to embed multi-scale context, and adds a convolution block in parallel to multi-head self-attention in each transformer layer. This explicitly introduces scale-invariance and locality inductive biases, reducing reliance on large-scale data and long training schedules.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 通过卷积显式注入归纳偏置来弥补ViT缺陷，思路清晰且实验较充分，对数据高效ViT研究有较强参考价值。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出ViTAE，用卷积显式引入尺度不变性与局部性归纳偏置以增强ViT。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 设计多膨胀率卷积空间金字塔缩减模块与并行卷积分支，将内在归纳偏置融入ViT。
2106.03348|v2.result: 减少了对大规模训练数据和长训练计划的依赖，在多个视觉任务上取得优异性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉 Transformer 自注意力对高分辨率特征图计算与内存开销随序列长度二次增长、难以用于密集预测的问题，提出 Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer）。方法受人类识别物体时"扫视+凝视"行为启发，设计两条并行分支：Glance 分支在自适应膨胀划分上做自注意力以高效建模长程依赖，Gaze 分支用深度可分离卷积捕获局部上下文。相比纯 Transformer 或纯卷积方案，在保持紧凑模型规模的同时兼顾全局与局部建模。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在密集预测任务上缓解了计算/内存瓶颈。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention that makes vision Transformers costly for dense prediction on high-resolution feature maps. It proposes the Glance-and-Gaze Transformer (GG-Transformer), inspired by human glance-and-gaze behavior, with a Glance branch performing self-attention on adaptively-dilated partitions for long-range dependencies and a Gaze branch using depth-wise convolution for local context. This design aims to model both global and local information efficiently while keeping the model compact.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 思路直观、工程上对高分辨率密集预测有参考价值，但摘要未给出量化结果，需看正文验证实际收益。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出 Glance-and-Gaze 双分支视觉 Transformer，用自适应膨胀划分注意力与局部卷积并行建模长程与局部依赖。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 将人类"扫视-凝视"认知行为映射为自适应膨胀分区自注意力加深度卷积的双分支结构。
2106.02277|v2.result: 声称在密集预测任务上以更紧凑模型缓解了自注意力的计算与内存瓶颈（摘要未给出具体数值）。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: 该论文提出 HRFormer（High-Resolution Vision Transformer），面向密集预测任务（如语义分割、姿态估计、目标检测）设计高分辨率 Transformer 主干。针对 ViT 因下采样导致空间分辨率损失、不适合像素级密集预测的问题，HRFormer 在并行多分辨率流中引入局部窗口自注意力与卷积，兼顾高分辨率表示与全局建模。相比 HRNet 等卷积高分辨率网络与 Swin 等 Transformer，在保持高分辨率的同时降低注意力计算量。摘要为空，具体指标无法引用。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: HRFormer is a high-resolution vision Transformer backbone tailored for dense prediction tasks such as segmentation, pose estimation and detection. It maintains parallel multi-resolution streams and combines local-window self-attention with convolutions to preserve high-resolution representations while retaining global modeling, addressing the resolution loss of standard ViTs. The abstract is empty, so quantitative results cannot be cited.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 高分辨率 Transformer 主干的代表性工作，对检测/分割等密集预测任务有直接借鉴意义，但摘要缺失无法评估具体实验。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出面向密集预测的高分辨率视觉 Transformer 主干 HRFormer，在并行多分辨率流中融合局部窗口注意力与卷积。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 将 HRNet 式多分辨率并行结构与局部窗口自注意力结合，兼顾高分辨率空间细节与全局建模。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 摘要为空，未能引用具体实验数据。

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中潜在空间建模能力不足的问题，提出一种带能量基先验隐变量的生成式视觉 Transformer。方法将视觉 Transformer 与能量基先验模型联合训练，通过基于 MCMC 的最大似然估计，用 Langevin 动力学从难解的后验与先验分布中采样。相比将隐变量先验简单设为各向同性高斯分布的既有生成模型，能量基信息先验更具表达力，并能从图像直接得到像素级不确定性图。在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著目标检测任务上取得准确预测与不确定性估计。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: The paper targets salient object detection and proposes a generative vision Transformer whose latent variables follow an informative energy-based prior. The Transformer and the energy-based prior are jointly trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation, with Langevin dynamics sampling from the intractable posterior and prior. Unlike generative models using an isotropic Gaussian prior, the energy-based prior is more expressive and yields pixel-wise uncertainty maps, validated on RGB and RGB-D saliency benchmarks.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 将能量基先验与 Transformer 结合并输出不确定性，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出带能量基隐变量先验的生成式视觉 Transformer 框架，用于显著目标检测并输出像素级不确定性。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量基信息先验替代各向同性高斯先验，并通过 MCMC/Langevin 动力学联合训练 Transformer 与先验模型。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著目标检测上同时获得准确预测与像素级不确定性估计（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉自监督学习中 Transformer 预训练探索不足、且既有方法只关注高层全局特征而难以迁移到关注局部特征的密集预测任务的问题，提出 Masked Self-supervised Transformer（MST）。方法受 NLP 中掩码语言建模启发，基于多头自注意力图动态掩码部分局部 patch token，在不破坏关键结构的前提下显式捕获局部上下文，并用全局图像解码器恢复被掩码 token 与其余 token 以保留空间信息。在多个数据集上的实验验证了其有效性，且对下游密集预测任务更友好。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the limited exploration of Transformers in visual self-supervised learning and the failure of global-feature-only methods to transfer to dense prediction tasks. It proposes MST, a Masked Self-supervised Transformer that dynamically masks local patch tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps, inspired by masked language modeling, and recovers masked and remaining tokens with a global image decoder to preserve spatial information. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate effectiveness and better transferability to dense prediction.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 掩码自监督思路与 MAE 同期，对自监督预训练迁移到检测/分割等密集任务有参考价值，但创新度相对有限。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力图动态掩码 token 的自监督 Transformer 预训练方法 MST，并用全局图像解码器恢复空间信息。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 利用多头自注意力图动态选择掩码 token，避免破坏关键结构，并保留空间信息以利于密集预测迁移。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性，且相比仅学全局特征的方法对下游密集预测任务更友好（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶多任务感知中缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法相比单任务基线仍存在明显性能差距的问题。②作者在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法，覆盖目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务，并提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例提示（visual exemplar prompting）引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征。③相比现有多任务方法，其改进点在于引入视觉示例作为任务提示，而非仅依赖共享骨干或任务查询。④摘要指出已有方法虽有进步但仍与单任务基线差距较大，VE-Prompt 旨在缓解这一困境，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the persistent performance gap between multi-task methods and single-task baselines. The authors extensively evaluate popular multi-task learning methods on a large-scale driving dataset across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, and propose VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide learning of high-quality task-specific representations. The key improvement over prior work is the use of visual exemplar-driven task prompting rather than relying solely on shared backbones or task queries, though the abstract does not report specific quantitative gains.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了较系统的评测与一个提示学习式的新框架，对关注多任务统一感知的研究者有参考价值，但需关注其相对单任务基线的实际提升幅度。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 构建了自动驾驶四项感知任务的统一多任务评测，并提出基于视觉示例任务提示的 VE-Prompt 框架。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 将任务特定的视觉示例提示引入多任务感知，以引导任务特定表征学习。
2303.01788|v2.result: 揭示了现有多任务方法与单任务基线仍存在较大性能差距，并给出缓解该问题的 VE-Prompt 方案（摘要未提供具体数值）。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测（如未知障碍物、异形物体）这一开放集识别问题，传统重建方法难以区分异常与正常区域。②论文提出基于部分图像重建的方法，并引入语义分割耦合机制，通过分割先验约束重建过程，使重建误差更聚焦于真正的异常区域。③相比纯重建或纯分割的已有工作，该方法利用分割耦合缓解了重建对纹理变化的过度敏感问题。④摘要未提供具体量化数据，但声称在道路异常检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection for autonomous driving, where unknown obstacles must be identified in an open-set setting. It proposes a partial image reconstruction method coupled with semantic segmentation, using segmentation priors to constrain the reconstruction and focus errors on genuine anomalies. Compared with pure reconstruction or segmentation baselines, the coupling reduces sensitivity to benign texture variations, yielding improved anomaly detection performance.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作将分割先验与重建式异常检测结合，思路对开放集道路感知有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其定量结果与泛化性。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出分割耦合的部分图像重建框架用于道路异常检测。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 利用语义分割先验约束重建过程，使重建误差更集中于真实异常区域。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 在道路异常检测任务上取得优于现有方法的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶环视语义占用感知缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，本文提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模环视语义占用感知基准。方法上构建了包含多模态传感器数据与密集语义占用标注的数据集，并提供了基于多相机、LiDAR及融合方法的基线。相比已有占用数据集，其规模更大、覆盖360度环视且标注更密集。该基准为环视占用感知提供了标准化评测平台，推动了该方向的发展。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving by introducing OpenOccupancy. It constructs a large-scale dataset with multi-modal sensor data and dense semantic occupancy annotations, along with baselines for camera, LiDAR, and fusion methods. Compared with existing occupancy datasets, it is larger, covers 360-degree surroundings, and provides denser annotations, offering a standardized evaluation platform.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为环视占用感知的首个大规模基准，对推动该领域标准化评测具有重要价值，值得关注。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了大规模环视语义占用感知基准OpenOccupancy及配套基线。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 构建了覆盖360度、多模态、密集标注的占用感知数据集与统一评测协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为环视占用感知提供了标准化基准，支撑多类方法的公平比较。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有感知与预测方法要么依赖低召回的目标检测加轨迹预测、要么计算昂贵的稠密占用流网格的问题，本文提出用单一神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占用与流场。方法上设计了一种可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询的隐式表示，并通过架构改进克服了显式占用预测方法感受野受限的缺陷。相比已有工作，该方法避免了不必要的计算并提升了感受野。实验表明其在感知与预测任务上取得了良好效果。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing perception and prediction approaches that either rely on low-recall detection-then-forecasting or computationally expensive dense occupancy and flow grids. It proposes a unified neural network that implicitly represents occupancy and flow over time, queryable by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations. The architecture overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit occupancy prediction methods, avoiding unnecessary computation while improving performance.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 将感知与预测统一为隐式占用流表示，思路新颖，对规划友好的查询式表示值得关注。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出了可被规划器连续查询的隐式占用流场统一感知与预测方法。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 用单一网络隐式表示时空占用与流，并扩展感受野避免冗余计算。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在感知与预测任务上取得良好效果，兼顾效率与召回。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云任意尺度上采样与细化的问题，本文提出ASUR3D，利用局部占用场实现点云的任意尺度上采样与细化。方法上通过局部占用场建模点云局部几何结构，从而在任意上采样倍率下生成高质量点云。相比已有固定倍率的上采样方法，其支持任意尺度并提升了细化质量。该方法在点云上采样任务上取得了改进效果。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper addresses arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds by proposing ASUR3D, which leverages local occupancy fields. It models local geometric structure via occupancy fields to generate high-quality point clouds at arbitrary upsampling ratios. Compared with fixed-ratio upsampling methods, it supports arbitrary scales and improves refinement quality.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 利用局部占用场实现任意尺度点云上采样，思路有一定新意，但与核心感知任务相关度中等。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出了基于局部占用场的任意尺度3D点云上采样与细化方法ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 用局部占用场建模几何结构以支持任意倍率上采样。

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对遮挡区域图像匹配困难的问题，本文提出Occ2Net，基于3D占用估计实现鲁棒的图像匹配。方法上通过估计3D占用信息来推断遮挡区域的几何结构，从而提升遮挡场景下的匹配鲁棒性。相比传统依赖2D特征的匹配方法，其利用3D占用信息更好地处理遮挡。该方法在遮挡区域的匹配任务上取得了更鲁棒的效果。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper addresses robust image matching in occluded regions by proposing Occ2Net, which leverages 3D occupancy estimation. It infers geometry in occluded areas via occupancy estimation to improve matching robustness. Compared with conventional 2D-feature-based matching, it better handles occlusion using 3D occupancy information.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 将3D占用估计引入图像匹配以处理遮挡，思路新颖，但与主流感知任务相关度中等。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出了基于3D占用估计的遮挡区域鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占用信息推断遮挡区域几何以增强匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡区域图像匹配任务上取得更鲁棒的效果。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D语义占用预测的问题，本文提出SurroundOcc，一种面向自动驾驶的多相机3D占用预测方法。方法上通过多相机图像构建稠密3D占用表示，并设计了相应的网络与监督策略。相比基于BEV的方法，其提供了垂直方向的稠密结构信息。该方法在占用预测任务上取得了领先性能，推动了多相机占用感知的发展。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-camera 3D semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing SurroundOcc. It constructs dense 3D occupancy representations from multi-camera images with a dedicated network and supervision strategy. Compared with BEV-based methods, it provides dense structural information along the vertical direction, achieving leading performance in occupancy prediction.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 多相机3D占用预测的代表性工作，方法扎实、性能领先，对占用感知方向极具参考价值。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出了多相机稠密3D语义占用预测方法SurroundOcc。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 从多相机图像构建稠密3D占用表示并提供垂直方向结构信息。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在3D占用预测任务上取得领先性能。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于视觉的3D语义占用预测问题，本文提出OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络以高效处理3D体素。方法上将繁重的3D处理沿水平面分解为局部与全局Transformer路径，实现长距离、动态且高效的编码，并在占用解码器中通过preserve-pooling和class-guided sampling缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。相比已有方法，其在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著超越现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing OccFormer, a dual-path transformer network for efficient 3D volume processing. It decomposes heavy 3D processing into local and global transformer pathways along the horizontal plane for long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding, and adapts Mask2Former with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling to mitigate sparsity and class imbalance. It significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 双路径Transformer设计高效且性能显著领先，是视觉3D占用预测的重要工作，值得深入研究。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出了用于视觉3D语义占用预测的双路径Transformer网络OccFormer。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部与全局Transformer路径，并引入preserve-pooling与class-guided sampling。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著超越现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有3D占用预测方法依赖固定类别标签、无法识别开放词汇物体的问题，提出POP-3D方法，仅从多视角图像输入出发实现开放词汇的3D语义占用预测。方法将图像特征通过视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）对齐到3D空间，构建可查询任意文本描述的占用表示，从而支持零样本类别识别。相比传统闭集占用预测，POP-3D无需3D标注即可泛化到新类别，在开放词汇语义占用基准上取得了显著优于基线的性能，验证了图像驱动开放词汇3D感知的可行性。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D occupancy prediction methods that rely on fixed category labels and cannot recognize open-vocabulary objects. It proposes POP-3D, which performs open-vocabulary 3D semantic occupancy prediction purely from multi-view images by aligning image features with vision-language models into 3D space. Compared to closed-set occupancy prediction, POP-3D generalizes to novel categories without 3D annotations and achieves substantial improvements over baselines on open-vocabulary occupancy benchmarks.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇感知从2D/3D检测拓展到占用预测，对自动驾驶中长尾物体感知具有重要价值，方法简洁且实验验证充分，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出首个仅从图像输入实现开放词汇3D语义占用预测的框架POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型将2D图像特征对齐到3D占用空间，实现零样本开放词汇占用预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在开放词汇占用基准上显著超越基线，验证了图像驱动开放词汇3D感知的有效性。

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉BEV/占用预测中稠密网格计算开销大、稀疏结构建模复杂的问题，本文提出紧凑占用Transformer（COTR）。方法上通过紧凑的占用表示与Transformer结构减少冗余计算，在保持精度的同时降低显存与计算量。相比已有稠密网格方法，COTR在nuScenes等基准上以更低计算代价取得有竞争力的占用预测精度。由于摘要缺失，具体数值无法引用，但整体思路与当前高效占用预测方向一致。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of dense-grid vision-based 3D occupancy prediction by proposing a Compact Occupancy TRansformer (COTR). The method introduces a compact occupancy representation with a transformer architecture to reduce redundant computation while preserving prediction accuracy. Compared with dense-grid baselines, COTR achieves competitive occupancy prediction performance at lower computational cost, though the abstract is missing so specific numbers cannot be cited.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 面向视觉占用预测的效率问题，思路与当前轻量化占用感知趋势契合，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献与实验强度。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占用Transformer以降低视觉3D占用预测的计算开销。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 通过紧凑占用表示与Transformer结合减少稠密网格冗余计算。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在保持有竞争力精度的同时降低计算量（摘要缺失，具体数值未知）。

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中bbox无法刻画物体精细几何、而全场景高分辨率占用又受算力限制的问题，本文提出以物体为中心的占用（object-centric occupancy）作为bbox的补充。数据上，作者用自动化流程构建了首个object-centric占用数据集；算法上提出带隐式形状解码器的占用补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占用生成。该网络能为不准确的检测框预测完整的物体级占用体，从而增强3D目标检测的几何感知能力。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that 3D bounding boxes cannot capture fine-grained object geometry while full-scene high-resolution occupancy is computationally infeasible, this paper introduces object-centric occupancy as a supplement to object bboxes. The authors construct the first object-centric occupancy dataset via an automated pipeline and propose an occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder that handles dynamic-size occupancy generation. The network predicts complete object-centric occupancy volumes for inaccurate detections, augmenting 3D object detection with detailed geometry.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 从数据与算法两方面推进物体级占用感知，为3D检测提供几何补充，思路新颖且数据集构建有实用价值。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 提出物体级占用表示、首个相关数据集及占用补全网络以增强3D检测。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 用隐式形状解码器实现动态尺寸的物体级占用补全，并配套自动化数据构建流程。
2412.05154|v2.result: 为检测框提供精细几何补充，提升3D目标检测的几何感知能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出RadarOcc，首次利用4D成像雷达进行3D占用预测。方法直接处理4D雷达张量以保留场景细节，通过多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离维自注意力应对数据量大与噪声问题，并设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合以减少坐标变换插值误差。该工作为全天候占用感知提供了新范式。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: To improve the robustness of 3D occupancy prediction under adverse weather, this paper proposes RadarOcc, the first approach to leverage 4D imaging radar for occupancy prediction. It directly processes the 4D radar tensor to preserve scene details, employing Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, and range-wise self-attention to handle voluminous and noisy data, plus spherical feature encoding and spherical-to-Cartesian aggregation to reduce interpolation errors. This offers a new paradigm for all-weather occupancy perception.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 将4D成像雷达引入占用预测，针对雷达稀疏与噪声问题设计了系统化处理模块，对全天候自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于4D成像雷达的3D占用预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 结合多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化、距离维自注意力与球面特征编码处理4D雷达张量。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下实现鲁棒的3D占用预测（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统稠密规则网格占用预测计算开销大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应地以可变粒度捕捉3D信息。方法引入图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，并设计迭代修正机制精化八叉树。实验表明OctreeOcc在占用预测上超越SOTA，同时相比稠密网格方法减少15%-24%的计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: To address the excessive computation and loss of spatial detail for small objects in dense regular-grid occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OctreeOcc, which leverages octree representation to adaptively capture 3D information at variable granularity. It incorporates image semantic information to improve the initial octree structure and designs an iterative rectification mechanism to refine it. Experiments show OctreeOcc surpasses state-of-the-art methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid methods.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 用八叉树自适应粒度替代稠密网格，在精度与效率上同时获益，是占用预测表示学习的一个实用方向。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的多粒度高效3D占用预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 结合图像语义初始化八叉树并设计迭代修正机制实现自适应粒度表示。
2312.03774|v2.result: 超越SOTA占用预测方法，计算开销相比稠密网格方法降低15%-24%。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占用预测先离散化稠密体素再分类、而绝大多数体素为空导致算力浪费的问题，本文提出OPUS，将占用预测重新表述为集合预测范式，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化。框架采用Transformer编码器-解码器，用一组可学习查询同时预测占用位置与类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失将集合间比较扩展到大规模训练，语义类别通过最近邻自适应分配。该视角简化了占用预测流程并提升效率。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: To avoid the wasted computation of classifying the vast majority of empty voxels in dense-grid occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OPUS, which reformulates occupancy prediction as a streamlined set prediction paradigm without explicit space modeling or complex sparsification. It uses a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries to jointly predict occupied locations and classes, employs a Chamfer distance loss to scale set-to-set comparison for end-to-end training, and adaptively assigns semantic classes via nearest neighbors. This perspective simplifies and improves the efficiency of occupancy prediction.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占用预测转化为集合预测，摆脱稠密体素分类范式，思路简洁且具启发性，对占用感知的建模范式有推动作用。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏集合预测的占用预测框架OPUS。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 用可学习查询与Chamfer距离损失实现无需显式空间建模的端到端占用预测。
2409.09350|v2.result: 简化占用预测流程并避免空体素上的无效计算（摘要未给出具体数值）。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中体素表示计算量大、效率低的问题，论文提出GaussianFormer-2，用概率高斯叠加来高效建模3D占用。方法通过概率化高斯表示与叠加机制，减少冗余计算并提升预测效率。相比已有高斯或体素方法，改进点在于概率建模与高效叠加，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。整体在效率与精度间取得较好平衡，值得关注。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of voxel-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussianFormer-2, which uses probabilistic Gaussian superposition for efficient modeling. It introduces a probabilistic Gaussian representation and superposition mechanism to reduce redundant computation. Compared to prior Gaussian or voxel methods, it improves efficiency, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 面向占用预测的效率瓶颈提出概率高斯叠加方案，思路新颖，对实时自动驾驶感知有潜在价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加的3D占用预测框架GaussianFormer-2。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 将概率建模引入高斯叠加，提升占用预测效率。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在效率与精度间取得平衡。

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的准确性问题，论文提出EvOcc，利用证据理论进行语义占用建模。方法通过证据理论处理不确定性，提升占用预测的鲁棒性与准确性。相比已有工作，改进点在于引入证据理论应对传感器噪声与遮挡，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。整体为占用预测提供了不确定性建模的新视角。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper targets accurate semantic occupancy prediction for automated driving by proposing EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory. It models uncertainty via evidence theory to improve robustness and accuracy. The improvement lies in handling sensor noise and occlusion, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测，为不确定性建模提供新思路，对自动驾驶安全感知有参考价值。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测方法EvOcc。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 利用证据理论处理占用预测中的不确定性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称提升了准确性。

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对语义占用预测中计算复杂度高的问题，论文提出OccMamba，将状态空间模型引入占用预测。方法利用Mamba架构高效建模长程依赖，降低计算开销。相比基于Transformer或卷积的方法，改进点在于状态空间模型的高效序列建模，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。整体为占用预测提供了高效的新架构。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of semantic occupancy prediction by proposing OccMamba, which introduces state space models. The improvement lies in efficient sequence modeling compared to Transformer or convolution-based methods, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用与场景流预测中时空建模不足的问题，论文提出STCOcc，采用稀疏时空级联更新策略。方法通过稀疏表示与级联更新机制，同时预测占用与场景流。相比已有工作，改进点在于稀疏时空级联设计，提升预测精度与效率，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。整体为占用与场景流联合预测提供了新方案。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper targets 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing STCOcc, which uses sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation. It employs sparse representation and cascade updates to jointly predict occupancy and scene flow. The improvement lies in the sparse spatial-temporal cascade design, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 联合占用与场景流预测，稀疏时空级联设计有创新性，对动态场景理解有参考价值。

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 稀疏时空级联更新机制，联合预测占用与场景流。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称提升了预测精度与效率。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据、可扩展性差的问题，论文提出GaussTR，一种基于高斯Transformer的自监督3D空间理解框架。方法通过前馈预测稀疏高斯集表示3D场景，将高斯投影到2D视图并与基础模型对齐，实现自监督表示学习和开放词汇语义占用预测，无需显式标注。相比已有工作，改进点在于无需标注、开放词汇且训练高效。在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本性能，训练时间减少40%。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on extensive labeled data and poor scalability in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussTR, a Gaussian-based Transformer framework for self-supervised 3D spatial understanding. It predicts sparse Gaussians, splats them into 2D views, and aligns rendered features with foundation models, enabling open-vocabulary semantic occupancy without explicit annotations. On Occ3D-nuScenes, it achieves 12.27 mIoU zero-shot and reduces training time by 40%.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐结合，实现自监督开放词汇占用预测，性能与效率俱佳，非常值得关注。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出自监督、开放词汇的3D占用预测框架GaussTR。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 高斯表示与基础模型对齐，无需标注实现开放词汇占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上零样本12.27 mIoU，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中依赖量化与熵编码的问题，论文提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间的稀疏模式进行压缩。方法在高维字典内使用稀疏编码压缩权重向量空间，并发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重。相比已有量化或潜在编码方法，改进点在于无需学习字典且可集成到现有INR压缩技术中。实验表明SINR在多种配置下大幅降低INR存储需求。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding in implicit neural representation (INR) compression by proposing SINR, which exploits sparsity patterns in INR weight vector spaces. It compresses weight spaces using high-dimensional sparse codes within a dictionary, and shows that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted. Compared to existing methods, it integrates with any INR compression technique and achieves substantial storage reductions across configurations.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 为INR压缩提供无需学习字典的稀疏编码方案，与视觉感知领域相关度较低，但压缩思路有借鉴意义。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏编码的INR压缩算法SINR。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 利用权重向量空间稀疏模式，字典原子无需学习或传输。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在多种配置下大幅降低INR存储需求。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: 针对不同激光雷达传感器之间因线束、安装角度和点云分布差异导致的域间隙问题，本文提出MergeOcc以提升占用预测的跨LiDAR鲁棒性。方法通过域对齐与融合策略桥接不同LiDAR配置的特征分布，使模型在未见传感器上仍能保持稳定预测。相比仅在单一LiDAR上训练的方法，MergeOcc显著缓解了跨域性能下降。摘要未给出具体数值，但该问题对多传感器自动驾驶部署具有实际价值。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors for robust occupancy prediction. MergeOcc bridges heterogeneous LiDAR configurations via domain alignment and fusion, improving cross-sensor generalization over single-LiDAR training. It targets practical multi-sensor autonomous driving deployment, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨LiDAR域适应是占用预测落地的重要瓶颈，该工作切中实际部署痛点，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc以桥接不同激光雷达之间的域间隙，实现鲁棒占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 针对异构LiDAR配置进行域对齐与融合以提升占用预测泛化性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 缓解了跨LiDAR域间隙导致的性能下降，提升跨传感器鲁棒性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D占用预测中类别与场景开放导致的泛化难题，本文提出AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction）。方法通过自适应grounding机制将开放词汇/开放类别语义与3D占用空间对齐，从而在未见类别上实现占用预测。相比封闭集占用方法，AGO提升了开放世界场景下的适应能力。摘要未提供具体指标，但开放世界占用是当前重要前沿方向。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world 3D occupancy prediction where categories and scenes are open-ended. AGO introduces an adaptive grounding mechanism to align open-vocabulary semantics with 3D occupancy space, enabling prediction on unseen categories. It advances beyond closed-set occupancy methods, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占用预测是新兴且具挑战性的方向，该工作提供了自适应grounding思路，值得关注。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出AGO自适应grounding方法用于开放世界3D占用预测。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将开放词汇语义自适应对齐到3D占用空间以处理未见类别。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 提升了开放世界场景下占用预测的泛化与适应能力。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督3D占用估计仍依赖真值6D位姿、且体渲染耗时低效的问题，本文提出GaussianOcc。方法包含GSP模块，从相邻视图投影提供尺度信息以实现完全自监督（无需真值位姿）；并提出GSV从体素空间进行高斯泼溅，利用其快速渲染特性替代体渲染。相比已有方法，GaussianOcc在无需位姿监督下达到有竞争力性能，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on ground-truth 6D poses and inefficient volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. GaussianOcc proposes GSP to supply scale from adjacent-view projection for fully self-supervised training, and GSV to render from voxel space via Gaussian splatting. It achieves competitive performance without pose supervision while being 2.7x faster in training and 5x faster in rendering.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效的占用估计方案，速度优势明显，对降低标注与位姿依赖很有价值。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianOcc实现完全自监督且高效的环视3D占用估计。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 用GSP提供尺度实现无位姿自监督，并用GSV以高斯泼溅替代体渲染。
2408.11447|v2.result: 无需真值位姿达到有竞争力性能，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D占用世界模型仍依赖昂贵3D占用标注的问题，本文提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。方法采用两阶段训练：自监督预训练阶段用属性投影头生成RGB、密度、语义等属性场，通过体渲染利用2D标签进行时序监督；并引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用与自车轨迹。在nuScenes上验证了有效性与可扩展性，取得有竞争力性能。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the high cost of 3D occupancy labels for occupancy world models. PreWorld is a semi-supervised vision-centric 3D occupancy world model with a two-stage paradigm: self-supervised pre-training using an attribute projection head (RGB, density, semantic) for temporal 2D supervision via volume rendering, and a state-conditioned forecasting module for recursive future occupancy and ego-trajectory prediction. Experiments on nuScenes validate effectiveness and scalability.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 利用2D标签降低3D占用标注依赖并做世界模型预测，对自动驾驶规划有实际意义。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练结合属性投影头与状态条件递归预测未来占用和轨迹。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上验证有效性与可扩展性，取得有竞争力性能。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: 针对占用预测中多帧时序信息对齐与融合不足的问题，本文提出CSV-Occ。方法引入时序交叉状态空间模型进行多帧对齐融合，并设计中心投票机制以聚合空间特征，提升占用预测的时序一致性与精度。相比单帧或简单时序融合方法，CSV-Occ强化了跨帧信息利用。摘要未给出具体数值，但时序建模对占用预测较为关键。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-frame temporal alignment and fusion in occupancy prediction. CSV-Occ introduces a temporal cross state space model for multi-frame alignment and a central voting mechanism to aggregate spatial features, improving temporal consistency and accuracy. It strengthens cross-frame information use over single-frame or naive temporal fusion, though quantitative results are not reported.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 时序融合是占用预测的重要环节，该工作提供状态空间与投票机制的组合思路，有一定参考价值。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出CSV-Occ融合多帧对齐用于占用预测。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合时序交叉状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行多帧融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 提升了占用预测的时序一致性与精度。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: 针对占用预测中表示效率与几何细节建模的问题，本文提出ODG（Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians）。方法采用双重高斯表示来建模占用场景，兼顾表面与体积/语义信息，从而更高效地表达3D占用结构。相比体素或单一高斯表示，双高斯在表达力与效率间取得更好平衡。摘要未提供具体指标，但双高斯思路对占用表示有创新性。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper tackles representation efficiency and geometric detail in occupancy prediction. ODG employs a dual Gaussian representation to model occupancy scenes, capturing both surface and volumetric/semantic information for more efficient 3D occupancy representation. It balances expressiveness and efficiency better than voxel or single-Gaussian representations, though quantitative results are not reported.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双高斯表示用于占用预测具有新意，可能兼顾效率与几何细节，值得关注。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出ODG使用双高斯进行占用预测。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 采用双重高斯表示建模占用场景的表面与体积语义信息。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 在表示效率与几何细节建模上取得更好平衡。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自回归式具身占据预测（autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction）中掩码策略效率与聚焦性不足的问题，提出动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断其通过动态调整掩码区域，将建模能力集中于运动相关或高不确定性区域，以提升自回归占据序列预测的精度与效率。相比固定或随机掩码策略，该方法有望在保持生成质量的同时降低冗余计算。具体实验数据与改进幅度因摘要缺失无法引用。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of masking strategies in autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction by proposing Dynamic Focused Masking. The method dynamically allocates modeling capacity to motion-relevant or high-uncertainty regions, potentially improving both accuracy and efficiency over fixed or random masking. Quantitative results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 自回归占据预测是具身智能与自动驾驶感知的前沿交叉方向，动态掩码思路具有潜在价值，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法细节与实验充分度。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出面向自回归具身占据预测的动态聚焦掩码策略。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 将动态掩码机制引入自回归占据预测，聚焦于关键区域以提升建模效率。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 因摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据与效果。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有3D语义占据预测方法中稠密体素表示忽略驾驶场景稀疏性、以及基于稀疏高斯的物体中心表示受椭球形状先验限制而需大量基元的问题，提出以超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元。作者构建了概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，并通过概率混合计算语义，进而提出QuadricFormer模型。相比椭球高斯表示，超二次曲面凭借其形状多样性可用更少基元高效表达长方体、圆柱体及不规则结构。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但方法在表示效率与几何表达力上具有明显优势。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of dense voxel and ellipsoid-based sparse Gaussian representations for 3D semantic occupancy prediction by introducing superquadrics as scene primitives. It develops a probabilistic superquadric mixture model that treats each superquadric as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior and computes semantics via probabilistic mixture, leading to the QuadricFormer model. Compared with ellipsoidal Gaussians, superquadrics capture diverse geometries (cuboids, cylinders, irregular shapes) with fewer primitives, improving representation efficiency and expressiveness.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 该工作将几何表达力更强的超二次曲面引入占据预测，思路新颖且切中稀疏表示效率痛点，对自动驾驶3D感知具有较高参考价值。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出基于超二次曲面混合模型的3D语义占据预测框架QuadricFormer。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 以超二次曲面替代椭球高斯作为场景基元，通过概率混合实现高效且几何多样的占据与语义建模。
2506.10977|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但方法在表示效率与复杂结构建模上优于椭球高斯基线。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对当前自动驾驶视频生成模型虽视觉逼真但存在细微几何畸变、导致下游3D感知任务性能下降的问题，提出基于几何反馈的强化学习（RLGF）方法。RLGF通过引入专用隐空间自动驾驶感知模型的奖励来微调视频扩散模型，核心包括隐空间窗口优化技术与分层几何奖励（HGR）系统，分别对点-线-面对齐和场景占据一致性提供多级奖励，并提出GeoScores量化几何畸变。在nuScenes上对DiVE等模型应用RLGF后，消失点误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%，显著缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and quantifies geometric distortions in state-of-the-art autonomous driving video generation models that degrade downstream 3D perception, and proposes Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback (RLGF). RLGF fine-tunes video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, featuring Latent-Space Windowing Optimization and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantification. On nuScenes with DiVE, RLGF reduces vanishing point error by 21% and depth error by 57%, and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统量化并解决生成视频的几何畸变问题，奖励设计针对性强，对利用合成数据提升自动驾驶感知具有实用价值。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出基于几何反馈强化学习的自动驾驶视频生成微调框架RLGF及几何畸变度量GeoScores。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 利用隐空间感知模型提供分层几何奖励，通过强化学习直接优化扩散视频模型的几何一致性。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使消失点误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动规划中自监督表示（如自车视角freespace）混淆了环境运动与自车运动、难以用于下游规划器的问题，本文提出以几何占据栅格作为替代表示，并利用可微光线投射将未来占据预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描预测，从而与真实扫描对比实现自监督学习。该方法使占据栅格作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现，无需直接观测完整3D占据标签。相比freespace等视角相关表示，占据栅格天然解耦环境与自车运动，为下游运动规划提供更稳定的信号。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但展示了可微渲染用于自监督占据预测的可行性。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that self-supervised representations like ego-centric freespace confound environment and ego motion, this paper proposes geometric occupancy as a view-independent alternative and uses differentiable raycasting to render future occupancy predictions into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning. This allows occupancy to emerge as an internal representation without direct full 3D occupancy supervision. The approach disentangles environment motion from ego motion, offering a more planner-friendly signal than freespace.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 将可微渲染与自监督占据预测结合，思路新颖，对占用栅格预测与端到端规划方向有参考价值。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出用可微光线投射将未来占据预测渲染为LiDAR扫描，实现自监督占据预测。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 以可微渲染作为自监督信号，使占据栅格作为网络内部表示自然涌现。
2210.01917|v2.result: 验证了无需直接3D占据标签即可学习解耦自车运动的占据表示，摘要未给出具体量化指标。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在从点云或稀疏观测重建三维表面时，对输入点云法向符号敏感、依赖符号一致性的问题，提出了 SA-ConvONet，即符号无关的优化框架。方法上通过设计符号无关的损失与网络优化策略，使网络无需预先确定法向朝向即可学习到一致的占用场，从而提升重建鲁棒性。相比原始 ConvONet 需要正确法向或符号信息，该方法在法向符号翻转或缺失时仍能稳定训练。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称在多个重建基准上取得了更优或相当的精度，并显著降低了对法向符号的依赖。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sign-sensitivity of Convolutional Occupancy Networks (ConvONet) for 3D surface reconstruction from point clouds or sparse observations. It proposes SA-ConvONet, a sign-agnostic optimization framework that learns consistent occupancy fields without requiring pre-determined normal orientations. Compared with the original ConvONet, the method remains robust when normal signs are flipped or missing, and achieves improved or comparable reconstruction accuracy on standard benchmarks while reducing reliance on sign information.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作对占用网络训练中的符号歧义问题给出了简洁有效的解决方案，对基于占用场的三维重建与感知研究有参考价值，但实验规模与自动驾驶场景的直接关联有限。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关的卷积占用网络优化框架，消除对法向符号一致性的依赖。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 将符号无关损失与占用网络优化结合，使网络在法向符号翻转或缺失时仍能稳定学习。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 在多个三维重建基准上取得更优或相当精度，并显著降低对法向符号的依赖。

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知的图像合成问题，提出生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields），旨在从多视角图像中同时重建表面并生成高质量新视角图像。方法上利用占用场表示三维几何，并将其与神经辐射场或生成模型结合，实现表面感知的渲染与合成。相比已有神经渲染方法，该方法显式建模占用场以提升几何一致性和表面细节。摘要未提供具体定量结果，但声称在表面感知图像合成任务上优于现有方法。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles 3D surface-aware image synthesis by proposing Generative Occupancy Fields, which jointly reconstruct surfaces and generate novel views from multi-view images. The method combines occupancy field representations with neural rendering or generative models to achieve surface-aware synthesis. Compared with existing neural rendering approaches, it explicitly models occupancy to improve geometric consistency and surface details, and is reported to outperform prior methods on surface-aware image synthesis tasks.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作将占用场引入生成式图像合成，对三维场景理解与神经渲染的交叉研究有启发，但与自动驾驶感知中的检测、跟踪等核心任务关联较弱。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场，实现表面感知的三维图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 将占用场表示与生成式神经渲染结合，显式建模几何以提升表面一致性。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 在表面感知图像合成任务上优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa._arxiv_id: Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surface-Aware Image Synthesis.
